job.title: Engineering Lead – ERP Services
job.description:
About Us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Together, we help audiences stay better informed and deepen their understanding of the world around them.

Our Product & Tech teams drive us forward in an ever-evolving digital landscape, delivering cutting-edge products to over one million digital subscribers daily. Our growth relies on a diverse, dedicated and dynamic group of product, tech, delivery and data specialists.

With a supportive culture, entrepreneurial spirit and opportunities at every turn, there are no limits to where your FT career can take you.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion

We believe everyone should have a fair opportunity to contribute, succeed, and reach their full potential. That means ensuring everyone is heard, respected, and valued, while identifying and removing barriers that may get in the way. Our commitment is to be an employer role model, grounded in inclusion and fairness for all.We want every application to receive fair and thoughtful consideration; therefore, all applications are reviewed by a member of our recruitment team, not by AI.

About you

You are an experienced engineering leader with strong knowledge of ERP or similarly complex enterprise platforms and a track record of leading teams responsible for business-critical technology.

You combine people leadership with credible technical judgement. You are comfortable setting direction, making engineering decisions and working with your team on complex technical problems, while creating the ownership and autonomy for engineers to succeed.

You understand that enterprise platform engineering goes beyond implementing configuration or coordinating vendors. You think about the entire technology capability: the core platform, integrations, data flows, extensions, operational processes, security, resilience and how the platform evolves over time.

You are comfortable working closely with Finance and other business stakeholders, translating priorities and requirements into sustainable technology solutions and constructively challenging approaches that create unnecessary complexity or risk.

You are also interested in building capability. You can identify gaps in skills and knowledge, develop engineers and create a team that understands and genuinely owns its technology rather than relying disproportionately on individual specialists or external partners.

About the team

ERP Services sits within Corporate Technology, part of Internal Products, and owns the engineering capabilities supporting critical Finance and enterprise business processes across the FT.

The team is responsible for the engineering, operation and continuous evolution of our ERP technology estate, including Oracle Fusion and the integrations, data flows and supporting capabilities that connect it to the wider FT technology landscape.

ERP Services works closely with Finance, Product, Architecture, Integration & Engineering Services, Security and other Corporate Technology teams to ensure these critical enterprise capabilities remain reliable and can evolve as the needs of the organisation change.

We are strengthening the engineering leadership and platform expertise within ERP Services as part of a wider evolution of the Corporate Technology operating model. The Engineering Lead will establish clear platform and team ownership, reporting to the Principal Engineer – Corporate Technology.

What you’ll work on

As Engineering Lead – ERP Services, you will own the engineering, operation and continuous evolution of the FT’s ERP technology capability.

You will lead the ERP engineering team, providing people leadership, technical direction and clear accountability for the health and performance of the platforms and services the team owns.

A key part of the role will be strengthening our internal ERP engineering capability. You will develop the technical knowledge of the team, establish clear ownership of platforms and services and ensure we have the skills and understanding required to operate and evolve our ERP estate effectively.

You will work closely with Product and Finance stakeholders to understand business priorities and translate them into engineering plans, balancing new capabilities and business change with platform health, technical debt and operational investment.

You will also work with the Principal Engineer and Architecture to ensure decisions within ERP Services support the longer-term direction of Corporate Technology and the wider FT technology estate.

Your responsibilities will include

Engineering & Platform Ownership

  • Owning the engineering, operation and continuous evolution of the ERP technology capability.
  • Providing clear technical direction for the platforms, integrations and supporting services owned by ERP Services.
  • Ensuring ERP platforms remain secure, resilient, scalable, maintainable and appropriately supported.
  • Establishing clear ownership across the team for systems, integrations and technical capabilities.
  • Ensuring engineering decisions consider reliability, security, operability, maintainability, cost and long-term sustainability.
  • Maintaining visibility of platform health, technical debt, lifecycle risks and significant dependencies.
  • Working with the Principal Engineer and Architecture on material technical decisions and longer-term platform direction.
  • Ensuring the team maintains sufficient technical understanding of its platforms to make informed decisions and challenge external recommendations.

People & Engineering Leadership

  • Leading, supporting and developing the engineers within ERP Services.
  • Setting clear expectations and providing regular coaching, feedback and career development.
  • Building a team culture based on ownership, accountability, collaboration and constructive technical challenge.
  • Developing ERP and enterprise platform expertise across the team rather than allowing critical knowledge to remain concentrated in individuals.
  • Identifying capability and skills gaps and developing plans to address them through development, recruitment or appropriate external expertise.
  • Creating opportunities for engineers to take greater technical ownership and develop their leadership capability.
  • Supporting recruitment and building a resilient team with the skills required for the future ERP technology landscape.
  • Ensuring appropriate succession and knowledge sharing across critical areas.

Delivery & Planning

  • Working with Product to translate business priorities and technology strategy into clear engineering plans and deliverable outcomes.
  • Owning engineering planning and resource allocation within ERP Services.
  • Ensuring engineering capacity appropriately balances business change, platform improvement, operational work and technical debt.
  • Identifying technical dependencies, risks and constraints early and ensuring these are visible in planning and prioritisation.
  • Ensuring delivery commitments are realistic and supported by appropriate technical understanding.
  • Working across teams where initiatives involve multiple platforms, integrations or engineering capabilities.
  • Providing clear visibility of engineering progress, risks and trade-offs to Product, technology leadership and relevant stakeholders.

ERP Platform Evolution

  • Developing a clear understanding of the current ERP estate and identifying opportunities to simplify, modernise and improve it.
  • Working with Product, Architecture and the Principal Engineer to shape the longer-term evolution of ERP technology.
  • Evaluating platform capabilities and determining when requirements should be addressed through standard functionality, configuration, integration or other engineering approaches.
  • Challenging unnecessary customisation and complexity where more sustainable solutions are available.
  • Ensuring platform upgrades, new capabilities and significant changes are introduced safely and sustainably.
  • Understanding vendor roadmaps and assessing their implications for the FT's technology direction and investment decisions.
  • Ensuring technical debt and lifecycle concerns are actively managed rather than accumulating through incremental business change.

Integration & Enterprise Technology

  • Ensuring the team understands and owns the integrations and data flows connecting ERP with the wider FT technology estate.
  • Working closely with Integration & Engineering Services and other platform teams to establish clear ownership of cross-system capabilities.
  • Ensuring integrations follow appropriate FT engineering and architectural standards.
  • Identifying opportunities to simplify interfaces, reduce duplication and improve reliability.
  • Supporting technical decisions that span ERP, Tax, People and other Corporate Technology capabilities.
  • Ensuring changes within ERP appropriately consider downstream and upstream impacts.

Operational Excellence & Risk

  • Owning the operational performance of ERP Services and ensuring critical services are appropriately monitored and supported.
  • Establishing effective approaches to observability, incident management, problem management, change management and operational readiness.
  • Ensuring recurring incidents and operational problems are investigated to their underlying causes and addressed sustainably.
  • Maintaining appropriate approaches to resilience, disaster recovery and business continuity.
  • Ensuring relevant security, data governance, compliance and technology standards are met.
  • Maintaining visibility of material operational and technical risks and ensuring appropriate mitigation plans are in place.
  • Using operational insight to inform engineering priorities and platform investment.

Vendors & Technology Partners

  • Managing the technical relationship with ERP vendors, implementation partners and specialist service providers.
  • Ensuring external partners are used effectively while maintaining clear internal engineering ownership.
  • Providing informed technical challenge to vendor recommendations and proposed solutions.
  • Ensuring externally delivered work meets FT engineering, security and operational expectations.
  • Building internal knowledge from vendor and partner engagements rather than allowing expertise to remain externally concentrated.
  • Contributing technical input to vendor performance, technology selection and investment decisions.

Stakeholder & Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Building strong working relationships with Product, Finance and other business stakeholders.
  • Translating business requirements and priorities into clear engineering implications, options and trade-offs.
  • Helping stakeholders understand platform constraints, technical risks and investment requirements.
  • Partnering with the Principal Engineer, Architecture, Security and other engineering leaders on decisions that cross platform or organisational boundaries.
  • Working constructively with specialist engineers, including Tax and Compliance engineering, on shared capabilities and dependencies.
  • Representing ERP Services in relevant engineering and technology forums.
Technical and leadership experience we’re looking for
  • Significant experience leading engineering teams responsible for complex, business-critical enterprise technology.
  • Strong experience with ERP platforms or similarly complex enterprise SaaS ecosystems.
  • Experience with Oracle Fusion or comparable enterprise ERP platforms would be highly advantageous.
  • Experience providing both people leadership and technical leadership to engineering teams.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise platform engineering, including integrations, APIs, data flows and system dependencies.
  • Experience owning technology through its full lifecycle, from change and delivery through to production operation and continuous improvement.
  • Experience developing engineering capability and strengthening technical ownership within teams.
  • Experience working with Finance or other complex enterprise business domains.
  • Strong understanding of reliability, security, observability, operational risk and technology lifecycle management.
  • Experience translating business priorities into engineering plans and balancing feature delivery with platform health and technical investment.
  • Experience leading technical decisions involving enterprise SaaS platforms, integrations and supporting services.
  • Experience working with vendors, implementation partners and managed service providers while maintaining internal technical ownership.
  • Experience identifying and addressing technical debt, platform lifecycle concerns and key-person dependencies.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical considerations and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working effectively with Principal Engineers, architects, Product Managers and other engineering leaders.
  • Experience of major ERP transformation, implementation or modernisation would be advantageous.
Characteristics we value
  • Strong engineering judgement and a willingness to remain close to the technology.
  • A strong sense of ownership and accountability for both the team and the platforms it operates.
  • The ability to develop people while setting clear expectations for engineering quality and delivery.
  • Pragmatism when balancing business priorities, technical quality and operational risk.
  • Curiosity and a willingness to develop deep understanding of complex enterprise technology.

  • An instinct for building capability and distributing knowledge rather than becoming the person who owns every technical answer.
  • A collaborative approach to working across Product, business and technology teams.
  • A focus on addressing underlying problems rather than repeatedly managing symptoms.
  • An appreciation for simplicity, resilience and long-term platform sustainability.

job.description:
Location: GA-Atlanta

Job Title:  Promotions Editor - WSB TV

 

Position Overview

WSB TV Channel 2, the #1 television station in Atlanta, Georgia is seeking a dedicated and creative video editor and motion designer to join its marketing & creative services team. You'll edit news promotions, image campaigns, and social content while creating motion graphics and branded assets for marketing campaigns across broadcast, streaming, digital, and social platforms. Your work will help shape how one of the country's leading local television brands connects with its audience.

 

The Promotions Editor works primarily in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, and Avid Media Composer to turn news stories and station initiatives into polished promotions and marketing content. The ideal candidate is a strong visual storyteller who can manage multiple projects and collaborate with marketing producers and other stakeholders in a fast-paced local news environment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Promotional Editing & Storytelling

  • Edit compelling promotional content for daily news, severe weather, investigations, special programming, station branding, and community initiatives.
  • Edit image campaigns for broadcast, streaming, social media, digital platforms, and paid marketing in formats suited to each channel.
  • Use music, pacing, sound design, and visual storytelling to maximize audience engagement.

Motion Design & Visual Branding

  • Design and animate high-quality motion graphics using Adobe After Effects.
  • Develop branded graphics, typography, transitions, and promotional assets for television, streaming, web, and social platforms.
  • Maintain a consistent and polished WSB-TV look across marketing channels.

Content Creation & Digital Media

  • Edit and adapt platform-specific content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Facebook, and emerging platforms.
  • Repurpose broadcast campaigns into social-first content designed to reach and engage more viewers.
  • Stay current on creative trends, editing techniques, storytelling styles, and social media best practices.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

Creative Development & Collaboration

  • Collaborate with marketing producers, news leadership, digital teams, on-air talent, photographers, and other stakeholders to develop campaigns that connect with viewers.
  • Contribute fresh ideas for station initiatives, ratings periods, major news events, and community campaigns.
  • Help bring campaign concepts to life through editing, motion design, and content tailored to each platform.

Asset & Workflow Management

  • Organize and maintain project files, graphic templates, media libraries, and creative assets.
  • Manage multiple assignments while maintaining high creative standards.
  • Ensure deliverables meet technical specifications, brand standards, and platform requirements.
  • Prepare and deliver campaign assets to external media partners and agencies.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 2+ years of professional experience in video editing, motion design, creative services, broadcast promotion, digital media, or a related field.
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects, with experience using Avid Media Composer.
  • Strong understanding of color correction, audio mixing, visual storytelling, branding, typography, composition, and motion design.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and time-management skills.
  • Strong portfolio or demo reel showcasing editing, motion graphics, and creative storytelling.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in local television, news promotion, digital media, agency creative services, or content marketing.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, or similar creative tools.
  • Knowledge of sound design and audience engagement best practices.
  • Photography, videography, or field production experience for assisting on occasional shoots is a plus.

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

About this Role

Semafor is seeking an experienced Contract Audience Booker to lead audience curation, recruitment, and booking for a portfolio of invitation-only executive roundtables.

This role requires a combination of editorial judgment, audience development expertise, and strong operational discipline. The successful candidate will be responsible for assembling high-quality, relevant groups of senior executives aligned with each roundtable's editorial theme and the objectives of its underwriting partner.

The role requires independent ownership of the booking process, close cross-functional coordination, and the ability to deliver a carefully curated audience against defined participation targets.

Key Responsibilities

Audience Strategy & Curation

  • Develop targeted invitation lists for private executive roundtables based on editorial themes, audience briefs, and partner objectives.
  • Identify and prioritize relevant senior executives, decision-makers, and industry leaders.
  • Work with internal stakeholders to ensure the proposed audience meets both editorial standards and partner expectations.
  • Maintain a balanced, high-quality audience mix that supports meaningful discussion and engagement.

Audience Recruitment & Booking

  • Own the invitation and booking process from initial outreach through confirmed attendance.
  • Draft and execute personalized invitations and follow-up communications.
  • Track outreach, responses, confirmed attendees, and declines, maintaining accurate booking records.
  • Proactively manage the recruitment pipeline to meet audience targets and address gaps in representation.
  • Manage substitutions, cancellations, and last-minute changes.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Serve as a key audience contact for internal editorial, events, and partner management teams.
  • Work closely with Partner Management Leads to understand partner priorities, provide booking updates, and manage expectations.
  • Maintain clear, timely communication on booking progress, audience composition, and potential challenges.
  • Ensure all stakeholders have accurate and up-to-date information ahead of each event.

Event Readiness & On-Site Handoff

  • Prepare and finalize attendee lists, briefing documents, and relevant participant information.
  • Coordinate with event operations teams on check-in, seating, and attendee management requirements.
  • Ensure a clear and accurate handoff to on-site teams, including last-minute updates and special considerations.
  • Support final attendance reconciliation and post-event reporting.

What makes you qualified

  • Demonstrated experience in senior-level audience recruitment, executive event booking, or high-touch invitation-only events.
  • Strong research skills and sound judgment in identifying relevant executives and organizations.
  • Excellent written communication and professional outreach skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple booking pipelines and deadlines.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, including experience working across editorial, commercial, and events teams.

job.title: Engineering Manager – Commercial Technology
job.description:
About Us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Together, we help audiences stay better informed and deepen their understanding of the world around them.

Our Product & Tech teams drive us forward in an ever-evolving digital landscape, delivering cutting-edge products to over one million digital subscribers daily. Our growth relies on a diverse, dedicated and dynamic group of product, tech, delivery and data specialists.

With a supportive culture, entrepreneurial spirit and opportunities at every turn, there are no limits to where your FT career can take you.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion

We believe everyone should have a fair opportunity to contribute, succeed, and reach their full potential. That means ensuring everyone is heard, respected, and valued, while identifying and removing barriers that may get in the way. Our commitment is to be an employer role model, grounded in inclusion and fairness for all.We want every application to receive fair and thoughtful consideration; therefore, all applications are reviewed by a member of our recruitment team, not by AI.

About you

You are an experienced engineering leader with a strong software engineering background and a track record of leading teams responsible for business-critical products and platforms.

You combine strong people leadership with credible technical judgement. You are comfortable setting direction, helping teams make complex engineering decisions and remaining close enough to the technology to understand the health, risks and opportunities within the platforms you own.

You understand that engineering leadership is about more than delivery. You think about the long-term health of technology: architecture, reliability, security, scalability, developer experience, operational performance and the ability of teams to evolve their systems sustainably.

You are comfortable working closely with Product and business stakeholders, translating priorities into engineering plans and making thoughtful trade-offs between new capabilities, technical investment and operational needs.

You are also motivated by developing people and teams. You create clear ownership, coach engineers, build capability and create an environment where people can challenge, learn and take increasing responsibility.

About the team

Commercial Technology is part of the Internal Products group within FT Product & Technology. We are a multidisciplinary group of Engineers, Product Managers and Business Analysts responsible for building and operating the technology platforms that support the FT’s commercial capabilities across Marketing, Sales, Service and Commercial Data.

We are undertaking a significant evolution of our commercial technology landscape, bringing these capabilities together around a more connected Salesforce platform and establishing a strong foundation for how our commercial teams engage with customers and use data.

In Marketing & Commercial Data, we are evolving our marketing technology landscape towards Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next and Data 360, while continuing to operate and transition from established platforms including Bloomreach, Marketo and Legacy Salesforce Marketing Cloud products for B2B & B2C marketing.

In Sales & Service, we are consolidating a number of Salesforce CRM orgs with their associated processes and procedures into a leaner Commercial Technology estate, utilising data available to us via Data 360, into a setup that aligns with the FT’s future commercial capabilities and setup.

In Commercial Platform, we are establishing a centre of excellence at the heart of the commercial workflow, tasked with ensuring the security, health and viability of our day-to-day commercial operation and providing a primary support route for our business users

The Engineering Manager will lead one of the engineering teams within Commercial Technology, working closely with Product, Senior Engineers, other Engineering Managers and the wider Commercial Technology leadership team.

Our Technology

Our Commercial Technology landscape is evolving. Technologies and platforms within or interacting with Marketing & Commercial Data include:

  • Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next (Advanced Edition)
  • Salesforce Data 360
  • Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud
  • Sales Collaboration & Enablement Tooling
  • Bloomreach
  • Marketo
  • JavaScript / TypeScript
  • APIs and integration technologies
  • AWS Technologies
  • Data platforms and integrations
  • CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling
  • GitHub
  • Monitoring and observability tooling
  • Jira & Confluence

You do not need experience with all of these technologies to apply. We are particularly interested in engineering leaders who can lead teams through technology change and help engineers develop the skills required for an evolving platform.

What you’ll work on

As Engineering Manager within Commercial Technology, you will lead the engineering team responsible for the delivery, performance and continuous evolution of the FT’s Marketing & Commercial Data capability.

You will be accountable for ensuring the engineering team is effectively organised, supported and resourced to deliver business outcomes. This includes leading delivery and planning, managing engineering capacity and priorities, building strong relationships with Product, Programme and business stakeholders, and ensuring risks, dependencies and resource constraints are understood and actively managed.

You will be leading a team through a significant transformation of the FT's commercial technology landscape, balancing the delivery of new capabilities with the operational health of existing platforms, the development of engineering capability and the longer-term evolution of the Commercial Technology estate.

You will remain close to the technology and provide credible engineering leadership. You will support technical decision-making, challenge approaches where appropriate and ensure the team understands the architecture, risks and operational health of the systems it owns.

You will also work with Principal Engineers and other senior technical leaders on decisions that extend beyond your team's boundaries, ensuring local engineering decisions contribute to a coherent and sustainable Commercial Technology landscape.

You will report to the Principal Engineer for the Commercial Technology domain.

Your responsibilities will include

Engineering Delivery & Planning

  • Own engineering delivery across the Marketing & Commercial Data capability, ensuring agreed business outcomes are delivered effectively and sustainably.
  • Work with Product, Programme, the Technical Lead and wider Commercial Technology leadership to shape priorities, roadmaps and achievable delivery plans.
  • Own the allocation of engineering capacity, balancing delivery commitments with operational needs, technical improvement, team capacity and longer-term capability development.
  • Identify and actively manage delivery risks, dependencies, resource constraints and capability gaps, escalating where necessary.
  • Continuously improve engineering processes, development workflows, documentation and ways of working.

People Leadership & Team Health

  • Leading, supporting and developing engineers, admins and specialists across Marketing Technology and Commercial Data through regular 1:1s, coaching, feedback and career development.
  • Setting clear expectations for individual and team performance
  • Create an inclusive, supportive and psychologically safe environment, building a strong engineering culture based on ownership, collaboration, continuous learning and shared accountability.
  • Manage team capacity and sustainable workloads, supporting the wellbeing, effectiveness and long-term development of the team.
  • Identify skills and capability gaps and work with engineers and wider engineering leadership to develop the capabilities required for our future platform.
  • Lead recruitment, onboarding and organisational change within the capability, ensuring engineers are supported through changes to technology, roles and ways of working.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

  • Partner closely with the Technical Lead – Marketing & Commercial Data, Together you will provide the complementary people, delivery and technical leadership required to operate and evolve our Marketing & Commercial Data capability successfully.
  • Own the organisational conditions required to execute the technical strategy, ensuring teams have the skills, capacity and ways of working required to deliver it successfully.
  • Contribute to technical discussions and decisions while maintaining clear accountability with the Technical Lead for technical direction, architecture, engineering standards and solution design.
  • Build strong relationships with Product, Programme, business stakeholders and other technology teams, providing clear visibility of delivery, capacity, operational health, risks and dependencies.
  • Work closely with Engineering Managers and Technical Leads across Commercial Technology to coordinate shared priorities, dependencies and engineering practices.
  • Work effectively with external technology partners and delivery vendors where required, ensuring they integrate successfully with FT engineering teams and delivery practices.
  • Represent the needs, constraints and capabilities of the engineering team in programme, planning and stakeholder discussions.

Operational Readiness & Engineering Excellence

  • Be accountable for ensuring Marketing & Commercial Data capabilities are operationally ready, supportable and sustainable throughout their lifecycle.
  • Ensure operational requirements are built into delivery, including observability, monitoring, resilience, documentation, support models, knowledge transfer and clear ownership.
  • Work closely with the Commercial Platform team to ensure new and changed capabilities can be effectively supported within the wider Commercial Technology operating model.
  • Ensure the team remains engaged in the ongoing health of the capabilities it owns, providing specialist domain or engineering expertise when required.
  • Lead the Marketing & Commercial Data team's response to incidents affecting capabilities it owns, working within the Commercial Technology incident-management model led by Commercial Platform.
  • Ensure operational health, capability risks, technical debt and engineering improvements are visible and prioritised alongside product and programme delivery.
  • Ensure learning from incidents, operational issues and business-user feedback is incorporated into future delivery and continuous improvement.

Change & Platform Evolution

  • Lead the engineering team through the evolution of the FT’s Marketing & Commercial Data technology landscape.
  • Support the transition from legacy marketing platforms, including Bloomreach and Marketo, towards the FT’s strategic Salesforce-based marketing and data capabilities.
  • Own the people, skills and team structure required to support the transition to the future Marketing & Commercial Data platform, ensuring the capability can be sustainably owned beyond programme delivery.
  • Work with the Technical Lead, Commercial Platform and wider Commercial Technology leadership to introduce platform changes sustainably and maintain operational continuity.

Leadership experience we’re looking for

  • Experience managing or leading software engineers within a collaborative engineering environment.
  • Strong coaching, feedback and people-development skills, with experience helping engineers progress in their careers.
  • Experience leading engineering delivery across complex platforms or products.
  • Experience balancing strategic programme delivery with operational responsibilities and longer-term engineering priorities.
  • Strong understanding of engineering practices associated with secure, resilient and scalable production systems.
  • Experience supporting teams responsible for operating and continuously improving business-critical technology.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working in partnership with senior technical leaders, architects or Technical Leads.
  • Comfortable operating across Product, Engineering, Data, Programme and business stakeholders.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity, organisational change and evolving priorities.
  • Experience leading teams through significant platform or technology transformation would be beneficial.
  • Experience with Salesforce, marketing technology, customer data platforms or enterprise SaaS ecosystems would be beneficial, but is not essential.

Characteristics we value

  • A people-first approach to engineering leadership.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills.
  • Empathy, emotional intelligence and a commitment to developing others.
  • A strong sense of ownership and accountability for outcomes.
  • Pragmatism and sound judgement when balancing business, people and engineering needs.
  • The ability to create clarity and structure in complex or ambiguous environments.
  • Curiosity and a willingness to continuously learn.
  • An appreciation for strong engineering practices, operational excellence and sustainable technology.
  • Calmness under pressure and the ability to lead teams through challenging situations.
  • A collaborative mindset and willingness to work across organisational and technology boundaries.
  • An interest in how technology and data can enable better customer experiences and commercial outcomes.

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location, but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for all roles. We believe this balanced approach supports flexibility and protects our culture, making collaboration and communication easier, building stronger relationships and team cohesion, and supporting peer learning.  We reserve discretion on reasonable notice to change this approach either generally or for specific individuals or teams.

job.title: Senior II Engineer - Commercial Technology
job.description:
About Us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Together, we help audiences stay better informed and deepen their understanding of the world around them.

Our Product & Tech teams drive us forward in an ever-evolving digital landscape, delivering cutting-edge products to over one million digital subscribers daily. Our growth relies on a diverse, dedicated and dynamic group of product, tech, delivery and data specialists.

With a supportive culture, entrepreneurial spirit and opportunities at every turn, there are no limits to where your FT career can take you.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

 

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion

We believe everyone should have a fair opportunity to contribute, succeed, and reach their full potential. That means ensuring everyone is heard, respected, and valued, while identifying and removing barriers that may get in the way. Our commitment is to be an employer role model, grounded in inclusion and fairness for all.We want every application to receive fair and thoughtful consideration; therefore, all applications are reviewed by a member of our recruitment team, not by AI.

 

About you

You are an experienced senior engineer and technical leader with a strong software engineering background and a track record of providing technical direction across business-critical products and platforms.

You combine deep technical expertise with pragmatic engineering judgement. You are comfortable navigating complex systems, shaping architecture, making and facilitating significant technical decisions, and helping engineering teams turn business requirements into secure, resilient and sustainable solutions.

You think beyond individual features and solutions to the long-term health of the technology: architecture, reliability, security, scalability, operability, developer experience, technical debt and the ability of teams to evolve their systems sustainably.

You are comfortable working with engineers, Product, Programme and business stakeholders, communicating complex technical considerations clearly and making thoughtful trade-offs between immediate delivery needs and longer-term technical investment.

You are also motivated by developing engineering capability. While this is not a people-management role, you will mentor engineers, encourage technical ownership, create opportunities for others to develop their expertise and help build a strong engineering culture based on learning, collaboration and constructive technical challenge.

 

About the team

Commercial Technology is part of the Internal Products group within FT Product & Technology. We are a multidisciplinary group of Engineers, Product Managers and Business Analysts responsible for building and operating the technology platforms that support the FT’s commercial capabilities across Marketing, Sales, Service and Commercial Data.

We are undertaking a significant evolution of our commercial technology landscape, bringing these capabilities together around a more connected Salesforce platform and establishing a strong foundation for how our commercial teams engage with customers and use data.

In Marketing & Commercial Data, we are evolving our marketing technology landscape towards Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next and Data 360, while continuing to operate and transition from established platforms including Bloomreach, Marketo and Legacy Salesforce Marketing Cloud products for B2B & B2C marketing.

In Sales & Service, we are consolidating several Salesforce CRM orgs with their associated processes and procedures into a leaner Commercial Technology estate, utilising data available to us via Data 360, into a setup that aligns with the FT’s future commercial capabilities and setup.

In Commercial Platform, we are establishing a centre of excellence at the heart of the commercial workflow, tasked with ensuring the security, health and viability of our day-to-day commercial operation and providing a primary support route for our business users

The Technical Lead will provide technical leadership for one of the engineering capabilities within Commercial Technology, working closely with the Engineering Manager, Product, engineers, other Technical Leads and the wider Commercial Technology leadership team.

 

Our Technology

Our Commercial Technology landscape is evolving. Technologies and platforms within or interacting with Marketing & Commercial Data include:

  • Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next (Advanced Edition)
  • Salesforce Data 360
  • Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud
  • Sales Collaboration & Enablement Tooling
  • Bloomreach
  • Marketo
  • JavaScript / TypeScript
  • APIs and integration technologies
  • AWS Technologies
  • Data platforms and integrations
  • CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling
  • GitHub
  • Monitoring and observability tooling
  • Jira & Confluence

You do not need experience with all of these technologies to apply. We are particularly interested in engineering leaders who can lead teams through technology change and help engineers develop the skills required for an evolving platform.

 

What you’ll work on

As Technical Lead within Commercial Technology, you will provide technical leadership for the engineering capability responsible for the delivery, operation and continuous evolution of the FT’s Marketing & Commercial Data technology.

You will be accountable for the technical direction and engineering integrity of the capability, ensuring our technology is secure, resilient, scalable, maintainable and aligned with wider Commercial Technology and FT engineering standards. You will lead architectural thinking, guide significant technical decisions and ensure technical risks, dependencies and opportunities are understood and actively managed.

You will help lead the technical transformation of the FT’s commercial technology landscape, shaping the transition from our established marketing platforms towards Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next, Data 360 and the wider Commercial Technology ecosystem while ensuring our existing technology remains sustainable throughout that transition.

You will work in close partnership with the Engineering Manager – Marketing & Commercial Data. Together, you will provide the complementary people, delivery and technical leadership required to operate and evolve the capability successfully. The Engineering Manager is primarily accountable for people leadership, delivery, capacity and operational coordination, while you will be primarily accountable for technical direction, architecture, engineering standards and technical sustainability.

You will remain close to engineering delivery, working directly with engineers to solve complex technical problems, review and challenge approaches, improve engineering practices and create opportunities for engineers to develop greater technical ownership and expertise.

You will also work with the Principal Engineer, Principal Architect and other senior technical leaders on decisions that extend beyond your capability, ensuring local technical decisions contribute to a coherent and sustainable Commercial Technology landscape.

You will report to the Principal Engineer for the Commercial Technology domain.

 

Your responsibilities will include

Technical Direction & Architecture

  • Own the technical direction for the Marketing & Commercial Data capability, ensuring technology decisions align with the wider Commercial Technology strategy and FT engineering standards.
  • Lead architectural thinking and significant technical decisions across the capability, balancing immediate delivery needs with security, resilience, scalability, maintainability and long-term sustainability.
  • Establish and champion appropriate engineering standards, patterns and practices across the team.
  • Maintain visibility of architecture, technical debt, lifecycle risks, dependencies and emerging technology opportunities.
  • Work with the Principal Engineer, Principal Architect and other Technical Leads on decisions that span multiple capabilities, platforms or technology domains.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify, modernise and improve the technology landscape while avoiding unnecessary complexity and duplication.

Engineering Quality & Technical Leadership

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership and guidance to engineers while creating appropriate autonomy for individuals to make decisions and take ownership of the technology they work with.
  • Mentor engineers and technical specialists, helping them develop their technical expertise, engineering judgement and confidence in making technical decisions.
  • Support engineers through complex technical challenges without becoming the decision-maker or implementation owner for every issue.
  • Promote strong engineering practices including testing, automation, observability, security, documentation and sustainable software development.
  • Encourage constructive technical challenge, knowledge sharing and continuous learning across the team.
  • Work with the Engineering Manager to identify technical skills and capability gaps and help develop the engineering capabilities required for our future platform.

Delivery & Collaboration

  • Partner closely with the Engineering Manager – Marketing & Commercial Data to ensure technical strategy, people, delivery and operational priorities remain aligned.
  • Provide technical input into roadmaps, planning and prioritisation, ensuring delivery plans are technically achievable and account for complexity, dependencies, technical risk and longer-term investment.
  • Work with Product, Programme and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into appropriate technical approaches and clearly communicate technical considerations, trade-offs and opportunities.
  • Identify technical risks and dependencies early and work with the Engineering Manager and wider Commercial Technology leadership to ensure they are understood and appropriately managed.
  • Work closely with Technical Leads, Engineering Managers and engineers across Commercial Technology to coordinate technical decisions and shared dependencies.
  • Work effectively with external technology partners and delivery vendors, providing technical direction and ensuring solutions align with FT architecture, engineering standards and practices.

Operational Excellence & Technical Health

  • Be accountable for the technical health and sustainability of the Marketing & Commercial Data capabilities throughout their lifecycle.
  • Ensure solutions are designed and engineered with appropriate consideration for security, resilience, scalability, observability, maintainability and supportability.
  • Work with the Engineering Manager and Commercial Platform team to ensure new and changed capabilities are operationally ready and can be effectively supported within the wider Commercial Technology operating model.
  • Provide technical leadership during incidents affecting Marketing & Commercial Data capabilities, supporting diagnosis, technical decision-making and sustainable resolution.
  • Ensure technical debt, lifecycle risks and engineering improvements are visible, understood and appropriately considered alongside product and programme priorities.
  • Ensure learning from incidents and operational issues informs architecture, engineering standards and future technical decisions.

Change & Platform Evolution

  • Provide technical leadership for the evolution of the FT’s Marketing & Commercial Data technology landscape.
  • Shape the technical transition from established marketing platforms, including Bloomreach and Marketo, towards the FT’s strategic Salesforce-based marketing and data capabilities.
  • Define and evolve the architecture, engineering patterns and technical practices required to support the future Marketing & Commercial Data platform.
  • Work with the Engineering Manager to ensure the team develops the technical skills and knowledge required to own and evolve the future platform sustainably.
  • Work with Commercial Platform, other Technical Leads, the Principal Architect and the Principal Engineer to ensure platform changes integrate coherently with the wider Commercial Technology ecosystem and maintain operational continuity.

 

Technical and Leadership experience we’re looking for

  • Experience managing, leading or designing a Customer Data Platform, ideally utilising Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next and Data 360.
  • Significant software engineering experience working with complex production systems, platforms or enterprise technology.
  • Experience providing technical leadership across engineering teams or significant technology capabilities.
  • Strong architectural and engineering judgement, with experience making and guiding significant technical decisions.
  • Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices and the design of secure, resilient, scalable and maintainable systems.
  • Experience identifying and managing technical debt, architectural risk, technology lifecycle concerns and cross-system dependencies.
  • Experience working closely with engineers to solve complex technical problems while enabling others to take ownership and develop their expertise.
  • Experience balancing immediate delivery needs with longer-term architecture, engineering quality and technical investment.
  • Strong understanding of operational excellence, observability, reliability and production engineering.
  • Experience working effectively with Product, Engineering, Data, Programme and business stakeholders.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical considerations and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working across teams and influencing technical decisions beyond your immediate area.
  • Experience leading technical change across significant platform or technology transformations would be beneficial.
  • Experience with Salesforce, marketing technology, customer data platforms, enterprise SaaS ecosystems or complex integration architectures would be beneficial, but is not essential

 

Characteristics we value

  • Strong technical judgement and curiosity.
  • A strong sense of ownership and accountability for technical outcomes.
  • Pragmatism when balancing technical quality, delivery needs and operational risk.
  • An ability to make complex technical concepts understandable.
  • Confidence challenging technical approaches constructively.
  • An instinct for enabling and mentoring engineers rather than becoming the person through whom every technical decision must pass.
  • An appreciation for simplicity, reliability and long-term technical sustainability.
  • A collaborative approach to working across Engineering, Product, Data and business teams.
  • Calm and clear technical leadership during incidents and periods of change.
  • Curiosity and a willingness to continuously learn.
  • An interest in how technology and data can enable better customer experiences and commercial outcomes.

 

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location, but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

We’ve embraced a 50% hybrid working model (averaging two to three days onsite) that fosters trust and remote adaptability while encouraging in-person camaraderie and peer learning. Additionally, we are open to accommodating specific flexible working pattern requests for all roles where feasible.

job.description:
iHeartMedia Markets

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as a Multi-Market Brand Integrations Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As a Multi-Market Brand Integrations Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.  


Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!  

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return

  • General understanding of business principles and sales environment

  • Interest in developing knowledge of business operations and sales concepts and techniques

  • Individual accountability and understanding of when to seek guidance

  • Skills managing assigned projects to completion

  • Understanding to resolve problems using established guidelines and professional judgement

  • Ability to communicate information about iHeart products in a digestible manner and to apply active listening skills to validate understanding of customer needs

  • Understanding of impact of your own decisions

  • Goal orientation and the ability to focus and prioritize

                                                                             

Location:

Columbus, OH: 2323 West Fifth Avenue, Suite 200, 43204

                                                                             

Position Type:                                                                                             

Regular

job.title: Spring 2027 FOX Sports - Big Ten Network - Internship Program - Chicago, IL
job.description:
FOX is proud to support a culture of creativity, entrepreneurial spirit and community that attracts the industry’s brightest talent. The FOX Internship Program offers an exciting opportunity for you to gain practical experience while interning for one of the biggest sports, media, and entertainment companies in the world. You will have the opportunity to participate in real-world projects, which provides valuable work experience and leadership skills.

Please note that this internship is an on-site opportunity in Chicago, IL.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Studio Production: The Studio Production intern’s responsibilities include helping our studio shows by logging and cutting VO elements, bumps, highlights, and montages. Interns are integral in working closely with producers and announcers on all our shows, including B1G Today, pregames, halftimes, postgames and B1G Shows.
  • Media Management: The Media Management intern will assist the media management department in transferring our library to cloud storage. This will include metadata tagging and understanding nomenclatures within our ecosystem. The role will also assist with day-to-day workflows as needed, including fulling requests from networks, athletic departments, vendors, and other stakeholders.

  • Must be actively enrolled in an accredited college or university and pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree during the length of the program 
  • Current class standing of sophomore, (second-year college student) or above
  • Strong academic record 
  • Committed and available to work for the entire length of the program
  • Access to own housing and transportation to/from the assigned Internship site
  • Must be able to work on-site in Chicago, IL

  • Share your top areas of interest

Are required to provide a copy of an unofficial transcript or letter from the adviser/registrar showing proof of enrollment

AREAS OF PLACEMENT:
Depending on your area of interest, you’ll have an opportunity to participate in one of the following below. Please include one top area in your cover letter. 

  • Media Management
  • Studio Production

SPRING 2027 SCHEDULE:

General Application Deadline: Sunday, November 22, 2026

Program Timeline: Monday, February 8, 2027 - Friday, April 16, 2027

Scheduled Weekly Hours: 16 - 24 hours per week 

NOTE: Schedules vary based on department needs and your availability. We do our best to work around your class schedule.


STANDING OUT AS A TOP CANDIDATE:

Successful students have: 

  • Knowledge of current Big Ten Network programming and talent
  • The ability to maintain a professional demeanor when interfacing with talent and executives.
  • Knowledge of software/technical skills applicable to your areas of placement.
  • Knowledge of and passion for a variety of sports
  • A detail-oriented nature with strong organizational skills
  • Self-starter attitude and team player
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to handle a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite

PROGRAM FEATURES:

job.title: Director, Acquisition Marketing (LATAM)
job.description:
The FOX direct-to-consumer (DTC) platform is a new, forward-looking initiative within Tubi Media Group that brings FOX’s unparalleled content portfolio—news, sports, and entertainment—directly to consumers via an innovative subscription streaming service.

Driven by a highly experienced leadership team with extensive backgrounds at the intersections of media, technology, streaming, and content—and built with the full support of Fox Corporation—this venture combines entrepreneurial energy with deep media expertise.

Our vision is to create a unified, modern viewing experience that puts the consumer first—seamlessly integrating live and on-demand content across platforms.

At the intersection of cutting-edge technology and trusted storytelling, this is an opportunity to shape the future of streaming at one of the most pivotal moments in media. We’re assembling a world-class team to deliver on that vision—and we’re just getting started.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a strategic, results-driven Director, Acquisition Marketing (LATAM) to lead FOX One's subscriber acquisition strategy and paid media investment across Latin America. As FOX One expands its international footprint, this leader will play a critical role in developing and scaling regional growth strategies, driving efficient subscriber acquisition, and establishing a strong market presence across LATAM.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Acquisition Marketing, this role will serve as the primary strategic lead for LATAM acquisition marketing, overseeing multi-million-dollar media investments, agency partnerships, and regional campaign performance. The Director will collaborate closely with U.S.-based leadership and international marketing teams while providing dotted-line leadership to LATAM-based team members.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in performance marketing, international media strategy, and incrementality-based measurement, along with the ability to balance short-term subscriber growth objectives with long-term brand development. This individual will be instrumental in shaping FOX One's regional acquisition roadmap, identifying opportunities to scale investment, and building a sustainable, data-driven growth engine across Latin America.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own and lead FOX One's subscriber acquisition strategy across LATAM, developing regional growth plans that align with global business objectives, subscriber targets, and market expansion priorities.
  • Manage and optimize multi-million-dollar paid media budgets across LATAM markets, driving investment decisions, resource allocation, and acquisition efficiency to maximize subscriber growth and return on marketing investment.
  • Provide strategic oversight of integrated paid media campaigns across paid social, paid search, Youtube, display, and connected TV (CTV), ensuring effective planning, execution, and optimization across markets.
  • Serve as the acquisition lead for LATAM, partnering with the U.S.-based leadership and regional stakeholders to translate global growth strategies into locally relevant marketing initiatives.
  • Establish and advance incrementality-based measurement frameworks, including geo-lift studies, marketing mix modeling (MMM), and holdout/control testing, to evaluate media effectiveness and inform investment decisions.
  • Lead and develop strategic relationships with media, creative, and measurement agency partners, establishing performance expectations, accountability, and opportunities for innovation.
  • Provide dotted-line leadership and strategic direction to LATAM-based team members, fostering collaboration, accountability, and alignment across regional and global teams.
  • Own regional acquisition performance reporting, including CPA/CPS, subscriber growth, campaign pacing, and marketing efficiency, delivering actionable insights and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Partner with measurement, analytics, creative, product, and international marketing teams to develop integrated go-to-market strategies that support FOX One's regional launches and ongoing growth.
  • Identify emerging market opportunities, evolving consumer behaviors, and competitive dynamics to inform regional acquisition strategies and long-term investment planning.
  • Drive continuous improvement in regional marketing operations, establishing scalable processes, testing frameworks, and best practices that support FOX One's international expansion.
  • Travel throughout LATAM markets as needed to strengthen strategic partnerships, support market launches, and deepen understanding of local market dynamics.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Typically, 10+ years of progressive experience in performance marketing, subscriber acquisition, growth marketing, or digital media, including significant experience leading acquisition strategies and large-scale paid media investments.
  • Professional-level fluency in Spanish, including the ability to participate in business meetings.
  • Extensive experience overseeing multi-million-dollar paid media budgets and driving investment decisions across paid social, paid search, online video (OLV), display, and/or connected TV (CTV).
  • Proven ability to lead and manage external media agency partners, establish strategic priorities, and drive accountability for performance and execution.
  • Deep expertise in incrementality-based measurement, including geo-lift studies, marketing mix modeling (MMM), holdout/control testing, and other advanced marketing effectiveness frameworks.
  • Strong strategic and analytical capabilities, with the ability to translate complex performance data into actionable business recommendations and investment decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, navigate cross-functional organizations, and align regional execution with broader business priorities.
  • Experience providing leadership, mentorship, or strategic direction to cross-functional or geographically distributed teams.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship management skills, with the ability to operate effectively across multiple markets and time zones.
  • Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace a minimum of 3 days per week is an essential function of the position. Selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally throughout Latin America as needed to support business operations, market launches, and strategic partnerships.

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Demonstrated expertise in building and executing user growth initiatives across Mexico, Central America, or South America, leveraging a nuanced knowledge of regional consumer habits and media landscapes.
  • Experience leading subscriber acquisition or growth marketing for streaming, subscription-based, or direct-to-consumer (DTC) businesses.
  • Experience developing market-entry strategies or scaling consumer subscription products across international markets.
  • Familiarity with the competitive streaming and digital media landscape across Latin America.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KUSA KTVD-TV Denver, the TEGNA-owned NBC affiliate in Denver, is seeking a proven, results-driven Account Executive to grow new business and manage a book of advertising clients across one of the strongest cross-screen portfolios in the market. This is a seat for a closer who can walk into a business owner's office or an agency pitch, uncover what's really driving their marketing decisions, and build the multi-platform solution that wins the budget. 

You'll sell the full weight of TEGNA: the mass reach and trust of NBC broadcast television paired with the targeting and growth of streaming. On the linear side, you'll connect advertisers to the large, engaged local audiences that tune in to Denver's trusted news and programming. On the streaming side, you’ll leverage Premion, TEGNA’s streaming and CTV advertising business, to deliver premium, brand-safe connected-TV inventory. Premion’s curated marketplace includes 125+ OTT and CTV publishers, offering the same premium environments national buyers demand. Layered with digital video, display, and content solutions, it's a cross-screen story few competitors can match and in your hands, a clear advantage in every pitch. 

We give experienced sellers the portfolio, the autonomy, and the support to build something significant. Top performers grow their books, their earnings, and their careers. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Drive new business. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of local and regional advertisers, connect with key decision-makers and create opportunities across broadcast TV, Premion streaming/CTV and digital.
  • Sell strategically and consultatively. Uncover each client's real business goals, read the market and competitive landscape, and architect tailored, multi-platform solutions that tie directly to measurable outcomes. 
  • Own the full sales cycle. Prospect, qualify, present, negotiate and close business while consistently meeting activity and revenue targets.
  • Grow and defend the book. Turn accounts into long-term partnerships; expand them through smart upsell and cross-sell across the portfolio and stay close enough to results to renew and grow every cycle. 
  • Pitch with data. Build compelling, insight-driven proposals that show advertisers exactly how broadcast reach and connected-TV targeting combine to deliver ROI. 
  • Run your business. Manage pipeline, forecast accurately, and keep deals moving in CRM and partner with account, creative, and product teams to deliver campaigns that perform and retain. 

Requirements:  

  • 3+ years of media, digital, or advertising sales experience with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets in a competitive market 
  • Demonstrated ability to prospect, open new business, and build a self-sustaining pipeline. You don't wait for leads 
  • Command of the modern media landscape: broadcast television, streaming/CTV, programmatic, digital video, display, social, and content 
  • Experience selling to business owners and/or agencies, and the presence to lead the room in a strategic pitch 
  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills 
  • Fluency in turning data and analytics into a clear ROI story clients believe 
  • Proficiency with CRM and Microsoft Office; familiarity with Google Analytics, DSPs/SSPs, and ad-management tools a plus 
  • Valid driver's license with the ability to travel locally to meet clients and partners as needed 

Salary: Competitive base + commission

 

The application deadline for this position is Dec 4, 2026

Pay Range$50,000—$200,000 USD

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year.

job.title: Sales Planner
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

Job Description

The New York Times' Advertising team is looking for a Sales Planner who is a digital and integrated sales plan expert. You will oversee the pre-sale process and ensure quality service to our advertisers from reservations and media plan creation and occasional post-sale activity on print campaigns. This is a hybrid role based in our New York headquarters, reporting to the Senior Manager, Sales Planning . You can typically expect to be in the office 3 days per week.

About the Role: 

You will serve as the support for a dynamic digital and integrated sales organization for a pod of sales professionals. A large part of the work will develop digital and integrated media plans that lead to sales campaign success and renewal. You will become knowledgeable about the sales process and serve as a team liaison with advertising agencies and clients as well as with internal groups. 

Responsibilities:

  • Guide logistical flow of pre- and post-digital and print ad campaigns, working on behalf of sales with other departments such as Research, Ad Ops, Sales Development, Ad Products and the Content Studio.
  • Support development of RFP (Requests for Proposal) process using the full scope of NYT ad products that address the advertiser’s needs and campaign goals for both print and digital. 
  • Build and revise media plans, check avails, reserve fixed placements and update associated fixed placement calendars.  Enter final plans into online proposal systems such as Atlas and Media Visor, et al.
  • Update Salesforce database throughout the sales process with necessary account information, including Opportunities, Call Reports, Rate Adjustments.
  • Respond to servicing and information requests from team members and advertisers; work with multiple teams to gather information for customers, or to fulfill requests, such as tickets for events, comp subscriptions.
  • Coordinate and schedule various meetings for accounts such as client tours, meetings and brainstorming meetings with internal support teams.
  • Manage the digital process workflow from RFP to IO and liaise with key approval stakeholders in AdOps, Revenue Analytics, Legal, Ad Product, Research and Strategy.
  • Understand the full suite of NYT products across all platforms and how to work with other New York Times Advertising departments, eg: Creative Strategy, T Brand Studio, Yield, Ad Operations/Campaign Management, Operations, etc.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications:

  • BS/BA degree
  • 2+ years media experience
  • 2+ years of experience with Microsoft and Google Suite applications
  • 2+ years of experience with Sales Force

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working in an Advertising or Publication industry
