Real Chemistry is seeking an  AI Transformation Senior Analyst to help reimagine how our business runs. You will join our transformation team, working alongside ambitious, supportive, and hard-working colleagues who always seek to do things better, faster, and smarter.

As an AI Transformation Senior Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in mapping how work gets done today and designing how it should get done in an AI-enabled future. Starting with our General & Administrative (G&A) functions, including finance, accounting, operations, resource management, marketing, legal, and internal communications, you will document current-state processes and operating models, design future-state alternatives, and help bring them to life across several AI transformation initiatives. You will also build the business case for each opportunity and prioritize initiatives based on the value they deliver. You will look holistically across people, processes, systems, and vendors to determine what should be automated or redesigned and which solution best fits each need, from a reusable AI skill to an end-to-end Copilot Cowork workflow or a coordinated team of AI agents. This position reports to the Vice President, Strategy and Revenue Analytics.

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What you'll do:

  • Map current-state processes: Lead process discovery with G&A stakeholders across finance, accounting, operations, resource management, marketing, legal, internal communications, and more to document how work gets done today, including handoffs, systems, data flows, vendors, pain points, and the time and cost behind each step.
  • Design future-state operating models: Translate current-state findings into practical future-state designs that rethink roles, responsibilities, governance, and ways of working, rather than simply digitizing today's processes.
  • Identify and prioritize automation opportunities: Assess where AI and automation can eliminate, streamline, or augment manual work, build business cases that size the impact, and shape a prioritized transformation roadmap.
  • Match the right solution to the problem: Determine the right fit for each need, whether a reusable AI skill, a Copilot Cowork workflow, a coordinated swarm of AI agents, an enhancement to an existing system, or a process change with no new technology at all, and partner with technical teams to pilot and scale solutions.
  • Get more from current automations: Inventory and assess the automations and tools already in place, identify gaps and redundancies, and recommend how to extract more value from existing investments.
  • Rethink sourcing and vendors: Analyze what we outsource versus perform in-house, assess vendor fit and cost, and determine where AI enablement means outsourced work should instead be automated or brought in-house.
  • Drive change and adoption: Partner with function leaders to plan and execute transitions, including change management, training, communications, and success measures that make new ways of working stick.
  • Advise leadership: Develop clear, executive-ready materials, including process maps, operating model blueprints, business cases, and roadmaps, and communicate findings and recommendations with clarity and confidence.

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if you:

  • Think like a consultant and act like an owner, bringing structured problem solving and a bias for action to ambiguous, cross-functional challenges.
  • Are energized by rethinking traditional processes for the age of AI, and stay curious about emerging tools, agents, and automation approaches.
  • See the whole picture across people, processes, systems, vendors, and data, and understand how a change in one area ripples through the others.
  • Are highly organized, proactive, and resourceful, adept at managing multiple workstreams and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment while delivering results under tight deadlines.
  • Build trust quickly with stakeholders at every level, from individual contributors to senior leadership, and can guide teams confidently through change.

What you should have:

  • 2–5 years of experience in strategy, transformation, or digital consulting (e.g., McKinsey, BCG, Bain, EY-Parthenon, Deloitte Digital, or similar firms, large or boutique), or in a corporate strategy, transformation, or M&A integration role.
  • Hands-on experience with transformation work, such as digital transformation, M&A integration, acquisitions, or divestitures, including process mapping, integration or separation planning, Day 1 readiness, or operating model design.
  • Demonstrated experience mapping current- and future-state processes and designing target operating models, ideally across G&A or back-office functions.
  • Working knowledge of AI and automation tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, generative AI assistants, AI agents, workflow automation platforms such as Power Automate or Workato, or RPA) and the ability to translate business needs into practical automation use cases.
  • Proficiency with process mapping and analysis tools (e.g., Visio, Lucidchart, Miro, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Exceptional analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex findings simply and confidently to senior leadership.
  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • PR, communications, advertising, healthcare, or agency experience a plus.

Real Chemistry is looking for an Associate Director, Social Media to join our growing Activation team. This is role for someone who is ready to help manage high-quality social programs, develop smart content and keep complex work moving across healthcare clients. 

For us, social isn’t just a channel — it’s a craft. Our team brings together healthcare knowledge, creative thinking, content development, paid media awareness and strong execution to help clients show up with purpose across platforms. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. This role will primarily support East Coast working hours; candidates based in other time zones may be considered if they are comfortable working East Coast hours.

  • Bring an integrated social and digital lens to the work, connecting day-to-day social execution to broader communications goals and client priorities.

  • Help guide team members by providing direction, feedback and support on content, timelines, reporting and client-ready deliverables.

  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.  
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.  
  • You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact. 

What you should have:  

  • 5–8 years of social media, digital marketing or integrated communications experience, ideally in healthcare, biotech, pharma or another regulated industry. 
  • Agency or client-service experience, with the ability to manage multiple projects, priorities and stakeholders at once. 
  • Experience coordinating social content development, review processes, calendars, campaign materials and client-ready deliverables. 
  • Experience guiding or mentoring team members 
  • Comfort balancing hands-on social work with project coordination, client communication, team support and new business or organic growth needs. 
  • College degree required; BA or equivalent preferred; understanding of FDA, fair balance, adverse event and client review considerations preferred. 
  • Strong social media judgment, including the ability to develop content plans, post copy, briefs, recommendations and executional materials that align to strategy. 
  • Understanding of major social platforms, audience behavior, platform-native content best practices and the role of social within broader healthcare communications. 
  • Ability to contribute to channel recommendations, paid social approaches, influencer considerations, content calendars and social media reports that tell a clear story.

Anchored by a rich longitudinal patient database, combined with market leading ML capabilities, Real Chemistry is laser focused on the transformation of data into actionable insights and commercialization strategies.

The Director has a multi-faceted role, with a primary responsibility for exceptional client delivery and strong client relationships. The Director also plays an active role in the sales process, communicating the value of Real Chemistry and uniquely identifying solutions to clients’ business problems. Therefore, this role will straddle both sales and delivery, and provide a critical linkage between the two functions. Delivery

The Director will lead multiple, parallel consulting engagements leveraging health claims data to address client needs. The role will encompass both external, client-facing and internal project leadership responsibilities. The delivery role will involve solutioning for internal Real Chemistry teams as well as external clients, and the clear and detailed translation of sold engagements to the operations team for analysis, while simultaneously managing ongoing project delivery.   • Conduct thorough quality control (QC) measures and pressure-test analysis outputs based on desk research and experiential logic
  • Derive insights and create PowerPoint stories from secondary claims data that address client needs/questions, with comfort delivering presentations to internal teams or brand/analytics teams within external organizations

Business Development

The Director also proactively identifies and qualifies leads, supporting teams across the agency to develop, assess, and solution for multiple qualified opportunities at any given time. The Director understands unique client business problems and translates solutions into sales support materials and development of sales-related presentations. Responsibilities include:

  • Cultivate relationships with existing clients and contacts within the biopharma industry, generate interest for Real Chemistry analytics offerings, and translate to sales opportunities
  • Identify client opportunities proactively, and work with Managing Principal and sales team to qualify and pursue sales leads
  • Support the Managing Principal and Sales Lead in developing sales materials for identified opportunities
  • Design and develop strategies and methodologies to deliver against client needs, and translate into compelling sales and pitch materials

  • Assist the Managing Principal and Sales Lead in identifying upselling opportunities

  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

What you should have:

  • 10+ years of relevant experience using real-world data to develop and implement cross-functional solutions in large organizations
  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree strongly preferred (MBA, MPH, PhD, PharmD, MD, MS, or equivalent) in economics, epidemiology, public health, biostatistics, health services research, business, marketing, communications, or related discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in the development of productized solutions utilizing real-world data to support advertising, communications, medical, media, and commercial clients.

Real Chemistry is seeking a hands-on Director, Technical Product Operations to own the end-to-end management, operation, and security of our flagship client-facing SaaS products.  These platforms are hosted in Amazon Web Services (AWS), delivered to clients as a commercial product, engineered to be SOC 2 compliant, and increasingly powered by AI-enabled features.

This is a working leadership role — not a purely strategic one. The successful candidate is a technically credible, roll-up-your-sleeves operator who has personally implemented and run a product on AWS infrastructure, and who can lead a team while remaining directly engaged in architecture, deployment, security, and production support. You will be the single point of accountability for platform availability, performance, security posture, and the fully-supported client experience.

What you'll do:

Platform Ownership & AWS Operations

  • Own the full lifecycle of the client-facing SaaS products hosted on AWS — from infrastructure design and deployment through ongoing operation, optimization, and support.
  • Architect, implement, and maintain scalable, resilient AWS environments (compute, storage, networking, databases, backups) with clear separation across development, staging, and production.
  • Lead high-availability and disaster-recovery (HA/DR) design, including backup, failover, and recovery procedures, to meet client and contractual uptime commitments.
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform), CI/CD pipelines, and controlled promotion paths between environments.
  • Own observability — metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting — and drive continuous improvement of platform performance and cost efficiency (FinOps).

Security, Compliance & SOC 2

  • Maintain and continuously mature the platform's security posture, ensuring controls are designed, implemented, evidenced, and audit-ready.
  • Own SOC 2 compliance for the platform — partnering with Information Security and external auditors to sustain Type I and progress toward Type II attestation.
  • Enforce least-privilege identity and access management (AWS IAM), encryption in transit and at rest, secrets management, and tamper-evident audit logging.
  • Coordinate third-party penetration testing, vulnerability management, and remediation within defined risk timelines.
  • Ensure client-facing security, data-handling, and confidentiality requirements are met and clearly documented for client assurance.

AI-Enabled Product Features

  • Support the secure integration and operation of AI/ML and LLM-enabled features within the product, including approved AI providers, usage boundaries, and cost guardrails.
  • Partner with engineering and data teams to productionize AI capabilities with appropriate data classification, DLP, and human-in-the-loop controls where required.

Support, Reliability & Client Experience

  • Ensure the product is fully supported — establishing SLAs, incident response playbooks, on-call coverage, and runbooks for production systems.
  • Serve as senior escalation point for platform incidents, driving rapid resolution and transparent client communication.
  • Own change management, release governance, and post-incident reviews to continuously improve reliability.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Lead, and mentor the external IT / platform engineering team, setting technical standards and delivery discipline.
  • Partner closely with Information Security, Product, and Client-facing teams to align platform capabilities with commercial and client needs.
  • Communicate platform health, risk, and roadmap clearly to both technical teams and executive / C-suite stakeholders.
  • Manage relationships with key vendors and third parties (AWS and supporting services).

Required Qualifications

  • Hands-on track record — the candidate must be a practitioner who has personally implemented and operated a product on AWS infrastructure, not solely a manager of others who do.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing a product on AWS (compute, networking, databases, IAM, IaC) from build through production operation.
  • 7+ years in IT / platform engineering / cloud operations, including 3+ years operating production workloads in AWS.
  • Prior leadership or people-management experience, ideally leading external IT, DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering functions.
  • Strong working knowledge of SOC 2 (and adjacent frameworks) and the practical implementation of the underlying controls.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), CI/CD pipelines, and cloud security best practices (least-privilege IAM, secrets management, logging/audit).
  • Proven ownership of production reliability — SLAs, incident response, on-call, and HA/DR.
  • Excellent communication skills — equally comfortable with hands-on technical teams and C-suite stakeholders.

 

What you should have:

  • Experience delivering a client-facing / commercial SaaS product (multi-tenant, externally sold).
  • Experience productionizing AI / LLM-enabled features and governing AI usage, data handling, and cost.
  • Familiarity with regulated or enterprise-client environments (HIPAA-adjacent, GDPR, GxP).
  • Experience with containerization/orchestration (ECS/Fargate, EKS), AWS Lambda, and observability tooling.
  • Relevant certifications (AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps / Security, CISSP, CCSP).
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

 

Pay Range: $200,000-$235,000

The Manager, Paid Social is responsible for social campaign paid planning, strategy, execution, implementation, and delivery to meet client objectives. 

You’ll be the day-to-day partner to strategy & account teams and will leverage your knowledge of paid social media to support strategy development and delivery. In support of our mission to help life-changing medicines and therapies reach their full market potential, we are building an enterprise platform for omnichannel orchestration in healthcare marketing.

Our technology enables healthcare organizations to design, deploy, and optimize HCP journeys through a scalable, self-service product that connects to their existing marketing and data systems. Real Chemistry is looking for an experienced Senior Analyst (Omnichannel Analytics) to help us build and scale our business intelligence practice for our media and omnichannel clients through advanced analytics, insights, and attribution modeling. We are looking for someone with hands-on-keyboard experience crafting analyses that answer clients’ key business questions about media performance. Reporting to the Director, Beyond Insights, this position will be client facing, with the opportunity to speak to ongoing deliverables and work with cross-functional media, strategy, and technology teams. You will get to use a new set of data partners to seamlessly integrate media and channel data flowing from partners into Tableau dashboards and ultimately client-facing performance reports.

Primary Responsibilities 

  • Build, manage, and deliver time-based performance reporting for media and omnichannel campaigns (weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting) 
  • Integrate media, channel, and partner data sources into Tableau dashboards and client-facing performance reports 
  • Conduct data exploration, cleaning, analysis, visualization, and mining across structured media and marketing data sources 
  • Develop quantitative analyses, predictive models, and attribution approaches that explain how media programs are performing and where to optimize 
  • Craft analyses and insights that answer clients’ key business questions, and present findings directly to client and internal stakeholders 
  • Partner with media, strategy, data engineering, and marketing technology teams on measurement methodology and campaign execution 

Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Business, Finance, Economics, Marketing, or a related field 
  • 5+ years of experience in business intelligence/advanced analytics/data analytics working closely with data 
  • Pharmaceutical media and marketing experience, with hands-on exposure to HCP and/or consumer omnichannel campaigns 
  • Experience with statistical and general-purpose programming languages for data analysis, including the development of algorithms leveraging SQL, R or Python 
  • Experience working with relational databases and with Snowflake or Databricks 
  • Experience with visualization tools/packages such as Tableau or PowerBI, and with creating dashboards 
  • Experience with reporting in media tools like Google Campaign Manager, Doubleclick Campaign Manager and Adobe Experience Manager 
  • Experience building reports in Google Slides or Microsoft PowerPoint for presentations to senior clients externally or to senior internal stakeholders 
  • Formal training/education in quantitative/data analysis, and an understanding of causal inference 
  • Understanding of visual information design principles 
  • Knowledge of agile principles/project management and experience with agile tools and methodologies 

The Ideal Candidate 

  • Creative. You are energized by turning messy, multi-source media data into clear answers to real business questions. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers 
  • Customer first. You enjoy client-facing work and can explain your analysis and its implications to a non-technical audience 
  • A collaborator. You thrive in cross-functional teams and are comfortable working across Media, Analytics, Strategy, and Technology partners 
  • A culture carrier. You embody Real Chemistry’s values of Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an “I.”

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry Media

Real Chemistry Media is transforming how medical and healthcare marketers engage healthcare professionals (HCPs) and consumers through data, technology, and omnichannel innovation. Real Chemistry Media's product and technology teams sit at the heart of this meaningful work by building tools that increase impact. In support of our mission to help life-changing medicines and therapies reach their full market potential, we are building an enterprise platform for omnichannel orchestration in healthcare marketing.

Our technology enables healthcare organizations to design, deploy, and optimize HCP journeys through a scalable, self-service product that connects to their existing marketing and data systems. The platform is live with early users and on track with rapid growth milestones, so the decisions made over the next year will be influential in shaping the product's future.

We are hiring a Technical Project Manager to run delivery across the platform. Reporting to the VP, Product, you will be the person who knows where every workstream stands and what needs to happen for the team to be unblocked. This role covers software delivery for a product team, including sprints, releases, and dependencies across teams. The team is small and we're building a lot, so there are a lot of opportunities for ownership and influence.

What You'll Do:

  • Run the delivery plan for the platform, including coordinating milestones and the dependencies between teams.

  • Own Agile ceremonies and keep sprints, backlogs, and release schedules up to date and easy to access.

  • Coordinate delivery across internal teams and external partners, keeping commitments and handoffs clear on both sides.

  • Track blockers and scope changes early and drive decisions with the right people in the room.

  • Manage release coordination across environments and teams.

  • Give leadership and stakeholders a clear, current picture of status and timelines.

  • Build the delivery process as the team scales, knowing when to adjust so it can be followed by all.

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

What You Should Have:

  • 4+ years managing software delivery for product or engineering teams, in B2B or enterprise software.

  • Experience coordinating one program across multiple external vendors or partners and several internal teams.

  • Strong Agile fluency, including running ceremonies, managing backlogs, and adapting the process to the team rather than the reverse.

  • Enough technical depth to follow conversations about APIs, data pipelines, environments, and releases, and to ask the question that surfaces a risk.

  • Skill at turning an ambiguous set of workstreams into a plan people can act on.

  • Experience managing dependencies and timelines across teams you do not manage.

  • Fluency with delivery and tracking tools such as Jira, Asana, GitHub, or Linear, including keeping them accurate as a source of truth.

  • Ability to communicate status and tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Bonus points for martech, adtech, orchestration tooling, or healthcare experience.

 

Pay Range: $90,000-$100,000

job.title: Director Global Public Affairs Healthcare (all genders)
job.description:
Director Global Public Affairs, Healthcare (all genders)

FGS Global is the world’s leading stakeholder strategy firm, with approximately 1,400 professionals around the world, advising clients in navigating critical issues and reputational challenges. FGS was formed from the combination of Finsbury, The Glover Park Group, Hering Schuppener and Sard Verbinnen & Co to offer board-level and C-suite counsel in all aspects of stakeholder strategy — including corporate reputation, crisis management, and public affairs and is also the leading force in transaction and financial communications worldwide.  

FGS offers seamless and integrated support with offices in the following locations: Abu Dhabi, Amsterdam, Beijing, Berlin, Boston, Brussels, Calgary, Chicago, Dubai, Dublin, Düsseldorf, Frankfurt, Hong Kong, Houston, Kingston, London, Los Angeles, Munich, Paris, Riyadh, San Francisco, Shanghai, Singapore, South Florida, The Hague, Tokyo, Toronto, Vancouver, Washington, D.C., and Zurich. The firm is headquartered in New York.  

FGS is consistently ranked a Band 1 PR firm for Crisis & Risk Management and for Litigation Support by Chambers and Partners.  For the second year, FGS was ranked #1 Global M&A PR firm by Deal Count and Value in 2024 by Mergermarket. 

Our Global Public Affairs experts advise companies and investors on the impact of political, policy, and regulatory developments on their businesses and strategic positioning. This includes advocacy support, political due diligence, media engagement, and advice on the optimal organization of firms' governmental relations and policy functions. Our Brussels office serves as the EU hub of FGS Global.

We are looking for a Director to join our Global Public Affairs Healthcare team in Brussels. This is a senior role at the intersection of healthcare policy and business strategy - one that spans EU institutions, national markets across Europe, and global mandates. You will work alongside a dedicated Brussels-based healthcare team and collaborate across FGS's European and global network.

 

Join our team in Brussels as Director Global Public Affairs Healthcare (all genders)

 

What tasks can you look forward to?

Client Leadership

  • Client account management: Lead client relationships across European markets and drive cross-sell opportunities across practice areas and geographies. Global mandates will be part of the mix.
  • Policy depth: Serve as the go-to expert on healthcare policy across EU institutions and key European markets. Stay ahead of regulatory and policy shifts to inform client advice and engagement strategies.
  • Policy foresight: Develop and continually refresh relevant, practical, and forward-looking insights - written and oral - for existing clients and in support of new business opportunities.

Team & Practice Development

  • Team management: Guide and develop the Brussels healthcare team - serving as a mentor and day-to-day lead, while remaining hands-on to ensure excellent delivery.
  • Sector group contribution: Contribute actively to FGS's European Healthcare Sector Group - including credentials, thought leadership, event strategy, and internal knowledge-sharing across offices.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Relationship building: Identify, map, and build effective relationships with senior policy, political, and regulatory stakeholders across EU institutions, member states, and relevant international bodies.

New Business

  • Pipeline development: Work hand-in-hand with the firm's Partners to build and grow a pipeline of new clients and projects. Drive pitch preparation and delivery, and bring an entrepreneurial mindset to identifying opportunities across sectors and markets.

What should you bring along?

The ideal candidate is a healthcare policy expert who understands commercial models well enough to translate how policy and regulatory change affects investors and businesses active in Pharma, Medical Devices, Biotech, and Digital Health. You are comfortable working across European markets - including the U.K. and Switzerland - and ideally have exposure to global campaigns or the Washington policy environment.

  • Bachelor's degree plus an MPA, MBA, or similar policy or business-related Master's degree.
  • 7+ years' experience in government, parliament, international organizations, a regulator, trade association, political party, policy-focused public affairs agency, management consultancy, or strategic advisory firm. Candidates with direct policy experience inside a Pharma, MedTech, BioTech, or Digital Health company are equally welcome.
  • Deep knowledge of EU policy-making processes and significant experience advising clients on European healthcare policy, politics, and regulation.
  • Comfort working across multiple European markets simultaneously, with an understanding of how national dynamics interact with EU-level developments.
  • Ability to engage directly with senior policymakers, regulators, and their networks -- often independently and with limited senior support.
  • Demonstrated ability to provide crisp, clear, logical analysis in both written and oral form, adaptable to different audiences.
  • Confidence presenting to, engaging with, and advising senior clients and contacts.
  • Experience managing and developing junior colleagues, with a genuine commitment to their growth.
  • Entrepreneurial approach to building teams and new business pipelines.
  • Excellent project and team management skills.
  • Exposure to Washington, D.C. policy dynamics or experience running global campaigns is a plus but not a requirement.


What we can offer you

  • A senior role within one of the world's leading strategic advisory firms, working on high-profile mandates across EU institutions, national markets, and global clients.
  • The opportunity to contribute to and shape FGS's European Healthcare practice.
  • Exciting mandates and real development prospects across sectors, geographies, and practice areas.
  • An inspiring working environment, with the opportunity to work at one of our international offices for a limited period of time.
  • Induction and individual support from experienced Partners.
  • Continuous development through close collaboration with integrated project teams and the FGS Global Academy.
  • A dedicated and supportive team.
  • A corporate culture that combines excellence with team spirit, and a flexible working model across our offices and from home.

 

You don’t meet every single requirement? Don’t worry! Studies have shown that some groups of people are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every qualification. At FGS Global, we are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. So, if you’re excited about this role and our company, but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or another role. 

We look forward to receiving your application. Please include a cover letter, an up-to-date CV, as well as relevant degree and employment certificates. Do you have further questions about the position, FGS Global, or beyond? 

You can find more information here: FGS Global

job.title: Enablement Lead EMEA
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

The Enablement Lead, EMEA accelerates adoption of WPP Enterprise Technology products in market for WPP Media. The role translates global product strategy into regional rollout plans, orchestrates stakeholder readiness, and measures value realization (adoption %, time-to-value, enablement NPS), ensuring that enterprise platforms deliver outcomes for agencies and markets in the region

What you'll be doing:

Strategy & Demand

  • Shape and qualify market demand; align initiatives with domain roadmaps and architecture.
  • Translate global product strategies into regional execution plans and benefit hypotheses.
  • Feed demand into governance forums (e.g., PRB/TSB) with clear business cases and readiness criteria.

Rollout & Governance

  • Design localized rollout plans with dependencies, risks, controls and cutover steps.
  • Run governance cadences (weekly status, risk/issue logs, QBRs) and maintain Wrike dashboards.
  • Ensure compliance with local regulations, info-security and change standards.

Stakeholders & Communications

  • Act as the primary interface between product teams and markets; orchestrate two-way feedback.
  • Prepare townhall decks, leadership briefings and market comms; support hiring/enablement needs.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to remove blockers and drive decisions.

Measurement & Improvement

  • Define and track KPIs for adoption and time-to-value; publish enablement scorecards.
  • Run launch retrospectives; update playbooks and prerequisites based on insights.
  • Contribute to portfolio-level reporting on value, efficiency and cost avoidance.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Platform adoption (e.g., OMS/Choreograph modules) vs baseline: +20–30% YoY
  • Time-to-launch for prioritized products: ≤ agreed SLA from gate to go-live
  • Enablement satisfaction/NPS from stakeholders: ≥ 60
  • Readiness index (prerequisites met pre-launch): ≥ 90%

What you'll need:

  • Significant experience in enterprise technology enablement, program management, or regional rollout leadership within matrixed organisations
  • Proven stakeholder engagement at senior levels; ability to influence without authority.
  • Experience leading multi-market product rollouts with clear governance and benefit tracking.
  • Data-driven approach to enablement design and measurement (dashboards, adoption analytics).
  • Fluent English (written & verbal).

Nice-to-have

  • Certifications: Prosci/ADKAR, PMP/Prince2, Agile (Scrum/SAFe).
  • Experience with media/advertising operations.
  • Exposure to regional compliance topics (privacy, labour, finance controls).

Tools & Platforms

Required: Wrike (or equivalent PM tool), one HRIS (e.g., Workday), one ERP (e.g., D365).Preferred: Choreograph/OMS, Chase Media, Adaptive, Power Platform.

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

 

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

job.title: Senior Data Engineer
job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM:

At TelevisaUnivision, we are the world's leading Spanish-language media company, reaching millions of consumers across digital, streaming, social, audio, linear television, and live events. As we continue expanding our global streaming platform, ViX, we are investing heavily in technology, data, and innovation to deliver exceptional subscriber experiences and drive long-term business growth.

 

The Data Engineering team designs, builds, and operates the high-volume, high-velocity data pipelines that power ViX, including playback and engagement events, subscription data, advertising data, and the analytics data warehouse that turns them into business decisions. The team works closely with Engineering, Product, Data Science, and Analytics teams across TelevisaUnivision.

 

The Senior Data Engineer will play a key role in the design, development, and deployment of our streaming data platform. You will own production data pipelines end to end, from real-time ingestion through modeled, analytics-ready data, and partner with data science, analytics, and product teams to understand their data needs and drive initiatives to completion.

 

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with a collaborative mindset, a passion for solving complex data challenges, and a commitment to delivering high-quality solutions at scale.


ABOUT YOU:

You are a data engineering professional who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and enjoys transforming complex data into actionable business value.

 

You bring:

·       Deep expertise in modern cloud-based data platforms, particularly Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, and Cloud Composer

·       Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, and data transformation frameworks such as dbt

·       Hands-on experience building both batch and real-time (streaming) data pipelines at scale

·       Experience working with large-scale distributed systems and big data technologies, including Spark and Hadoop

·       Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Pulumi or Terraform

·       Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to design scalable and efficient solutions

·       Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively

·       Outstanding communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to partner across technical and non-technical teams

·       A continuous improvement mindset and passion for mentoring and knowledge sharing

 

YOUR DAY-TO-DAY: (Responsibilities)

Data Platform Development

·       Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reliable, and efficient batch data pipelines using Airflow (Cloud Composer), Python, SQL, and dbt

·       Build and maintain real-time ingestion pipelines that land event data from Pub/Sub into Cloud Storage and BigQuery using Dataflow

·       Build and optimize dimensional data models and workflows in the analytics data warehouse to support reporting, analytics, machine learning, and product initiatives

·       Own assigned pipelines end to end, from design and development through testing, deployment, and production support

·       Ensure data quality, integrity, security, and availability across the data ecosystem


Cross-Functional Collaboration

·       Partner with Product Managers, Data Scientists, Analysts, and Engineering teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions

·       Contribute to data architecture discussions and long-term platform strategy

·       Collaborate with stakeholders to identify opportunities for process improvements and operational efficiencies


Performance & Optimization

·       Optimize data storage, processing, and orchestration for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency, including BigQuery query and storage costs

·       Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve data pipeline and platform issues, and contribute to incident reviews

·       Implement best practices for data governance, observability, testing, and CI/CD


Leadership & Team Contribution

·       Mentor and support junior data engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, and knowledge sharing

·       Contribute to architectural decisions and engineering best practices

·       Participate in technical interviews and help grow a high-performing data engineering team

 

YOU HAVE: (Qualifications, Experience)

Required Experience & Skills

·       Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field

·       7+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Warehousing, or Big Data environments

·       Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL

·       Hands-on experience building and owning production-grade, end-to-end data pipelines

·       Strong experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, and Cloud Composer; AWS experience will also be considered

·       Experience with workflow orchestration and transformation tools such as Airflow and dbt

·       Experience building real-time or near-real-time data pipelines

·       Strong understanding of data warehousing best practices, including relational and dimensional modeling

·       Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Pulumi or Terraform

·       Solid understanding of distributed data processing frameworks, including Spark

·       Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities

Preferred Qualifications

·       Experience supporting machine learning and data science workflows

·       Familiarity with data observability, data quality frameworks, and CI/CD practices

·       Experience working within subscription-based, media, streaming, or digital product organizations

 

 

ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS

  • Must be authorized to work in the United States
  • Employment/education will be verified

·       Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis

 

 

OUR BENEFITS:

This is in addition to a comprehensive and competitive health benefits package featuring medical, dental, and vision coverage options.

job.title: Digital & Social Platform Editor
job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

About the Role

Semafor is seeking a Digital & Social Platform Editor to help amplify our journalism across platforms and formats.

This is not a  traditional “social posting” role. We’re looking for someone who understands how modern media travels — across video, live events, podcasts, breaking news, YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, Reddit, X, and emerging platforms. The right candidate understands that packaging and distribution is editorial — and an important part of propelling our journalism forward.

This role sits at the center of newsroom, audience, video, audio, and events. You’ll help shape the strategy for how Semafor’s journalism is framed, edited, clipped, promoted, and distributed in real time . 

You should have strong editorial instincts, comfort with video and light editing workflows, sharp news and platform judgment, and a deep understanding of how to create platform-native content that drives reach without compromising editorial quality. Interest in business, politics, media, technology, and global affairs is important.

Responsibilities

Packaging & Distribution of Our Best Journalism

  • Work with newsroom leaders to identify the strongest moments, angles, and formats for distribution across scoops, breaking news, enterprise reporting, interviews, video, podcasts, and live journalism
  • Develop deep relationships with distribution platforms, with a special focus on LinkedIn, YouTube and X 
  • Package and distribute Semafor journalism across social and digital platforms in formats optimized for each audience and channel
  • Write platform-native copy, headlines, captions, hooks, and framing that increase engagement and discoverability
  • Publish and optimize content across LinkedIn, X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging platforms

Video & Live Content

  • Support rapid-turnaround distribution from Semafor events, including clipping live mainstage conversations in real time, or editorial video
  • Knowledge of analytics, audience development, and platform performance trends
  • Interest in business, politics, media, technology, and global affairs
  • Work closely with video and audio producers to extend the reach and lifecycle of original content
  • Execute social video editing, formatting, subtitling, and platform optimization
  • Ability to clip, package, and publish short-form video from interviews, podcasts, newsroom shoots, and live events

Events & Promotion

  • Support promotional campaigns for Semafor events, franchises, and editorial launches
  • Coordinate social coverage plans and live posting during major convenings and newsroom moments
  • Help extend the reach of Semafor’s live journalism before, during, and after events
  • Develop and implement promotion plans for shows and big events across all platforms

Audience & Editorial Collaboration

  • Partner closely with the newsroom and audience teams to identify distribution opportunities and audience growth strategies
  • Apply editorial judgment to determine what content should travel, where it should live, and how it should be framed
  • Monitor performance trends, audience behavior, and platform shifts to inform publishing strategy
  • Maintain Semafor’s editorial standards, voice, and accuracy across all distributed content

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience in social media, audience development, digital publishing, or platform distribution
  • Strong editorial instincts and understanding of news judgment
  • Experience publishing across major social and video platforms, with a particular focus on LinkedIn, YouTube, X, and Reddit
  • Understanding of platform-native storytelling and audience behavior
  • Ability to work quickly and calmly in a fast-paced newsroom and live event environment
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills
  • Experience covering or supporting live events
  • Familiarity with Premiere, CapCut, Descript, or similar editing tools
  • Experience working with a wide array of journalists, newsroom teams

Compensation: The salary range for this role is $100,000 - $120,000 annually based on individual candidate experience and skills.

Additional job details

Semafor offers a Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) policy to our full-time, salaried employees who may take paid time off as-needed without a prescribed limit or defined balance.

job.description:

Join the 2027 New York Times Fellowship class as a reporter.

The Times is looking for fellows who have strong writing and reporting fundamentals, and who are eager to learn and work with others. The program is an opportunity to stretch your journalistic skills alongside the world’s best editors and reporters. You would be assigned to a news or features department, and directly report to editors on your desk. 

Many of your stories may take the form of traditional reported articles. But you could also write live updates and explainers, as well as pieces that put visuals first. You should be eager to participate in these different kinds of storytelling and to engage with readers in a variety of ways.

The most competitive candidates will be those who submit a variety of published clips that show excellence — in breaking news, high-impact news stories, features and/or thoughtful, reported analytical pieces. 

These are in-office positions and include regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance. You may be required to work some nights, weekends and holidays as needed.

Responsibilities: 

  • Deliver a mix of breaking news and enterprise assignments
  • Participate in training and social programs designed for the fellowship
  • Collaborate with colleagues across the newsroom
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world

  • No more than five years of full-time, professional journalism experience, excluding internships
  • Can demonstrate clear prose, evocative writing, and original and impactful reporting

  • Record of multiple news internships or equivalent news experience

job.title: Associate Director, Omnichannel & Media Strategy
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry Media is a fully integrated media, analytics, technology, and customer engagement organization that helps healthcare brands create meaningful, measurable connections with their audiences. The Omnichannel Strategy team sits at the center of this ecosystem, partnering closely with Media, Analytics, CRM, Engagement, Creative, Technology, and Client Services teams to design customer-centric experiences that align business objectives, audience needs, and channel activation. Our strategists help clients move beyond channel planning to deliver coordinated engagement across the full customer journey. 

The Associate Director, Omnichannel & Media Strategy will lead the development of omnichannel engagement strategies for assigned brands, products, and business challenges, grounded in a strong understanding of media strategy and how paid media connects across the broader customer experience. This role translates audience insights, customer needs, media behaviors, market dynamics, and business objectives into actionable journey architectures, media and channel strategies, and engagement plans that drive measurable outcomes.   As a strategic leader, you will guide audience segmentation, customer journey development, media and channel planning, engagement strategy, and orchestration design while serving as a trusted strategic partner to clients and internal teams. You will collaborate across Media, Analytics, CRM, Creative, Engagement, and Client Services to create integrated experiences that connect customer needs with business goals.

What you’ll do 

  • Architect omnichannel engagement strategies with media strategy at the core, connecting paid media with owned, earned, CRM, field, and digital channels.
  • Lead audience segmentation, persona development and customer prioritization across healthcare professional, patient, caregiver and other relevant audiences. 
  • Design end-to-end customer journeys that identify audience needs, barriers, behaviors, triggers and engagement opportunities. 
  • Develop media and channel orchestration frameworks that define the role of paid media and connect it effectively across owned, earned, field, CRM, and digital touchpoints.
  • Lead client and internal workshops focused on audience strategy, journey design and engagement planning. 
  • Define measurement frameworks, testing plans and strategic requirements for CRM, analytics and engagement platforms. 
  • Translate client needs, market research, media and campaign performance, and audience insights into clear strategic recommendations for cross-functional teams.
  • Oversee supporting strategists, delegate work and review deliverables for strategic quality and consistency. 
  • Contribute to scoping conversations and manage multiple client workstreams to established timelines and utilization expectations. 

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if 

  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines. 

What you should have 

  • Demonstrated experience developing media strategy, ideally within healthcare, pharmaceutical marketing, or another highly regulated or complex industry.
  • Strong understanding of paid media strategy and how channels such as paid search, paid social, programmatic, video, and other digital media work together within an omnichannel ecosystem.
  • Experience leading client workshops, strategic planning sessions or collaborative working sessions.
  • Strong understanding of how paid media connects with owned channels, CRM, field engagement, content and digital experiences.
  • Ability to translate research, data, media performance and campaign results into strategic recommendations. 
  • Experience overseeing junior strategists and providing feedback, training or quality review.
  • Strong client communication, presentation development and facilitation skills. 

 

Pay Range: $90,000-$115,000

This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting.  Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, skills, certifications, and geographical location. The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. 

Real Chemistry is proud to be Great Place to Work® certified; check out what our people shared about our culture and workplace on our Great Places to Work Profile here.

We believe we can do our best when feeling our best, which is why we’ve put together a benefits program designed to give you the support you and your family need at every stage of life. Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefit program and perks, tailored to your region. Globally, this includes offices in our key markets with free snacks to keep you running all day long, generous holiday and paid time off, options for private medical, dental, and vison plans, and support in saving for the future. Other perks include mental wellness coaching and support and access to more than 13,000 online classes with LinkedIn Learning.  Learn more about our great benefits and perks and search specific offerings in your region at: www.realchemistrybenefits.com.

At Real Chemistry, we believe we're at our best when we're connected. Our Real Hybrid and Regional Teams (Real HART) approach is designed to foster collaboration, learning, innovation, and meaningful relationships while providing flexibility where appropriate. Because our workforce spans multiple countries, regions, and client needs, work arrangements may vary by role and location. Some positions offer hybrid or remote flexibility, while others require regular in-office presence. For example, certain teams and regions, including some of our UK operations, have office-based requirements. Your recruiter will discuss the specific expectations for the role you're pursuing during the interview process and keep you informed throughout the hiring journey. For employees located within a one-hour commute of a Real Chemistry office, we require in-person attendance two days per week, either from a Real Chemistry office or when working onsite with clients. Employees in regions without a nearby office may work remotely and come together throughout the year for collaboration, culture-building, learning, and team connection opportunities. While these guidelines reflect our current workplace model, we understand that everyone’s circumstances are unique. If you require additional flexibility, we welcome an open conversation with your recruiter and our HR team to discuss your needs and determine what may be possible.

Real Chemistry is an Equal Opportunity employer. We continually strive to build and sustain an inclusive and equitable work environment where our employees feel empowered to leverage all they bring from their personal lived experience and professional expertise, to make our team the best in the industry.   • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.

  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

  • Relevant degree in a scientific subject

  • Excellent business communication skills, including informal/formal presentation and writing skills

  • Excellent business communication skills

  • Informal/formal presentation and writing skills; including presenting to clients

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Executive Assistant to the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) is a critical partner in ensuring the success of The Washington Post’s financial leadership. This role requires a high level of professionalism, confidentiality, and strategic awareness, providing seamless administrative and operational support to the CFO while navigating a fast-paced, high-stakes environment.


The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver with exceptional organizational skills, a service-minded attitude, and the ability to manage competing priorities with discretion, efficiency, and diplomacy. You’ll be responsible for maintaining the CFO’s calendar, coordinating cross-functional meetings, managing communications, and supporting the broader Finance team through administrative coordination and internal event planning. This is an opportunity to contribute meaningfully to the success of our finance function while working closely with senior leaders at The Washington Post. 


What Motivates You 

  • You thrive on supporting a senior leader in a complex, fast-moving organization. 
  • You take initiative, anticipate needs, and provide solutions before problems arise.
  • You are energized by juggling multiple priorities and keeping everything organized. 
  • You enjoy being the reliable force behind the scenes that helps an executive and their team thrive.
  • You build strong, trusting relationships across functions and with all levels of an organization. 

 

How You’ll Support The Mission  

  • Provide high-level administrative support to the CFO, including calendar management, travel coordination, and preparation of meeting materials.
  • Act as a liaison between the CFO and internal/external stakeholders, ensuring timely communication and follow-ups.
  • Support executive’s decision making for specific meetings, projects, or events by understanding the roles and responsibilities of employees in different departments within the organization, building relationships with colleagues across teams, and gathering and synthesizing relevant information to ensure successful outcomes. 
  • Draft, proofread, and edit professional correspondence, and basic presentation materials using available technology to improve quality and efficiency.

  • Support scheduling meetings with external guests by greeting the guests, completing security checks, and setting up food and drinks. 
  • Provide budgeting support, invoice review and contract management. 

 

The Skills and Experience You Bring 

  • At least 7 years of executive support experience; experience supporting a financial executive is a plus. 
  • 2+ years of experience in operations, project management, process improvements, etc. 
  • Experience reviewing, tracking, and managing contracts. 
  • Professional maturity and ability to remain calm and flexible under pressure. 
  • Outstanding interpersonal skills and attention to detail. 
  • Proven organizational acumen and interdepartmental coordination skills.

  • Ability to multitask and prioritize workload with minimal supervision 
  • Excellent editing and proofreading skills 
  • Strong consulting and project management skills. 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. 
  • Ability to work fast and well under pressure.

 

Collaboration makes us stronger. That’s why our offices are designed with open layouts, modern technology, and easy access to transportation. With certain exceptions for newsgathering and business travel, we work on-site five days a week.

job.title: Account Manager (Healthcare Communications)
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for an Account Manager to join our growing team!

Real Chemistry is looking for driven, savvy game changers who are ready to dive into the trenches and make an immediate impact. We are currently seeking an Account Manager with client services experience in healthcare. The position offers a great opportunity for an individual with a passion for healthcare to work with leading clients in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical devices and health IT fields. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What You’ll Do:

  • Responsible for exceptional client service and account management activities for 3-4 accounts
  • In collaboration with account associate, senior management and project management staff, drive flawless and timely project execution and high-touch client communications
  • Participates in development of clients’ marketing strategies and tactics; collaborates with multiple internal stakeholders to ensure consensus around tactics’ scope and approach
  • Support overall account development, resourcing fiscal performance and growth
  • Support day-to-day client contact in executing ad hoc requests and delivering planned activities and materials
  • Develop draft scope of works, contracts, presentations, creative briefs, PR and marketing materials and other internal/external communications
  • Ensure client feedback is gathered, understood and addressed as appropriate across deliverables and internally
  • Document status and otherwise communicate need-to-know information to all project stakeholders to ensure progression along critical path
  • Sets meetings, provides agendas and contact reports
  • Ability to run client calls or meetings independently
  • Manage account finances; must be able to track budget, raise invoices and POs

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

 

What You Should Have:

  • Highly organized with a mindfulness of deadlines, the ability to manage multiple tasks based on priorities and a strong attention to detail
  • Independent thinker confident in taking ownership of assets and material development, but a team player who enjoys collaboration
  • Professional presence, performs with a sense of urgency and with a client service orientation
  • Has confidence to manage upward when required; able to communicate with managers when deadlines will not be met or when issues are foreseeable
  • High energy, able to effectively operate in fast-paced, growing and evolving environment
  • Demonstrated strong work ethic, with a track record of following through on client requests and with high-quality deliverables on schedule and on budget
  • Has good understanding of social media vehicles and is comfortable managing and drafting communications around them
  • Strong written and oral communication and presentations skills
  • Good management of Microsoft Office tools (PowerPoint, Word, Excel) – particularly PowerPoint
  • Excellent business communication ability including informal/formal presentation and writing skills; this includes confident public speaking both internally and externally with clients, vendors, and affiliates
  • Ability to mentor junior staff and delegate accordingly in order to achieve project deadlines
  • Able to communicate with managers when deadlines will not be met
  • Able to devise and articulate solutions to problems on an ongoing basis
  • Able to clearly communicate project updates, scopes and recommendations to clients
  • Ability to develop project scopes and client and vendor contracts
  • Demonstrated experience with media monitoring, research and taking on projects with limited supervision
  • BA or equivalent work experience require

Pay Range: $63,000-$72,000 
This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting.  Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, skills, certifications, and geographical location. The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time.

Other perks include mental wellness coaching and support and access to more than 13,000 online classes with LinkedIn Learning.  Learn more about our great benefits and perks and search specific offerings in your region at: www.realchemistrybenefits.com.
