job.title: Engineering Lead – ERP Services
job.description:
About Us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Together, we help audiences stay better informed and deepen their understanding of the world around them.

Our Product & Tech teams drive us forward in an ever-evolving digital landscape, delivering cutting-edge products to over one million digital subscribers daily. Our growth relies on a diverse, dedicated and dynamic group of product, tech, delivery and data specialists.

With a supportive culture, entrepreneurial spirit and opportunities at every turn, there are no limits to where your FT career can take you.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion

We believe everyone should have a fair opportunity to contribute, succeed, and reach their full potential. That means ensuring everyone is heard, respected, and valued, while identifying and removing barriers that may get in the way. Our commitment is to be an employer role model, grounded in inclusion and fairness for all.We want every application to receive fair and thoughtful consideration; therefore, all applications are reviewed by a member of our recruitment team, not by AI.

About you

You are an experienced engineering leader with strong knowledge of ERP or similarly complex enterprise platforms and a track record of leading teams responsible for business-critical technology.

You combine people leadership with credible technical judgement. You are comfortable setting direction, making engineering decisions and working with your team on complex technical problems, while creating the ownership and autonomy for engineers to succeed.

You understand that enterprise platform engineering goes beyond implementing configuration or coordinating vendors. You think about the entire technology capability: the core platform, integrations, data flows, extensions, operational processes, security, resilience and how the platform evolves over time.

You are comfortable working closely with Finance and other business stakeholders, translating priorities and requirements into sustainable technology solutions and constructively challenging approaches that create unnecessary complexity or risk.

You are also interested in building capability. You can identify gaps in skills and knowledge, develop engineers and create a team that understands and genuinely owns its technology rather than relying disproportionately on individual specialists or external partners.

About the team

ERP Services sits within Corporate Technology, part of Internal Products, and owns the engineering capabilities supporting critical Finance and enterprise business processes across the FT.

The team is responsible for the engineering, operation and continuous evolution of our ERP technology estate, including Oracle Fusion and the integrations, data flows and supporting capabilities that connect it to the wider FT technology landscape.

ERP Services works closely with Finance, Product, Architecture, Integration & Engineering Services, Security and other Corporate Technology teams to ensure these critical enterprise capabilities remain reliable and can evolve as the needs of the organisation change.

We are strengthening the engineering leadership and platform expertise within ERP Services as part of a wider evolution of the Corporate Technology operating model. The Engineering Lead will establish clear platform and team ownership, reporting to the Principal Engineer – Corporate Technology.

What you’ll work on

As Engineering Lead – ERP Services, you will own the engineering, operation and continuous evolution of the FT’s ERP technology capability.

You will lead the ERP engineering team, providing people leadership, technical direction and clear accountability for the health and performance of the platforms and services the team owns.

A key part of the role will be strengthening our internal ERP engineering capability. You will develop the technical knowledge of the team, establish clear ownership of platforms and services and ensure we have the skills and understanding required to operate and evolve our ERP estate effectively.

You will work closely with Product and Finance stakeholders to understand business priorities and translate them into engineering plans, balancing new capabilities and business change with platform health, technical debt and operational investment.

You will also work with the Principal Engineer and Architecture to ensure decisions within ERP Services support the longer-term direction of Corporate Technology and the wider FT technology estate.

Your responsibilities will include

Engineering & Platform Ownership

  • Owning the engineering, operation and continuous evolution of the ERP technology capability.
  • Providing clear technical direction for the platforms, integrations and supporting services owned by ERP Services.
  • Ensuring ERP platforms remain secure, resilient, scalable, maintainable and appropriately supported.
  • Establishing clear ownership across the team for systems, integrations and technical capabilities.
  • Ensuring engineering decisions consider reliability, security, operability, maintainability, cost and long-term sustainability.
  • Maintaining visibility of platform health, technical debt, lifecycle risks and significant dependencies.
  • Working with the Principal Engineer and Architecture on material technical decisions and longer-term platform direction.
  • Ensuring the team maintains sufficient technical understanding of its platforms to make informed decisions and challenge external recommendations.

People & Engineering Leadership

  • Leading, supporting and developing the engineers within ERP Services.
  • Setting clear expectations and providing regular coaching, feedback and career development.
  • Building a team culture based on ownership, accountability, collaboration and constructive technical challenge.
  • Developing ERP and enterprise platform expertise across the team rather than allowing critical knowledge to remain concentrated in individuals.
  • Identifying capability and skills gaps and developing plans to address them through development, recruitment or appropriate external expertise.
  • Creating opportunities for engineers to take greater technical ownership and develop their leadership capability.
  • Supporting recruitment and building a resilient team with the skills required for the future ERP technology landscape.
  • Ensuring appropriate succession and knowledge sharing across critical areas.

Delivery & Planning

  • Working with Product to translate business priorities and technology strategy into clear engineering plans and deliverable outcomes.
  • Owning engineering planning and resource allocation within ERP Services.
  • Ensuring engineering capacity appropriately balances business change, platform improvement, operational work and technical debt.
  • Identifying technical dependencies, risks and constraints early and ensuring these are visible in planning and prioritisation.
  • Ensuring delivery commitments are realistic and supported by appropriate technical understanding.
  • Working across teams where initiatives involve multiple platforms, integrations or engineering capabilities.
  • Providing clear visibility of engineering progress, risks and trade-offs to Product, technology leadership and relevant stakeholders.

ERP Platform Evolution

  • Developing a clear understanding of the current ERP estate and identifying opportunities to simplify, modernise and improve it.
  • Working with Product, Architecture and the Principal Engineer to shape the longer-term evolution of ERP technology.
  • Evaluating platform capabilities and determining when requirements should be addressed through standard functionality, configuration, integration or other engineering approaches.
  • Challenging unnecessary customisation and complexity where more sustainable solutions are available.
  • Ensuring platform upgrades, new capabilities and significant changes are introduced safely and sustainably.
  • Understanding vendor roadmaps and assessing their implications for the FT's technology direction and investment decisions.
  • Ensuring technical debt and lifecycle concerns are actively managed rather than accumulating through incremental business change.

Integration & Enterprise Technology

  • Ensuring the team understands and owns the integrations and data flows connecting ERP with the wider FT technology estate.
  • Working closely with Integration & Engineering Services and other platform teams to establish clear ownership of cross-system capabilities.
  • Ensuring integrations follow appropriate FT engineering and architectural standards.
  • Identifying opportunities to simplify interfaces, reduce duplication and improve reliability.
  • Supporting technical decisions that span ERP, Tax, People and other Corporate Technology capabilities.
  • Ensuring changes within ERP appropriately consider downstream and upstream impacts.

Operational Excellence & Risk

  • Owning the operational performance of ERP Services and ensuring critical services are appropriately monitored and supported.
  • Establishing effective approaches to observability, incident management, problem management, change management and operational readiness.
  • Ensuring recurring incidents and operational problems are investigated to their underlying causes and addressed sustainably.
  • Maintaining appropriate approaches to resilience, disaster recovery and business continuity.
  • Ensuring relevant security, data governance, compliance and technology standards are met.
  • Maintaining visibility of material operational and technical risks and ensuring appropriate mitigation plans are in place.
  • Using operational insight to inform engineering priorities and platform investment.

Vendors & Technology Partners

  • Managing the technical relationship with ERP vendors, implementation partners and specialist service providers.
  • Ensuring external partners are used effectively while maintaining clear internal engineering ownership.
  • Providing informed technical challenge to vendor recommendations and proposed solutions.
  • Ensuring externally delivered work meets FT engineering, security and operational expectations.
  • Building internal knowledge from vendor and partner engagements rather than allowing expertise to remain externally concentrated.
  • Contributing technical input to vendor performance, technology selection and investment decisions.

Stakeholder & Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Building strong working relationships with Product, Finance and other business stakeholders.
  • Translating business requirements and priorities into clear engineering implications, options and trade-offs.
  • Helping stakeholders understand platform constraints, technical risks and investment requirements.
  • Partnering with the Principal Engineer, Architecture, Security and other engineering leaders on decisions that cross platform or organisational boundaries.
  • Working constructively with specialist engineers, including Tax and Compliance engineering, on shared capabilities and dependencies.
  • Representing ERP Services in relevant engineering and technology forums.
Technical and leadership experience we’re looking for
  • Significant experience leading engineering teams responsible for complex, business-critical enterprise technology.
  • Strong experience with ERP platforms or similarly complex enterprise SaaS ecosystems.
  • Experience with Oracle Fusion or comparable enterprise ERP platforms would be highly advantageous.
  • Experience providing both people leadership and technical leadership to engineering teams.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise platform engineering, including integrations, APIs, data flows and system dependencies.
  • Experience owning technology through its full lifecycle, from change and delivery through to production operation and continuous improvement.
  • Experience developing engineering capability and strengthening technical ownership within teams.
  • Experience working with Finance or other complex enterprise business domains.
  • Strong understanding of reliability, security, observability, operational risk and technology lifecycle management.
  • Experience translating business priorities into engineering plans and balancing feature delivery with platform health and technical investment.
  • Experience leading technical decisions involving enterprise SaaS platforms, integrations and supporting services.
  • Experience working with vendors, implementation partners and managed service providers while maintaining internal technical ownership.
  • Experience identifying and addressing technical debt, platform lifecycle concerns and key-person dependencies.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical considerations and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working effectively with Principal Engineers, architects, Product Managers and other engineering leaders.
  • Experience of major ERP transformation, implementation or modernisation would be advantageous.
Characteristics we value
  • Strong engineering judgement and a willingness to remain close to the technology.
  • A strong sense of ownership and accountability for both the team and the platforms it operates.
  • The ability to develop people while setting clear expectations for engineering quality and delivery.
  • Pragmatism when balancing business priorities, technical quality and operational risk.
  • Curiosity and a willingness to develop deep understanding of complex enterprise technology.
  • Confidence challenging vendors, stakeholders and technical colleagues constructively.
  • An instinct for building capability and distributing knowledge rather than becoming the person who owns every technical answer.
  • A collaborative approach to working across Product, business and technology teams.
  • A focus on addressing underlying problems rather than repeatedly managing symptoms.
  • An appreciation for simplicity, resilience and long-term platform sustainability.

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

  • Annual bonus scheme
  • 25 days paid leave
  • 24/7 Employee Assistance Program
  • Life Insurance
  • Enhanced Parental Leave policy
  • Food Allowance
  • Multisport Card
  • Both in house and external training programs
  • Your own training dedicated budget (for conferences, courses etc.)

 

We currently operate a hybrid model which requires staff to work onsite 50% of the time, subject to role requirements & regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for all roles. We believe this balanced approach supports flexibility and protects our culture, making collaboration and communication easier, building stronger relationships and team cohesion, and supporting peer learning.  We reserve discretion on reasonable notice to change this approach either generally or for specific individuals or teams. 

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help.

Further information

At the FT, we embrace innovation and the use of technology and appreciate that individuals may leverage AI tools as part of their job application process. Whilst we are happy for you to use AI to assist with your application, it is essential that all information provided is authentic and accurately represents your skills, experience, and qualifications.

Candidates should be aware that the use of AI throughout the application process may be monitored to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process for all.

Please beware of fraudulent job postings and offers claiming to be from the Financial Times. All legitimate opportunities will direct you to apply through the official Financial Times careers site, and the FT will never ask for financial information, payments, or referrals to third parties during the hiring process. If you have any concerns about the legitimacy of a job posting or suspect any scam activity, please contact talent@ft.com.

Interested in the FT but don’t see the right role yet? Join our Talent Community to receive exclusive updates, featured jobs, and insights into working at the FT.

job.title: Engineering Manager – Commercial Technology
job.description:
About Us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Together, we help audiences stay better informed and deepen their understanding of the world around them.

Our Product & Tech teams drive us forward in an ever-evolving digital landscape, delivering cutting-edge products to over one million digital subscribers daily. Our growth relies on a diverse, dedicated and dynamic group of product, tech, delivery and data specialists.

With a supportive culture, entrepreneurial spirit and opportunities at every turn, there are no limits to where your FT career can take you.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion

We believe everyone should have a fair opportunity to contribute, succeed, and reach their full potential. That means ensuring everyone is heard, respected, and valued, while identifying and removing barriers that may get in the way. Our commitment is to be an employer role model, grounded in inclusion and fairness for all.We want every application to receive fair and thoughtful consideration; therefore, all applications are reviewed by a member of our recruitment team, not by AI.

About you

You are an experienced engineering leader with a strong software engineering background and a track record of leading teams responsible for business-critical products and platforms.

You combine strong people leadership with credible technical judgement. You are comfortable setting direction, helping teams make complex engineering decisions and remaining close enough to the technology to understand the health, risks and opportunities within the platforms you own.

You understand that engineering leadership is about more than delivery. You think about the long-term health of technology: architecture, reliability, security, scalability, developer experience, operational performance and the ability of teams to evolve their systems sustainably.

You are comfortable working closely with Product and business stakeholders, translating priorities into engineering plans and making thoughtful trade-offs between new capabilities, technical investment and operational needs.

You are also motivated by developing people and teams. You create clear ownership, coach engineers, build capability and create an environment where people can challenge, learn and take increasing responsibility.

About the team

Commercial Technology is part of the Internal Products group within FT Product & Technology. We are a multidisciplinary group of Engineers, Product Managers and Business Analysts responsible for building and operating the technology platforms that support the FT’s commercial capabilities across Marketing, Sales, Service and Commercial Data.

We are undertaking a significant evolution of our commercial technology landscape, bringing these capabilities together around a more connected Salesforce platform and establishing a strong foundation for how our commercial teams engage with customers and use data.

In Marketing & Commercial Data, we are evolving our marketing technology landscape towards Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next and Data 360, while continuing to operate and transition from established platforms including Bloomreach, Marketo and Legacy Salesforce Marketing Cloud products for B2B & B2C marketing.

In Sales & Service, we are consolidating a number of Salesforce CRM orgs with their associated processes and procedures into a leaner Commercial Technology estate, utilising data available to us via Data 360, into a setup that aligns with the FT’s future commercial capabilities and setup.

In Commercial Platform, we are establishing a centre of excellence at the heart of the commercial workflow, tasked with ensuring the security, health and viability of our day-to-day commercial operation and providing a primary support route for our business users

The Engineering Manager will lead one of the engineering teams within Commercial Technology, working closely with Product, Senior Engineers, other Engineering Managers and the wider Commercial Technology leadership team.

Our Technology

Our Commercial Technology landscape is evolving. Technologies and platforms within or interacting with Marketing & Commercial Data include:

  • Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next (Advanced Edition)
  • Salesforce Data 360
  • Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud
  • Sales Collaboration & Enablement Tooling
  • Bloomreach
  • Marketo
  • JavaScript / TypeScript
  • APIs and integration technologies
  • AWS Technologies
  • Data platforms and integrations
  • CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling
  • GitHub
  • Monitoring and observability tooling
  • Jira & Confluence

You do not need experience with all of these technologies to apply. We are particularly interested in engineering leaders who can lead teams through technology change and help engineers develop the skills required for an evolving platform.

What you’ll work on

As Engineering Manager within Commercial Technology, you will lead the engineering team responsible for the delivery, performance and continuous evolution of the FT’s Marketing & Commercial Data capability.

You will be accountable for ensuring the engineering team is effectively organised, supported and resourced to deliver business outcomes. This includes leading delivery and planning, managing engineering capacity and priorities, building strong relationships with Product, Programme and business stakeholders, and ensuring risks, dependencies and resource constraints are understood and actively managed.

You will be leading a team through a significant transformation of the FT's commercial technology landscape, balancing the delivery of new capabilities with the operational health of existing platforms, the development of engineering capability and the longer-term evolution of the Commercial Technology estate.

You will remain close to the technology and provide credible engineering leadership. You will support technical decision-making, challenge approaches where appropriate and ensure the team understands the architecture, risks and operational health of the systems it owns.

You will also work with Principal Engineers and other senior technical leaders on decisions that extend beyond your team's boundaries, ensuring local engineering decisions contribute to a coherent and sustainable Commercial Technology landscape.

You will report to the Principal Engineer for the Commercial Technology domain.

Your responsibilities will include

Engineering Delivery & Planning

  • Own engineering delivery across the Marketing & Commercial Data capability, ensuring agreed business outcomes are delivered effectively and sustainably.
  • Work with Product, Programme, the Technical Lead and wider Commercial Technology leadership to shape priorities, roadmaps and achievable delivery plans.
  • Own the allocation of engineering capacity, balancing delivery commitments with operational needs, technical improvement, team capacity and longer-term capability development.
  • Identify and actively manage delivery risks, dependencies, resource constraints and capability gaps, escalating where necessary.
  • Continuously improve engineering processes, development workflows, documentation and ways of working.

People Leadership & Team Health

  • Leading, supporting and developing engineers, admins and specialists across Marketing Technology and Commercial Data through regular 1:1s, coaching, feedback and career development.
  • Setting clear expectations for individual and team performance
  • Create an inclusive, supportive and psychologically safe environment, building a strong engineering culture based on ownership, collaboration, continuous learning and shared accountability.
  • Manage team capacity and sustainable workloads, supporting the wellbeing, effectiveness and long-term development of the team.
  • Identify skills and capability gaps and work with engineers and wider engineering leadership to develop the capabilities required for our future platform.
  • Lead recruitment, onboarding and organisational change within the capability, ensuring engineers are supported through changes to technology, roles and ways of working.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

  • Partner closely with the Technical Lead – Marketing & Commercial Data, Together you will provide the complementary people, delivery and technical leadership required to operate and evolve our Marketing & Commercial Data capability successfully.
  • Own the organisational conditions required to execute the technical strategy, ensuring teams have the skills, capacity and ways of working required to deliver it successfully.
  • Contribute to technical discussions and decisions while maintaining clear accountability with the Technical Lead for technical direction, architecture, engineering standards and solution design.
  • Build strong relationships with Product, Programme, business stakeholders and other technology teams, providing clear visibility of delivery, capacity, operational health, risks and dependencies.
  • Work closely with Engineering Managers and Technical Leads across Commercial Technology to coordinate shared priorities, dependencies and engineering practices.
  • Work effectively with external technology partners and delivery vendors where required, ensuring they integrate successfully with FT engineering teams and delivery practices.
  • Represent the needs, constraints and capabilities of the engineering team in programme, planning and stakeholder discussions.

Operational Readiness & Engineering Excellence

  • Be accountable for ensuring Marketing & Commercial Data capabilities are operationally ready, supportable and sustainable throughout their lifecycle.
  • Ensure operational requirements are built into delivery, including observability, monitoring, resilience, documentation, support models, knowledge transfer and clear ownership.
  • Work closely with the Commercial Platform team to ensure new and changed capabilities can be effectively supported within the wider Commercial Technology operating model.
  • Ensure the team remains engaged in the ongoing health of the capabilities it owns, providing specialist domain or engineering expertise when required.
  • Lead the Marketing & Commercial Data team's response to incidents affecting capabilities it owns, working within the Commercial Technology incident-management model led by Commercial Platform.
  • Ensure operational health, capability risks, technical debt and engineering improvements are visible and prioritised alongside product and programme delivery.
  • Ensure learning from incidents, operational issues and business-user feedback is incorporated into future delivery and continuous improvement.

Change & Platform Evolution

  • Lead the engineering team through the evolution of the FT’s Marketing & Commercial Data technology landscape.
  • Support the transition from legacy marketing platforms, including Bloomreach and Marketo, towards the FT’s strategic Salesforce-based marketing and data capabilities.
  • Own the people, skills and team structure required to support the transition to the future Marketing & Commercial Data platform, ensuring the capability can be sustainably owned beyond programme delivery.
  • Work with the Technical Lead, Commercial Platform and wider Commercial Technology leadership to introduce platform changes sustainably and maintain operational continuity.

Leadership experience we’re looking for

  • Experience managing or leading software engineers within a collaborative engineering environment.
  • Strong coaching, feedback and people-development skills, with experience helping engineers progress in their careers.
  • Experience leading engineering delivery across complex platforms or products.
  • Experience balancing strategic programme delivery with operational responsibilities and longer-term engineering priorities.
  • Strong understanding of engineering practices associated with secure, resilient and scalable production systems.
  • Experience supporting teams responsible for operating and continuously improving business-critical technology.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working in partnership with senior technical leaders, architects or Technical Leads.
  • Comfortable operating across Product, Engineering, Data, Programme and business stakeholders.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity, organisational change and evolving priorities.
  • Experience leading teams through significant platform or technology transformation would be beneficial.
  • Experience with Salesforce, marketing technology, customer data platforms or enterprise SaaS ecosystems would be beneficial, but is not essential.

Characteristics we value

  • A people-first approach to engineering leadership.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills.
  • Empathy, emotional intelligence and a commitment to developing others.
  • A strong sense of ownership and accountability for outcomes.
  • Pragmatism and sound judgement when balancing business, people and engineering needs.
  • The ability to create clarity and structure in complex or ambiguous environments.
  • Curiosity and a willingness to continuously learn.
  • An appreciation for strong engineering practices, operational excellence and sustainable technology.
  • Calmness under pressure and the ability to lead teams through challenging situations.
  • A collaborative mindset and willingness to work across organisational and technology boundaries.
  • An interest in how technology and data can enable better customer experiences and commercial outcomes.

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

  • Annual bonus scheme
  • 25 days paid leave
  • 24/7 Employee Assistance Program
  • Life Insurance
  • Enhanced Parental Leave policy
  • Food Allowance
  • Multisport Card
  • Both in house and external training programs
  • Your own training dedicated budget (for conferences, courses etc.)

We currently operate a hybrid model which requires staff to work onsite 50% of the time, subject to role requirements & regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for all roles. We believe this balanced approach supports flexibility and protects our culture, making collaboration and communication easier, building stronger relationships and team cohesion, and supporting peer learning.  We reserve discretion on reasonable notice to change this approach either generally or for specific individuals or teams. 

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, please contact the FT Talent team via email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help.



Further information

At the FT, we embrace innovation and the use of technology and appreciate that individuals may leverage AI tools as part of their job application process. Whilst we are happy for you to use AI to assist with your application, it is essential that all information provided is authentic and accurately represents your skills, experience, and qualifications.

Candidates should be aware that the use of AI throughout the application process may be monitored to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process for all.

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. job.title: Broadcast Production Engineer
job.description:
FOX News is on the hunt for a stellar Broadcast Production Engineer to work in our Washington DC bureau. This role involves providing support and routine compliance for our substantial media and broadcast systems within a competitive, live, 24/7 news environment. As a cornerstone of our Production Engineering team, within the Broadcast and Media Technology group, you'll coordinate with various engineering teams, providing support to IT groups/helpdesk, broadcast production, technical operation personnel, and network operations aggregations.

As our ideal candidate, you are enthused about broadcast engineering/IT and comfortable acclimating to evolving media technologies, concepts, and trends such as Media over IP, Cloud Computing, and Radio Workflows.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support infrastructure for on-air broadcast production systems
  • Oversee studio operations including video walls, video processing systems, and cameras
  • Supervise live control room production systems and subsystems
  • Handle infrastructure systems like routers, intercom, monitoring, KVM, audio suites, and live production-related equipment
  • Provide maintenance and support for off-site remote locations including the White House, Capitol Hill, etc.
  • Address, communicate, manage, and track technical issues in a live 24/7 production environment
  • Perform maintenance of subsystems including software and hardware updates, modifications, and replacements as warranted
  • Develop and retain process benchmarks for deployment and support documentation for operations
  • Collaborate on a team that works hands-on with the latest generation of production systems and technologies
  • Work on complex audio processing tasks and Audio-over-IP setups including gating, compression, equalization of talent microphone audio, and multi-band processing of outbound audio programming using Orban processors
  • Set up up small Dante audio networks

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer science, or related majors, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years' experience in broadcast production and live television
  • Extensive knowledge of standards like SMPTE for broadcast television and video environments
  • Strong technical skills in troubleshooting and repairing broadcast equipment
  • Aptitude to troubleshoot traditional SDI and IP audio/video signal routing environments
  • Familiarity with studio technologies including video walls, cameras, VR set technologies, image processing systems, touch screens, and lighting
  • Solid understanding of production control automation (e.g., Ross Overdrive) and Newsroom Computer System (NRCS) workflows
  • Proficiency in MS Windows workstation and server platforms
  • Experience with file-based workflows and knowledge of enterprise Media Asset Management systems (e.g. Dalet)
  • Ability to interpret technical documentation standards 
  • Demonstrated working knowledge of IT/networking theory, topology, and best practices
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks independently and as part of a team.
  • Aptitude to work a flexible schedule based on the needs of a live production environment, including overtime, holidays, weekends
  • Capability to remove, lift, and replace equipment in racks as warranted
  • Experience operating manual and electric mechanical tools is required

job.title: Open Source Reporting, Graphics (Graphics Multimedia Editor)
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The New York Times Graphics team is looking for a reporter with extensive open-source and investigative reporting skills to turn raw evidence into impactful visual stories. You have a track record for uncovering exclusive information off the news.

The Graphics team is a leader in using spatial and visual techniques on investigative stories, and we're looking for someone who is passionate about accountability journalism using cutting-edge reporting techniques.

Below are a few examples of the kinds of stories that you will be a part of:
  • An exclusive look at the failed columns of the Midtown Manhattan near-collapse
  • A 3-D analysis of why firefighters' lines of sight were limited in the deadly LaGuardia Crash
  • An investigation into the mass graves in Syria
  • An investigation into the causes of a Miami building collapse
  • A spatial investigation into a deadly fire in the Bronx
  • A forensic analysis of an apartment building collapse in the Turkey earthquake
Working with journalists on the Graphics team and across the newsroom, you will play an important role in shaping visual reconstructions and investigations that rely on spatial analysis or use 3-D modeling. You will gather and analyze evidence for stories across a wide range of topics for both quick-turn stories as well as longer-term enterprise.

You will be expected to take the initiative in leading major storylines, with the goal of uncovering new or exclusive findings across multiple visual story formats. You should be curious and driven, and be comfortable with moving between solo deep dives and fast-paced, cross-desk collaborations.

This is an in-office position based in New York and includes regular attendance in the office four days a week.

Responsibilities:
  • Bring core OSINT fluency to the desk's coverage: geolocation, chronolocation, satellite/aerial imagery analysis, audio-video research, and more.
  • Analyze a variety of data sources, including satellite and aerial imagery, flight/vessel tracking data, social media platforms and radio scanner data.
  • Vet and build relationships with a network of sources on stories.
  • Generate ideas that help the team develop custom tooling to automate open-source reporting for analyzing and visualizing evidence.
  • Find new ways to report beyond the standard OSINT toolkit, by using computational techniques, including through machine learning, computer vision and approved AI tools.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.
  • You will report to an Assistant Editor on the Graphics desk.
Basic Qualifications:
  • 5+ years of relevant experience as an investigative reporter, open-source researcher or forensic expert.
  • Proven experience conducting open-source investigations by sourcing audio and visual evidence across a variety of platforms.
  • Experience producing accountability journalism, with a strong portfolio.
  • Experience producing clear copy about the visual evidence on tight deadlines.
  • Experience verifying user-generated content from social media for authenticity.
  • Skilled in building timelines using a variety of sources, including official statements and metadata from user-generated content.
  • Familiarity with open-source intelligence tools and techniques like Google Earth, satellite imagery platforms, scanner audio data, flight or vessel tracking, or similar.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience working both independently and collaboratively while managing multiple research threads.
  • Experience with advanced tools for reporting, such as QGIS, Blender for 3-D scene reconstructions, data analysis methods, audio and image forensics tools.
  • Adept at creating clear, visual explainers piecing together complex findings.
  • Familiarity with programming and custom tool development.
  • Familiarity with Adobe Suite and Figma.
  • Experience with web scraping tools and working with APIs.
  • Experience using command line tools.
  • Willingness and flexibility to work evenings and weekends as needed.
This position is represented by the NewsGuild of NY.   REQ-020693

About the Role

The Developer Platforms mission at The New York Times builds the foundational platforms, tooling, and paved paths that help product teams ship high‑quality experiences quickly and safely. Our Application Delivery team owns the shared software delivery platform (CI/CD, artifact management) and deployment workflows used by hundreds of engineers across News, Cooking, Games and Audio to ship software.

As the Times leans into AI‑assisted and agentic development, Application Delivery is where those changes become real. You will set the technical direction for how AI‑generated and agent‑driven change flows safely, observably, and at scale through CI/CD.

You'll help teams reduce release risk with modern deployment patterns, and turn effective delivery practices into reusable pipelines and templates that scale across the organization, much like our GenAI platform roles turn internal practices into reusable tools and agents. When you improve this platform, you change how The New York Times ships software.

You will report to the Engineering Manager of the DevEx Application Delivery team. This is a hybrid role based in our New York City headquarters. You can typically expect to come into the office 3 days/week.

  • Deliver scalable, secure, and observable software delivery systems and workflows that improve reliability, and overall software quality and velocity.

  • Champion engineering excellence in delivery by setting best practices for testing, deployment strategies, progressive delivery, and observability that are easy to adopt through the platform.

  • Mentor engineers across the mission, contribute to hiring, and help foster an inclusive, collaborative engineering culture centered on shared platforms and high‑quality software delivery.

  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our mission and values and a commitment to our purpose to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience building the technical strategy and driving software delivery (Github Actions, Argo CD or equivalent CI/CD systems) or similar platform work with broad organizational impact beyond operations.

  • Experience building and scaling a platform as a product for internal engineers with multi-tenancy serving many teams through self‑service paved paths, with attention to adoption, backward compatibility, and isolation/guardrails between tenants

  • Demonstrated proficiency in building and maintaining production services in one or more general‑purpose programming languages (e.g., Go, Python, TypeScript/Node.js, or Java), including code review and debugging complex issues.

  • 5+ years of experience with containers, Kubernetes, package management tools(Helm or equivalent), IAC tools(Terraform or equivalent), Gitops‑based deployment workflows and cloud services such as AWS, GCP.

  • Experience using delivery and productivity metrics (e.g., DORA, SPACE) and platform observability to measure and improve release quality and delivery.

  • Proficiency with GenAI‑assisted developer tooling (e.g., Cursor, Copilot, or Claude Code) and judgment about how to integrate agentic workflows into CI/CD safely.

  • Experience leading cross‑team technical work, communicating trade‑offs, and building understanding among diverse partners including Product, platform, and product engineering teams.

  • Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to an inclusive, collaborative engineering culture.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to artifact/package management (e.g., Artifactory or similar) with attention to security, retention, cost, and ease of use for engineers.

job.title: LA Galaxy, Producer- Video & Content
job.description:
LA Galaxy is where soccer, culture, and community come together. As one of Major League Soccer’s most storied clubs, the Galaxy deliver unforgettable matchdays and moments that connect fans across Los Angeles and beyond.

Owned by AEG, the LA Galaxy are powered by teams who bring energy, creativity, and commitment to everything they do, from matchday operations and fan engagement to the work that happens behind the scenes. Every role plays a part in shaping the experience on and off the pitch and building a club that reflects the city it represents.   If you want to be part of a team where your work shows up live, in real time, and in front of passionate fans, there’s a place for you here. Because on matchday, it happens here.

Job Summary

The Apple TV Video and Content Producer for the LA Galaxy will plan, produce, and elevate all video content created for our recurring Apple TV programming. This includes both short‑form and long‑form storytelling that will also be repurposed across the club's owned and operated channels.

The incumbent will lead the end‑to‑end production of original content, oversee post‑production workflows, manage video platforms, and support broadcast and external partners with footage requests. This role requires regular domestic and international travel to capture content for scheduled events and club initiatives.

Additionally, this position will help conceptualize and execute creative motion graphics for visual communications including in‑stadium videoboards and LED displays along with digital content for websites, social media, and video‑based advertising for the LA Galaxy and Dignity Health Sports Park.

Essential Functions

  • Plans, oversees, and produces a wide range of video content (documentary‑style features, comedy segments, news pieces, sizzle reels, highlight packages, commercial spots, PSAs, etc.) for the LA Galaxy, Marketing, Digital, Ticket Sales, Partnerships, and Dignity Health Sports Park.
  • Conceptualizes and provides creative guidance for Corporate Partnerships and Marketing on commercial spots, branded content series, and partner‑driven storytelling.
  • Captures video content on the field, at training sessions, in studio environments, and on production sets across scheduled events at DHSP and other locations (special events, PR appearances, away games). Responsibilities include filming, lighting design, audio recording, and conducting interviews for video productions.
  • Maintains the LA Galaxy Digital Asset Management platform by uploading and organizing new content for cross‑departmental use.
  • Collaborates with Design, Digital, Video Production, Photo (Creative Services), and Game Presentation teams to develop motion graphics for LA Galaxy and DHSP videoboards and LED boards, including matchup assets, player animations, goal and win animations, and other in‑stadium visuals.
  • Oversees the design, creation, and implementation of graphics, animations, and subtitling to ensure alignment with LA Galaxy brand standards established by Creative Services and Brand Marketing.

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS Degree (4-year) In Video Production, Media Production or a related area
  • 2-4 years In a videographer or content editing role
  • 2-4 years Industry specific experience is preferred
  • Experience with a professional sports team is a plus
  • Must have an excellent proficiency of non-linear software (i.e. Final Cut Pro, Premier) as well as a mastery of the Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Proactive, highly organized, and resourceful with great attention to details
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills and ability to prioritize workload efficiently and quickly
  • Proactive and have the ability to work independently without the need for supervision.
  • Ability to multi-task, meet tight timelines, and work effectively in a high pressure and fast-paced environment
  • Ability to professionally handle highly sensitive and confidential information
  • Must be creative, idea-oriented, and thrive in a collaborative team-based environment
  • Must be technically proficient with MS Office.
  • Efficient and skilled in Adobe After Effects, ensuring smooth, timely, and accurate execution of motion‑based deliverables.
  • Outstanding written and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to professionally communicate and interact with all levels of management, staff, etc.
  • Ability to carry and maneuverer equipment efficiently of 40 lbs. or more
  • Proficiency in Spanish preferred

job.description:

Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry is looking for an Experience Designer to join our growing team!  

 

This is a entry to mid-level Experience Design position that will provide support in execution of creative and digital experiences for various clients across the agency. Organization, positivity and flexibility are essential as you work both autonomously and collaboratively to discover creative solutions based on quantitative and qualitative research. We want Experience Designers who love unraveling tough problems and inspiring people to think strategically about experiences in fresh new ways.

 

This is a hybrid/remote role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, Lambertville, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

 

What you’ll do: 

  • Create and own UX and design deliverables including wireframes, prototypes, functional annotations, experience strategic thinking, customer journeys, sketches and full comp designs
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, heuristic analysis and competitive analysis
  • Involvement in all stages of the design process; research through concepting, prototyping, and implementation
  • Effectively provide experience and support in applying consumer needs, brand guidelines, strategic insights, etc. to a variety of digital solutions 
  • Contribute and critique design work with the creative teams
  • Utilize and advocate for human-centered design process and thinking
  • Lead with action to inspire and encourage teams in use of new methods and push thinking 
  • Research and stay current in digital design trends, tools, and technologies within all industries, but especially the healthcare industry. 
  • Present ideas and concepts to internal teams
  • Ensure consistent and user-friendly solutions

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if: 

  • Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you. 
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving. 
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data. 
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines. 

 

What you should have:  

  • 2-5 years of experience in creating and designing complex digital products/experiences 
  • Interest in healthcare and medicine
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a love for new challenges
  • Strong verbal communication skills; strong writing and composition abilities Knowledge of general SEO and ADA guidelines
  • Excited about changing the landscape and finding creative solutions 
  • Self-directed and comfortable working with ambiguity and uncertainty
  • Ability to think proactively, multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced environment 
  • An eye for pixel perfect design and careful attention to detail. 
  • Construct clean and organized creative deliverables that adhere to style guidelines

 

Pay Range: $85,000 - $95,000
This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting.  Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, skills, certifications, and geographical location. The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time.

Take Your Sales Career to the Next Level:

Are you a driven, goal-oriented seller looking to grow your career in a high-impact role? At Townsquare Media Group, we’re seeking experienced Account Executives who thrive in a fast-paced environment, love building relationships, and are motivated by helping local businesses succeed. If you’re a confident closer with a passion for strategic, consultative sales—this is your opportunity to make a real impact.

 

Why Townsquare Media Group?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including our trusted Kalamazoo stations.

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

As a key member of our Kalamazoo sales team, you’ll take full ownership of building and managing a book of business. You’ll focus on bringing in new clients while maintaining long-term relationships with existing accounts. This is a full-cycle sales role where you’ll:

  • Prospect, qualify, and secure new business using data-driven insights and tools
  • Conduct in-depth needs assessments and present tailored marketing strategies
  • Represent our full portfolio of solutions including broadcast, digital, programmatic, and event sponsorships
  • Cross-sell and upsell to expand your clients’ reach and ROI
  • Partner with internal teams and collaborate on campaign execution and strategy
  • Work directly with your Market Leadership to meet and exceed individual and team goals

  • Exceptional presentation, interpersonal, and communication skills
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required)

job.title: Multi-Media Advertising Strategist
job.description:
Multi-Media Advertising Strategist

*This is a full-time, in-office opportunity. *

 

Every now and then a great opportunity presents itself, that time is now, for you, at Townsquare Media in Bangor.  At Townsquare, we are a team of driven individuals who push ourselves and those around us to grow personally and professionally.  We have a current opening which includes an existing book of business that requires a strong marketing professional.  You can expect a dynamic and competitive work environment that fosters success, training, development, and above average pay. 

We have a rare opening for the right person to bring our best-in-class marketing solutions to local businesses in eastern and central Maine. We’re the number one local media company in each of the markets we serve. Our top-rated radio stations, our market exclusive digital media solutions and our exciting live events are a winning combination for you, and our customers.

 

Responsibilities:

  • determine strategy for identifying, connecting and closing new opportunities in the Bangor market.
  • prospect and identify potential clients using our proprietary data and analytics;
  • build and maintain close working relationships with internal teams to identify key accounts and build solution based strategic plans that help businesses grow.
  • responsible for bringing our premier marketing and advertising solutions to both local and regional businesses in eastern and central Maine.
  • diversifying our clients’ solutions through cross-selling a variety of marketing solutions including broadcast, digital (website design, SEO, SEM, Programmatic, Paid Search/Social, etc.), and live event sponsorship.

 

Qualifications:

  • B 2 B sales experience preferred
  • A strong business acumen
  • Outside sales experience in any field with a track record of success
  • General understanding digital advertising, broadcast media and event sponsorship
  • Goal-oriented, strong work ethic, and a desire to learn and grow a career in Sales

 

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation plan + UNCAPPED earning potential
  • 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays (including 2 personal days)
  • Volunteer Time Off—give back to your community
  • Health, Dental, Vision, and Pet Insurance
  • 401(k) with company match + Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Company-provided laptop
  • Hands-on training and dedicated support from your leadership team
  • Real opportunities for career growth in a fast-moving multi-media organization

 

About Us

Townsquare is a community-focused digital media, digital marketing solutions, and radio company focused outside the Top 50 markets in the U.S. Our assets include Townsquare Interactive, a digital marketing services subscription business providing websites, search engine optimization, social platforms, and online reputation management for approximately 21,900 SMBs; Townsquare IGNITE, a proprietary digital programmatic advertising technology with an in-house demand and data management platform; and Townsquare Media, our portfolio of 322 local terrestrial radio stations in 67 cities with corresponding local news and entertainment websites and apps including legendary brands such as WYRK.com, WJON.com, and NJ101.5.com, along with a network of national music brands including XXLmag.com, TasteofCountry.com, UltimateClassicRock.com, and Loudwire.com.

job.title: INTERNSHIP/ HETS PARTNERSHIP - KFVS
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Gray Media, or Gray, is a multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. The company is the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 113 television markets that collectively reach approximately 36 percent of US television households. The portfolio includes 77 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first and/or second-highest-rated television station, as well as the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 45 markets totaling nearly 1.5 million Hispanic TV Households. The company also owns Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Gray's additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About KFVS:

KFVS12 is the #1 local TV station serving as the CBS/CW/MeTV/Outlaw/Telemundo/Oxygen/GRIT affiliate in the Cape Girardeau, Missouri/Paducah, Kentucky/Harrisburg, Illinois market. Founded in 1954, KFVS12 has a rich heritage of serving "America's Heartland" with the best local news and weather information, along with a legacy of community service and disaster relief. KFVS12 produces more local news than any other station in the market, currently offering over 50 hours of news content every week, along with special high-profile, topical local programming. Heartland News on KFVS12 consistently leads the competition in award-winning journalism having been honored this year with numerous Missouri and Illinois Broadcasters' Awards as well as the prestigious Edward R. Murrow Awards.

The Cape Girardeau market covers 45 counties in four states and is home to four division-one universities. It is where the North meets the South and the East meets the West. The area is rich with many diverse communities, including historic riverfront towns, that offer a variety of unique benefits and recreational opportunities. It is also conveniently located for easy travel to St. Louis, Memphis, Nashville, and Chicago.

The station has an exceptional staff that is committed to maintaining the legacy of the institution of KFVS. They are forward-thinking with news coverage in on-air newscasts and 24/7 on numerous digital platforms, consistently leading the competition in digital traffic across the board. This provides exciting opportunities throughout the station including News, Sales, Marketing, Engineering, and more.

Job Summary/Description:

KFVS is seeking applicants for bilingual interns in partnership with Southeast Missouri State University and three universities located in Puerto Rico that belong to the Hispanic Educational Technology Services (HETS) program. Applicants should be in their junior or senior year at a HETS partner University and willing to live in Cape Girardeau, Missouri for a semester while attending Southeast Missouri State University. These positions will teach producing, shooting, and editing skills while contributing and creating content for Spanish-speaking Gray Television outlets. Partnership Universities include:

  • Inter-American University – Universidad Inter American De Puerto Rico
  • Sacred Heart University -- Universidad Del Sagrado Carazon
  • Ana G. Mendez University – Universidad Ana G. Mendez

Qualifications/Requirements:

* Meet enrollment criteria above
* Train with digital producer to produce/write/edit for KFVS digital properties.
* Work with a photojournalist to learn camera operation basics.
* Shadow Multi-Media Journalist to learn how to shoot/write/edit news stories for broadcast and/or streaming.
* Translate relevant stories from English to Spanish for digital properties.
* Enrolled in a HETS-affiliated school.
* Proficient in English and Spanish.

*** Intern rate of pay can range from minimum wage in your state to $15 an hour ***

If you feel you’re qualified and want to work with a great group of people go to https://gray.tv/careers#currentopenings, you may type in the job title, station call letters, or click on "apply now", upload your resume, cover letter, and references

(Current employees who are interested in this position can apply through the Gray-TV UltiPro self-service portal)

job.title: Traffic/Copy Coordinator
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

TEGNA Commercial Operations (TCO) is searching for a highly motivated individual to facilitate the entry and management of commercial copy for multiple TEGNA properties. The Continuity Coordinator will manage the materials and copy for multiple  properties, advertisers, and agencies. This candidate must be extremely detailed, meet high standards of accuracy, have outstanding organizational skills, and solve problems under tight deadlines. Strong communication skills in both verbal and written form are critical to the success of this candidate. This hybrid position reports directly to the Continuity Manager and can be based in any TEGNA market.

Responsibilities:

  • Execute the entry of trafffc instructions of commercial copy with a high level of accuracy while providing exceptional customer service to clients, agencies, and TEGNA stakeholders
  • Assist in confirming commercial copy from all delivery systems, FTP, and outside sources
  • Retrieve necessary information regarding traffc instructions and materials, view materials for quality control, and ensure material locations (in the material server and in Wide-orbit) are up-to date and accurate
  • Ensure commercial materials are received and downloaded by the daily deadline
  • Work closely with internal (Station Sales Departments) and external (businesses, production houses, and advertising agencies) customers in a professional manner
  • Build and maintain relationships with the TEGNA Commercial Operations (TCO) teams and TEGNA Streaming Center (TSC)
  • Provide support and backup to team members to ensure high standards are maintained across all properties served by the team
  • Collaborate with colleagues to address any issues promptly and efficiently
  • Adhere to established protocols and guidelines when completing assigned tasks to ensure consistency, accuracy, and efficiency
  • Offer constructive feedback and innovative suggestions to enhance and streamline processes
  • Contribute to a positive and productive team environment.

 

Requirements:

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in traffc or sales support in broadcast, cable or radio
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a team and independently
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks effectively under deadline pressure
  • Attention to detail, accuracy, and strong organizational skills are a must
  • Ability to effectively solve problems with a sense of urgency
  • Creative and able to adapt quickly to change
  • Position requires strong written and verbal communication skills, as well as strong organization and time management
  • Proficient with computer software/applications, including Microsoft Office: Outlook, Word, and Excel
  • WideOrbit traffic system knowledge (required

The application deadline for this position is Dec 4, 2026

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring and developing individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences to add to our collaborative culture. job.title: Senior Specialist, Global Mobility
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

About the Role, Mission or Department Overview

As the Senior Specialist, Global Mobility you will be a critical support member of the Global Mobility team, playing an important role in the smooth execution of our international and domestic assignment programs. You will deliver high-touch support, managing vendor relationships, global relocation, and tax support processes. You will collaborate with team members from HR, Payroll, Finance, and Tax ensuring compliance and a positive employee experience. This position operates on a hybrid model (3 days per week in our New York office) and you will report to the Director of Global Mobility.

Responsibilities:

  • Help prepare cost projections, assignment letters, benefit summaries.
  • Issue service orders to our external providers.
  • Follow up with assignees on questions and manage their relocation and tax support with our external providers.
  • Help with the outsourcing of Global Mobility payments.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience in Global Mobility, relocation, or immigration coordination.
  • Experience with Workday or similar HRIS.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for reporting and cost modeling.
  • Experience advising employees, managers, and external partners.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Global Mobility Specialist certification or equivalent experience.
  • Experience managing external vendor relationships and invoice/billing reconciliation.
  • Experience focusing on process improvement and compliance.

This position is primarily responsible for studio production and maintenance, lighting, and audio operation. From time to time may direct automated newscast or technical direct live and pre-recorded production.

Studio

Operate with proficiency handheld television camera for in studio and live remote productions.

Program and operate robotic cameras and Smart Shell program.

Operate VOICE teleprompter,

Understand audio equipment in the studio at a satisfactory level and with confidence during live and taped shows.

Control the quality of the audio going through the audio booth. Insure that all elements of the audio are at the proper level. Insure that the balance between microphones, music, and videotape sources are mixed and at a proper relationship with each other.

Ready at the audio position during assigned shift to handle any audio needs, especially during times of breaking news.

Insure that all paperwork properly submitted. Accurately complete the logging of all musical elements to insure proper credits under the music license rules. Complete any logs, scripts or other paperwork that is required.

Code and Direct an automated newscast using Overdrive.

Technical direct a creative and technically clean productions within format guidelines.

Protect the integrity of the format.

Make suggestions for improvement.

Be responsible for all elements of a show. Set a positive attitude and example. Solve problems at the source. Respond appropriately to others.

Other

Assist with training and assist newly hired Director Technicians.

Work as a team player. Set a positive attitude and example. Foster a spirit of cooperation and helpfulness with news and other departments. Develop professional relationships with employees of other departments.

Have a high knowledge of operation of current equipment. Advise Director of Operations and Operations Coordinator on equipment needs or problems.

Seek out ways to become more knowledgeable about new technologies in our business.

Reports to work on time and works established schedule/hours.

Other duties as assigned.

Complete other duties as assigned

Basic knowledge and experience with broadcast production equipment, techniques and language; can demonstrate proficiency in use of equipment, techniques and language.

Familiarity with television control rooms, audio rooms, studios and news and non-news productions. Previous experience preferred.

Ability to work well under pressure and meet tight deadlines.

Must be flexible and able to deal with unexpected changes calmly.

Follows directions well.

Ability to work alternate hours and schedules including early mornings, evenings and weekends.

Ability to communicate information and ideas in English both verbally and in writing so that others will understand.

Ability to listen and understand information and ideas presented in English through spoken and written words.

Must be able to work in areas and conditions that can be noisy, has many distractions, and on occasion in extreme weather conditions (heat and cold).

Must have manual dexterity to operate camera and studio equipment.

Must be able to move quickly at times throughout the building and on location.

Stands and sits for long periods of time.

Pushes and pulls equipment on a regular basis.

Work under tight deadlines and in pressure situations.

job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team

 

The Legal department has deep expertise in all core practice areas relevant to a global media and information company, including labor and employment, commercial agreements across all our businesses, privacy, intellectual property, M&A, litigation, corporate governance, compliance, media law and a variety of other specialties.


The team is also responsible for the company’s compliance program, including screening for compliance with international sanctions, enforcement of company policies—such as the Dow Jones Code of Conduct—and bolstering internal systems and controls.


We work in our Midtown Manhattan office 3 days each week.

 

You Will

  • Build a Legal Operations Function: Serve as the first head of Legal Operations at Dow Jones. You will establish the function and develop a clear multi-year strategy. This role, which will have one direct report to start, will report to the General Counsel of Dow Jones, and will join the Legal leadership team. 
  • Strategic Planning & Execution: Assist in various key projects across the department. You will track department goals, manage the legal roadmap, and help ensure we are hitting our milestones.
  • Financial Management: Assist with the legal budget. This includes outside counsel spend management, accruals, and finding "value-based" fee arrangements to replace the billable hour where possible.
  • Technology & Data: Serve as the manager and visionary for our tech stack (CLMs, e-Billing, IP Management, AI integration, and agentic tools). You don’t just use the tools; you optimize them to drive global legal team transformation and provide data-driven insights to the executive team. To start, AI integration and AI-powered solutions (evaluating current tools and scoping the need for next-generation agentic solutions) alongside process improvement will be a key focus and strategic priority.
  • Global Operational Scaling & Change Management: Partner closely with a globally distributed legal team across multiple international regions to harmonize processes and drive adoption of new technologies.
  • Vendor Management: Oversee our relationships with law firms and ALSPs (Alternative Legal Service Providers). You’ll run RFPs when needed and hold our partners accountable.
  • Project Management: Assist with various projects throughout the department. Whether it's implementing a new privacy compliance workflow, streamlining the workflow on contracts, or helping to coordinate legal resources on large projects, you provide the structure that frees up time across the department.
  • Knowledge Management: Help the Legal team build and maintain our internal core contract templates, playbooks, and training materials that empower the wider company to move faster.
  • M&A/Integration: Work closely with the M&A team on possible M&A opportunities and any resulting integration efforts. 

 

You Are

  • The Architect: You see a messy process and instinctively want to build a workflow for it.
  • The Translator: You can speak Legal (risk mitigation/precedent) and Business (ROI/efficiency) fluently.
  • The Diplomat: You can deftly handle an inflated bill just as effectively as you can pitch a new software spend to the CFO.

 

You Have

  • Experience: Minimum of 12 years of operations experience, and at least 5 years specifically within a Legal Operations function required. We are looking for someone who has worked in operations in a global legal department. Experience building a Legal Operations function from inception is strongly preferred.

  • Industry Knowledge: Experience in the Media/Entertainment or Tech sectors is a plus.

  • Collaborative and innovative.
  • Creative self-starter who takes initiative. 
  • Keen sense of how to make appropriate trade-offs between risk and business needs.
  • Big-picture, strategic decision maker with an ability to analyze and explain complex concepts with speed and resolution.

And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

About the Role, Mission or Department Overview

As a temporary editor, you'll edit stories from staff writers on the discovery team and collaborate with cross-team partners on publishing.
