job.title: Group Strategy Director
job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do. 

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious! 

We are looking for a Group Strategy Director to join Translation. This role demands four days in office and one day remote.

What You'll Do

  • Set the strategic direction across key client accounts, ensuring our thinking is clear, differentiated, culturally informed, and connected to meaningful business outcomes.
  • Define the real problem behind complex business and brand challenges, quickly identifying the tensions, opportunities, and strategic choices that should guide the work.
  • Lead the development of brand, cultural, and creative strategy, translating insight into a clear point of view that inspires both clients and creative teams.
  • Lead multiple engagements and workstreams simultaneously, maintaining a high standard of strategic quality while helping teams prioritize what matters most.
  • Shape the strategic approach to major briefs and opportunities, determining what we need to learn, questions to answer, and how different disciplines should come together.
  • Partner with Data Strategy, Context, Business, and Creative leadership to create an integrated strategic vision for the work.
  • Develop and mentor strategists, providing clear direction and feedback while helping junior and mid-level talent strengthen their judgment, storytelling and strategic craft.
  • Raise the quality of the Strategy discipline, establishing strong standards for briefs, narratives, presentations, research, and strategic recommendations.
  • Contribute to Translation’s intellectual capital, developing perspectives that advance how we understand audiences, culture, brands, and business.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Exceptional strategic judgment with the ability to distinguish an interesting observation from an insight that can meaningfully change the work.
  • Strong command of brand, cultural, and creative strategy, with the ability to connect them into a cohesive strategic narrative.
  • Ability to simplify complex business and cultural challenges into clear, compelling strategic choices.
  • Persuasive storyteller who can build and present a strategic argument with clarity, confidence, and conviction.
  • Strong client leadership skills and the ability to build credibility with senior clients.
  • Ability to lead through ambiguity, bringing structure and direction to assignments that may not begin with a clearly defined answer.
  • Strong creative instincts and the ability to translate strategy into direction that inspires and improves creative work.
  • Strong understanding of qualitative and quantitative research, with the judgment to determine when additional research is necessary and how findings should inform strategy.
  • Ability to lead, coach, and elevate other strategists while maintaining accountability for the quality of their work.
  • Collaborative leadership style with the ability to bring different disciplines and perspectives toward a common strategic ambition.
  • Deep curiosity about people, culture, brands, and business, informed by interests and experiences that contribute a distinct point of view.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of relevant experience in strategy, brand development, communications, cultural strategy, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience leading strategy for significant client accounts, campaigns, brand platforms, or integrated engagements.
  • Proven ability to independently develop and defend strategic recommendations with senior clients and internal leadership.
  • Demonstrated ability to synthesize research, cultural intelligence, business context, and audience understanding into actionable strategy.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading strategy across multiple/ complex, multi-workstream accounts.
  • Strong understanding of the digital, social, media, and creator ecosystems.
  • Demonstrated ability to turn cultural understanding into distinctive brand, cultural, and creative strategies.
  • Proven ability to uncover and translate audience-specific insights into impactful brand, cultural, and creative strategies

About UnitedMasters 

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Salary Hiring Range: $188,000 -$221,000

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. bonus, stock options, 401(k) match, etc.)

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.  We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. 

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.  If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for the NY/CA.  As a company, we have a location based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

job.title: Temp-to-Perm Finance Analyst
job.description:
About the Guardian

The Guardian is a global news organization that delivers fearless, independent journalism. From breaking news and award-winning investigations to in-depth coverage of technology, sports, film, culture, and lifestyle, the Guardian offers a global view that deepens our audiences' understanding of America and the world.

Headquartered in New York City, Guardian US is an entirely digital operation that seeks to engage US readers by combining the Guardian's international coverage with US voices and expertise. Core coverage areas include US politics, technology, the climate emergency, economic and racial inequality, health, sports, culture, and more. Guardian US launched in 2011 and has bureaus in New York, Washington DC, New Orleans, and Los Angeles. The Guardian is an independently owned, mission-driven organization funded by readers around the globe.

It's the talent, energy, and commitment our people bring to The Guardian that makes us who we are. Across our business, we have some of the most creative thinkers in media and beyond, award-winning journalists, cutting-edge commercial teams, digital talent, and more.

About the role

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Temp-to-Perm Finance Analyst to support the Finance function through financial reporting, planning, analysis, and business partnership. This role will play a key part in delivering accurate and timely P&L reporting, financial analysis, ad hoc reporting, and management insights, while partnering closely with teams across the organization.

 

The ideal candidate is highly proficient in Hyperion, Microsoft Excel, and Google Workspace, with strong financial acumen and the ability to translate financial data into meaningful insights. This individual will be comfortable working independently, managing multiple priorities, and collaborating cross-functionally to support business objectives and improve financial performance.

 

Department: Finance
Reports to: Interim Head of Finance, US
Location: New York, New York

Hybrid/Remote/In-Person: Hybrid, 3 days 
Terms and conditions: Full-time, Temp to Perm (Temporary duration: 6 months)

Annual Salary: $110-120k

 

Key responsibilities

Financial Reporting & P&L Management

  • Own and support monthly P&L reporting, including preparation, analysis, variance explanations, and identification of key business drivers.
  • Prepare recurring and ad hoc financial reports and analyses for Finance leadership and cross-functional business partners.
  • Support the preparation of presentations and financial insights for Finance leadership and business stakeholders.

Financial Analysis & Strategic Planning

  • Analyze actual results against budget, forecast, and prior periods, identifying trends, risks, opportunities, and actionable insights.
  • Investigate variances and financial trends, working with relevant stakeholders to understand root causes and communicate findings.
  • Support the broader Finance function across forecasting, budgeting, reporting, planning, and other strategic and operational initiatives.
  • Assist with special projects and other ad hoc analyses as needed to support evolving business and Finance priorities.

Systems, Modeling & Process Improvement

  • Leverage Hyperion to support financial reporting, data analysis, forecasting, budgeting, and financial planning processes.
  • Develop and maintain sophisticated Excel-based financial models, reporting tools, and analyses to support decision-making.
  • Utilize Google Workspace, including Google Sheets, and Google Slides, to facilitate reporting, analysis, presentations, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Develop and improve reporting processes, templates, and analytical tools to increase efficiency, accuracy, and visibility into financial performance.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Collaboration

  • Partner with other Finance team members to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of financial reporting.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders to understand business performance, gather financial inputs, resolve discrepancies, and provide financial guidance.
  • Serve as a trusted financial partner to cross-functional teams, helping stakeholders understand financial results and make informed business decisions.

 

About you

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of relevant financial analysis or FP&A experience.
  • Strong experience with P&L reporting, financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex formulas, financial modeling, data analysis, and reporting.
  • Hands-on experience with Hyperion or a comparable enterprise financial planning and reporting system.
  • Strong proficiency with Google Workspace, particularly Google Sheets, Slides, and Drive.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and deliver both recurring and ad hoc financial reporting.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to communicate financial information clearly to both Finance and non-Finance stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and business partnering skills.

 

How to apply

We know there are great candidates who might not check all these boxes or who possess important skills we haven’t thought of. If that’s you, we encourage you to apply and tell us about yourself.

All candidates interested in applying should upload a resume and cover letter.  

 

All roles at the Guardian are open for everybody to apply. It is important to us that you feel supported and comfortable throughout your recruitment process, in order to perform your best. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it easier and more comfortable for you. Please email the recruiter listed on the job posting or at recruitment.us@theguardian.com to discuss further so we can work with you to support you through your application.

 

Compensation and benefits

  • 20 days of vacation leave in addition to 12 company holidays and 2 personal days
  • Unlimited sick time
  • Employee Assistance Programs
  • 401(k) Match
  • Subsidized healthcare coverage including medical, vision, and dental
  • Medical and Dependent Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Generous parental leave with 100% pay
  • Long Term and Short Term Disability insurance 
  • Life insurance 
  • Commuter benefits 
  • Wellhub
  • Work/Life balance: Flexible hybrid schedule 

 

Culture & wellbeing

We want everyone to feel like they belong at the Guardian and we champion diversity of thought. You will also have the opportunity to hear unique insight from our journalists in our morning conference, a live discussion on the news story of the day. 

We offer great tools to help you prioritize your wellbeing including access to Employee Assistance Programs. 

Learning & development

We encourage personal and professional growth. Employees have access to a broad range of tools and solutions, and we are happy to support the pursuit of professional qualifications through vocational courses and apprenticeships.

Sustainability

Our goal is to become an environmentally regenerative company and we have signed up to a sustainability vision and strategy to reach it. Find more information about sustainability at GNM here.

***

The Guardian is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, color, national origin, ethnic origin, citizenship status, disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law in its employment policies. In addition, the Guardian will provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities.

 

We value and respect all differences (seen and unseen) in all people at the Guardian. We aspire to have inclusive working experiences and an environment that reflects the audience we serve, where our people have equal access to career development opportunities, their voices are heard and can contribute to our future.

job.title: Salesforce Developer
job.description:
About SoundExchange

SoundExchange is the largest global neighboring rights organization in the world, redefining how creators in the music industry get paid. By turning data into fast, accurate revenue for artists and rights owners, we have collected and distributed more than $13 billion in digital performance royalties to date on behalf of more than 800,000 music creators. As the sole organization designated by the U.S. government to administer the Section 114 sound recording license, SoundExchange seamlessly collects and distributes digital performance royalties from platforms like Pandora, SiriusXM, iHeartRadio, and thousands more, as well as all available international performance royalties through a strong global partnership network. 

 

Title: Salesforce Developer
Department: Technology
Job Location: Washington, DC or anywhere (Continental US) (If local, on-site Tuesdays and Wednesdays)
Reports To: Director, Engineering
Supervisory Role: No
FLSA Status: Exempt

Position Summary: 

SoundExchange seeks a Salesforce Developer to design, build, maintain, and enhance scalable Salesforce solutions and integrations that support account management and customer service operations.

The Salesforce Developer will translate business requirements into secure, maintainable solutions on the Salesforce platform; integrate Salesforce with existing systems; ensure data quality, reliability, and security; and provide ongoing technical support for production applications.

The ideal candidate combines hands-on Salesforce development and configuration experience with the ability to design complex solutions, collaborate with technical and business stakeholders, and support reliable applications in a production environment.

Essential Functions:

  • Design, develop, configure, and deploy scalable Salesforce solutions that meet documented business and technical requirements
  • Participate throughout the software development life cycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, code review, testing, documentation, deployment, and production support
  • Support, maintain, troubleshoot, and enhance existing Salesforce applications to improve reliability, performance, usability, and maintainability
  • Design, build, document, monitor, and maintain secure integrations between Salesforce and other applications using APIs, web services, and event-based integration patterns
  • Collaborating with stakeholders and other developers to identify and implement improvements for the system
  • Apply Salesforce security, privacy, and development standards, including appropriate access controls, secure coding practices, and protection of sensitive data
  • Collaborating with integrated teams to ensure smooth data flow with minimal interruptions or disruptions

Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities (KSAs):

  • Proficient in Salesforce administration and development concepts, including Lightning Experience, Lightning Web Components, Flow, security and sharing, and platform configuration
  • Proficiency with Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, SOSL, Salesforce APIs, asynchronous processing, and declarative automation; familiarity with Visualforce for supporting legacy solutions
  • Understanding of the Salesforce data model, including standard and custom objects, relationships, fields, data quality, data migration, and governance practices
  • Ability to influence and communicate effectively with team members and business partners
  • Proficiency in Agile software development methodology, processes, and practices
  • Experience with Salesforce testing and release-management practices, including Apex unit tests, automated regression testing, source control, code review, and CI/CD deployment pipelines
  • Knowledge of Salesforce integration patterns, REST and SOAP APIs, authentication mechanisms, middleware, error handling, and integration monitoring
  • Experience developing, integrating, or supporting Salesforce Marketing Cloud solutions is preferred

Required Education, Certifications/ Licenses, Related Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent experience
  • 4 years or more years of experience in software engineering
  • At least 3 years of experience in Salesforce development

ADA SPECIFICATIONS:

  • This position requires the ability to remain in a stationary position (standing and/or seated) all of the time
  • This position requires the ability to spend all of the time viewing computer monitors

Travel Requirements:

  • If hired remote, this person is expected to travel to the Washington DC corporate office as needed (2-4 times per year).

PAY RANGE:  $115,000.00 - $135,000.00 

Note:

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. Management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary.

Taking Care Of The Band:

At SoundExchange we empower creators and help shape the future of music. One way we do this is by respecting different voices, varied perspectives, and distinct backgrounds of all our team members. We are intentional in creating a culture where we recognize that all employees have the opportunities and support needed to thrive. We strive to create teams that reflect the music community we serve – every individual’s unique attributes and abilities are valued, and are part of how we innovate, create, and deliver experiences to the creators we champion.

SoundExchange has an employee-led committee that focuses on amplifying different voices and backgrounds and undertakes activities to promote inclusion and access. It helps to cultivate SoundExchange culture and policies, advocates for equality within the music industry, and participates in community building activities in the Washington, DC area where SoundExchange is located.

All with the goal of promoting more belonging and access in the workplace, music industry, and local community.

Accommodations:

SoundExchange is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the SoundExchange Careers website as a result of your disability. We will make a determination on your request for reasonable accommodation on a case-by-case basis.  If you need an accommodation, please email jobs@soundexchange.com.

job.title: 21GRAMS- Account Director
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a Account Director to join our growing team!

21GRAMS, a Real Chemistry subsidiary is an advertising agency born to make healthcare more human. Not just in our work, but in the way we conduct business, approach client relationships, and treat each other. It’s a place where people subscribe to the adage, “Be good to each other, but hard on the work.” A place where people are not just in it for the paycheck, but to make a dent in the universe. Sound like you?

21GRAMS is in search of an Account Director. In addition to being the diplomatic face of the brand, both internally and externally, they accept the role of manager, liaison, thinker, and problem-solver. The Account Director leads broad-based, complex work-streams, is critical to the smooth running of Accounts, is a credible advisor and has very strong marketing communications experience.

The Account Director has mastered communications, project management, and has a strong point of view on the pharmaceutical side. This person should be able to confidently lead client projects and internal teams, encouraging smart, effective and integrated solutions, and always deliver results and client satisfaction. This position offers the opportunity to become an internal leader while developing strong relationships with clients.

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, Lambertville or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What you'll do:

  • Establish and maintain productive working relationships to drive agency success
  • Demonstrate understanding and knowledge of key messages/message platform, data, and promotional story for brand and competition
  • Develop and align on key agency/client documents that drive success (e.g., Project and Creative Briefs)
  • Read and interpret analytics around programming, tactics, and overall brand performance (e.g., metrics, KPIs, goals)
  • Negotiate, when necessary, to meet and deliver on client needs while managing agency resources and projects effectively
  • Continuously identify new opportunities to make recommendations based on customers, markets, and competitive environments, including corresponding rationales
  • Lead by example: exhibit professional conduct while providing ongoing leadership as a role model for the team
  • Demonstrate a solutions-oriented approach and collaborate across teams to drive success
  • Pursue business objectives, while developing talent and preserving the 21GRAMS culture
  • Supervise, train, and mentor team members to develop the skills and careers of others by providing guidance

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • Our Company values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I", genuinely resonate with how you work and lead.
  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.
  • You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact.

What you should have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in communications, marketing or a related field or equivalent
    experience is required
  • 5-7 years marketing experience, agency environment preferred.
  • Strong ability to multi-task and manage multiple projects with strong organizational
    skills.
  • Excellent business communication skills
  • Strong written and oral communication and presentations skills
  • Experience working on Therapeutic brands a plus

job.description:
Location: NC-Charlotte

Job Title:  Content Coordinator - WSOC TV

 

Position Overview

WSOC TV Charlotte is looking for a Content Coordinator to join the team! The Content Center aggressively follows breaking news, coordinates coverage among our crews and creates content for our online and on-air platforms.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • You will be responsible for monitoring content resources like station email, phones, scanners, social media and handling logistics for field crews.
  • You will be responsible for gathering and writing content for digital and social platforms, working with your manager to determine the best platform to share each story.
  • Because Charlotte is a hub for major news events, you will work with ABC affiliates, CNN, CMG stations, local partners and other media organizations across the country.
  • You will need to see the big picture and understand the significance of editorial content.
  • You will work directly with reporters, photographers, producers and other newsroom managers to stay on top of the news of the day and prepare for major news events.

Minimum Qualifications

  • The ideal candidate is someone who loves to investigate news tips and see stories through to online and on-air distribution. You must be able to work under pressure, meet strict deadlines, be aggressive on breaking news and be self-motivated.
  • You must be a strong writer with editorial judgement and organizational skills.

 

Preferred Qualifications

The Director, Financial Data Reporting leads the strategy, architecture, development, and delivery of enterprise ﬁnancial data and business intelligence solutions. This role combines deep expertise in data engineering, warehousing, analytics, ﬁnancial systems, and technical leadership to improve business processes, expand access to trusted information, and enable timely, informed decision-making.

 

The Director owns the full systems development life cycle for complex reporting and data initiatives—from requirements and solution design through testing, implementation, production support, and continuous optimization. The role also directs the conﬁguration of interactive dashboards, including global and local ﬁlters, to meet a broad range of ﬁnance and business requirements.

 

Serving as a trusted partner to executive leadership, Corporate Finance, IT, Security, and cross-functional stakeholders, the Director translates business needs into scalable technical solutions, strengthens data governance and controls, resolves performance challenges, and advances the organization’s ﬁnancial reporting capabilities.

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic leadership: Connects data and technology priorities to business strategy and long-term enterprise needs.
  • Business partnership: Builds credibility across Finance, IT, Security, operations, vendors, and executive leadership.
  • Execution and accountability: Converts complex requirements into reliable solutions and delivers measurable results across competing priorities.
  • Continuous improvement: Uses data, technology, and disciplined problem-solving to simplify processes and improve performance.
  • Communication and inﬂuence: Presents complex information clearly and drives alignment across technical and nontechnical audiences.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead the strategy, design, development, testing, implementation, and continuous improvement of enterprise ﬁnancial data reporting, data warehouse, and business intelligence solutions.
  • Manage the full systems development life cycle across multiple concurrent projects, ensuring solutions align with stakeholder requirements, technical standards, delivery commitments, and business priorities.
  • Own the AWS (RDS MySQL, S3) and SQL Server reporting databases, including moving the remaining legacy reporting to AWS.
  • Own month-end close data processing: WideOrbit, programmatic, digital and MAI revenue loads and the journal entry/invoice ﬁles into SAP, including reconciliations and controls.
  • Own the Power BI estate: reports, data models, scheduled refreshes and subscriptions, including daily revenue pacing and the daily liquidity summary.
  • Lead digital analytics data engineering on Google Cloud (BigQuery) and the Tableau-to-Power BI migration.
  • Direct the contractors and vendors supporting data and reporting.
  • Maintain documentation, runbooks and backup coverage so no critical process depends on one person.
  • Evaluate and recommend system architecture that improves scalability, reliability, availability, performance, and access to critical ﬁnancial data.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

  • Build and optimize data processes that integrate multiple disparate data sets into a trusted reporting environment, reducing executive reporting cycle times.
  • Partner with Corporate Finance and cross-functional teams to identify reporting needs, resolve data and warehouse performance issues, and deliver timely, actionable insights.
  • Oversee the integration of WideOrbit, WideOrbit Programs, MAI, Concur, Costar, Darwin, Operative, ADP, Blackline, Magnit, and related vendor systems with SAP and the broader reporting environment.
  • Design and conﬁgure interactive dashboards using global and local ﬁlters to support a diverse matrix of ﬁnancial and operational requirements.
  • Establish data governance, validation, reconciliation, documentation, and quality-control practices that support accurate, consistent, secure, and audit-ready ﬁnancial reporting.
  • Partner with Finance, IT, and Security to maintain appropriate data access, privacy, retention, and information-security standards.
  • Provide production support and operational oversight, including monitoring, incident resolution, root-cause analysis, change management, and business continuity for critical reporting solutions.
  • Deﬁne and monitor success measures for data availability, reporting accuracy, system performance, user adoption, project delivery, and stakeholder satisfaction.
  • Provide technical leadership, communicate complex data concepts clearly, manage key vendor relationships, and serve as a trusted advisor to executive leaders, business partners, and technical teams.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related ﬁeld; an equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience may be considered.
  • 10 or more years of progressive experience in ﬁnancial data reporting, data warehousing, business intelligence, analytics, or ﬁnancial systems, including at least ﬁve years leading enterprise initiatives, technical teams, or cross-functional programs.
  • Demonstrated success delivering executive reporting solutions and leading complex systems integrations, cloud or data warehouse migrations, and ERP transformations.
  • Advanced knowledge of SQL-based environments, cloud data platforms, dimensional modeling, fact and dimension tables, dashboard design, data quality practices, and ﬁnancial reporting architecture.
  • Experience with project management, SDLC governance, quality assurance, production support, and vendor management in a complex operating environment.
  • Proven ability to inﬂuence senior leaders, translate business needs into scalable technical solutions, manage competing priorities, and support multiple business units.
  • Strong written, verbal, analytical, and executive-presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to ﬁnancial, operational, and technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with SAP, Power BI, AWS MySQL, Google Cloud (BigQuery), and enterprise ﬁnancial or media-industry systems.

job.title: Regional Market Engineering Manager
job.description:
Regional Market Engineering Manager - Twin Falls

*This is a hybrid position that involves travel, after-hours and weekend work, and on-call availability as required. You will be supporting our Boise, Twin Falls, Tri-Cities, Yakima, and Wenatchee markets. *

 

About Townsquare Media:

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Boise, Twin Falls, Tri-Cities – Richland/Kennewick/Pasco, Yakima, and Wenatchee stations. 

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

The Regional Market Engineering Manager Opportunity:

Townsquare Media is looking for a Regional Market Engineering Manager to oversee our multi-station broadcast radio facilities in the Boise, Twin Falls, Tri-Cities, Yakima, and Wenatchee markets. 

 

Essential Functions:

Travel & Transportation:

  • Maintain a valid driver's license and reliable transportation
  • Drive independently to multiple transmitter sites across assigned markets, including remote locations
  • Respond to emergency equipment failures on short notice, including after hours and weekends
  • Travel between sites safely and efficiently, navigating to locations without assistance

Technical Operations:

  • Manage activities for a goal of 100% uptime of station on-air and streaming products
  • Inspect, repair, and maintain all broadcast radio station equipment, including transmitters, antennas, satellite downlinks, automation systems, studio equipment, remote equipment, generators, telephone systems, and related equipment
  • Install and maintain AoIP and automation systems (Zetta and Wheatstone experience preferred)
  • Maintain and troubleshoot AM directional antenna systems
  • Maintain EAS systems, logging compliance, and related equipment
  • Maintain personal computers, servers, printers, and software; perform updates as needed
  • Install and maintain LAN systems
  • Ensure compliance with FCC technical rules and perform duties of Chief Operator
  • Ensure compliance with all Company Engineering and Information Technology practices

Cognitive & Communication:

  • Read and interpret technical documents, safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, schematics, and procedure manuals
  • Follow detailed verbal and written instructions accurately and retain information necessary to complete tasks
  • Identify and differentiate between multiple transmitters, equipment components, and site locations
  • Diagnose equipment issues and make real-time decisions to restore broadcast operations
  • Write routine reports and correspondence
  • Speak effectively with programming staff, management, and other employees to achieve operational goals
  • Interface with Senior Vice President of Engineering and Senior Vice President, Information Technology, as well as other Corporate Technical Staff to ensure current guidance and best practices are followed.

Safety & Physical Requirements:

  • Follow all safety protocols for working with high-voltage equipment and at tower sites
  • Maintain situational awareness to prevent falls and injuries
  • Climb ladders and work at heights
  • Work in varying weather conditions and outdoor environments
  • Frequently stand, walk, sit, use hands to finger, handle, or feel, reach with hands and arms, and talk or hear
  • Occasionally climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl
  • Frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds; occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds
  • Maintain close visual acuity to prepare and analyze data and figures, view a computer terminal, read extensively, visually inspect small defects and parts, operate machines, and use measurement devices

 

Qualifications:

  • Technical training school, or two to four years related experience and/or training, or equivalent combination of education and experience (required)
  • SBE or computer-related certification helpful but not required
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Windows (all versions), Microsoft Office, networking concepts, computer hardware, and wireless/handheld devices
  • Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists
  • Ability to interpret instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form

 

Work Schedule:

  • After-hours and weekend work as required
  • On-call availability for emergency response

 

Disclaimer:

This job description should not be construed to imply that these requirements are the exclusive standards of the position. The incumbent will follow any other instructions and perform any other related duties as may be required by the supervisor. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

 

Benefits:

  • 3 weeks of PTO (+ 9 paid holidays)
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Casual, high-energy work environment
  • Opportunity for upward mobility
  • Company provided laptop
  • Competitive salary + bonus program
  • Company discounts
  • Pet Insurance
  • Time off for volunteering
  • And much more…

 

About Us:

Townsquare is a community-focused digital media, digital marketing solutions and radio company focused outside the Top 50 markets in the U.S. Our assets include Townsquare Interactive, a digital marketing services subscription business providing web sites, search engine optimization, social platforms and online reputation management for approximately 21,900 SMBs; Townsquare IGNITE, a proprietary digital programmatic advertising technology with an in-house demand and data management platform; and Townsquare Media, our portfolio of 357 local terrestrial radio stations in 74 cities with corresponding local news and entertainment websites and apps including legendary brands such as WYRK.com, WJON.com, and NJ101.5.com, along with a network of national music brands including XXLmag.com, TasteofCountry.com, UltimateClassicRock.com and Loudwire.com.

About Townsquare Media:

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Fort Collins, Casper, Cheyenne, and Laramie stations.

The Regional Market Engineering Manager Opportunity:

Townsquare Media is looking for a Market Engineering Manager to oversee our multi-station broadcast radio facility in the Fort Collins, Casper, Cheyenne, and Laramie markets. 

This position serves as the sole technical authority for market-level engineering operations and is responsible for the planning, analysis, and independent decision-making that governs broadcast continuity, FCC compliance, and infrastructure strategy across all assigned stations. The Market Engineering Manager exercises independent judgment on matters that directly affect station revenue, regulatory standing, and operational performance, and will personally perform technical work when operational circumstances require.

 

Essential Functions:

The following duties are essential functions of this position. The ability to perform each of these functions, with or without reasonable accommodation, is a condition of employment.

Independent Judgment and Decision-Making

  • Exercise independent judgment to assess, prioritize, and resolve technical failures affecting station broadcast continuity, including real-time decisions during on-air emergencies where delays directly impact revenue and regulatory standing
  • Evaluate equipment performance and determine appropriate corrective action, including the authority to take systems offline, reroute signals, or authorize emergency repairs without prior approval when broadcast continuity is at risk
  • Ability and willingness to serve as Chief Operator under FCC rules, with independent authority to ensure station compliance with all applicable technical regulations
  • Conduct root cause analysis of equipment failures and develop technical solutions to prevent recurrence
  • Evaluate and optimize broadcast transmission infrastructure and technical systems to ensure operational continuity and regulatory compliance
  • Develop technical operating standards for market engineering operations
  • Develop and recommend capital expenditure plans for infrastructure upgrades, including vendor evaluation, budget proposals, and cost-benefit analysis for executive approval
  • Evaluate and select vendors and contractors for engineering projects and maintenance

Technical Operations

  • Inspect, diagnose, repair, and maintain all broadcast radio station equipment, including transmitters, antennas, satellite downlinks, automation systems, studio equipment, remote equipment, generators, telephone systems, and related equipment
  • Install and maintain AoIP and automation systems (Zetta and Wheatstone experience preferred)
  • Maintain and troubleshoot AM directional antenna systems
  • Maintain EAS systems, logging compliance, and related equipment
  • Maintain personal computers, servers, printers, and software; perform updates as needed
  • Install and maintain LAN systems
  • Ensure compliance with all Company Engineering and Information Technology practices

Travel and Emergency Response

  • Maintain a valid driver’s license and reliable transportation
  • Drive independently to multiple transmitter sites across assigned markets, including remote locations
  • Respond to emergency equipment failures on short notice, including after hours and weekends; this role requires on-call availability reflecting the position’s independent authority over broadcast operations
  • Travel between sites safely and efficiently, navigating to locations without assistance

Cognitive and Communication Requirements

  • Read and interpret technical documents, safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, schematics, and procedure manuals
  • Follow detailed verbal and written instructions accurately and retain information necessary to complete tasks
  • Identify and differentiate between multiple transmitters, equipment components, and site locations
  • Diagnose equipment issues and make real-time decisions to restore broadcast operations
  • Write routine reports, technical documentation, and correspondence
  • Communicate effectively with programming staff, management, and other employees to achieve operational goals
  • Interface with the Senior Vice President of Engineering, Senior Vice President of
  • Information Technology, and other Corporate Technical Staff to ensure current guidance and best practices are followed

  • Follow all safety protocols for working with high-voltage equipment and at tower sites

  • Climb ladders and work at heights
  • Work in varying weather conditions and outdoor environments
  • Frequently stand, walk, sit, use hands to handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, and talk or hear
  • Occasionally climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl

job.title: Sales Internship, Townsquare Media Group – Boise
job.description:
Sales Internship, Townsquare Media Group – Boise

*This position requires you to work in-office and on-site as needed. * 

 

Launch Your Sales & Media Career:

Interested in a career in sales, advertising, or digital marketing? Townsquare Media’s Sales Internship gives college students the opportunity to gain real-world experience while learning how businesses use media and marketing to grow.

As a Sales Intern with our Boise team, you won’t spend your internship sitting on the sidelines. You’ll work alongside experienced sales professionals, learn the fundamentals of consultative selling, and gain exposure to the full sales process—from identifying prospective clients and qualifying opportunities to conducting needs analysis and securing appointments.

You’ll also get a behind-the-scenes look at how a local media company operates, with exposure to our radio brands, digital marketing solutions, on-air operations, community events, and the teams that bring it all together.

 

Why Townsquare Media Group?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Boise stations.  

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

What You’ll Do:

As an intern on our Boise sales team, you’ll gain hands-on experience with the fundamentals that drive successful sales organizations. You’ll have the opportunity to:

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

WFMY-TV Greensboro, the TEGNA-owned CBS affiliate in Greensboro is seeking an innovative Producer to shape our daily newscasts. At WFMY-TV Greensboro, we build creative shows that engage, educate and inform our audiences. We prioritize original storytelling and investigative journalism as key components of our newscasts to set our product apart in the Greensboro market. 

At TEGNA, we are committed to our core values: We Win, We Work Smarter, We Demand the Truth, and We Do the Right Thing. These values guide how we create content and serve our communities.

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. 

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

Position Summary:

The Director Touring serves as the Touring teams senior representative on the road for national and international touring productions, including arena, stadium, tours. This role is responsible for overseeing the overall financial and operational execution of assigned tours from launch through final settlement. In addition, the Director provides guidance and support to Managers and Senior Managers, personnel and part-time road staff, and helps identify and implement best practices that improve consistency, efficiency, and execution across the Road Touring team.

Essential Functions:

  • Oversee the financial management of assigned national and international tours, including artist settlements, venue settlements, expense reconciliation, revenue reporting, foreign currency considerations, contractual settlements, and final tour closeout activities.
  • Serve as AEG's senior representative for assigned arena, stadium, and international touring, by maintaining relationships with external artist management, and venue teams, throughout the entire tour.
  • Oversee the internal collaboration across Ticketing, Finance, Operations, Marketing, Production, and road touring teams for a successful execution of assigned tours
  • Resolve complex operational, financial, artist-related, and customer service issues that arise during a tour to minimize disruptions and maintain tour continuity.
  • Provide guidance and support to Managers, Senior Managers, and touring personnel on settlements, artist relations, ticketing, and operational matters by reinforcing established touring practices, procedures, and expectations.
  • Support the onboarding, training, and development of touring personnel and part-time road staff while identifying opportunities to improve processes, share best practices, and drive consistency across touring operations.

Required Qualifications:

  • BA/BS Degree (4-year)
  • 6-8 years Of related work experience
  • Understanding of accounting and ability to complete accurate show settlements (inclusive of working knowledge of global exchange rates)
  • Understanding of and experience in touring music business both domestic and international (i.e. has worked on at least one touring project that has extended beyond North America).
  • Ability to build effective working relationships with clients, venues, and co-workers
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook)
  • Excellent written, verbal and listening communication skills

job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a AI-Forward Technical Delivery Manager join our growing team!

21GRAMS, Real Chemistry’s advertising agency, has been ranked the #2 creative health agency in the world by Cannes Lions. ROOM42 is 21GRAMS’ in-house production company, content studio, and Digital & Technology services arm — the team that turns briefs, Figma files, and napkin sketches into working, beautiful, compliant digital deliverables for the top pharma and biotech companies in the world.

We are looking for an AI-Forward Technical Delivery Manager (TDM) to run technical delivery across the full ROOM42 output spectrum — marketing websites, microsites, emails (including Veeva rep-triggered and approved email), banners, IVAs, conference kiosks and interactive experiences — built with in-house developers and specialist vendor partners. This is the person who owns whether the right work gets to the right build team, whether the estimate is real, whether it ships to spec and on time, and who is increasingly using AI to make all of that faster and more consistent. The project manager and account teams own the client relationship and the date. The TDM owns whether that date is achievable and gets the work built — qualifying intake, routing to the right build team, running the review-and-QA lifecycle, holding vendors to standard, and applying AI where it creates genuine delivery leverage, not novelty.

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville, NJ, San Francisco, or Carmel, IN or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What you’ll do:

Intake & Technical Qualification

  • Triage incoming requests from Workfront and Jira; assign deliverable type, complexity tier, and dependency flags (Veeva, MLR, client restrictions) within a defined SLA.
  • Return incomplete requests rather than absorbing them — no handoff to build without specs, assets, link matrix, CTAs/UTMs, and a real level-of-effort estimate.
  • Own or validate the estimate before any build commitment, using ROOM42’s estimation tooling and rate card. 

Build Team Routing & Vendor Management

  • Decide in-house vs. vendor partner per project against MSA offshore rules, client restrictions, Veeva dependency, and capacity — and escalate routing decisions that carry cost or transition implications.
  • Run day-to-day vendor delivery: standing syncs, staging-date accountability, cap-burn visibility against SOW, and knowledge-transfer documentation during vendor transitions.
  • Escalate quality issues to the vendor lead and commercial issues to the Digital & Technology leadership.

Technical Delivery Lifecycle

  • Own delivery from kickoff through post-launch: dev kickoff, staging links, review-round sequencing (R1/R2/R3), MLR/PRC submission readiness, QA gate, and go-live.
  • Maintain a live view of technical progress across a concurrent portfolio; proactively flag risks to Producers and Delivery leadership before they surface in status calls.
  • Drive milestone gates with QA — confirm that what moves from development to QA to UAT to production is actually ready, not optimistically ready.
  • Manage technical dependencies across concurrent projects (shared environments, overlapping timelines, licensing, PDUFA-anchored dates) and surface conflicts before they collide.

AI-Augmented Delivery

  • Use AI tools daily to accelerate the delivery workflow — status synthesis, ticket hygiene, QA support, specification drafting, and documentation — not as novelties but as real accelerators.
  • Partner on ROOM42’s AI-augmented QA and design-to-code workflows (visual regression, accessibility scanning, Figma-to-code handoff) so quality is structural and repeatable across deliverable types.
  • Help define and document AI-assisted delivery playbooks per deliverable type so the approach scales beyond a single practitioner, and evaluate emerging tooling for genuine leverage.
  • Apply judgment to AI output — know where AI-assisted work needs human review before it reaches a client, and keep quality from degrading as volume scales.

Quality, Standards & Portfolio Hygiene

  • Define ‘done’ for each deliverable type with the technical lead and QA — not just ‘it works,’ but performant, accessible, cross-browser validated, MLR-clean, and visually faithful to approved design.
  • Own quality accountability for your portfolio: if something ships broken or fails an MLR technical review, own the root cause and the remediation.
  • Enforce Jira/Workfront field discipline and status accuracy so the portfolio is legible to leadership and reporting is reliable.
  • Lead post-launch reviews on major engagements; translate defect patterns into upstream process improvements.

Partnership & Communication

  • Serve as the technical delivery counterpart to Producers, account teams, UX/UI, developers, and QA — translating between them without jargon.
  • Partner with Producers on SOW scoping: turn creative and functional requirements into accurate hours, stack decisions, and phased rollout plans.
  • Participate in client-facing conversations where technical delivery credibility matters — scoping sessions, risk discussions, and demo walkthroughs.

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.
  • You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact.

What you should have:

This means applying AI to concrete delivery problems (specification drafting, estimation, ticket and status synthesis, QA support, documentation, triage classification, deployment), measuring whether it actually saved time, and exercising judgment over the output before it reaches a client.

  • 5+ years of digital project or technical delivery management in an agency or production environment, running concurrent digital builds from intake through launch.
  • Hands-on experience delivering across web (WordPress and/or Drupal), email, and banners; exposure to IVAs, Veeva, or interactive experiences a strong plus.
  • Pharma, healthcare, or other regulated-delivery experience — familiarity with MLR/PRC review cycles, compliance gates, and fixed regulatory launch dates.
  • Vendor and cross-functional coordination: routing work, holding external partners to standard, and managing offshore/nearshore delivery.
  • Fluency in delivery tooling: Jira, Workfront or comparable, and a working understanding of QA, staging/UAT/production flow, and design-to-code handoff.
  • Enough technical literacy to hold a credible build conversation with developers and vendors, scope realistically, and know when to pull in the technical lead — without needing to write production code.

Nice to have

  • Experience defining and documenting AI-augmented delivery playbooks so the approach scales beyond a single practitioner across a team or vendor pod.
  • Hands-on work with agentic tooling — MCP servers, AI browser agents, or generative UI frameworks — and a point of view on where each creates real delivery leverage.
  • Built AI-assisted QA automation in production: visual regression, accessibility scanning, or AI-generated test coverage.
  • Veeva certification (approved email and/or IVA).
  • Experience standing up delivery processes, studios, or standards from the ground up.

job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry is looking for a Director, Social Media to join our growing Activation team and lead smart, platform-native social work that drives meaningful impact for healthcare clients. 

For us, social isn’t just a channel — it’s a craft. Our Social Media team blends deep healthcare expertise with sharp strategy, standout content, paid media fluency and data-driven execution to help clients show up with purpose across platforms. As Director, you’ll be a day-to-day lead across multiple books of business, helping teams move from big ideas to smart execution while coaching people, guiding clients and raising the quality of the work. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. This role will primarily support East Coast working hours; candidates based in other time zones may be considered if they are comfortable working East Coast hours. 

What You’ll Do: 

Social Leadership, Strategy & Business Impact 

  • Lead integrated social media programs across organic, paid and influencer workstreams, translating strategy into smart, compliant, platform-native execution. 
  • Lead complex client engagements with confidence, helping teams deliver strategic, high-quality work that drives measurable impact. 
  • Bring clarity and momentum to client programs by pairing strong creative instincts, sharp copy and smart storytelling with organized, insight-led execution. 

Client Partnership, Meetings & Storytelling 

  • Serve as a trusted day-to-day client lead, running recurring, ad-hoc and planning meetings with confidence, clarity and a little spark. 
  • Connect the dots across social, paid, influencer and performance data, turning analytics into clear insights, recommendations and senior-level narratives. 
  • Stay one step ahead of client needs, bringing thoughtful solutions, clear next steps and a steady hand to help programs run smoothly from planning through execution. 

AI, Innovation & Smarter Social Operations 

  • Champion responsible AI adoption across social workflows, using tools like Microsoft Copilot, Canva, social listening platforms and analytics dashboards to improve research, ideation, content development, reporting and presentations. 
  • Help teams use AI with good judgment, keeping healthcare accuracy, client privacy, compliance and brand standards at the center. 

Business Growth & New Opportunities 

  • Partner with colleagues to identify opportunities to expand, refine or elevate social media programming across existing accounts. 
  • Contribute to growth opportunities by shaping smart social POVs, strategic recommendations and pitch-ready thinking. 

This Position is a Perfect Fit for You if: 

Mindset, Ownership & Leadership Style 

  • You’re a confident, curious social leader who loves the pace of platform change but keeps the work grounded, strategic and reputable. 
  • You can zoom out to spot patterns, connect insights to business opportunities and zoom in to make the strategy, copy, storytelling and details sharper. 
  • You enjoy coaching people, building trust with clients and living our values: Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I.” 

What Experience & Skills You Should have: 

Experience, Leadership & Healthcare Context 

  • 7–10 years of social media, digital marketing or integrated communications experience, ideally in healthcare, biotech, pharma or another regulated industry. 
  • Agency experience in a client-facing role, with the ability to manage multiple accounts, assignments and stakeholders at once. 
  • Experience leading teams, managing performance and supporting the development of direct or indirect reports. 
  • Comfort balancing hands-on client work with team leadership, internal initiatives and business development support. 
  • College degree required; BA or equivalent preferred; understanding of FDA, fair balance, adverse event and client review considerations preferred. 

Social, Paid, Influencer, Analytics & Tools 

  • Deep understanding of social platforms, audience behavior and content best practices across organic, paid and influencer-led programs. 
  • Experience building strategic plans, channel recommendations, paid social approaches and insight-led performance narratives for senior stakeholders. 
  • Fluency with social buying, publishing, listening, analytics and AI-enabled tools, including platforms such as Meta Business Manager, LinkedIn Ads, Sprinklr, Sprout Social, Brandwatch, Microsoft Office and Canva. 
  • Strong communication, organization and judgment, with the ability to synthesize inputs, shape strong copy, delegate effectively and keep work moving.

job.title: R1 News Anchor
job.description:
About the Role:

The R1 News Anchor is responsible for anchoring newscasts, news gathering, reporting, content creation, execution, and collaborative strategy on all WIBC/Network Indiana on air, digital and social platforms. The position requires the production and gathering of text, images, audio/video,etc. Video production and posting experience preferred. The ideal candidate will have a knack for social media and possess excellent writing skills and news judgement. Will be responsible for creating on air news packages for use on WIBC and Network Indiana and anchoring newscasts as assigned. This role requires synthesizing complex information into clear, concise narratives that inform and captivate viewers while maintaining journalistic integrity and impartiality. The anchor will collaborate closely with producers, reporters, and technical staff to ensure seamless broadcast execution and adherence to editorial standards. Additionally, the position involves staying current with breaking news, conducting live interviews, and adapting to rapidly changing news environments. Ultimately, the R1 News Anchor plays a critical role in shaping public understanding and trust through professional and compelling news presentation.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Proven experience as a news anchor or reporter with on-air presence in a professional broadcast environment.
  • Exceptional verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate complex information clearly and engagingly.
  • Strong understanding of journalistic ethics, news production processes, and media law.
  • Ability to work under pressure and adapt quickly to breaking news and changing schedules.
  • Experience with digital media platforms and social media engagement to extend news reach.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, Broadcast Media, or a related field.
  • Proficiency in teleprompter operation and familiarity with broadcast studio technology.
  • Experience in investigative journalism or specialized reporting areas such as politics, economics, or science.

Responsibilities:

  • Present daily news broadcasts clearly and confidently, ensuring accuracy and professionalism in delivery.
  • Write report on, write, and edit news stories, scripts, and content for broadcast.

job.title: Senior Data Product Manager- eCommerce
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How we LEAD:

We seek an experienced and driven Sr. Data Product Manager – eCommerce within the Global Data & Analytics Products team.

As AI transforms how businesses operate, trusted data products become even more critical. In this role, you will ensure UMG's eCommerce data products are AI-ready by design—governed, semantically consistent, well-documented, observable, and trusted—enabling analytics, predictive models, intelligent agents, and generative AI applications to reliably consume enterprise data at scale. You'll also embrace AI as part of your own product management practice, using modern AI tools to accelerate discovery, prototyping, documentation, and collaboration while maintaining a relentless focus on delivering measurable business outcomes.

You are passionate about treating data as a product and building trusted, scalable data foundations that enable decision-making across UMG. You understand that great data products require more than pipelines—they require clear ownership, reliability, governance, usability, and stakeholder trust.

In this role, you will lead the strategy and execution of enterprise eCommerce data products and data marts that serve as authoritative sources of truth for digital commerce performance. These products will power reporting, analytics, predictive modeling, AI applications, intelligent automation, and data-driven decision-making across UMG’s direct-to-consumer ecosystem.

You will partner closely with eCommerce business leaders, Product, Marketing, Data Engineering, Analytics, and Governance teams to define, build, and continuously improve trusted data products that are reliable, discoverable, and broadly adopted across the organization.

You will champion product management principles within the data ecosystem, ensuring eCommerce data products have clear roadmaps, service levels, semantic definitions, documentation, quality standards, and measurable business outcomes.

This role will report to the Sr. Director of Product Management (Data Platform).

How you’ll CREATE:

  • Champion AI-ready data products by ensuring trusted business definitions, semantic consistency, metadata, lineage, documentation, observability, and governance are embedded into every data product.
  • Ensure enterprise data products are designed to support emerging AI capabilities, including semantic retrieval, intelligent agents, recommendation systems, and LLM-powered applications.
  • Partner with eCommerce, Marketing, Finance, and Analytics stakeholders to define trusted business metrics, KPIs, and data definitions.
  • Define scalable dimensional models and semantic layers that support entities such as sales, orders, customers, products, subscriptions, marketing attribution, fulfillment, and customer lifecycle reporting.
  • Establish authoritative data products that serve as the source of truth for digital commerce performance across brands, labels, and regions.
  • Partner with enterprise tech & business teams to standardize the global data layer for digital ecommerce
  • Partner with Commercial Strategy, Global Insights, and AI teams to identify opportunities where trusted consumption data products can enable artist forecasting, audience segmentation, fan engagement, trend detection, catalog optimization, and intelligent decision-support.
  • Drive standardization of business definitions for metrics such as revenue, orders, conversion, customer acquisition, repeat purchase, AOV, LTV, refunds, subscriptions, and marketing performance.
  • Partner with engineering teams to implement SLAs, monitoring, observability, incident management, and operational support processes.
  • Establish and maintain data contracts with upstream commerce platforms and source systems to improve reliability and predictability.
  • Drive adoption of eCommerce data products through business-friendly documentation, semantic models, stakeholder enablement, and training.
  • Evaluate opportunities to improve data product usability and business outcomes through AI-enabled capabilities while maintaining strong governance, privacy, and data quality standards.

Bring your VIBE:

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience supporting enterprise eCommerce, direct-to-consumer (D2C), retail, or digital commerce organizations.
  • Experience delivering data products that support AI, machine learning, predictive analytics, or generative AI initiatives
  • Strong understanding of common eCommerce business processes, including product catalog, pricing, promotions, customer lifecycle, order management, fulfillment, subscriptions, and returns.
  • Familiarity with Shopify or other modern commerce platforms such as Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Magento, BigCommerce, or custom commerce ecosystems.
  • Shopify experience Preferred
  • Experience working with customer, order, product, marketing, and transactional datasets.
  • Understanding of digital marketing and attribution concepts, including paid media, email, CRM, customer acquisition, retention, and lifetime value.
  • Demonstrated experience owning data products throughout their lifecycle, from strategy and requirements through adoption and operational support.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage modern AI tools to accelerate product discovery, documentation, analysis, and collaboration.
  • Strong understanding of the data foundations required for enterprise AI, including dimensional modeling, data warehousing concepts, data marts, semantic layers, and modern analytics architectures.
  • Experience in defining and managing data quality frameworks, governance standards, and operational reliability practices.
  • Experience in establishing and managing data contracts and cross-functional data ownership models.
  • Strong SQL proficiency preferred, with the ability to independently validate requirements and investigate data issues.
  • Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes and stakeholder value.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, and influence skills.
  • Strong systems thinker with a customer-centric product mindset.
  • Knowledge of the music and label business is a plus.

You will advance and defend the reputation of the New York Times and its employees by creating and executing media relations strategies during emerging issues and high-stakes situations.
