job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry is looking for a Senior Project Manager to join our growing team!  

21GRAMS, part of Real Chemistry, takes an innovative approach to advertising, and focusing on making healthcare more human.  Not just in our work, but in the way we conduct business, approach client relationships, and treat each other. It’s a place where people subscribe to the adage, “Be good to each other, but hard on the work.” A place where people are not just in it for the paycheck, but to make a dent in the universe. Sound like you? 

At 21GRAMS, we set the benchmark for excellence in healthcare project management. As trusted leaders, we build confidence through teamwork, ownership, and proactive risk management. We uphold our processes with accountability, deliver with precision, and communicate with clarity. Creative problem-solving, adaptability, and integrity define our work. Guided by purpose and collaboration, we inspire our teams to achieve best-in-class outcomes for every project.

The Senior Project Manager leads complex, integrated initiatives across channels and provides day-to-day leadership for the project team. This role balances hands-on delivery with mentoring and process stewardship.

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, Lambertville, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What you’ll do: 

·      Lead execution of integrated campaigns that span digital, print, events, and video.

·      Develop detailed Gantts and critical paths across multiple deliverables and vendors.

·      Anticipate risks, propose solutions, and manage change control to protect scope, timing, and margin.

·      Mentor and coach Project Managers and Coordinators. Model best practices and documentation hygiene.

·      Partner with Account to align execution to strategy and client expectations.

·      Own forecasting inputs and invoice readiness in collaboration with Finance.

Portfolio Management:

·      Oversight of approximately 5 million dollars in revenue.

·      Administrative involvement in new business and shadowing scoping.

Resource Management:

·      Own staff plan rollup inputs and updates. Plan and communicate resourcing needs.

·      Develop brand Gantts and coordinate sequencing across workstreams.

Client and Vendor Relationship Management:

·      Active in client communications for delivery topics.

·      Own vendor relationships for assigned brands.

Training, Growth, Reporting:

·      Manage team best practices, process reference documents, and onboarding tools.

·      Shadow leadership to gain foundational management skills.

Admin Operations:

·      Own day-to-day task management within Workfront and Teams.

·      Ensure program compliance across all teams on the brand.

Execution:

·      Think strategically at the brand level. Identify overlaps and staggering opportunities.

·      Drive process improvements and QA across deliverables.

Finance:

·      Create scopes and change orders. Review estimates.

·      Analyze brand-level finances, forecast, and support invoicing. Speak to finances with clients.

Culture, Comms and Collaboration:

·      Build morale. Investigate and analyze issues. Gather the right collaborators.

This position is a perfect fit for you if: 

·  ​Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you. 

·  You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving. 

·  You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data. 

·  You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines. 

 What you should have:  

• Bachelor’s degree preferred.

• Expert knowledge of digital and print production workflows.

• Strong skills in scoping, budgeting, resource planning, and risk management.

• Excellent client-facing communication and presentation skills. 

• 5 or more years of project management experience in healthcare communications.

• Prior mentoring or supervisory experience.

job.description:
ABOUT HALLMARK’S INTERNSHIP PROGRAM  

We're looking for curious, creative, and consumer-focused interns who are passionate about storytelling, trends, culture, creativity, and human connection. 

This posting includes two distinct Creative Internship opportunities within Hallmark Greetings Creative .

 

Writing Studio & Greetings Editorial Intern 

This internship provides hands-on experience in creative writing, content development, editorial planning, trend research, and greeting card product strategy. Interns will partner with writers, editors, and product teams to develop consumer-focused content and concepts that help Hallmark create meaningful connections through greeting cards and related products.  

 

What you'll do 

  • Create original writing for greeting cards and related Hallmark products. 
  • Explore emerging trends, voices, and cultural insights relevant to Gen Z and Gen Alpha consumers. 
  • Learn how Hallmark plans, develops, and curates greeting card programs. 
  • Conduct editorial analysis and consumer research to identify future content opportunities. 
  • Develop concepts and editorial content that authentically connect with consumers. 
  • Partner with writers, editors, designers, and product teams throughout the creative process. 
  • Present recommendations and creative concepts to business and creative leaders. 

               

              BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 

              The following is required to be considered for this role: 

              • Pursuing a bachelor's degree in English, Journalism, Communications, Creative Writing, Advertising, Marketing, Public Relations, or a related field 
              • A graduation date of December 2027, May 2028, December 2028, May 2029, December 2029, or May 2030.  

                 

                PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

                Your resume and application will stand out if you are: 

                • Demonstrated interest in writing, content creation, publishing, media, advertising, or product development 
                • Strong writing and editing skills 
                • Familiarity with social, cultural, and consumer trends relevant to Gen Z and Gen Alpha audiences 
                • Experience through coursework, publications, student organizations, freelance work, or personal creative projects is a plus 

                        

                      ADDITIONAL DETAILS 

                      • A portfolio is required for this position. Your portfolio should be compiled into one PDF document that is no larger than 5 MB. If your portfolio file size is above the 5MB limit, you can submit a one-page overview of your work (see example). You can also submit a link to a personal portfolio website to supplement your uploaded portfolio. Applicants who do not upload a portfolio or one-page overview will not be considered.
                      •  Candidates selected to move forward in the interview process will be asked to complete a few brief exercises later in the process.
                      • Our internship program is 12 weeks long, starting in late May and ending in early August. 
                      • This summer internship is a hybrid position, with the flexibility to work from both our recently renovated headquarters building in Kansas City, MO, and from your summer residence within the KC metro area. 
                      • Some relocation and housing assistance is provided for interns whose permanent address is outside of the KC metro area. Relocation is required for this role. 

                             

                            Interested? Follow the application instructions below to apply. 

                             

                            APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS  

                            Along with your resume and application, please provide up to 10 samples of your own writing that demonstrate:

                            • Your unique voice
                            • A range of content types (academic, creative, journalistic, prose, verse, etc.)
                            • Ability to edit for clarity / conciseness (for example, a piece of writing that shows before and after edits)
                            • Success in writing for a variety of audiences

                             

                            You must show how you meet the basic qualifications in a resume or document you upload, or by completing the work experience and education application fields. Accepted file types are Microsoft Word (DOC or DOCX), PDF, HTML, or TXT.  

                             

                            In compliance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, Hallmark Cards, Inc. and its subsidiary companies will hire only individuals lawfully authorized to work in the United States. Hallmark does not generally provide sponsorship for employment. Employment by Hallmark is contingent upon the signing of the Employment Agreement, signing of an agreement to arbitrate in connection with the Hallmark Dispute Resolution Program, completing Form I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification, passing the urinalysis drug screen, education verification and satisfactory reference and background checks. 

                             

                            ABOUT HALLMARK – Because Connecting With Each Other Has Never Been More Important  

                             

                            For more than a century, Hallmark has been bringing people together and improving the relationships that matter most. That’s why millions of people all over the world connect with the Hallmark brand. It has always been a mission so much bigger than any one of us who work here. Today, we need empathetic learners, strategic thinkers, and enthusiastic visionaries with diverse experiences and skills to help us create the rest of Hallmark’s second century as we shift to a more digitally savvy, unified approach that combines the best of brick-and-mortar retail with the efficiency of dot-com spaces. Help us imagine what our next hundred years could look like!  

                            When you join Hallmark, we will go out of our way to make you feel like part of the team, even in a remote/hybrid work environment. In the day-to-day, we’ll make the best use of the skills and talents you already have. We’ll also give you leadership opportunities and show you multiple potential pathways to future success.  

                            Our culture of care for our consumers and for one another shows in the way we embrace different backgrounds, identities, and working styles, deliberately seeking out ways to be more inclusive both internally among our work groups and externally through the ings we make and sell to our retail partners and consumers. We believe that a broadly inclusive, equitable approach is also our best path to future success. We’re seeking out those who can bring a fresh perspective to our business and would love your input as someone new to our team! We can only change and grow when we intentionally include new perspectives–like yours.

job.title: Director, Strategy and Insights, Paramount Pictures
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Overview:

If you're excited by the idea of influencing how some of the world's biggest movies are created and launched, then look no further. We're hiring a Director of Strategy and Insights to join us at Paramount Pictures!

 

At Paramount, our Strategy and Insights team sits at the intersection of consumer insights and creative strategy, shaping how upcoming releases are made, marketed, and distributed. This role offers rare exposure to the entire film slate, from original titles to iconic franchises like Mission: Impossible, Transformers, Sonic the Hedgehog, and A Quiet Place.

 

Within the studio, this team serves as the voice of the audience, understanding how moviegoers feel about our films and brands and translating those perspectives into strategies that help us tell stories that connect authentically. This role requires someone who can balance analytical rigor with creative intuition, and who can build genuine trust and influence with creative and marketing leaders — not just deliver findings to them.

 

As Director, you'll help drive how insights guide strategy for all Paramount Motion Picture releases and play a key role in designing and implementing the research that shapes creative direction. You'll report to the Senior Vice President of Global Strategy and Insights and work closely with teams across the studio.

 

Apply now and join us!


Responsibilities:

  • Drive research findings into actionable strategies that guide Paramount’s full slate of releases
  • Lead the division in developing qualitative and quantitative research to tackle key questions and challenges
  • Manage research planning and delivery, including vendor management, questionnaire development, and reporting
  • Design clear, dynamic visual documents that communicate research findings and data effectively
  • Present research insights regularly at marketing strategy and management meetings, acting as a trusted, consultative partner to creative and marketing leadership
  • Actively supply ideas and feedback in meetings, presentations, and brainstorming sessions
  • Assess each motion picture’s target audience, opportunities, and challenges
  • Monitor research trends and guidelines to implement innovative approaches across the studio, including evaluating competitive campaigns, expanding statistical analysis, and advancing AI use in research

46421

 

Overview and Responsibilities:

 

Paramount Streaming is a division of Paramount that encompasses both free, paid, and premium streaming services including Paramount+ and Pluto TV.

We are the Global Content and Lifecycle Analytics team, part of the Paramount Streaming, Data & Insights Group (DIG) team. DIG is a key connector among the Paramount Streaming verticals. The group has subject matter experts. They prototype, build, and scale data infrastructure and products. They assess, aggregate, and analyze data. They also create qualitative and quantitative narratives and insights. This work helps stakeholders make decisions, understand performance, and get business recommendations.

 

Role Details

 

In this role you will develop and maintain scalable data pipelines. You will also build reliable core business reasoning. Additionally, you will ensure high data quality standards for content metadata. This includes titles, rights, taxonomy, and catalog data that support Paramount's streaming business.

You will work closely with analysts, data engineers, content operations, programming, licensing, and product teams. Your goal is to turn raw metadata feeds and content telemetry into consistent datasets, dashboards, and insights. These resources will support decision-making for Paramount+, Pluto TV, and Paramount's larger streaming portfolio. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of engineering and analytics and wants to drive data excellence at scale. This role has people management responsibilities.

 

Responsibilities

Pipeline Ownership: Design, build, and maintain robust data pipelines. These pipelines will oversee content metadata, including titles, rights, licensing windows, genres, talent, franchise or series hierarchies, and availability. You will work closely with data engineering and analytics teams. Content Metadata Modeling: Develop and refine reliable data models. These models will unify content metadata from different sources. This includes ingest, catalog management, licensing, and rights management systems. This will help with precise reporting at the title, franchise, and window levels.

Data Quality: Work with software and data engineering teams. Ensure that metadata is complete and reliable. This includes catching issues such as duplicate titles, missing or conflicting rights windows, incorrect genre or talent tagging, and misclassified territories.

Performance Monitoring: Contribute to anomaly detection systems and operational dashboards that track content catalog health, metadata completeness, and data quality KPIs. Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with analysts. Collaborate on projects. Share insights. Collaborate with the content operations team. Work with programming teams, licensing, and product managers. Your goal is to turn business needs into technical data solutions.

Tooling & Enablement: Build scalable, performant datasets in platforms such as Databricks, Looker, and Snowflake to enable self-service analytics for content stakeholders. Documentation and Standards: We support creating and maintaining clear technical documents. Set coding standards and data governance practices. Focus on metadata taxonomy standards and ensure content rights compliance.

 

 

Basic Qualifications

 

Bachelor’s degree in economics, Statistics, Analytics, Computer Science, MIS, Data Engineering, or related field.

 7+ years of experience in analytical engineering, data engineering, or data analytics with solid SQL and data modeling expertise.

Deep knowledge of ETL/ELT principles, data architecture, and performance optimization. Proven experience building scalable data products and pipelines using tools such as Databricks, Airflow, Spark, or similar platforms. You should have direct experience in modeling and maintaining content metadata pipelines. This involves managing title catalogs, rights data, windowing data, and genre or talent taxonomies. Experience with similar structured data in entertainment or media is also acceptable. Solid ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to deliver high-impact data solutions. Fluency in building and maintaining production-grade datasets in cloud-based data environments (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, Big Query). Proficiency with BI tools such as Looker and Tableau, including building curated data layers and performance tuning. Proficient data hygiene practices, including version control, code reviews, unit testing, and documentation. Exemplary problem-solving skills and attention to detail, especially when reconciling metadata inconsistencies across systems.

 

Additional Qualifications

 

Experience working with content rights and licensing data, including availability windows, territory restrictions, and content lifecycle management.

Knowledge with content taxonomy and classification systems used in entertainment or media. Proficiency in Python or another scripting language for data transformation or orchestration.

Knowledge with streaming media or direct-to-consumer digital products. Experience implementing anomaly detection systems or contributing to root cause investigations for metadata issues. Knowledge of data governance and compliance best practices as they relate to licensed content

Overview and Responsibilities

 

Paramount Streaming is a division of Paramount that encompasses both free, paid, and premium streaming services including Paramount+ and Pluto TV.

We are the Global Content and Lifecycle Analytics team, part of the Paramount Streaming, Data & Insights Group (DIG) team.

DIG is a key connector among the Paramount Streaming verticals. The group includes experts who create and improve data systems and products. They evaluate, combine, and analyze data. They develop insights and stories from both qualitative and quantitative data. Their work helps stakeholders make decisions. It also helps them understand performance and receive business recommendations.

 

Role Details

 

In this important role, you will develop and maintain scalable data pipelines. You will build reliable core business reasoning. You will ensure high data quality standards for content metadata. This includes titles, rights, taxonomy, and catalog data that support Paramount's streaming business.

You will work closely with analysts, data engineers, content operations, programming, licensing, and product teams. Your goal is to convert basic metadata feeds and content data into reliable datasets, dashboards, and insights. These will support decision-making for Paramount+, Pluto TV, and other Paramount streaming services.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of engineering and analytics and wants to drive data excellence at scale. This role has people management responsibilities.

 

Responsibilities

 

Pipeline Ownership: Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines. These pipelines will manage content metadata like titles, rights and licensing windows, genres, talent, franchise or series hierarchies, and availability. You will work with data engineering and analytics teams. Content Metadata Modeling: Develop and improve reliable data models. These models will unify content metadata from different sources. This includes ingest, catalog management, licensing, and rights management systems. They will support detailed reporting. This reporting will be at the title, franchise, and window levels.

Data Quality: Collaborate with software and data engineering teams. Make sure the metadata is complete, precise, and consistent. This involves identifying issues such as duplicate titles, missing or conflicting rights windows, incorrect genre or talent tagging, and misclassified territories.

Performance Monitoring: Contribute to anomaly detection systems and operational dashboards that track content catalog health, metadata completeness, and data quality KPIs. Collaboration across functions is important. You will work closely with analysts. Collaborate with content operations, programming teams, licensing, and product managers. You will translate business needs into technical data solutions. Tooling & Enablement: Build scalable, performant datasets in platforms such as Databricks, Looker, and Snowflake to enable self-service analytics for content stakeholders. Documentation & Standards: Lead the creation and maintenance of clear technical documents. Set coding standards and practices for data governance. Focus on metadata taxonomy standards and ensure compliance with content rights.

 

Basic Qualifications

 

Bachelor’s degree in economics, Statistics, Analytics, Computer Science, MIS, Data Engineering, or related field. 7+ years of experience in analytical engineering, data engineering, or data analytics with solid SQL and data modeling expertise.

Deep knowledge of ETL/ELT principles, data architecture, and performance optimization. Proven experience building scalable data products and pipelines using tools such as Databricks, Airflow, Spark, or similar platforms. You should have direct experience with modeling and maintaining content metadata pipelines. This includes working with title catalogs, rights and windowing data. You should also be acquainted with genre and talent taxonomies, or similar structured data in entertainment or media. Proficient ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to deliver high-impact data solutions.

Fluency in building and maintaining production-grade datasets in cloud-based data environments (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery). Proficiency with BI tools such as Looker and Tableau, including building curated data layers and performance tuning. Solid data hygiene practices, including version control, code reviews, unit testing, and documentation. Exemplary problem-solving skills and attention to detail, especially when reconciling metadata inconsistencies across systems.

 

Additional Qualifications

 

Experience working with content rights and licensing data, including availability windows, territory restrictions, and content lifecycle management. Knowledge with content taxonomy and classification systems used in entertainment or media. Proficiency in Python or another scripting language for data transformation or orchestration.

Knowledge with streaming media or direct-to-consumer digital products.

Experience implementing anomaly detection systems or contributing to root cause investigations for metadata issues. Knowledge of data governance and compliance best practices as they relate to licensed content.

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Overview:

CBS Mornings brings viewers original reporting, breaking news, newsmaker interviews and compelling storytelling each weekday. The broadcast is seeking a Senior Editor to supervise a team of writers and play an integral role on the editorial team. Working at the center of the editorial process, the Senior Editor will help shape clear, accurate and engaging copy for the live broadcast while collaborating closely with editorial and production partners.  

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Supervise and provide editorial guidance to a team of writers
  • Edit writers’ copy, originate scripts as needed and write teases for CBS Mornings’ on-air talent under tight deadlines
  • Fact-check copy for accuracy and ensure it aligns with CBS News editorial standards and style
  • Ensure all copy is formatted correctly for the broadcast and works effectively with video, graphics and other production elements
  • Collaborate closely with the executive producer, line producer, producers and technical teams
  • Contribute timely and creative ideas for daily and future broadcasts, including guest segments
  • This position is covered by a collective bargaining agreement and is represented by 315 - WGA Staff Radio and TV 

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of writing and copy-editing experience in television news
  • Exemplary writing, copy-editing and communication skills
  • Experience supervising or providing editorial direction to writers
  • Experience with ENPS or a comparable newsroom computer system
  • This is a fully in-person position based in the control room
  • The schedule requires overnight and early-morning hours, Monday through Friday, leading into the live broadcast

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Sound editorial judgment and close attention to detail
  • Ability to work accurately and effectively under tight deadlines
  • Familiarity with video feeds, video sources and breaking-news coverage
  • Ability to respond to breaking news in the control room as required
  • Knowledge of U.S., international and business news, with an interest in sports and popular culture

 


CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS EVENING NEWS, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. CBS News’ streaming services, across national and local, amassed more than 1.01 billion streams in 2021. Launched in November 2014 as CBSN, the CBS News Streaming Network is available on 30 digital platforms and apps, as well as CBSNews.com and Paramount+. The service is available live in 91 countries. CBS News and Stations is dedicated to providing the highest quality journalism under standards it pioneered and continues to set in today’s digital age. CBS News earns more prestigious journalism awards than any other broadcast news division.

job.title: Producer I, Social (FinLit)
job.description:
Position Summary:

Marketplace is looking for a creative social media producer who can create those scroll-stopping moments for our portfolio of financial literacy programs and help bring our economic journalism to new audiences.

We are the most widely heard suite of business shows in the country, reaching more than 10 million people on air, online, and on demand. Our financial literacy portfolio includes award-winning kids podcast “Million Bazillion” and award-winning money and relationships podcast “This Is Uncomfortable,” among others.

The ideal candidate is someone who can produce and execute innovative social content. You must have sharp social copywriting, video editing, graphic design, and fact-checking skills. You’ll optimize Marketplace content in a dynamic way across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Bluesky, and emerging social platforms. You have strong instincts for short-form video and visual design. And you have demonstrated success in creating campaigns and content that resonate with diverse audiences.

*This is a grant-funded, two-year role.

This position sits in the collective bargaining agreement between Marketplace and Screen Actors Guild—American Federation of Television and Radio Artists (“SAG-AFTRA”).

Location: Remote

Application Process: Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Application Deadline: Open until filled.

Position Responsibilities:

  • Write and produce highly shareable social-first content on tight deadlines, including short-form videos and graphics, for all social platforms.
  • Identify stories, moments and ideas from Marketplace’s financial literacy programs that can translate into compelling social content.
  • Help develop original social videos, including researching ideas, writing scripts, shaping hooks and selecting clips.
  • Write and edit social copy, headlines, captions, scripts and other audience-facing language.
  • Strategically schedule and publish content across all social platforms.
  • Analyze social performance and produce regular campaign and content reports.
  • Work collaboratively with reporters, producers and hosts.
  • Use data to inform how and what we post.
  • Stay up-to-date and ahead of the curve on social media best practices.
  • Ensure consistent voice and branding across our social platforms.
  • Help cultivate and develop conversations between our audience, hosts and reporters.

Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Journalism or related field required.
  • 5+ years experience producing content for social platforms on behalf of a brand or media outlet.
  • Familiarity with financial literacy content and social media trends in the FinLit space, with an understanding of how creators and organizations are engaging audiences around economic topics.

Required Skills, Knowledge and Abilities:

  • Self-starter with excellent editorial judgment and an understanding of journalistic standards.
  • Deep interest in how economic news intersects with people’s lives.
  • Demonstrated success producing engaging social content for a newsroom, media organization, publication or other editorial environment.
  • Strong knowledge of social media trends and best practices, including video-first platforms such as YouTube and TikTok
  • Superb social copywriting and fact-checking skills.
  • Proficient in Photoshop, Premiere, CapCut, Davinci Resolve or similar editing software
  • A team player who is accountable, proactive, and solution-oriented
  • Have strong instincts for content that social audiences find engaging.
  • Ability to work effectively with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to successfully meet deadlines and handle multiple responsibilities on a consistent basis.
  • Superior communication, organizational and collaborative skills.
  • Experience using social analytics and audience insights.
  • Responsible for developing and owning the social strategy for the fin-lit porftolio.
  • Ability to appear on camera or directing/editing on-camera video as needed.

Preferred Skills and Experience:

  • Experience using Sprout Social or similar social media programs (Hootsuite, Buffer, Later, etc.)

job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

21GRAMS, a Real Chemistry subsidiary, is an advertising agency born to make healthcare more human. Not just in our work, but in how we conduct business, approach client relationships, and treat each other. We believe in being good to each other and hard on the work, and in creating work that makes a meaningful difference for patients, caregivers, healthcare professionals, and brands.

Job Summary

The Director, Product Design is a senior design leader responsible for setting the product design vision, raising the quality of the work, and building the conditions for teams to deliver cohesive, accessible, and effective digital experiences. This role leads complex engagements across websites, platforms, products, services, and connected ecosystems, translating user needs, brand strategy, business goals, technology constraints, and healthcare requirements into clear experience direction.

This is not solely an execution role. The Director is accountable for design strategy, client leadership, team development, resourcing, design operations, and measurable experience outcomes. They remain close enough to the work to guide critical decisions, facilitate discovery, critique design, and step into high-impact moments while enabling senior designers to lead day to day.

What You Will Do

Design Vision and Product Strategy

  • Own the product design vision and experience strategy across a portfolio of complex client engagements, connecting user needs, brand intent, business objectives, and technical feasibility.
  • Partner with Experience Strategy, UX, Product Management, Creative, Technology, Data, Medical, Strategy, and Account leadership to frame opportunities, define roadmaps, and establish measurable outcomes.
  • Lead discovery and definition activities, including stakeholder alignment, experience principles, journey framing, service blueprints, value propositions, prioritization, and product or platform planning.
  • Identify opportunities that extend beyond the immediate brief and turn them into clear, decision-ready recommendations for clients and agency leadership.

Design Excellence and Delivery

  • Set and uphold a high bar for interaction design, visual design, responsive behavior, content hierarchy, prototyping, motion, and end-to-end experience coherence.
  • Guide teams from early concepts through detailed design, validation, launch, and optimization, ensuring that strategic intent is maintained through implementation.
  • Oversee scalable design systems, component libraries, pattern governance, and documentation in Figma, working with engineering partners to improve quality and delivery efficiency.
  • Build accessibility into the work from the start, applying WCAG 2.2 AA principles and inclusive design practices rather than treating compliance as a final review step.
  • Use qualitative research, analytics, usability findings, and business measures to evaluate design decisions and recommend iteration.

Client and Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Act as a trusted senior design partner to clients, clearly articulating experience strategy, design rationale, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations to executive and working teams.
  • Lead high-stakes presentations, workshops, critiques, and decision-making sessions, creating alignment across internal and external stakeholders.
  • Partner with project and account leadership on scope, staffing, schedules, assumptions, and change management; surface delivery risks early and propose practical solutions.
  • Represent Product Design in new-business opportunities, estimates, proposals, capability presentations, and pitch work.

People Leadership and Practice Development

  • Manage, coach, and develop product designers across levels through clear expectations, actionable feedback, growth plans, and regular career conversations.
  • Create an environment where designers can do their best work, with strong critique, psychological safety, accountability, and thoughtful delegation.
  • Partner with Experience leadership on hiring, staffing, performance management, succession planning, and capability development.
  • Improve the Product Design practice through reusable methods, templates, standards, training, and responsible adoption of emerging tools, including AI-enabled workflows.
  • Contribute to a culture of collaboration across Product Design, UX, Creative, Technology, and Strategy, reducing silos and improving continuity from concept through launch.

What Success Looks Like

  • Clients see Product Design as a strategic partner, not only a production capability.
  • Teams have clear experience direction, decision criteria, and an appropriate level of design leadership from discovery through delivery.
  • Creates a more consistent, accessible, and high-quality experience across the portfolio.
  • Designers receive strong coaching, understand what is expected of them, and demonstrate measurable growth.
  • The practice becomes more scalable through better systems, methods, staffing decisions, and cross-functional ways of working.
  • Experience recommendations connect to defined user, client, and business outcomes.

What You Should Have

  • 10+ years of experience in product design, experience design, interaction design, or a related discipline, including 3+ years managing and developing designers.
  • A portfolio demonstrating leadership across complex, multi-channel digital products or platforms, from strategy and concept through detailed design and launch.
  • Experience leading multiple workstreams or a portfolio of client engagements in an agency, consultancy, product organization, or similarly complex environment.
  • Deep fluency in human-centered design, interaction design, visual systems, prototyping, responsive design, information architecture, and design systems.
  • Strong working knowledge of Figma and modern collaborative design workflows; familiarity with Adobe Creative Cloud and prototyping or motion tools is helpful.
  • Practical knowledge of accessibility standards, including WCAG 2.2 AA, and the ability to guide teams in designing inclusive experiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner with engineering, product, research, content, analytics, strategy, creative, and account teams.
  • Excellent executive communication, facilitation, storytelling, critique, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Experience defining design outcomes and using research, usability testing, analytics, and performance data to improve experiences.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity, making informed trade-offs, and balancing strategic leadership with hands-on guidance when the work requires it.

This Position Is a Strong Fit If

  • You can move between the 30,000-foot view and the detail that determines whether an experience actually works.
  • You are direct, low-ego, generous with feedback, and able to challenge the work while supporting the people doing it.
  • You bring structure to ambiguity, anticipate needs, and help teams make better decisions faster.
  • You care about craft, but judge success by the quality, usefulness, accessibility, and impact of the experience.
  • Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you. 
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving. 
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data. 
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines. 

Preferred Experience

  • Healthcare, pharmaceutical, patient support, medical technology, or other regulated-industry experience.
  • Experience with privacy, consent, regulated content, and design considerations for patients, caregivers, and healthcare professionals.
  • Experience supporting business development, scoping, estimating, and presenting capabilities or pitch work.
  • Experience leading enterprise websites, authenticated platforms, service ecosystems, omnichannel programs, or AI-enabled experiences.

 

Pay Range: $140,000 - $155,000
This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting.  Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, skills, certifications, and geographical location. The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time.

job.title: Back End Engineer
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Senior FullStack Engineer
WPP Open · Engineering · Gurugram

About the job:

WPP Open is WPP's AI-enabled marketing operating system, used by brands and agencies around the world. Our engineering teams in India build and run it alongside colleagues in the UK and Europe. As a Senior Engineer you own a component or service, from its design and API to its tests and production health, and you mentor other engineers. The role is backend-heavy, and you also build the React interfaces for the features you deliver. Our interviews are practical and hands-on.

Responsibilities:

• Design, build, test and ship production code every sprint, test-first.
• Own a component or service end to end: its design, OpenAPI contract, data model, Playwright test suite, monitoring and runbook.
• Write design documents and architecture decision records for your component, and review other engineers' code with rigour and care.
• Choose between AWS Lambda and Kubernetes for your workloads, and build and maintain the CI/CD pipeline that ships them.
• Lead triage when your component fails, write post-incident reviews and fix the underlying causes.
• Build production AI features on the Anthropic and OpenAI APIs, and maintain your component's Claude Code configuration and MCP server.
• Explain technical trade-offs to product and delivery colleagues, including colleagues in other regions.
• Mentor less experienced engineers and help new joiners become productive quickly.

Minimum qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 5 years of professional software development in TypeScript and Node.js or Python.

• 3 years of experience testing, maintaining or launching production software, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.

• Experience working in globally distributed teams across time zones, with stakeholders in other regions.

• Backend language and craft. You write idiomatic, strictly typed backend code in TypeScript with Node.js or in Python, with runtime validation at service boundaries using Zod or Pydantic. You understand concurrency in your language well enough to recognise blocking work and profile a misbehaving service, and you know NestJS, Fastify or FastAPI in depth.

• React and frontend. You choose and justify state-management approaches in React, keep rendering fast through memoisation, lazy loading and code splitting, and meet WCAG AA accessibility on the 
features you build. You contribute components to the design system and can build interfaces that stream responses from AI services.

• APIs and data formats. You design REST APIs with OpenAPI and own the contract for your service, including versioning, backwards compatibility, idempotency keys, rate limiting and webhooks. You know when to use JSON and when to use Protocol Buffers, and you check schema compatibility automatically in your pipeline.

• Data. You design PostgreSQL schemas and change them without downtime, tune slow queries and understand transaction isolation. You model data well in both DynamoDB and MongoDB, use Redis for caching, and choose the right store for each workload with clear reasons.

• Asynchronous systems and reliability. You design producers and consumers on queues such as SQS and BullMQ or Celery, with retries, dead-letter queues and idempotent handlers so that at-least-once  delivery is safe. You recognise when these safeguards are needed before anyone asks.

• Cloud and platform. You design services on AWS Lambda, with sensible function boundaries, concurrency settings, dead-letter queues and Step Functions or EventBridge where needed, all defined 
as code with AWS CDK or SAM. You operate workloads on Kubernetes, including Helm, autoscaling, rollouts and rollbacks, and you choose between serverless and containers for each workload.

• Testing and quality. You practise test-driven development and apply it to the design of whole components, not just individual functions. You write integration and contract tests with Testcontainers and
own your component's Playwright test suite, including test data, parallel runs and removing flaky tests.

• Observability and performance. You instrument services with OpenTelemetry, own the Datadog monitors, alerts and CloudWatch alarms for your component, and lead triage and post-incident reviews 
when it fails. You set performance budgets, profile under realistic load, and find memory leaks and blocking work in production.

• Security and identity. You implement OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect end to end, including the authorisation-code flow with PKCE and client credentials for service-to-service calls. You design role based access control, rotate secrets and keys, and secure your supply chain with dependency scanning and static analysis in the pipeline.

• Architecture and design. You design a service from a short brief, write design documents and architecture decision records that name the trade-offs, and design for backwards compatibility so that 
changes do not break the people who depend on your service.

• Engineering practices. You work trunk-based with GitHub Flow and hold others to it in code review. You build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, treat every dependency as something to pin and upgrade on a  regular cadence, and write documentation for the people who will read it. AI-first engineering and LLMs. You build production features on the Anthropic and OpenAI APIs, using tool calling, structured output and evaluations, and you track token usage and cost. You maintain the Claude Code configuration for your component, including CLAUDE.md, skills and subagents, and have built an MCP server that exposes your service to AI agents.

• Communication, collaboration and initiative. You communicate clearly and concisely, and you explain technical trade-offs to product, design and delivery colleagues in terms they can act on. You understand problems quickly and confirm shared understanding before acting. You collaborate well across locations and time zones, working asynchronously and handing over cleanly. You are proactive: you spot problems before you are asked, propose solutions and improvements of your own, and see them through without waiting for instructions.

• Leadership and behaviours. You review others' code with rigour and care, mentor less experienced engineers, and disagree openly when you need to and then commit fully to the decision. You say "I don't know" when you don't, and you dig in until you do.


Preferred qualifications:
• B.Tech or B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
• Experience with monorepo tooling such as Nx or Turborepo at scale.
• Experience with Kafka and change data capture.
• Experience with behaviour-driven development using Cucumber.
• Experience with Bigtable.
• Experience shipping an AI agent with LangGraph, Google ADK or the Anthropic Agent SDK.
• Experience configuring an identity provider such as Okta, Keycloak or Cognito.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. Senior FullStack Engineer
WPP Open · Engineering · Gurugram

About the job:

WPP Open is WPP's AI-enabled marketing operating system, used by brands and agencies around the world. Our engineering teams in India build and run it alongside colleagues in the UK and Europe. As a Senior Engineer you own a component or service, from its design and API to its tests and production health, and you mentor other engineers. The role is backend-heavy, and you also build the React interfaces for the features you deliver. Our interviews are practical and hands-on.

Responsibilities:

• Design, build, test and ship production code every sprint, test-first.
• Own a component or service end to end: its design, OpenAPI contract, data model, Playwright test suite, monitoring and runbook.
• Write design documents and architecture decision records for your component, and review other engineers' code with rigour and care.
• Choose between AWS Lambda and Kubernetes for your workloads, and build and maintain the CI/CD pipeline that ships them.
• Lead triage when your component fails, write post-incident reviews and fix the underlying causes.
• Build production AI features on the Anthropic and OpenAI APIs, and maintain your component's Claude Code configuration and MCP server.
• Explain technical trade-offs to product and delivery colleagues, including colleagues in other regions.
• Mentor less experienced engineers and help new joiners become productive quickly.

Minimum qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 5 years of professional software development in TypeScript and Node.js or Python.

• 3 years of experience testing, maintaining or launching production software, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.

• Experience working in globally distributed teams across time zones, with stakeholders in other regions.

• Backend language and craft. You write idiomatic, strictly typed backend code in TypeScript with Node.js or in Python, with runtime validation at service boundaries using Zod or Pydantic. You understand concurrency in your language well enough to recognise blocking work and profile a misbehaving service, and you know NestJS, Fastify or FastAPI in depth.

• React and frontend. You choose and justify state-management approaches in React, keep rendering fast through memoisation, lazy loading and code splitting, and meet WCAG AA accessibility on the 
features you build. You contribute components to the design system and can build interfaces that stream responses from AI services.

• APIs and data formats. You design REST APIs with OpenAPI and own the contract for your service, including versioning, backwards compatibility, idempotency keys, rate limiting and webhooks. You know when to use JSON and when to use Protocol Buffers, and you check schema compatibility automatically in your pipeline.

• Data. You design PostgreSQL schemas and change them without downtime, tune slow queries and understand transaction isolation. You model data well in both DynamoDB and MongoDB, use Redis for caching, and choose the right store for each workload with clear reasons.

• Asynchronous systems and reliability. You design producers and consumers on queues such as SQS and BullMQ or Celery, with retries, dead-letter queues and idempotent handlers so that at-least-once  delivery is safe. You recognise when these safeguards are needed before anyone asks.

• Cloud and platform. You design services on AWS Lambda, with sensible function boundaries, concurrency settings, dead-letter queues and Step Functions or EventBridge where needed, all defined 
as code with AWS CDK or SAM. You operate workloads on Kubernetes, including Helm, autoscaling, rollouts and rollbacks, and you choose between serverless and containers for each workload.

• Testing and quality. You practise test-driven development and apply it to the design of whole components, not just individual functions. You write integration and contract tests with Testcontainers and
own your component's Playwright test suite, including test data, parallel runs and removing flaky tests.

• Observability and performance. You instrument services with OpenTelemetry, own the Datadog monitors, alerts and CloudWatch alarms for your component, and lead triage and post-incident reviews 
when it fails. You set performance budgets, profile under realistic load, and find memory leaks and blocking work in production.

• Security and identity. You implement OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect end to end, including the authorisation-code flow with PKCE and client credentials for service-to-service calls. You design role based access control, rotate secrets and keys, and secure your supply chain with dependency scanning and static analysis in the pipeline.

• Architecture and design. You design a service from a short brief, write design documents and architecture decision records that name the trade-offs, and design for backwards compatibility so that 
changes do not break the people who depend on your service.

• Engineering practices. You work trunk-based with GitHub Flow and hold others to it in code review. You build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, treat every dependency as something to pin and upgrade on a  regular cadence, and write documentation for the people who will read it. AI-first engineering and LLMs. You build production features on the Anthropic and OpenAI APIs, using tool calling, structured output and evaluations, and you track token usage and cost. You maintain the Claude Code configuration for your component, including CLAUDE.md, skills and subagents, and have built an MCP server that exposes your service to AI agents.

• Communication, collaboration and initiative. You communicate clearly and concisely, and you explain technical trade-offs to product, design and delivery colleagues in terms they can act on. You understand problems quickly and confirm shared understanding before acting. You collaborate well across locations and time zones, working asynchronously and handing over cleanly. You are proactive: you spot problems before you are asked, propose solutions and improvements of your own, and see them through without waiting for instructions.

• Leadership and behaviours. You review others' code with rigour and care, mentor less experienced engineers, and disagree openly when you need to and then commit fully to the decision. You say "I don't know" when you don't, and you dig in until you do.


Preferred qualifications:
• B.Tech or B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
• Experience with monorepo tooling such as Nx or Turborepo at scale.
• Experience with Kafka and change data capture.
• Experience with behaviour-driven development using Cucumber.
• Experience with Bigtable.
• Experience shipping an AI agent with LangGraph, Google ADK or the Anthropic Agent SDK.
• Experience configuring an identity provider such as Okta, Keycloak or Cognito.

job.title: Senior Director, Paid Media Performance
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

Overview:

As the Senior Director, Paid Media Performance, you will develop strategic recommendations and own performance for paid user acquisition of paid media across search, social and programmatic channels, as well as programmatic/DSP investment for the full Paramount+ title portfolio. You will help shape the vision, in partnership with senior leadership, for how paid media drives efficient, scalable subscriber and engagement growth. Directing multiple large campaigns across genres and translating business goals into channel strategy, audience approach, and measurable performance targets.   You will lead and develop a team of paid media specialists across search, social and programmatic disciplines, while also managing media partner relationships and multi-million dollar media budgets across channels.   This is a senior leadership role accountable for results across multiple campaigns, channels, and disciplines. Requiring solid people leadership, sound judgment on decisions that carry real business risk, and the ability to drive priorities and influence direction across the organization.   This is an on-site position, based at our New York City office.   

Responsibilities include but not limited to:

  • Develop and execute the paid media acquisition strategy across paid search, social (Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Snapchat, Reddit) and programmatic/DSP channels (e.g., DV360, Yahoo DSP, Amazon DSP, Samsung DSP), aligning channel and audience approach to the business goals across all genres.
  • Own CPA and efficiency targets across the portfolio and across channels (e.g., sports, drama, reality, and service titles), continually optimizing tactics, media mix, and audience targeting to scale acquisition cost-effectively.
  • Lead development of audience targeting and consolidation strategy across search, social and programmatic, including genre-level segmentation and cross-platform/cross-channel audience consolidation, to improve scale and efficiency.
  • Lead activation of incrementality and platform/channel performance testing in partnership with internal testing teams.
  • Provide feasibility guidance on the testing roadmap across social and programmatic, turning learnings into action.
  • Own media recommendations and launch support for key title releases and seasonal tentpoles across channels, ensuring the full paid media mix is positioned to deliver against goals.
  • Lead, coach, and develop the paid media team across social and programmatic disciplines, setting priorities, standards, and clear expectations to build a robust, high-performing function.
  • Partner cross-functionally with internal marketing teams and senior leadership on budget, reporting, and strategic decisions, and represent paid search, social and programmatic in broader team planning.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 12+ years of experience in paid media/digital performance marketing across paid search, social and programmatic channels, with 5+ years of people management experience leading teams.

Overview
We are looking for a Senior MLOps Engineer (IC3) to join the Platform Engineering pod. Your mission is to build the Agentic Systems Platform—the runtime environment where autonomous agents live, reason, and collaborate. You will lead the development of the MCP (Model Context Protocol) Gateway, routing logic, and the orchestration support required for multi-agent personalization systems. In this role, you will bridge the gap between traditional ML serving and autonomous agency. You will lead the design of agentic runtimes using GKE and Apigee, utilizing the ADK (Agent Development Kit) and A2A (Agent-to-Agent) protocols to enable complex workflows. Your challenge is to manage the "thinking time" and cognitive overhead of agentic systems, ensuring they remain responsive and cost-effective in a production environment.

Why This Role Matters

  • Architecting Agency: You are building the foundation for our shift from passive models to active, reasoning agents.
  • Governance & Routing: Your work on the MCP Gateway ensures that agents can safely access the tools and context they need to perform their tasks.
  • Collaborative Intelligence: By mastering A2A orchestration, you enable a new class of multi-agent applications that solve problems individual models cannot.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Platform Design: Architect the production runtime for agentic systems, focusing on low-latency tool-use and state management.
  • Own the MCP Gateway: Design and implement the routing and security layer for agentic tool-use via Apigee.
  • Standardize Agentic Workflows: Develop orchestration patterns using ADK and A2A that are adopted by pods across the AMLG.
  • Performance Management: Monitor and optimize agentic "thinking" cycles to balance reasoning depth with production latency constraints.
  • Mitigate System Risks: Proactively identify and fix failure modes unique to agentic systems (e.g., tool-use loops or context window overflows).

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4–8+ years in MLOps or Platform Engineering
  • Experience with API Gateways (Apigee) and K8s (GKE)
  • Background in Agentic Orchestration

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with A2A protocols
  • Experience managing long-running stateful workflows

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

We’re looking for someone who’s naturally curious, biased toward action, and deeply focused on the outcomes of their work. You know that great design starts with recognizing the problem. Your work demonstrates pixel-level attention to detail alongside a proficient mastery of usability and interaction patterns at scale. You’re able to turn complex ideas into simple, intuitive, and visually balanced experiences—no matter the device. Above all, you’re a collaborative team player who lives and breathes interactive design.  

   

Responsibilities:

Overview:

 

WBBM Newsradio, Chicago’s number one news station, is looking for a talented part time Assistant Producer  with an enterprising attitude and impressive work ethic to join our team of award-winning journalists. What You'll Do:

  • Primary duties involve taking and editing audio from multiple sources including reporters, weather feeds, and network audio feeds.
