job.title: Director of Sales
job.description:
Description

  

Dick Broadcasting Company | Myrtle Beach, South Carolina
Full-Time | Exempt

Dick Broadcasting Company is looking for a driven, entrepreneurial sales leader to lead our Myrtle Beach sales team and accelerate revenue growth across our broadcast and digital platforms.

This is not a position for someone who wants to simply maintain the status quo.

We are looking for someone who wants to build — a great sales team, strong client relationships, new business opportunities, and a culture where people are continually challenged to improve and succeed.

You will lead the sales efforts for our four-station Myrtle Beach operation and its growing digital advertising business, with significant responsibility for developing people, executing sales strategies, and delivering results.

For more than 72 years, Dick Broadcasting Company has built successful local media brands by remaining committed to the communities we serve. As a family-owned company, we believe local leadership matters. We encourage our leaders to identify opportunities, try new things, develop people, solve problems, and find creative ways to grow our business.

This position is based in Myrtle Beach, South Carolina, one of the Southeast’s most dynamic and rapidly growing markets. Beyond being a world-class tourism destination, Myrtle Beach offers a strong local business community, tremendous population growth, beaches, golf, entertainment, and an outstanding quality of life.

If you are a successful Local Sales Manager, General Sales Manager, Digital Sales Manager, or proven media sales leader looking for an opportunity to build and lead a high-performing sales organization, we would like to hear from you.


  

What You’ll Do

Build and lead a great sales team.

Recruit, develop, coach, and retain talented sales professionals. Create an environment where people enjoy coming to work, know what is expected of them, celebrate wins together, and are continually challenged to grow and improve.

Drive revenue growth.

Develop and execute sales strategies that grow revenue across broadcast, digital, and other advertising platforms. Place a strong emphasis on local-direct new business development, growing existing client relationships, and identifying new revenue opportunities.

Develop people, not just manage numbers.

Spend time in the field with your sellers. Participate in client meetings, provide meaningful coaching, help improve their prospecting and presentation skills, and develop their ability to uncover client needs and recommend effective advertising solutions.

Create a culture of consistent sales activity.

Establish clear expectations for prospecting, discovery meetings, presentations, follow-up, and closing business. Help sellers build strong pipelines and develop the habits necessary for sustained success.

Be part of the sales effort.

Lead by example. Participate in key client meetings, help develop creative advertising strategies, and assist sellers in overcoming challenges and closing opportunities. Be a resource for the sales team without becoming the sales team.

Know the numbers and use them to drive results.

Take ownership of sales budgets, revenue forecasting, pipeline management, and sales performance. Utilize CRM data, sales activity, ratings, digital performance, and other key metrics to recognize opportunities, identify challenges, and hold the team accountable for results.

Help our clients succeed.

Build a sales organization focused on understanding client needs and delivering results rather than simply selling advertising schedules. Encourage creative thinking and the development of integrated solutions that help local businesses grow.

Collaborate across departments.

Work closely with programming, promotions, digital, and other departments to develop compelling advertising opportunities, maximize the value of our brands, and ensure successful execution of client campaigns.

Be part of the Myrtle Beach community.

Build relationships with advertisers, agencies, community organizations, and business leaders. Be visible in the market, develop new relationships, and help ensure our stations remain valuable partners to local businesses.

Requirements

  

What We’re Looking For

We are less interested in a particular title than we are in finding the right sales leader. The successful candidate will bring:

· A demonstrated track record of growing revenue, developing new business, and consistently delivering sales results.

· Proven experience leading, coaching, motivating, and developing sales professionals.

· A strong understanding of the sales process, from prospecting and discovery through presenting, negotiating, following up, and closing.

· The ability to establish clear expectations, measure performance, and hold people accountable while building a positive team culture.

· Experience managing sales budgets, forecasting revenue, and evaluating sales pipelines.

· An understanding of digital advertising and how broadcast and digital solutions can work together to solve client problems.

· A willingness to get into the field, work alongside sellers, and actively participate in the sales process.

· Strong communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.

· Curiosity, creativity, and a willingness to try new things.

· The confidence to make decisions and the humility to listen to other ideas.

· An entrepreneurial mindset and a desire to create opportunities rather than wait for them to appear.

· A college degree or equivalent professional experience.

· A valid driver’s license.

Who Will Thrive Here

This opportunity is best suited for someone who genuinely enjoys building a successful sales team and helping people reach their potential.

We want a leader who gets energy from coaching sellers, developing creative ideas, meeting with clients, winning new business, and celebrating the team’s successes.

You should be comfortable setting high expectations, having difficult conversations when necessary, and holding yourself and others accountable for delivering results.

We believe great sales leadership requires both encouragement and accountability. The right person will know how to motivate a team, recognize progress, address underperformance, and create an environment where everyone understands their role in the organization’s success.

At DBC, we value leaders who take initiative, think creatively, and approach challenges with a solutions-oriented mindset.

Ultimately, we’re looking for someone who measures their success not just by the revenue they personally generate, but by the success of the salespeople they lead and the business they help build.

If you are looking for an opportunity to develop a great team, grow revenue, have some fun along the way, and make a meaningful impact in one of DBC’s key markets, we would like to hear from you.

Benefits

Dick Broadcasting Company offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package, including:

· Paid Time Off (Vacation, Personal and Sick)

· Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, and Life Insurance

· Flexible Spending Account

· 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan

job.title: Field Engineer
job.description:
Overview

Called to K-LOVE

 

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

 

At K-LOVE, every role is ministry.

 

We hire first for ministry alignment and a shared commitment to our faith, mission, vision, and values. We then seek talented professionals who can use their God-given gifts, skills, and experience to serve with excellence.

 

If you love Jesus and are called to be part of a ministry that places Christ at the center of everything we do, we invite you to explore this opportunity. If your heart aligns with our mission and you possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for the role, please keep reading.

 

**This position requires you to service the New York and surrounding areas.**

 

 

What will you do?

  • Strategic System Optimization & Engineering Leadership:
    • Partner across the engineering team to ensure K-LOVE's programming is broadcast successfully and to the highest quality through expert installation, maintenance, operation, updates, and intricate repairs.
    • Lead the operation, testing, and maintenance of advanced broadcast equipment such as audio processors, transmission systems, EAS equipment, receivers, monitors, electrical systems, and optimizing signal and sound based on Ministry guidelines.
    • Drive a culture of excellence by identifying opportunities to enhance system performance, reliability, and efficiency, with a focus on IP-based, modern microwave, and Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite solutions.
  • Troubleshooting & Mentorship:
    • Serve as a primary expert in diagnosing and resolving complex technical faults on equipment and systems down to the component level, utilizing advanced analytical methods.
    • Partner and communicate with engineers (including contract engineers) to accomplish critical objectives.
    • Serve as a dedicated mentor and escalation point for more junior Broadcast Engineers, fostering their technical knowledge and professional development.
  • Administrative & Documentation:
    • Accurately complete and submit all required administrative documentation, including but not limited to timecards, expense reports, vehicle logs, budgeting documents, and other relevant records by established deadlines.
    • Utilize and maintain designated asset management, work order, and ticketing system software to log activities, track inventory, and update status efficiently.
    • Respond promptly and professionally to emails, texts, and phone calls, ensuring clear and timely communication regarding operational status, project updates, and other work-related matters.
    • Maintain organized digital and physical records as required for compliance and operational continuity.
  • Advanced Compliance & Safety Stewardship:
    • Maintain an expert-level understanding of FCC rules and regulations, ensuring all equipment and operations are compliant and uphold safety standards.
    • Actively champion K-LOVE's Injury Prevention and Safety program, ensuring strict adherence to safety standards.
    • Strict adherence to lock out-tag out procedures.
    • Serve as a Chief Operator/Engineer for assigned broadcast station(s), meticulously fulfilling all regulatory responsibilities.
  • Critical Site Management & Extensive Field Presence:
    • Conduct mandatory, comprehensive on-site visits to each assigned transmitter site at least once per quarter.
    • Provide immediate and expert response for unplanned outages, emergency repairs, and critical events requiring on-site presence.
    • Perform essential maintenance and troubleshooting on non-broadcast equipment (e.g., generators, HVAC, minor electrical/plumbing) ensuring complete site functionality.
    • Undertake necessary trips to remote sites for complex installations or critical repairs, or K-LOVE Campus for specialized training or leadership on projects.
    • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent technical studies in electronics, broadcast communications, or a related field; OR a minimum of five years of directly related experience; OR an equivalent combination of education
  • SBE Certification highly desirable.
  • Minimum of 6+ years of demonstrated expert-level experience in troubleshooting, installing, repairing, and maintaining complex broadcast electronic equipment, or comparable relevant experience.
  • Thorough understanding of broadcast air-chain components, including complex system interactions and IP-based signal distribution.
  • Intermediate networking skills (TCP/IP, routing, switching) and ability to diagnose common network issues.
  • Advanced understanding of modern microwave and Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite technologies and their integration.
  • Deep understanding of radio frequency (RF) emissions, interference mitigation, and regulatory compliance, serving as an escalation point for complex RF challenges.
  • Expertise in soldering and desoldering electronic components, including precision work.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of applicable broadcast-related FCC rules and regulations.
  • Ability to perform complex calculations for common broadcast-related formulae.
  • Advanced proficiency with standard broadcast test equipment (VOMs, Oscilloscopes, Spectrum Analyzers).
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and other common software.
  • Proven ability to systematically and logically address multiple, highly complex technical problems, often requiring innovative solutions.
  • Ability to apply sophisticated common-sense understanding to carry out complex instructions and think strategically from abstract problems to practical solutions.
  • Exemplary communication skills characterized by grace, respect, and humility; strong ability to listen, provide constructive feedback, and influence positively.
  • Demonstrates lifelong learning, actively pursuing and taking personal responsibility for advanced professional development.
  • Maintains a deep and current understanding of technical processes/equipment, strategically leveraging new technologies to enhance performance and productivity.
  • Strives for error elimination, prioritizes high-quality work, and proactively seeks opportunities to improve products and services.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to develop sincere business/Ministry relationships.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
  • Demonstrated commitment to the social sector with a passion for our mission and values.

 

What can we offer you?

  • Industry leading Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
  • Short/long term disability and life insurance
  • Robust 401K with company match
  • Parental leave with Baby Bonding pay
  • Generous PTO, holiday and sick pay
  • Unique company culture that includes exclusive access to concerts, movie premieres, media industry events, and more
  • Leadership and Career Development Programs

Why work for K-LOVE? 

K-LOVE is a nonprofit, multi-platform media company on a mission to draw people closer to Christ. Founded in 1982 in Santa Rosa, CA, with a singular radio station, K-LOVE today owns and operates the nation's two largest Christian music radio networks (K-LOVE and Air1) with over 1,000 broadcast signals across all 50 states, streaming audio reaching around the world, and a growing family of media ministries including podcasts, books, films, concerts, and events. K-LOVE employs nearly 500 team members between its office in Nashville, TN and field locations around the country. You can view our mission and values here Mission, Beliefs & Values.

 

“As an Equal Opportunity Employer, K-LOVE makes employment decisions based on merit and other legitimate reasons. The Company is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment and equal employment opportunities regardless of protected class, characteristic or status. However, K-LOVE is a religious non-profit organization where all team members contribute to the Company’s mission of encouraging our audiences “to have a meaningful relationship with Christ.” Therefore, pursuant to the Civil Rights Act of 1964, Section 702 (42 U.S.C. 2000e I(a)), K-LOVE has the right to hire only candidates who agree with the Company’s Statement of Faith, Mission, Vision, and Values. Also, as a religious non-profit organization, the Company is not governed by the CA Fair Employment and Housing Act.”

job.description:
Title: Accounts Payable Specialist

Reports to: AP Manager

 

At Meruelo Enterprises, we’re building more than infrastructure, we’re building communities, careers, and a better tomorrow.

Founded in 1986 and proudly minority-owned, we’ve grown into one of California’s leading construction and engineering firms, serving major utility, transportation, and telecom clients across the West Coast. With a talented team of over 2,500 professionals and a family of top-tier subsidiaries, we deliver innovative, high-impact solutions in gas, electric, water, and more.

From the ground up, we’re committed to safety, quality, and integrity. If you're looking to be part of a fast-growing, mission-driven company making a real difference, welcome to Meruelo Enterprises.

 

About the Role:

The Accounts Payable Specialist plays a vital role in ensuring the accurate and timely processing of vendor and subcontractor invoices while supporting daily financial operations within Spectrum. In this position, you will help maintain strong financial controls, resolve invoice discrepancies, and ensure compliance with company policies and procedures. Your work directly supports smooth project execution and fosters strong, reliable relationships with our vendors and subcontractors.

 

Key Responsibilities:

²  Perform day-to-day financial transactions, including verifying, classifying, computing, posting and recording accounts payable data.

²  Verifies validity and resolves issues of account discrepancies by obtaining and investigating information from Purchasing and other departments.

job.title: Associate Counsel
job.description:
The Associate Counsel will report to the Senior Vice President, Labor Relations and be responsible for development, negotiation and administration of the NFL-NFLPA Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA), including representing the league and clubs in litigation under the CBA.  The holder of this position will represent the league in grievance hearings and arbitrations brought by or against the NFL and supervise outside counsel in the litigation of such matters.  This critical role will require strong investigative and advocacy skills, and the ability to spot and solve issues related to league policies. 

Responsibilities

  • Acquire and demonstrate substantive mastery of the CBA and league policies regulating the conduct of clubs and players.   
  • Litigate grievances on behalf of the league and member clubs under the collective bargaining agreement with the NFL Players Association.  
  • Provide counsel to the league and clubs regarding rights and obligations under the CBA, the Salary Cap system, Player Personnel rules, and other collectively bargained league rules. 
  • Assist in the investigation and enforcement of potential violations of the CBA and related policies regulating player and club conduct.  
  • Draft and review policy directives for NFL players and Clubs. 
  • Interact with outside law firms, consultants and others involved in the administration of the CBA, policies and/or litigation. 
  • Assist in negotiations with the NFL Players Association. 
  • Prepare legal memoranda for clubs regarding policy obligations. 
  • Independently develop and maintain working relationships with club counsel and NFLPA representatives. 

Required Qualifications

  • Law Degree (J.D.); 4 to 6+ years of litigation experience at a top law firm or federal government agency.   
  • Experience conducting and maintaining a docket of litigation matters and internal investigations.   
  • Experience appearing in court or similar settings, interviewing senior executives and drafting investigatory findings.   
  • Experience deposing and cross-examining witnesses.

job.title: Talent Acquisition Partner
job.description:
Working at QVC Group means joining a live social shopping company with incredible teams, ambitious projects and rewarding careers. QVC Group, Inc. is a Fortune 500 company with six leading retail brands - QVC®, HSN®, Ballard Designs®, Frontgate®, Garnet Hill® and Grandin Road®.

Your Opportunity, Your Team

  • As a Talent Acquisition Partner, you’ll help QVC Group teams hire the talent they need by managing recruiting from intake through offer acceptance.
  • You will build trusted relationships with hiring managers and bring talent-market insight into search decisions.
  • You will go beyond reviewing applicants. Through proactive sourcing, thoughtful candidate engagement, and structured hiring practices, you’ll connect people with opportunities and help hiring teams make informed decisions.
  • You will support frontline recruiting with operational forecasts for high-volume recruiting, ongoing pipelines, as well as ongoing pipelines for professional recruiting that calls for deeper market research, passive-candidate outreach, and building external partnerships.

Where You'll Work

  • This role is onsite and requires you to work daily from our Ontario, California Fulfillment Center location.
  • Relocation assistance is not available for this role.

What You'll Do

  • Manage full-cycle recruiting for assigned roles, from intake and sourcing through offer acceptance.
  • Lead structured intake conversations, using labor-market insights to align on requirements, candidate availability, and search approach.
  • Find and engage candidates through inbound applications, Boolean search, direct outreach, pipelining, and other relevant channels.
  • Partner with hiring managers to build structured interview processes, clarify evaluation criteria, and deliver timely, thoughtful candidate communication.
  • Use market insights and recruiting data to share search updates, support equitable offer development, maintain accurate ATS records, and recommend process improvements.
  • Support high-volume frontline fulfillment center hiring by aligning recruiting activity with workforce forecasts, training class start dates, seasonal demand, and operational priorities.
  • Build relationships with external partners and community organizations to strengthen local talent pipelines, increase awareness of QVC Group career opportunities, and support community engagement.

What You'll Bring

  • 3 to 5 years of full-cycle recruiting experience and high-volume recruiting; in-house corporate recruiting experience is strongly preferred.
  • Experience building hiring-manager partnerships and managing searches from intake through offer acceptance.
  • Ability to source candidates proactively, including using Boolean search and direct outreach to engage passive talent.
  • Skill in using talent-market information to calibrate role requirements, explain candidate availability, and shape search plans.
  • Clear, timely communication and a commitment to a respectful, inclusive candidate experience.
  • Ability to manage priorities, maintain accurate ATS records, and use recruiting information to provide useful updates.

job.description:

  Senior Software Engineer, CMS Platform Paramount Streaming • Technology & Engineering   Location: Burbank, CA / New York, NY/ San Francisco, CA • Full-Time (onsite)  

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer, CMS to build and own the web experiences at the heart of our content management platform - shipping high-quality code across a polyglot stack that powers Paramount+, Pluto TV, and CBS.com. This is a frontend-leaning full-stack role: you'll spend most of your time crafting fast, resilient, server-rendered React applications, and you'll own features end to end - from the component layer down through the APIs and data model that back them; along with event driven messaging for external integrations.

 

Motivational Fit

 

·You'll become the person the team turns to on frontend architecture and web performance, lead small-to-medium projects from design through production, and mentor other engineers.

·You care about how things feel for users and how maintainable they are for the engineers who come after you.

·You are driven to improve code quality, developer experience and team processes

 

Responsibilities

 

•     Build and evolve server-rendered React applications: design high-quality, accessible, performant UIs with Next.js and modern React, with server-side rendering (SSR) at the core of how we deliver fast first-load experiences at streaming scale.

•     Own component architecture: establish and champion clean, reusable component patterns and shared design conventions that scale across the codebase and keep the team moving quickly.

•     Drive web performance: measure and improve Core Web Vitals, rendering strategy, bundle size, caching, and load performance — and set the standards other engineers follow.

•     Deliver features end to end: design complete solutions that span the frontend and the services behind it — building and evolving REST APIs in Java/Spring Boot and modeling the data with PostgreSQL (entities, schema, migrations) that power those experiences.

•     Develop the API and data layer: build the Node.js and Spring Boot service layers that connect the frontend to the platform, with an eye to clean contracts and clear boundaries that also supports external clients through messaging.

•     Improve developer experience and quality: raise the bar on testing, observability, tooling, and team processes — making the whole team faster, the codebase healthier and reduce technical debt

•     Ownership: take ownership of small to medium projects from design through production, coach colleagues, and help codify expertise — including clear, agent-readable docs and conventions — so both people and AI agents can ramp quickly.

•     Mentorship: mentor engineers through code reviews, pairing and knowledge sharing including effective AI-augmented workflows

•     Collaboration: collaborate with stakeholders and partner teams to ensure seamless integrations and cohesive experiences

•     Participate in on-call rotations, incident resolution and RCAs

•     Help grow the team through interviewing and onboarding new members


Required Qualifications

 

 

•     BS in Comp Science or related field, or equivalent applicable experience

•     5+ years of professional software engineering experience

•     Strong React expertise, with production experience building server-rendered applications (SSR) using Next.js or a similar framework.

•     Deep frontend fundamentals: component architecture, TypeScript, state management, and a genuine command of web performance and accessibility.

•     Full-stack range: comfort building the services behind the UI — Node.js and/or Java/Spring Boot REST APIs — and modeling data in a relational database such as PostgreSQL (entities, schema design, migrations).

•     End-to-end ownership: a track record of taking features from design through production, and the judgment to make sound architectural tradeoffs across the stack.

•     Senior-level collaboration: strong communication, a habit of mentoring, and the ability to set patterns others adopt.

•     Technical writing: comfort producing clear design documentation and conventions.

 

Preferred

 

•     Strong exposure to cloud platforms (GCP, AWS etc.)

•     Good experience with container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and DevOps/CICD practices & tools

•     Experience with message brokers (Kafka, GCP Pub/Sub) / event driven messaging systems

•     Experience with search tools like Solr and Elasticsearch

 

Nice-to-Have

 

     Familiarity with content management domains, media/streaming, or other high-traffic consumer platforms.

 

How We Work

 

AI is part of how we build every day, and we expect our engineers to be fluent with it. This is core to the role, not a bonus.

 

Required:

 

•     Daily fluency with AI coding tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor, Copilot — we provide licenses). Agents draft, you direct and review. You know how to prompt effectively, when to trust the output, and how to catch what it gets wrong.

•     Judgment over autopilot: you review agent-generated code critically, hold the quality bar, and can explain your reasoning. As a senior engineer, you'll help shape how the team uses these tools well — encoding conventions, setting review patterns for agent-generated code, and mentoring juniors on           judgment.

•     Exposure to building agentic workflows developing systems where AI agents take on multi-step tasks with the right guardrails.

•     Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar approaches for connecting AI agents to tools, data, and services.

•     Exposure to multi-agent orchestration and emerging agentic patterns.

 

Why Join

 

You'll work on web experiences seen by millions, on a team that pairs a strong frontend craft culture with real full-stack ownership and an AI-native way of building. We provide the tools, the licenses, and the room to shape how modern web engineering is done at one of the industry's most recognizable brands.

SilverLoch Media · Stuart, Florida · On-site · Full-time · $95,000 – $130,000

The Company

SilverLoch Media is the production company founded by Dan and Paula Bongino, producing The Dan Bongino Show and a slate of daily news and commentary programming distributed across [Rumble, podcast platforms, and national radio syndication].

We operate from a purpose-built broadcast facility on Florida's Treasure Coast, where a deliberately lean team delivers live daily programming to a national audience. There is no soft launch here. Every show is live, every day.

The Position

SilverLoch Media seeks an Executive Producer to assume complete ownership of production, from concept through delivery.

The Executive Producer ensures that every program airs on time and to standard, and builds the operational systems that make that outcome dependable. The role carries authority over the production team, the schedule, the technical environment, and the editorial bar.

The Executive Producer works directly with on-air talent, syndication partners, and the digital team.


Core Responsibilities

Daily Delivery. Ensure every live episode is produced as the best possible product and airs on time.

Editorial Oversight. Approve scripts, rundowns, and program concepts. Direct episode planning and story development in alignment with the company's editorial standards and audience.

Team Leadership. Manage and mentor production staff. Own assignments, workflow, performance management, and professional development.

History of successfully deploying sourcing systems for better collaboration with internal teams and clarity on spend and usage Collaboration, curiosity, and creativity. job.title: Legal Affairs Fellow
job.description: Location: US-NYC Type: In Person | Part Time to Full Time Start: Immediate Initial Term: Through Q1 2027, with extension and potential conversion to a permanent role Hours : 20 - 40 hours/week Hourly Rate : $30/hour; $35/hour for candidates admitted to the New York bar (effective upon admission if admitted during the term) About Hook Hook is a social music platform, backed by top-tier investors, building the next generation of music discovery, fan expression, and creator growth. We turn the songs people love into sounds they can play with — enabling fans and creators to reimagine music through intuitive, remix-friendly experiences with zero learning curve. By partnering directly with artists, labels, and rightsholders, Hook ensures music is discovered, shared, and expressed in ways that respect and reward the people behind it. At Hook, music isn’t just consumed — it’s experienced, expressed, and made personal. Role Overview This is not your typical entry-level legal role. As Legal Affairs Fellow at Hook, you will work directly alongside the General Counsel with hands-on responsibility for virtually every facet of an in-house legal practice. From day-to-day operational documents to complex content licensing and IP transactions, you will be doing the real legal affairs work of a fast-moving early-stage music and consumer tech startup. This role is designed for a 3L or recent law school graduate who already has a foundation in music, IP, or technology law and wants to understand what it truly means to serve as General Counsel within a dynamic music technology startup —not just in theory, but in practice. You will work cross-functionally within the company, learning from and collaborating with immensely talented professionals within Hook’s content, engineering, marketing, operations, and business development teams. You will have the opportunity to contribute meaningfully to the company and to see your ideas and work come to fruition. This role demands excellent drafting and communication skills, an eye for detail, sound judgment about when to escalate, a passion for technology and the law, a self-driven ability to learn quickly and, most importantly: an insatiable curiosity. For the right candidate, this fellowship is designed as a path to a permanent role on Hook’s legal team as the company grows. Conversion to a permanent position is at Hook’s discretion and is not guaranteed. What You’ll Do Day-to-Day Legal Operations Draft, redline, and manage non-disclosure agreements (NDAs) and confidentiality agreements, taking first-pass ownership of the negotiation Prepare and process offer letters, contractor agreements, and other employment-related documents Support corporate governance and organizational housekeeping, including board and stockholder consents and corporate records Transactional & Commercial Work Draft and redline service agreements, vendor contracts, and partnership deals, and support their negotiation through signature Assist with content licensing agreements with labels, publishers, and other rightsholders, as well as sync licenses and content distribution deals Conduct due diligence and support deal execution across a range of commercial transactions Intellectual Property & Entertainment Research and advise on copyright, trademark, and other IP matters relevant to the music, entertainment, and digital media industries Review and redline complex IP licensing and rights agreements Support Hook’s trademark and patent portfolio, working with outside counsel Monitor industry developments, regulatory changes, and emerging legal issues in entertainment and digital media, including AI, UGC, and platform liability General Counsel Exposure Participate in cross-functional projects with business, creative, and product teams Gain exposure to risk assessment, compliance, and corporate strategy at the executive level Build and improve internal legal templates, playbooks, policies, and legal operations processes. Qualifications & Experience Required 3L at an ABA-accredited law school or a recent law school graduate, with strong academic credentials. Demonstrated experience in music, intellectual property, and/or technology law—through prior internships, clinics, journal work, coursework, or professional experience before or during law school. Hands-on drafting and redlining experience: you have marked up real agreements (NDAs, services agreements, licenses, or similar) in an internship, clinic, or prior role and are comfortable working in tracked changes. A strong understanding of music copyright law and the corresponding licenses (sound recording and musical composition rights; mechanical, performance, and sync licensing). Excellent legal research, writing, and analytical skills. Detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines. Self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and is comfortable taking ownership of matters with General Counsel oversight. Comfort with social media consumption patterns and creator / UGC platforms. Strong interpersonal and communication skills—comfortable collaborating across teams. Preferred Prior in-house, law firm, label, publisher, or DSP experience in music, entertainment, or technology. An understanding of the current commercial and legal landscape within the entertainment industries, music, social media, UGC, music consumption, and creator marketplaces. Familiarity with emerging issues at the intersection of AI and copyright, including training data and AI-generated content. Experience working at an early-stage startup (Seed–Series B). For recent graduates: admitted to, or sitting for, the New York bar. Passion for music and technology.

job.title: Team Manager, Customer Success
job.description:
Job Description:

POLITICO is looking for a Team Manager, Customer Success to manage a team of 10 Customer Engagement Specialists and develop scalable customer engagement practices that drive product adoption, customer value, Wallet Retention Rate, and retention rate across the US Professional Subscriptions business. This senior manager level role will focus on coaching and developing team members, driving team performance, and executing strategies that strengthen customer engagement and retention.


POLITICO's mission from the very beginning was to win the audience. We dedicate ourselves to providing accurate, non-partisan, impactful information to the right people at the right time so that they can act with confidence and speed. We experiment to avoid being disrupted and we have fun disrupting others. And we are not afraid to risk failure if it means being the best at what we do.


What You’ll Do:

  • Manage, coach, and develop a team of 10 Customer Engagement Specialists, fostering a high-performing team culture focused on growth, accountability, and results.
  • Partner with the Managing Director, Customer Success to develop and execute strategies that drive customer engagement, product adoption, Wallet Retention Rate, and overall retention.
  • Establish team goals, performance expectations, and scalable processes to improve customer onboarding, engagement, training, and support.
  • Provide ongoing coaching, feedback, and professional development to strengthen individual and team performance.
  • Leverage customer health, usage, and engagement data to identify opportunities, address risks, and improve the customer experience.
  • Collaborate with Account Management and Customer Success leadership to align customer engagement efforts with broader business goals.
  • Partner with Product, Marketing, Technology, and Data teams to share customer insights and drive improvements across the business.

What You’ll Need:

  • Experience in Customer Success, Account Management, client services, customer engagement, or a related field, preferably within SaaS, subscription, or information services.
  • Proven experience managing, coaching, and developing customer-facing teams, with a track record of driving performance and results.
  • Ability to build and improve scalable processes that strengthen customer engagement, product adoption, and retention.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and relationship-building skills, with a passion for developing people.
  • Analytical mindset with experience using customer data and performance metrics to identify opportunities and drive decisions.
  • Ability to collaborate across departments, manage competing priorities, and adapt in a fast-paced environment.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

COMPENSATION: $85,000 - $100,000 annual salary. This role is also eligible to participate in POLITICO’s commission plan, with a target incentive opportunity of $35,000 - $50,000, resulting in an on-target earnings (OTE) potential of approximately $120,000 - $150,000. Commission payments are variable and are based on achievement against applicable performance goals and the terms of the commission plan. Actual compensation will depend on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, and other job-related considerations.


We value our people. Click here for more on what we offer and what it’s like to work for POLITICO.

Let’s keep in touch. You can view our list of open positions here and email us careers@politico.com. We hope to see your application soon!

 

About Us. 

POLITICO illuminates the forces shaping global power. Since 2007, we have delivered intelligence that anticipates tomorrow's headlines, not reports on yesterday's news. As politics has increasingly become the defining force of our era, our work has never been more vital. 

Cabinet secretaries and Ministers start their mornings with our analysis. CEOs shape strategy around our reporting. Advocacy leaders rely on our insights to move policy. We deliver the straightforward facts and clear-eyed analysis they need to navigate the most complex political landscape of our lifetimes. 

Our 1,100+ publishing professionals across the world's key democratic capitals—Washington, Brussels, London, Paris, Berlin, Sacramento, and New York—form the world's premier politics and policy newsroom. We tell the story of how power really works by explaining who wields it and how they plan to exercise it, connecting dots others miss and delivering scoops from sources others don't even know exist. 

Innovation has always been a core tenet of our story. At launch, we bet that depth would trump scale, that talent would trump traffic, and that politics would become central to modern life. In 2011, we made another bet and launched POLITICO Pro to help decision-makers understand the business of government, transforming both how they shape government action and the business of journalism itself. 

These bets have made POLITICO the most successful digital news startup of its generation and the indispensable resource for leaders who shape the future. Today, we are a rarity in media: a growing, profitable, and sustainable news organization. 

POLITICO is a subsidiary of Axel Springer SE, a family-owned transatlantic media company headquartered in Berlin and New York. Axel Springer is dedicated to shaping the future of journalism in the free world, believing that a free and informed society is essential to democracy. The company’s guiding principles - first articulated as  The Essentials by founder Axel Springer in the aftermath of World War II - remain a cornerstone of the company’s foundation today. Learn more about Axel Springer.

The Fellowship is a six-month, paid fellowship in the heart of the FT’s London newsroom. You will join the World News Desk, where a dozen-strong team of accomplished journalists commission and edit our global coverage.   

You will work with the editors to help deliver ground-breaking coverage. You will also work closely with our London-based regional editors, the Africa Editor, Europe Editor, Latin America Editor and Middle East Editor, helping them with their coverage.

You will support the global network of correspondents with research and ideas for how to complement their stories with the right data and visual elements. You will be part of a team of experienced journalists covering the world, and there may also be opportunities for short-term stints on other editorial desks. You will learn the timeless arts of writing clear crisp copy and reporting on complex and sensitive stories. 

You will also gain insight into the essential skills of cutting-edge digital journalism and story-telling. The overarching ambition of the fellowship is to help to equip you one day to be a foreign correspondent, hopefully for the FT.

The successful candidate will:

  • Display a keen interest in international affairs
  • Want to pursue a career in journalism covering global news
  • Be capable of keeping a cool head under deadline pressure
  • Care deeply about writing accurately and objectively

Some experience in journalism is preferable but not essential. Career change applications are also welcome.

This opportunity is designed for Black candidates to help to address historical under-representation in the media, and to support greater diversity.

All applicants must have the right to work in the United Kingdom.

  • CV
  • A Cover Letter detailing what you will bring to the role and why you think you are suitable
  • An unpublished article on an international story (600 words max)

Further information

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview and to take a short writing test. The successful applicant will join the World News Desk and report to the FT’s Foreign Editor, Alec Russell.

21GRAMS, part of Real Chemistry, takes an innovative approach to advertising, and focusing on making healthcare more human.  Not just in our work, but in the way we conduct business, approach client relationships, and treat each other. It’s a place where people subscribe to the adage, “Be good to each other, but hard on the work.” A place where people are not just in it for the paycheck, but to make a dent in the universe. The Senior Strategist will write clear and forward-thinking strategies involving encouraging and advising creative teams.   • Lead and oversee competitive audits and analysis 
  • Show deep command of brand and the brand’s category 
  • Attend market research and provide key insights 
  • Create research and insight decks 
  • Help Strategy Director/Group Strategy Director with brand planning
  • Assist with client workshops, oversee development of materials, and facilitate sections of the workshop and breakout groups 
  • Manage/Mentor Strategists and Associate Strategists, helping them develop their skills and complete work at the highest levels of quality 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

  • 2-3 years of experience in strategic management with integrated agencies
  • Creative mind and ability to encourage and instigate ideation across departments
  • Oral and written communication skills
  • A leader that can coach, encourage, and mentor clients, staff, and team members
  • Crucial problem-solving abilities

job.title: Director, Product-Media & Creative Activation
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Who we are:

We create data products and technology that make advertising work better for people.

WPP Open is WPP’s intelligent marketing operating system, fuelling growth for the world’s most admired brands. Purpose-built for an era that demands a modern approach to data management, usage, and brand growth, we deliver modular products and interconnected capabilities across the marketing lifecycle.

Operating globally across WPP, we empower marketers and agencies to drive sustainable, data-enabled growth through connected technology and intelligent automation.

Who we are looking for:

As Director of Product Management – Media & Creative Activation & Optimization, you will lead a core capability area within Unified Activation in WPP Open, focused on executing and optimizing media and creative performance at scale.

This is a genuine product-building role. You will take activation and optimization problems from concept and rapid prototype through production, go-to-market, adoption, and measurable operational impact. You will have significant autonomy to shape product vision, roadmap, and priorities, working at pace to turn complex activation challenges into scalable, automated products.

This is a senior IC product leadership role. You own a capability area end-to-end — setting direction, managing the roadmap, and driving delivery across multidisciplinary teams spanning Product Ownership, Engineering, Data Science, Support, and Enablement.

You own campaign optimization across media and creative — from structured optimization (budget, bidding, targeting, DCO, in-flight creative performance across walled gardens and open platforms) to unstructured, agent-driven troubleshooting and optimization workflows. You also own the cross-product governance layer that keeps activation consistent from intake through live execution.

Unified Activation connects creative production, pre-launch quality assurance, campaign setup and activation, and cross-platform monitoring and optimization into one workspace from creative handoff to live campaign execution, with full governance and traceability across platforms.

Unified Activation Capabilities

This capability area spans the full path from creative handoff to live, optimized delivery covering creative readiness, campaign activation, campaign optimization for media and creative, and the governance that keeps work consistent across platforms.

Creative management. Creative briefs, schedules, and variants become activation-ready requirements. Assets are organized with quality metadata and status visibility. AI-assisted checks catch format, duration, safe-zone, and related issues before launch, while performance insights and quality signals inform creative decisions. The outcome is faster, more reliable creative handoff.

Campaign activation. Media plans become structured, launch-ready campaigns targeting, budgets, bidding, and naming rules included. Approved creative reaches buying environments with automated tagging, mapping, and pre-launch integrity checks. The outcome is scalable, faster activation with fewer broken paths.

Campaign optimization. Spanning media and creative. Algorithmic optimization uses ML models to optimize budgets, bids, and targeting parameters for cross-platform uplift while campaigns are live. Monitoring covers portfolio-level campaign health, delivery pacing, and KPI performance across platforms. Agentic optimization handles unstructured troubleshooting and optimization turning delivery signals into recommendations and governed actions when problems are open-ended rather than rule-bound. Dynamic Creative Optimization sits within this same area, measuring and improving how creative performs once live across walled gardens, buying platforms, ad servers, and other activation environments.

Cross-module governance. Shared taxonomies, advertiser and platform best-practice guardrails across intake, activation, and in-flight execution. Governed connectivity into major ad platforms using so access stays persistent, auditable, and free of direct token exposure.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own the product vision, strategy, and execution roadmap for Optimization & Governance within the Unified Activation platform in WPP Open.
  • Own campaign optimization across media and creative algorithmic ML optimization of budgets, bids, and targeting; portfolio-level monitoring of campaign health, delivery, and KPI performance; and agentic optimization for unstructured troubleshooting and open-ended performance improvement.
  • Own Dynamic Creative Optimization measuring, governing, and improving creative performance while campaigns are live across walled gardens, buying platforms, ad servers, and other activation environments.
  • Own governance for the capability area taxonomies, advertiser compliance rules, and best-practice guardrails across creative and media activation workflows, including in-flight execution.
  • Define and deliver agentic activation and optimization workflows that automate creative distribution, dynamic taxonomy generation & platform guardrails.
  • Partner with Product Ownership, Engineering, Architecture, Data Science, and other cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, resilient integrations across major media buying platforms, ad servers, and WPP Open services.
  • Translate complex business problems from WPP agencies and global brand clients into concrete product requirements, functional specifications, and prioritized backlogs.
  • Own direction and priorities across multidisciplinary delivery teams spanning Product Ownership, Engineering, Data Science, Support, and Enablement.
  • Manage dependency and cross-functional alignment across WPP Open platform teams, ensuring cohesive delivery across governance, integration services, and shared data layers.
  • Partner with Support and Enablement teams to ensure capabilities are successfully launched, adopted, and embedded into agency workflows.
  • Establish clear success metrics, tracking product adoption, workflow time savings, error reduction, zero tracker leakage outcomes, and client performance / KPI-driven uplift across global markets.

What you'll need:

Essential

  • Deep expertise in at least one activation domain such as campaign activation, creative management, trafficking, optimization, or governance with the ability and appetite to broaden across the wider suite.
  • Evidence of building and operationalizing automation or product capabilities that solve real workflow or activation problems.
  • Evidence of taking solutions beyond concept or requirements into practical use, including driving adoption or measurable workflow improvement.
  • Hands-on experience using agentic and AI-assisted tools to prototype product concepts, explore technical systems, accelerate documentation, and communicate ideas.
  • Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams spanning Product Ownership, Engineering, Data Science, Support, and Enablement through influence rather than formal reporting lines.
  • Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex agency and client problems into clear product priorities.
  • Sufficient technical fluency to work effectively with engineering, architecture, and data teams and make informed product decisions.

Preferred

  • Formal product-management experience at Senior Product Manager or Director level.
  • Experience owning or delivering enterprise SaaS, AdTech, or MarTech products.
  • Experience managing or leading delivery across Engineering and Data Science teams.
  • Broader activation knowledge across creative, media, trafficking, governance, and campaign optimization including in-flight structured optimization, agentic troubleshooting, and dynamic / creative optimization workflows.
  • Experience with major advertising and activation platforms such as Google Ads, DV360, CM360, Meta, Amazon Ads, The Trade Desk, and relevant third-party activation technology (e.g. Grasp, Smartly, Concord, SKAI).
  • Experience developing ML/AI-driven optimization products, automated decision systems, or agentic workflows.
  • Technical experience with API-led integrations, relational data models, and SQL.
  • Experience working within agile product-delivery environments and frameworks such as Scrum, Kanban, or Shape Up.
  • Day-to-day fluency with modern AI-assisted product workflows (e.g. rapid prototyping, codebase exploration, automated documentation).

Success Attributes

  • Strategic thinker: Capable of decomposing complex, fragmented media operations into unified, automated software products.
  • Builder mindset: Comfortable moving quickly from problem definition to prototype, production and adoption rather than stopping at strategy or requirements.
  • High autonomy: Able to establish direction, make informed product decisions and run with an area of ownership without requiring close management.
  • High ownership: Demonstrates resilience and operational discipline in managing cross-functional initiatives under shifting technical landscapes.
  • Natural collaborator: Builds strong partnerships across technical teams, agency practitioners, and executive leadership.
  • Curious and adaptable: Able to develop knowledge across the wider activation ecosystem as products, channels and technologies evolve.

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

 

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

#LI-Hybrid 

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

job.title: VP, Digital Sales and Operations
job.description:
Position Overview

Beasley Media Group is seeking a dynamic and growth-oriented Vice President, Digital Sales & Operations to lead and scale the Company's digital commercial business. This is a remote leadership position responsible for driving digital revenue growth, sales performance, and operational excellence across all markets.

This executive will lead initiatives focused on accelerating digital revenue growth, optimizing advertising operations, enhancing customer acquisition and retention, and ensuring operational excellence across Beasley's portfolio of digital marketing solutions.

As the senior leader accountable for the performance of Beasley's digital business, the Vice President will oversee digital sales strategy, revenue generation, advertising operations, fulfillment, client success, and key business initiatives. This leader will own digital revenue performance and profitability while partnering closely with executive leadership to expand market share, strengthen competitive positioning, and accelerate the Company's transformation into a leading multi-platform media and digital marketing organization.

The Vice President will play a critical role in shaping strategy, driving execution, and building a high-performance culture focused on growth, accountability, innovation, and measurable results.

Location: Remote (U.S.-based). Candidates may reside anywhere in the United States. Periodic travel to corporate offices, market visits, client meetings, industry events, and leadership meetings is required.

Key Responsibilities

Revenue Growth & Business Leadership

  • Own and lead the digital business revenue plan, operating budget, and P&L performance.
  • Develop and execute strategies that drive sustainable revenue growth, profitability, and long-term enterprise value.
  • Establish sales and operating performance targets aligned with corporate objectives and growth initiatives.
  • Partner with market leadership teams to increase digital revenue penetration and expand adoption of digital products and services.
  • Identify new revenue opportunities, partnerships, and go-to-market strategies that support business expansion.
  • Deliver accurate forecasting, pipeline visibility, and performance reporting to executive leadership.

Sales Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a geographically distributed team of digital sales and operations leaders.
  • Foster a high-performance culture centered on accountability, execution, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Recruit, retain, and develop top talent while building leadership bench strength and succession plans.
  • Establish clear goals, compensation alignment, and performance management processes that drive results.
  • Lead organizational transformation efforts that improve sales productivity and overall business performance.

Advertising Operations & Client Delivery

  • Oversee all digital advertising operations, campaign fulfillment, and client delivery functions.
  • Establish operational KPIs and service-level standards focused on quality, efficiency, scalability, and customer satisfaction.
  • Drive process optimization initiatives that improve speed-to-market, campaign execution, and operational effectiveness.
  • Ensure excellence in campaign performance, reporting, billing accuracy, and client support.
  • Champion automation, technology adoption, and workflow improvements that increase productivity and profitability.

Customer Success & Retention

  • Develop strategies that improve customer retention, increase customer lifetime value, and reduce client churn.
  • Partner with sales leadership to strengthen client relationships and maximize revenue growth within existing accounts.
  • Ensure client success teams deliver exceptional experiences and measurable business outcomes for customers.
  • Analyze customer performance data, identify trends, and implement initiatives that improve retention and expansion opportunities.

Strategic Partnerships & Innovation

  • Collaborate with the Chief Digital Officer to evaluate technology platforms, vendor relationships, and strategic partnerships.
  • Support the development, commercialization, and market positioning of new digital products and services.
  • Drive innovation initiatives that improve competitive differentiation and business performance.
  • Partner with product, technology, finance, and market leadership teams to align resources and execution against strategic priorities.
  • Support the growth of Beasley's B2B platform initiatives, customer acquisition strategies, and long-term digital business expansion plans.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in digital media, advertising, ad-tech, marketing services, agency leadership, SaaS, or related industries.
  • Proven track record of leading high-growth digital businesses with direct responsibility for revenue, profitability, and operating performance.
  • Demonstrated success building and scaling digital sales organizations and advertising operations teams.
  • Experience managing multi-million-dollar revenue businesses and complex organizational structures.
  • Strong understanding of digital advertising ecosystems, programmatic media, performance marketing, audience solutions, CRM platforms, analytics, and campaign fulfillment processes.
  • Proven ability to drive organizational change, improve operational performance, and execute transformational initiatives.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence at all levels of the organization.
  • Data-driven decision maker with strong analytical, financial, and strategic planning capabilities.
  • Experience within digital agencies, media organizations, marketing technology companies, publishers, or ad-tech platforms strongly preferred.
  • Radio broadcasting experience is not required.



Beasley Media Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Good Karma Sports’ Milwaukee office is currently recruiting college students for the Spring 2027 Semester. This is a part-time paid internship that will provide an excellent opportunity for students to learn more about sport marketing and media.

job.description:
Company Overview

Cumulus Media is an audio-first media company delivering premium content to a quarter billion people every month — wherever and whenever they want it. Cumulus Media engages listeners with high-quality local programming through 377 owned-and-operated radio stations across 84 markets; delivers nationally-syndicated sports, news, talk, and entertainment programming from iconic brands including the NFL, the NCAA, the Masters, US Soccer, and AP News, across more than 7,800 affiliated stations through Westwood One, a leading national audio network; and inspires listeners through the Cumulus Podcast Network, an established and influential platform for original podcasts that are smart, entertaining, and thought-provoking. Cumulus Media provides advertisers with personal connections, local impact and national reach through broadcast and on-demand digital, mobile, social, and voice-activated platforms, as well as integrated digital marketing services, powerful influencers, full-service audio solutions, industry-leading research and insights, and live event experiences. For more information visit www.cumulusmedia.com.


Position Overview

CUMULUS MEDIA | Dallas is in search of a hard-working Part-Time Promotions Assistant. If you are looking to get a foot in the door to the radio industry, have an outgoing personality and have a passion for radio, this is a great opportunity for you! This job will consist of general office duties as well as going out into the community to interact with listeners and promote our stations.

 

The Promotions Assistant travels around the area and represents the Cumulus stations at specified events, acting as Brand Ambassadors. This includes set-up and breakdown of pop-up tents and tables, hanging banners, interacting with listeners and executing on-site activations. To join the team, you must be able to lift 50 pounds, and be on your feet for extended periods of time.


In the office, the Promotions Assistant handles prize fulfillment, event preparation, contest building, attending weekly promotions meetings, posting on radio station social media platforms, brainstorming new ideas, and other promotion-oriented tasks. The position also includes running errands and helping with vehicle maintenance.


Would you describe yourself as an extrovert? Are you social media savvy? We’re looking for charismatic applicants, with smiling faces and outgoing personalities. If you love talking to people and listening to great radio, this could be the perfect job for you. If you desire a job where no day is the same as the last, this could be for you! This position is a great foot in the door to an exciting career in media!


Key Responsibilities & Qualifications

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assist in planning, organizing & execution of promotional events and digital campaigns
  • Execute proper technical and physical set-up and breakdown of remote broadcasts and station events; ability to troubleshoot and resolve issues on the fly
  • Represent stations at events in an upbeat, outgoing and friendly manner
  • Data Entry of Promotional events and contesting
  • Create e-blasts, social media posts & website posts; review promotional information and graphics
  • Inventory and maintenance of prize closet, calendars, events for current and upcoming promotions
  • Assisting the Promotions and Marketing Department with projects as needed in the office
  • Assist with vehicle inspections, fuel and coordinating maintenance
  • Ability to drive station vehicles with attached trailer
  • Maintain and storage of station equipment


Qualifications:

  • No experience necessary, however Customer Service experience helpful
  • Must have a valid driver’s license and clean driving record
  • Reliable; have a flexible schedule and be available to work at least 20 hours per week, including days, nights, weekends and holidays
  • May require lifting or moving up to 50 pounds
  • Must be able to stand for extended periods of time
  • Outgoing, energetic, detail-oriented and responsible
  • Proficient using computers and Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint
  • Multi-tasking abilities
  • Event experience a plus
  • Works well with a variety of personalities
  • Passion and desire to perform at a high level in a competitive environment
  • Positive attitude, even in stressful situations, is a must
  • Desire and bravado to share innovative ideas with team
  • Ability to ask for clarification, when needed
  • Strong Social Media skills

Pay Range

USD $15.00 - USD $15.00 /Hr.
What We Offer

  • Competitive Pay
  • Focused, responsible and collaborative work environment with the ability to ask, “what if” and try innovative solutions
  • 401K with company match


For immediate consideration, please visit: https://jobs.cumulusmedia.com/careers

 

For more information about Cumulus Media, visit our website at: https://www.cumulusmedia.com/

CUMULUS MEDIA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE).

This is 3-Month Assignment onsite in Stamford, CT WWE Headquarters.


The primary role of a Logistics (Mailroom) Clerk is to process and distribute incoming mail to employees in our corporate setting. They sort mail and log incoming mail as required. Mailroom clerks deliver messages and packages from one department or individual to another within an office, maintain shipping and mailing supplies, such as envelopes, tape, and stamps, and keep an inventory of these supplies. In addition, the mailroom clerk will handle all outgoing packages; they package items, ensure proper labeling, and arrange pickup from the post office, UPS, FedEx, or other carriers.

 

Mailroom Clerk Duties and Responsibilities

Mailroom clerk must perform various tasks to fulfill all the demands of this occupation:

 

Sort and Distribute Mail

One responsibility of a mailroom clerk is to sort incoming and interoffice mail and distribute to employees and departments. Mailroom clerk could use any of the following: computer or automated system to sort mail and track its delivery.

 

Manage Inventory of Shipping Supplies

Mailroom clerk is responsible for maintaining an adequate supply of shipping materials, such as boxes, tape, and labels. Manage the inventory of these items and re-order materials as needed to keep the required number of supplies on hand.

 

Handle Outgoing Packages

Mailroom clerk is not only responsible for incoming mail but outgoing packages as well. They pick up outgoing mail from departments and prepare packages for shipment. Mailroom clerks typically choose the best methods for shipment, box, and label packages, and plan with carriers for pick up times to meet shipping deadline needs.

 

Mailroom Clerk Skills

It is important for the mailroom clerk to demonstrate strong communication, organizational, and customer service skills to succeed in this profession. Mailroom clerks should be detail-oriented multitaskers who are able to stand and carry packages for long periods of time. Time management skills and the ability to work independently are essential for this position. In addition, the ability to prioritize when it comes to the delivery and shipping of parcels is critical for those in this role. Besides these skills, it is important for the mailroom clerk to possess the following abilities:

  • Sort mail by department and individual employees
  • Distribute incoming and interoffice mail in a timely manner
  • Prepare outgoing shipments
  • Arrange package pickups with appropriate carriers
  • Manage inventory of shipping and mail supplies
  • Lift 50lbs – 75lbs “Team Lift” packages
  • Potential full-time employee requires a valid driver’s license
  • Be proficient in with SSO Applications as well as Microsoft Word, Outlook, Slack, and Excel to create necessary documents and communicate with employees.
  • Knowledge of Shipping Software and procedures with some familiarity of international shipping.
  • Operate and check basic office equipment – from copiers to fax machines, mailroom clerks often employ the use of various office machines to complete necessary tasks
  • Operation of electric pallet jacks

job.title: Senior Manager, Client Operations
job.description:
Fox Entertainment Studios is seeking an experienced Senior Manager, Client Operations. This role leads the team responsible for all third-party client servicing of Fox Entertainment Global (FEG Sales), ensuring that clients across the world receive their contracted content and materials accurately and on time. The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, and proactive: a great communicator with a genuine commitment to best-in-class client service.

Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace for a minimum of four (4) days per week is an essential function of the position. The selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as the central operations point of contact for all FEG Sales third-party clients
  • Fulfill contractual client requirements, including video, audio, marketing collateral, and paper deliverables
  • Act as the primary liaison for the global sales team throughout the sales lifecycle, including deal analysis, inventory research, and issue resolution
  • Partner with the Mastering and Legal Documentation teams to ensure timely receipt of high-quality materials
  • Onboard new clients for technical delivery, using internal systems and external vendors as needed
  • Maintain accurate, auditable records of delivery status, client specifications, and completed deliverables
  • Trigger and perform revenue recognition upon verified delivery, in coordination with Finance and in accordance with contract terms and company policy
  • Ensure client satisfaction through on-time delivery, proactive communication, and prompt issue resolution
  • Lead, coach, and develop one US-based and one UK-based team member, while directly managing a portfolio of global clients
  • Collaborate with Business Affairs, Legal, Finance, and Rights Management

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 7+ years of related experience in high-volume entertainment studio servicing
  • 2+ years of people management or team leadership experience
  • Experience supporting clients and colleagues across multiple time zones, including the UK
  • Familiarity with media assets, including audio and visual materials, marketing and advertising materials, and legal documentation
  • Working knowledge of frame rates, codecs, resolutions, and delivery specifications
  • Strong prioritization and resource-allocation skills
  • Proven ability to manage a high volume of concurrent deliveries or projects at various stages in an extremely fast-paced environment
  • Ability to learn new systems, processes, and client requirements quickly and thoroughly
  • Ability to communicate effectively with senior executives
  • Discretion in handling confidential information
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience with Airtable, Salesforce, and Rightsline

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.
