job.title: Senior Multimedia Producer/ SVJ, Serial
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

Serial Productions, in collaboration with The New York Times Metro desk, is launching a new bi-weekly narrative podcast focused on New York City. The podcast will be accompanied by weekly editorial extensions — primarily social video, but also newsletters and live events — that share the sensibility of the show while standing alone as distinctive creative work.

The Senior Multimedia Producer will lead the conception, production and evolution of these extensions, helping invent a distinctive visual language that translates Serial's narrative, character-driven stories about New Yorkers into social-first video and other formats that feel unmistakably of New York City.

This role is a key member of the Serial editorial team and will work closely with Serial producers and editors, New York Times video, social and marketing teams, and freelance collaborators to create fun, experimental and ambitious content that grows and deepens the audience for the show and for Serial more broadly.

This role is based in New York City. The Senior Multimedia Producer is expected to spend significant time in person with Serial, Metro and partner teams, in accordance with New York Times policies, while also doing field and location work across the city as needed.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the editorial vision and production strategy for all extensions to the podcast, including social video, newsletters and live or virtual events.
  • Develop platform-specific social video concepts (for example, TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) that translate the show's reporting, characters and ideas into compelling visual storytelling.
  • Oversee end-to-end production of social videos, from pitching and scripting through shooting, editing, sound design, approvals and publishing.
  • Be able to independently shoot and edit straightforward social video pieces when needed, while primarily commissioning work from New York Times video teams and freelance collaborators.
  • Work with the Metro desk, Serial producers and reporters to identify stories, moments and themes that lend themselves to extensions, and to ensure alignment with the core podcast.
  • Hire, manage and direct freelance videographers, editors, designers and other collaborators; over time, this role may supervise staff producers or associates.
  • Work with Serial staff to develop newsletters and other written extensions that bring the project's reporting, voice and perspective to readers in distinctive formats.
  • Partner with events and live journalism teams to design and produce live or virtual experiences that reflect Serial's editorial sensibility and can generate compelling audio and video.
  • Work with the NYT Audience team to define success metrics for extensions, track performance across platforms and incorporate data and audience insights into ongoing strategy.
  • Run experiments in format, tone, length and distribution to learn what resonates with different audiences while maintaining Serial's editorial standards.
  • Ensure all extensions adhere to New York Times and Serial guidelines around fairness, accuracy, ethics and visual and audio standards.
  • Help foster an inclusive, collaborative and creatively adventurous culture on the Serial team and across partner desks.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.
  • You will report to the Executive Editor, Serial Productions.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Experience (typically 4+ years) producing digital video, social content and multimedia storytelling, ideally in a news, documentary or narrative audio environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to conceive, produce and deliver compelling and unique social video series or campaigns that grow and engage audiences across platforms.
  • Strong hands-on production skills, including scripting, directing talent, field production and working with editors on visual and audio cuts, as well as the ability to shoot and edit short-form social video.
  • Experience collaborating with editorial, audience, marketing and visual teams on cross-platform projects.
  • Comfort working with analytics and platform tools (such as TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and internal dashboards) to interpret performance and inform decisions.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Proven experience managing complex projects with multiple stakeholders, deadlines and deliverables.
  • Experience hiring, directing and giving constructive feedback to freelance and, ideally, staff colleagues.
  • Excellent communication, organization and time-management skills.
  • Deep familiarity with, and enthusiasm for, Serial's work and The New York Times's audio journalism.
  • Experience producing content specifically about New York City and its communities, or in another large metropolitan context with similar complexity.
  • Background in podcast or audio production and comfort working alongside audio-first producers and editors.
  • Experience developing live or virtual events tied to audio or video projects.
  • Familiarity with The New York Times newsroom, standards and workflows, or comparable large news organizations.

This position is represented by the NewsGuild of NY.

The Content Data Products team governs the centralized, compliance-cleared platform for all Times content data. Partnering closely with the New AI Products and Platforms (NAPP) team—whose Discovery Engine (search, knowledge graph, and AI) relies on our infrastructure—we ensure our rich archive is ingested, structured, attributed, and indexed across all brands (News, Cooking, Wirecutter, The Athletic, Games) and multimedia formats (articles, video, interactives).

job.description:
1 big thing: Axios Live transforms award-winning journalism into dynamic live events—offering editorial experiences that spark smart conversations across politics, business, technology, health, and more. We are hiring an Associate Director of Production to manage the technical execution, budget management, and vendor oversight for in-person and virtual events, helping scale Axios Live into its next phase of editorial and experiential growth.

Why It Matters: This isn’t just about running events—it’s about making them work flawlessly. You will serve as the technical lead for some of Axios’s most visible moments, from live-streamed policy interviews to international stage productions. As a strategic and hands-on executor, you'll ensure each event reflects Axios's high standards for editorial integrity, production value, and audience experience.

The details:

Technical Execution & Production Oversight

  • Manage the technical production of Axios Live events, including A/V systems, staging, lighting, livestreaming, video playback, and on-site recording for our large-scale event productions.
  • Serve as stage manager and show-caller, managing real-time production cues, backstage operations, and talent movement
  • Oversee A/V production vendors, including sourcing, scoping, budgeting, contracting, and on-site management
  • Coordinate site-specific tech builds, rehearsals, and contingency plans for both in-person and virtual platforms (e.g. Zoom, Vimeo, custom integrations)

Manage post-production editing workflows, including rapid content clipping in Adobe Premiere Pro and video asset delivery to marketing/editorial teams

Production & Budget Management

  • Own end-to-end production timelines, task tracking, and staffing schedules for simultaneous events
  • Manage event production budgets at the line-item level—tracking vendor estimates, spend actuals, and reconciliations with minimal supervision
  • Negotiate cost-effective solutions with vendors while ensuring Axios’s production standards are met or exceeded

Maintain internal tools and documentation for production planning, budget tracking, vendor database and show files (e.g. run-of-show, call sheets, tech specs)

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Mentorship

  • Collaborate with editorial, creative, and design teams to bring branded experiences to life across Axios IP and custom event formats
  • Act as a technical advisor to internal stakeholders on what’s possible (or not), offering solutions grounded in experience and vendor capabilities
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to associates and freelance contractors, helping build a strong, technically savvy team culture

Support new production innovation by identifying technical opportunities to improve quality, reduce risk, or scale event offerings

What You’ll Bring: You are a technical producer with creative instincts, leadership skills, and a command of live event dynamics. You have:

  • 5–7 years of experience in high-volume event production, including technical design, A/V execution, and budget management
  • Deep understanding of A/V production workflows, including livestreaming, broadcast systems, LED, comms, rigging, and event safety
  • Demonstrated success managing production budgets line by line, including vendor estimates, POs, and invoice reconciliation
  • Proven ability to build and manage relationships with A/V and production vendors, including onsite teams

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly with senior executives and high-profile participants
  • Ability to manage fast paced, quick communication work flows with external and internal stakeholders.

job.title: IT Security Specialist
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a media company dedicated to delivering trustworthy news and information with efficiency, clarity, and Smart Brevity. We are hiring an IT Security Specialist on our IT team to help protect the systems, devices, identities, applications, and workflows that power the company.

Why it matters: Security at Axios is not simply a matter of deploying tools or responding to vulnerabilities. It means understanding how systems are used, assessing whether they are fit for purpose, and identifying risk created by workflows, permissions, configurations, vendors, and user behavior.

This role will help de-risk current and future solutions by embedding security into technology decisions from evaluation and procurement through implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

Go deeper: This role will own key areas of our corporate security environment, including endpoint security, identity and access management, Google Workspace, SaaS security, security monitoring, security awareness, and AI security. We’re looking for an experienced practitioner who understands that, in a modern company, the browser is often the operating system through which people access data, applications, and business workflows. In this role, you will:

  • Own security for Axios’ Mac fleet, including Jamf, compliance, monitoring, alert investigation, malware response, and device remediation.
  • Own Okta-based identity and access management, including adaptive MFA, authentication, SSO, application assignments, access scopes, and joiner/mover/leaver processes.
  • Partner with People, Legal and Infrastructure to improve provisioning, offboarding, access removal, archival, legal holds, and lifecycle automation.
  • Establish and maintain security configurations and risk controls for core services and SaaS applications, including authentication, access, collaboration, email security, data protection, alerting, activity monitoring, vendor and procurement reviews, security questionnaires, evidence gathering, and recommended safeguards.
  • Treat the browser and SaaS layer as critical security boundaries, evaluating how users access data and applications and where browser-based workflows create risk.
  • Use logs and activity monitoring across endpoints, browsers, identity systems, Google Workspace, and SaaS applications to investigate suspicious activity and support incident response.
  • Assess systems, tools, permissions, and workflows for security, operational fit, and long-term supportability.
  • Help protect high-risk users, including journalists and executives, through appropriate privacy, account-security, and personal-data protections.

Security awareness and AI security

  • Own security awareness programs, including human risk, phishing simulations, reporting workflows, completion tracking, and targeted training for higher-risk users.
  • Design and deliver customized training for different parts of the company, including the newsroom, journalists, business teams, and technical teams, based on their workflows and threat models.
  • Develop practical AI security policies and guidance, and review AI tools, automations, agents, and internally built solutions for data handling, permissions, authentication, authorization, secrets management, logging, monitoring, human oversight, and operational readiness.

Worthy of your time: This is an opportunity to shape security inside an AI-enabled media company. You’ll have meaningful ownership and the chance to improve security across our technology environment and the workflows built on top of it.

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Has substantial experience in IT security, endpoint security, identity and access management, systems administration, or a related field.
  • Has hands-on experience with macOS, Jamf or comparable endpoint platforms, CrowdStrike Falcon, Okta or a similar identity provider, and Google Workspace security.
  • Understands modern security boundaries across browsers, SaaS applications, identity providers, endpoints, APIs, data flows, and AI-enabled systems.
  • Has experience with security logging, monitoring, incident investigation, vendor assessments, and SaaS risk management.
  • Has operated or improved security awareness, phishing, or role-specific training programs.
  • Can evaluate risk in the context of real-world workflows, users, business requirements, and operational constraints.

We are looking for a Senior Security Engineer with strong cloud infrastructure and AI security experience to lead our defensive posture, drive threat modeling and vulnerability management, and embed security controls - including AI-driven defense and monitoring - across our platform and automation pipelines.

Why it matters: As a Senior Security Engineer at Axios, you will architect and implement proactive security strategies to protect our audience, platform, and data assets against evolving threat vectors, including AI-driven attacks. In this role, you will define our security roadmap, leverage internal and third-party AI defense tools, and ensure our cloud systems remain resilient, secure by default, and capable of automated threat detection and response.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the architectural design and implementation of security controls across cloud infrastructure, platform services, and AI integrations.
  • Drive vulnerability management, threat modeling, incident response, and proactive security assessments across AWS, Kubernetes, and AI application environments.

job.title: Staff Software Engineer
job.description:
1 big thing: Axios is a growth-focused media company helping people get smarter, faster, on what matters. We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer—a senior, hands-on individual contributor—to lead architecture and delivery for Axios’ core products across multiple teams using strong product-engineering and AI-native practices.

Why it matters: Axios delivers clear, trustworthy news to millions of readers. You’ll be anchored to a product area while shaping full-stack systems and technical direction across multiple teams and connected systems. This is not a people-management role.

AI is core to how we build. You’ll use coding agents throughout implementation, testing, review, debugging, documentation, and operations while remaining accountable for architecture, quality, security, and product outcomes. Staff impact comes from sustained scope, judgment, and results—not tool use alone.

You’ll work with product managers, designers, engineers, and leaders to shape plans, align dependencies, resolve ambiguity, build resilient systems, and help others make better technical decisions.

Responsibilities:

As a Staff Software Engineer, you’ll lead reliable product and platform work across Axios’ frontend and backend systems. You’ll remain hands-on while driving multi-quarter initiatives, improving technical coherence, and using agentic practices to accelerate delivery. Key responsibilities include:

  • Cross-team technical leadership: Lead mission-critical or high-risk initiatives spanning teams and connected systems. Frame problems, align ownership and dependencies, make tradeoffs explicit, and drive production adoption.
  • Architecture and design: Own architecture for a product area and scalable boundaries across frontend, APIs, data, and production systems. Lead design reviews and establish standards within your sphere of influence.
  • Hands-on system ownership: Own the technical direction and long-term evolution of key systems while writing and reviewing code, prototyping, debugging, leading migrations, and operating services in production.
  • AI-enabled product and engineering: Identify where models, agents, retrieval, or automation create value. Build reusable capabilities with measurable behavior, guardrails, and judgment about when conventional software is better.
  • Quality, reliability, and incident leadership: Improve testing, performance, observability, security, and operational readiness. Anticipate systemic risks, address technical debt, and help lead resolution and learning during critical production issues.
  • Technical leadership and mentorship: Mentor mid- and senior-level engineers across teams, spread systems thinking and design patterns, and build alignment through proposals, reviews, and influence without authority.
  • Product and technical strategy: Partner with product, design, and engineering leaders to shape the product-area roadmap, align dependencies, and connect technical investment to reader, editorial, and business outcomes.

Skills:

The ideal candidate is a staff-level engineer with sustained multi-team impact, deep expertise in a relevant domain, broad systems thinking, and a commitment to user experience, reliability, scalability, maintainable code, and effective AI-enabled practice. You should have:

  • Experience: Typically 7+ years in professional software development, or equivalent sustained Staff-level impact, including leading complex initiatives across multiple teams or systems.
  • AI-native development: Hands-on experience using agentic coding tools—such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or comparable tools—to complete meaningful, multi-step software work, rather than only generating snippets or using autocomplete.
  • Agent direction and context: Ability to write clear strategies, specifications, and acceptance criteria; provide context; scope complex work; decide what to delegate; and redirect incomplete or incorrect approaches.
  • Verification and engineering judgment: Ability to review AI-generated code critically, validate assumptions, identify security, scalability, and maintainability risks, and catch plausible but wrong solutions. You understand that AI raises the importance of sound architecture, testing, and human judgment.
  • Frontend development: Hands-on experience building production interfaces with JavaScript or TypeScript and React, preferably with Next.js, plus judgment to guide frontend architecture across teams.
  • Backend development: Hands-on experience building production services and APIs. Our backend systems use Go and Python, and you should be able to shape reliable service boundaries and work effectively in or learn either language.
  • Data fundamentals: Experience with relational databases, SQL, schema design, transactions, and migrations.
  • Quality and security: Experience with testing, accessibility, input validation, authentication, authorization, and web security practices, plus the ability to raise standards across teams.
  • Engineering judgment: Ability to operate independently in ambiguity, identify high-leverage problems, align teams, make sound tradeoffs, and connect decisions to product and business goals—including when AI is not the right tool.
  • Communication: Ability to build alignment through clear proposals and reasoning, communicate risks and tradeoffs across functions, and drive clarity during disagreement.
  • Continuous learning: Curiosity about changing models, tools, and practices, paired with an evidence-based approach. You share useful patterns, identify what fails, and make others more effective.

We’ll be even more excited if you have:

  • Experience building production AI-enabled features using model APIs, structured outputs, tool or function calling, retrieval, or agent workflows.
  • Experience evaluating and operating AI-enabled systems through regression tests, evaluation harnesses, tracing, feedback loops, model or prompt versioning, cost and latency monitoring, or human-review paths.
  • Experience extending AI development environments through MCP servers, agent tools, repository instructions, reusable skills or plugins, custom workflows, or automated code review.
  • Led a multi-team architecture, platform, migration, or modernization initiative from problem framing through production adoption.
  • Owned critical systems through incidents, scaling challenges, and long-term architectural evolution.
  • Drove adoption of technical standards, reusable tools, or platform capabilities across multiple teams.
  • Mentored experienced engineers and helped improve technical judgment beyond your immediate team.
  • Experience with CMS, publishing, media, subscription, search, or other consumer-facing products.
  • Production experience with Go or Python and distributed systems using gRPC, cloud infrastructure, containers, queues, CI/CD, or similar technologies.

What success looks like:

  • Cross-team delivery: You drive multi-quarter initiatives from problem framing through production adoption, aligning dependencies and ownership to produce durable outcomes.
  • Engineering leverage: Teams deliver more effectively because of the standards, tools, architecture, documentation, and context you create. You establish safe, repeatable AI patterns where they add value.
  • System health: Key systems become more reliable, scalable, secure, observable, and easier to change. You reduce systemic risk and improve incident prevention and response.
  • Product-area impact: Your decisions support Axios’ readers, products, editorial workflows, and business goals within the teams and systems you influence.
  • Organizational technical leadership: Engineers across teams make better decisions through your mentorship, proposals, reviews, and example. You remain a hands-on IC who multiplies others’ effectiveness.

job.title: Sr. Context Planner
job.description:
Who We Are

We are a well-established independent agency and thriving music business, built to help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do. 

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. In 2022, Translation was awarded the number three spot in Ad Age’s Agency A-List and AdWeek’s Multicultural Agency of the Year. One year before, Translation was awarded Ad Age’s Small Agency of the Year. We’re unapologetically ambitious, but we’re also a tight-knit crew.

We are looking for a Senior Context Planner to join Translation! Please note that this role is a Hybrid role: three days in office and two days remote. 

Summary

The Senior Context Planner leads integrated communications and go-to-market planning that turns brand strategy and creative ideas into audience participation. As a strategic partner to clients and colleagues across disciplines, you define where, when, with whom and why a brand should show up, giving every channel a clear role. You move quickly and independently, form and defend a clear point of view, and translate complex thinking into compelling stories, thoughtfully designed decks and actionable plans.

You pair that planning craft with cultural fluency across sports, music, entertainment and the worlds they intersect with, from creators and fandom to fashion, gaming and internet behavior. With strong social instincts and a sharp creative eye, you understand how ideas come to life in-feed, spot emerging behaviors and formats, and turn those insights into meaningful opportunities for brands.

What You'll Do

Comms Planning.

  • Translate cultural insights and creative platforms into campaign architecture, defining the role of messaging, channels, moments and partners.
  • Build phasing and sequencing that shows how the idea unfolds over time.
  • Communicate the approach clearly and visually, making complex ecosystems simple and actionable

Cultural Insights

  • Identify meaningful cultural shifts, behaviors and communities relevant to the audience and brand.
  • Frame those signals into clear implications and opportunities for strategy and creative.
  • Use research and cultural inputs to sharpen the comms approach, not just report what’s happening, and contribute insights to company thought leadership (e.g. newsletters, social, etc.) beyond client work.

Creative world-building

  • Maintain a clear narrative throughline as the idea extends across the campaign ecosystem.
  • Shape how the idea is expressed across different touchpoints while preserving what makes it distinctive.
  • Identify opportunities for participation and amplification that help the idea travel further.

Campaign casting

  • Synthesize best practices across the talent x brand landscape into clear POVs
  • Develop talent filters and casting recommendations for creators, artists and partners who credibly bring the idea to life.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Build trust through clear and persuasive presentations
  • Collaborate across departments including strategy, creative, business leadership and production, including risk assessments, case studies and awards.
  • Mentor associate and mid level Context Planners, delegating clearly and providing feedback that strengthens their craft.
  • Actively connect with the UnitedMasters team for an understanding of upcoming milestones and priority artists for casting consideration in Translation brand campaigns.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Comfortable working quickly and independently, owning deliverables with light oversight and adapting as priorities shift.
  • Able to form and defend a clear POV, using cultural insights and research to make actionable recommendations.
  • Strong comms planning instincts, connecting audience behavior, brand opportunity and campaign choreography.
  • Sharp information design and visual taste: build strong decks, shape a clear story and make complex ideas simple and actionable.
  • Cultural fluency across sports, music, entertainment and pop culture, including their intersections with creators, fandom, fashion, gaming and internet behavior.
  • A social-first thinker with a strong creative eye for how ideas work in-feed and an instinct for emerging behaviors and formats.
  • Strong collaborator across disciplines, receptive to feedback and confident presenting to internal teams and clients.
  • Resourceful in research, curious about new platforms and media opportunities, and committed to refining the work.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Possess excellent time management, organization and prioritization skills.
  • Have the proven ability to work under tight deadlines and handle pressure, while consistently paying attention to accuracy and quality of work.
  • Exercise the ability to quickly and effectively adapt to changing needs and expectations.                                                                                        

Preferred Qualifications

  • Minimum 4-7 years experience in a strategic position in an agency or brand environment
  • 4-year college degree in Marketing, Advertising or Business preferred.
  • Digitally savvy; MUST be proficient in Google Suite and Keynote (Mac preferred).

About UnitedMasters Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Salary Hiring Range: $93,000 - $110,000

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. bonus, stock options, 401(k) match, etc.)

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.  We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. 

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.  If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for the NY/CA.  As a company, we have a location based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

job.title: Front Doors Product Manager
job.description:
Title: Front Doors Product Manager
Schedule Format - Location: Hybrid - San Francisco
Pay Information: $106,080 - $110,000
Temporary:  Limited Term, Full Time - 18- Months


This role is onsite at KQED's newly renovated headquarters located in San Francisco, CA. Applicants must currently reside in San Francisco Bay Area or be willing to relocate.

About the Role

KQED is looking for a Product Manager to own the performance of our homepage and key landing pages — the "front doors" that shape how millions of visitors discover our journalism each month. This role blends programming judgment with product thinking: building the processes, tools, and metrics to support editorial and product teams.

You'll work closely with editorial leadership, engineering, design, analytics, marketing, and events to ensure our most important journalism gets the visibility it deserves — balancing breaking news, evergreen content, franchise programming, promotional priorities, and strategic priorities across a public media audience that spans news, arts, education, and local community coverage.

KQED envisions a public media organization with a culture that centers on human dignity, equity, and belonging. This will enable us to better serve and reflect the Bay Area through diverse and inclusive storytelling. 

We value the contributions of marginalized people in society — including Black, Indigenous, and all people of color,  people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people — and we believe that these communities must be centered in the work we do, and we strongly encourage members of these communities to apply.

KQED Code of Ethics  https://www.kqed.org/about/code-ethics

The mission that drives us:

KQED provide citizens of Northern California with a community-supported alternative to commercial media.   We provide citizens with the knowledge they need to make informed decisions; convene community dialogue; bring the arts to everyone and engage audiences to share their stories. We help students and teachers thrive in 21st-century classrooms, and take people of all ages on journeys of exploration- exposing them to new people, places and ideas.

This role will work hybrid between working in KQED's newly renovated headquarters and working remotely. 


What You'll Do
  • Own day-to-day strategy for KQED's homepage and major landing/section pages, ensuring content placement reflects editorial priorities, audience needs, and real-time news judgment
  • Partner with editors and reporters to understand story priority, timeliness, and strategic significance, translating editorial intent into homepage/landing page decisions
  • Define and evolve the workflows, guidelines, and (where useful) tooling that support consistent, scalable curation — including rules for automated vs. manual placement, module rotation, and content lifecycle on high-traffic pages
  • Establish and track success metrics for front-door performance (engagement, click-through, time-on-page, downstream conversion) and use that data to inform curation strategy and future product investments
  • Identify opportunities to improve or automate parts of the curation workflow, partnering with engineering on tooling that reduces manual burden without sacrificing editorial nuance
  • Collaborate with design on layout, module types, and page templates that support flexible, effective curation
  • Coordinate with Marketing and Events teams to schedule and place promotional content (campaigns, member drives, live events, sponsorships) on the homepage and landing pages, balancing promotional needs against editorial priorities and audience experience
  • Monitor site performance and respond to real-time needs (breaking news, election coverage, major community events) with appropriate homepage/landing page adjustments
  • Contribute to broader digital product strategy conversations around audience discovery, SEO/AIO crawlability, personalization/recommendations, and content distribution across owned platforms

What We're Looking For
  • 3+ years of product management experience, ideally with exposure to media, publishing, content platforms, or audience-facing digital products
  • Strong editorial judgment or demonstrated ability to partner closely with editorial teams — you don't need a journalism background, but you should be comfortable making news judgment calls collaboratively
  • Experience defining and using metrics/analytics to evaluate content or product performance
  • Comfort working in ambiguity and building process/structure where none exists yet (this is a net-new role)
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills — this role sits at the intersection of editorial, engineering, design, marketing, and events, and requires translating fluently across all of them
  • Comfort balancing competing stakeholder priorities (editorial vs. promotional/marketing needs) with clear, defensible tradeoff decisions
  • Familiarity with CMS platforms and how content architecture affects front-end presentation
  • Bias toward action balanced with sound judgment — front doors need attention daily, sometimes hourly
  • Passion for public media's mission and KQED's role serving the Bay Area

NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may be required to perform other related duties as necessary to meet the ongoing needs of this organization.

Real Chemistry is looking for a Senior Manager, Paid Social to join our growing Biddable Media team. 

The Senior Manager owns paid social strategy and execution for client projects of moderate scope with limited oversight. This person translates business objectives into effective channel approaches, solves complex activation challenges and develops compelling performance stories tied to client outcomes. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, Lambertville, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What you’ll do 

  • Translate client business goals, audience needs and campaign objectives into paid social channel strategies.

  • Develop test-and-learn initiatives that evolve account performance and expand paid social capabilities. 
  • Address complex performance concerns through audience, bidding, creative, placement or account-structure changes. 
  • Supervise campaign launches, identify process gaps and improve practice documentation and workflows. 
  • Translate media metrics into meaningful business insights, recommendations and ROI narratives. 
  • Own or support recurring client updates and deliver clear presentations on performance, insights and next steps. 
  • Guide junior team members on strategy, delegate work appropriately and contribute to their development. 
  • Manage cross-functional relationships with Client Experience, Analytics, Strategy, Ad Operations, Creative and partner agencies.

  • You are an expert campaign storyteller who can make complex performance data understandable and actionable. 
  • You bring proposed solutions when escalating issues rather than simply identifying problems. 
  • You are comfortable serving as a developing channel authority for clients and internal teams. 
  • You enjoy testing new ideas and turning successful learnings into repeatable practices. 
  • You communicate with confidence, clarity and an awareness of your audience. 

What you should have 

  • 4+ years of experience in digital media, including significant hands-on paid social campaign management. 
  • Experience translating client business objectives into channel strategy and tactical recommendations. 
  • Demonstrated success managing complex campaigns, restructures or performance challenges. 
  • Strong understanding of audience strategy, campaign measurement, optimization and testing. 
  • Experience presenting campaign recommendations and results to clients. 
  • Ability to oversee multiple projects and balance competing priorities. 
  • Experience mentoring junior practitioners or providing workstream leadership. 
  • Healthcare or pharmaceutical media experience is preferred.

job.title: Outside Account Executive
job.description:
iHeartMedia Markets

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy!

job.title: Advertising Sales Executive
job.description:
Job Type Full-time Description

 

Advertising Sales Executive

We don’t just broadcast messages. Radio has the power to make people listen- and, more importantly, act. 


Strong local businesses help create strong communities. At Midwest Communications, we help Kalamazoo businesses reach new customers, strengthen their brands, and turn great ideas into results. As an Advertising Sales Executive, you’ll become a trusted marketing partner for businesses in your community. You’ll learn what a client is trying to accomplish, identify opportunities, and build marketing strategies using radio, digital, social media, promotions, and more.


What You’ll Do:

  • Help local businesses become stronger and more successful - understand what they’re trying to accomplish and find ways to help them by using marketing strategies across radio, digital, social media, and promotions.
  • Create new opportunities for growth- conduct needs assessments and build relationships with businesses that could benefit from what Midwest Communications has to offer.
  • Build a presence by attending client meetings, networking events, and community functions. 
  • Turn marketing strategies into results- help clients connect with customers, increase awareness, drive traffic, generate leads, and grow their business.
  • Create your own success story- develop new business, grow existing partnerships, and build a book of clients you’re proud to represent.
  • Stay ahead of the market by tracking the latest trends, competitor offerings, and best industry practices. 

What We Offer:

  • A full-time position with an established and successful business.
  • Competitive pay with commission and benefits ($45,000-$60,000 based on experience). Start with a guaranteed draw pay while you build your business and client relationships, with additional earning potential through commission. 
    • Paid time off/holidays, health/dental/vision insurance, 401(k), flexible spending accounts, life insurance, and disability coverage. 
  • Professional development and sales training.
  • Performance based incentives/bonuses.
  • Opportunities to grow within Midwest Communications, Inc.

About GDM (Gray Media Group):

Gray’s Digital Technology group builds and operates the products that bring local news, sports, and live programming to audiences across 100+ television stations – on the web, on mobile, and on connected TV platforms. Quality is critical to ensure viewers are focused on journalism, not the technology that delivers it. You will help make sure that what we ship is reliable, accessible, and ready when it counts – election night, severe weather, breaking news.

Job Summary/Description:

The Digital QA Analyst validates the quality, functionality, accessibility, and reliability of digital products across web, mobile, connected TV, APIs, data feeds, and internal systems. You’ll partner closely with Product Owners, developers, and business stakeholders to confirm that what we build meets requirements, holds up under real-world use, and is genuinely ready for release. The right person combines strong testing fundamentals, critical thinking, technical curiosity, and a sharp eye for detail to catch problems early and promote quality at every stage of the development lifecycle, not just at the end.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

• Design, plan, and execute testing activities across web, mobile, connected TV (CTV), APIs, data feeds, and internal platforms to ensure products meet quality and business expectations.
• Collaborate with Product Owners, developers, and stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle to clarify requirements, identify risks, and improve overall product quality.
• Create and maintain test strategies, test cases, regression suites, and documentation while prioritizing testing efforts based on risk, complexity, user impact, and release timelines.
• Identify, document, and validate defects through resolution, providing clear communication on testing status, release readiness, and potential risks.
• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing quality trends, supporting efficient QA processes, and helping expand test automation coverage where it provides the greatest value.

Test design and planning:
• Build test strategies, cases, and validation approaches from requirements, Jira tickets, stakeholder input, and product knowledge.
• Partner with Product Owners and developers early in the software lifecycle to surface risks, clarify requirements, and improve testability before development starts.
• Prioritize coverage by risk, complexity, business, and user impact, and release timelines.

Test execution across platforms:
• Run functional, regression, integration, exploratory, accessibility, and user acceptance testing across web, mobile, CTV, and internal platforms.
• Execute cross-browser, cross-device, and mobile testing.
• Test connected-TV apps (Roku, Apple TV, Fire TV, Android TV) for playback, captions, ad behavior, and live-versus-VOD scenarios.
• Validate APIs, data feeds, AI-generated outputs, JSON/XML payloads, and downstream integrations.

Defect lifecycle:
• Identify defects, usability issues, edge cases, and unexpected behavior.
• Write clear defect reports with reproduction steps, expected-versus-actual results, and supporting evidence.
• Re-test fixes and confirm resolution before release.

Collaboration and process:
• Take part in sprint planning, backlog refinement, standups, and retrospectives.
• Work alongside developers to isolate issues and support root-cause analysis.
• Maintain regression suites, test documentation, and repeatable QA processes.
• Validate release readiness and communicate status, risks, and recommendations clearly.

Continuous improvement:
• Track quality trends, recurring defects, and areas of technical debt that affect product
stability.
• Help identify where automated testing would add the most value, and partner with
engineering to grow coverage and efficiency.
• Contribute to initiatives that raise product quality and team effectiveness.

Qualifications/Requirements:

• A minimum of 3 years of experience in software quality assurance, digital product testing, or a related field, with hands-on experience testing web applications, mobile applications, internal systems, or other digital products.
• Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, including functional, regression, integration, exploratory, accessibility, and user acceptance testing, with the ability to identify issues and validate solutions across multiple platforms.
• 3+ years of experience in software QA, digital product testing, or a closely related field.
• Hands-on experience testing web applications, mobile applications, internal systems, or other digital products.
• Strong grasp of functional, regression, integration, exploratory, accessibility, and acceptance testing.
• Ability to turn requirements and user workflows into effective test cases and scenarios.
• Experience validating APIs, structured data, and system integrations.
• Strong defect documentation and the collaboration skills to work across the full SDLC.
• Working understanding of accessibility principles, and willingness to build accessibility checks into everyday testing.
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving instincts.
• Excellent written and verbal communication

Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience testing media, broadcast, publishing, CMS, or other content-driven platforms.
• Experience testing connected-TV/OTT apps and validating video playback, closed captions, and ad insertion (SSAI/DAI).
• Experience validating JSON/XML/API responses and integration workflows.
• Basic SQL for validation and troubleshooting.
• Experience testing iOS and Android applications.
• Familiarity with browser developer tools and network inspection.
• Exposure to test automation and an interest in growing automated coverage.
• Accessibility testing against WCAG guidelines.
• Experience supporting release validation and production readiness.

What Success Looks Like:
• Requirements are validated thoroughly before release.
• Critical workflows perform reliably across every supported platform – including playback and ad delivery.
• Defects are identified early and communicated clearly enough to influence product and development decisions.
• Releases ship with predictable quality and few production-impacting issues, which means less rework afterward.
• Test coverage and regression confidence improve over time.
• Stakeholders have clear visibility into QA status, risks, and release readiness.
• Engineering trusts the quality bar on every release.

Job Summary/Description:

A Solutions Journalist at WIS joins a market-leading, award-winning newsroom to research, develop, and produce enterprise reporting that doesn’t stop at identifying what’s broken. This role is for an investigative-minded storyteller who understands evolving audience demand for journalism that holds power accountable while also rigorously examining responses—what’s being tried, what’s working (or not), for whom, and why.

Solutions journalism is not “good news.” It is tough, evidence-based reporting about responses to problems, grounded in:

• Evidence of effectiveness (data, results, credible evaluation)
• Insight (what can be learned and why it matters here)
• Limitations (tradeoffs, gaps, risks, what hasn’t worked, who’s left out)

The ideal candidate is an aggressive self-starter with strong public records skills, understands how to research, has a deep commitment to fairness and verification, and has the ability to produce compelling, high-impact stories across broadcast and digital platforms.

 Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

• Pitch, report, and produce enterprise/solutions stories that examine both the problem and credible responses, with clear evidence and limitations
• Shoot, write, edit, and publish multiplatform video (broadcast + digital) with high standards of verification and transparency
• Plan and execute short- and long-term projects on a shared enterprise calendar with newsroom stakeholders
• Use public records (FOIA), databases, documents, and data to uncover accountability and measure outcomes
• Develop sources and leads that reveal exclusive information and deepen reporting over time
• Interrogate claims made by institutions and organizations promoting “solutions,” testing what’s true and what’s overstated
• Center the audience with clear “why it matters” framing and practical context, without advocacy or cheerleading
• Present information fairly and accurately, including right-of-reply and strong attribution
• Collaborate closely with News leadership, digital, and producers to maximize reach, clarity, and follow-through reporting
• Build and maintain reporting systems (trackers, databases, timelines) to ensure stories evolve beyond a single hit
• Create strong digital components (explainers, FAQs, document viewers, short-form video, follow-ups) that extend impact and engagement

Qualifications/Requirements:

• 3-5 years’ experience in investigative, enterprise, or accountability reporting (solutions journalism experience is a plus)
• Refined ability to write for both broadcast & digital presentation
• Bachelor’s degree in journalism or related field
• Understanding of and adherence to AP Style for digital platforms and broadcasting writing for TV
• Ability to operate a field camera, editing, and lighting equipment
• Ability to lift/carry equipment ranging from 35-50 lbs
• Must have a valid driver’s license and a clean driving record
• Represent WIS professionally/responsibly in the community and newsroom, online and in person
• Must have the desire to win, reflect critically on your work, and apply feedback
• Demonstrated ability to report with rigor on evidence, impact, and limitations (data literacy and document reporting preferred)

Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners. 

 

Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win—and we believe in celebrating those victories together! 

  

Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships and long-lasting relationships. You're helping businesses find the right audience in the right place at the right time. When we say One Partner, Endless Possibilities, we mean it! 

 

Be A Trusted Guide: In this role, you'll connect with clients on a human level, understand their unique needs, and craft tailored sales and marketing solutions that deliver results. As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision.  

 

Shake Things Up: Bring your creativity and fresh ideas to the table! We're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, embraces innovation, and finds new ways to connect with our audience. Your contributions will help elevate our brand and drive meaningful results for your clients.  

 

Join us and Conquer the Media Landscape: You'll be part of a dedicated team of A1 media sales professionals, committed to achieving market leadership. Together, we amplify our impact, deliver exceptional outcomes, and help our clients succeed in ways that truly matter. 

 

Identify Emerging Opportunities: It's about being able to see what others can't, anticipating market shifts, analyzing data and predicting the next big thing. Your insights will position our clients and AMP for long-term success.  

  

What We're Looking For 

Proven Sales Ability and an Unstoppable Desire to Learn

You're a seasoned sales professional and we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 

 

Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

 

A Passion for helping Others: You're committed to understanding clients' needs, providing top-notch customer service and making a difference. You're not just selling a product; you're providing a solution.  

 

A Competitive Spirit: Do you get a little boost when you achieve a goal (especially if it was a tough one)? We love that for you (and us)!  We want someone who's driven to excel but also knows how to celebrate the victories (big and small) with their team. That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization.  

 

A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.  

 

The Practical Stuff 

A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

 

Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.  

 

The Compensation Package: We offer a base salary, commission structure, and benefits package designed to support your success and well-being. Happy employees don't stage rebellions! ;) 

 

We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales specialist isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.) 

 

Top-Notch Training and Support: We're not the kind of company that hires you and then disappears into the corporate abyss. We carefully select candidates for a cohort-based training program, where you'll join a group of sales professionals from all over the country. From onboarding to ongoing mentorship, we invest in your success with training programs that set you up for long-term growth. 

 

Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, providing you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.  

 

Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.   

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Senior Analyst, Finance Systems
job.description:
Reporting to the Senior Manager of Financial Systems, the Senior Analyst of Finance Systems will support the financial reporting team that delivers financial reports across FOX Corporation.

The Senior Analyst is responsible for designing and supporting innovative reporting solutions for a variety of ongoing financial needs. This position will work closely with internal and external stakeholders across multiple FOX divisions and corporate finance. This role offers the opportunity to work on emerging AI initiatives and Adaptive Planning projects as part of the team's broader financial systems modernization efforts. The Senior Analyst will engage with divisional and corporate finance teams to understand their business needs and effectively work with the reporting team to deliver solutions that meet the business requirements.


In addition to financial reporting, this opportunity requires in-depth understanding of Financial Accounting and the related processes. Experience with Workday Financials, Adaptive Planning, Reporting Tools, and Foundation Data Model (FDM) is preferable.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead reporting tasks from planning and fit-gap analysis to design sessions, requirements gathering, testing and deployment
  • Serve as the Workday / OfficeConnect reporting lead and be primary point of contact between finance and the Workday reporting team
  • Utilize OfficeConnect, Adaptive Planning, AI, and other reporting tools to create and maintain financial reporting.
  • Support and contribute to Adaptive Planning initiatives, including improvements
  • Assist divisional finance teams with troubleshooting reporting issues
  • Support corporate finance with internal and external reporting
  • Ensure the accuracy of reports by validating the results of the data analysis
  • Engage with finance teams on a regular basis to understand reporting opportunities and pain points
  • Manage reporting projects by working with partners of different backgrounds to keep projects on track
  • Utilize AI tools to streamline reporting and automate manual processes
  • Identify opportunities to apply AI and Adaptive Planning capabilities to modernize existing reporting workflows

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 2-5 years in accounting, finance, financial reporting, or other relevant experience
  • Strong communication skills
  • Ability to present to leaders regarding FOX's potential to transform, to modernize and streamline legacy business processes
  • Ability to think "outside the box" to provide creative and effective solutions
  • Understanding of AI tools and interest in applying them to financial reporting and planning
  • Flexibility to manage team members across multiple time zones and support of concurrent complex projects

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Experience with Reporting Tools — Workday, Adaptive, and OfficeConnect
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance

job.title: Video News Photojournalist & Editor
job.description:
We are in search of a talented Video News Photojournalist & Editor to join our team and as we strive deliver the highest standards in news production in the number one market, providing content for our marquee morning news and variety show "Good Day New York", "The Noon", 5 & 6 PM newscasts, "The 10 O'clock News" and a host of special programming, plus our various digital streaming platforms.

As a Video News Photojournalist and Editor, you will play a key role in capturing and producing visually compelling news stories that resonate with our audience. You will work closely with reporters, producers, and other team members to ensure that our content is both informative and visually engaging. This position requires a creative eye, technical expertise, and a passion for storytelling.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Capture high-quality video footage for breaking news stories, live events, and special features.
  • Edit video content under tight deadlines to create accurate, engaging news segments that meet our editorial standards.
  • Work side-by-side with reporters and producers to develop visual storytelling strategies.
  • Operate and maintain video equipment, ensuring all gear is in excellent working condition.
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends and emerging technologies to continually enhance our content.
  • Work in a fast-paced environment, meeting tight deadlines while maintaining attention to detail.
  • Ensure all video content adheres to legal and ethical standards.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Expertise operating ENG cameras (we shoot w Sony PXW-X400 and PXW-Z300), DJI Osmos, GoPros, and other portable "action cameras".
  • 5+ years as a videographer and editor, preferably in a top 10 market.
  • Familiarity with the Tri-State area, as you will be operating station owned vehicles in NY, NJ,CT and beyond.
  • Experience with cellular bonding transmitters (LiveU/Dejero) and Starlink.
  • Strong understanding of video production techniques, including lighting, sound, and composition.
  • Proficiency with Windows OS and Adobe Premiere Pro, FTP applications is a must.
  • Excellent storytelling skills with a keen eye for detail and the moving image.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team, managing multiple projects all at once.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams.
  • A degree in journalism, film production, or a related field is preferred but not required.
  • Ability to lift heavy equipment and climb stairs; driver’s license required.

REQUIREMENTS

Flexibility to work irregular hours, including evenings, early mornings, overnights and weekends as news coverage dictates, in a 24/7/365 breaking news environment; must be able to work overtime, holidays and varied hours. Candidate will also be required to join the I.A.T.S.E Local 794 union. Pursuant to state and local pay disclosure requirements, the pay range for this role, with final offer amount dependent on education, skills, experience and in accordance with the applicable union collective bargaining agreement is: $49.69 per hour.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to lift heavy equipment up to 50 lbs., frequently bend, kneel, stoop, and reach.
  • Ability to stand for long periods (1+ hour).
  • Regularly drive automobiles for extended periods of time to perform job-related activities.
  • Must be able to work in adverse weather conditions, on occasion.

job.title: Weekend Senior Producer, LiveNOW from FOX
job.description:
We're hiring a Weekend Senior Producer to join the team behind LiveNOW from FOX, FOX TV Stations’ national live streaming news channel. LiveNOW brings viewers the most relevant and engaging live news coverage occurring right now across the country and the world. We are a team of passionate content creators seamlessly moving between the biggest live events and stories as they happen to keep our viewers informed. LiveNOW is always raw, live, and unfiltered, with limited commentary and no opinion. 

As a Weekend Senior Producer, you will serve as an editorial leader for our team and take an active role in boosting the quality of our product while championing the LiveNOW mission. If you describe yourself as a tech-savvy multitasker obsessed with news and producing it differently, this is your opportunity to create compelling content in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

With your guidance, you will help take LiveNOW’s content to the next level!

This position is based in LiveNOW’s West Coast newsroom located in Phoenix, Arizona.

SCHEDULE: Thursday - Monday

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Take a hands-on role in producing relevant, timely, live coverage of breaking news and major news events for all digital platforms.
  • Lead editorial decisions and ensure content meets editorial standards while staying on top of current news, events, and industry news.
  • Monitor video feeds, social media, and other newsgathering tools for fresh, live content and the latest information. 
  • Contribute to coverage plans of major stories and live events to drive viewer engagement.
  • Support the development of other producers as you ensure a positive work environment and mentor them. 
  • Actively participate in training news staff on all technical, editorial, and presentation aspects of LiveNOW.
  • Work closely with LiveNOW leadership to develop and adjust producer workflows as needed. 
  • Support LiveNOW’s efforts to cultivate relationships with key players at FTS O&O stations and other internal or external partners.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 3-5 years of experience leading the planning and producing of live news content, including breaking news on digital, social, and broadcast platforms.
  • BA/BS degree preferably in Journalism, Communications or a related field.

The person in this role will collaborate with finance teams and IT to design and develop new SAC planning and analytic solutions. The Applied Intelligence Data Engineering team is seeking a Sr. Data Engineering Manager to lead the strategy, design, delivery, and operational excellence of large-scale batch and real-time data platforms. This role will oversee multiple data engineering teams that power analytics, APIs, AI workflows, and mission-critical data services across the organization.
You will guide the design and implementation of distributed data systems. This includes ETL and ELT pipelines. You will also work with streaming platforms, warehouse ecosystems, and cloud-native infrastructure.

As a manager, you will shape technical direction, develop engineering talent, and ensure production-grade reliability, scalability, and operational rigor across data platforms.This role requires deep expertise in modern data architectures, distributed systems, and cloud-native engineering, plus proven experience leading multiple teams and managing managers or senior ICs.

Lead & Scale Data Engineering Teams
•    Manage and develop a team of data engineers in charge of batch and streaming data systems.
•    Drive technical execution across ingestion, transformation, modeling, and serving layers.
•    Establish engineering standards, code quality practices, and architectural review processes.
•    Mentor engineers in distributed systems design, performance optimization, and production reliability.
•    Foster a culture of operational excellence, accountability, continuous improvement, and technical ownership.

Architect Scalable Data Platforms
•    Ensure scalable data modeling standards and efficient query performance across analytical workloads.
•    Help with important architectural choices. This includes orchestration. It also covers schema evolution. Additionally, it involves partitioning strategies and storage optimization.

•    Lead architectural reviews and drive long-term platform strategy.
•    Foster a culture of ownership, documentation, and continuous improvement.
•    Stay current with evolving technologies and industry trends in cloud data platforms, distributed systems, and AI data infrastructure.

Modern Data Architecture
•    Strong expertise in data lakes, warehouses, and lakehouse architectures.
•    Deep knowledge of ETL/ELT frameworks, orchestration platforms, and distributed data processing systems.
•    Solid knowledge of Kafka-based architectures and event-driven data patterns.

•    Strong foundation in distributed systems engineering, scalability patterns, resiliency design, and high-availability architectures.

•    Committed to creating an inclusive and collaborative engineering culture that is also accountable.

Execution & Delivery Leadership
•    Strong sprint planning, capacity modeling, and roadmap sequencing skills.
•    Ability to manage competing priorities across reliability, feature delivery, and technical debt reduction.
•    Experience establishing engineering KPIs such as reliability, latency, throughput, and deployment frequency.

•    Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field; advanced degree preferred.

job.description:

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. KPNX-TV Phoenix, the TEGNA NBC in Phoenix seeks a full-time Broadcast Engineer to join the Technology team. This position is responsible for the day-to-day hands-on maintenance of the station’s technical equipment including traditional broadcast hardware and industry specific software.

The ideal candidate can balance multiple ongoing projects while addressing the immediate maintenance needs of a 24/7 operation. If you enjoy problem solving, are a people person, like solving technical/IT challenges and enjoy communicating, we want to hear from you.

Current driver’s license and ability to operate news gathering vehicle to and from various locations required

job.description:

We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How We Lead:

Universal Music Group is seeking a Coordinator to join the Virgin Music Group Paid Media team in Hollywood, CA. This role supports the full paid media campaign lifecycle (planning and setup through execution, optimization, and reporting) while owning the department’s billing workflow and coordinating day-to-day team operations. Working closely with internal teams, clients, and media partners, the Coordinator will help deliver campaigns that build artist audiences, support streaming growth, and drive direct-to-consumer (D2C) engagement and sales across new releases, catalog, and other priority initiatives throughout the Virgin Music Group roster and select distribution partners.


This position is ideal for someone who combines a passion for music with strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and curiosity about digital advertising. As experience develops, there will be opportunities to take on greater responsibility for media planning and campaign management.



How You'll Create:

Campaign Planning and Execution

  • Support the paid media team throughout the campaign lifecycle, including briefing, audience research, media planning, setup, launch, optimization, and reporting
  • Coordinate with clients and internal teams to gather creative assets, copy, destination links, approvals, and other campaign materials; track deadlines and flag missing items
  • Assist with campaign setup and media buying across platforms such as Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube, Snapchat, X, and programmatic advertising partners
  • Perform prelaunch quality checks on access, creative specifications, copy, links, targeting, budgets, flight dates, and tracking parameters
  • Monitor campaign delivery, spend, and budget pacing; flag discrepancies or performance concerns and assist with optimizations under the guidance of the paid media team
  • Support audience research, segmentation, and activation across artist affinity, interest, engagement, retargeting, customer, and lookalike audiences
  • Coordinate campaign changes, creative refreshes, and testing, maintaining accurate records of approvals and updates

Reporting and Insights

  • Prepare accurate campaign updates and post campaign reports using advertising platforms, internal tools, and third-party dashboards
  • Track performance against campaign objectives and relevant metrics
  • Translate campaign results into clear takeaways and recommendations for review by the paid media team
  • Stay informed about advertising platform updates, music marketing trends, and emerging media partners; share relevant opportunities with the team

Billing and Department Operations

  • Own the department’s billing workflow in partnership with Finance, including raising POs, collecting invoices, maintaining billing records, reconciling spend, and tracking outstanding items
  • Coordinate purchase orders, vendor setup, campaign coding, and payment follow-up as required by company processes
  • Help reconcile planned budgets, platform spend, and vendor invoices; flag discrepancies for resolution
  • Maintain campaign trackers (Airtable tool), reporting calendars, and organized campaign documentation
  • Coordinate team meetings, agendas, notes, and action items, and follow up on deadlines and deliverables
  • Support timely communication among internal teams, clients, and media partners regarding assets, campaign status, reporting, and billing
