Skills and Abilities

  • Strong interest and curiosity to learn digital advertising, audience development, and music marketing, with a willingness to learn new platforms and tools
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines as priorities evolve
  • Strong attention to detail and follow-through, particularly when working with campaign settings, budgets, invoices, and reporting
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to summarize data and coordinate effectively with internal and external partners
  • Comfort working with numbers and spreadsheets, identifying discrepancies, and turning data into useful insights
  • Foundational understanding of paid social advertising, audience targeting, campaign objectives, and performance measurement
  • Familiarity with social platforms, creative formats, and audience behavior across music genres
  • A proactive, resourceful approach to problem solving, with sound judgment about when to ask questions or escalate issues
  • Ability to work collaboratively, handle confidential information, and communicate professionally with stakeholders at all levels
  • Passion for music and artist development, with an interest in how advertising supports discovery, fan engagement, streaming, and sales

Experience and Technical Qualifications

  • Relevant experience through internships, employment, coursework, or hands-on projects in digital advertising, marketing, media, or a related field
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word; comfort using spreadsheets for campaign tracking, reporting, and billing reconciliation
  • Proficiency in Figma, Airtable, Canva

  • Experience with invoice processing, budget tracking, purchase orders, or financial systems such as SAP/Uniport preferred

As a Technical Operations Center (TOC) Manager, you will be one of three global managers operating in a "Follow the Sun" model, ensuring continuous 24/7 coverage and operational excellence across our technical infrastructure. This role is accountable for more than ticket throughput. It turns operational signals into measurable reliability outcomes by strengthening service ownership, leading disciplined incident response, reducing repeat failure and toil, and moving the organization toward proactive, increasingly automated operations. Your leadership will be crucial in facilitating seamless handoffs between shifts, maintaining high performance, and upholding and improving they systems and processes that create operational drag.

 

Job Functions:

Service Reliability & Operational Leadership

·         Lead day-to-day operations for the Technical Operations Center, ensuring critical infrastructure and services are operated safely, reliably and consistently.

·         Establish and maintain a service-centric operating rhythm covering service ownership, criticality, dependencies, SLOs/SLIs, incident trends, capacity, risk and operational readiness.

·         Partner with service owners, engineering, cybersecurity, business technology teams and vendors to identify reliability risks before they become business-impacting incidents.

·         Use observability, telemetry and service health data to improve detection, prioritization and decision-making.

·         Maintain a regular operating review and publish a concise scorecard focused on outcomes rather than activity.

 

Major Incident Management & Swarming

·         Lead or sponsor response to major incidents, acting as Incident Commander or ensuring the appropriate command structure is in place.

·         Establish clear incident roles, escalation triggers, communication standards and decision rights for high-severity events.

·         Make swarming repeatable through shared queues, structured triage-ready information and timely engagement of the right technical and business partners.

·         Coordinate internal teams and third-party providers through restoration, stakeholder communication and service validation.

·         Ensure blameless postmortems convert incident learning into prioritized problem-management, reliability and prevention work.

 

Problem Management, Toil Reduction & Automation

·         Maintain a ranked backlog of repeat incidents, operational toil, alert noise and manual work, with owners and measurable outcomes.

·         Drive the conversion of repeatable procedures into versioned runbooks, scripts, workflows, automation and self-service capabilities.

·         Apply AI-assisted triage and knowledge discovery where appropriate, with human oversight, security controls, auditability and clear escalation paths.

·         Improve the quality, findability and lifecycle management of operational knowledge, including runbooks, known-error records, as-builts and shift documentation.

·         Track automation adoption and toil hours avoided using the results to redirect capacity toward reliability engineering and service improvement.

 

Change, Release & Operational Readiness

·         Strengthen risk-tiered change practices, including pre-checks, peer review, testing evidence, implementation plans, monitoring and rollback readiness.

·         Partner with engineering and delivery teams to shift operational readiness earlier in the lifecycle, including supportability, observability, runbooks and ownership before release.

·         Analyze change-related incidents and failure patterns leading corrective actions that improve change success and reduce recovery time.

·         Support paved-road standards and a transparent exception process for common infrastructure, cloud, identity, network and systems patterns.

 

Global Coordination & Follow-the-Sun Operations

·         Facilitate structured handoffs between global teams, ensuring the incoming shift receives current service health, active incidents, risks, decisions, next actions and escalation needs.

·         Maintain consistent severity, response, handoff, change and review practices across regions while respecting local context and coverage requirements.

·         Build strong working relationships across time zones, technical domains, business units and strategic vendors.

·         Participate in a rotating global coverage and escalation model, including occasional out-of-hours or weekend coverage when required. The schedule should support sustainable coverage rather than routine weekend office attendance.

 

People Leadership & Capability Building

·         Lead, coach and develop Technical Operations Center specialists, creating a culture of accountability, learning, collaboration and continuous improvement.

·         Set clear expectations for performance, incident leadership, documentation, operational discipline and customer experience.

·         Hire, onboard and develop talent while building role-based learning paths and cross-training plans for critical domains.

·         Establish resilient coverage with documented SME and backup relationships, reducing key-person dependency.

 

Job Requirements:

 

Skills/Abilities

·         Deep technical knowledge in infrastructure operations, site reliability, platform operations or related disciplines.

·         Ability to assess impact, prioritize under pressure, communicate clearly and make sound decisions during high-severity events.

·         Experience with service ownership, observability, SLOs/SLIs, operational readiness, runbooks and reliability metrics.

·         Experience reducing operational toil through scripting, workflow automation, self-service or similar engineering practices.

·         Working knowledge of cloud, identity, network, systems and/or enterprise infrastructure operations.

·         Ability to build trust across engineering, security, business technology, vendors and geographically distributed teams.

·         Commitment to blameless learning, continuous improvement and inclusive people leadership.

·         Three or more years leading technical teams, major incident response, operational programs or cross-functional reliability initiatives.

·         Demonstrated experience operating mission-critical infrastructure or applications in a complex, globally distributed environment.

·         Strong working knowledge of incident, problem, change, service-level and knowledge-management practices.

·         Experience leading a follow-the-sun operating model or global shift handoff process is preferred.

 

Preferred Qualifications

·         Experience with AI-assisted operations, event correlation, anomaly detection or intelligent triage, with appropriate governance and human review.

·         Experience implementing or improving a service catalog, SLO framework, error-budget practices or reliability scorecard.

·         Experience with ITSM, observability, automation/orchestration and knowledge-management platforms.

·         ITIL, SRE, cloud, automation or related certification.

job.description:
Department Summary:

Drake University is a forward-thinking community of scholars with a focus on active, collaborative learning and applied scholarship. Drake is in Des Moines, Iowa—a vibrant city that is nationally recognized for its quality of life and a wealth of opportunities for professional, social and civic engagement.


A Drake education couples hands-on training in professional skills with a strong liberal arts education. We strive to create a community of scholars that represents the complexity of the human experience in regards to race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, economic status, gender identification, religion, age and physical abilities. We are committed to creating a welcoming and supportive environment for all our faculty, staff, students and visitors.


We develop and offer innovative programming serving a variety of audiences, including high school, undergraduate, and graduate students, as well as community members, industry professionals, and retirees. The successful applicant will join a collegial, welcoming, energetic and supportive community. Visit our website (drake.edu/sjmc) to learn more.


Job Summary:

The Drake School of Journalism and Mass Communication invites applications for a nine-month, consecutive term appointment of an assistant professor of sports media and communication, beginning in fall semester 2027. Drake’s School of Journalism and Mass Communication is accredited by ACEJMC and offers seven award-winning undergraduate majors: advertising, content strategy and publishing, digital media production, multimedia journalism, public relations, sports media and communication, and strategic political communication. The School also has a successful online Master of Arts in Communication with tracks in brand communication, communication leadership, and public policy and advocacy. The successful applicant will join a collegial, welcoming and supportive community of 14 full-time faculty and staff, and approximately 350 undergraduate and graduate students. We are looking for an innovative colleague who embraces cutting-edge technologies and who can help lead our School in preparing our students for the rapidly changing media landscape.

Professional experience working in sports media is required. Ideally the candidate will have experience in sports production and live broadcasts. Candidates may also bring front-of-camera experience to the role. A portfolio of work is expected. Evidence of teaching effectiveness is preferred. Master’s degree is preferred, but we are open to hiring an experienced professional with a bachelor’s degree for this consecutive-term appointment. Qualified candidates will have a demonstrated ability to train and mentor students and a history of early adoption of new technologies. The ability to work with colleagues across disciplines to lead students in conceiving, creating, delivering, and promoting rich multimedia content packages for all platforms, and for all types of media outlets, is essential. Depending on skills and interest, teaching assignments may include these undergraduate courses, both on campus and online: Sports Writing, Sports Production, Reporting and Writing Principles, Multimedia Lab, Multimedia Sound Design, Electronic Field Production, Reporting for Television and the Web, and special topics courses focused on interactive reality, data visualization, and emerging technologies. The qualified candidate may also teach online graduate classes in Digital Media Strategies, Emerging Media, and Multimedia Storytelling. Course load is seven courses (4/3) over the academic year. Duties also include academic and career mentoring for students, advising a student media organization or student sports production, and service to the University and community.


The search committee is particularly interested in candidates who, through their teaching, scholarship/creative activity, and service, will contribute to the diversity and excellence of the academic community.


Minimum Qualifications:

● An advanced degree (MA, MS) in Communication, Media, Journalism or a related field or equivalent professional experience, which SJMC defines as “at least three to five years of broad and deep experience in real-world situations relevant to the discipline in which the faculty member would be teaching.”

● Potential for successful teaching of undergraduate courses in sports media production

● Production experience directly related to sports media, media production, television production, news production or related fields

● Record of professional achievement related to sports media production

● Excellent written communication skills

● Expressed desire to provide equal opportunity for all students

Preferred Qualifications:

While not everyone may meet all preferred qualifications, the ideal candidate will bring many of the following:

● Experience teaching at the college or university level

● Successful experience in the following:

- working collaboratively with others (e.g., committee service, being part of

a production team, co-teaching);

- working independently (e.g., supervising a production, course

development)

● Experience in Live Sports Productions as any of the following:

- Producer

- Director

- Technical Director

- Replay Operator

- Audio Operator

- Camera Operator

- Graphics Operator

- Talent (Play-By-Play/Analyst)

● Experience in Sports Newsrooms/Departments as any of the following:

- Anchor

- Reporter (MMJ)

- Videographer

- Editor

- Producer

- Director

● Demonstrated successful experience teaching undergraduate media production courses

● Experience connecting and collaborating with media industry professionals on the local, regional, and/or national levels

● Effective interpersonal communication skills

● Effective oral communication skills

● Effective classroom management skills

● Expressed commitment to Drake University’s mission and values.

● Terminal degree in communication, media or related field (MFA, PhD)

‌

Special Instructions to Applicants:

Please complete the online application and attach (1) a letter of interest, (2) CV/Resume, (3) a statement about your experience in supporting the success of students from diverse backgrounds, and (4) the contact details for three references, including one for teaching (if a teaching position).

Please do not attach additional documents at this time. Supplemental documents may be requested or required of semi-finalists and finalists.


For full consideration, apply by November 9, 2026. The position will remain posted until filled.


Questions about this position can be directed to the search chair: Dr. Kelly Bruhn, dean of the School of Journalism and Mass Communication, kelly.bruhn@drake.edu

Questions about the application process, working at Drake, spouse/partner support, reasonable accommodations, benefits, or additional information about Drake or Des Moines, Iowa, may be directed to Drake Human Resources at jobs@drake.edu.

All job offers are contingent upon satisfactory completion of a background check, satisfactory reference checks, and proof of authorization to work in the United States.

Salary is competitive with peer schools and will be commensurate with qualifications and experience of the selected candidate.

At Drake, we are proud to offer our employees, their spouses, and eligible dependents a comprehensive benefits package, which includes a wide range of core benefits, perks, and discounts. If you are exploring a job with Drake University, we invite you to spend a little time with our digital benefits guide: Benefits Overview | Drake University.

One of our very popular policies provides a tuition waiver for Drake employees, their spouses, and eligible dependents. Drake also participates in not one, but two tuition exchange programs available to dependent children. You can learn about both the tuition waiver policy and tuition exchange programs here: Benefits Overview | Drake University.


For faculty positions, selection will depend on the receipt of recommendation confirming the candidate's scholarly achievements and teaching abilities and/or on the candidate's satisfactory passing of a teaching demonstration if selected for an on-campus interview. For staff positions, selection will depend upon careful review of each applicant’s references, education, and, if applicable, experience.

Drake University is recognized as a top private university in the Midwest. Drake is a midsize university in Des Moines, Iowa, with an increasingly diverse student body. We are deeply committed to equity and inclusion and creating a sense of belonging for all members of the campus community—faculty, staff, and students alike. More than 900 faculty and staff are part of the Bulldog pack, a close-knit group of colleagues enthusiastic about preparing students to be global citizens and leaders, challenging assumptions. job.title: Client Success Manager
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

Job Description

The New York Times' Advertising team is looking for a Client Success Manager to join the team. As a Client Success Manager, you will oversee customer success and retention for important advertising clients by providing the best, daily account management. You will help build the development of new and current client partnerships, including the RFP (Requests for Proposal) process. Use the full scope of NYT ad products that address the advertiser's needs and campaign goals for both print and digital. This is a hybrid role based in our New York headquarters, reporting to the Executive Director, Business Operations and Enablement. You can typically expect to be in the office 3 days per week.

About the Role

Client Success Manager is both an internal and client-facing role and is instrumental in making us the most effective media partner for our important clients. You will develop relationships with advertising agencies and clients; become their go-to person, keeping clients positively engaged with The New York Times and our products. You will work closely with Sales and Sales Operations teams on the assigned client accounts to ensure premium client partnership execution, by overseeing and leading the process of building and implementing client deals, receiving and managing client feedback, and tracking the changes with the sales and sales operations team.

Responsibilities:

Responsible for operationally supporting a key set of accounts through the full life-cycle of the business.Lead client contact and coordination with top-tier clients to ensure best-in-class, high-touch service.

  • Own and facilitate a smooth sales process from pre-sale through post-sale.

Assist the Sales Director with renewals through life-cycle management of campaigns for our key set of clients.Ensure the timely creation and delivery of our best work to clients by collaborating across interdisciplinary teams in the department.

  • Lead workflow of pre- and post-digital and print ad campaigns, interacting on behalf of sales with other departments such as Research, Ad Ops, Sales Development, Ad Products and the Content Studio to make sure projects stay on track, deadlines are met, and that people are communicating effectively.

Own client communications, create/own contact and status reports, and share feedback with the client and the internal teams.Lead non-pitch meetings to keep clients updated on performance, and address with speed any campaign issues in need of attention.Track & monitor the business of the account, including account financials, and account progress internally and with the client.Assist sales with pipeline accuracy of key accounts in Salesforce.Oversee pre-launch campaign execution by informing internal teams about client expectations, direction, and decisions.Participate in strategic and creative brainstorming sessions as needed and take an active interest in business development.Aid in optimizing workflows, best practices and processes where necessary, in partnership with the Executive Director, Sales Operations.Reports to the Executive Director, Sales Operations, and works closely with the Head of Industry and respective sales leads for the assigned set of clients.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree

  • 2+ years of digital/print advertising/media experience

Google docs, Powerpoint, Excel and Salesforce proficiency

  • Experience navigating multiple deadline and priority items at once

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Digital media experience or Digital product organization experience

  • Experience with team communication tools, such as Slack

This position is represented by the NewsGuild of NY.

REQ-020830

Benefits may include medical, dental and vision benefits, Flexible Spending Accounts (F.S.A.s), a company-matching 401(k) plan, employee stock purchase plan, paid vacation, paid sick days, paid parental leave, tuition reimbursement and professional development programs.

job.title: People Operations Generalist
job.description:
People & Operations Generalist

Who We Are

UnitedMasters is building a marketplace that connects artists, brands and fans - empowering artists to earn and grow. UnitedMasters has taken the bold step of building a music distribution service that, radically, puts artists first - disrupting the legacy music business by letting up-and-coming artists distribute their music directly to fans through streaming services while maintaining ownership of their master recording rights and up to 100% of royalties. Through the combination of UnitedMasters' music distribution platform and its deep ties to brands, UnitedMasters enables independent artists and change-makers to grow and earn unlike any other platform.

The UnitedMasters team is made up of musicians, marketers, engineers, and storytellers with backgrounds from YouTube, SoundCloud, Pandora, Facebook, Uber, Dropbox, Complex, VICE, and more. We work hand in hand with the award-winning creative teams that forge those innovative partnerships at Translation (our in-house creative advertising agency).

We’re looking for a People Operations Generalist to own daily employee support, HR systems, and employee lifecycle operations across UnitedMasters, Translation, and Shared Services. You’ll independently manage core People processes, support programs, and use AI and automation to improve how we work. The ideal candidate brings strong HR experience, sound judgment, and the initiative to navigate shifting priorities and take on broader responsibilities. 

This role is based in Brooklyn, NY, with four days in office and one remote.

job.title: Senior Marketing Manager- Burson
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

We are looking for an ambitious, commercially minded Senior Marketing Manager to help Burson drive visibility, relevance and connection to the clients and prospects we most want to work with.

Sitting at the heart of the UK Growth Team, this is a high-profile role working closely with the Chief Growth Officer and senior leaders across the business. You will help further Burson’s momentum in the UK having been named Cannes Lions Agency of the year 2026, turning our best thinking, expertise, people and client work into marketing that builds our reputation, creates demand and opens doors.

You will be responsible for growing Burson's reputation and visibility in the market, strengthening engagement with priority audiences and building marketing programmes that support our growth ambitions across all areas of our business.

We are looking for someone with ideas, energy and excellent judgement. Someone who understands what makes senior decision-makers pay attention, knows how to turn complex expertise into compelling stories and can mobilise a busy organisation behind a great idea.

What you'll do:

  • Develop and deliver a focused UK marketing strategy that builds brand awareness, distinctiveness and demand, aligned with business and growth priorities.
  • Strengthen Burson’s profile among priority clients, prospects, industry influencers, business leaders and future talent, positioning us as a modern strategic advisory partner.
  • Build a distinctive thought leadership and editorial programme, turning our expertise, insights, data and senior counsel into timely and compelling content across multiple channels.
  • Identify key moments across the business, media and cultural agenda where Burson can lead the conversation, mobilising experts and building the external profiles of senior leaders.
  • Create an engaging events and experiences programme, including briefings, roundtables, webinars and partnerships that deepen relationships with clients and prospects.
  • Showcase Burson’s best work through case studies, credentials, awards and external storytelling, increasing visibility and recognition for our people, expertise and client impact.
  • Build a modern, high-performing marketing engine, using AI, automation, media intelligence, data and measurement to make marketing faster, smarter and more effective.
  • Partner closely with UK leadership, Growth, practices, capabilities and the EMEA Marketing Team to maximise commercial impact, amplify regional and global programmes, and share the best of Burson UK across the wider network.

Experience that contributes to success:

We're looking for an ambitious marketer who combines the instincts of a marketer, editor and connector, and who likes making things happen.

You'll bring:

  • A strong track record in B2B or professional-services marketing, ideally within strategic communications, consulting, creative, technology or another expertise-led business.
  • Evidence that you have helped build a brand, audience or market position, rather than simply managed marketing activity.
  • Experience developing and delivering high-impact thought leadership, content and integrated marketing programmes.
  • Excellent editorial judgement. You know what makes an interesting point of view, what will engage an external audience and what won't.
  • Outstanding writing and storytelling skills, with an ability to turn complex ideas into clear, engaging narratives.
  • Commercial instinct and an understanding of the relationship between reputation, relationships, marketing and new business.
  • Confidence working with senior leaders, including the ability to advise, influence and challenge constructively.
  • A strong understanding of AI-enabled marketing, together with curiosity about how emerging technology can improve insight, creativity, personalisation, productivity and measurement.
  • Strong knowledge of the communications, marketing and wider business landscape, with a natural curiosity about what's happening in the world.
  • A proactive approach to building external relationships with industry influencers, partners, media stakeholders and senior decision-makers.
  • A bias for action. You spot opportunities, bring ideas and make them happen.
  • High standards and exceptional attention to detail, without allowing perfection to get in the way of momentum.
  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to bring people together across Growth, practices, capabilities, creative teams and regional marketing colleagues.

What success looks like

You will help create a Burson UK that feels impossible to ignore: sharper in the market, faster into important conversations and better at turning our expertise into reputation, relationships and growth.

Success will mean:

  • greater visibility and distinctiveness for Burson amongst priority audiences;
  • stronger engagement with the clients and prospects we most want to reach;
  • a recognisable and consistent flow of distinctive Burson attitude, thinking and expertise into the market;
  • greater visibility for our senior experts and our best client work;
  • marketing programmes, content and experiences that create meaningful conversations and support growth; and
  • a faster, smarter and more measurable marketing operation.

This is an opportunity to help shape not simply how Burson markets itself in the UK, but how the market sees Burson and what we are capable of.

The Senior Manager, Evidence & Insights provides strategic and scientific support across real-world evidence (RWE), health economics and outcomes research (HEOR), and evidence generation. This role co-leads client engagements end-to-end, helping to shape evidence strategies, oversee analytics and deliverables, and advise biopharma and related stakeholders.

  • Co-lead and support RWE and HEOR strategy across client programs, including evidence planning, study design, and interpretation of findings to inform value, access, and payer and health system decision-making. 
  • Design and support evidence generation plans (e.g., RWE studies, retrospective database studies, economic models) aligned to product lifecycle needs and client requirements. 
  • Develop and oversee the process for systematic literature reviews (SLRs), including the development of study protocols, execution of study searches, delegation of screening, and oversight of data extraction and reporting (leveraging the Nested Knowledge platform where possible).
  • Translate complex real-world datasets and outcomes evidence into clear, defensible insights and recommendations for clients (clinical, economic, and utilization outcomes). 
  • Serve as a client co-lead alongside Director and VP: build trusted relationships, guide strategic direction, and ensure work products meet scientific rigor, timelines, and client expectations. 
  • Directly manage staff planning, internal and external project timelines, internal and external communications, and budgets to ensure projects are adequately staffed, managed, and executed.
  • Stay current on evolving evidence standards and trends impacting access decisions, including: 
    • HTA requirements and value frameworks 
    • Payer evidence expectations and comparative effectiveness 
    • RWE guidance and regulatory considerations 
    • Measurement/reporting of quality, performance, and outcomes 
  • Co-lead scoping and resourcing for engagements: define scope of work, timelines, budgets, and staffing plans; proactively manage risks and changes. 
  • Partner cross-functionally to connect evidence strategy to broader client objectives and account growth. 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines. 

What you should have: 

  • 3-5+ years of relevant experience in HEOR, RWE, SLR, epidemiology, outcomes research, market access strategy, or closely related fields (consulting and/or biopharma experience preferred). 
  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree strongly preferred (MPH, PhD, PharmD, MD, MS, or equivalent) in health economics, epidemiology, public health, biostatistics, health services research, or related discipline. 
  • Demonstrated expertise in HEOR/RWE study design and execution and ability to translate evidence into access-relevant strategy. 
  • Strong project/program leadership experience, including managing teams on complex, multi-workstream engagements and ensuring scientific and editorial quality. 
  • Excellent writing, editing, and executive communication skills; ability to craft clear narratives from technical analyses. 
  • Strong analytical fluency and comfort engaging with complex datasets and statistical outputs (hands-on analytics not required but highly valued). 
  • Client-service orientation, sound judgment, high attention to detail, and ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Outlook). 

 Pay Range: $90,000-$110,000

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.  


Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!  

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return
  • General understanding of business principles and sales environment
  • Interest in developing knowledge of business operations and sales concepts and techniques
  • Individual accountability and understanding of when to seek guidance
  • Skills managing assigned projects to completion
  • Understanding to resolve problems using established guidelines and professional judgement
  • Ability to communicate information about iHeart products in a digestible manner and to apply active listening skills to validate understanding of customer needs
  • Understanding of impact of your own decisions
  • Goal orientation and the ability to focus and prioritize

Compensation:


Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and alignment with market data. In addition to salary, this position is also eligible for commissions.

job.description:
Company Overview

Cumulus Media is an audio-first media company delivering premium content to a quarter billion people every month — wherever and whenever they want it. Cumulus Media engages listeners with high-quality local programming through 377 owned-and-operated radio stations across 84 markets; delivers nationally-syndicated sports, news, talk, and entertainment programming from iconic brands including the NFL, the NCAA, the Masters, US Soccer, and AP News, across more than 7,800 affiliated stations through Westwood One, a leading national audio network; and inspires listeners through the Cumulus Podcast Network, an established and influential platform for original podcasts that are smart, entertaining, and thought-provoking. Cumulus Media provides advertisers with personal connections, local impact and national reach through broadcast and on-demand digital, mobile, social, and voice-activated platforms, as well as integrated digital marketing services, powerful influencers, full-service audio solutions, industry-leading research and insights, and live event experiences. For more information visit www.cumulusmedia.com.


Position Overview

The Account Executive successfully manages relationships with dozens of local and regional businesses, protects and grows the revenue base, identifies and creates new business opportunities with existing and new clients; provides marketing solutions to help customers achieve their business goals; strategically plans and implements initiatives to meet personal, company and corporate directives, recognizes that achieving budgeted revenue targets is the minimum expectation of performance. The right individual will invest in personal professional development, understanding technology, marketing and the full suite of company products and services.


Key Responsibilities & Qualifications

Key Responsibilities:

  • Able to create and identify client business needs by gaining a deep understanding of their goals, objectives and processes as well as their external environment including key market and consumer trends to proactively develop customized marketing solutions to meet client objectives
  • Deliver and Develop effective and informed marketing solutions via multi-platform, integrated sales presentations identifying Cumulus broadcast, digital, and event tactics to foster brand loyalty and deliver results for the client
  • Ability to negotiate and close business that drives revenue results and fosters long term client relationships, regardless of medium or platform
  • Commitment to having a proficient understanding of the Cumulus Media assets and resources and a desire to constantly learn and grow your product knowledge thus staying relevant and current with industry advertising opportunities for your clients
  • Represent the full suite of products and services as marketing solutions to new and existing clientele. This includes station digital assets, internet-based marketing, social media, streaming, events and specialized programming
  • Ability to appropriately manage time to optimize revenue opportunities, client interaction, implementation and fulfillment of successful sales agreements. Individual must be able to assist in the development of creative messaging, regardless of platform
  • Excel at prospecting and aggressively seeking new clientele by networking, cold calling, canvassing, referrals or other means to maintain a full pipeline of sales prospects at all times
  • Follow all station and corporate procedures for preparing orders, resolving billing issues, submitting regular reports regarding sales, pipeline lists, forecasts and competitive analysis
  • Collaborate, create, and capitalize on opportunities to best represent our brand while working to help your clients achieve success


Qualifications:

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite, social networking platforms and CRM tools
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Passion for developing new business relationships in an outside sales role
  • Enjoy presenting to clients of sales opportunities and post-sale successes
  • Strong understanding of lead generation and ability to connect with viable prospects
  • Comprehension of sales metrics in order to fill a sales funnel and maintain a constant pipeline of new business
  • Self-motivating and entrepreneurial spirit
  • Positive and friendly with a willingness to collaborate
  • High energy and passion for sales
  • Flexible, creative and curious
  • Digitally savvy
  • 2 years in Media Sales background preferred
  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing or related field is preferred

USD $3,000.00 - USD $5,000.00 /Mo.

The monthly pay range listed above reflects your guaranteed income during your first year, with additional opportunities to earn commissions

  • Focused, responsible and collaborative work environment with the ability to ask, “what if” and try innovative solutions
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance coverage
  • 401K with company match
  • Paid Vacation, Sick & Holiday time off
    Parental leave time off benefits, life insurance, disability insurance, wellness, and an employee referral bonus program

job.description:
Company Overview

CUMULUS | Modesto/Stockton, CA currently features 8 stations in the Modesto/Stockton area and surrounding counties.  Our stations include:  KATM-FM, KHKK-FM/KDJK-FM, KWIN-FM/KWNN-FM, KHOP-FM, KJOY-FM, and KESP-AM.  The cluster of 8 stations reaches thousands of listeners on a daily basis.     

 

Cumulus Media is an audio-first media company delivering premium content to a quarter billion people every month — wherever and whenever they want it. Cumulus Media engages listeners with high-quality local programming through 377 owned-and-operated radio stations across 84 markets; delivers nationally-syndicated sports, news, talk, and entertainment programming from iconic brands including the NFL, the NCAA, the Masters, US Soccer, and AP News, across more than 7,800 affiliated stations through Westwood One, a leading national audio network; and inspires listeners through the Cumulus Podcast Network, an established and influential platform for original podcasts that are smart, entertaining, and thought-provoking. Cumulus Media provides advertisers with personal connections, local impact and national reach through broadcast and on-demand digital, mobile, social, and voice-activated platforms, as well as integrated digital marketing services, powerful influencers, full-service audio solutions, industry-leading research and insights, and live event experiences. For more information visit www.cumulusmedia.com.


Position Overview

Cumulus Media | Modesto is looking for a Director of Sales with a proven track record of winning, successfully supporting their teams and creating a positive environment where everyone can succeed. Our Director of Sales are exceptional problem solvers, true collaborators, creative, efficient and lead their teams to exceed our local sales revenue goals utilizing our on-air, digital and experiential assets. Developing new business is key to our success so our sales leaders cultivate plans to assist our sales teams to strategically prospect, develop and maintain opportunities both locally and beyond our home markets.


The right Director of Sales candidate will be someone who lives by our FORCE Cumulus values; WE are Focused, Responsible, Collaborative and Empowered!  If you are looking for a great culture and professional environment, then Cumulus could be the home for you.


Key Responsibilities & Qualifications

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement a strategic sales plan that will exceed the market’s revenue goals. The emphasis will be on selling integrated solution campaigns consisting of but not limited to: Radio, Audio, Digital, Live Events, Sweet Deals, and NTR
  • Be a visible and available leader to your team and community
  • Identify, recruit, train, coach, manage and develop high-performance Sales talent and build a successful team to ensure continued top-line growth
  • Maintain an ongoing recruitment effort to ensure top quality team, always having a bench of 3 or more candidates
  • Attend all high-profile account presentations; provide coaching and leadership to sales team
  • Conduct weekly one-on-one meetings with Sales Team members to evaluate pending business for conversion and note in CRM accordingly
  • Maximize and monitor CRM to verify your team has a blueprint to succeed
  • Participate and lead Sales staff meetings and training sessions
  • Manage inventory and reporting in Stratus/Wide Orbit
  • Manage administrative functions connected with forecasting revenue, rate, pricing and order approvals
  • Actively participate in business & community associations with the intention of developing extensive relationships with local influencers and decision makers
  • Develop and build relationships with clients by providing quality customer service
  • Lead communication with other departments to assure quality service when placing orders and coordinating promotions
  • Oversee special event sales
  • Provide managerial assistance in local and national rate negotiations, sales plans and budgeting
  • Develop creative, solution oriented, customer-focused revenue programs and ancillary sales projects
  • Oversee and manage expenses of the Sales organization
  • Generate revenue from personal account list
  • Work in collaboration between all departments

 

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in broadcast or digital sales, sales management and mentoring experience preferred with a proven track record of success in the radio and/or digital industry required.
  • Bachelor's degree in business, communications, marketing or related field is preferred.
  • Valid driver's license required. Driving is an essential function of this position because regular travel is required to perform key job duties, including traveling to client meetings and attending business-related events.
  • Proficient in all aspects of radio and digital sales, including use of quantitative/qualitative research, event development, and multi-platform/integrated sales expertise.
  • Familiar with the management of CRM systems, budget procedures, daily sales accountability and recognition programs, inventory management and collections procedures.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite, social networking platforms.
  • Highly developed training and coaching skills including; skills in organization, delegating, interviewing and motivating sales people.
  • Demonstrate high energy level and achievement-oriented attitude toward sales, sales training and education, and client relations with exceptional negotiation skills.
  • Excellent presentation skills.
  • Flexible and creative.
  • Digitally savvy.
  • Ability to stay ahead of the curve in the constantly evolving advertising landscape.

Pay Range

USD $120,000.00 - USD $150,000.00 /Yr.
What We Offer

  • Competitive Pay
  • Focused, responsible and collaborative work environment with the ability to ask, “what if” and try innovative solutions
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance coverage
  • 401K with company match
  • Paid Vacation, Sick & Holiday time off
  • Parental leave time off benefits, life insurance, disability insurance, wellness, and an employee referral bonus program


For immediate consideration, please visit: https://jobs.cumulusmedia.com/careers

 

For more information about Cumulus Media, visit our website at: https://www.cumulusmedia.com/

job.title: GRAY MEDIA SALES TRAINING PROGRAM (SPRING '2027) - WBTV
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first and/or second highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WBTV:

WBTV is the top rated CBS affiliate in market 21 and a digital publisher that reaches tens of millions of users each year, and the home of Gray Digital Media Charlotte, a full service in-house digital agency. It is the oldest television station in the Carolinas. It is known as a trusted source for News, Weather and information.

The Charlotte market is one of the fastest-growing cities in the country. Charlotte is home to two professional teams, the NFL Carolina Panthers and the NBA Charlotte Hornets! Charlotte is a vibrant financial city, and many financial and other categories of industries are headquartered here. It is a great place to live and work and has much to offer!

The Sales Training Program:

Are you among the best and brightest at your college or university and wondering what's actually next? Life is short - so why wait for "real life" to start when you can put your knowledge to the test right now? We're looking for a high-energy, ambitious Sales & Marketing Intern who is ready to stop "contemplating" and start doing. This isn't a "get the coffee" kind of internship; it's an immersive, front-row seat to how a dominant local media organization wins in the digital-first world.

General Responsibilities: 

  • What if your internship didn’t feel like an internship?
  • What if you actually learned how to sell?
  • At Gray Media, our Sales Interns don’t sit on the sidelines.
  • They learn how to build a business from day one.
  • The internship will be for a term of 10 weeks
  • This is a hands-on, real-world experience designed to teach you the fundamentals of media sales and help you build skills you can use in any career.

     

    What You'll Do:
    • Learn the Hustle: Shadow our elite sales team to see how they craft winning strategies for local businesses.
    • Master Multi-platform Marketing: Dive into the world of digital advertising, social media strategy, streaming (OTT), and linear broadcast sales to see how we reach audiences everywhere they are.
    • Go Behind- the- Scenes: Get an all-access look at the inner workings of a major media station from the Newsroom to the Boardroom.
    • Create a Real Impact: Assist in developing marketing materials and sales pitches that help local businesses grow and thrive.
    • Build Your Network: Work alongside industry pros who are invested in your growth and ready to help you launch your career.

    What you’ll learn:

    • How to confidently start conversations with clients
    • How to sell multi-platform advertising solutions (TV + Digital)
    • How to build and present a winning pitch
    • How to manage a pipeline and grow revenue

     This internship is for you if:

       • You’re curious, competitive, and not afraid to try
       • You want real experience—not just something to put on a résumé
       • You’re interested in sales, marketing, or media
       • You’re ready to learn skills that translate to any industry 

  • What makes this different:

job.title: Sr. Mgr., Community Connections, WEWS
job.description:
WEWS, The E.W. Scripps Company ABC affiliate in Cleveland, Ohio, is looking for a dynamic Senior Manager, Community Connections to serve as the station's primary bridge to the communities we serve. In this pivotal role, you'll build the trusted relationships that keep WEWS at the heart of Northeast Ohio — turning community intelligence into real journalistic impact, forging meaningful partnerships, and ensuring our station remains an essential, credible voice in the lives of Clevelanders. From leading newsroom community engagement priorities to coordinating forums, town halls, and public-service initiatives, you'll champion connection at every level and make sure every audience member feels heard and valued.


Application Review: Applications received by 11/04 will receive priority consideration. Applications received after this date may continue to be reviewed as needed.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Build and maintain relationships with community stakeholders to understand emerging issues, priorities, and opportunities.
  • Gather, analyze, and communicate community insights to station leadership, newsroom teams, and partners to inform decision-making and coverage.
  • Partner with News to identify story opportunities, connect journalists with trusted sources, and support audience engagement across community channels.
  • Serve as the station's primary community liaison, developing trusted relationships with civic, nonprofit, business, educational, and government organizations.
  • Represent the station throughout the community and foster partnerships that create long-term value and impact.
  • Ensure responsive, professional communication with community members, partners, and stakeholders, ensuring audience inquiries are acknowledged, routed and resolved in a timely and professional manner.
  • Lead the planning and execution of forums, town halls, public-service initiatives, educational programs, and other community engagement activities.
  • Partner with News, Sales, Marketing, and station leadership to create meaningful opportunities that strengthen audience relationships and community impact.
  • Oversee event logistics, stakeholder coordination, and effectiveness measurement to ensure engagement activities are inclusive, relevant, and impactful.
  • Develop and execute a market-wide community engagement strategy aligned with station and regional priorities.
  • Advise station leadership on community needs, emerging issues, and opportunities to strengthen trust and local impact.
  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional community engagement efforts, while sharing best practices, tracking outcomes, and developing team capabilities.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in community engagement, journalism, nonprofit leadership, communications, public affairs, partnership development, government relations, or related fields
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Exceptional relationship-building and networking skills
  • Strong community listening skills and ability to recognize emerging issues and opportunities
  • Strategic thinking and judgment; ability to translate insight into action
  • Strong facilitation, public speaking, writing and presentation skills
  • Ability to influence across News, Sales, Marketing, Operations and community organizations
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • Empathy, cultural awareness, diplomacy, discretion and integrity
  • Ability to work independently and adapt to change
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM/community relationship platforms and collaboration tools
  • Strong customer-service mindset, conflict-resolution skills and sound judgment when responding to audience questions, concerns and sensitive community issues

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Cleveland is a city that surprises and rewards — a place where world-class culture, deep sports pride, and genuine community spirit come together on the shores of Lake Erie. The Rock & Roll Hall of Fame and Museum calls Cleveland home, as does Playhouse Square, the largest performing arts center in the United States outside of New York City. The Cleveland Museum of Art is internationally renowned and offers free general admission, while the Great Lakes Science Center and Cuyahoga Valley National Park — just a short drive south — give residents endless ways to explore, learn, and unwind.


Cleveland's neighborhoods are as vibrant and diverse as the people who live in them. Ohio City's West Side Market is a beloved institution brimming with local vendors, craft food, and community energy, while Tremont, Little Italy, and the Detroit-Shoreway corridor each bring their own distinct character, dining scenes, and arts communities. The city's food culture has blossomed into a genuine destination, with nationally recognized chefs and a range of restaurant experiences to suit every taste.


Sports are a way of life here — home of the Cleveland Guardians, Cleveland Browns, and Cleveland Cavaliers, the city rallies passionately around its teams season after season. With a cost of living that remains affordable relative to other major metros, a growing job market, and a downtown that continues to reinvent itself, Cleveland offers both roots and opportunity for those ready to be part of something meaningful.

#LI-SM2 #LI-Onsite

Annual Salary: $95,000.00 - $105,000

At Scripps, we are committed to a culture that reflects the audiences and communities we serve. We are intentional about creating an environment where employees, our audiences and other stakeholders feel valued and inspired to reach their full potential and create connections. To successfully deliver on this commitment, we must understand and reflect the values and perspectives those around us embody. That process begins by looking inward to build and celebrate a respectful workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging and connection. By continuing to cultivate an environment where all employees have a fair chance to succeed, are included, valued, and seen, we will strengthen the connections that drive positive business impact and align with our core purpose.

job.title: Executive Reporter, KERO
job.description:
KERO, The E.W. Scripps Company ABC station in Bakersfield, CA, is searching for an Executive Reporter to join our team. In this role, you'll be at the heart of our newsroom, driving a mission to elevate the way we connect with our community through compelling, authentic, and impactful stories. You'll inspire reporters, MMJs, and newsroom staff at every level, bringing your passion and expertise to foster a culture of continuous growth and creative excellence. If you're energized by mentoring talent and shaping the voice of a newsroom, we want to hear from you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Lead, develop, and enhance the storytelling skill and abilities of all reporters and MMJs in the station.
  • Collaborate with other newsroom leaders to consistently execute the content strategy through authentic, meaningful storytelling.
  • Oversee the writing of stories for all platforms; provide timely feedback to foster continuous improvement.
  • Develop and supervise effective workflow strategies and procedures for multiple news programs and outlets.
  • Ensure that all content adheres to journalistic standards and ethical guidelines.
  • Deliver a vision and create trust among reporters, photographers and newsroom staff.
  • May provide on-air, multi-platform coverage for breaking news as needed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred, or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 7+ years of experience in related field preferred
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Demonstrated expertise in storytelling
  • Knowledge and demonstration of editorial judgment, journalistic ethics and libel laws
  • Curiosity for the community, city, state and world we report on daily
  • Deep understanding of the content strategy
  • Ability to work a variety of shifts including nights, weekends, early morning, and holidays

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Bakersfield sits at the southern end of California's San Joaquin Valley, a city with a rich cultural identity and a surprisingly vibrant lifestyle. Known worldwide as the birthplace of the Bakersfield Sound — the country music movement that launched legends like Buck Owens and Merle Haggard — the city wears its roots proudly. The iconic Buck Owens' Crystal Palace keeps that musical spirit alive, while a growing arts scene, local breweries, and a diverse and delicious food culture give the city its own modern energy.


The great outdoors is practically at your doorstep. The Kern River draws whitewater rafting enthusiasts, anglers, and hikers year-round, while Lake Isabella offers boating and camping under wide-open skies. Sequoia National Park and Kings Canyon National Park — home to some of the tallest trees on Earth — are just a couple of hours away, making weekend adventures a genuine California experience.


Bakersfield offers a quality of life that's hard to beat for the price. With a significantly lower cost of living than Los Angeles (just about two hours south), you'll find spacious housing, short commutes, and a strong sense of community. From Friday night high school football to the Bakersfield Condors hockey games at Mechanics Bank Arena, this is a city where people show up for each other — and for the stories that deserve to be told.

Most importantly, this is a fun, collaborative newsroom in one of the most vibrant cities in the country. Austin moves fast, thinks creatively, and values authenticity — and so do we. job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

We're looking for a product manager who embeds directly with engineering, product, and business teams to build and ship AI products that directly serve our NBCUniversal businesses. You'll work side-by-side with Enterprise Business Solutions Product and Program teams to identify high-value problems, rapidly prototype and deploy production agentic solutions to drive business impact.  

As a Senior Product Manager in the Enterprise Business Solutions AI Product team, you will own the full lifecycle of agent products — from discovery through deployment and ongoing iteration. You'll build intelligent workflows that automate program operations, surface insights from complex data, and enable teams across NBCUniversal to work with agentic solutions.  

Your work will have a direct, measurable business impact on our employees’ experience and effectiveness in their work outputs. This role is a blend of technical, design, education, and product thinking. You will understand business needs deeply, identify where AI creates leverage, write code, and ship solutions that will drive real business impact. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Work directly with Enterprise Business Solutions program and product teams to identify highest-value use cases for agentic solutions, deployment, tool adoption, and infrastructure architecture 
  • Partner with client-facing teams to understand customer use cases, ensuring conversational agents meet the needs of both end users and stakeholders. 
  • Assist in the building of end-to-end agentic products and solutions (including multi-agent orchestration, tool use, and structured reasoning), from concept and design through implementation, ensuring scalability, adaptability, and alignment with business objectives. 
  • Co-develop agentic solutions with business teams — enabling them to customize, maintain, and operate agents after initial deployment. 
  • Translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped agentic product and solution requirements with clear success metrics. 
  • Leverage data insights to continuously optimize AI products and business outcomes — measuring adoption, output quality, user journeys, time-to-insight, and other KPIs. 
  • Own agent quality by implementing evaluation frameworks, monitoring production accuracy, and driving prompt iteration cycles based on eval results. 
  • Create and present documentation to business partners, execute product demos and walk-throughs, and deliver AI-driven analytics capabilities that enable real-time, data-informed decision-making across the enterprise. 
  • Bachelor’s degree in data analytics, computer science, or related field. 
  • 8+ years of experience in digital product development or a closely related field 
  • Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels. 
  • Proven expertise in developing and deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture (prompt engineering, tool use, agent orchestration), NLP, machine learning algorithms, and big data analytics. 
  • Analytical skills for identifying user patterns, insights, and performance metrics. 
  • Ability to gather and comprehend complex requirements and challenges across all business levels. 
  • Ability to convey complex technical issues to both technical and non-technical audiences, with ability to define requirements and iterate on solutions 
  • Hands-on experience with understanding and building products on large data sets and enterprise data architectures requiring systems integration, data governance, and security compliance. 
  • Hands-on experience with AI platforms, cloud services, and analytics tools (e.g., Python, Azure, AWS, Google Cloud) 
  • Expertise in SDLC process, scoping, iteration planning, user story writing, rollout management. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience building multi-agent systems or complex LLM orchestration pipelines 
  • Familiarity with evaluation frameworks for LLM outputs (accuracy, hallucination detection, quality scoring) 
  • Technical skills — ability to build end-to-end prototypes from data pipelines through user-facing interfaces 
  • Background in ERP systems, media, commerce, enablement, or enterprise operations domains 
  • Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar tool-use frameworks 
  • Experience embedded with business teams to build solutions (solutions engineering, field engineering, or similar) 

Additional Requirements:

· Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

CBS News Miami is looking for a dynamic Multi-Skilled Journalist to join our team. The MSJ will have a passion for original storytelling, bring story ideas to the table daily, and a desire to tell local stories that matter in fast-paced South Florida.
MSJ’s are responsible for enterprising content and executing a story from start to finish. The candidate will also have a strong on-camera presence and strong technical skills.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop and executive enterprise content on a daily basis
  • Cover breaking news when assigned
  • Shoot, write, and edit packages for daily newscasts
  • Work with news managers and producers to develop stories
  • Produce content for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X and other social media platforms
  • Perform other duties as assigned

 

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Proven ability to shoot and edit broadcast quality video for linear and digital platforms
  • Must have knowledge of Grass Valley Edius editing platform or similar platform
  • Must have knowledge of Broadcast ENG cameras, lighting, audio and LiveU
  • Flexibility to work evenings, overnights, weekends and holidays is required
  • Must be a team player who can multi-task and possess the ability to work well under pressure to meet deadlines
  • Must have a valid driver’s license and clean driving record
  • Journalism degree is preferred
  • A valid driver’s License is required

 

 

CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS EVENING NEWS, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. CBS News’ streaming services, across national and local, amassed more than 1.01 billion streams in 2021. Launched in November 2014 as CBSN, the CBS News Streaming Network is available on 30 digital platforms and apps, as well as CBSNews.com and Paramount+. The service is available live in 91 countries. job.title: Director
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

CBS News 24/7, the digital streaming operation from CBS News is looking for a San Francisco based freelance AR/VR ELC Director.

The ideal candidate is a great communicator, has current experience directing in active breaking news environments, has strong organizational skills and can break out of the mold of a coded newscast and pivot to breaking news when the moment happens. 

 

As an ELC director you’ll be working with show producers creating dynamic visual newscasts in a virtual space You’ll be verbally calling the shots as the anchor works the virtual studio environment with the jib camera following along as you trigger augmented reality objects to help enhance the storytelling. 

 

The Gear:

Zero Density Virtual Production 

Sony ELC Automation

Sony XVS Switchers

Chyron Prime / ISQ 

Calrec Audio

Studio Jibs

 

Job Function:

The main responsibility is to provide leadership in and out of the control room fulfilling production needs as assigned. You’ll works with the 24/7 editorial and production teams to execute an error-free production in an ELC automated control room environment. Director’s code their assigned newscast and run through portions of the show with crew and talent before going to air to help ensure a crisp production is delivered.  A successful candidate must have sound technical skills, collaborate before each show with producer and jib operator to ensure smart, effective use of virtual studio space and bring a “can-do” approach to problem solving in a fast-paced, high-energy environment. 

 

Candidate must be willing to work a flexible work schedule that may include early mornings and holidays. You must be open to implementing new technologies and/or methods to accomplish future assignments. 

  

Required:

  • Demonstrated experience in live news production is required.
  • Previous Control Room Automation use is desired, Sony ELC experience is preferred.
  • Knowledge of iNews preferred.
  • Ability to work in fast paced, high-pressure environment.
  • Must be a self-starter with excellent organizational skills.

Paramount+ streams some of the biggest live sports and events in the world, and our Live Services Product (LSP) oversees the backend platform that makes it possible. LSP provides operators with one experience through our Live Events CMS. The live services automations team supports this. They create specialized services to manage provider integrations. They also oversee orchestration, automation, and distribution. Each of these services is separate.

 

We're hiring a Technical Product Manager to expand the Live Services Automation area within LSP. This includes systems that automatically process incoming live signal inputs. You will set up and manage channel infrastructure. You will also make sure that each live show element is checked and ready before it goes on air. Finally, you will consistently distribute live content to our target destinations for the Paramount+ experience.

 

This is a deeply technical, backend-first role. The Live Events CMS owns the operator-facing surface, and you own the domain logic underneath it that extends its functionality through automation with 1st party/3rd part integrations. You'll partner closely with the CMS product owner to make sure the workflows you build surface cleanly through the CMS, and you'll report to the Live Services lead on platform strategy and vision.

 

Experience with live streaming, broadcast, or real-time systems is strongly preferred. We want someone who understands the ecosystem and its challenges. They should know what works and what might fail during a live event. This knowledge will help them build systems that work well and can recover automatically.
