  • Shape and ship the roadmap for the Live Services Platform. Focus on automation, workflows, and links between systems.

  • Build services that scale with every live event. Cover the full path from scheduling to playback and monitoring.

 

Drive Automation & Orchestration

 

  • Design automation that removes manual steps from live event setup.

  • Build "self-healing" workflows that boost reliability and cut extra   work.

  • Own the links between Summit and other systems. This covers scheduling, channels, listings, signal acquisition, and monitoring.

  • Keep data flowing smoothly across internal platforms and third-party services.

  • Partner with Live Operations and Engineering. Turn real-time needs into backend  solutions that scale.

  • Spot bottlenecks and design systems that run better at scale.

  • Write clear product docs with senior engineering and product leads. This covers API contracts, workflows, sequence diagrams, and system designs.

  • Give engineering teams clear direction on architecture, dependencies, and      integration patterns.

 

Agile Product Ownership

  • Manage the backlog, set priorities, and ship deeply technical platform features.

  • Align stakeholders across product, engineering, and operations on backend      platform strategy and delivery.

  • Support big live event launches with systems that never miss a beat!

  • Well-developed technical writing: API specs, sequence diagrams, system workflows.

  • Experience owning a backlog and leading technical delivery on an Agile team.

This is a seat for a closer who can walk into a business owner's office or an agency pitch, uncover what's really driving their marketing decisions, and build the multi-platform solution that wins the budget. 

You'll sell the full weight of TEGNA: the mass reach and trust of NBC broadcast television paired with the targeting and growth of streaming. On the linear side, you'll connect advertisers to the large, engaged local audiences that tune in to Cleveland's trusted news and programming. Premion’s curated marketplace includes 125+ OTT and CTV publishers, offering the same premium environments national buyers demand. Layered with digital video, display, and content solutions, it's a cross-screen story few competitors can match and in your hands, a clear advantage in every pitch. 

We give experienced sellers the portfolio, the autonomy, and the support to build something significant. Top performers grow their books, their earnings, and their careers. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Drive new business. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of local and regional advertisers, connect with key decision-makers and create opportunities across broadcast TV, Premion streaming/CTV and digital.

  • Pitch with data. Build compelling, insight-driven proposals that show advertisers exactly how broadcast reach and connected-TV targeting combine to deliver ROI. 
  • Run your business. Manage pipeline, forecast accurately, and keep deals moving in CRM and partner with account, creative, and product teams to deliver campaigns that perform and retain.

  • Fluency in turning data and analytics into a clear ROI story clients believe

Works with other Revenue Recognition team members and leadership team on various projects as assigned.

Passion for results

Customer/client orientation

Strong communication at all levels

Support multiple customers simultaneously

Teamwork and team leadership

job.title: Director, Product Development - Product Management
job.description:
About the Role

We are seeking a strategic and commercially minded Product Director to lead the evolution of our audience, media, and advertising platform capabilities. This leader will define and deliver product strategy across audience solutions, programmatic advertising, and the integration of owned media into a unified commercial experience.

The role will turn audience insights, media assets, and performance data into differentiated products that are easy to sell, plan, activate, measure, and optimize. It is an opportunity to shape a foundational growth platform at the intersection of product, data, advertising technology, and commercial transformation.

What You Will Own

Audience Strategy & Product Development

Define and execute the vision, product strategy, and roadmap for audience capabilities.

Build differentiated products using first-party, behavioral, contextual, geographic, and advertiser-permissioned data.

Create packaging, activation, pricing, measurement, and reporting frameworks.

Advance segmentation, enrichment, identity, insights, and responsible data use.

Owned Media Integration & Unified Workflows

Integrate owned media inventory and audience signals into planning, selling, delivery, and reporting workflows.

Define the target experience across planning, order management, inventory, campaign delivery, optimization, and measurement.

Connect advertising, commercial, data, and reporting capabilities through clear platform boundaries.

Simplify fragmented workflows and reduce manual handoffs.

Programmatic Monetization

Own the strategy for direct and automated media offerings across multiple buying models.

Improve yield and inventory utilization while protecting customer value and premium experiences.

Advance forecasting, pricing, packaging, decisioning, and campaign optimization.

Use performance data and market insights to prioritize investment and validate product-market fit.

Commercialization & Leadership

Build business cases, launch plans, adoption strategies, and success measures.

Lead across Sales, Client Success, Marketing, Data, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Privacy.

Guide roadmap, investment, dependency, and trade-off decisions with senior stakeholders.

Develop product talent and influence matrixed teams across the organization.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of product management experience in digital advertising, advertising technology, media platforms, data products, or related fields.

5+ years leading complex platform products, major integrations, or multi-team transformation initiatives.

Strong understanding of programmatic advertising, digital media monetization, audience products, campaign workflows, and advertising operations.

Experience translating customer and commercial problems into platform strategy, roadmaps, product requirements, and measurable outcomes.

Strong analytical and commercial judgment, executive communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.

Technical & Domain Expertise

Deep working knowledge of Google Ad Manager or a comparable enterprise ad server, including orders, line items, targeting, pacing, creative trafficking, and reporting integrations.

Experience with advertising order-to-cash ecosystems, including booking, pricing, fulfillment, billing, and revenue-recognition processes to connect with ad-serving and reporting platforms.

Understanding modern cloud data platforms and warehouses, such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or Databricks, including audience tables, identity graphs, data marts, and scalable reporting layers.

Expertise in audience and identity architecture, including first-party identity resolution, consumer graphs, segment taxonomies, known and anonymous audiences, and deterministic and probabilistic matching.

Experience defining API and integration patterns, including REST or GraphQL, event-driven contracts, system-of-record boundaries, and data synchronization across commercial, advertising, and reporting systems.

Strong understanding of media monetization and yield concepts, including CPM pricing, rate cards, floor strategies, margin structures, premium and remnant inventory, and cross-channel revenue attribution.

Knowledge of cross-channel audience activation from owned environments into social, video, and demand-side advertising platforms.

Knowledge of data-modeling and SQL, including dimensional models for campaign, impression, audience, and revenue data; sold-versus-delivered reconciliation; complex joins; window functions; and performance optimization on large datasets.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience launching audience-based solutions and enabling commercial teams to bring new capabilities to the market.

Experience integrating advertising, customer-management, order-management, reporting, or revenue platforms.

Familiarity with AI-assisted media planning, campaign optimization, and decision-support products.

Experience integrating customer relationship management and commercial workflow platforms, including campaign planning, quote-to-cash, and opportunity-to-order processes in a media sales environment. Experience with Salesforce or an equivalent platform is beneficial.

Experience with business intelligence and reporting platforms that surface campaign, audience, and revenue insights to commercial teams and customers. Familiarity with tools such as Looker, Tableau, or comparable reporting solutions is beneficial.

Understanding of creative fulfillment workflows, including how creative assets are requested, produced, approved, and routed into advertising delivery systems. Experience with commercial creative workflow platforms is beneficial.

Working knowledge of Python or a similar language for prototyping, data validation, analysis, and workflow automation.

MBA or equivalent experience leading product strategy and commercial transformation.

Variable incentive compensation, including commissions, is not reflected in these figures and based on the role, may be applicable. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, education level, location, and union representation, if applicable

job.title: VP, Video Sales & Strategy
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team

Dow Jones Media Sales connects leading brands with influential audiences through our trusted portfolio, including The Wall Street Journal, Barron’s, MarketWatch and Investor’s Business Daily. Our teams across Sales, Marketing, Creative and Client Success work together to deliver innovative advertising solutions and exceptional client experiences across digital, print, video, audio, events and custom content

 

About the Role

Dow Jones is seeking a commercially minded VP, Video Sales & Strategy to drive the growth and commercialization of its digital video advertising business. This role combines strategic thinking with commercial execution to refine go-to-market strategy, develop key relationships, and expand revenue opportunities.

 

The VP will directly report to an SVP of Advertising Sales in the Chief Revenue Officer’s organization and will work closely with the new video team under the Chief Growth Officer.

 

This is a senior role for a leader who understands both how digital video inventory is bought and sold across today’s increasingly complex media ecosystem. The ideal candidate brings deep experience working with advertisers, media agencies, publishers and platforms and understands how video investment decisions are made across premium publishers, streaming environments, social platforms, programmatic channels and other digital distribution platforms.


This individual should have deep knowledge of FAST, AVOD/SVOD, YouTube, as well as Advanced Television buying/planning/selling, and Programmatic Buying and Selling (DSP, SSP).

 

As Dow Jones plans significant investment into serialized shows, the VP will play a central role in shaping and executing the commercial strategy for Dow Jones’s existing and future digital video inventory, including how inventory is positioned, packaged, priced and brought to market. This person will work closely with sales leadership, product, programming, audience, advertising operations and finance teams to maximize the value of Dow Jones video inventory and create compelling, scalable solutions for advertisers and agencies.

 

A primary focus of the role will be leveraging strong relationships with the digital and video buying centers within major holding companies: diversifying revenue pipeline and integrating Dow Jones video solutions within proprietary buying models, technologies, and upfront/scatter ecosystems. Additionally, the VP will work alongside existing sales teams and client-direct relationships bringing deep video expertise to help grow existing relationships with video-specific revenue pipeline. 


You Will:

Video Sales Strategy & Commercial Development

  • Develop and execute the commercial and go-to-market strategy for digital video advertising.
  • Define positioning, packaging, and pricing strategy for video inventory to maximize value across platforms.
  • Identify growth opportunities across direct, agency, programmatic, and new demand channels.
  • Partner with internal teams (product, programming, operations, finance) to create and commercialize scalable video solutions leveraging Dow Jones brands.
  • Monitor marketplace dynamics, competitive offerings and advertiser demand to inform video sales strategy and commercial positioning.
  • Identify opportunities to grow existing video revenue and develop new sources of Demand.
  • Serve as an internal subject matter expert on the evolving digital video marketplace and the changing ways video is bought and sold.

Agency & Marketplace Development

  • Leverage existing and build relationships with key stakeholders within the digital and video buying centers at major media agencies and agency holding companies. 
  • Lead strategic conversations and business development efforts with senior agency and client stakeholders.
  • Represent the brand at industry events including Newfronts, Upfronts, Possible, Cannes.
  • Work directly with agency leaders and buyers to understand evolving marketplace needs and translate those insights into commercial opportunities.
  • Leverage and develop relationships across the broader digital video ecosystem, including advertisers, agencies, platforms and other key industry stakeholders. 

 

Sales Leadership & Team Development

  • Help build and lead a focused video sales capability targeting agency and client video buying centers.
  • Manage and develop a dedicated team as the organization and business opportunity evolve.
  • Coach sellers on navigating complex agency organizations and developing relationships with relevant planning, investment and buying stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with the broader Dow Jones sales organization to align coverage and maximize opportunities.

 

You Have:

  • 15+ years of experience in digital media, advertising sales, video advertising, or agency investment.
  • Significant experience buying, selling and/or commercializing digital video advertising inventory.
  • Strong understanding of how digital video is bought, sold, packaged, priced and measured across multiple platforms and distribution environments.
  • Experience working with premium publishers, digital video platforms, streaming businesses, media agencies or other major participants in the video advertising ecosystem.
  • Deep relationships with senior stakeholders at major media agencies and agency holding companies.
  • Strong experience leading and developing sales teams.
  • Excellent client relationship, negotiation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Willingness to travel as required.

The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post is one of the most influential newsrooms in the world, and our subscriber base is growing to match. This role sits at the center of that growth responsible for how enterprise clients and professional product subscribers experience The Post after they sign up. WP Intelligence is our professional intelligence product line, delivering curated reporting, data, and analysis for decision-makers across industries. As the Engagement Marketing Lead for Enterprise and WP Intelligence, you will own the subscriber journey from activation through renewal designing omnichannel programs that help organizations and professionals get lasting value from their subscriptions.

Reporting to the Director of Engagement and Retention, you will partner closely with Enterprise Sales and Account Management, WP Intelligence Editorial, Product, Engineering, Analytics, Finance, and Brand Marketing to build and execute strategies that drive measurable engagement and long-term retention.

Why This Role Matters

  • You support The Post’s mission to deliver world-class journalism while expanding reach and influence

  • You drive data-informed marketing strategies that improve activation, usage, and long-term retention

  • You thrive in collaborative environments that value initiative, clarity, and continuous improvement

  • You enjoy leading fast-paced, cross-platform programs that enhance subscriber experience and fuel business growth

How You'll Support the Mission

Lifecycle Strategy

  • Develop and execute full-funnel lifecycle programs that increase usage and deepen engagement across app, site, newsletters, and subscription benefits for enterprise and professional product subscribers.

  • Build subscriber journeys spanning lead progression, account activation, onboarding, education, loyalty, and renewal maintaining playbooks that support scalable, repeatable execution.

  • Design approaches that serve multiple audiences within a single account, including corporate and higher education end users, students, and key decision-makers.

  • Identify and promote product features, upsell, and cross-sell opportunities that drive long-term value and contract renewal.

  • Partner with Brand, Product, Engineering, and Editorial to align lifecycle initiatives with broader business goals and the group customer experience.

Performance and Experimentation

  • Monitor engagement trends, feature adoption, and lifecycle performance using dashboards and core KPIs.

  • Translate subscriber behavior into insights that guide strategy and experimentation.

  • Run A/B and multivariate tests to refine segmentation, messaging, channel sequencing, and timing.

  • Identify friction points in the subscriber experience and collaborate cross-functionally to improve activation, engagement, and renewal rates.

  • Partner with Analytics and Data Engineering to refine audience definitions, data inputs, and targeting models.

Execution and Operations

  • Design and manage integrated engagement campaigns across email, onsite surfaces, in-app messages, and push notifications.

  • Develop clear creative and technical briefs that guide asset production; lead QA and auditing to uphold accuracy across all touchpoints.

  • Document processes and improve operational workflows to support scalable delivery.

  • Use subscriber signals and feedback gathered in partnership with Enterprise Sales, Account Management, and Support — to inform proactive engagement strategies and feature improvements.

The Skills and Experience You Bring

  • 6-8 years of experience in digital, growth, EdTech, or subscription marketing with deep expertise in customer engagement, activation, or habit formation across diverse audiences.

  • Experience working with B2B customers and partnering with internal Sales teams.

  • Hands-on experience with Marketing Technology platforms like Iterable, and familiarity with customer data systems and e-commerce platforms.

  • Proficiency with analytics tools such as Tableau, Looker, and Google Analytics; strong ability to evaluate performance and translate testing outcomes into decisions.

  • Excellent communication and project management skills, with a track record of influencing cross-functional partners and driving clarity in complex environments.

 

Collaboration makes us stronger. That’s why our offices are designed with open layouts, modern technology, and easy access to transportation. With certain exceptions for newsgathering and business travel, we work on-site five days a week.

Compensation and Benefits

Wherever you are in your life or career, The Washington Post offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits for every step of your journey:

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage

  • Company-paid pension and 401(k) match

  • Three weeks of vacation and up to three weeks of paid sick leave

  • Nine paid holidays and two personal days

  • 20 weeks paid parental leave for any new parent

  • Robust mental health resources

  • Backup care and caregiver concierge services

  • Gender affirming services

  • Pet insurance

  • Free Post digital subscription

  • Leadership and career development programs

Benefits may vary based on the job, full-time or part-time schedule, location, and collectively bargained status.

The salary range for this position is:

$85,100 - $127,700 Annual

The actual salary within this range will depend on individual skills, experience, and qualifications as they relate to specific job requirements. This position may be eligible for a bonus or incentive program, and a member of the Talent Acquisition team will discuss bonus payment terms and conditions during the interview process.

Your story awaits. Apply today!

Learn more about The Post at careers.washingtonpost.com.

job.title: Manager, Corporate Development, Asia
job.description:
Established in 1997, Sony Music Entertainment is an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, Japan, with a presence in over 100 countries through our affiliates. We have nurtured some of music's most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Sony Music's Corporate Development team for Asia & the Middle East works across some of the highest-growth music markets in the world, and has been behind many of the region's most significant transactions. Our work spans M&A and minority investments in music and entertainment businesses, music IP catalogue acquisitions, and strategic joint ventures.

We're seeking a highly analytical Manager to join us, reporting to the VP, Corporate Development, Asia & Middle East. The ideal candidate brings a strong background in financial modeling, commercial analysis, and deal execution, with a genuine interest in music, entertainment, and media.

 

What you will do:

  • Financial Modeling: Build and own the financial models underpinning valuation and deal structuring.
  • Commercial Analysis: Conduct industry and competitor analysis to evaluate potential acquisition and investment targets, joint ventures, and strategic initiatives.

  • Exceptional analytical skills, with strong proficiency in financial modeling and a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working with large datasets, such as digital sales and streaming reports, to support deal analysis. Advanced Excel is essential; Python, SQL, or experience using AI/LLM tools to accelerate analysis is a plus.
  • Ability to craft compelling stories and presentations to convey complex information clearly and persuasively.
  • Fluency in English and Mandarin.

job.title: Performance Marketing Manager
job.description:
Sony Music Entertainment är ett av världens ledande musikbolag med drygt 5 000 medarbetare globalt. På Sony Music Sverige arbetar ca 80 medarbetare med att dagligen skapa, utveckla, marknadsföra och distribuera våra artisters musik ur vårt breda urval av svensk och internationell repertoar. Vår vision är att vara Sveriges bästa musikbolag och arbetsplats inom branschen, kända för vår innovation, kreativitet och framgång, präglat av mångfald och passion för musik.

Sammanfattning av rollen
Brinner du för performance marketing och mäter du framgång i konverteringar snarare än räckvidd? Sony Music Sweden söker en datadriven, handlingskraftig och analytisk Performance Marketing Manager med gedigen erfarenhet av avancerad, konverteringsdriven digital annonsering. Du planerar, sätter självständigt upp och optimerar ett stort antal kampanjer – med ett tydligt mål; att driva konvertering och skapa långsiktiga resultat.

Du blir en del av vår Commercial-avdelning, där vi inte bara driver kampanjer för våra artister, utan framför allt marknadsför våra spellistor och artisternas största hits genom tiderna, både i Sverige och internationellt. Vi arbetar i grunden som en e-handlare: våra kampanjer optimeras mot konvertering och faktiska resultat snarare än traditionella räckviddsmål. Hos oss får du arbeta operativt med avancerade, datadrivna kampanjer och våra egenutvecklade marknadsföringsverktyg.

Rollen är baserad i Stockholm.

Vad kommer du att göra?
Som Performance Marketing Manager kommer du bland annat att:

  • Självständigt planera, sätta upp och optimera ett stort antal parallella kampanjer (ca 10–30 per vecka), med ansvar för budget, leverans och resultat.
  • Driva konverteringsfokuserade kampanjer för spellistor, artister, katalog och e-handel – från målgrupp och budskap till konvertering.
  • Granska och analysera kampanjdata över flera plattformar och löpande optimera mot konvertering, CPA och ROAS.
  • Säkerställa korrekt tracking och mätning – pixlar, Conversions API, UTM-struktur och förstapartsdata – i nära samarbete med våra analytiker och utvecklare.
  • Arbeta systematiskt med A/B-testning och konverteringsoptimering av annonser, målgrupper och landningssidor.
  • Bidra med ett varumärkesbyggande perspektiv och förståelse för vad som gör våra spellistor attraktiva och relevanta, med målet att skapa långsiktigt engagemang hos lyssnarna.
  • Samarbeta med teamet för att utveckla nya idéer, arbetssätt och lösningar som förbättrar våra resultat.

Vem är du?

  • Du har gedigen erfarenhet av performance marketing med fokus på konverteringsdriven annonsering, avancerad tracking och komplexa kampanjupplägg, gärna inom e-handel eller liknande digitala verksamheter.
  • Mycket goda praktiska kunskaper i Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads och TikTok Ads Manager. Du är van att självständigt sätta upp, hantera och optimera kampanjer.
  • Goda kunskaper om tracking och mätning, exempelvis spårningspixlar, Conversions API/server-side tracking, attribution och förstapartsdata.
  • Erfarenhet av konverteringsoptimering (CRO) och systematisk A/B-testning.
  • Förståelse för SEO, sökbeteenden och hur digital annonsering kan bidra till organisk tillväxt.
  • Förmåga att analysera och visualisera data samt presentera insikter som leder till konkreta förbättringar.
  • God förmåga att skriva engagerande och säljande texter för digitala kampanjer på svenska och/eller engelska.
  • Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av att driva försäljning i en webbshop samt grundläggande kunskaper i Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Premiere Pro, After Effects).

Personliga egenskaper

  • Du är kommersiellt driven och motiveras av mätbara resultat.
  • Du är analytisk, nyfiken och tycker om att testa, utvärdera och optimera för att ständigt förbättra resultaten.
  • Du är kreativ och har känsla för målgrupper, budskap och vad som skapar engagemang.
  • Du är strukturerad, organiserad och trivs med att hantera många parallella kampanjer.
  • Du är självgående, tar egna initiativ och trivs med att arbeta operativt och hands-on.
  • Du är kommunikativ, prestigelös och samarbetar gärna med andra.
  • Du är flexibel och har lätt för att anpassa dig till nya förutsättningar.

Vad erbjuder vi?

  • Som en del av Sony Music får du chans att vidga dina vyer och naturligt växa in i ett globalt nätverk.
  • Möjligheten att arbeta med avancerade, datadrivna kampanjupplägg i en miljö där vi ständigt utvecklar nya verktyg och arbetssätt.
  • Här får din kreativitet flöda fritt; vi uppmuntrar nya idéer som kan revolutionera hur vi skapar banbrytande kampanjer.
  • Ett team och en arbetsmiljö som genomsyras av kreativitet, engagemang och internationellt samarbete.
  • En konkurrenskraftig lön med förmåner och möjligheter till professionell utveckling.

Ansökan
Är detta rollen för dig? Skicka in din ansökan senast den 13 november 2026. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Som en aktiv del i ett samhälle med kulturell och social mångfald är Sony Musics ambition att präglas av inkludering och bred representation, samt vara en arbetsplats med lika möjligheter för alla. Sony Music anställer, bibehåller, befordrar och i övrigt behandlar alla medarbetare och kandidater efter erfarenhet, kvalifikationer och kompetens, oavsett kön, religion, ursprung, ålder, sexuell läggning, könsidentitet eller funktionsvariationer.

job.title: Senior Manager, Identity Governance
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Job Summary

As a key member of UMG Global Tech’s Security & Identity organization, the Senior Manager, Identity Governance & Administration leads UMG’s Identity Governance and Administration capability and serves as the enterprise IAM deputy for governance, operating model, roadmap, and execution. This role is accountable for the security, effectiveness, scalability, and continuous improvement of UMG’s IGA processes and platforms, with primary responsibility for Saviynt and related identity-governance capabilities.


This is an identity-security leadership role, not simply an IT operations or account-administration role. The Senior Manager treats identity as a foundational security control and enterprise risk domain. They ensure that identity data, access decisions, entitlements, workflows, lifecycle events, and governance evidence are designed and operated in a way that reduces cyber risk, supports business outcomes, and enables sustainable global operations.


The Senior Manager directly leads the IGA/Saviynt team and mentors leaders and practitioners across UMG’s other identity product functions. The role reports directly to the VP, Security & Identity and works as a peer leader with the Sr. Security & Identity Architect. The Senior Manager owns IGA strategy, operating model, platform outcomes, and control execution, while partnering with the Architect to align IGA capabilities with UMG’s broader identity-security architecture, standards, and technology strategy.


Success requires a balanced business and technical leader who can challenge designs, diagnose complex issues, translate cyber risk into practical decisions, lead through influence, and build trusted relationships with security, technology, business, audit, compliance, HR, application, and regional stakeholders.


What Your Impact Will Be

·   Strengthen UMG’s identity-security foundations by improving the quality, ownership, governance, and reliability of identities, accounts, entitlements, access decisions, and lifecycle processes.

·   Establish and execute a multi-year IGA roadmap while stabilizing near-term control performance, including User Access Reviews, remediation, evidence, data quality, workflow reliability, and ownership accountability.

·   Reduce inappropriate, excessive, stale, orphaned, and otherwise unmanaged access through risk-based governance, automation, clear accountability, and measurable control outcomes.

·   Translate business requirements, cyber risk, audit findings, control objectives, and architectural direction into prioritized capabilities, sustainable operating processes, and measurable results.

·   Improve the experience of business reviewers, application owners, access approvers, and technology partners while maintaining the rigor required for identity security and auditability.

·   Build a high-performing IGA team and strengthen the broader identity organization through mentoring, shared standards, technical leadership, and effective cross-functional partnership.


Job Functions

·   Lead the strategy, operating model, roadmap, governance, and day-to-day execution of UMG’s Identity Governance and Administration program.

·   Serve as the enterprise IAM deputy to the VP, Security & Identity, helping align identity governance, identity engineering, access management, privileged access, authentication, and related identity product functions around common security outcomes and priorities.

·   Directly lead, coach, and develop the IGA/Saviynt team; establish priorities, clarify accountability, remove obstacles, and promote a collaborative, security-minded culture.

·   Partner with the Sr. Security & Identity Architect to evaluate identity-security designs, establish practical standards and patterns, prioritize roadmap investments, and translate architectural direction into sustainable IGA capabilities and operating processes.

·   Serve as the business and governance product owner for Saviynt and related IGA capabilities, working with internal engineering teams, implementation partners, and vendors to define requirements, manage roadmaps, and deliver measurable improvements.

·   Own the end-to-end lifecycle of Saviynt User Access Review campaigns, including scope, population and data validation, reviewer and owner assignment, launch, reminders, escalations, remediation, certification, evidence, and formal closure.

·   Establish and maintain the UAR campaign calendar and readiness process, confirming that application data, entitlements, owners, reviewers, communications, dependencies, and support processes are prepared before launch.

·   Lead the continuous improvement of joiner, mover, and leaver processes, including identity creation, change detection, access updates, termination, deprovisioning, exception handling, and evidence of timely execution.

·   Govern access-request, approval, provisioning, deprovisioning, and recertification processes across applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, and other enterprise services.

·   Establish effective governance for roles, entitlements, access packages, privileged access relationships, segregation-of-duties policies, high-risk access, service accounts, application accounts, and other non-human identities.

·   Define and improve data ownership models for authoritative identity sources, application accounts, entitlements, organizational attributes, manager relationships, and access metadata.

·   Improve the reliability of data synchronization and reconciliation relationships across HR, directories, identity platforms, applications, cloud services, service-management platforms, and other systems of record.

·   Monitor and improve data quality, connector health, reconciliation, workflow execution, notification, reporting, access-removal, and user-experience performance; identify root causes and coordinate sustainable resolution.

·   Translate policy, control, audit, risk, architecture, and business requirements into functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, test plans, implementation plans, operating procedures, and support models.

·   Manage the Saviynt enhancement, defect, integration, and technical-debt backlog; prioritize work using cyber risk, business impact, control effectiveness, operational resilience, user experience, and implementation complexity.

·   Establish appropriate governance for platform releases, configuration changes, workflow changes, integrations, access models, and other changes that may affect identity-security controls.

·   Define and report meaningful metrics, key performance indicators, and risk indicators, including campaign completion and timeliness, exception volume, remediation aging, access-removal effectiveness, data-quality trends, orphaned ownership, workflow and integration health, control performance, and vendor service levels.

·   Provide concise and actionable updates to governance forums and senior leadership on readiness, status, risks, issues, exceptions, remediation progress, decisions required, and the business impact of unresolved identity risks.

·   Partner with application owners, entitlement owners, business reviewers, IAM Engineering, Security Architecture, Security Operations, GRC, Audit, Compliance, HR, Service Management, regional IT teams, and external providers to drive accountability and results.

·   Support internal and external audits, control testing, regulatory inquiries, and risk assessments; respond to findings, develop remediation plans, and track corrective actions through closure.

·   Establish and maintain governance documentation, including standards, procedures, RACI models, data-ownership models, campaign playbooks, workflow documentation, communication templates, issue and decision logs, training materials, and audit evidence.

·   Lead stakeholder adoption and process change, using feedback and operational data to simplify processes without weakening identity-security controls.

·   Provide business and technical consulting on identity governance, helping stakeholders understand the cyber risk, control intent, technical tradeoffs, and practical path forward.

·   Mentor leaders and practitioners across the broader identity product organization, including through shared practices, design reviews, technical coaching, and career development.

·   Manage strategic vendors and service providers; establish expectations for deliverables, quality, service levels, issue resolution, roadmap alignment, and escalation.

·   Balance operational stability, control execution, platform modernization, project delivery, and strategic improvement in a global, fast-paced, and geographically distributed environment.

This role is based in Nashville and requires in-office attendance Tuesday through Thursday.


Job Requirements

Essential

·   Minimum of ten years of progressive experience in Identity and Access Management, Identity Governance and Administration, cybersecurity, technology risk, security architecture, consulting, or a closely related field; equivalent education and experience may be considered.

·   Minimum of five years leading enterprise IAM, IGA, security-governance, product, consulting, or technology-risk programs, including experience leading teams or complex cross-functional workstreams.

·   Demonstrated production experience with Saviynt, SailPoint, or other IGA platforms, including platform administration or configuration, User Access Reviews and access-certification campaigns, workflows, reporting, troubleshooting, integrations, and continuous improvement.

·   Strong practical knowledge of Saviynt or another enterprise IGA platform; experience with both Saviynt and SailPoint is preferred.

·   Deep understanding of identity-governance processes and controls, including joiner-mover-leaver, access requests and approvals, provisioning and deprovisioning, UAR and certifications, roles and entitlements, segregation of duties, least privilege, exception management, auditability, and control evidence.

·   Demonstrated understanding of identity data ownership, authoritative sources, synchronization and reconciliation relationships, data-quality management, and the dependencies between HR, directories, IGA platforms, applications, cloud services, and service-management platforms.

·   Experience governing human and non-human identities, including service accounts, application accounts, shared accounts, technical identities, and other machine-to-machine access.

·   Ability to understand and challenge technical designs, diagnose complex workflow or integration issues, assess tradeoffs, and distinguish sustainable control improvements from short-term operational workarounds.

·   Experience translating business needs, security risks, control requirements, audit findings, and architectural direction into practical roadmaps, functional requirements, operating processes, and measurable outcomes.

·   Demonstrated business and technical consulting experience, preferably across multiple industries, complex enterprises, or geographically distributed and matrixed organizations.

·   Experience partnering with security architects, engineers, application owners, HR, business leaders, audit, compliance, risk, and external vendors.

·   Strong program and product-management skills, with the ability to manage concurrent priorities, dependencies, roadmaps, releases, risks, issues, decisions, and stakeholder expectations.

·   Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical identity issues and cyber risk clearly to business stakeholders, technology teams, executives, auditors, and control owners.

·   Demonstrated leadership and ability to influence without authority, build trusted relationships, resolve conflict, drive accountability, and lead through organizational change.

·   Experience supporting audits, compliance activities, control testing, risk assessments, remediation plans, and evidence requirements within an IAM, IGA, cybersecurity, or technology-risk environment.

·   Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify patterns, evaluate data quality and control performance, determine root cause, and coordinate practical solutions.

·   Exceptional organization, attention to detail, documentation discipline, and follow-through, with the ability to work independently while maintaining a high level of accountability.

Desirable

·   Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, information systems, computer science, business, risk management, or a related field, or comparable education and experience.

·   Relevant Identity & Access Management business and/or technical certifications, publications, speaking experience.

·   Experience with adjacent identity and security technologies and data sources, including Workday or another HR system, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, ServiceNow, privileged access management, cloud platforms, enterprise directories, and application-integration services.

·   Working knowledge of identity and security protocols and integration patterns such as SAML, SCIM, OAuth, OpenID Connect, LDAP/LDAPS, APIs, and event-driven integrations.

·   Experience with reporting, analytics, and work-management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Monday, and ServiceNow.

·   Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CGEIT, ITIL, or a comparable IAM, security, risk, or governance credential.

·   Experience operating in a large, global, matrixed organization and leading governance-process change, user adoption, or enterprise transformation.

Perks Playlist:

Join an entrepreneurial, global organization where authenticity, boldness, creativity, connection, drive, and insight aren’t just values—they’re how we work every day. Here are some of the ways we support you along the way (and just a few of the benefits we offer):

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Including 100% coverage for out-patient in-network mental health services

  • Fertility coverage for eligible medical plan participants

  • Wellbeing reimbursements for fitness classes, spa treatments, meal services, travel, and so much more (up to $720/year)

  • Student Loan Repayment Assistance and Tuition Reimbursement

  • 401(k) with 100% immediate vesting on the first 5% of your contributions, plus an additional UMG contribution

A variety of ways to prioritize much-needed time away from work including:

  • Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) for exempt employees

  • 3-weeks PTO for non-exempt employees

  • 2-weeks paid Winter Break

  • 10 Company Holidays (including Juneteenth and Wellbeing Day)

  • Summer Fridays (between Memorial Day and Labor Day)

  • Generous paid parental leave for every type of parent

Check out our full overview of benefits on the Perks Playlist page of the career site.

Universal Music Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer

job.title: Executive Producer - Daily Show
job.description:
Executive Producer, New Daily Show

KNKX | Full-time onsite in Tacoma, Washington

Salary Range: $90,000 - $110,000 annually, depending on experience



About the Opportunity

Pacific Public Media/KNKX has a strong history of creating memorable, award-winning content. From long-form documentaries to reporting, the station has always valued creativity and digging deep into the topics that matter to Western Washington.


Now, KNKX is launching something new: a daily, one-hour news, interview and storytelling program that will serve listeners from Bellingham to Castlerock, and Seattle to Aberdeen. The show will cover the news of the day while saving space for arts, culture, and the stories that surprise and inspire.


We’re hiring for an Executive Producer onsite in Tacoma, WA. This is a rare opportunity to build a show from the ground up at a station that is investing and growing. In a media landscape where newsrooms are contracting, KNKX is creating something, and the right person gets to shape what it becomes.


Why This Role Stands Out

  • You get to create a show from scratch and define its voice, identity, and editorial direction.
  • You will build your own team: partner in hiring the Host, Co-Host, Producers, and Digital Producer who will bring the show to life.
  • Fill a real need: this show is part of KNKX's commitment to serving the community.



The Role

As Executive Producer, you will be the creative and operational leader behind this new program. Working in close partnership with the News Director, you will shape the daily editorial vision and sound of the show, lead a 6-person production team, and help set the standard for what local public media can be.

This is not a role where you step into an existing show with established workflows. The first months will be about building: developing the show's identity, hiring the team, integrating with the newsroom, and getting a new program on the air. Once the show launches, you will be responsible for the consistency, quality, and growth of the product across broadcast, podcast, digital, and social platforms.



Key Responsibilities

  • Help build the show from the ground up in partnership with KNKX senior leadership, including hiring the production team.
  • Shape the daily editorial direction and sound of the program, balancing news of the day with arts, culture, and storytelling.
  • Manage, develop, and lead a 5-person production team (Host, Co-Host, 2 Producers, Digital Producer) to deliver compelling daily content.
  • Pitch and produce engaging segments alongside the team, leading by example on deadline.
  • Work closely with the KNKX newsroom to share content, develop story leads, and coordinate regional coverage.
  • Champion a multi-platform approach, ensuring the show reaches audiences as a broadcast, podcast, in digital stories, on social media, and through a weekly newsletter.
  • Handle administrative responsibilities including scheduling, time management, and planning for coverage across the team.



What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

  • 5+ years of experience managing people and leading a collaborative production team. This is the top priority. You have inspired and guided different personalities, navigated tough conversations, and managed, supported, and held your team accountable.
  • 7+ years of deep experience with daily production and deadlines. You know what it takes to put out a show every day, whether that has been in radio, television, or podcasting.
  • On-air experience. With a 6-person team, coverage gaps happen. We need you to be comfortable stepping in front of the microphone when the situation calls for it.
  • A demonstrated understanding of public media values and sound. You do not have to come from public radio, but you need to get what makes it different.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred
  • This position is based in KNKX’s Tacoma, WA studios 5 days a week



Sets You Apart

  • Experience building or creating a show or program from scratch. If you have launched something new and it stuck, that puts you in the top tier for this role.
  • Connections to Western Washington's news, civic, cultural, and political landscape. Local knowledge is not required, but it strengthens your candidacy.
  • A flexible, audience-first mindset. You think about what listeners want and need.



About us

At KNKX we work hard to create a culture where employees feel valued and respected, are trusted and encouraged to be a part of improvements that impact their work, create value, and help build trust in public media. KNKX’s vision is to grow and become a more inclusive organization that brings joy, meaning and understanding into people’s lives. We value diverse perspectives and an array of life experiences.


KNKX is a Western Washington public media company, dedicated to bringing jazz, blues, regional news, and NPR programs to the Northwest and beyond. As an independent dual-format station, KNKX employees are energized in their mission to provide the very best music and news content to an audience of more than 400,000 weekly.



How to Apply

Apply here: https://knkx.bamboohr.com/careers/66?source=aWQ9NjE%3D

Submit your:

  • Resume
  • Link to a daily show or podcast you have produced that you are proud of

If selected to continue, we will ask for additional work samples (at least two produced shows/podcast samples and an on-air sample) before the panel interview stage.



Compensation and Benefits

Salary: $90,000 - $110,000 annually, depending on experience

KNKX offers a strong benefits package, including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage with FSA option
  • PTO and holidays, including the full week between Christmas and New Year's
  • 401(k) with generous company match
  • Disability, life, and AD&D insurance options
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)



Interview Process

  • Phone screening with the myHR Partner hiring team
  • Work sample collection (produced show/podcast samples and on-air sample)
  • Panel interview with the hiring committee
  • Final onsite interview


Our hiring management partner is myHR Partner. myHR Partner is not a staffing service or recruiter. All resumes/applications will be reviewed for this position and only for our organization.


Thank you for considering us as a potential employer!

Prior to hire, references and a background check including criminal record history will be conducted. Information from the background check will not necessarily preclude employment but will be considered in determining the applicant’s suitability and competence to perform in the position.

You are welcome to include the name and pronoun you would like to be referred to in your materials and we will honor it. Persons requiring accommodation in the application process, during the recruitment process, or who need this job announcement in an alternative format, may contact the Human Resources Office at knkxhr@myhrpartner.com.

job.title: Assistant White House Editor
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The Assistant White House Editor will play a central role in shaping the Washington Bureau report, supporting the White House editor and collaborating with other teams as news requires. This editor will manage reporters, help launch and edit news and enterprise stories focused on the President, and will help coordinate coverage across platforms. Operating in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment, this editor will help monitor ongoing developments on multiple fronts, and assist the White House editor in planning, making assignments, editing stories and thinking creatively about how to advance our report to serve our audiences.

The Assistant White House Editor also collaborates with other newsroom departments and stakeholders, monitoring daily and weekly priorities, helping to manage daily story planning and budgeting, getting reporters launched on stories and doing first or second-editing. This editor will manage the team when the White House editor is absent and shares responsibility for managing coverage of events on nights and weekends.

At a time when the news priorities can shift rapidly, this editor will sometimes be deployed to jump on other developments, work with other teams and support live coverage.

This editor should be able to move quickly across storylines without sacrificing accuracy and tone. Experience managing reporters or other editors is essential, as is a demonstrated ability to make thoughtful news judgements under pressure. Experience with White House coverage is a plus.

This position is based in Washington, D.C. and may include night and weekend coverage. It includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance.

You will report to the White House editor.

Responsibilities:

  • You will serve as a deputy first editor for the White House team, stepping in to support the White House editor. You will assign and cover first edits for breaking, live news and some enterprise stories, ensuring continuity of coverage and clear direction for reporters across beats.
  • You will handle edits of all sorts, including quick cuts, write-throughs, live stories, dailies and lead-alls as needed.
  • You will help set up weekend and off‑peak Washington coverage for these teams, including assigning, editing and coordinating with the News Director, editors managing live and breaking news stories as well as staff editors on key stories and providing additional support for stories that move or break at night, on weekends or holidays.
  • You will be nimble and flexible about being directed to other news developments and coverage teams as necessary and to work across platforms.
  • You will support live and alternative formats, helping decide when developments should go into live files versus traditional stories, and partnering with other news editors as needed.
  • You will be organized and work in close partnership with other editors on the bureau to build out the day's budget and update the week's budget, anticipating news needs and planning future coverage.
  • You will be skilled at anticipating potential problems, addressing unexpected issues and finding solutions.
  • You will help identify potential stories, including non-traditional story formats, visual stories, service and explanatory pieces.
  • You will coordinate with editors and the audience team on story publication and promotion plans and foster group headline brainstorming and promotion planning.
  • You will work in close partnership with the Weekend Editor on planning handoffs at the start and mid-points of the week so we have clarity and continuity in our storylines and with other editors on the team to help identify potential stories, assign and edit the daily report.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 10+ years' experience at a journalism or media company or other relevant organization
  • Editing skills that demonstrate mastery of journalistic style and standards, including ethical standards.
  • Proven news judgment.
  • Previous experience managing and editing reporters.
  • Previous experience juggling multiple storylines with rigor and judgment.
  • Experience with coverage of some combination of government, policy and politics.
  • Openness to and comfort with new story forms, live coverage and adopting new ways of working as the newsroom's needs evolve.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • People management experience
  • A willingness to be nimble and flexible in anticipating potential problems, addressing unexpected issues and finding solutions.
  • A strong understanding of Times style and standards
  • A willingness to collaborate and the ability to partner with colleagues across The New York Times newsroom.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive coverage across multiple topics.

Benefits may include medical, dental and vision benefits, Flexible Spending Accounts (F.S.A.s), a company-matching 401(k) plan, employee stock purchase plan, paid vacation, paid sick days, paid parental leave, tuition reimbursement and professional development programs.

Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

About the Role

Semafor is expanding across Asia to help decision-makers in the region and around the world make sense of the region’s rapidly shifting dynamics in trade, technology, finance, geopolitics and global power, in the primary theater where the new global economy is being built. 

We want to connect the dots across this complex landscape, delivering rigorous, independent business journalism to the world’s most discerning readers and are looking for a talented journalist with deep knowledge of China and the Asia-Pacific region to help lead an expansion effort across digital platforms and live journalism. 

A seasoned leader with a track record of managing teams, the successful candidate will bring a deep understanding of the economic and financial forces transforming Asia — with a focus on how China is reshaping the region and the world. 

We’re looking for someone with an entrepreneurial attitude, a deep sense of their audience, sure feet and a clear voice to produce useful, revelatory, and fair coverage in an enormous and complex part of the world. This person will be charged with chronicling the forces shaping Asia including trade, technology, capital flows, energy, CEOs, power, politics, and policy.

The successful candidate will be well-sourced and eager to get scoops and deliver big interviews, while bringing a sophisticated perspective in delivering thought-provoking and insightful stories. Reporting to the Global Managing Editor, the Asia Editor will be charged with building out our Asia-based reporting team and products, targeting sophisticated, engaged, and globally aware readers who live in — or have deep interest and connections to — the region.

The ideal candidate will be based in Singapore, but Semafor is open to applicants in other parts of the region. 

Your responsibilities

  • Work with Semafor’s leaders to shape our Asia vision and product.
  • Help recruit for and build Semafor’s Asia-based reporting team.
  • Lead the development of Semafor’s Asia briefings and products that best cater to our readers, viewers, and listeners.
  • Anchor Semafor’s coverage across Asia — across all platforms and live journalism.
  • Write must-read stories about the region, with a focus on business, economics, technology, and energy for a sophisticated audience who live in, or have interest and connections to Asia.
  • Participate in event moderation, as well as media appearances on TV, radio, and podcasts.
  • Collaborate closely with other parts of Semafor’s global newsroom and audience teams.

 

What makes you qualified

  • 10+ years of journalism experience, including relevant experience covering Asia
  • A track record of newsroom leadership.
  • Experience and interest in global financial and business journalism.
  • A strategic, sophisticated approach to identifying themes and focuses of coverage across sectors and borders.
  • Bring speedy insight to big news stories, and flair and personality to writing.
  • A passion for world events and issues and a broad interest in a wide range of subjects.
  • Broad media consumption habits across conventional and unconventional sources.
  • Eagerness to be part of a dynamic work environment demanding initiative, flexibility, and a willingness to jump in wherever needed to help the team succeed.
  • Experience working with diverse teams with teammates from many different backgrounds.
  • Diligence and reliability to work without hands-on supervision.
  • The ability to think constantly about story distribution and audiences, across many forms of media and platforms.

  • A strong network of European writer, commentator and expert contacts
  • Fluency in at least one modern European language 
  • An understanding of how Guardian journalism can be delivered across multiple formats including video, audio and social, with a track record of working with multimedia teams. 
  • An aptitude for generating sharp, original, timely ideas from geopolitics and policy to culture and lifestyle. 
  • A thorough knowledge of UK media law. 
  • Ideally you will have a demonstrable ability to bring a diverse perspective to the role. 

 

We actively encourage applications from groups traditionally underrepresented in the UK media.

 

We operate in a hybrid environment working at least three days a week from our offices in King’s Cross in London.

 

The salary band for this role starts at £50,695, with the final offer determined by the successful candidate's skills, experience, and responsibilities.  

 

How to apply

To apply, please upload your latest CV and a cover letter which outlines why you’d love to take on this role, and why you’re a great match for what we’re looking for. 

 

We appreciate the time taken to prepare each application we receive. We do not use AI-assisted technology to review applications; every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team. 

 

The closing date for applications is Sunday 8 November 2026.

 

All roles at the Guardian are open for everybody to apply. It is important to us that you feel supported and comfortable throughout your recruitment process, in order to perform your best. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to help your application, this includes providing documents in accessible formats or personalising the process to better support your needs.

 

Benefits at the Guardian

You'll have six weeks of annual leave per year (plus bank holidays) with the option to purchase an additional 5 days. Our pension scheme is generous; if you contribute 5% then we will contribute 8-12% (depending on your age). We believe in giving back, which is why employees are given 2 volunteering days annually and the option of payroll giving. Season ticket loans are also available.

 

You are entitled to life cover, private healthcare, income protection, and eye tests. You can also opt in to dental insurance.

 

We have enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental leave policies in place. We also support our employees by offering an IVF, menopause, baby loss, and trans equality policy.

 

Culture and wellbeing

We want everyone to feel like they belong at the Guardian and we champion diversity of thought. Our various employee forums provide a platform to use their voice to foster an inclusive workplace. We became the first major media organisation to achieve B Corp status.

 

We offer tools to help you prioritise your wellbeing including access to our employee benefits platform which provides tailored support for health and wellbeing. In addition, we also offer free yoga and pilates classes. These run alongside our corporate gym membership and cycle to work scheme.

 

Our canteen has views overlooking the Regents Canal and caters for breakfast, lunch and dinner.

 

Learning and development

We encourage personal and professional growth. Employees have access to a broad range of tools and solutions, and we are happy to support the pursuit of professional qualifications through vocational courses and apprenticeships.

    • Monday - Thursday: 8am - 4pm GMT

Join The Daily Beast as our Photo Editor for the London Bureau. The Daily Beast is a leading digital news site known for its fearless and incisive reporting. We cover breaking news, politics, pop culture, and more with a distinctive voice that engages a dedicated audience.

About the Role:

The Daily Beast’s London bureau is growing and we’re seeking a creative, witty, and enthusiastic photo editor to help curate the aesthetic of the site. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of American culture and politics, a background in both journalism and photo-editing/illustrating, have a keen eye for compelling and impactful visuals, and the ability to work quickly and under tight deadlines. The role is essential in ensuring that our visual content is as engaging and impactful as our reporting.

Key Responsibilities:

  • (Photo)Illustrate: Create inventive and witty illustrations – whether using photo collages or original drawing – that capture the story and engage prospective readers

  • Photo Research: Source, edit, and optimize images for daily stories and features across the site

  • Infographics: Design and produce infographics, charts, maps, and timelines that bring dynamism to stories and help readers understand complex topics

  • Rights Management: Obtain and ensure all images used on the site comply with copyright laws and licensing agreements, and secure permissions when necessary

  • Quality Control: Maintain visual consistency and high standards by ensuring all are properly credited, captioned, and formatted

  • Collaboration: Work closely with other members of the visuals department as well as editors, reporters, and the social media team to develop creative ways to tell stories

Qualifications:

  • Minimum 4 years experience in photo editing in a digital media environment

  • Expertise in Adobe Photoshop, with a proficiency in other Adobe Creative Cloud and supplemental photo-editing software

  • Strong visual literacy and an eye for detail, composition, and color

  • Ability to work under tight deadlines and to manage multiple projects simultaneously

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and ability to work collaboratively both in-office and remote

Why Join Us?

  • Be a part of a respected and influential news organization

  • Engage with a dedicated audience passionate about political news

  • Enjoy a collaborative and fast-paced work environment

Pay Range Salary

The pay range for this position is $50,000 USD to $60,000 USD, which is approximately £37,000 to £45,000.

We are recruiting one full-time Photo Editor, Sunday—Thursday, however, some flexibility may be required.

This is a permanent role in a contractor position. You must be based outside of the U.S. to apply. The role is work from home but may change as the Beast expands operations. job.title: PR Manager - Contract
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

Burson Malaysia is looking for a highly motivated and collaborative Account Manager to join our growing team. This is an exciting opportunity to work with local, regional, and global brands while building your career with a communications leader at the intersection of reputation, creativity, data, and technology. As an Account Manager, you will play a key role in providing strategic counsel to clients, leading integrated communications programmes, and managing account teams to deliver impactful work and measurable business and reputation outcomes. You will be responsible for day-to-day client leadership, strategic planning, project and budget management, quality delivery, and the development of junior colleagues. You will also contribute to organic growth and new business opportunities. We’re looking for someone who combines strong communications fundamentals with a growth mindset, sound judgement, and curiosity about emerging communications trends, data-driven insights, and AI-enabled communications.

What you'll do:

  • Develop and lead integrated communications strategies and programmes that help clients achieve their business, communications, and reputation objectives.
  • Provide strategic counsel to clients and proactively identify emerging issues, opportunities, and reputational risks.
  • Lead day-to-day client relationships, building trusted partnerships and ensuring consistently high-quality counsel and delivery.
  • Develop strategic and creative recommendations informed by audience, industry, cultural, competitive, and media insights.
  • Oversee the development of compelling content including media materials, reports, briefing documents, executive communications, social content, and thought leadership.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with media, influencers, content creators, and key stakeholders.
  • Support clients in crisis preparedness and issues management, as well as media and spokesperson preparation.
  • Monitor, analyse, and evaluate programme performance, translating data and insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Manage project and retainer budgets, scopes, timelines, and resources to ensure effective delivery and appropriate account servicing.
  • Manage, coach, and mentor junior colleagues, providing clear direction, constructive feedback, and opportunities for development.
  • Ensure work produced by account teams meets Burson’s quality standards, client requirements, and agreed deadlines.
  • Identify opportunities to expand existing client relationships and contribute to proposals, pitches, and new business development.
  • Embed AI-enabled tools into everyday workflows to enhance research, ideation, content development, insights generation, programme optimisation, and operational efficiency.
  • Apply critical thinking and professional judgement when using Generative AI, ensuring outputs are accurate, relevant, appropriate, and aligned with client and company requirements.
  • Stay curious about emerging technologies and identify opportunities to apply AI, data, and new communications tools to create greater value for clients and teams.

Experience that contributes to success:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing, Business, or a related discipline.
  • 5–6 years of experience in public relations, communications, or a related field, ideally within an agency or similarly fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with strong writing, editing, and presentation capabilities.
  • Proven experience developing and delivering integrated communications strategies and programmes.
  • Strong client relationship and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to provide strategic counsel.
  • Strong media relations capabilities and established relationships with relevant journalists and media.
  • Ability to interpret audience insights, media intelligence, industry trends, and campaign analytics to inform recommendations and evaluate success.
  • Strong understanding of clients’ businesses and industries, with the ability to connect communications strategies to broader business and reputation objectives.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple clients, projects, budgets, and competing priorities simultaneously.
  • Proven ability to manage, coach, and develop junior colleagues while maintaining high standards of work.
  • Experience contributing to organic client growth, proposals, and new business pitches.
  • Familiarity with Generative AI tools and an understanding of how AI can be applied across communications strategy, research, content creation, ideation, insights, and operational efficiency.
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and combine technology with human judgement, creativity, and communications expertise.
  • Results-driven and client-focused, with strong project management and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Collaborative and proactive team player who thrives in a fast-paced agency environment.

You belong at Burson:

Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.

At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson.
