This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

job.title: Accounting Manager
job.description:
Overview of the Firm 

FGS Global helps the world's most influential leaders move minds and markets. Working where business, government, and public opinion intersect, we advise CEOs, boards, and leadership teams at the most consequential moments.

We work as one team across geographies and disciplines - bringing together specialists with backgrounds in communications, finance, law, government, journalism, data science, and digital. Whatever the moment demands, we combine multidimensional perspectives to help leaders anticipate what's next, engage the stakeholders who matter, and drive meaningful outcomes.

Across 31 global offices, we draw on the full depth of the firm so clients can operate with clarity, act with confidence, and lead with trust. This collaborative approach has established FGS as a market leader: we are consistently ranked Band 1 for Crisis & Risk Management and Litigation Support by Chambers and Partners, and were ranked the #1 Global M&A PR firm by deal value and deal count for four consecutive years (Mergermarket, 2025).

 

The Role

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Accounting Manager to join our Asia finance team in Hong Kong. Reporting to the Head of Finance, Asia, and working closely with the Finance Operations Senior Manager, this role plays a key part in the accounting operations of the firm across the Hong Kong, Singapore, and China entities, with key responsibility for the month-end close, financial reporting, and tax compliance, as well as supporting the statutory and group audits. The role places a strong focus on income statement analysis to provide insight into revenue and cost performance.

The ideal candidate will be a qualified accountant who combines strong technical knowledge with a hands-on approach, takes accountability for their deliverables, and communicates clearly with senior internal and external stakeholders. They will be comfortable operating in a fast-paced professional services environment and contributing to continuous improvement in processes and controls. Experience with VAT/GST filing across Singapore and China jurisdictions will be highly regarded.

 

Responsibilities

  • Work closely with the Finance Operations Senior Manager on month-end close, audits, and process improvements, ensuring alignment across the Asia finance function.
  • Act as a key member to perform the month-end closing, including revenue recognition, accruals, and balance sheet reconciliations, ensuring accurate and compliant accounting treatment.
  • Perform detailed monthly income statement analysis, explaining revenue and cost movements against prior periods, budget and forecast, and identifying trends, anomalies and risks.
  • Ensure departmental costs are accurately recorded, coded, and allocated to the correct cost centres, reviewing cost reports and resolving variances with budget holders on a timely basis.
  • Review and deliver monthly, quarterly, and annual financial and management reports, providing analysis and commentary on key variances to the Head of Finance and regional leadership.
  • Support the statutory and group audit processes together with Finance Operations Senior Manager.
  • Manage tax filing obligations across Hong Kong, Singapore, and China, including GST/VAT compliance, corporate income tax, and withholding tax matters, and liaise with external tax advisers.
  • Partner with operational teams on cost budgeting and reforecasting to support business to drive cost control.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to drive cost optimisation, analysing spending trends and recommending practical cost-saving initiatives to the Head of Finance and business leaders.
  • Partner with global finance teams and external service providers on group reporting, intercompany, and consolidation matters.
  • Maintain and strengthen internal controls and accounting policies, and drive process and system improvements to enhance efficiency in the Asia finance function.
  • Support ad hoc finance projects as required.

 

Desired Skills & Qualities

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or a related discipline from a recognised university.
  • A recognised professional accounting qualification (e.g. HKICPA, ACCA, CPA) is required.
  • Over 10 years of relevant accounting experience, preferably in a professional services or multinational environment. Audit firm experience is an advantage.
  • Solid technical accounting knowledge, with experience applying US GAAP and/or IFRS/HKFRS.
  • Strong analytical skills with a proven track record in income statement analysis, able to translate financial results into clear, actionable insights for business leaders.
  • Proven experience supporting statutory audits and managing tax filings across multiple jurisdictions; familiarity with Singapore GST and China VAT filing will be highly considered.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel; experience with ERP or accounting systems such as NetSuite is strongly preferred.
  • Strong team player, with the ability to guide and support junior team members.
  • Hands-on, highly organised, and able to manage competing priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced and dynamic working environment.
  • Treasury experience is a plus but it is NOT a must.
  • Proactive, with excellent interpersonal and communication skills and the confidence to engage senior stakeholders, auditors, and advisers.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English and Cantonese is preferred; Mandarin proficiency is an advantage.

To be an industry leader and set the standard for equality and inclusivity for all races, genders, ages, ethnicities, abilities, sexual orientations and religions by creating and fostering principles that integrate our core values.

To be proactive in providing a welcoming, professional environment; free of harassment, discrimination and marginalization with on-going habits that incorporate our unique experiences into the overall success and continuous evolution of this organization.

Job Overview

The Account Manager is responsible for selling advertising to clients and developing new business relationships by prospecting, developing and selling new direct-business accounts, making sales presentations, performing collections, maintaining client relations and sales.

Meet and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets including spot, digital, and new direct business. Prospect new businesses on a weekly basis.

Prepare and complete sales presentations with decision makers.

Excellent written and oral English language communication skills.

Experience developing presentations for the purpose of direct-business selling and ability to effectively present and communicate.

Ability to respond to questions appropriately and think on feet.

Ability to read, hear and speak clearly and follow both oral and written direction.

Ability to think critically, analytically, creatively and logically; and to articulate information in clear, concise manner to others.

A conviction, violation pending adjudication, or adverse driving record more than 3 years old or does not meet the major violation definition per company policy will not, on its own, disqualify an applicant. The company will use background check information in a confidential, non-discriminatory manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Compensation and Benefits

When extending an offer, the company considers a variety of factors such as (but not limited to) the candidate's work experience, education/training & key skills as well as internal peer equity and other market and business considerations.

We offer a competitive starting base salary of $52,000 per year with a guaranteed salary period for a smooth transition to our commission-based model, where top performers can earn 1x to 6x their base salary, providing significant earning potential directly tied to your success and the volume of advertising you sell. Your total compensation will be determined based on your relevant experience, skills, and knowledge.

Hubbard Broadcasting has been committed to representing the communities we serve since our founding over 100 years ago. The same holds true today. job.title: Media Consultant - Orlando Radio
job.description:
Location: FL-Orlando-John Young

Job Title:  Media Consultant - Orlando Radio

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) is looking for Media Consultants (MCs) for outside sales roles focused on acquiring new clients and managing existing accounts. We’re seeking talented, enthusiastic, motivated, and goal-oriented individuals who are self-starters and excel in a fast-paced work environment.

 

As a Media Consultant, you will acquire new clients and strengthen relationships with existing ones to become a marketing solution provider that understands each customer’s unique business goals and helps them achieve those goals through your media assets. In this field-based role, you will regularly collaborate with a team of sales professionals and use industry-leading tools and resources to create integrated marketing solutions that help clients achieve their business objectives.

 

This role focuses on generating new and incremental radio and digital revenue. The main job is to prospect for new business, develop innovative cross-platform advertising solutions, run effective marketing campaigns, and build strong relationships and business partnerships within the community. The Media Consultant is also responsible for retaining and expanding their existing accounts through insight-driven proposals, performance metrics, and by maximizing all radio station and digital assets.

 

To succeed, you’ll need to be driven, resourceful, organized, customer-focused, and a problem-solver. You also must have effective communication skills and the ability to build both new and lasting client relationships. The ideal candidate should have strong presentation and time management skills, along with the ability to generate new business.

 

In return, we offer a unique career opportunity - one where you face a challenging mission, have access to world-class tools to help you succeed, and can realize your full potential as a sales professional. This position provides an opportunity to increase your income through a rewarding commission structure.

 

You’ll also join a team dedicated to making a positive impact on those we serve. CMG annually generates tens of millions of dollars in economic value for our communities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Identifies and assesses sales opportunities and applies resources and strategies appropriately
  • Solicits new business through prospecting and cold calling
  • Consistently manages target accounts within the pipeline
  • Generates revenue by developing new accounts and expanding existing ones
  • Prepares proposals to present to Sales leaders, along with existing and potential clients
  • Consults clients on all CMG solutions and offerings, demonstrating a deep understanding of product capabilities, measurement, attribution, and KPIs
  • Responsible for learning and selling fully integrated advertising solutions using our complete range of audio and digital products
  • Responsible for meeting and surpassing all sales targets as outlined by the General Sales Manager and/or Director of Sales
  • Performs a needs analysis and account review to identify the customer’s most important needs
  • Creates effective marketing strategies to satisfy each client’s needs and goals
  • Creates engaging and convincing presentations that generate new or additional business
  • Successfully negotiates advertising rates
  • Showcases product knowledge and its value to customers
  • Matches available station sponsorships with the needs of prospects and clients, then persuasively presents and sells those sponsorships
  • Collaborates with internal departments to oversee account stewardship throughout the process
  • Uses CRM (HubSpot) to track and manage daily activities, build a pipeline, ensure execution, and generate weekly projections and revenue reports
  • Upsells existing customers by sharing performance metrics, research insights, and proven results
  • Collaborates with account management to provide timely and accurate traffic instructions, conduct account maintenance, including make-goods, and collect on aging receivables
  • Attend sales meetings, training sessions, and remote client meetings

Minimum Qualifications

  • Two years of experience in new business development and prospecting within media sales or a related sales role
  • Demonstrated track record of increasing revenue through effective campaigns
  • Proven success in working with people (i.e., career, school, organizations, sports, etc.)
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, interpersonal skills, and business acumen
  • Ability to multitask and work in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment with tight deadlines
  • Excellent marketing, presentation, and closing abilities
  • Excellent attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Capable of successfully negotiating with customers to achieve a strong return on investment
  • Experience in prospecting for new clients, selling services to them, and maintaining and upselling to existing clients
  • Proﬁcient in Microsoft Oﬃce, PowerPoint, and CRM tools like HubSpot
  • Valid driver's license with a clean driving record

Preferred Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree
  • Three years of experience in media sales, account management, or media buying
  • Proven track record of success in digital and radio sales within a local media environment

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com

job.description:
Company Overview

Cumulus Media is an audio-first media company delivering premium content to a quarter billion people every month — wherever and whenever they want it. Cumulus Media engages listeners with high-quality local programming through 377 owned-and-operated radio stations across 84 markets; delivers nationally-syndicated sports, news, talk, and entertainment programming from iconic brands including the NFL, the NCAA, the Masters, US Soccer, and AP News, across more than 7,800 affiliated stations through Westwood One, a leading national audio network; and inspires listeners through the Cumulus Podcast Network, an established and influential platform for original podcasts that are smart, entertaining, and thought-provoking. The Account Executive successfully manages relationships with dozens of local and regional businesses, protects and grows the revenue base, identifies and creates new business opportunities with existing and new clients; provides marketing solutions to help customers achieve their business goals; strategically plans and implements initiatives to meet personal, company and corporate directives, recognizes that achieving budgeted revenue targets is the minimum expectation of performance.   • Ability to negotiate and close business that drives revenue results and fosters long term client relationships, regardless of medium or platform
  • Commitment to having a proficient understanding of the Cumulus Media assets and resources and a desire to constantly learn and grow your product knowledge thus staying relevant and current with industry advertising opportunities for your clients
  • Represent the full suite of products and services as marketing solutions to new and existing clientele. This includes station digital assets, internet-based marketing, social media, streaming, events and specialized programming
  • Ability to appropriately manage time to optimize revenue opportunities, client interaction, implementation and fulfillment of successful sales agreements. Individual must be able to assist in the development of creative messaging, regardless of platform
  • Excel at prospecting and aggressively seeking new clientele by networking, cold calling, canvassing, referrals or other means to maintain a full pipeline of sales prospects at all times
  • Follow all station and corporate procedures for preparing orders, resolving billing issues, submitting regular reports regarding sales, pipeline lists, forecasts and competitive analysis
  • Collaborate, create, and capitalize on opportunities to best represent our brand while working to help your clients achieve success


Qualifications:

years of sales experience required; with background in broadcast, media or digital advertising sales highly preferred.

  • Valid driver's license required. Driving is an essential function of this position because regular travel is required to perform key job duties, including meeting with clients & prospects, as well as attending business-related events.

  • Passion for developing new business relationships in an outside sales role, including preparing and presenting sales opportunities and post-sale successes to clients/potential clients.

job.title: Associate, Transmission (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
The NFL Media group is looking for a TOC Operator who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and demonstrates strong technical, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills while supporting live broadcast and transmission operations. The TOC Operator performs a broad range of technical and operational duties, including monitoring systems, coordinating broadcast workflows, and ensuring all technical facility requests are resolved in a timely and effective manner. The ideal candidate has extensive knowledge in operation of broadcast routing systems, including split routes and familiarity with other broadcast transmission systems. This role requires a strong understanding of analog, digital, and SMPTE 2110 signal flows, as well as the ability to troubleshoot technical issues in a fast-paced broadcast environment. As the first point of escalation for broadcast and transmission issues, the TOC Operator is responsible for communicating with Operations and Production Management in a timely and effective manner.  

Responsibilities

  • Work closely with the NFL Media Production team, Streaming Video Group, NFL Films Technical Operations, Encompass Atlanta Technical Operation, and all 32 NFL Clubs to ensure all video content is received and distributed to broadcast specifications. 
  • Partner with the Remote Operations team to support the transmission and receipts of feeds for live remote productions, including NFL Network games, the Super Bowl, NFL Combine, NFL Draft, Hall of Fame Enshrinement, and other NFL Network remote projects.  
  • Collaborate with the Streaming Video Group (SVG) to ensure content is captioned across NFL.com, NFL Fast Channel, NFL+ streaming platforms.  
  • Partner closely with the Engineering team to troubleshoot all issues that may occur with a feed or broadcast.  
  • Communicate with NFL Network Master Control during live broadcasts to ensure signal continuity. 
  • Perform test bar setups as needed 
  • Conduct extensive transmission, sync, and fax checks prior to live shows and remote events.  
  • Manage booking and goodnight procedures for The Switch, Lumen, AT&T Fiber, and Satellite orders. 
  • Responsible for the generation of broadcast reports as required. 

 Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in a broadcast operations environment, including 2110, HD/SD, ASI, JPEG and MPLS signals, with the ability to troubleshoot those signal paths. 
  • Strong understanding of analog, digital, and SMPTE 2110 signal flows. 
  • Ability to read audio meters, digital and analog waveform monitors, and set up test bars. 
  • Strong understanding of common broadcast signal problems and how to rectify them (ex. audio levels or distortion, sync issues, and video issues).  
  • Ability to perform sync and fax checks prior to live broadcasts and events.  
  • Familiarity with EVS IP Director ingest server systems.  
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple feeds to ensure high broadcast quality.  
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including ability to document on-air issues and have maintain excellent telephone etiquette.  
  • Must be willing to work flexible schedules, including nights, weekends and holidays.  

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Possess a strong work ethic, positive attitude and leadership qualities.   
  • Demonstrated ability to adapt and thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment. 
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills 
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities at the same time.  
  • Excellent teamwork and collaboration skills.  

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Minimum 40 hours/week or less as business needs permit 
  • This is an in-office position.  
  • Must be willing to work a flexible schedule including nights, weekends and holidays. 
  • This job posting is for a position with one of the NFL’s third-party agency partners that provides services to the NFL. The individual selected for this role will be an employee of that third-party agency and not the NFL. All compensation, benefits, and other terms and conditions of employment are handled by the agency. The assignment to provide services to the NFL will be limited in duration but may be extended for an additional period by agreement between the NFL and the agency. 

Salary / Pay Range

This job posting contains a pay range, which represents the range of salaries or hourly rates that the NFL believes, in good faith, at the time of this posting that it might be willing to pay for the posted job in the location(s) specified. The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. Only in truly rare and exceptional circumstances, where an external candidate has experience, credentials or expertise that far exceed those required or expected for the position, would the NFL consider paying a salary or rate near the higher end of the range.

Benefits Information
To learn more about our comprehensive benefits offerings, please visit: NFL BENEFITS

At the NFL, in-person work at our offices is a top priority because it allows us to collaborate more effectively, build stronger connections, and maintain the culture that drives our success. This role requires onsite presence at an NFL office or stadium location, and remote and/or hybrid working options are not offered. 

NO RELOCATION ASSISTANCE WILL BE PROVIDED.

The NFL is committed to building an inclusive work environment that reflects our incredible fan base. We provide an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all employees and applicants without regard to status as protected by applicable federal, state, and local laws.

  • Inspire: We motivate others through vision, energy, and a commitment to excellence.

  • Know the Business: We stay informed, understand our industry, and make decisions that strengthen our position.
  • Think Big: We challenge the status quo, envision bold possibilities, and strive for transformative impact

WHO YOU ARE:

Talent Attributes:   What we expect for our employees:

  • Embody an enthusiastic, proactive can-do attitude 
  • Embrace grit, free from ego or entitlement
  • Excel as a relationship builder, with the ability to influence
  • Eager learner, driven by passion rather than just ambition
  • Encompasses an incredible work ethic with an agile mindset

job.title: Sr Mgr, Community Connections, KRIS
job.description:
KRIS, The Scripps station in Corpus Christi, Texas is seeking a Sr Mgr of Community Connections. This individual will serve as the station's primary connector to the community, building trusted relationships that strengthen local engagement, inform journalism, and create meaningful partnerships. Through community intelligence, strategic relationships, and meaningful engagement, this role helps ensure the station remains an essential and trusted part of community life. Lead day-to-day newsroom community engagement priorities, and ensures the station responds quickly and thoughtfully to audience questions, story tips, community concerns, and public-facing engagement opportunities.

Application Review: Applications received by Nov 3 will receive priority consideration. Applications received after this date may continue to be reviewed as needed.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Build and maintain relationships with community stakeholders to understand emerging issues, priorities, and opportunities.
  • Gather, analyze, and communicate community insights to station leadership, newsroom teams, and partners to inform decision-making and coverage.
  • Partner with News to identify story opportunities, connect journalists with trusted sources, and support audience engagement across community channels.
  • Serve as the station's primary community liaison, developing trusted relationships with civic, nonprofit, business, educational, and government organizations.
  • Represent the station throughout the community and foster partnerships that create long-term value and impact.
  • Ensure responsive, professional communication with community members, partners, and stakeholders, ensuring audience inquiries are acknowledged, routed and resolved in a timely and professional manner.
  • Lead the planning and execution of forums, town halls, public-service initiatives, educational programs, and other community engagement activities.
  • Partner with News, Sales, Marketing, and station leadership to create meaningful opportunities that strengthen audience relationships and community impact.
  • Oversee event logistics, stakeholder coordination, and effectiveness measurement to ensure engagement activities are inclusive, relevant, and impactful.
  • Develop and execute a market-wide community engagement strategy aligned with station and regional priorities.
  • Advise station leadership on community needs, emerging issues, and opportunities to strengthen trust and local impact.
  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional community engagement efforts, while sharing best practices, tracking outcomes, and developing team capabilities.

 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in community engagement, journalism, nonprofit leadership, communications, public affairs, partnership development, government relations, or related fields.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Exceptional relationship-building and networking skills
  • Strong community listening skills and ability to recognize emerging issues and opportunities
  • Strategic thinking and judgment; ability to translate insight into action
  • Strong facilitation, public speaking, writing and presentation skills
  • Ability to influence across News, Sales, Marketing, Operations and community organizations
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • Empathy, cultural awareness, diplomacy, discretion and integrity
  • Ability to work independently and adapt to change
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM/community relationship platforms and collaboration tools
  • Strong customer-service mindset, conflict-resolution skills and sound judgment when responding to audience questions, concerns and sensitive community issues
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company's required insurance limits.

job.title: Community Connections Coordinator, WEWS
job.description:
WEWS, The E.W. Scripps Company ABC affiliate in Cleveland, Ohio, is searching for a Community Connections Coordinator. We're looking for a driven, people-first professional to join our team and serve as the vital link between our newsroom and the communities we cover. In this role, you'll cultivate meaningful relationships, surface credible story leads, coordinate community events and listening sessions, and help our journalists connect with the trusted local voices that make our coverage matter. Whether you're in the field building source networks, managing audience tips, or supporting breaking news coverage, your work will directly shape how WEWS serves the people of Greater Cleveland every day.


Application Review: Applications received by 11/04 will receive priority consideration. Applications received after this date may continue to be reviewed as needed.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Build and maintain relationships with community organizations, residents, leaders, and trusted sources to gather community insights and identify emerging issues, events, and story opportunities.
  • Monitor, track, and route audience tips, questions, and leads from community channels, ensuring timely communication and escalation to newsroom teams.
  • Support newsroom listening efforts, community conversations, and source development by connecting journalists with credible and diverse community voices.
  • Assist with breaking and developing news coverage by gathering community context, maintaining source networks, and providing timely intelligence to newsroom staff.
  • Serve as a responsive point of contact for community organizations and residents, fostering positive relationships and trust.
  • Coordinate outreach, maintain partner and contact records, and represent the station at community meetings, events, and activities.
  • Support newsroom talent by coordinating interviews, identifying community contacts, gathering background information, and facilitating community appearances.
  • Coordinate logistics and execution for community conversations, listening sessions, public programs, newsroom events, special coverage initiatives, and station appearances.
  • Manage event-related activities including outreach, scheduling, partner coordination, participant communications, on-site support, and post-event follow-up.
  • Support audience engagement across digital and in-person channels, including live discussions, community groups, neighborhood platforms, and other audience interaction opportunities.
  • Maintain community calendars, project plans, contact databases, and engagement records to support execution of the market community strategy.
  • Track community insights, engagement outcomes, story leads, and best practices, preparing summaries and reports that help inform newsroom and community engagement priorities.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Associates degree in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in journalism, communications, community engagement, nonprofit work, events, public relations or related fields
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Strong listening, relationship-building and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to establish rapport with diverse community members and organizations
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent organization, follow-through and attention to detail
  • Ability to identify and communicate relevant community information quickly and accurately
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with journalists and station teams
  • Comfort working independently in the community and adapting to newsroom needs
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM/contact systems, social platforms and collaboration tools
  • Solid news judgment, comfort with newsroom urgency, ability to verify and relay information quickly, and understanding of how community tips can develop into stories
  • Ability to communicate clearly and accurately across digital platforms, maintain professionalism in public-facing conversations and collaborate closely with reporters, producers, anchors, meteorologists and newsroom leaders

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Cleveland is a city of neighborhoods, grit, and genuine heart — and it's having a moment. Situated on the southern shore of Lake Erie, Cleveland combines a rich cultural heritage with a revitalized downtown and a food and arts scene that consistently surprises newcomers. The Rock & Roll Hall of Fame, the world-class Cleveland Museum of Art (with free general admission), and Playhouse Square — the largest performing arts center in the U.S. outside of New York City — give the city a cultural depth that is hard to match. Walkable neighborhoods like Ohio City, Tremont, and Little Italy each bring their own distinctive character, cuisine, and community.


Sports are woven into the fabric of Cleveland life. Cheer on the Cleveland Guardians at Progressive Field, follow the Cleveland Cavaliers at Rocket Arena, and join the passionate faithful who rally behind the Cleveland Browns every season. The sense of community pride around Cleveland's teams is infectious, and game days turn the city into one big celebration.


The outdoors are never far away. Cuyahoga Valley National Park — the only national park in Ohio — sits just south of the city, offering miles of hiking, biking, waterfalls, and scenic railroad excursions. Cleveland Metroparks wraps the city in a beloved "Emerald Necklace" of parks and trails, and Lake Erie's shoreline provides year-round recreation from sailing to fishing. With a lower cost of living than many comparable metros, a growing tech and healthcare economy, and a community-first spirit you can feel on every block, Cleveland is a fantastic place to build a career and a life.

If you thrive at the intersection of storytelling, strategy, and service, this is your opportunity to shape how KPAX shows up for the community it serves.

  • Oversee event logistics, stakeholder coordination, and effectiveness measurement to ensure engagement activities are inclusive, relevant, and impactful.
  • Develop and execute a market-wide community engagement strategy aligned with station and regional priorities.
  • Advise station leadership on community needs, emerging issues, and opportunities to strengthen trust and local impact.
  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional community engagement efforts, while sharing best practices, tracking outcomes, and developing team capabilities.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in community engagement, journalism, nonprofit leadership, communications, public affairs, partnership development, government relations, or related field
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Exceptional relationship-building and networking skills
  • Strong community listening skills and ability to recognize emerging issues and opportunities
  • Strategic thinking and judgment; ability to translate insight into action
  • Strong facilitation, public speaking, writing and presentation skills
  • Ability to influence across News, Sales, Marketing, Operations and community organizations
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • Empathy, cultural awareness, diplomacy, discretion and integrity
  • Ability to work independently and adapt to change
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM/community relationship platforms and collaboration tools
  • Strong customer-service mindset, conflict-resolution skills and sound judgment when responding to audience questions, concerns and sensitive community issues

OUR TEAM: We have hikers, rock climbers, mountain bikers, kayakers, runners, skiers, gamers, musicians, community leaders, swimmers, and every other mixture of diverse backgrounds, passions, and life experiences. We are a community of welcoming, mission-focused, and lively people who continue to grow as we grow our company and rise to our full potential in every aspect of our business.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY: Missoula, MT where the Clark-Fork River really does run through this vibrant city. Set at the convergence of five mountain ranges, earning Missoula the name of the "hub of five valleys". Missoula is surrounded by 60,000 acres of wilderness and is an outdoor paradise, with national forests, ski areas, incredible hikes, and bicycling, raging rivers with excellent blue-ribbon trout fishing. Missoula has repeatedly earned its ranking as a top 100 Best Places to live and was recently recognized as one of the healthiest places in the US with the highest life expectancy compared to any other city in Montana. If you seek a life that isn't consumed by your work or your commute, where living is about community, exploring the same trails as Lewis and Clark, as well as new adventures, and a place where "fur babies" are considered part of the Missoulian community than this is the place for you! After Billings, Missoula is the second-largest city and metropolitan area in Montana and is home to the University of Montana, a public research university. Where else can you walk outside and jump on a mountain trailhead or drive two to three hours and arrive at the gates of both Glacier and Yellowstone National Park? The economy is growing, culture and arts are thriving, calling filmmakers such as Paramount's Yellowstone to call on Missoula for some of the most beautiful scenic movie and TV show backgrounds. Truly the last best place!​

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline or equivalent years of relevant experience preferred.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Exceptional relationship-building and networking skills, with the ability to establish credibility across a wide range of communities and organizations.
  • Strong community listening skills and the ability to recognize emerging issues, needs, and opportunities.

  • Strong facilitation, public speaking, writing, and presentation skills.

job.title: Software Development Engineer, Backend (Java)
job.description:
Fox Corporation is home to industry-leading brands including FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations, Tubi Media Group, and FOX One, our recently launched direct-to-consumer (DTC) platform.


Across our portfolio, we build and operate large-scale digital platforms that serve millions of users globally. Our teams combine innovative technology, deep data insights, and world-class content to deliver highly personalized, reliable, and scalable consumer experiences across web, mobile, and connected TV platforms.

As a Software Engineer in the Backend/API team, you will be responsible for building and operating scalable, resilient backend systems that power multiple consumer-facing platforms. You will work on high-throughput, low-latency services and APIs that are critical to core product experiences.

This role requires engineers who take end-to-end ownership - from understanding the problem and designing systems to implementing, deploying, and operating them in production. We are looking for strong backend engineers who can work independently, make sound technical decisions, and deliver reliable systems without the need for constant hand-holding.

  • Design, build, and operate backend services and APIs that run at high scale with strict reliability and performance requirements.
  • Take complete ownership of assigned problem areas, from requirements understanding and system design to production rollout and ongoing operations.
  • Perform high-level and low-level system design, clearly articulating trade-offs and architectural decisions.
  • Write high-quality, maintainable, and well-tested code across backend components.
  • Build and evolve distributed systems that are resilient, fault-tolerant, and observable in production.
  • Optimize existing systems for performance, latency, scalability, and cost.
  • Apply strong problem-solving skills and data structures knowledge to design efficient, real-world solutions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver backend capabilities that support evolving product needs.
  • Participate actively in code and design reviews, maintaining high engineering standards.
  • Continuously improve system reliability, developer productivity, and engineering best practices within the team.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.
  • 4-8 years of experience building backend software systems in production environments.
  • Strong programming skills in one or more backend languages, preferably Java.
  • Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and their application in backend and distributed systems.
  • Experience designing and building distributed systems with a focus on scalability, availability, and reliability.
  • Hands-on experience working with cloud-based systems (e.g., AWS or equivalent).
  • Experience working with databases and data stores (relational and/or NoSQL) and an understanding of data modeling and performance trade-offs.
  • Practical understanding of modern AI systems, including large language models (LLMs), and how to integrate AI capabilities into backend software.
  • Familiarity with using AI to build, enhance, or operate software systems (e.g., LLM-based APIs, prompt-driven workflows, automation, developer productivity).
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership, and deliver systems end-to-end with minimal guidance.

FOX Corporation is looking for an experienced Director, Engineering – Personalization & Recommendations API (PNR) to lead the engineering organization responsible for building scalable personalization and recommendation platforms that power content discovery and individualized user experiences across FOX's digital products. You will be responsible for defining the engineering strategy, building and scaling high-performing teams, and driving technical excellence across one of the most strategic areas of our Digital Product ecosystem.

Our Personalization & Recommendations engineering team develops and maintains intelligent platforms that deliver personalized content recommendations, user experiences, and engagement capabilities across Web, Mobile, and Connected TV applications. Working closely with Product, Data Science, Machine Learning, Analytics, and Platform Engineering teams, the organization builds highly scalable services that leverage customer behavior, content metadata, and machine learning models to provide relevant and engaging experiences for millions of users worldwide.

As the Director, Engineering – Personalization & Recommendations (PNR), you will provide strategic and technical leadership across multiple engineering teams responsible for recommendation services, personalization platforms, user profile services, experimentation frameworks, and content discovery capabilities. You will partner closely with Product Management, Data Science, Machine Learning, Analytics, Platform Engineering, and executive leadership to define technology strategy, deliver business-critical initiatives, and foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and engineering excellence.

  • Lead and grow multiple engineering teams responsible for Personalization and Recommendation platforms across FOX's Digital Product ecosystem.
  • Define and execute the engineering strategy and technology roadmap aligned with FOX's Digital Product vision.
  • Drive architecture decisions for highly scalable, resilient, and low-latency recommendation and personalization services.
  • Build a culture focused on engineering excellence, innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

job.description:
Videographer/Photographer

The Des Moines Register/desmoinesregister.com, part of the USA TODAY NETWORK, seeks a videographer/photographer to join our talented staff in Iowa’s capital city.

This journalist should have an interest in telling stories with video, from spot news to mini-documentaries and social media clips. They should also be versed in making still photos that tell stories from sports fields, Iowans’ homes and political rallies. They will also play a key role in training members of our newsroom on video and will track and adopt evolving best practices.

This person will join a team of four photojournalists in Iowa, including a photo editor who is a veteran journalist and spends more time making photos than holding meetings. The successful candidate must have a passion for telling stories visually, quickly when needed, in-depth when called for, and always with accuracy.

We expect anyone who works with us to constantly improve their skills. We offer internal and company-wide training programs and study metrics, audience, social and search trends to deliver essential news and information.

The position requires flexibility to cover the news and is generally a Tuesday to Saturday workweek.

Des Moines is one of the Midwest’s fastest growing cities and has become a magnet for young professionals, attracted by an expanding job base and an increasingly diverse cultural and arts scene.

The Des Moines Register is a 17-time Pulitzer Prize winner. The Register offers an opportunity to build a career path in Iowa or to gain the foundation to move on to top metros across the country.

Requirements:

Bachelor's or master’s in communications, journalism or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Three years of experience in professional photojournalism.

Solid news judgment.

Self-motivation and self-direction.

Top-notch planning, organizational and time management skills.

A portfolio that shows their command of news video and stills.

This role requires a valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and the minimum liability insurance required by state law.

Application Instructions

We are eager to learn more about you and how you fit this role. When you apply, don’t limit your upload to a resume; show us what you’ve done. To do so, please submit the following, in this order:

Your resume – one to two pages.

A cover letter that outlines how you would approach this job.

Links to 3-6 online samples of your work or your online portfolio. Show us what you’ve produced that best reflects what you can do in this role.

Completing these steps will ensure that your application receives the highest consideration.   #Newsgnt#LI-NC1

The New York Post delivers news, sports, pop culture and entertainment with unmatched speed, attitude and authority, reaching more than 90 million unique viewers each month. With a 225 year legacy and a fast moving digital first newsroom, the Post operates across print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce, and continues to define the city’s most talked about stories.

The New York Post is seeking a full-time Reporter (Tuesday-Saturday) who can thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

The Reporter will take the lead on major news stories, no matter the topic, and ensure The Post has the crucial elements covered while working to break our own lines. job.title: Part-Time Producer, Create or Destroy
job.description:
Part-Time Producer, Create or Destroy

Vox Media and The Wisdomous Company are seeking a highly organized, editorially sharp, and business-fluent Producer for Create or Destroy: Reimagining Marketing, a weekly video podcast hosted by Seth Matlins.

The show is built on the premise that marketing is not a siloed department within an organization, but an enterprise-wide mindset and core growth engine. Because every company decision—from product design, supply chain, and HR to capital allocation, data architecture, and board composition—ultimately touches the customer, every decision either creates value or threatens to destroy it. Each week, the show features unvarnished, actionable, and irreverent conversations with influential thinkers and leaders across the business and cultural landscape.

This role is central to the weekly video and audio production pipeline, managing the tactical execution, editorial rigor, and quality control needed to take episodes from initial research through recording, post-production, and multi-platform publication. The ideal candidate pairs foundational technical chops in video podcast production with a solid grasp of modern marketing, business strategy, and brand dynamics.

This is a temporary, part-time position for a 6-month assignment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Editorial Research & Briefing: Conduct thorough research on featured enterprise leaders, market developments, and corporate case studies. When needed, prepare detailed host prep packets, narrative outlines, and interview questions centered on how internal and external forces shape value creation and destruction.
  • Production Lead on Create or Destroy: Direct weekly in-studio and remote recording sessions, manage technical setups (audio/video capture, lighting, framing), liaise closely with host Seth Matlins, and guide guest talent through seamless tapings.
  • VIP & C-Suite Logistics: Own the end-to-end production calendar, coordinating prep calls and recording logistics with high-profile guests, executive assistants, and corporate communications teams.
  • Post-Production & Assembly: Execute the foundational assembly edit (rough cuts, paper edits, and stringouts); craft compelling, high-converting episode titles and SEO-informed descriptions tailored to business decision-makers.
  • Ad Integration & Monetization: Coordinate with ad operations and sales teams to facilitate the timely recording, placement, and delivery of sponsored segments and host-read endorsements.
  • Quality Control & Distribution: Perform rigorous quality control checks on master audio and multi-camera video exports; manage publishing workflows across YouTube, Megaphone, and supporting feeds.
  • Audience Growth & Social Clipping: Identify high-impact, provocative soundbites from each episode; oversee the cutting, captioning, and quality control of short-form video clips optimized for B2B engagement across LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in video podcast production, digital video journalism, or multimedia content creation, preferably within a fast-paced media network or business publication.
  • Demonstrated business & marketing literacy: A working understanding of corporate strategy, brand marketing, consumer behavior, and executive decision-making, along with genuine curiosity about how companies drive sustainable growth.
  • Hands-on production proficiency: Practical experience with video and audio editing software (e.g., Adobe Premiere Pro, Audition, or Descript) and remote recording tools (e.g., Riverside.fm).
  • Multi-platform packaging expertise: A strong grasp of YouTube audience retention mechanics, packaging (titles and thumbnails), and how to optimize professional video content for platforms like LinkedIn.
  • Executive-level communication: Comfort directly producing, briefing, and interacting with high-profile guests such as CEOs, CMOs, founders, and cultural leaders.
  • Meticulous project management: Proven ability to manage multi-track deliverables, asset files, and tight weekly turnaround deadlines without sacrificing editorial polish.

job.title: Client Systems Specialist
job.description:
The Client Systems Specialist’s primary responsibility is to provide responsive customer service, technical support, and troubleshooting for approximately 100 AccuWeather TV customers. This role supports the department’s 24/7 customer service coverage, helping customers maintain reliable operation of their AccuWeather software, hardware, and data services. The position requires proactive customer communication, advanced troubleshooting, and coordination with internal teams to resolve issues promptly. Occasional travel is required for product demonstrations, system installations, customer training, and trade shows. 

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
• Serve as a primary technical support resource for AccuWeather TV customers, providing timely, professional assistance by phone, email, and remote support.
• Participate in the department’s 24/7 support coverage and assigned on-call schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
• Monitor customer support calls, emails, and requests; prioritize issues based on urgency, impact on customer operations, and departmental guidelines.
• Troubleshoot and resolve software, hardware, system configuration, and data issues, with particular attention to problems affecting on-air operations.
• Take ownership of assigned support issues from initial response through resolution, keeping customers informed of progress and next steps.
• Document customer issues, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and follow-up actions to support consistent service and knowledge sharing.
• Escalate complex or unresolved issues to management and developers, providing clear details to support timely resolution.
• Communicate with sales and account management teams about ongoing customer issues, support needs, and customer satisfaction.
• Provide proactive customer guidance to help prevent recurring problems and improve system reliability.
• Maintain proficiency and required certifications on all AccuWeather TV graphics systems.
• Maintain a working understanding of AccuWeather and other meteorological data to effectively support customers and meteorologists.
• Test new software versions using current customer configurations and coordinate customer upgrades following release.
• Provide remote customer training on system operation, new features, and troubleshooting procedures.
• Occasionally travel to customer sites to install and configure systems, verify proper operation, and provide training.
• Support sales efforts by demonstrating AccuWeather TV products remotely and, as needed, at customer sites and trade shows.
• Identify customer needs for upgrades, additional systems, or training, and communicate those opportunities to the appropriate sales or account management team.
• Provide technical training, guidance, and mentorship to new staff and sales team members.
• Coordinate support coverage with the team during travel and other scheduled activities.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

BACKGROUND AND QUALIFICATIONS
• At least one year of professional experience supporting PC or Mac computers, software, or hardware required. Relevant education or extensive technical training may be considered in place of employment experience.
• Strong customer service skills, including the ability to remain calm, responsive, and professional when customers experience urgent technical issues.
• Ability to troubleshoot software and hardware problems, prioritize competing requests, and follow issues through to resolution.
• Ability to communicate technical information clearly to customers and colleagues with varying levels of technical knowledge.
• Ability to read and interpret instructions, technical documentation, procedural and policy manuals, and customer communications.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when documenting issues, coordinating follow-up, and maintaining customer records.
• Ability to work independently while collaborating with support staff, sales, management, and developers.
• Availability to participate in assigned 24/7 on-call coverage, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
• Ability and willingness to travel occasionally for demonstrations, installations, training, and trade shows.
• Experience with broadcast systems, graphics systems, or meteorological data preferred.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS
The physical demands described here are representative of those required to perform the job's essential functions. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions. The position requires extended periods of work at a computer workstation using a keyboard and mouse, as well as frequent communication by phone and video conference. The employee may occasionally be required to stand, walk, and lift or move equipment weighing up to 25 pounds during installations, demonstrations, or training. Specific vision abilities include color vision, close vision, and the ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those encountered while performing the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions. Work is primarily performed in an office or remote support setting, with occasional work at customer stations and trade shows. The role includes responding to time-sensitive technical issues in a live broadcast environment and providing support outside regular business hours as part of the department’s assigned coverage schedule.

 

  ABOUT ACCUWEATHER   AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making.   Billions of people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™ across our consumer digital platforms. AccuWeather.com is the #1 weather destination and one of the top 100 most-visited websites in the world, and our award-winning AccuWeather app delivers detailed real-time forecasts to tens of millions of smartphones.   AccuWeather forecasts also appear on digital signage, in 700 newspapers, are heard on over 400 radio stations, and viewed on 100 television stations. He has been recognized in Entrepreneur Magazine’s Encyclopedia of Entrepreneurs as one of the greatest entrepreneurs in American history. job.title: NOC Analyst

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. SiriusXM Connected Vehicle (SiriusXM CV) is a leading provider of connected services to vehicle manufacturers, delivering one of the most broadly adopted connected vehicle platforms in North America for the last 25 years. Named the 2020 Company of the Year in the Telematics Industry by Frost & Sullivan, we provide safety, security and convenience services to millions of vehicle owners across major automotive brands. Our teams are continuously working to develop leading-edge technology that can not only add convenience to the daily lives of so many drivers across the country but our advancements in safety and security could also help save their lives.

How you’ll make an impact:

The Network Operations Center (NOC) Analyst will be responsible for monitoring large computer networks and servers farms for problems from a central location. They analyze problems, perform troubleshooting and incident response on the systems, communicate with Operations teams and track problems through to resolution. The NOC engineer will lead the effort for notifications (e-mail, text, and phone), cross functional team triage sessions, status to Senior Leadership teams and communications to internal/external stakeholders during production incidents. Responsible for 24x7 monitoring of systems performance and communicates any problems to team and management.  Recommends and performs operational enhancements, including but not limited to: process improvement, documentation updates, monitoring enhancements and communications to leadership on production incidents. 

What you’ll do:

  • Assist with maintaining NOC operational, escalation, and notification documentation.

  • Documents steps taken during the Incident to resolve the issue and communicates them to the incident team
  • Coordinates with the IT Support Center any necessary problem escalation and makes sure operations staff and management are informed of any major errors.
  • Timely and accurately create and update Incident Tickets using ticketing system.
  • Ensures all work is done completely and correctly, including all logs and preventative maintenance.
  • Monitors overall system, server and application performance. Notes and records anomalies, and recommends enhancement to improve performance.
  • Identify any trending in current monitoring system and recommend changes or improvements.
  • Recommends changes and enhancements that improve efficiency of operation.
  • Thoroughly communicates shift review to oncoming shift.
  • Maintains all logs, records, and reports relative to shift operations.
  • Perform scheduled maintenance activities.
  • Perform Network password reset requests.

  • 0-2 years related experience in a computer/network operations environment. Adapts well to rapidly changing environment.

  • Ability to multitask, displays attention to detail, organizational and time management skills.

  • Additional shift coverages may be asked to cover TSOC activities.
  • Proficient in the following areas (Windows, Linux)
  • Experience in a Network Operations Center environment is required.
  • Experience with updating and tracking technical issues in a ticketing system is required.

About SoundExchange

SoundExchange is the largest global neighboring rights organization in the world, redefining how creators in the music industry get paid. By turning data into fast, accurate revenue for artists and rights owners, we have collected and distributed more than $13 billion in digital performance royalties to date on behalf of more than 800,000 music creators. As the sole organization designated by the U.S. government to administer the Section 114 sound recording license, SoundExchange seamlessly collects and distributes digital performance royalties from platforms like Pandora, SiriusXM, iHeartRadio, and thousands more, as well as all available international performance royalties through a strong global partnership network. 

 

 

Title: Account Manager
Department: Customer Services
Job Location: Washington, DC (Hybrid: In office on Tuesdays & Wednesdays)

Supervisory Role: No

Position Summary:
The Account Manager, as part of the Account Management team within the Customer Services Department, is responsible for the routine processing of incoming registrations, supplemental documents, and Letters of Direction (LOD) submissions, as well as recurring administrative tasks assigned to the team. This role involves creating new accounts, maintaining and updating existing accounts, and processing LODs by establishing associations between artist and LOD recipient payee accounts, including the allocation of royalty items at the specified percentages and effective dates. The Account Manager also processes Default Allocation applications and conducts outreach as needed via phone and email to artists and LOD recipient clients. In all aspects of the role, the Account Manager is expected to provide excellent customer service and to perform duties efficiently and accurately to ensure timely service and maximized pay-through rates for clients.

Essential Functions:
• Evaluate and process new registrations by creating new accounts
• Evaluate and process new LOD submissions by creating or modifying existing accounts, applying associations between artist and LOD recipient payees, and associating royalty items at the proper percentage(s) and effective date(s);
• Evaluate and process Default Allocation applications;
• Conduct outreach regarding document completion, LOD clarification, and Default Allocation application to clients (as needed);
• Update existing accounts by processing supplemental documents/tasks
• Provide excellent customer service via email and phone
• Meet production and quality standards
• Conduct document completion or clarification outreach to clients
• Assist with Support team calls and/or inquiry overflow (as needed);
• Work on special projects (as needed)

Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities (KSAs):
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Outlook)
• Salesforce and/or database experience is a plus
• Excellent written and oral communication skills
• Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
• Proven capacity to work independently, think critically, multi-task, and report progress under tight deadlines
• LOD familiarity is a plus
• Customer Service experience and/or knowledge of music genres is a plus

• Post-secondary education or certification is a plus

• This position requires the ability to spend all of the time viewing computer monitors

• This position has less than 25% travel requirements

 

PAY RANGE: $26.44/hr - $30.28/hr

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. Management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary.

At SoundExchange we empower creators and help shape the future of music. One way we do this is by respecting different voices, varied perspectives, and distinct backgrounds of all our team members. We are intentional in creating a culture where we recognize that all employees have the opportunities and support needed to thrive. We strive to create teams that reflect the music community we serve – every individual’s unique attributes and abilities are valued, and are part of how we innovate, create, and deliver experiences to the creators we champion.

It helps to cultivate SoundExchange culture and policies, advocates for equality within the music industry, and participates in community building activities in the Washington, DC area where SoundExchange is located.

All with the goal of promoting more belonging and access in the workplace, music industry, and local community.

job.description:
WHO WE ARE:  

Splice is a creative platform for people who make music. Serious producers choose Splice Sounds to bring their ideas to life. A subscription to Splice inspires and accelerates creative success for digital music creators with an industry-leading catalog of sounds and samples and an expanding AI stack. With a rent-to-own marketplace of DAWs and plugins, the Splice experience seamlessly integrates into any music production workflow, regardless of DAW (Digital Audio Workstation). Via Splice, an unparalleled team of sound designers and sample creators are fueling the success of a growing global community of chart-topping producers, students, and DIY creators.

HOW WE WORK:  

At Splice, DISCO is a rallying cry for collaboration, accountability, and unity within our organization; Direct, Inclusive, Splice Together, Creator Centric, and Optimistic. Our shared success depends on our ability to support one another, work well together, and communicate directly. By embracing flexibility and a unified approach, we can navigate anything that’s thrown at us.

Splice embraces a culture of remote work. You’ll see your colleagues showing up from across the US and the UK. In order to keep us working well as a team, we have regular communication, including Town Halls, departmental all-hands and get-togethers.

When you join Splice, you join a network of colleagues, peers, and collaborators. Are you ready?

JOB TITLE: Data Engineer II 
LOCATION: REMOTE- US


THE ROLE: 

We're looking for a Data Engineer II to join Splice's Data Engineering team and help scale the platform that powers creator payouts, revenue reporting, and product analytics across Splice's product lines.

Data Engineering builds and maintains the reliable foundation that makes trusted data possible, enabling teams across Splice to work from a governed, consistent source of truth. We are accountable for the warehouse and pipeline foundation; ingestion, transformations, and the standards and quality guardrails that keep data consistent, timely, and usable. This is a mid-level, high-ownership role: engineers here carry features from technical design through delivery, monitoring, and documentation, and participate in our on-call rotation.

The work requires hands-on data engineering experience. Our stack; BigQuery, SQLMesh, Python, Dagster- is distinct from Splice's web engineering stack, and effective contribution requires domain expertise in data pipeline systems, not general software engineering background.

TEAM INFORMATION: 

You'll be joining Splice's Data Engineering team, a small, embedded platform team responsible for the pipelines, transformations, and warehouse infrastructure the rest of the company depends on. Our systems support finance-critical processes (contributor payouts, GAAP revenue reporting), product analytics, and data reliability for customer-facing features like recommendations. We operate with a shared on-call rotation and a strong bias toward observable, well-documented, durable systems.

WHAT YOU’LL DO: 

Pipeline Development & Transformation

  • Build and maintain data models in SQLMesh, including incremental strategies, testing, and documentation
  • Continuously improve and evolve our orchestration and transformation infrastructure as the platform scales
  • Modernize legacy pipeline jobs in Python and SQLMesh, reducing technical debt over time

Reliability & Observability

  • Participate in on-call rotation; triage and resolve incidents including ETL failures, data unavailability, and core metric breakage
  • Build introspectable software: define alert thresholds, emit metrics and logs, produce dashboards, and establish closed-loop escalation paths
  • Improve observability across the platform so failures are caught early and resolved quickly

Finance & Revenue Pipelines

  • Extend and maintain pipelines powering creator payouts and GAAP-compliant revenue reporting across Splice's product lines
  • Build pipeline support for new revenue streams as Splice launches them

Platform Quality & Optimization

  • Improve query performance and reduce compute costs in BigQuery
  • Contribute to ingestion platform work and product analytics infrastructure
  • Uphold our definition of done: validation complete, documentation updated, monitoring in place before closing a ticket

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

  • 3+ years of hands-on data engineering experience in a production environment
  • Proficiency in SQL — window functions, CTEs, query optimization, execution plan analysis
  • Proficiency in Python for pipeline logic, data transformation, and testing (maintainable code, not just scripts)
  • Experience with a modern transformation framework — SQLMesh, dbt, or equivalent — including incremental models, testing, and documentation
  • Production experience with a cloud data warehouse (we use BigQuery); understands partitioning, clustering, and cost management
  • Experience with at least one workflow orchestrator (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect, or equivalent)
  • Demonstrated ability to build observable, reliable data systems — alerting, dashboards, and data quality checks
  • Comfortable owning small-to-medium features from technical design through delivery with limited guidance

SPLICE BENEFITS: 

  • Compensation & Equity: Competitive pay with annual reviews and equity opportunities.
  • Time Off: Unlimited PTO to recharge and thrive.
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents.
  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with immediate vesting and company match.
  • Parental Support: 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for non-birthing parents, and 18-20 weeks for birthing parents.
  • Flexible Work Options: Work remotely or connect at our office hubs and creative spaces worldwide.
  • Professional Growth: Annual learning budget, leadership programs, and team ambassador opportunities.
  • Community & Connection: Inclusive events, team meet-ups, and vibrant Employee Resource Groups.

The national pay range for this role is $94,952 - $118,690. Individual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate's experience.

job.title: Enterprise Account Executive
job.description:
About Us

UNICEPTA, as a part of The Marketing Cloud here at Stagwell, is a leading provider of media intelligence, communication insights, and reputation management solutions for many of the world's most recognized brands. For decades, organizations have relied on UNICEPTA to transform complex media and business information into actionable intelligence that drives strategic decision-making.

 

As we continue to expand our presence across North America, we are investing in experienced sales professionals who can help accelerate growth, build meaningful enterprise relationships, and position UNICEPTA as a strategic partner to Fortune 1000 organizations.

 

We are seeking an Enterprise Account Executive to drive new logo acquisition and revenue growth across the U.S. market. This is a true hunter role designed for a high-performing enterprise seller who thrives on developing pipeline, navigating complex buying environments, and winning strategic enterprise business.

 

Responsibilities

  • Identify, prospect, and develop new business opportunities through strategic outbound and account-based selling efforts.
  • Build and maintain a pipeline of qualified enterprise opportunities within Fortune 1000 organizations.
  • Generate and close net-new logo business across communications intelligence, media intelligence, social listening, reputation management, and consumer insights functions.
  • Own the entire sales lifecycle from initial outreach through contract execution.
  • Develop relationships with senior-level stakeholders across Communications, Public Relations, Corporate Affairs, Marketing, Consumer Insights, Brand Strategy, and Executive Leadership teams.
  • Lead consultative sales conversations that align UNICEPTA's solutions with customer business objectives and strategic priorities.
  • Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles involving executive sponsors, procurement, legal, and cross-functional decision-makers.
  • Create and execute territory plans focused on high-value enterprise accounts.
  • Collaborate with solutions, strategy, product, and delivery teams to develop winning proposals and business cases.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage additional Stagwell capabilities when they can enhance customer outcomes.
  • Consistently achieve and exceed individual pipeline, activity, and revenue targets.

 

Qualifications

  • Proven track record of exceeding quota and closing complex enterprise opportunities within large organizations.
  • Experience selling to Fortune 1000 companies or similarly sophisticated enterprise environments.
  • Demonstrated success generating net-new business through outbound prospecting, executive engagement, and account-based sales strategies.
  • Strong understanding of the media intelligence, social listening, reputation intelligence, consumer insights, PR technology, or communications technology landscape.
  • Experience selling to stakeholders within Communications, Public Relations, Corporate Affairs, Marketing Intelligence, Consumer Insights, Brand Strategy, or related business functions.
  • Track record of managing six- and seven-figure opportunities involving multiple stakeholders and lengthy consultative buying cycles.
  • Exceptional executive presence, communication skills, and ability to build credibility with senior business leaders.
  • Highly entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate independently while influencing cross-functional teams.
  • Strong business acumen and disciplined sales process management.
  • Existing relationships within enterprise communications, insights, marketing, or corporate affairs organizations are a plus.

 

Compensation

In order to comply with equal pay and salary transparency laws in various locations, we believe the target range of base compensation in New York City for this role is $115,000 - $135,000. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location. This role includes commission-based incentive compensation.

 

In addition to medical, dental and vision coverage, we offer a generous PTO plan, 401k program, comprehensive family planning benefits (including paid parental leave), tuition reimbursement, and pre-tax commuter benefits. Benefits/perks may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Stagwell and the location where you work.

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.
