  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.

We believe in creativity, innovation, and collaboration in everything we do, and we are looking for people who share this mindset to join us. With a monthly reach of 30 million Canadians, you can help shape the future of sports, news, e-commerce, and entertainment. At Rogers, we value diversity and inclusivity and believe that every voice matters. Join us today and be a part of a team that is redefining the future of media.

 

Radio Traffic Coordinator - 6 Month Contract 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

The Traffic Coordinator is a key member of the Revenue Operations team at Rogers Sports & Media. They support radio sales by ensuring all ads are scheduled and delivered as ordered. The ideal candidate will be highly detailed, with excellent problem solving skills. They will work effectively within a team but can also work independently, always taking pride in their work. Everyday brings new challenges, requiring the ability to prioritize, multitask and meet multiple deadlines. On a daily basis, they will work collaboratively with colleagues in AdOps, Sales, Creative, Programming and Finance.  

 

What you'll do: 

  • Accurately enter and revise broadcast orders in the WideOrbit Traffic system.
  • Ensure the integrity of campaigns by scheduling, editing, and publishing daily commercial logs for multiple stations.
  • Reconcile and troubleshoot aired commercial logs.
  • Monitor weekly Inventory to maximize inventory and revenue.
  • Create, schedule and revise programming formats as needed.
  • Respond to requests for accountability using a combination of software tools and internal departments available.
  • Work constructively with other departments essential to maintaining our business, including but not limited to Revenue Management, Sales, Promotions, Accounting, Creative, and Commercial Production.
  • Assist team members as required.

 

What you bring: 

  • Strong administrative experience with exceptional data entry skills, ensuring the highest of accuracy.
  • Effective organizational skills with the ability to prioritize in a high demand environment and meet deadlines.
  • Relationship building and communication skills that earn credibility and respect, establishing excellent relationships with internal and external clients, developing mutual respect through knowledge of standard business practices.
  • Strong analytical skills. 
  • A Customer First approach with all stakeholders, always exercising patience and professionalism.
  • Ability to be flexible/agile and willing to learn new functions in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work effectively, collaboratively within the team as well as independently.

job.description:
KMGH, The E.W. Scripps Company ABC affiliate in Denver, Colorado, is seeking an Executive Reporter who will lead our mission to enhance storytelling and inspire the next generation of journalists. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the narrative of our community while mentoring talented reporters and MMJs to reach their full potential.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Lead, develop, and enhance the storytelling skill and abilities of all reporters and MMJs in the station.
  • Collaborate with other newsroom leaders to consistently execute the content strategy through authentic, meaningful storytelling.
  • Oversee the writing of stories for all platforms; provide timely feedback to foster continuous improvement.

job.title: Sr Mgr, Community Connections, WTXL
job.description:
WTXL, the ABC affiliate in Tallahassee, Florida, owned by The E.W. Scripps Company, is searching for a Senior Manager of Community Connections. You'll be the station's main link to the community, building trusted relationships with civic, nonprofit, business, education and government leaders. You'll turn community insights into stronger journalism, partnerships that matter and events people show up for, like town halls and public forums. You'll also lead the newsroom's daily community engagement and make sure audience questions, story tips and concerns get a fast, thoughtful response. If you love connecting people and making a real local impact, we want to hear from you.

Tallahassee gives you Southern charm, college-game-day excitement and miles of trails and green space. It's a capital city that still feels like home. Apply today!

Applications received by November 3, 2026 will receive priority consideration. Applications received after this date may continue to be reviewed as needed.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 

  • Build and maintain relationships with community stakeholders to understand emerging issues, priorities, and opportunities.
  • Gather, analyze, and communicate community insights to station leadership, newsroom teams, and partners to inform decision-making and coverage.
  • Partner with News to identify story opportunities, connect journalists with trusted sources, and support audience engagement across community channels.
  • Serve as the station's primary community liaison, developing trusted relationships with civic, nonprofit, business, educational, and government organizations.
  • Represent the station throughout the community and foster partnerships that create long-term value and impact.
  • Ensure responsive, professional communication with community members, partners, and stakeholders, ensuring audience inquiries are acknowledged, routed and resolved in a timely and professional manner.
  • Lead the planning and execution of forums, town halls, public-service initiatives, educational programs, and other community engagement activities.
  • Partner with News, Sales, Marketing, and station leadership to create meaningful opportunities that strengthen audience relationships and community impact.
  • Oversee event logistics, stakeholder coordination, and effectiveness measurement to ensure engagement activities are inclusive, relevant, and impactful.
  • Develop and execute a market-wide community engagement strategy aligned with station and regional priorities.
  • Advise station leadership on community needs, emerging issues, and opportunities to strengthen trust and local impact.
  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional community engagement efforts, while sharing best practices, tracking outcomes, and developing team capabilities.

 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

 

  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in community engagement, journalism, nonprofit leadership, communications, public affairs, partnership development, government relations, or related fields

 

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

 

  • Exceptional relationship-building and networking skills
  • Strong community listening skills and ability to recognize emerging issues and opportunities
  • Strategic thinking and judgment; ability to translate insight into action
  • Strong facilitation, public speaking, writing and presentation skills
  • Ability to influence across News, Sales, Marketing, Operations and community organizations
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • Empathy, cultural awareness, diplomacy, discretion and integrity
  • Ability to work independently and adapt to change
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM/community relationship platforms and collaboration tools
  • Strong customer-service mindset, conflict-resolution skills and sound judgment when responding to audience questions, concerns and sensitive community issues

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Boise is one of the West's most exciting and livable cities, a place where big-city energy meets the ease of an outdoor lifestyle. Nestled in the foothills of the Rocky Mountains along the Boise River, the city offers a stunning natural backdrop and near-endless recreation — from world-class skiing and snowboarding at Bogus Basin just 16 miles from downtown, to hiking and mountain biking the Ridge to Rivers trail system, to floating the Boise River Greenbelt in summer. Sun Valley, one of America's premier ski destinations, is just a couple of hours away.

job.title: Sales and Marketing Coordinator
job.description:
The Sales Marketing Coordinator supports Sinclair’s National Sports Ad Sales team throughout the sales and sponsorship process. The role helps develop client concepts and integrated marketing solutions, then works with teams across Creative Services, Ad Operations, Social, Content and Production to bring those ideas to life.

The coordinator contributes to innovative, revenue-generating partnerships for new and existing sponsors. This position reports to the Senior Director of Sales Marketing and follows a hybrid schedule based in Sinclair’s New York office.

We’re looking for a detail-oriented candidate with an interest in sports media. Familiarity with media sales, RFP responses and campaign management is a plus.

Responsabilities:

  • Partner with the Sales Marketing team to develop integrated solutions across linear, digital and social platforms.
  • Work with internal teams to develop client and agency pitches, using PowerPoint and Excel and supporting the media buying and RFP process.
  • Coordinate with On-Air Graphics, Social, Content and Production teams to execute branded content, in-show integrations and sponsorship enhancements.
  • Brainstorm with internal partners to create custom, multi-channel sponsorship ideas for brands.
  • Support campaign strategy and performance projections in collaboration with Sales.
  • Develop presentations and one-sheets for programming, events and tournaments with Research, Production, Marketing and other teams.
  • Track marketplace trends and share relevant insights in brainstorms and weekly Sales meetings.

 

Desired Characteristics:

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects efficiently.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to collaborate across departments.
  • Skilled at creating presentations, especially in Microsoft PowerPoint.
  • Able to work with urgency and prioritize competing projects.
  • Proactive, self-sufficient and resourceful.
  • Creative thinker who can develop fresh, effective solutions.
  • Interested in sports, content creation and pop culture, especially the NFL, NBA, soccer, tennis and college sports

 

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree and 1–2 years of experience in media sales, advertising, marketing or a related field.
  • Understanding of branded content, digital media and online video, including basic digital media metrics such as CPM, CPV, impressions and KPIs.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office. Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop and Illustrator, is a plus but not required.

job.title: Unreal Engine Artist
job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM:

TelevisaUnivision’s Art & Design department is looking for a highly skilled Unreal Engine Artist / Developer to join our Augmented and Mixed Reality team supporting our Broadcast and Streaming News operations.

This is a creative and highly technical role focused on developing innovative real-time AR, VR, and virtual production solutions for both live and pre-recorded programming. The ideal candidate combines strong Unreal Engine development skills with a sophisticated understanding of design, visual storytelling, spatial composition, and broadcast production.

Reporting to the Sr. Manager of Graphics Technology, you will collaborate closely with artists, designers, producers, directors, and technical teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven news environment.

You are a collaborative, detail-oriented problem solver with a strong understanding of scale, space, lighting, architecture, and visual realism. You enjoy building immersive environments and real-time graphics while finding creative and technical solutions to complex production challenges.

 

YOUR DAY-DAY: (aka Responsibilities)

  • Collaborate with the Sr. Manager of Graphics Technology and the Art & Design team to support multiple live and pre-recorded news programs.
  • Take ownership of Unreal Engine projects from concept and development through implementation and on-air delivery.
  • Design and develop innovative AR, VR, and real-time graphics solutions for daily programming, breaking news, and special events.
  • Build, integrate, and optimize 3D environments, assets, animations, materials, and real-time graphics for broadcast.
  • Work closely with producers, directors, designers, and other stakeholders to translate creative concepts into technically viable on-air experiences.
  • Follow established brand, editorial, and technical standards while continuously exploring new creative and technological possibilities.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to Unreal Engine, real-time rendering, tracking, camera systems, and virtual production workflows.
  • Help develop and improve Unreal Engine workflows, tools, templates, and production pipelines.
  • Optimize projects for performance, stability, and reliability in demanding live broadcast environments.
  • Stay current with emerging Unreal Engine, AR/XR, virtual production, and real-time graphics technologies.

 

 

YOU HAVE: (aka Qualifications)

 

  • Advanced experience with Unreal Engine / Unreal Editor in professional production environments.
  • Strong proficiency with Blueprints, Sequencer, Materials/Shaders, LiveLink, nDisplay, and DMX.
  • Strong programming experience with C++ and Unreal Engine Blueprints, including the ability to write, maintain, debug, and optimize code.
  • Experience developing real-time systems and interactive functionality within Unreal Engine.
  • Understanding of technical areas such as rendering pipelines, physics, AI systems, procedural workflows, and networking/multiplayer concepts.
  • Strong understanding of 3D environments, spatial design, architectural visualization, lighting, animation, materials, and look development.
  • Experience working with live camera tracking, virtual cameras, data capture, and in-camera VFX (ICVFX).
  • Experience creating data-driven visuals and real-time rendered graphics.
  • Proven ability to optimize Unreal Engine projects and pipelines for live broadcast, virtual production, and linear content.
  • Strong understanding of scale, perspective, composition, and spatial relationships when creating virtual environments.
  • Ability to integrate architectural realism and logical spatial design into immersive virtual environments.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical partners, including producers, directors, and production managers.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced production environment.

·         A creative, collaborative, and solution-oriented mindset with a passion for emerging media and technology.

 

OUR BENEFITS:

At TelevisaUnivision, we prioritize the well-being of our team. Our benefits include:

  • Paid time off (PTO)
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Wellness and employee support programs
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Comprehensive health insurance (medical, dental, vision)
  • Life and other insurance coverage options

job.title: Sales Strategy & Excellence Lead
job.description:
SALES STRATEGY & EXCELLENCE LEAD

Ubicación: Santa Fe, presencial  


Acerca de TelevisaUnivision

TelevisaUnivision es la compañía líder de medios y contenido en español a nivel global, con un ecosistema que integra televisión, streaming, contenido digital y soluciones publicitarias. A través de sus plataformas y capacidades de innovación, conecta a las marcas con audiencias relevantes y ofrece soluciones comerciales orientadas a generar impacto y resultados de negocio.


Sobre el puesto

El Sales Strategy & Excellence Lead será responsable de diseñar y optimizar la estrategia comercial y los procesos operativos del equipo de Ad Sales Streaming & D2C, impulsando la eficiencia de la operación, la productividad comercial y el crecimiento de los ingresos publicitarios.

Esta posición conectará la estrategia de ventas con las áreas de Producto, Finanzas, Legal, Crédito, Facturación y Ad Operations para facilitar la implementación y monetización de nuevos productos y formatos publicitarios. Asimismo, transformará información de mercado, datos de audiencia y resultados de campañas en propuestas de valor y narrativas comerciales que respondan a las necesidades de marcas y agencias, fortalezcan la venta consultiva y aceleren el desarrollo de nuevos negocios.


Sobre ti

Buscamos a una persona con visión estratégica y sólida orientación a resultados, capaz de combinar análisis comercial, excelencia operativa y conocimiento del ecosistema de publicidad digital y streaming. Deberá contar con experiencia en la optimización de procesos comerciales, análisis de indicadores, gestión de proyectos transversales y desarrollo de propuestas de valor para clientes estratégicos.

Será fundamental su capacidad para traducir información compleja en recomendaciones accionables, influir en equipos multidisciplinarios y facilitar la adopción de nuevas soluciones comerciales, manteniendo el enfoque en la generación de ingresos, la experiencia del anunciante y la eficiencia del negocio.


Requisitos:

  • Licenciatura concluida en Administración, Mercadotecnia, Negocios, Ingeniería, Economía o carreras afines.
  • Inglés avanzado.
  • Entre 7 y 10 años de experiencia en estrategia comercial, Sales Operations, Sales Planning o Sales Enablement, preferentemente en medios digitales, AdTech, streaming (OTT/CTV) o empresas de tecnología.
  • Experiencia desarrollando estrategias comerciales, presentaciones ejecutivas, pitches consultivos y propuestas de valor para clientes estratégicos.
  • Dominio de indicadores comerciales, análisis de pipeline, forecasting y elaboración de tableros de control.
  • Experiencia en administración y optimización de CRM, preferentemente Salesforce.
  • Conocimiento de modelos de monetización publicitaria digital, compra programática y estrategias basadas en datos de primera mano (1P).
  • Experiencia coordinando procesos comerciales y administrativos con áreas de Finanzas, Legal, Crédito, Cobranza y Facturación.
  • Habilidad para liderar proyectos transversales, negociar con distintas áreas y resolver problemas de manera estructurada.

Será un plus:

  • Experiencia en empresas globales de tecnología, redes sociales o plataformas de streaming.
  • Conocimiento de Connected TV (CTV), AdTech, live streaming, commerce media y formatos publicitarios interactivos.
  • Experiencia en metodologías de medición publicitaria, atribución, Brand Lift Studies, Marketing Mix Modeling y análisis de ROI.

Tu día a día

  • Diseñar e implementar estrategias y procesos comerciales que impulsen la productividad del equipo de Ad Sales y el crecimiento de los ingresos publicitarios.
  • Coordinar con Producto, Innovación, Finanzas, Legal, Crédito, Facturación y Ad Operations la habilitación integral de nuevos productos y formatos publicitarios, desde su implementación operativa hasta su monetización.
  • Desarrollar narrativas comerciales y propuestas consultivas basadas en datos de mercado, audiencias y objetivos de negocio, atendiendo las necesidades específicas de marcas y agencias.
  • Establecer y dar seguimiento a los procesos de forecasting semanal, mensual y trimestral, identificando riesgos, oportunidades y desviaciones en las proyecciones comerciales.
  • Crear y actualizar presentaciones comerciales, casos de éxito, materiales de venta y playbooks que fortalezcan la efectividad de la fuerza comercial.
  • Diseñar y monitorear tableros de indicadores clave, incluyendo conversión de oportunidades, ticket promedio, velocidad del pipeline, retención de anunciantes y productividad comercial.
  • Administrar y optimizar las herramientas de CRM, definiendo lineamientos de uso, calidad de datos, automatización y seguimiento de oportunidades comerciales.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist & Producer
job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM:

Univision Texas Central is looking for a motivated, competitive, and news-hungry Multimedia Journalist (MMJ) and Producer who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative newsroom and is passionate about delivering impactful journalism to our Hispanic communities.

This hybrid role combines strong newscast production skills with the initiative, creativity, independence, and on-air reporting capabilities of a multimedia journalist. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable producing compelling newscasts, developing original stories, and independently reporting from the field. As editorial needs evolve, this individual will also be expected to serve as an on-camera journalist, delivering live and pre-recorded reports, covering breaking news, and developing original stories for broadcast and digital platforms. This role requires someone who can confidently transition between producing behind the scenes and reporting in front of the camera.

We are building a newsroom culture rooted in ownership, accountability, collaboration, curiosity, and a relentless commitment to journalism. We value individuals who take initiative, communicate openly, embrace feedback, support their teammates, and approach challenges with a solutions-oriented mindset.

 

We believe great journalism is a shared responsibility. Every producer plays an active role in identifying stories, developing sources, verifying information, advancing coverage, and responding to breaking news. We are looking for someone who doesn’t simply wait for assignments but actively seeks opportunities to inform our audience and strengthen our coverage.

Success in this role requires more than technical ability. It requires a team-first mentality, strong editorial instincts, adaptability, and a genuine desire to contribute to a newsroom where everyone is invested in the collective success of our journalism.

 

YOUR DAY-DAY:

  • Produce compelling, accurate, and visually engaging newscasts and/or news content for broadcast, digital, and streaming platforms.
  • Identify, pitch, research, and develop original, impactful stories that matter to Hispanic audiences in San Antonio, Austin, and surrounding communities.
  • Demonstrate the versatility, confidence, and editorial readiness to transition between newscast production, assignment desk responsibilities, and independent field reporting based on daily newsroom priorities and operational needs.
  • Actively contribute to the daily assignment process by monitoring developing news, identifying coverage opportunities, gathering and verifying information, following up on leads, and helping advance stories throughout the day.
  • Exercise strong editorial judgment when evaluating story relevance, urgency, impact, and potential for audience engagement.
  • Independently report from the field as assigned, serving as a Multimedia Journalist (MMJ) responsible for researching, conducting interviews, gathering video and sound, writing scripts, editing packages, and producing complete news stories.
  • Deliver live and pre-recorded on-camera reports for newscasts and digital platforms, including breaking news coverage, developing stories, and independently researched enterprise reporting. Be prepared to work in the field without an assigned photographer or additional reporting support when necessary.
  • Build and organize rundowns, write compelling scripts, develop effective story treatments, and execute creative showcasing elements that strengthen the newscast.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with community members, public officials, organizations, and other sources to generate original reporting and follow-up opportunities.
  • Monitor news wires, scanners, social media, competing outlets, and other reliable sources to identify breaking news and developing stories.
  • Coordinate closely with assignment editors, reporters, photographers, anchors, producers, and digital teams to ensure effective news gathering, timely communication, and efficient execution.
  • Take initiative during breaking news and severe weather coverage, adapting quickly to changing circumstances and supporting newsroom needs in both the field and the control room.
  • Identify opportunities to advance stories beyond the initial report by pursuing additional interviews, new angles, accountability questions, and meaningful follow-ups.
  • Produce platform-appropriate digital content, including short-form videos, social media updates, and other multimedia storytelling elements.
  • Maintain clear and timely communication across shifts, ensuring important editorial developments, pending follow-ups, and coverage needs are properly shared with the next team.
  • Contribute actively to editorial meetings by bringing fresh story ideas, informed perspectives, and solutions that strengthen coverage.
  • Take responsibility for assigned work from beginning to end, maintaining accuracy, meeting deadlines, communicating challenges, and following through on commitments.
  • Demonstrate flexibility and ownership by supporting other newsroom functions when editorial priorities or breaking news demand it.
  • Uphold high standards of accuracy, fairness, ethical journalism, and editorial integrity across all platforms.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

 

 

YOU HAVE:

  • Strong news judgment and a demonstrated passion for local journalism and community-focused storytelling.
  • Experience in television news production, multimedia journalism, reporting, or a related newsroom environment.
  • Strong writing, research, interviewing, and fact-checking skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently research, shoot, write, edit, and deliver complete multimedia news stories for broadcast and digital platforms.
  • Strong on-camera presentation skills, including the ability to confidently deliver live reports, pre-recorded standups, and breaking news updates.
  • Ability and willingness to work independently in the field, including covering breaking news, developing original stories, and reporting without an assigned photographer or additional reporting support.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to balance multiple responsibilities and meet tight deadlines.
  • A proactive, competitive mindset and the initiative to identify, develop, and pursue stories without waiting for direction.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across teams and newsroom functions.
  • A team-first mentality, openness to feedback, adaptability, and a demonstrated commitment to accountability and collective success.
  • Proficiency in Spanish, including strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to communicate and research effectively in English.
  • A commitment to factual accuracy, fairness, balanced reporting, ethical journalism, and editorial integrity.
  • Flexibility and willingness to transition between newscast production, assignment desk responsibilities, and independent field reporting based on editorial priorities and newsroom needs.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including early mornings, overnights, weekends, and holidays.

job.description:

Allen Media Group is a diversified media company with a portfolio of television, streaming, and digital brands, including The Weather Channel, one of the most trusted names in media. Across the portfolio, we partner with leading brands to turn the reach and trust of our properties into smart, creative marketing solutions. Our Ad Sales Marketing team is the creative engine behind how we tell the portfolio's story to clients, agencies, and partners.


The Role

We're looking for a sharp, creative, and organized Manager to join our Ad Sales Marketing team. Reporting to the Director, you'll be a key partner in our day-to-day workstream, helping manage client and partner relationships while producing the polished, persuasive marketing materials our sales team takes to market across the Allen Media Group portfolio. This role blends strong writing, design-forward thinking, and client-facing communication. If you love turning a great idea into a compelling story, this is for you.


What You'll Do

● Write and produce client-facing communications, including e-blast emails, newsletters, and announcements that drive engagement from agencies and advertisers

job.description:
The Manager, Accounting & Financial Reporting is an integral member of the Finance team supporting the Fox Digital & Technology organization. The Manager, Accounting & Financial Reporting is responsible for the financial integrity and operational oversight of the Digital & Technology P&L, managing monthly and quarterly close processes to ensure accurate, timely, and complete financial reporting. In addition, this role serves as a key business partner to operational stakeholders and external suppliers across all purchasing and invoicing activities. The Manager oversees the end-to-end Procure-to-Pay process, collaborating cross-functionally to drive financial discipline, process efficiency, and strong internal controls. This position plays a critical role in validating financial results, including reconciliation of the full Balance Sheet and P&L, investigating variances, and ensuring reported results align with business expectations.

The Manager exercises strong independent judgment in resolving issues, demonstrates ownership, and consistently delivers high-quality, timely results without the need for constant supervision. Additionally, this role collaborates with the FP&A team during budget and forecast cycles to support planning activities and ensure alignment between actual results and forward-looking projections. This position reports directly to the Sr. Manager, Accounting & Financial Reporting.

  • Analyze actual spending results and review accrual journal entries to ensure completeness and accuracy of third-party costs across both the P&L and Balance Sheet

  • Serve as a subject-matter expert on monthly financial results, clearly articulating drivers of spend, key variances, and accounting treatments to finance and operational stakeholders

  • Partner with operational leaders and the FP&A team to investigate expense fluctuations, provide variance explanations, and support reporting deliverables

  • Perform and validate monthly reconciliation of key Balance Sheet accounts to ensure reported financial results are accurate, supported, and compliant with internal controls

job.title: Project Manager - FoxNXT
job.description:
FoxNXT is FOX Entertainment’s next-generation technology studio, built to expand what our creative teams can achieve and put more of every production dollar on screen. Our work spans four pillars: R&D, Production, Talent, and Education.

We turn emerging technology into practical tools and workflows across scripted, unscripted, animation, and marketing. We test in real productions, learn what works, and make those lessons useful across the business. We also develop talent and help our creative and production teams build the skills to use these tools confidently.

Our approach starts with people and craft. We work with creative partners to solve real production problems, protect creative intent, and use AI responsibly, with respect for rights, the creative community, and the resources production consumes.

The Project Manager turns priorities into coordinated action. You will manage intake, establish clear plans and ownership, track delivery, and make sure the right decisions happen at the right time. Working across creative, production, technical, and business teams, you will keep an accurate picture of what is moving, what is blocked, and what needs attention.

We are looking for someone who is organized, curious, direct, and comfortable working through ambiguity. You ask good questions, follow through, and raise problems early with a recommendation. You know when to resolve an issue yourself and when to bring others in. You build enough structure to help talented people do their best work as the business grows.

Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace for a minimum of four (4) days per week is an essential function of the position. The selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own project intake and help translate requests into clear objectives, scope, deliverables, owners, and timelines
  • Maintain a reliable, current view of active projects, priorities, dependencies, and team capacity
  • Coordinate across R&D, production, talent, education, and business teams to align resources and move work forward
  • Identify risks, conflicting priorities, and resource constraints early. Recommend solutions and escalate decisions with clear options and trade-offs
  • Drive follow-through on commitments, approvals, and next steps, with clear accountability for each
  • Give leadership and project teams concise, useful updates on progress, blockers, decisions needed, and outcomes
  • Track schedules, agreed budgets, and scope changes. Make the impact of changes visible before commitments are made

Principal Machine Learning Engineer, Content Engineering (45445) 

 

 

Overview:

 

We are seeking a Senior Lead / Principal Machine Learning Engineer to lead our ShortForm & Video Intelligence pod. This team is in charge of a critical mission: the automated transformation of our massive long-form content library into "ShortForm" assets—high-impact clips, "gists," and social-ready highlights. You will lead the development of the models that "watch" our content to identify narrative hooks, emotional climaxes, and key characters to create compelling bite-sized experiences.

 

This is a deeply technical leadership role requiring mastery of multi-modal machine learning. You will oversee the creation of intelligence layers that perform video safety analysis (nudity/profanity detection), spoiler detection, and sophisticated narrative comprehension. Your work ensures that our ShortForm content is not only engaging but also safe, contextually precise, and optimized for discovery across the Paramount ecosystem.

 

The ShortForm pod unlocks the value of our entire catalog. In this role, you will directly shape:

 

  • The "Gist" Ecosystem: Building the engine that generates short-form previews, allowing users to "snack" on content before committing to a full watch.
  • Platform Safety & Integrity: Owning the "Video Intelligence" filters that protect our brand and users through automated detection of sensitive or restricted content.
  • Narrative AI: Transitioning beyond simple metadata to a world where AI understands story arcs, character importance, and "viral" moments within a film or episode. 

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • Lead the ShortForm Pod: Define the technical roadmap for automated clip generation and video insight, managing a high-performing pod of ML engineers.
  • Architect Multi-Modal Models: Design and deploy models that synthesize signals across video (pixels), audio (speech/music), and text (transcripts/scripts) to understand content context.
  • Own Video Intelligence: Develop and scale robust computer vision and audio classifiers for nudity, profanity, and sensitive content detection.
  • Advance Narrative Understanding: Build models that can identify "hooks," "climax points," and "narrative summaries" to automate the creation of trailers and highlights.
  • Spoiler & Context Detection: Create intelligence layers that identify plot-critical "spoilers" to ensure ShortForm assets don't ruin the viewing experience for new users.
  • Scalable Content Pipelines: Partner with Content Engineering to integrate these models into petabyte-scale video processing workflows.

 

Basic Qualifications:

 

  • 6-8+ years of experience in machine learning, with a heavy focus on Computer Vision (CV) and Multi-Modal architectures.
  • Deep Learning Expertise: Mastery of PyTorch or TensorFlow, specifically for video-based tasks (e.g., Video Transformers, 3D CNNs). Video Intelligence: Proven experience building safety/moderation models (Nudity, Profanity, Hate Speech) or content-tagging systems.
  • Leadership: Experience leading senior technical teams and translating complex "creative" goals into engineering requirements.
  • Video Tech Stack: Knowledge of video processing frameworks (FFmpeg) and handling various codecs/resolutions at scale.

 

Additional Qualifications:

 

  • Experience with Generative AI for Video (automated editing or style transfer).
  • Background in NLP/Speech for sync-ing transcripts with video frames.
  • Knowledge of Narrative Theory or experience in the media/entertainment industry.
  • Experience deploying large-scale models in Cloud Environments (AWS/GCP/Azure) with high GPU utilization efficiency.

Overview:

 

We are the Global Content and Lifecycle Analytics team, part of the Paramount Streaming, Data & Insights Group (DIG) team. DIG is a key connector among the Paramount Streaming verticals. The group consists of subject matter experts that prototype, build, and scale data infrastructure and products; assess, aggregate, and analyze data; and shape qualitative and quantitative based narratives and insights, providing stakeholders with decision support, performance clarity and business driving recommendations.

The User Lifecycle Analytics team works closely with Lifecycle Marketing, Product, Finance, and DTC Executives to drive subscriber growth and retention.

 

The Senior Director will report into the VP of User Lifecycle Analytics, and will support a wide range of initiatives, partnering with the Lifecycle Marketing and Product teams, DTC executives and Finance. This role requires the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and strategic recommendations.

The ideal candidate will possess strong communication skills, an inquisitive nature, attention to detail, and a passion for media, ideally with experience in analyzing user journeys and advanced causal inference frameworks.

This role owns two core business questions:

 

  1. What drives long-term subscriber health, and how do we use our levers (lifecycle, product, pricing, promotions) to encourage it? 
  2. How are optimization efforts across content and the subscriber journey impacting the bottom line?

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • Design and lead causal inference frameworks (quasi-experimental methods, uplift modeling, instrumental variables, matching, diff-in-diff). Find what truly drives retention and value.
  • Work with Lifecycle Marketing and Product to turn causal findings into clear levers. These span content, onboarding, pricing, and promos to improve subscriber health.
  • Own how we link content and journey optimization to outcomes like ARPU, survival, and LTV.
  • Design, launch, and analyze A/B tests across the subscriber journey (acquisition, onboarding, involvement, win-back). Use sound design. Deliver clear results.
  • Build and keep LTV and survival models with the causal drivers above. Finance and DTC teams can then use them.
  • Lead subscriber journey mapping. Find where levers (lifecycle, product, pricing, promos) drive the most causal impact on retention and monetization.
  • Run pricing and promo analyses to shape pricing and promo design. Weigh short-term conversion against long-term value.
  • Explain technical findings clearly to non-technical teams, like DTC leaders and Finance.
  • Manage, mentor, and grow a team of data scientists and analysts. Set technical standards and review methods.
  • Work with Data Engineering and Product Analytics. Keep the data systems for causal analysis (experiment platforms, behavioral and billing data) reliable.
  • Share findings with senior leaders to shape the roadmap. Guide where we invest across Marketing, Product, and Finance.

 

 

Basic Qualifications:

 

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Data Science, or Computer Science).
  • 10+ years in data science/analytics. This covers hands-on and team-leading work. It spans causal inference methods (diff-in-diff, propensity matching, instrumental variables, uplift modeling, synthetic control).
  • Experience designing and analyzing A/B tests and experiments at scale, handling common pitfalls (novelty and network effects, selection bias).
  • Built or run LTV, survival, or churn models. Turned them into financial metrics (ARPU, retention curves).
  • Strong SQL skills and a stats language (Python or R) for causal modeling.
  • A proven track record leading and growing a team of data scientists or analysts.
  • A clear communicator who can present complex work to senior leaders and shape decisions.
  • Experience working across Marketing, Product, and Finance teams.

 

Additional Qualifications:

 

  • Know pricing awareness/elasticity work. Design smart promos.
  • Skilled in subscriber/customer journey mapping.
  • Skilled in Bayesian or ML-based causal techniques (e.g., double machine learning, causal forests).
  • Familiarity with cloud data warehousing/BI tools (e.g., BigQuery, Databricks, Looker, Tableau).

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Overview:

 

We are the Global Content and Lifecycle Analytics team, part of the Paramount Streaming, Data & Insights Group (DIG)! DIG is a key connector across the Paramount Streaming verticals. Our group is made up of subject matter experts who prototype, build, and scale data infrastructure and products. We also assess, aggregate, and analyze data, and we shape both qualitative and quantitative stories and insights. In short, we give our stakeholders decision support, clear performance views, and recommendations that help the business grow!

 

The User Lifecycle Analytics team works closely with Lifecycle Marketing, Product, Finance, and DTC Executives to drive subscriber growth and retention.

 

The Lead Data Scientist reports to the Senior Director of Data Science. You'll support a wide range of projects, partnering with the Lifecycle Marketing and Product teams, DTC executives, and Finance. This role calls for a solid analytical foundation, real curiosity about subscriber behavior, and the skill to run careful analysis that feeds straight into strategy!

 

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, communicates clearly, and has hands-on experience (or eagerness to grow) in causal inference and experimentation.

 

This role supports two core business questions:

 

  1. What drives long-term subscriber health, and how do we use our levers (lifecycle, product, pricing, promotions) to grow it?
  2. How do our optimization efforts across content and the subscriber journey affect the bottom line?

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • Run causal inference analyses (e.g., diff-in-diff, matching, uplift modeling) under the Sr. Director's guidance. You'll find which subscriber behaviors truly drive retention and long-term value, while correcting for known biases in streaming data.
  • Help map the subscriber journey to pinpoint where lifecycle, product, pricing, and promo levers have the most impact.
  • Help design, set up, and analyze A/B tests across the subscriber journey (acquisition, onboarding, engagement, win-back), including power analysis, monitoring, and read-outs.
  • Build and maintain reporting and models that turn journey optimization into ARPU, survival, and LTV metrics for stakeholders.
  • Own the SQL/Python data pulls, cleaning, and analysis pipelines behind the team's causal and LTV modeling.
  • Prepare clear, well-organized presentations and summaries of your findings for stakeholders.
  • Partner with Data Engineering and Product Analytics to check data quality and fix issues in our experimentation and behavioral data pipelines.
  • Stay current on causal inference and experimentation best practices and help promote sound methods across the team.
  • Mentor junior analysts on SQL, statistical methods, and analytical best practices as the team grows.

 

Basic Qualifications:

 

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Computer Science, Operations Research, or related).
  • 5+ years in data science/analytics, with hands-on use of causal inference or experimentation methods (e.g., A/B testing, diff-in-diff, propensity score matching) — not just predictive modeling.
  • Experience designing or analyzing A/B tests, including an understanding of common pitfalls (novelty effects, selection bias, sample ratio mismatch).
  • Solid SQL skills and proficiency in Python or R for statistical analysis.
  • Experience working with or building LTV, survival, or churn-related metrics.
  • Great communication skills, with the ability to turn analytical results into clear takeaways for non-technical stakeholders.

 

Additional Qualifications:

 

  • Experience in subscription/DTC streaming, media, or another subscription business (e.g., SaaS, telecom).
  • Familiarity with subscriber/customer journey mapping.
  • Exposure to advanced causal techniques (e.g., instrumental variables, double machine learning, causal forests).
  • Familiarity with cloud data warehousing/BI tools (e.g., BigQuery, Databricks, Looker, Tableau).

WUPA is the CBS owned-and-operated station in Atlanta, Georgia, together with Paramount+ and the full CBS Stations portfolio, we give advertisers something rare: reach that spans every screen, every daypart, and every device.

 

THE OPPORTUNITY
This is not a maintenance role. This is a growth role built for a broadcast-experienced seller who is capable of doing it all – someone who has spent time in local TV, knows how to maximize opportunities, and is hungry to excel as a multi-screen, multi-market powerhouse.

 

As an Account Executive on the Local Ad Sales team at CBS, you will sell across our full O&O footprint – with the ability to close multi-market broadcast deals that span from coast to coast. Layered on top of that is the opportunity to sell Paramount+ and Pluto TV streaming inventory, giving clients a truly end-to-end screen solution backed by one of the most recognized brands in media.

 

You will bring new business to the table. You will build client relationships that outlast any single campaign. And you will be held to results. When you sell CBS, you sell trust. When you sell Paramount, you sell reach. Together, that's a competitive advantage that belongs to you.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Hunt — hard. Prospect relentlessly across local, regional, and national categories. New-to-station and non-traditional revenue is your primary mandate. You don't wait for the phone to ring.•    Sell all screens. Drive revenue across CBS O&O broadcast, Paramount+ and Pluto TV — in a single, integrated pitch.
  • Go multi-market. Leverage the full 17-market CBS O&O footprint to bring advertisers a scaled broadcast solution to reach audiences across any & all markets.
  • Build, don't inherit. Develop direct client and agency relationships from the ground up. Own your pipeline and your outcomes.
  • Think like a strategist. Package custom solutions — tentpole programs, sports integrations, streaming packages, sponsorships — tailored to client business objectives, not just available inventory.
  • Own your numbers. Manage quarterly and annual account plans, forecast accurately, and hit your monthly and quarterly revenue goals. 
  • Stay ahead of the market. Know the linear and streaming landscape. Understand where categories are investing and why. Bring category intelligence into every client conversation.
  • Collaborate to win. Partner with Integrated Marketing, Account Management, Traffic, to deliver seamless, high-impact campaigns from pre-sale through post-recap.

  • Represent WUPA-TV at client meetings, presentations, and station events.

job.description:
Account Executive

Territory-Based | Hybrid | Client-Facing Market Role

Company: LocaliQ, powered by the USA TODAY Network

Location:  This is a hybrid, outside sales role supporting a designated geographic territory surrounding Rochester, New York.  Success in this position requires regular in-market client and prospect engagement. While much of the work is performed remotely (home office)  and in the field, periodic attendance at a company office for meetings, training, collaboration, and business activities may be required.

Why This Role Stands Out:

Competitive base salary with uncapped commission and strong earning potential

Contests, and recognition programs

Consultative, full-cycle sales

Hybrid flexibility with autonomy to manage your schedule and territory

Strong onboarding, coaching, and sales enablement

Access to an extensive mix of digital and traditional marketing solutions, enabling consultative, end-to-end strategies tailored to each client’s growth objectives

Career Development – Clear paths to career advancement, mentor programs, and tools to manage your long-term career.

Backed by marketing expertise, post-sale specialists, and industry-leading tools

About LocaliQ

At LocaliQ, the digital marketing division of USA TODAY Co., we help businesses grow by bringing together advanced marketing technology, trusted audience reach, and the expertise to turn it into results. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of digital marketing and one of the most trusted media networks in the country—helping businesses connect with customers across the full marketing funnel.

You’ll partner with clients to understand their goals, build strategies that combine performance-driven digital solutions with the reach of the USA TODAY Network, and deliver measurable outcomes. This is an opportunity to be part of a team that doesn’t just sell products. We bring together the right mix of solutions to drive real business growth.

About the Role

Our Integrated Media Specialist – Outside sales role is a consultative, relationship-driven sales position for someone who loves owning the full sales cycle—from net-new prospecting through long-term account growth—and who thrives in both hunting and managing client relationships.

In this role, you will actively hunt for net-new business, while also managing, growing, and expanding an ongoing book of clients. You’ll create tailored marketing strategies, guide businesses from first conversation through ongoing performance discussions, and continually identify opportunities to deepen partnerships over time. You’ll act as a trusted marketing partner—not a transactional seller—balancing new business development with retention, upsell, and account expansion to drive long-term client value.

Our Account Executive - Integrated Media Specialist role is partnered with a post-sales team that manages campaign performance, optimizes results, and prepares reporting. Additional support resources are available, including the Data and Insights team, Client Strategists, and other product-specific resources.

In your first 90 days, you’ll gain confidence in LocaliQ’s solutions, tools, and sales approach while building meaningful prospecting and discovery habits. By the end of this period, you’ll be owning your territory and sales cycle end-to-end, with the support and coaching needed to set you up for long-term success.

What You Will Do

Build a consistent prospecting cadence using cold calls, email, social outreach, networking, and in-person or virtual meetings to develop a strong pipeline.

Manage and grow a territory by balancing new business development, client retention, and account expansion.

Lead thoughtful discovery conversations to understand business goals, marketing challenges, and growth opportunities.

Build and present data-informed digital and traditional marketing proposals that connect strategy, tactics, and budget to client goals.

Own the full sales cycle—from initial outreach through close—while maintaining accurate CRM activity, pipeline management, and forecasting.

Partner with internal account management, creative, and strategy teams to support strong client outcomes.

Stay engaged post-sale through reporting, optimization, and performance conversations that support renewals and continued growth.

Qualifications

2+ years of B2B sales experience with success in new business development, account growth, or business development roles

Ability to run a full-cycle, consultative sales process—from discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close.

Strong prospecting skills across phone, email, social, networking, and relationship-based outreach.

Experience using CRM and sales tools with disciplined pipeline management and follow-up.

Comfort learning and discussing digital marketing solutions such as search, social, display, and video (direct experience is a plus, not required).

Excellent communication skills, business curiosity, and the ability to build credibility with diverse clients and stakeholders, influencing decisions through clear data-driven recommendations.

Proficiency with CRM, Microsoft Office Suite, and AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot.

Valid driver’s license and vehicle insurance

Who Thrives Here

High performers in this role are resilient, self-motivated, strategic and creative minded and competitive, with a strong drive to outperform and continuously take on greater impact. They are coachable and highly self-directed, comfortable initiating outreach, staying organized, asking thoughtful questions, and using data and tools to work efficiently. Energized by real-time results, they handle rejection well and maintain full ownership of their performance and trajectory.

Benefits

We believe high performance should be recognized and supported through compensation, development, and real opportunity to grow your skills.

Competitive base salary + Uncapped commission opportunity

401(k) with company match

Career Progression Opportunities

Flexibility and autonomy in a hybrid work environment

High-performance culture with recognition, incentives

Comprehensive health, dental & vision coverage options and more

Unlimited MTO time off, including paid holidays

Structured onboarding to get you ramped fast

Ongoing coaching from experienced leaders

Access to industry-leading tools, resources, and marketing expertise

Step into a territory where you can own the full sales cycle, bring smart marketing solutions to the table, and be recognized for the results you deliver. If you’re ready to grow your career and be part of a high-performing team, we encourage you to apply.

The annualized base salary for this role will range between $$55,000 - $65,000. Base compensation is reflective of many factors, including, but not limited to, the market in which one lives/works, individual education level, skills, certifications and experience. Note: variable compensation is not reflected in these figures and based on the role, may be applicable.

The New York Post delivers the best in news, sports, entertainment and pop culture with wit, irreverence, and authority. Over the past 225+ years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce.

job.title: TV Analyst
job.description:
About ASCAP

The American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers (ASCAP) is a membership association of more than one million songwriters, composers and music publishers, and represents some of the world’s most talented music creators. Founded and governed by songwriters, composers and publishers, it is the only performing rights organization in the U.S. that operates on a not-for-profit basis. ASCAP licenses a repertory of over 20 million musical works to hundreds of thousands of businesses that use music, including streaming services, cable television, radio and satellite radio and brick and mortar businesses such as retail stores, hotels, clubs, restaurants and bars. ASCAP collects the licensing fees; identifies, matches and processes trillions of performances every year; and returns nearly 90 cents of every dollar back to its members as royalties. The ASCAP blanket license offers an efficient solution for businesses to legally perform ASCAP music while respecting the right of songwriters and composers to be paid fairly. ASCAP puts music creators first, advocating for their rights and the value of music on Capitol Hill, driving innovation that moves the industry forward, building community and providing the resources and support that creators need to succeed in their careers. Learn more and stay in touch at www.ascap.com, on X and Instagram @ASCAP and on Facebook.

# # #

Job Overview:

The TV Analyst is responsible for assisting both the TV Team Leader and other TV Distribution team members with the processing of audio and visual programming, sharing in the overall responsibility of ensuring that ASCAP members are properly credited for the performance of their works in audio/visual media.

Successful completion of these efforts requires the careful analysis of television performance, promo, and cue sheet data. TV Analysts will associate programs and promos with performances, verify the accuracy of any data provided, procure and upload any missing data, identify and reconcile discrepancies, and participate in quality assurance procedures to ensure that ASCAP members are accurately paid. The TV Analyst position reports to the TV Team Leader, is situated within the TV Distribution department, and is based out of ASCAP’s New York City office. This is a hybrid position with currently a minimum 1 day per week in-office requirement.

Areas of Responsibility & Accountability:

  • Identify and match cue sheets to performances.
  • Request missing or incomplete cue sheets from suppliers.
  • Upload missing performances to the performance database.
  • Reconcile the station count and any informational discrepancies within performance data.
  • Verify cue sheet content.
  • Assign and create work records for cues.
  • Control check work records and performances that have been matched by 3rd party vendors.
  • Integrate music video programming into distribution.
  • Assist with the timely resolution of member-initiated inquiries.

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred, relevant work experience accepted.
  • 1+ years of relevant work experience.
  • Strong analytical skills and basic research adeptness.
  • Highly organized with the ability to prioritize.
  • Skilled at handling multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Access) and internet applications.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Self-starter, independent, and self-sufficient.
  • Ability to work and interact with team members on a remote basis.
  • Ability to connect and communicate with people at all levels of business and management.
  • Performs with both a positive attitude and commitment to being a team player.
  • Interest in music, music licensing, and/or the TV and Film industry is preferred.
  • This position currently requires the incumbent to be in the office one day per week. In-office requirements are subject to change.

Compensation/Benefits:

Besides providing a unique and dynamic work environment, there are a few other reasons you should consider ASCAP in your career planning. We also offer generous benefit options that are comprehensive and provide the flexibility that most employees want and need. These health care and financial plan options include the following:

  • A choice of either network-only provider medical and dental plans or more flexible medical and dental plans where you can see providers in or out-of-network
  • Vision plan that offers both in and out-of-network provider options
  • 401(k) Plan that offers pre-tax, Roth, and an after-tax employee contribution option, including a company match for pre-tax and Roth contributions
  • An additional employer paid discretionary profit share contribution, regardless of your participation in the 401(k) Plan
  • Generous time-off policy
  • Health care and dependent care flexible spending accounts
  • Short-term disability insurance/salary continuation and long-term disability insurance
  • Company-provided basic life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance
  • Employee gym discounts at select gyms
  • Commuter benefits
  • Voluntary pet health insurance
  • Voluntary auto and homeowner’s insurance
  • Voluntary employee, spouse, and dependent life insurance options
  • Voluntary ID protection coverage

The above summary of the current benefits is subject to the terms and conditions of the benefit plan documents. This summary is not complete and is subject to the terms of the underlying plan documents. Please note that ASCAP reserves the right to amend or otherwise revise or terminate, at any time and in its sole discretion, its benefit plans, programs, and policies.

Occasional travel for in-person meetings may be required.

job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a modern media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news content in an audience-first format. We are hiring a Production Manager to join the Axios Creative House team!

Why it matters: The Production Manager will drive the day-to-day execution of Axios Creative House’s custom video and visual content, serving as the primary production partner to Client Success and guiding complex programs from kickoff through launch with clear ownership, timelines, and communication.

Go Deeper: In this role, you will coordinate stakeholders, deliverables, approvals and production requirements while developing deep expertise in Airtable, ACH’s production operating system, to strengthen workflows, visibility and team adoption. This includes the following responsibilities and opportunities for impact:

  • Video + custom visual content production: Manage assigned video and custom web destination programs from kickoff through delivery.
    • Coordinate timelines, deliverables, approvals and handoffs across internal creative teams, external partners and client-facing teams.
    • Keep projects moving by proactively identifying dependencies, following up on outstanding needs and escalating risks when necessary.
  •  Client Success partnership: Serve as the primary Production point of contact for Client Success on assigned programs.
    • Provide clear guidance on production requirements, timelines, deliverables and next steps.
    • Maintain consistent visibility into project status so client-facing teams can communicate confidently with advertisers.
    • Help translate client needs and feedback into clear, actionable direction for production partners.
  • Cross-functional coordination: Connect the people and inputs required to successfully execute custom programs.
    • Partner closely with video, design and written leadership.
    • Coordinate internal and external production resources and ensure teams have the information, assets and approvals needed to deliver.
  • Launch readiness + quality control: Help ensure programs meet agreed-upon requirements and are ready to launch.
    • Track key milestones, approvals and dependencies throughout production.
    • Coordinate QA and final delivery checks across video and custom web experiences.
    • Surface timeline, scope or execution risks early and work with the Director of Production and project stakeholders to resolve them.
  • Production process + systems: Strengthen ACH production workflows through disciplined process management and hands-on ownership of the tools that support them.

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will embody an entrepreneurial spirit and passion for Axios’s mission. Required skills and experience include:

job.title: Deputy Digital Editor
job.description:
Join our team at the Guardian and be a part of a diverse and inclusive global organisation that delivers fearless, investigative journalism, and holds power to account. Our team of award-winning journalists, cutting-edge commercial professionals, and industry-leading digital experts are committed to making a difference and represent a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives. We offer a challenging and exciting environment for career development, with a focus on training, growth and fostering an inclusive culture.

 

We are looking for a deputy digital editor to support digital editors with day-to-day oversight of all GNM’s digital content.

 

You’ll play a crucial role in ensuring our digital presence is dynamic, engaging, and globally responsive. Supporting the head of digital (live), you’ll help oversee the flow of content across multiple platforms, ensuring breaking stories and live coverage are delivered with speed, accuracy, and creativity. 

 

In addition, you’ll deputise for the head of digital (live) and in their absence, manage the team of homepage editors.

 

This is a 9-month fixed-term contract or staff secondment, on a 9-day fortnight working pattern (including Saturdays).

 

About the role

  • Assist with running the day's digital output, working closely with desk editors and the digital editing team to respond in smart, imaginative ways to stories throughout the day.
  • Lead the digital desk on Saturdays to ensure our weekend online offering is well planned and promoted, as well as responding to live news as it happens
  • Manage the UK, Europe, and International homepages on a day-to-day basis.
  • Send breaking news alerts and oversee live blogs.
  • Work with design, visuals, video, community and audience teams to ensure the best possible expression of the Guardian’s digital output.
  • Work with planning teams and different desks to schedule content and to ensure meticulous preparation for live events.
  • Attend planning and ideas meetings to ensure the Guardian’s digital needs are reflected in commissioning decisions.
  • Attend meetings and work with colleagues in digital development to agree and shape plans to develop the Guardian’s digital storytelling.
  • Understand targets and metrics and build them into balanced editing judgments. 

 

About you

  • Significant experience of a live newsroom, ideally at a national or international news organisation
  • Strong understanding of content management systems (CMS), digital publishing, and analytics tools (e.g. Ophan)
  • Experience of editing homepages and articles
  • Understanding and knowledge or analytics, search and other measurements of digital audience and targets
  • Strong record of creativity and innovation in digital journalism
  • Proven track record of using social media channels to engage diverse audiences, adapt stories for platform-specific formats, and drive digital reach
  • Clear vision of the purpose and aims of the Guardian
  • Ideally you will have a demonstrable ability to bring a diverse perspective to the role.

 

We actively encourage applications from groups traditionally underrepresented in the UK media.

 

We operate in a hybrid environment working at least three days a week from our offices in King’s Cross in London.

 

The minimum salary for this NUJ position starts from £63,712, with a package commensurate with the skills, level of experience and responsibilities of the position.

 

How to apply

To apply, please upload your latest CV and a cover letter which outlines why you’d love to take on this role, and why you’re a great match for what we’re looking for. 

 

We appreciate the time taken to prepare each application we receive. We do not use AI-assisted technology to review applications; every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team. 

 

The closing date for applications is Thursday 12 November 2026.

 

All roles at the Guardian are open for everybody to apply. It is important to us that you feel supported and comfortable throughout your recruitment process, in order to perform your best. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to help your application, this includes providing documents in accessible formats or personalising the process to better support your needs. Please contact Sean on sean.brinkley@guardian.co.uk to discuss further so we can work with you to support you through your application.

 

Benefits at the Guardian

You'll have six weeks of annual leave per year pro rata (plus bank holidays) with the option to purchase an additional 5 days. Our pension scheme is generous; if you contribute 5% then we will contribute 8-12% (depending on your age). We believe in giving back, which is why employees are given 2 volunteering days annually and the option of payroll giving. Season ticket loans are also available.

 

You are entitled to life cover, income protection, and eye tests. You can also opt in to dental insurance.

 

We have enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental leave policies in place. We also support our employees by offering an IVF, menopause, baby loss, and trans equality policy.

 

Culture and wellbeing

We want everyone to feel like they belong at the Guardian and we champion diversity of thought. Our various employee forums provide a platform to use their voice to foster an inclusive workplace. We became the first major media organisation to achieve B Corp status.

 

We offer tools to help you prioritise your wellbeing including access to our employee benefits platform which provides tailored support for health and wellbeing. In addition, we also offer free yoga and pilates classes. These run alongside our corporate gym membership and cycle to work scheme.

 

Our canteen has views overlooking the Regents Canal and caters for breakfast, lunch and dinner.

 

Learning and development

We encourage personal and professional growth. Employees have access to a broad range of tools and solutions, and we are happy to support the pursuit of professional qualifications through vocational courses and apprenticeships.
