job.title: Senior Product Manager - 12 Month FTC
job.description:
About the FT

The Financial Times is one of the world's leading business news organisations, recognised internationally for its authority, integrity and accuracy.

Trust sits at the heart of the FT. That means not only producing journalism our readers can rely on, but also being thoughtful, transparent and responsible in how we design our products and use customer data.

Our Product & Technology organisation plays a central role in helping the FT deliver on this ambition, building products and experiences that serve our customers while supporting the long-term growth of the business.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager, Privacy to lead this important product area on a fixed-term basis, covering maternity leave until the end December, 2027.

The role

Privacy is an increasingly important part of the customer experience.

Customers should be able to understand how their information is used, make meaningful choices and feel confident that the FT acts responsibly with their data. Our ambition is to make privacy a reason for customers to trust the FT.

As Senior Product Manager for the Privacy team, you will lead the product strategy and roadmap for this area.

You will work across Product, Engineering, Design, Research, Data, Legal, Compliance, Marketing and commercial teams to turn complex customer, regulatory, technical and business needs into simple, trustworthy product experiences.

It is a product leadership role focused on how the FT can create clearer, simpler and more transparent experiences, while ensuring that privacy and responsible data use are embedded into the way we build products. 

You will help us work towards an ambition of being one of the most trusted digital organisations in how we handle customer data and privacy choices.

What you'll work on

You will lead the evolution of the FT's privacy and consent experience, including areas such as:

  • Customer trust: Identifying opportunities to strengthen trust through clear, transparent and respectful privacy experiences.
  • Customer choice: Making it easier for customers to understand and manage how their data is used.
  • Privacy experience: Creating simpler and more consistent experiences across customer journeys.
  • Responsible data use: Helping ensure that product teams use customer data in ways that are responsible, understandable and aligned with customer expectations.
  • Privacy by design: Working with teams across the FT to embed privacy thinking earlier in product and technology development.
  • Measurement and insight: Developing a better understanding of how customers interact with privacy choices and how those experiences affect trust and engagement.
  • Experimentation: Using customer research and responsible experimentation to improve how privacy choices are communicated and experienced.
  • Regulatory change: Working with Legal, Compliance and Data Governance colleagues to ensure that evolving requirements are translated into scalable and customer-friendly product solutions.
  • Product foundations: Helping improve the systems, processes and ownership models that support privacy experiences across the FT, powering more personalised journeys.

What you'll do

Set the product direction

Define and communicate a clear product vision, strategy and roadmap for the Privacy team

Identify the most important customer and business problems to solve and translate them into measurable outcomes.

Balance customer trust, regulatory responsibilities, product experience, technical sustainability and business needs when setting priorities.

Look beyond individual requirements or projects to build capabilities that can support the FT over the long term.

Champion the customer

Make the customer perspective central to privacy product decisions.

Work with Research, Design and Data teams to understand how customers perceive privacy, data use and consent.

Identify areas where experiences may be confusing, inconsistent or unnecessarily difficult.

Advocate for simple language, meaningful choices and experiences that help customers feel informed and in control.

Lead complex cross-functional work

Lead initiatives involving multiple product and technology teams and a wide range of business stakeholders.

Work closely with Engineering and Architecture colleagues to understand technical opportunities, constraints and dependencies.

Partner with Legal, Compliance and Data Governance teams to translate specialist requirements into effective customer and product solutions.

Build strong relationships across the FT and create alignment where different teams have competing needs or priorities.

Use evidence to make decisions

Define meaningful measures of success and use data and customer research to understand product performance.

Develop hypotheses and experiments that help improve customer understanding and trust.

Use external trends, industry developments and emerging best practice to inform product direction.

Ensure decisions are based on evidence while recognising the importance of judgement in areas involving trust and customer expectations.

Deliver outcomes

Take opportunities from problem definition and discovery through delivery, measurement and iteration.

Give cross-functional teams clear objectives and priorities.

Identify risks, dependencies and trade-offs early and help teams make good decisions.

Communicate strategy, progress, outcomes and decisions clearly to stakeholders at all levels of the organisation.

Provide senior product leadership

Bring clarity and structure to complex and ambiguous problems.

Influence teams and senior stakeholders without relying on formal authority.

Contribute to the wider Product community and help raise the quality of product thinking and practice.

Support and mentor other Product Managers where appropriate.

What you'll bring

We are looking for an experienced Product Manager who is comfortable working in complex, technically challenging and highly cross-functional environments.

You are likely to have:

  • Significant experience managing digital products or platforms.
  • A strong track record of defining product strategy and turning it into measurable outcomes.
  • Experience leading complex initiatives across multiple teams and stakeholder groups.
  • A strong customer focus and an ability to identify the underlying customer problem rather than simply respond to requirements.
  • Excellent judgement when balancing customer, business, technical and regulatory considerations.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience using data, customer research and experimentation to inform decisions.
  • The ability to turn complex or ambiguous problems into clear priorities and actions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience communicating with senior stakeholders.
  • Experience working closely with engineers, designers, researchers, analysts and other specialist disciplines.
  • An understanding of how product decisions contribute to both customer value and sustainable business outcomes.
  • A collaborative leadership style and the ability to influence without direct authority.

Experience that would be useful

You do not need to be a privacy lawyer or regulatory expert.

We are interested in experienced Product Managers who can learn a complex domain quickly and work effectively with specialist colleagues.

Experience in one or more of the following would be helpful:

  • Privacy, consent or customer preferences.
  • Customer identity or first-party data.
  • Personalisation or data-driven customer experiences.
  • Data governance.
  • Trust and safety.
  • Regulatory or highly regulated product environments.
  • Large-scale digital platforms or shared product capabilities.

Most importantly, you will care deeply about creating products that customers can trust.

What success looks like

Success in this role means helping the FT make privacy and responsible data use a stronger part of our customer proposition.

You will help us:

  • Create simpler and more understandable privacy experiences.
  • Give customers greater clarity and control over their choices.
  • Build stronger understanding of how privacy experiences affect customer trust.
  • Establish clearer product principles for the responsible use of customer data.
  • Embed privacy thinking more consistently into product development.
  • Improve the foundations that allow teams to deliver trustworthy experiences efficiently.
  • Build stronger alignment between customer needs, regulatory responsibilities and business priorities.
  • Develop a clear long-term product direction for Privacy & Trust.

Ultimately, we want customers to feel that the FT respects their choices, is transparent about how their data is used and consistently earns their trust.

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location, but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

We currently operate a hybrid model which requires staff to work onsite 50% of the time, subject to role requirements & regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for all roles. We believe this balanced approach supports flexibility and protects our culture, making collaboration and communication easier, building stronger relationships and team cohesion, and supporting peer learning.  We reserve discretion on reasonable notice to change this approach either generally or for specific individuals or teams. 

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help.

Further information

At the FT, we embrace innovation and the use of technology and appreciate that individuals may leverage AI tools as part of their job application process. Whilst we are happy for you to use AI to assist with your application, it is essential that all information provided is authentic and accurately represents your skills, experience, and qualifications.

Candidates should be aware that the use of AI throughout the application process may be monitored to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process for all.

job.title: Associate, Investor Relations
job.description:
Associate, Financial Practice, Investor Relations Specialist  

Brunswick Group is seeking an Associate to join our Financial practice. This individual will be an integrated member of the team who specializes in Investor Relations.

Brunswick was founded in 1987 as a financial communications firm, expertise that continues to differentiate us. For nearly four decades, Brunswick has consistently ranked at the top of our industry’s league tables on a country, regional, and global basis.

Our global Financial practice has unparalleled experience developing and implementing campaigns to advise clients on both long-term positioning to enhance valuation and navigating complex capital markets transactions. Members of our Financial practice are deeply experienced and focus their client work on strategic investor relations and financial communications, mergers & acquisitions, shareholder activism, IPOs, and restructuring. These specialists partner with global colleagues to bring a powerful and complementary combination of perspectives across stakeholders to help clients manage their reputations during critical financial events.

We are seeking an Associate to join the Financial practice who will specialize in advising Brunswick's leading corporate clients in integrating deep knowledge of investors into their strategic communications and decision making.

About the Role 

Client Contribution & Handling
  • Developing investor relations and financial communications engagement programs
  • Advising clients across industries on effectively communicating to investors at critical moments such as financial transactions and leadership transitions
  • Support management teams on financial calendar milestones such as earnings, conferences, and investor days
  • Analyzing complex financial information and developing strategic messaging to support valuation and help manage volatility
  • Develop plans to disseminate messaging across traditional and emerging communications channels to target members of the investor community
Team Management
  • Managing and mentoring team members; working with Partners and Directors on the day-to-day management of staff and client deliverables
  • Actively and effectively managing account teams and driving day-to-day activities for multiple clients at a time
  • Managing the development of key client documents, supporting drafting, editing and integrating feedback from across internal and client stakeholders.
  • Overseeing research assignments on fast-moving situations with tight deadlines; distilling a large amount of information into impactful insight and recommendations.
Networking
  • Playing an entrepreneurial role in supporting Brunswick’s Financial practice and strategic investor relations capability including thought leadership and new business development
  • Actively cultivating relationships with clients and potential clients
  • Developing relationships with the analyst and investor community 

What We're Looking For

  • 7-10+ years of relevant work experience in one or more of the following areas: investment banking, sell-side equity research, buy-side active asset management, in-house public company investor relations, investor relations advisory
  • Deep knowledge of the corporate finance, capital markets and U.S. public company investment landscape
  • Ability to anticipate and analyze market expectations, translate the investor perspective into effective communications to multiple stakeholders (shareholders, analysts, ratings agencies and financial media)
  • Ability to rapidly learn new sectors and companies, and operate with imperfect information
  • Ability to operate effectively in an entrepreneurial, fast-paced environment
  • Energetic team player with strong self-motivation
  • Operates with discretion and maintains confidentiality at all times
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, particularly when dealing with complex matters
  • Experience managing teams and passionate about mentoring junior staff
  • MBA degree or CFA certification preferable but not required

Why Join Us  

Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of exceptional employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.  

The successful applicant will be eligible for the following compensation and benefits package:  

Base Pay: The annual base compensation range for this role is $130,000 - $170,000. The base pay offered will be determined by factors including experience, skills, training, office location, certifications, and education.  

Bonus Eligibility: Annual discretionary bonus contingent upon individual and firm-wide performance.  

Benefits: Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance. Disability insurance. Employee assistance program. Flexible spending account. Health savings account. Life insurance. Commuter Benefits. Generous Paid Time Off: 25 vacation days and 10 days sick leave, as well as 11 paid company holidays. Firm-sponsored 401(k) Plan with 3% automatic company contribution of base and bonus with an additional 1.5% profit share– immediate vesting. Career training and development opportunities. Employee discounts. 

Office Policy: At Brunswick, our work is a craft that thrives in teaching environments – whether in our offices or on-site with clients – through real-time observation, collaboration, human connection, clear guidance and by challenging one another to keep getting better. Our policy is that our team members are in person – either in the office or on-site with clients – at least four days each week.  

The firm will provide reasonable accommodation to qualified applicants or employees, as defined by applicable law. In addition to the application, the process may include virtual and in-person interviews, as well as an assessment, which may be timed. To request an accommodation during our application and hiring process, email americasaccommodations@brunswickgroup.com. 

About Brunswick

Brunswick is a global advisory firm. We help companies tackle high-stakes issues, navigate complex stakeholder relationships, and deliver high-impact outcomes. 

Our clients value our ability to anticipate, shape, and respond to the key players and forces in the financial and investment arena, regulatory and geopolitical universe, NGO community, workforce and beyond. They rely on us for deep experience, fresh perspectives and original thinking. So, in Brunswick you will find an exceptional range of experience and talent with a rich mix of backgrounds. From the beginning, we have prioritized attracting, developing, and retaining the best professionals in the industry, united by a culture of inclusivity, excellence, and intellectual curiosity.

Founded in 1987 in London, the firm has organically grown to 27 offices in 18 countries across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia and Australia. We operate as a “one-firm firm” with no individual profit centers. This allows us to assemble fully integrated, bespoke teams for each client, able to draw on the full resources of Brunswick anywhere in the world. 

 

Brunswick is an equal opportunity employer.  All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law. Please read our Global Privacy Notice to understand how your data is managed.

job.title: Stagiair Global Public Affairs – Focus op Nederlandse Politiek
job.description:
Stagiair Global Public Affairs – Focus op Nederlandse Politiek

 

FGS The Hague zoekt een stagiair Global Public Affairs van 1 februari 2027 tot 31 juli 2027.

FGS Global is het toonaangevende stakeholderstrategie-bureau ter wereld, met ongeveer 1.800 professionals wereldwijd, die klanten adviseren bij het navigeren door kritieke vraagstukken en reputatie-uitdagingen. FGS is ontstaan uit de samenvoeging van Finsbury, The Glover Park Group, Hering Schuppener en Sard Verbinnen & Co om advies op bestuursniveau en aan de C-suite te bieden op alle aspecten van stakeholderstrategie — waaronder corporate reputatie, crisismanagement en public affairs — en is tevens de toonaangevende kracht in transactie- en financiële communicatie wereldwijd.

Onze Global Public Affairs experts in Den Haag adviseren bedrijven over de impact van politieke, maatschappelijke en economische ontwikkelingen op hun businessmodel en over hun strategische positionering. Dit omvat ondersteuning bij belangenbehartiging, media-engagement en het schrijven van analyses en aanbevelingen voor een optimale organisatie van Global Public Affairs.

 

Welke taken kun je verwachten?

  • Als stagiair maak je vanaf dag één deel uit van ons team en maak je het dagelijkse werk van een Public Affairs consultant van dichtbij mee. Je bent veel bezig met het monitoren van politieke en maatschappelijke ontwikkelingen in Nederland.
  • Je woont relevante Tweede Kamerdebatten en evenementen bij, en maakt hiervan verslagen. Daarnaast volg je het nieuws op de voet. Je maakt media-analyses over politieke ontwikkelingen en stelt briefings op voor collega’s en klanten.
  • Je ondersteunt collega’s bij de ontwikkeling en uitvoering van strategieën om het Nederlandse publieke beleid en het bijbehorende mediadebat positief te beïnvloeden.
  • Je schrijft briefings over o.a. Kamerleden, ambtenaren, en andere stakeholders.
  • Je leert hoe politieke communicatie werkt en ondersteunt bij het schrijven van persberichten, position papers, en andere stukken.
  • Let op: Voor deze stagepositie ligt de focus op de Nederlandse politiek - nationaal én lokaal. Europese en internationale ontwikkelingen komen aan bod waar ze de nationale agenda raken. Ben je meer geïnteresseerd in buitenlandse/EU politiek, kijk dan ook eens naar vacatures bij ons kantoor in Brussel.

 

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je volgt momenteel een bachelor- en/of masteropleiding – de studierichting is minder belangrijk dan je enthousiasme voor politiek en communicatie;
  • Een achtergrond in bijvoorbeeld Bestuurskunde, Politicologie, (Politieke) Communicatiewetenschap, Economie, Europese en/of Internationale Betrekkingen of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied is een pré.
  • Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en hebt een goede beheersing van de Engelse taal;
  • Je bent nieuwsgierig, proactief, zelfstandig en breed geïnteresseerd in de raakvlakken tussen het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven/economie en politiek/maatschappij;
  • Je beschikt over sterke analytische vaardigheden en bent een bewezen teamspeler;
  • Je kunt complexe ideeën effectief overbrengen, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk;

 

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Kennis van hoe de Nederlandse politiek écht werkt: hoe beleid wordt gevormd en waar de mogelijkheden liggen om daar invloed op uit te oefenen.
  • Inzicht in de activiteiten van een strategisch adviesbureau en in verschillende expertisegebieden als onderdeel van onze geïntegreerde projectteams;
  • Interessante en gevarieerde taken in een internationale en inspirerende werkomgeving;
  • Individuele begeleiding en ondersteuning, evenals gedetailleerde feedback van een ervaren consultant;
  • Een betrokken, collegiaal en groeiend team waarin respect en teamspirit centraal staan;
  • Een bedrijfscultuur die excellentie combineert met vriendelijkheid, en veel gezellige teamactiviteiten in het hart van Den Haag;
  • Je ontvangt een stagevergoeding;
  • Duur: 6 maanden, 40 uur per week.

 

Voldoe je niet aan alle eisen? Geen zorgen! Onderzoek wijst uit dat sommige groepen minder snel solliciteren als ze niet aan alle eisen voldoen. Bij FGS Global streven we naar een divers, inclusief en authentiek werkklimaat. Dus als je enthousiast bent over deze functie en ons bedrijf, maar je eerdere ervaring niet volledig aansluit op elke kwalificatie in de vacature, moedigen we je toch aan om te solliciteren. Misschien ben jij wel de juiste kandidaat voor deze of een andere rol.

We kijken uit naar je sollicitatie. Neem gerust contact op met ons HR-team via careers-eu@fgsglobal.com.

job.title: WPP Production | Transcreation Account Manager, Japan
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

The Role:

The Transcreation Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for project managing localisation work for the clients Marketing Communications (Marcom) team. The TAM works closely with the clients Marcom Project Manager and a network of creative talents from various markets. This person needs to engage with other cross-functional teams of producers and project managers to ensure work is delivered on time, on quality and within budget. Constant need to communicate and negotiate priorities and deadlines with internal and external teams to ensure expectations are well managed is required. Primary tasks include organising and coordinating schedules, distributing workload, tracking progress of projects and allocated budget.

 

You will be responsible for project managing localization projects (incl. Transcreation of headlines) ensuring good communication with all stakeholders.

 

You will focus on building strong relationship with the Client Talent Network and briefing new projects accurately. Strong organization and time management skills when managing Clients, with focus on quality.

 

Key Responsibilities:

Validator Network Management

  • Ensure a thorough understanding of the contractual obligations, commercial arrangements, SOW and SLAs of the accounts and ensure specific details are understood by the wider team where relevant
  • Manage a network of creative people and ensure they are motivated to perform
  • Coordinate weekly status meetings/monthly review sessions
  • Organize teamwork, create a balanced work schedule and ensure work is of high standards and delivered on time
  • Flag any potential team issues to the line manager and be actively involved in finding a solution
  • Review talent performance and drive constant performance improvement by working closely with talent manager and providing regular feedback on all talent
  • Highlight and resolve quality control issues with the network

 

Project & Account Management

  • Coordinate and ensure all parties follow the agreed workflows and manage them through the process
  • Work alongside and support client’s Traffic Manager when briefing and tracking projects through to completion
  • Ensure that there is clear division and allocation of workload among team members
  • Ensure that trackers are updated at all times
  • Monitor timelines and manage client expectations
  • Monitor budget utilization and flag potential issues
  • Monitor internal workflows and identify areas for improvement
  • Advise line manager on resource gaps and flag potential issues
  • Plan resources for large overseas projects and inform talent manager and line manager of new recruitment needs
  • Work closely with talent manager in delivering recruitment briefs on time
  • Ensure account delivers consistently against all contractual obligations including SLAs and KPIs
  • Identify bottle necks/pain points for the validation network, suggest resolution and advise
  • Identify training requirements for team members to ensure their adherence to processes and workflow
  • Plan, prepare and implement the induction of new starters
  • Lead overseas projects for up to 3 weeks (2 – 3 times per year)

 

Finance Management

  • Quarterly planning
  • Regular budget spend reports – monitor and analyse progression of spends
  • Flag important budget fluctuations, peaks to the Client and line manager and track spend progress
  • Monthly financial reconciliation
  • Ensure full compliance with all financial procedures and policies

 

Client Management

  • Co-ordinate between all relevant parties: Hogarth team, Client traffic and cross-functional teams and Validation network
  • Set and manage client expectations for deliverables and timeframes
  • Understand and work under the confidentiality policy
  • Build strong, trusting relationships with all key client stakeholders

 

Requirements:

  • A minimum of 4 years Project Management/Traffic background in an ad agency or in-house creative department
  • Experience managing multi-market projects
  • Experience working on global brands, ideally across all media, including print, interactive and film
  • Demonstrable experience managing total creative workflow, i.e, internal briefing, briefing to vendors/studios, managing key milestones/deadlines, presentations/internal approvals, executions, delivery
  • Proven project management skills
  • Self-driven, organized and have an eye for detail
  • Proficient with technology and tools
  • Ability to work effectively and collaboratively in high-pressure situations and tight time frames
  • A hands-on, can do approach to solving problems
  • Fluent written and spoken English and Japanese
  • Must be able to travel as required, sometimes several weeks at a time

ポジション概要

**Transcreation Account Manager（TAM）**は、クライアントのマーケティングコミュニケーション（Marcom）チームにおける、ローカライゼーション案件のプロジェクトマネジメントを担当するポジションです。

クライアント側のMarcom Project Managerや、各市場のクリエイティブ人材ネットワークと密接に連携しながらプロジェクトを進行します。また、プロデューサーやプロジェクトマネージャーなどの部門横断チームとも協働し、納期・品質・予算を管理しながら、プロジェクトを円滑に進行することが求められます。

社内外の関係者と継続的にコミュニケーションを取り、優先順位や納期を調整・交渉しながら、関係者の期待値を適切にマネジメントすることも重要な役割です。

主な業務には、スケジュールの策定・調整、業務の割り振り、プロジェクトの進捗管理、予算管理などが含まれます。

また、ヘッドラインのトランスクリエーションを含むローカライゼーションプロジェクト全体を管理し、すべてのステークホルダーとの円滑なコミュニケーションを図ります。

Client Talent Networkとの良好な関係構築や、新規プロジェクトにおける正確なブリーフィングも担当します。品質を重視しながら複数の案件やクライアントを管理するため、高い組織力とタイムマネジメント能力が求められます。

主な業務内容

Validator Network Management

バリデーターネットワークの管理

  • 担当アカウントにおける契約上の義務、商務条件、SOW（業務範囲記述書）、SLA（サービスレベル合意書）を十分に理解し、必要に応じてチーム全体にも共有・浸透させる
  • クリエイティブ人材のネットワークを管理し、パフォーマンスを発揮できる環境を整える
  • 週次のステータスミーティングおよび月次レビューを調整・運営する
  • チームの業務を整理し、適切なワークロードを設定するとともに、高い品質を維持しながら期限内に業務が完了するよう管理する
  • チーム内で発生する可能性のある問題を上長に共有し、解決策の検討・実行に積極的に関与する
  • Talent Managerと密接に連携し、各メンバーへの定期的なフィードバックを通じて継続的なパフォーマンス向上を支援する
  • ネットワーク内で発生する品質管理上の課題を特定し、解決する

Project & Account Management

プロジェクト・アカウント管理

  • 関係者間の調整を行い、合意されたワークフローに沿ってプロジェクトが進行するよう管理する
  • クライアント側のTraffic Managerと連携し、プロジェクトのブリーフィングから進捗管理、完了までをサポートする
  • チームメンバー間の役割・業務分担を明確にする
  • 各種プロジェクトトラッカーを常に最新の状態に保つ
  • スケジュールを管理し、クライアントの期待値を適切にコントロールする
  • 予算の使用状況をモニタリングし、問題が発生する可能性がある場合は早期に共有する
  • 社内ワークフローを確認し、改善できる領域を特定する
  • リソース不足や潜在的な問題について上長に報告・提案する
  • 大規模な海外プロジェクトのリソース計画を行い、新たな採用が必要となる場合はTalent Managerおよび上長へ共有する
  • Talent Managerと連携し、必要な採用要件・ブリーフを適切なタイミングで提供する
  • SLAやKPIを含む、契約上求められるサービス水準を継続的に達成できるよう管理する
  • Validation Networkにおけるボトルネックや課題を特定し、改善策を提案する
  • チームメンバーがプロセスやワークフローを適切に遵守できるよう、必要なトレーニングを特定する
  • 新入社員のオンボーディングについて計画・準備・実施する
  • 年2～3回程度、最長3週間の海外プロジェクトをリードする

Finance Management

予算・財務管理

  • 四半期ごとの計画策定
  • 定期的な予算使用状況レポートの作成、および支出状況のモニタリング・分析
  • 大きな予算変動や支出の増加が発生した場合、クライアントおよび上長へ共有し、その後の支出状況を管理する
  • 月次の財務照合作業
  • すべての財務関連プロセスおよびポリシーを遵守する

Client Management

クライアントマネジメント

  • Hogarthチーム、クライアント側Trafficチーム、部門横断チーム、Validation Networkなど、すべての関係者間の調整を行う
  • 成果物および納期についてクライアントの期待値を設定・管理する
  • 機密保持に関するポリシーを理解し、それに沿って業務を遂行する
  • クライアント側の主要なステークホルダーと、強固で信頼性の高い関係を構築する

応募要件

  • 広告代理店または事業会社のインハウスクリエイティブ部門における、4年以上のプロジェクトマネジメントまたはトラフィックマネジメント経験
  • 複数の国・市場にまたがるプロジェクトを管理した経験
  • グローバルブランドに携わった経験。印刷物、デジタル／インタラクティブ、映像など、複数のメディアに関する経験があれば尚可
  • クリエイティブ制作の一連のワークフローを管理した実務経験
    （社内ブリーフィング、ベンダー／スタジオへのブリーフィング、マイルストーン・納期管理、プレゼンテーション、社内承認、制作・実行、納品など）
  • 優れたプロジェクトマネジメント能力
  • 自発的に行動でき、高い組織力と細部への注意力を持っている方
  • テクノロジーや各種ツールの活用に抵抗がない方
  • プレッシャーの高い状況や短い納期の中でも、周囲と協力しながら効果的に業務を進められる方
  • 課題に対して自ら手を動かし、前向きに解決に取り組める方
  • 英語および日本語で、ビジネス上必要な読み書き・会話が流暢にできること
  • 必要に応じて出張が可能であること。場合によっては数週間の出張となることがあります

job.title: Learning & Development Coordinator
job.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

The Learning & Development (L&D) Coordinator supports the planning and day-to-day delivery of learning programs. Working under the guidance of the ONWARD Connected Lead and program managers, this role helps keep timelines, participant communications, enrollment details, logistics, records, and follow-up activities organized and on track.

The L&D Coordinator partners with subject matter experts (SMEs), facilitators, Learning Operations, Learning Communications, Learning Impact, Connected Capabilities Leads, Learning & Performance Business Partners (LPBPs), HR Business Partners (HRBPs), and external vendors. The role is suited to an early-career professional who is organized, service-minded, eager to learn, and ready to build program coordination skills while contributing to a positive participant experience.

This is for UK Shift. 

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

Program Planning & Coordination

  • Help maintain program calendars, workplans, schedules, task trackers, and key deadlines; update them as plans change.
  • Gather planning information from program leads, SMEs, facilitators, Learning Operations, and other partners, and keep shared materials current.
  • Coordinate routine details across program activities such as marketing, nominations, preparation, delivery, evaluation, and follow-up.

Nominations & Participant Administration

  • Support nomination and enrollment activities using established criteria, processes, forms, and timelines, in partnership with Learning Business Partners.
  • Maintain participant lists, registration status, waitlists, and alumni records, checking information for accuracy and completeness.
  • Prepare participant rosters and provide enrollment details to Learning Operations and other partners as requested.
  • Track participation changes or gaps and bring them to the program lead's attention for review and follow-up.

Participant Communications & Support

  • Prepare and send routine participant communications using approved templates and guidance, including invitations, welcome information, reminders, logistics, and follow-up resources.
  • Help keep communication plans, templates, FAQs, and send dates organized and up to date.
  • Monitor program inboxes or communication channels; respond to routine questions using approved information and route complex or sensitive issues to the appropriate partner.
  • Provide timely, courteous support and help participants understand where to find program information and materials.

Digital & On-Demand Program Support

  • Responsible for LMS setup and enrollment following established processes.
  • Check that program information such as descriptions, dates, links, prerequisites, and instructions matches the approved source materials.
  • Use available reports to track enrollment, progress, and completion; send reminders according to the program plan and share potential concerns with the program lead.
  • Record access or technical issues and route them to Learning Operations or the appropriate support contact.

Program Logistics & Delivery

  • Use program checklists to help prepare virtual sessions, including meeting links, platform settings, breakout rooms, recordings, and technology checks.
  • Coordinate in-person logistics such as room arrangements, audiovisual needs, materials, and onsite details with the relevant partners.
  • Organize and distribute agendas, participant materials, facilitator resources, and other approved program content.
  • Support session-day operations, maintain attendance records, and share required information with Learning Operations for tracking and reporting.
  • Help identify logistical gaps early and bring them to the program lead's attention.

Evaluation, Reporting & Follow-Up

  • Help prepare and distribute program evaluations, surveys, and pulse checks; monitor responses and send planned reminders.
  • Compile attendance, enrollment, completion, and evaluation information in established trackers or templates.
  • Prepare basic status updates and summaries for review by the program lead; flag notable feedback, recurring questions, or participation issues.
  • Keep follow-up tasks and resource distribution organized after program sessions.

Documentation & Process Support

  • Maintain shared program files, calendars, participant records, and materials so information is current, easy to find, and appropriately organized.
  • Follow established version-control, privacy, data-handling, and governance practices when working with program materials and participant information.
  • Update FAQs, checklists, standard operating procedures, and other program documentation as directed.
  • Share practical ideas with the team for making recurring coordination tasks clearer, more consistent, or more efficient

EDUCATION, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

  • Minimum 3 years' experience in Learning & Development.
  • Organization & attention to detail: Keeps information accurate and follows through on assigned tasks and deadlines.
  • Clear communication: Writes and speaks courteously, shares updates, and asks questions when expectations are unclear.
  • Service mindset: Responds helpfully to participant and stakeholder needs and knows when to seek support.
  • Teamwork & learning agility: Collaborates well, accepts feedback, and builds knowledge of learning program operations over time.
  • Coordination & prioritization: Tracks multiple tasks, adapts to changing details, and raises capacity or timing concerns early.
  • Problem solving & judgment: Notices issues, gathers relevant details, and escalates appropriately rather than making unsupported decisions.
  • Comfort with digital tools: Willingness to learn collaboration, scheduling, learning-management, and survey tools used by the team.

job.title: MarTech Platform Specialist
job.description:
Overview

Called to K-LOVE

 

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

 

At K-LOVE, every role is ministry.

 

We hire first for ministry alignment and a shared commitment to our faith, mission, vision, and values. We then seek talented professionals who can use their God-given gifts, skills, and experience to serve with excellence.

 

If you love Jesus and are called to be part of a ministry that places Christ at the center of everything we do, we invite you to explore this opportunity. If your heart aligns with our mission and you possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for the role, please keep reading.

 

Join K-LOVE as a MarTech Platform Specialist and use your technical expertise, data insights, and collaborative skills to power multichannel marketing campaigns that advance our ministry’s mission!

 

Here's some of what you will be doing:

  • Own the technical configuration, audience segmentation, and optimization framework for Braze email campaigns, Canvases, and related messaging, while enabling marketing and digital teams to execute simpler day-to-day campaigns independently.
  • Implement and refine Braze segmentation, Liquid personalization, and testing strategies to improve email performance and audience experience.
  • Partner with digital teams to guide quality assurance for Braze email campaigns, including setup, Liquid-driven personalized content, link tracking, inbox rendering, deliverability, and launch readiness.
  • Build and troubleshoot forms, landing pages, templates, and related technical components in partnership with digital and web teams.
  • Create, interpret, and communicate Braze email, audience, and journey performance insights using marketing platforms, CRM tools, and related data sources.
  • Use SQL, platform tools, and troubleshooting methods to investigate data issues, campaign behavior, and integration needs, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Develop and maintain HTML, CSS, and related technical components that support Braze email templates, modular content blocks, and campaign assets.
  • Maintain and help improve campaign standards, UTM tracking practices, naming conventions, and operational documentation that support Braze email execution.
  • Lead the technical development, testing, launch, optimization, and reporting of complex Braze Canvases, triggered campaigns, and related email initiatives, while supporting scalable execution by marketing and digital teams.
  • Partner with campaign managers, developers, analysts, and business stakeholders to align on technical requirements, support scalable execution, and strengthen Braze campaign operations across teams.
  •  

Here's some experience we are seeking: 

  • 2-5 years' experience, with practical experience and expertise in one domain.
  • Advanced working knowledge of Braze, including email campaign setup, Canvas orchestration, audience segmentation, and message configuration, with the ability to manage more complex execution independently.
  • Hands-on experience with Liquid and related templating approaches to support Braze personalization and dynamic email content.
  • Strong data analysis skills with the ability to interpret Braze email performance, audience behavior, segmentation opportunities, and journey trends.
  • Proficiency in HTML, CSS, APIs, webhooks, and related technical solutions that support Braze email templates, campaign builds, and platform integrations.
  • Experience executing and optimizing Braze email campaigns, triggered messages, Canvases, and related push or in-app messaging with increasing complexity.
  • Proficiency in UTM parameters, link tracking, and measurement practices that support Braze email reporting and attribution.
  • Working knowledge of SQL for data analysis, troubleshooting, reporting support, and investigation of campaign or data issues.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce CRM and related customer data used to support marketing initiatives.
  •  

What can we offer you?

  • Industry leading Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
  • Short/long term disability and life insurance
  • Robust 401K with company match
  • Parental leave with Baby Bonding pay
  • Generous PTO, holiday and sick pay
  • Unique company culture that includes exclusive access to concerts, movie premieres, media industry events, and more
  • Leadership and Career Development Programs

Why work for K-LOVE? 

K-LOVE is a nonprofit, multi-platform media company on a mission to draw people closer to Christ. Founded in 1982 in Santa Rosa, CA, with a singular radio station, K-LOVE today owns and operates the nation's two largest Christian music radio networks (K-LOVE and Air1) with over 1,000 broadcast signals across all 50 states, streaming audio reaching around the world, and a growing family of media ministries including podcasts, books, films, concerts, and events. K-LOVE employs nearly 500 team members between its office in Nashville, TN and field locations around the country. You can view our mission and values here Mission, Beliefs & Values.

 

“As an Equal Opportunity Employer, K-LOVE makes employment decisions based on merit and other legitimate reasons. The Company is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment and equal employment opportunities regardless of protected class, characteristic or status. However, K-LOVE is a religious non-profit organization where all team members contribute to the Company’s mission of encouraging our audiences “to have a meaningful relationship with Christ.” Therefore, pursuant to the Civil Rights Act of 1964, Section 702 (42 U.S.C. 2000e I(a)), K-LOVE has the right to hire only candidates who agree with the Company’s Statement of Faith, Mission, Vision, and Values. Also, as a religious non-profit organization, the Company is not governed by the CA Fair Employment and Housing Act.”

Overview

Called to K-LOVE

 

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

 

At K-LOVE, every role is ministry.

 

We hire first for ministry alignment and a shared commitment to our faith, mission, vision, and values. We then seek talented professionals who can use their God-given gifts, skills, and experience to serve with excellence.

 

If you love Jesus and are called to be part of a ministry that places Christ at the center of everything we do, we invite you to explore this opportunity. If your heart aligns with our mission and you possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for the role, please keep reading.

 

Join our team as a Systems Technician I, helping maintain reliable, high-quality national radio broadcast and IT networks while building hands-on expertise in RF, IP, and control systems.

 

Here's some of what you will be doing:

  • Monitor network alerts and support basic system health across the national broadcast and IT infrastructure using remote control platforms and network monitoring tools.
  • Assist in troubleshooting audio, RF, and control systems by following standard diagnostic procedures and escalating complex issues as needed.
  • Perform support tasks such as cable fabrication, labeling, soldering, and minor equipment-level repairs (e.g., XLR, RJ45, BNC cabling) under supervision.
  • Document work activities accurately by updating incident logs, work orders, and support tickets; contribute to wiring diagrams and equipment records.
  • Collaborate with Field Team Members and Technology teams to ensure uninterrupted service and consistent broadcast quality.
  • Support preparation of transmitter and activity logs, and assist in compliance-related reporting including telemetry analysis under direction.
  • Make adjustments to Network Operations Center equipment and settings to support uptime, under direction.
  • May participate in scheduled shift coverage, on-call rotations, and event-based escalation support, as assigned.
  • Engage proactively with teammates, supporting a cooperative team environment and contributing to shared goals.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

Here's some experience we are seeking: 

  • Associate degree in IT Networking or Broadcast Technology preferred, or equivalent experience
  • Demonstrable competence with basic principles of broadcast technology and network operations.
  • Proficiency in English (written and verbal) for effective asynchronous communication.
  • Ability to follow direction, provide status updates, and complete assigned tasks with minimal oversight.
  • Willingness to approach troubleshooting iteratively and communicate clearly about technical issues.
  • Positive and solution-oriented mindset with a strong commitment to learning and team integration.
  • Strong organizational habits and self-motivation to manage work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Open to mentorship and development through hands-on experience.
  • Demonstrated alignment with the values and mission of the Ministry.
  • A collaborative and flexible style, with a strong service mentality. Need to be seen as a team player.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to develop sincere business/Ministry relationships.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
  •  

What can we offer you?

  • Industry leading Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
  • Short/long term disability and life insurance
  • Robust 401K with company match
  • Parental leave with Baby Bonding pay
  • Generous PTO, holiday and sick pay
  • Unique company culture that includes exclusive access to concerts, movie premieres, media industry events, and more
  • Leadership and Career Development Programs

 

Why work for K-LOVE? 

K-LOVE is a nonprofit, multi-platform media company on a mission to draw people closer to Christ. Founded in 1982 in Santa Rosa, CA, with a singular radio station, K-LOVE today owns and operates the nation's two largest Christian music radio networks (K-LOVE and Air1) with over 1,000 broadcast signals across all 50 states, streaming audio reaching around the world, and a growing family of media ministries including podcasts, books, films, concerts, and events. K-LOVE employs nearly 500 team members between its office in Nashville, TN and field locations around the country. You can view our mission and values here Mission, Beliefs & Values.

KELO - 1320-AM | Where South Dakota businesses and agriculture meet. 


From our small businesses to the farmers and ranchers feeding our communities, South Dakota’s economy is built by people with stories worth tuning in for. Main Street & The Farm is a brand-new two-hour program on KELO Radio dedicated to sharing those stories, exploring local economic issues, and connecting listeners with the people shaping our state. Fox News Media

FOX News Media operates the FOX News Channel (FNC), FOX Business Network (FBN), FOX News Digital, FOX News Audio, FOX News Books, the direct-to-consumer digital streaming services FOX Nation and FOX News International and the newly announced platform FOX Weather. Currently the number one network in all of cable, FNC has also been the most watched television news channel for 20 consecutive years, while FBN currently ranks among the top business channels on cable. Owned by FOX Corporation, FOX News Media reaches 200 million people each month.

JOB DESCRIPTION

FOX News is seeking a creative, resourceful, and highly motivated Freelance Producer to join our Washington, D.C. Bureau. You’ll work closely with reporters, editors, and bureau staff to develop compelling live shots and packages. Responsibilities include pitching story ideas, gathering information, arranging interviews, writing scripts, coordinating logistics, building graphics, monitoring breaking news, and identifying strong editorial elements, visuals, and sound. The ideal candidate is an experienced journalist with excellent editorial judgment who thrives in breaking news situations. You remain calm under pressure, make confident independent decisions, and are passionate about bringing stories to life on air.

 

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work closely with reporters to produce compelling, visually engaging live shots and packages
  • Collaborate with editors to shape footage, sound, and visuals into a cohesive story that reflects the reporter’s editorial vision
  • Recommend interview subjects and coordinate, schedule, and conduct interviews on behalf of reporters
  • Gather the latest sound and video, log events, and identify and flag important news developments
  • Monitor news wires, social media, and other broadcast networks for breaking news and emerging stories
  • Build graphics, banners, and lower-thirds/CGs to support live coverage and packages
  • Pitch timely, creative story ideas that resonate with the Fox News audience
  • Provide editorial and logistical support during breaking news and major events

 

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent experience

job.description:
Working at QVC Group means joining a live social shopping company with incredible teams, ambitious projects and rewarding careers. QVC Group, Inc. is a Fortune 500 company with six leading retail brands - QVC®, HSN®, Ballard Designs®, Frontgate®, Garnet Hill® and Grandin Road®.

Your Opportunity, Your Team


The Senior Media Operations Technician helps keep QVC’s live broadcast and transmission operating reliably across broadcast platforms and streams. You’ll oversee incoming live and remote feeds, monitor channel output, and respond to technical issues where fast, accurate troubleshooting matters.

You’ll work across Media Operations, production, and engineering as a senior technical resource. You’ll also share your expertise with less experienced colleagues and help maintain consistent operating practices.

job.title: Executive Reporter, KTNV
job.description:
Scripps-owned KTNV, the ABC affiliate in Las Vegas, is looking for a Executive Reporter who believes great journalism starts with great storytelling. In this leadership role, you’ll help elevate the craft across the newsroom, working alongside reporters and MMJs to create authentic, meaningful stories that connect with the Las Vegas community.


You’ll bring a sharp editorial eye, a passion for developing people, and the ability to turn everyday assignments into memorable journalism. You’ll also partner with newsroom leaders to bring our content strategy to life across platforms while maintaining the highest journalistic standards. If you’re an accomplished storyteller who gets energized by helping other journalists grow, this is an opportunity to make an impact both inside the newsroom and throughout the community we serve.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Lead the development and enhancement of storytelling skills for reporters and MMJs across the newsroom.
  • Coach and mentor journalists at all experience levels, helping them discover creative ways to strengthen their reporting, writing, and storytelling.
  • Collaborate with newsroom leaders to consistently execute the station’s content strategy through authentic, meaningful journalism.
  • Oversee story writing and development across platforms, providing timely and actionable feedback that encourages continuous improvement.
  • Develop and supervise effective workflows, strategies, and procedures supporting multiple news programs and platforms.
  • Ensure content consistently meets journalistic standards and ethical guidelines.
  • Create and communicate a clear storytelling vision that builds trust among reporters, photographers, and other newsroom colleagues.
  • Contribute on-air and multi-platform coverage during breaking news when needed.
  • Support evolving newsroom priorities and perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline preferred, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Generally 7+ years of experience in journalism, news, storytelling, or a related field preferred.
  • A valid driver’s license and ability to meet applicable driving requirements for the role.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Demonstrated expertise in compelling, community-focused storytelling.
  • Strong editorial judgment and a thorough understanding of journalistic ethics and libel laws.
  • Genuine curiosity about the people, issues, and events shaping Las Vegas, Nevada, and the world.
  • A deep understanding of content strategy and how strong storytelling can serve audiences across platforms.
  • A coaching mindset and a passion for helping journalists develop their craft and reach their potential.
  • The ability to collaborate, communicate a creative vision, and establish trust across a newsroom.
  • Sound judgment and composure in a fast-moving news environment where priorities and deadlines can change quickly.
  • Flexibility to work a variety of shifts, including nights, weekends, early mornings, and holidays.
  • Ability and willingness to work onsite and drive as required to fulfill job responsibilities.

OUR TEAM:

At KTNV, you’ll join a newsroom united by curiosity, creativity, and a commitment to serving the community through meaningful journalism. Our team brings different backgrounds, experiences, interests, and perspectives to the stories we tell. We value collaboration, thoughtful feedback, strong editorial standards, and the willingness to keep improving our craft. As Executive Reporter, you’ll play an important role in creating an environment where journalists learn from one another, take creative approaches to storytelling, and do work that matters to the people of Las Vegas.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Las Vegas offers much more than its world-famous entertainment corridor. The region combines big-city energy with distinctive neighborhoods, a thriving food and entertainment scene, and countless opportunities to discover the people and stories that make Southern Nevada unique. For a curious journalist, it’s a dynamic community with no shortage of stories to tell.


Outside of work, Las Vegas puts the outdoors within easy reach, from desert landscapes and hiking to nearby recreation and scenic escapes. It’s a place where entertainment, culture, community, and the natural beauty of the Southwest come together, giving you plenty to explore when you’re off the clock.

Scripps is looking for a Sr. Analyst, Local Digital Inventory to manage and optimize digital video and connected TV inventory across our local station streaming and website properties. In this role, you'll lead inventory forecasting, allocation, availability analysis, sponsorship planning, and performance reporting — all in direct support of our revenue goals and advertiser commitments. Working hand in hand with Sales, Ad Operations, Finance, Product, and technology teams, you'll drive sell-through and yield improvements while protecting both campaign delivery and the viewer experience. If you're energized by solving complex inventory challenges in a fast-moving, collaborative environment, this is the opportunity for you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Create and maintain calendar templates to track sold sponsorships and HPTOs.
  • Analyze avails and sponsorships that maximize inventory to reach budgetary goals.
  • Manage software integration to and from WideOrbit traffic and Order Management System.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues with sponsorships not running on pages correctly.
  • Create and generate potential revenue loss/gain reports.
  • Create and maintain format template groups.
  • Create and maintain avails tracking docs for all local media stations.
  • Work cross-functionally with Sales Operations teams to support shared inventory and revenue objectives.
  • Develop and maintain forecasts for digital video and CTV supply by market, platform, device, content type, audience, daypart, and sales channel.
  • Monitor sell-through, fill rate, CPM, revenue, and delivery trends; recommend pricing floors, packaging, prioritization, and channel mix adjustments that improve monetization.
  • Identify under delivery, overbooking, pacing, frequency, and supply-quality risks early; coordinate corrective action with Sales and Ad Operations.
  • Produce recurring inventory, capacity, and revenue reports with clear recommendations for sales leadership and operational partners.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Applied knowledge of broadcast logs, digital media inventory, sales operations, and inventory management processes
  • Strong analytical and forecasting skills, with the ability to interpret inventory, revenue, and delivery data and identify risks and opportunities
  • Working knowledge of digital advertising, connected TV, programmatic delivery, and relevant traffic, order management, and ad-serving platforms
  • Proficiency with spreadsheets, reporting tools, and large data sets
  • Sound business judgment, problem-solving ability, and attention to detail
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present actionable recommendations to cross-functional partners
  • Ability to collaborate effectively, work independently, manage multiple priorities, and adapt in a fast-paced environment

job.title: News Anchor (Part-Time)
job.description:
WSYX/ABC 6 is seeking a curious, confident, and engaging part-time host for After the Headlines, a new weekday 7:30 p.m. program built to take viewers deeper into the stories they’ve just seen in our regular newscasts.

This is a conversation-driven show, not a traditional newscast. The host will guide discussions with reporters, newsmakers, and community voices, helping audiences understand what’s behind the headlines, why it matters and what questions remain. The right candidate is an excellent journalist and communicator who can bring energy, authenticity, and thoughtful curiosity to every conversation.

What You’ll Do

  • Host After the Headlines and lead clear, engaging conversations about the day’s important local stories.
  • Work with producers, reporters, and editors to identify stories that benefit from added context, explanation, or accountability.
  • Prepare thoughtful questions, research topics, and help shape discussions that are informative, fair, and compelling.
  • Collaborate with reporters and other Sinclair journalists, drawing on their expertise and firsthand reporting to deepen the conversation.
  • Conduct interviews with newsmakers, experts, and community members in studio, remotely and in the field as needed.
  • Contribute to the show’s development across broadcast, streaming, social and digital platforms.
  • Maintain strong editorial judgment, accuracy, and ethical standards.
  • Participate in promotional and community activities as assigned.

 

What We’re Looking For

  • A strong journalist with excellent writing, interviewing, and communication skills.
  • A natural conversational presence who can make complex topics understandable and keep discussions moving.
  • Sound news judgment, curiosity, and the ability to ask direct, thoughtful follow-up questions.
  • Confidence working live and adapting when conversations or breaking news take an unexpected turn.
  • A collaborative approach and the ability to work closely with producers, reporters and colleagues across platforms.
  • Experience in television news, reporting, anchoring, hosting, interviewing or a related field is preferred.

This is a part-time position. Schedule and hours will be discussed with candidates.

job.title: Sales and Marketing Specialist
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 


Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 


Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

Help Brands Thrive: 

Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners. 


Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win—and we believe in celebrating those victories together! 

  

Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships. You're helping businesses find the right audience in the right place at the right time. When we say One Partner, Endless Possibilities, we mean it! 

 

Be A Trusted Guide: In this role, you'll connect with clients on a human level, understand their unique needs, and craft tailored sales and marketing solutions that deliver results. As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision.  

 

Shake Things Up: Bring your creativity and fresh ideas to the table! We're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, embraces innovation, and finds new ways to connect with our audience. Your contributions will help elevate our brand and drive meaningful results for your clients.  

 

Join us and Conquer the Media Landscape: You'll be part of a dedicated team of A1 media sales professionals, committed to achieving market leadership. Together, we amplify our impact, deliver exceptional outcomes, and help our clients succeed in ways that truly matter. 

 

Identify Emerging Opportunities: It's about being able to see what others can't, anticipating market shifts, analyzing data and predicting the next big thing. Your insights will position our clients and AMP for long-term success.  

  

What We're Looking For 

Proven Sales Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn) 

Whether you're a seasoned sales professional or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 

 

Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

 

A Passion for helping Others: You're committed to understanding clients' needs, providing top-notch customer service and making a difference. You're not just selling a product; you're providing a solution.  


A Competitive Spirit: Do you get a little boost when you achieve a goal (especially if it was a tough one)? We love that for you (and us)!  We want someone who's driven to excel but also knows how to celebrate the victories (big and small) with their team. That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization.  


A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.  

 

The Practical Stuff 

A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

 

Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.  

 

The Compensation Package: We offer a base salary, commission structure, and benefits package designed to support your success and well-being. Happy employees don't stage rebellions! ;) 

 

We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales specialist isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.) 

 

Top-Notch Training and Support: We're not the kind of company that hires you and then disappears into the corporate abyss. We carefully select candidates for a cohort-based training program, where you'll join a group of sales professionals from all over the country. From onboarding to ongoing mentorship, we invest in your success with training programs that set you up for long-term growth. 

 

Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, providing you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.  

 

Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.   

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Station Manager
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

We are seeking a hands-on, strategic Station Manager to lead this market.  This is a frontline leadership role - not a desk job - and the top priority is revenue growth with a clear digital revenue strategy and an operational partnership with the General Manager. You will co-author the station operating plan, own digital growth, and translate strategy into measurable sales and operational execution with focus on overall revenue growth.

Primary Goals 

  • Co-create and execute the station Operating Plan with the GM — lead forecasting, P&L management, budget accountability, and tactical execution to hit quarterly/annual targets.
  • Own the station’s digital revenue strategy — grow streaming/OTT, programmatic, social, display, mobile, email, and lead-gen income; build integrated digital products for local advertisers.
  • Turn strategy into results — design go-to-market plans for linear + digital-first programs, measure performance, and iterate quickly to scale what works.

 

Core Responsibilities

  • Develop and scale digital product offerings (OTT/CTV, programmatic, social, email, local search, lead-gen) and integrate them with traditional TV packages.
  • Partner daily with the GM to set the Operating Plan: budgets, revenue targets, staffing plans, promotions calendar (gantt chart), and contingency plans for breaking events.
  • Lead sales strategy and execution — train and coach the sales team to sell integrated, data-driven campaigns and demonstrate value with metrics.
  • Own sales forecasting, pipeline health, and KPI reporting; use analytics to drive pricing. 
  • Drive new business development with aggressive, targeted outreach and modern prospecting techniques (CRM, lead gen software, AI tools).
  • Manage employee relations and station relations in absence of the GM — ensure on-air/digital continuity and execution during breaking news or weather events.
  • Hire, mentor, and hold staff accountable; foster a collaborative culture that balances creativity with performance.
  • Build and maintain strong local client relationships; identify and convert non-traditional revenue opportunities (events, sponsorships, branded content).
  • Ensure cross-department alignment (news, promotions, engineering, finance).

 

Success Metrics / KPIs (what you’ll be measured on)

  • Digital revenue growth (OTT/CTV, programmatic, social, email, digital sponsorships) — quarter-over-quarter and year-over-year.
  • Integrated campaign penetration — percent of total revenue from campaigns that include digital + linear components.
  • Operating Plan performance — revenue vs. budget, margin, and forecast accuracy.
  • Sales team performance — budget attainment, pipeline conversion rate, average deal size.

 

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years in senior management at a TV station or media company with a hands-on background in TV advertising sales and operations.
  • Proven track record growing digital revenue — direct experience with OTT/CTV, programmatic, social, email, and digital sponsorship products.
  • Strong capability in data, analytics, and attribution — able to translate metrics into pricing, packages, and sales programs.
  • Experience co-creating operating plans / P&L management with station leadership; strong budgeting and forecasting skills.
  • Demonstrated leadership: hiring, coaching, motivating, and holding sales and operations teams accountable.
  • Strong negotiation and closing skills; highly focused on new business development using modern prospecting tools (CRM, AI).
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills; comfortable presenting results and strategy to senior leadership.
  • Technical & tools: Excel, PowerPoint, CRM systems, programmatic/SSP/DSP familiarity preferred; OSI or similar traffic/billing experience a plus.

 

Preferred

  • Experience building pricing, packaging for new linear + digital products, and working with third-party vendors.
  • Demonstrated use of AI or automation in sales operations.
  • Background in community engagement that drives audience growth and advertiser affinity.

 

Why Sinclair

  • Leadership role with measurable strategic impact across two markets.
  • Opportunity to define and scale a modern, digital-first revenue engine while preserving linear strengths.
  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and the ability to rapidly move ideas to market.

 

Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. This leader will partner closely with Content Programming, Scheduling, Marketing, Ad Sales/Finance, Communications, and Strategy while integrating with other groups across Decision Sciences to translate first- and third-party Nielsen data into clear recommendations that inform business decision-making.   • Own projects end-to-end, from framing and planning through execution and delivery, ensuring outputs are timely, accurate and aligned with business objectives
  • Champion data democratization, performance storytelling, and data-driven decision-making across the organization
  • Harness AI solution to accelerate analysis, surface patterns and trends, and deepen actionable insight
  • Lead, develop, and mentor a high-performing, high-output analytics team while fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and equitable culture within NBCUniversal

Basic Qualifications

  • Expertise in Nielsen measurement methodology, data and reporting systems (NPower, NNTV) with experience running complex segmentation analyses for both linear/traditional and streaming content/platforms

  • Strategic, outcome-oriented thinker with the ability to derive insights, conclusions, and recommendations from ambiguous or unstructured data from disparate sources
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools and capabilities to enhance workflows, including automating repetitive work, synthesizing large and disparate datasets to surface themes, and identifying patterns and trends more quickly
  • Highly collaborative leader with strong intellectual curiosity, accountability, detail-oriented mindset, and the ability to drive projects of varying scope with clarity and purpose

Desired Characteristics

  • Work with a group of data scientists in the development of recommendation and personalization models using statistical, machine learning and data mining methodologies.
  • Drive the collection and manipulation of new data and the refinement of existing data sources.
  • Translate complex problems and solutions to all levels of the organization.

  • Drive innovation of the statistical and machine learning methodologies and tools used by the team.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Advanced (Master or PhD) degree with specialization in Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Operations Research or another quantitative field or equivalent.
  • 5+ years of combined experience in machine learning in industry or research.
  • Experience with commercial recommender systems or a lead role in an advanced research recommender system project.
  • Strong working experience with deep learning.
  • Proficient in Python.  
  • Experience in data processing using SQL and PySpark.
  • Experience working with foundation models and other GenAI technologies.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Experience in media analytics and application of data science to the content streaming and TV industry.
  • Good understanding of reinforcement learning algorithms and graph methodologies.
  • Experience with multi-billion record datasets and leading projects that span the disciplines of data science and data engineering.
  • Experience with Kubeflow, Airflow, and Databricks (or equivalent).
  • Experience with large-scale video assets.
  • Team oriented and collaborative approach with a demonstrated aptitude and willingness to learn new methods and tools.
