job.title: Local Government Watchdog/Breaking News Reporter
job.description:
Local Government Watchdog/Breaking News Reporter

The Desert Sun/desertsun.com in Palm Desert, California, part of the USA TODAY NETWORK, is looking for a reporter to join our team covering nine Coachella Valley cities – from Palm Springs to Coachella in the California desert — and Riverside County government.

This fast-growing area of Southern California is bursting with amazing stories to chase or conceive. We are looking for a journalist who is comfortable with quick-hit breaking news and ambitious enterprise in an exciting and complex area widely known for its Hollywood history as it grapples with modern-day realities. This dynamic position offers the chance to cover city hall; social justice issues; new restaurants and businesses and buzzy pop-ups; in addition to weather, traffic and public safety issues. The right candidate understands how to deliver this information both through traditional story formats and videos.

We are looking for a watchdog reporter who will hold public officials accountable and help our audience make informed decisions about their communities — from the spending of tax dollars, to the quality of their schools and the safety of their neighborhoods. Although your first task is to serve the local community, we want someone who will strive to use this local beat as a launching pad for stories with statewide or national impact. You must build trust with sources and have an eye for important details buried in local government agendas, budgets and public records. You should have work samples that demonstrate an aptitude for data-driven stories and familiarity with FOIA requests, and a track record of producing compelling, timely, well-sourced stories and videos. We expect that you can recognize compelling, socially shareable stories and that you will be quick to jump on them.

This job is well suited for a reporter who can think critically and creatively and communicate with clarity and impact on complex issues in a fast-paced and competitive environment. You must be willing to ask tough questions that are in the moment, but also with an eye toward the future.  We will expect you to break important news and develop stories that engage our audiences on multiple platforms using text, video, graphics, social media and more. The best candidate can act independently, drawing on audience interest to identify stories our readers and viewers need and want to know about.

Responsibilities:

Report quickly, clearly and accurately to deliver news, via stories, video, Facebook, Twitter, Instagram or any other methods available to reach our audiences.

Jump on breaking news. Research, write, report, photograph and/or video a variety of stories.

Demonstrate fast news judgement on an ongoing basis.

Source development is key to cultivating contacts among city officials, community leaders, residents, first responders and police. Have a genuine interest in people and ability to build trust and engage on social media with sources and audiences.

Experiment with new ways of informing and engaging audiences on social platforms and alternate story forms.

Monitor real-time news and sniff out the most important and fascinating stories important to our audiences in addition to pursuing enterprise/investigative work to uncover stories that no one else is reporting.

Use metrics to inform story choices and identify top news stories of the day, based on analytics and audience potential.

Write and/or produce multimedia content that appeals to key audience targets and maximizes user experience on digital and social platforms to reach readers where they spend their time and attention.

Requirements:

Bachelor's or master’s degree in communications, journalism, marketing or related field preferred or equivalent combination of education and experience.

At least two years’ previous reporting/newsroom experience working in digital journalism.

Reliably clear and compelling copy, whether with quick breaking news or in-depth investigations.

Strong grasp of AP style and grammar.

Good time management and organizational skills.

Ability to distill information quickly and determine the best course of action.

Familiarity with digital storytelling tools and techniques.

Basic aptitude with photography and videography.

Experience with video and alternative story formats.

Exceptional social media skills and audience engagement experience.

Exceptional core journalism skills.

Deep understanding of journalism ethics.

Self-motivated and self-directed.

Effective communicator; able to get along with diverse personalities.

Able to multi-task and excel under intense deadline pressure in a rapidly changing environment.

Knows how to use time effectively.

Works collaboratively within a cross-functional environment.

Must embrace peer-to-peer feedback and training.

Applies innovative, creative thinking to support the company's goals.

Familiarity with the Coachella Valley or Southern California is a plus.

Spanish language skills are a plus.

This position may involve working early mornings, evenings or weekends and occasional holidays.

This role requires a valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and the minimum liability insurance required by state law.

Application Instructions

We are eager to learn more about you and how you fit this role. When you apply, don’t limit your upload to a resume; show us what you’ve done. To do so, please submit the following, in this order:

Your resume – one to two pages.

A cover letter that outlines how you would approach the job.

Links to 3-6 online samples of your work. Show us what you’ve produced or had a hand in that best reflects what you can do in your desired role.

Completing these steps will ensure that your application receives the highest consideration.

job.title: Digital Advertising Campaign Manager – Automotive
job.description:
Optimizer I / Account Manager – Automotive

Digital Advertising | Campaign Optimization | Fully Remote

Company: LocaliQ, powered by the USA TODAY NetworkBase Salary: $60,000 annuallyWork Arrangement: 100% Remote

About LocaliQ

At LocaliQ, part of the USA TODAY Network, we help businesses grow through powerful marketing technology, trusted audience reach, and the expertise to turn marketing into measurable results.

We combine innovative advertising solutions, actionable insights, and a customer-first approach to help businesses reach the right audiences and achieve their goals. Our teams bring together marketing expertise, technology, and collaboration to deliver solutions that make a meaningful difference for our clients.

In this role, you’ll support automotive dealerships by helping them get more from their digital advertising investments. You’ll use campaign performance data, industry knowledge, and a solution-oriented mindset to identify opportunities, solve challenges, and help customers make informed decisions about their marketing.

About the Role

Our Digital Marketing Account Manager – Automotive role is an opportunity for someone who enjoys analyzing performance, building relationships, and turning challenges into solutions.

You’ll manage a portfolio of automotive dealer accounts, serving as a trusted day-to-day partner to customers and our internal Sales team. You’ll monitor digital advertising campaigns, evaluate performance trends, identify opportunities for improvement, and recommend actions that align with each dealer’s business goals.

This role combines analytical thinking, digital marketing expertise, and customer relationship management. You won’t simply report numbers or pass along problems. You’ll dig into the details, ask thoughtful questions, investigate what’s happening, and collaborate with the right people to determine the best path forward.

Working closely with Sales, campaign operations, analytics, creative, product, and other internal partners, you’ll help deliver a strong customer experience while supporting account health, retention, and long-term growth.

With a $60,000 annual base salary and the flexibility of a fully remote work environment, this is an opportunity to grow your digital marketing expertise, take ownership of meaningful customer relationships, and make a direct impact on business results.

Why This Role Stands Out

$60,000 annual base salary

100% remote work with the flexibility to work from home

Opportunity to work at the intersection of digital marketing, campaign strategy, and account management

Manage a portfolio of automotive dealership accounts and build meaningful client relationships

Use data and performance insights to identify opportunities and make a measurable impact

Develop expertise across digital advertising platforms, analytics tools, and emerging marketing technologies

Collaborate with Sales and specialized internal teams to solve customer challenges and improve campaign performance

Build knowledge of the automotive retail industry and the digital automotive shopping journey

Strengthen your analytical, strategic, communication, and customer-management skills

Work within an established organization backed by the marketing expertise, resources, and reach of LocaliQ and the USA TODAY Network

Access professional development opportunities and continued learning as advertising technology evolves

Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off, and additional employee benefits

What You Will Do

Manage day-to-day relationships across a portfolio of automotive dealership accounts, developing an understanding of each customer's goals, inventory priorities, market conditions, and business challenges

Monitor digital advertising campaigns, evaluating performance, budget pacing, traffic, conversions, leads, and other key performance indicators

Identify trends, investigate performance changes, and uncover the why behind the numbers

Make appropriate campaign optimizations and recommend strategies that align with dealer objectives and business priorities

Translate campaign data into clear, actionable insights that help customers understand performance and identify opportunities for improvement

Proactively communicate with customers, manage requests from intake through resolution, and provide updates to ensure consistent follow-through

Identify potential issues involving campaigns, tracking, websites, creative, targeting, or operations and coordinate with the appropriate internal teams to resolve them

Partner with Sales to support customer satisfaction, account health, retention, and growth opportunities

Collaborate with campaign operations, creative, analytics, product, support, and other internal partners to deliver effective solutions

Manage competing priorities, customer requests, deadlines, and campaign responsibilities while maintaining accurate documentation

Build expertise across digital advertising channels and platforms, including Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics 4, and reporting tools

Stay curious about changes in advertising technology, AI-driven marketing, consumer behavior, and the automotive marketplace

Identify recurring challenges and share ideas that improve processes, team collaboration, and the overall customer experience

Qualifications

2–4 years of relevant experience in digital marketing, campaign optimization, automotive advertising, agency services, or account management

Experience supporting automotive dealerships or working in automotive advertising is strongly preferred

Working knowledge of digital advertising concepts and performance metrics, including impressions, clicks, CPC, CTR, conversions, conversion rate, leads, budget pacing, and return on advertising investment

Experience with platforms such as Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics 4, Looker Studio, or comparable advertising and analytics tools is preferred

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate performance trends and turn data into actionable recommendations

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain campaign performance and recommendations in a clear, customer-friendly way

Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to work effectively with customers, Sales, and cross-functional partners

A proactive, solution-oriented approach to challenges, with the ability to investigate issues, evaluate options, and determine when additional expertise is needed

Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple accounts, deadlines, and competing priorities

Comfort working in an evolving environment where customer needs, advertising platforms, products, and priorities can change

Strong working knowledge of Excel and the ability to learn new advertising, analytics, CRM, and reporting systems

Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience

Who Thrives Here

The people who succeed in this role are curious, analytical, collaborative, and driven to find solutions. They enjoy understanding how things work, asking questions, and looking beyond the surface to uncover opportunities.

You’ll thrive if you enjoy working with data but also understand the importance of the people behind it. You can identify a performance issue, investigate the possible causes, and communicate a practical recommendation without losing sight of the customer's goals.

You’re also someone who takes ownership. You follow through on commitments, keep others informed, and work through challenges rather than simply passing them along. You know when to take initiative independently and when to bring in the right partners to reach the best outcome.

Above all, you’re eager to learn. Whether you’re building your automotive expertise, exploring new advertising technology, or finding a better way to support a customer, you approach each opportunity with a growth mindset and a willingness to improve.

What Success Looks Like

First 3 Months:Build foundational knowledge of LocaliQ's advertising products, campaign-management processes, internal tools, and automotive customers. Develop relationships with Sales and internal partners while learning to evaluate campaign performance, manage customer requests, and navigate available resources.

6 Months:Independently manage day-to-day account responsibilities, monitor campaign performance, identify optimization opportunities, and communicate meaningful recommendations. Build confidence troubleshooting common issues and coordinating solutions across internal teams.

12 Months:Confidently manage your portfolio of dealer accounts, proactively identify performance opportunities, and serve as a reliable partner to customers and Sales. Demonstrate strong ownership of account needs, effective cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to turn campaign insights into actionable solutions that support customer satisfaction and business results.

Benefits & Growth

We believe great work starts with competitive compensation, flexibility, opportunities to learn, and the ability to build a rewarding career.

$60,000 annual base salary

100% remote work environment

Medical, dental, and vision coverage

401(k)

Paid time off and floating holidays

8 paid holidays

Professional development and ongoing learning opportunities

Opportunities to expand your digital marketing, analytics, and automotive industry expertise

Collaboration with experienced Sales, marketing, and campaign-management professionals

Career development opportunities within LocaliQ and the USA TODAY Network

Turn Marketing Insights Into Meaningful Results

Great marketing is about more than numbers. It’s about understanding a customer's goals, recognizing opportunities, and finding the right solutions to help their business grow.

As a Digital Marketing Account Manager – Automotive, you’ll bring together analytical thinking, digital marketing, and customer partnership to help automotive dealerships get more from their advertising investments.

With a $60,000 base salary and the flexibility of working remotely, you’ll have the opportunity to build your expertise, take ownership of your work, and contribute to meaningful customer outcomes.

If you’re ready to solve problems, build strong relationships, and make an impact in digital marketing, we encourage you to apply.

The salary for this role will range between $55,000 and $60,000. Base compensation is reflective of multiple factors, including market location, education level, skills, certifications, and experience. Variable compensation is not reflected in these figures and may apply based on the role.

job.title: Overnight/Live Broadcast Supervising Editor, Morning Edition & Up First
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Application Instructions:

Please submit your resume and cover letter. In your cover letter please share your philosophy for leading a newsroom overnight in order to deliver the most up-to-date morning broadcast possible.

Intro to Position

Morning Edition and Up First are looking for a resilient journalist with strong news judgment, excellent writing skills and a willingness to work overnights as the Overnight/Live Broadcast Supervising Editor, managing  a production team that executes what is needed to get the live radio show to air and the Up First podcast to publication.

Millions of listeners depend on Morning Edition and Up First to set the news agenda to start their day. We deliver the latest national and international news stories paired with analysis to put headlines into context. Morning Edition is a platform for accountability through interviews with government officials and decision makers who make or influence policy that affect people's lives. The show also features culture stories about music, movies and books that bring joy and provoke thoughtful conversations about who we are in this world.

The right candidate for this position is committed to daily news, and is eager to deliver the freshest, most important stories to listeners. They put the needs and wants of audiences first. They believe in the mission of public media.

As the Overnight/Live Broadcast Supervising Editor, you will join a team of managers who collaboratively lead news and editorial coverage of events in the U.S. and around the world for Morning Edition and Up First. You ensure that the show is at the leading edge of the conversation across a range of issues. Most importantly, you work directly with our hosts to edit and make final changes to the show before and while it is live on air to ensure we are broadcasting our best journalism and editorial work.

Duties for this position include assigning stories and segments to hosts, producers and editors; editing show scripts, crafting live coverage and breaking news plans; leading the control room during the live broadcast; finding guests and reporters to feature on the show when needed; monitoring news and responding with show coverage plans as needed; mentoring and editing producers’ and editors’ writing for stories and show segments; managing staff work schedules as emergencies arise; coordinate and collaborate with other newsroom editors, leaders and journalists on show coverage plans, projects; upload editorial standards and ethics as the lead show manager during your shift. As a manager, you will be assigned direct reports and are expected to evaluate and develop staff.

This is an overnight position with a shift scheduled from approximately 11:30pm - 8:30am Eastern Time Sunday-Thursday.

Morning Edition is a 24/6 news operation. Successful candidates can work holidays and may be asked to temporarily change their work schedule to cover other show shifts and special assignments as needed.

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff are defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.    

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the show production team in bringing the live radio show and podcast to air, including the most listened to segment that airs during the 7a ET hour
  • Manage the editorial operation of the control room during the live broadcast
  • Coordinate with teams for live updates for later news feeds
  • Work directly with show hosts, guests and reporters to prep, record and edit live and taped interviews for the show and podcast on a tight deadline
  • Line edit various scripts for the live show while maintaining NPR’s editorial standards for all parts of the final product
  • Make editorial, programming and news judgment decisions about edits and show coverage plans, especially during breaking news situations
  • Provide written and verbal editorial feedback to staff on work
  • Evaluate, develop, and manage staff performance
  • Collaborate with multiplatform news teams to maximize reach of show content
  • Participate in the hiring of individual staff
  • Cultivate, promote and advance diversity, equity, and inclusion in one’s work and in the workplace.
  • Demonstrated awareness of intersectional identities and ability to collaborate with people from diverse backgrounds
  • Other duties as assigned

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least 3  years of experience managing direct reports in a newsroom or operation
  • At least 5  years of experience writing and editing broadcast journalism content
  • At least 5 years of experience producing daily news journalism content for a national or international news organization

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with audio production and mixing techniques
  • Experience working in a live control room
  • Experience being the lead producer or editor for a radio or podcast show 
  • Experience editing news content for various platforms
  • Familiarity in another written language other than English, such as Spanish or Mandarin

EDUCATION REQUIREMENT

Bachelor's degree or equivalent in work experience.

WORK LOCATION

On-site: This is an on-site role based in Washington, DC .

REQUIRED SKILLS

  • Mastery in project management such as managing deadlines and time management
  • Expert knowledge and demonstrated skill in news-writing techniques for varied formats such as guest interviews, breaking news,  feature stories
  • Mastery in AP style writing and editing skill for broadcast and digital platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability and experience in writing and editing news copy for varied platforms including broadcast, podcast, social, mobile, newsletters and other digital platforms, especially during breaking news situations
  • Proficiency in people management skills such as delivering constructive feedback, clear communication and conflict resolution.
  • Proficiency in independent, problem solving. 
  • Ability to adapt and accommodate differing styles of editorial workflows and communication.
  • Ability to negotiate and compromise.
  • Professional communication skills when representing the NPR organization.

Job Type

  • This is a full time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S. based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $145,000-155,000 a year plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

Benefits: NPR offers access to comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees. 

Does this sound like you? If so, we want to hear from you.

job.title: General Counsel
job.description:
AccuWeather is searching for a dynamic General Counsel to join its leadership team. The General Counsel leads AccuWeather's Legal Services team and serves as chief legal advisor to the CEO and business leaders across a global B2C digital media business, and enterprise B2B weather-data and insights business, and a linear broadcast/OTT network. This role owns the company's legal risk, commercial contracting, IP, privacy, and litigation strategy, and is responsible for modernizing the legal functions, including through the adoption of AI-enabled tools and workflows to deliver faster, leaner, and more scalable legal support to the business.

The position is located on-site at AccuWeather's Headquarters in State College, PA  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Legal Operations & AI-Driven Efficiency

  • Champion the adoption of AI legal tools (contract lifecycle management, legal research, drafting assistance) to cut cycle time, reduce outside counsel spend, and scale the legal team's output.
  • Build and own the company's internal AI governance framework and advise the business on legal and regulatory risk arising from its own use and development of AI.
  • Redesign commercial contracting and other legal workflows for speed, consistency, and measurable efficiency gains.
  • Structure and manage the internal legal team and legal support staff; manage outside counsel relationships and budget for cost-effective coverage.

Commercial & Corporate Transactions

  • Negotiate and draft high-value commercial agreements, including content and technology licensing, strategic partnerships and alliances, and ad-tech platform arrangements.
  • Serve as lead legal advisor on M&A, divestitures, joint ventures, and corporate investment transactions.
  • Advise on financing activity, including business and legal-entity structuring.
  • Advise on content delivery and distribution issues across broadcast, cable, and OTT platforms.

Data Privacy, Cybersecurity & Regulatory

  • Act as subject-matter expert on consumer data privacy for a digital media company with a global user base, and monitor emerging privacy, cybersecurity, and AI regulation for business impact.
  • Partner with Security and IT on cybersecurity risk, vendor data-processing terms, and incident response.
  • Ensure company-wide compliance with applicable domestic and international laws and standards.

Litigation, IP & Risk

  • Direct litigation strategy and outside counsel on matters filed by or against the company; approve settlements.
  • Protect the company's intellectual property portfolio, trademarks, copyrights, patents, and trade secrets — including strategy for complex IP litigation.
  • Oversee contract enforcement and delinquency collections.

Corporate Governance & Board Support

  • Serve as key advisor to the CEO and Board of Directors on corporate governance, risk, and major transactions.
  • Participate in defining corporate policies, procedures, and programs, and advise on their legal implications.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • JD and 15+ years of relevant experience, including service as General Counsel or senior in-house counsel in a corporate environment, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Strong working knowledge of AI legal tools and a demonstrated record of using AI to drive legal-department efficiency (not just familiarity, but hands-on experience selecting, implementing, or championing AI tools in a legal setting).
  • Broad intellectual property experience, including patent law, IP licensing, and IP due diligence.
  • Working familiarity with employment law and compliance investigations (DOL/OFCCP).
  • Proven ability to negotiate and draft complex, high-value contracts and to quickly analyze agreements from varied origins.
  • Strong executive presence; able to advise and present to senior management, the Board, and international clients and partners.
  • Experience managing a team of attorneys and legal support staff and managing outside counsel cost-effectively.
  • Experience with corporate governance matters involving a Board of Directors.
  • General knowledge of tax laws and standards as they relate to corporate transactions.
  • Must reside in State College, PA, or be willing to relocate to the State College area.

Preferred

  • Experience in digital media, broadcast/OTT, or a comparable data- or platform-driven industry.
  • Exposure to board governance, M&A processes, or strategic planning cycles.
  • Experience directing strategy for complex IP litigation.
  • Experience managing or coordinating cross-functional teams without direct authority.

ABOUT ACCUWEATHER

AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making. Billions of people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™ across our consumer digital platforms. AccuWeather.com is the #1 weather destination and one of the top 100 most-visited websites in the world, and our award-winning AccuWeather app delivers detailed real-time forecasts to tens of millions of smartphones. AccuWeather forecasts also appear on digital signage, in 700 newspapers, are heard on over 400 radio stations, and viewed on 100 television stations. The AccuWeather Network and AccuWeather NOW® reach an audience of over 225 million on cable and streaming platforms including DirecTV, Charter Communications - Spectrum, Verizon, Samsung, Vizio, Philo, Frndly TV, Comcast’s Xfinity X1 and Xfinity Stream, Roku, Xumo, Rockbot, LG, and Amazon Freevee. AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally. 

ABOUT DR. MYERS

Dr. Joel Myers, Founder and Executive Chairman, established AccuWeather in 1962 and is considered the “father of modern commercial meteorology.” Myers is a visionary entrepreneur and has been called “the most accurate man in weather” by The New York Times. He has been recognized in Entrepreneur Magazine’s Encyclopedia of Entrepreneurs as one of the greatest entrepreneurs in American history. Myers received the American Meteorological Society’s 2018 Award for Outstanding Contributions to the Advancement of Applied Meteorology and the National Weather Association’s 2017 Lifetime Achievement Award, in addition to numerous other accolades. Most recently, on September 29, 2026, Dr. Myers was inducted into the Broadcasting & Cable Hall of Fame. 

COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY & INCLUSION

We are committed to equal employment opportunity to all applicants and existing employees and we evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity/expression), sexual orientation, age, ancestry, physical or mental disability, marital status, political affiliation, religion, citizenship status, genetic information, veteran status, or any other basis protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.
 
AccuWeather is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process, please send an e-mail to human.resources@accuweather.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

job.title: Operations & Engagement Coordinator, Agency Development & Sales Strategy
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

Job Description

About the Team

The mission of the Agency Development & Sales Strategy team is to leverage agencies as our next big source of incremental revenue growth. Our strategy is to create the conditions for our Sales Organization to drive more revenue from agency partners. Our approach is threefold: drive demand by changing perceptions; enable commerce by reducing friction and creating incentives; and standardize ways of working in order to scale. As a small but growing team, we have outsized impact by leveraging other internal teams, including Industry Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations, and Programmatic Ops.

About the Role

You will report to the Associate Director, Agency Development & Sales Strategy. This role is based in our New York office and follows a hybrid work schedule.

As the Operations & Engagement Coordinator, you will support the operational core of the team. You will help execute day-to-day processes, coordinate projects, and manage logistics that enable successful, long-term partnerships with advertising agencies, with a particular focus on agency-facing activations. You will ensure that information, timelines and logistics stay aligned. You will assist in setting up and maintaining internal systems and workflows that translate strategy into successful agency partnership.

This role is ideal for a highly organized professional with strong project coordination skills, attention to detail, and an interest in agency partnerships, engagements, and media. Success in this role is defined by reliable execution, clear communication, and the smooth, scalable operation of our processes.

Responsibilities

Change agency perceptions of The Times

Agency Engagements: Support the planning and coordination of agency-specific engagements (e.g., Lunch & Learns, leadership gatherings, summits); managing logistics, invitations, venue and vendor coordination, materials preparation, and day-of execution

Scheduling: Maintain an event calendar, track deadlines, manage checklists, coordinate internal stakeholders (Sales, Marketing, Research, Creative), and ensure follow-up actions and reporting are completed on time

Outbound Communications: Help create external-facing materials – such as competitive reports and presentation decks – to strengthen agency relationships

Enable commerce by reducing friction and creating incentives

Agency Partnerships: Support the development and execution of revenue-generating deals with agency partners (e.g., tracking deliverables, updating status docs, coordinating approvals)

Strategic Implementation: Support the roadmapping, scoping and executing of strategic initiatives and work streams aligned with team goals

Prioritization and Planning: Coordinate with Sales, Revenue Operations, and Programmatic teams to identify opportunities, propose priorities, and ensure alignment on agency engagement strategies

Standardize ways of working in order to scale

Workflows: Help design and refine workflows and processes that streamline repeated tasks and external-facing materials, using AI-driven tools and automations where possible

Industry Research: Monitor industry trends and agency needs, collaborating with Sales Ops and Measurement teams to generate insights that enhance The Times' value proposition.

Lifecycle Support: Support the lifecycle of projects by helping to organize information, schedule meetings, capture notes and action items, and follow up with stakeholders to keep work moving

Accountability: Use and help maintain tools and processes (e.g., CRM and reporting dashboards) required to associate our engagement efforts with real traction with agencies (e.g., RFPs, IOs)

Basic Qualifications:

  • 1+ years of experience in operations or project coordination, event planning, business strategy support, business development support, or a related field.

  • Experience coordinating events or programs (professional, academic, or extracurricular), including logistics and communication with participants

  • Experience working collaboratively across teams and build positive working relationships

  • High attention to detail and willingness to roll up your sleeves on both administrative and project-based work

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 1+ years of experience in Media, Advertising, Media Agencies, or Tech

  • 1+ years experience with project management software tools (e.g., Monday.com, Coda)

  • Comfort working with data in spreadsheets and basic reporting tools; familiarity with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce)

job.title: Assistant Editor, Central Desk
job.description:
Job Description:

POLITICO is seeking an Assistant Editor to join its Central Editing Desk, the newsroom’s general-assignment editing team. Central editors support a daily flow of stories through editing and publication while also deploying to individual teams during major news events or to fill temporary staffing needs. 


This is an opportunity to develop an expansive view of POLITICO’s journalism while also building expertise in particular coverage areas. You will touch some of our most impactful work and collaborate with journalists throughout our fast-moving newsroom. Assistant Editors work alongside Editors and Senior Editors to support the daily second-editing workflow as they build their editing skills.


The Assistant Editor will work M-TH 4pm-12am and F 1pm-9pm. The desk is staffed 7 days per week, 6 a.m. to midnight on weekdays, with hours subject to change. We're looking for candidates who can work from one of our offices: Arlington, VA, New York, NY or Sacramento, CA.


Who You Are: 

  • You are curious about the full breadth of POLITICO’s news coverage and want to work across beats, products and platforms 
  • You are already an editor, or a reporter or producer who has developed strong editing skills and is eager to make editing a larger part of your career 
  • You enjoy moving between the big picture and the details that make an individual story stronger 
  • You can quickly learn the priorities and working styles of different teams while developing deeper expertise in particular coverage areas 
  • You find satisfaction in helping a newsroom respond effectively when priorities change or coverage intensifies 

 

What You’ll Do: 

  • Edit a wide range of content for POLITICO’s consumer and Pro subscriber audiences, including breaking news stories, live blogs, quick-turn enterprise pieces, daily newsletters and long-form deep dives across all our digital platforms, applying consistent high standards while understanding the needs of each platform 
  • Edit articles in our content management system for accuracy and clarity, as well as fact-check and copy edit, ensuring articles adhere to POLITICO standards and style 
  • Optimize content for digital platforms and search, review choice of photos and other multimedia, and assist in writing and reviewing headlines, decks and photo captions 
  • Collaborate with reporters, editors and multimedia teams to ensure smooth and speedy publishing 
  • Deploy flexibly to teams that need additional editing capacity because of breaking news, major events, special projects or temporary staffing gaps 

 

What You’ll Need: 

  • Demonstrated editing ability, whether developed in a formal editing role or through substantial experience editing colleagues’ work, producing coverage, shaping stories or collaborating closely on publication 
  • Strong news judgment and a rigorous commitment to fair-minded, nonpartisan journalism  
  • Excellent organization and communication skills and an ability to quickly adapt to changing priorities and juggle multiple tasks in a fast-paced newsroom 
  • Flexibility to work varying shifts and support different projects and teams, depending on need 
  • Experience in digital publishing and content management systems 
  • Working knowledge of AP Style 

Interested candidates should submit a resume and cover letter under the Resume/CV section of the application.

 

COMPENSATION: 

Assistant Editor: $78,000-$85,000 Annual Base. 


The final salary offered will be based on factors including relevant experience, skills, and qualifications. 


We value our people. Click here for more on what we offer and what it’s like to work for POLITICO. 


Let’s keep in touch. You can view our list of open positions here.


About Us.

POLITICO illuminates the forces shaping global power. Since 2007, we have delivered intelligence that anticipates tomorrow's headlines, not reports on yesterday's news. As politics has increasingly become the defining force of our era, our work has never been more vital. 


Cabinet secretaries and Ministers start their mornings with our analysis. CEOs shape strategy around our reporting. Advocacy leaders rely on our insights to move policy. We deliver the straightforward facts and clear-eyed analysis they need to navigate the most complex political landscape of our lifetimes. 


Our 1,100+ publishing professionals across the world's key democratic capitals—Washington, Brussels, London, Paris, Berlin, Sacramento, and New York—form the world's premier politics and policy newsroom. We tell the story of how power really works by explaining who wields it and how they plan to exercise it, connecting dots others miss and delivering scoops from sources others don't even know exist. 


Innovation has always been a core tenet of our story. At launch, we bet that depth would trump scale, that talent would trump traffic, and that politics would become central to modern life. In 2011, we made another bet and launched POLITICO Pro to help decision-makers understand the business of government, transforming both how they shape government action and the business of journalism itself. 


These bets have made POLITICO the most successful digital news startup of its generation and the indispensable resource for leaders who shape the future. Today, we are a rarity in media: a growing, profitable, and sustainable news organization. 


POLITICO is a subsidiary of Axel Springer SE, a family-owned transatlantic media company headquartered in Berlin and New York. Axel Springer is dedicated to shaping the future of journalism in the free world, believing that a free and informed society is essential to democracy. Learn more about Axel Springer.

job.title: Touring Coordinator - Production (Global Touring)
job.description:
For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. 

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. 

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

Position Summary:

The Touring Coordinator is responsible for supporting the touring department operations by maintaining office systems, controlling department correspondence - the dissemination of tour information to all relevant departments, the maintenance of venue, artist and tour databases, conducting new and relevant research to update the databases as needed. The touring coordinator may also be assign various projects for the touring department including but not limited to the creation of potential tour designs, initial drafting of potential tour offers, coordinating the tour budget development, working on tour routing and execution of venue deals for tour.

Essential Functions:

 

  • Maintains department services & efficiencies by organizing department operations and procedures; controlling correspondence; designing filing systems; processing department supply requests; maintaining department contacts, scheduling meetings, planning and implementing department systems and equipment procurement including repair of machinery and equipment for employees on the road
  • Responsible for building the routing of each assigned tour. Creating a realistic schedule for production crew to follow. Reach out to venues to compare availability to artist availability and submit routing for approval to begin execution of necessary contracts
  • Review of ticket audits to ensure tour is on budget. Ensure that all production needs and requests are met to successfully execute stage, lighting, and sound vision of artist and management team.
  • Assist with tour research, pull tour histories from internal booking system, and compile ticket price comparison and other similar research compilation comparisons as requested. Create presentations and operational reports for supervisor review and analysis.
  • Liaison with potential partners, sponsors and co-promoters in an effort to maintain databases for tour contacts, venue expenses, rent deals, etc.
  • May be responsible for assisting with show settlements on the road, assisting the ticketing department, and the recruiting and supervision of interns, executive expense reports, planning travel, and routing phone calls to appropriate party.
  • May build financial models for Tour Manager and Tour Director to assess financial risk associated with each venue and the potential revenue of a proposed tour. Prepare potential scaling maps and projected budgets. Work with accounting department for budgeting, expense reports, and various department costs throughout the year with department heads

 

Required Qualifications:

 

  • High School Diploma or its equivalency (BA/BS Degree Preferred) In Accounting/Finance, Legal, Logistics, or a related area
  • 0-2 years Of related work experience
  • Proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) & Adobe Acrobat
  • Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills
  • Detail orientated individual with commitment to advancing in the music industry
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with an ability to take direction and work as a team towards the execution of a large scale touring event
  • Knowledge of accounting principles and previous experience in building financial models
  • Able to work a flexible schedule which may include nights, weekends and holidays as tour permits
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills
  • Knowledgeable about the music industry
  • Positive attitude with an ability to take initiative

We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

Crypto.com Arena is where the world comes to play, perform, and come together. As one of the most iconic venues in sports and live entertainment, we host unforgettable moments, from championship games and global tours to once in a lifetime events that define the culture of Los Angeles. 

Owned and operated by AEG, our team brings live experiences to life with creativity, precision, and pride. Every role plays a part in creating nights fans remember, powered by people who care about the details and the impact of getting it right. 

If you want your work to show up in real moments, in a venue where history is made every night, there’s a place for you here. Because it happens here. 

Job Summary:

The Utility Operator controls and shades cameras during events for Crypto.com Arena.

Essential Functions:

  • Work with the camera operators to prepare the proper connection and operation at the Camera Control Unit (CCU). This includes properly connecting the camera with the camera cable to the assigned port at one of the media panels. This includes running the cable from the panel to the camera location and making sure any points along the run are taped to the ground with non-stick gaffer’s tape at any point that is considered a trip hazard.
  • During the game, will provide support as the handheld camera is requested to move around to get shots. This includes making sure the extra cable staged by the camera is kept organized and fed out and wrapped up neatly as the camera operator moves from their original position.
  • Act as a guide to the camera operator ensuring their safety from their blind side and behind them. May also need to make supply runs back to the control room such as fresh batteries or tape or a replacement headset.
  • Lift and/or carry a handheld camera which can weigh up to 30 lbs.
  • Must be able to spend time on their feet or be seated throughout the shift, including moving from a seated position to standing and moving quickly such as an unexpected time out that requires quick action.

Required Qualifications:

job.title: 3D Designer - Burson
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Burson Studio:

In Studio, we create ideas and bring them to life. We’re a multi-disciplined team, creating content for integrated marketing campaigns, brand experiences and brand identity. We currently have a team of around 40; a mix of Creatives, Brand and Digital Designers, Editors and Content Producers and Creative Project Managers, supplemented by freelancers when specialist skills are needed or workload dictates.

Everyone that succeeds here enjoys the diversity of clients and projects and is driven to do great work that will have a positive effect on our clients’ businesses.

More about the role:

As an Experiential Designer you will be instrumental in working alongside the team executing creative design solutions across a broad range of projects, ensuring we deliver exceptional and immersive brand experiences and design for events. You will bring broad experience across spatial, experiential and interior design. You will be adept at taking productions through all stages from concept and brief, through the pitch process.

You will have an eye for detail, high-end design experience and understanding of brand and consumer experience. Being equally confident developing ideas and creative concepts as you are in 3D we are looking for a creative designer and not just a visualiser, so we are keen to meet people who bring big ideas as well as technical skills.

You can present your ideas clearly and with confidence. You need to be able to give and listen to feedback and act on it for the good of the project. Asking questions is important. You will have curiosity and a desire to soak up ideas and feedback from wherever you can. We want to see your passion for design and creativity, and see you explore the creative world around you, looking out for what’s hot and what’s not. Being part of the experiential team, you will regularly communicate key trends in design and technology to the wider team.

The devil is in the detail and you’ll be expected to be thorough, articulate and well organised in your work. Attention matters and we want you to obsess over it.

We’ll look to you to have good organisational skills and manage your time and requested project
deadlines well. At your level, you will be able to handle multiple projects at once, calmly and
with confidence.

What you'll do:

  • Work as an integral member of the Studio, collaborating with the Experiential team to support the delivery of spatial projects and events of varying scales and complexity  
  • Work closely with cross functional teams and directly with clients on projects, building their trust and confidence at every stage
  • Communicate ideas through mood imagery and description, honing creative concepts and inspiring others
  • Build out ideas into 3D designs and visuals
  • Work closely with cross functional teams across 2D and graphics, strategy and account management teams to deliver excellence
  • Recommend and research suppliers that share your creative vision and will partner with us to deliver first class events
  • Collaborate with production and technical teams to make sure we are in line with timelines and budgets, and that your incredible design vision is honoured through to implementation

Experience that contributes to success:

  • You will have a minimum of 4 years’ experience working in a similar role
  • You will have an understanding of brand experiences, consumer journey and design at the highest level
  • You will have experience taking design projects from start to finish, from initial concept right through to final design and implementation
  • You will have a high cultural radar with a finger on the pulse across all areas of art, design and culture
  • You will have a desire to drive innovation within the business, creating beautiful and impactful work that strives to make a difference (environmentally and socially)
  • You will be experienced working in collaborative and multi-facetted teams
  • You will be energetic and collaborative, we are big fans of teamwork
  • You will be Proficient in Sketchup and Creative Suite
  • CAD and visualisation software capability – ideally Vector Works / Cinema 4D or equivalents
  • You will be motivated to always push creative ideas as far as possible
  • However, you will also be pragmatic, realistic and diligent never to over promise or under deliver - managing client expectations brilliantly while looking for alternative solutions
  • You will have a good understanding of build and production and the technical aspects of the design process
  • You will be calm and organised with meticulous attention to detail
  • Strong organisational and communication skills
  • Be kind, supportive and fun

job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

starpower, part of Real Chemistry, is a leading entertainment, talent, influencer, and cultural marketing agency that helps brands build authentic connections with audiences through the power of culture. For more than two decades, we've partnered with brands to develop impactful programs spanning celebrity partnerships, influencer marketing, talent procurement, experiential activations, content, sponsorships, and strategic consulting. Widely recognized as the bridge between Hollywood and healthcare, starpower brings unmatched expertise in connecting healthcare, wellness, consumer, and lifestyle brands with the talent, creators, and cultural moments that matter most.

 

Job Overview

The Senior Director, Entertainment & Sport will develop, negotiate, and execute strategic partnerships for specific healthcare, health, and wellness client accounts. Working closely with Real Chemistry leadership and integrated client teams, this role will connect brands with entertainment and sport properties, teams, leagues, and talent. The position requires deep industry relationships, strong commercial judgment, and agency-or buyer-side experience building brand partnerships from strategy through activation.

Title: Senior Director, Entertainment & Sports

 

Responsibilities

 

Client Partnership Strategy

  • Develop entertainment and sports partnership strategies for healthcare, health, and wellness client accounts, in collaboration with Real Chemistry leadership and integrated client teams.
  • Identify and evaluate opportunities with properties, teams, leagues, talent, rights holders, and other industry partners based on each client’s objectives.
  • Translate client objectives, audience insights, and cultural trends into differentiated partnership platforms and activation ideas.

 

Deal Development, Negotiation & Execution

  • Lead the end-to-end partnership process, including opportunity sourcing, valuation, proposal development, rights packaging, negotiation, contracting support, and activation planning.
  • Develop clear business cases and recommendations that balance brand impact, audience relevance, budget, risk, and measurable value.
  • Partner with legal, finance, creative, strategy, experiential, influencer, social, and media teams to deliver programs on time and within scope.
  • Oversee partnership activation and optimization, ensuring contractual rights are fully leveraged and programs meet brand and compliance requirements.

 

Client Leadership & Industry Relationships

  • Serve as a senior advisor on assigned client accounts, partnering with Real Chemistry leadership to guide partnership choices and present recommendations with clarity and confidence.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships across entertainment and sports, including properties, teams, leagues, talent, agents, rights holders, and agency partners.
  • Use market intelligence and relationships to create access, uncover opportunities, and strengthen negotiating positions for clients.

 

Business Development & Team Contribution

  • Support new business pitches, proposals, and organic growth opportunities by contributing partnership expertise, recommendations, and industry insights.
  • Partner with Real Chemistry leadership to strengthen entertainment and sports resources, partner networks, evaluation tools, case studies, and best practices.
  • Represent Real Chemistry at relevant industry events and stay current on emerging properties, talent, platforms, audience behaviors, and partnership models.
  • Share expertise with team members and foster collaborative, rigorous, and commercially minded ways of working.

 

Qualifications and Experience

  • 12+ years of experience in entertainment and sports partnerships, sponsorships, brand marketing, or a related field.
  • Significant agency- or buyer-side experience developing, negotiating, and executing partnerships for brands.
  • Deep, active relationships across entertainment and sports, including properties, teams, leagues, talent, agents, rights holders, and relevant intermediaries.
  • Demonstrated expertise in rights valuation, deal structure, negotiation, contracting processes, activation planning, and partnership measurement.
  • Experience in healthcare, health and wellness, or another highly regulated category is strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of brand strategy, consumer audiences, culture, media, experiential marketing, social platforms, and talent-led programs.
  • Excellent client leadership, communication, presentation, and financial skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple complex partnerships and cross-functional teams in a fast-paced agency environment.
  • Entrepreneurial, collaborative, detail-oriented, and energized by building new capabilities and offerings.

 

Pay Range: $135,000 - $180,000

job.title: Producer / On-Air Talent for X107.9 (KVGS)
job.description:
Position Overview 

Beasley Media Group Las Vegas is seeking a creative, energetic, and versatile Producer / On-Air Talent for X107.9 (KVGS), our alternative music station and the English-language radio home of the Vegas Golden Knights. 

We're looking for a talented broadcaster who can bring personality, creativity, and technical expertise to both sides of the microphone. The ideal candidate is passionate about alternative music, pop culture, sports, and the Las Vegas community, with the ability to produce compelling content, execute flawless broadcasts, and connect with listeners on-air and across digital platforms. 

This is a hands-on position that combines on-air hosting, audio production, live broadcast execution, and digital content creation. The successful candidate will be comfortable working independently, collaborating with programming and sales teams, and thriving in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. 

Key Responsibilities 

On-Air Talent & Content Creation 

  • Host assigned on-air shifts with an engaging, authentic personality that reflects the X107.9 brand. 

  • Deliver compelling, entertaining content focused on alternative music, pop culture, local events, sports, and the Las Vegas lifestyle. 

  • Prepare and execute entertaining on-air breaks, interviews, promotions, and station features. 

  • Maintain strong listener engagement through on-air interaction, social media, and station events. 

  • Execute commercial endorsements, promotional announcements, and sponsored features as assigned. 

  • Represent X107.9 professionally at concerts, community events, promotional appearances, and station activities. 

Production & Broadcast Operations 

  • Produce high-quality audio content, including commercials, station imaging, promotional announcements, interviews, and specialty programming. 

  • Record, edit, mix, and deliver audio using industry-standard production software. 

  • Operate studio equipment, automation systems, and broadcast technology to ensure smooth daily programming. 

  • Coordinate with programming, traffic, sales, and engineering to ensure accurate and timely execution of broadcast content. 

  • Manage production deadlines, maintain organized audio libraries, and ensure consistent quality across all produced materials. 

  • Troubleshoot routine broadcast and production issues in a live environment. 

Vegas Golden Knights & Sports Programming 

  • Support the production and execution of Vegas Golden Knights game broadcasts and related programming on X107.9. 

  • Coordinate with play-by-play talent, producers, board operators, and station management to ensure seamless live broadcasts. 

  • Assist with pregame and postgame programming, sports features, interviews, and special broadcasts. 

  • Execute commercial breaks, sponsorship elements, and in-game features accurately. 

  • Produce and edit hockey-related audio, promotional content, and digital features. 

  • Assist with live remote broadcasts and special events as needed. 

Digital & Social Media 

  • Create engaging content for station social media platforms, streaming channels, and digital properties. 

  • Develop short-form video, audio clips, interviews, and behind-the-scenes content to extend the station's reach. 

  • Collaborate with the programming and promotions teams on digital campaigns, contests, and audience engagement initiatives. 

  • Stay current on alternative music trends, emerging artists, pop culture, and digital content opportunities. 

Programming & Team Collaboration 

  • Work closely with the Program Director to execute the station's programming strategy and brand vision. 

  • Collaborate with sales and promotions on creative client campaigns, sponsored content, and station events. 

  • Maintain accurate programming logs and ensure compliance with FCC regulations and company policies. 

  • Provide support for additional programming, production, and live broadcast needs across the Las Vegas cluster as assigned. 

Qualifications 

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in radio broadcasting, audio production, on-air hosting, or a related media position preferred. 

  • Strong on-air communication skills, creativity, and the ability to connect authentically with listeners. 

  • Proficiency with digital audio editing and production software, such as Adobe Audition, Pro Tools, or similar platforms. 

  • Experience with radio automation systems, studio operations, and live broadcast production. 

  • Knowledge of alternative music, emerging artists, pop culture, and current music trends. 

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines. 

  • Familiarity with social media platforms, digital content creation, and video editing. 

  • Experience with live sports broadcasting or production is a plus. 

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. 

  • Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and special events, including Vegas Golden Knights broadcasts, as needed. 

  • Valid driver's license and ability to participate in off-site promotional events as required. 

What We're Looking For 

We're looking for someone who loves radio, lives for great content, and isn't afraid to jump in wherever needed. You should be equally comfortable behind a microphone, producing a compelling piece of audio, running a live broadcast, or creating content that gets people talking online. 

X107.9 is a station with personality, energy, and a strong connection to the Las Vegas community. As the English-language radio home of the Vegas Golden Knights, we offer a unique opportunity to combine music, sports, entertainment, and live broadcasting in one exciting role. 

If you're creative, technically skilled, passionate about alternative music, and ready to make an impact both on-air and behind the scenes, we want to hear from you.

The Multimedia Account Executive successfully manages relationships with dozens of local and regional businesses, protects and grows the revenue base, identifies and creates new business opportunities with existing and new clients; provides marketing solutions to help customers achieve their business goals; strategically plans and implements initiatives to meet personal, company and corporate directives, recognizes that achieving budgeted revenue targets is the minimum expectation of performance.   • Able to create and identify client business needs by gaining a deep understanding of their goals, objectives and processes as well as their external environment including key market and consumer trends to proactively develop customized marketing solutions to meet client objectives

  • Ability to negotiate and close business that drives revenue results and fosters long term client relationships, regardless of medium or platform
  • Commitment to having a proficient understanding of the Cumulus Media assets and resources and a desire to constantly learn and grow your product knowledge thus staying relevant and current with industry advertising opportunities for your clients
  • Represent the full suite of products and services as marketing solutions to new and existing clientele. This includes station digital assets, internet-based marketing, social media, streaming, events and specialized programming
  • Ability to appropriately manage time to optimize revenue opportunities, client interaction, implementation and fulfillment of successful sales agreements. Individual must be able to assist in the development of creative messaging, regardless of platform
  • Excel at prospecting and aggressively seeking new clientele by networking, cold calling, canvassing, referrals or other means to maintain a full pipeline of sales prospects at all times
  • Follow all station and corporate procedures for preparing orders, resolving billing issues, submitting regular reports regarding sales, pipeline lists, forecasts and competitive analysis
  • Collaborate, create, and capitalize on opportunities to best represent our brand while working to help your clients achieve success

TSC, the retail arm of Rogers, is one of Canada's top 10 eCommerce retailers, with a loyal customer base that shops with us across multiple channels. Our assortment covers fashion, jewellery, beauty, home and electronics, so every day brings new data and new questions to answer.

Reporting to the Director of Planning, Digital Product & Analytics, you'll be at the centre of how we make decisions as our eCommerce & Digital Analytics analyst. You'll work with Planning, Buying and Marketing to understand what drives performance and turn insights into action. Our teams move fast, so your recommendations won't sit in a deck: you'll see them put into practice quickly and measure the results.

The Material Movement Specialist position in Lawrence is on 2nd Shift (3:30pm - 12:00am midnight).

The Materials Movement Specialist reports through the Warehouse Department in the Lawrence Production Center.  Individuals in this department transport stock and recycled material to and from the warehouse to the production areas.   

 

The Materials Movement Specialist in Lawrence transports stock between production departments and warehouse or between shipping and receiving docks.  Loads and unloads incoming and outgoing trucks.  Locates stock in the warehouse and fills orders for manufacturing using a variety of powered equipment.  Responsible for loading and unloading skids onto the vertical lift and using the elevator as necessary.  Responsible for sorting paper or other materials into proper recycling categories to ensure maximum revenue generation.  Acts as a technical resource to support departments on paper grading.  Operates paper, chip and poly balers to compress recyclable materials into bales.  Responsible for all documentation related to stock movement.  Transports hazardous waste material in accordance with Federal, State, and Local regulations.   Positively participates in performance dialogues and other team problem-solving activities.  Identifies potential problems, and shows willingness to proactively work on problem resolution and alternative solutions to traditional methods of operation.  Flexibility is key as the incumbent will be expected to move to different work assignments as needed.  Incumbent will be expected to learn and perform multiple assignments within this job classification.

 

The Materials Movement Specialist position may be in several departments, and incumbent will be expected to learn and perform multiple assignments within this job classification.   

 

In this position you will:

  • Be certified to operate fork lifts and other power equipment as required. 
  • Transport stock between production departments and warehouse or between shipping and receiving docks and load onto trucks.
  • Prepare materials and supplies for shipment using banding equipment, power saws, power drills, film wrapper and string tie as required.  Responsible for all documentation related to stock movement.
  • Coordinate with paper recycling contractor, metal, or other contractors regarding the pick-up and delivery of storage containers and trailers to support manufacturing workloads.  Performs preventive and scheduled maintenance services on balers and power equipment.

  • Utilize good safety practices.

The Director, Partnership Sales develops, secures and grows strategic partnerships that advance the PGA of America’s mission to serve the Member and grow the game of golf. This role leads the partnership sales process from prospecting and outreach through proposal development, negotiation, contracting and onboarding. While collaborating across the Association to create customized opportunities across the PGA’s championships, events, member and consumer platforms, media, digital, PGA REACH, education, hospitality, licensing, content and other strategic assets. The Director builds trusted relationships with brand decision-makers, agencies, media partners and internal stakeholders to deliver meaningful value, achieve revenue objectives, maintain a strong sales pipeline, support partner retention and identify opportunities to expand existing relationships.

RESPONSIBILITIES (Specific areas of responsibility include but are not limited to):

Lead partnership sales efforts, including prospecting, outreach, presentations, negotiations and closing.

Develop and manage a qualified sales pipeline to achieve new business, renewal and revenue goals.

Identify prospective partners and emerging opportunities aligned with the PGA’s mission, audiences and assets.

Create customized partnership proposals, sales materials, pricing strategies and financial analyses.

Collaborate with internal departments and media partners to develop integrated opportunities across PGA assets.

Lead contract development and negotiations in partnership with Legal and senior leadership.

Manage relationships with assigned partners, ensuring satisfaction, delivery of benefits and achievement of objectives.

Develop recaps and performance reports to demonstrate partner engagement, return on investment and renewal opportunities.

Identify opportunities to retain, renew, extend and expand existing partnerships.

Maintain strong relationships with brand decision-makers, agencies and industry contacts.

Monitor industry trends and competitive activity to inform sales strategies and identify new revenue opportunities.

Communicate partnership opportunities, agreements, progress and challenges to senior leadership.

Employees are expected to contribute to a respectful and inclusive team environment by welcoming and respecting others’ beliefs, backgrounds, identities, abilities, and individuality to help ensure a supportive and engaging experience for Association Members, partners, customers, and guests. PGA of America respects the uniqueness of each employee and offers everyone the means to find their place and thrive. 

SHARED VALUES: 

 

Embody the organization's shared values and help ensure the organization's values-based culture thrives by proactively identifying and addressing any shared values, challenges and opportunities you are experiencing. 

SUPERVISION:

No supervisory responsibility.

FINANCIAL RESPONSIBILITY:

Assists in the development of the partnership development budget and manage partnership activations within assigned budgets.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

Bachelor’s degree (B.A.) in Business Administration, Economics, Marketing, Sales, Sports Management or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience preferred. 


Five or more years of progressive experience in partnership sales, sponsorship sales, sports marketing, media sales, experiential marketing or a related discipline.
