job.title: Senior Industrial Engineer
job.description:
Working at QVC Group means joining a live social shopping company with incredible teams, ambitious projects and amazing careers. QVC Group, Inc. is a Fortune 500 company with six leading retail brands - QVC®, HSN®, Ballard Designs®, Frontgate®, Garnet Hill® and Grandin Road.

Your Opportunity, Your Team

As a Senior Industrial Engineer, you will serve as a key technical leader within QVC’s largest and most advanced fulfillment center. This is a highly visible and impactful role and you will lead meaningful impact as both a thought leader and a savvy change agent.

As a technical expert, you will be responsible for optimizing processes, driving innovation, and transforming operations at the site and across QVC's supply chain network. You are part of the leadership team; you will be joining an impressive and highly talented team within engineering, operations, and technology.
You'll lead high-impact initiatives spanning labor optimization, automation deployment, process design, facility layout, capacity planning, and operational analytics. From implementing advanced material handling technologies to developing scalable solutions that support future growth, you'll help shape the next generation of fulfillment at QVC.
You'll have the opportunity to influence decisions at both the site and network level while partnering with cross-functional leaders to solve complex operational challenges. If you're energized by data-driven decision making, large-scale operations, and creating innovative solutions that deliver measurable business results, this is the role for you.


Where You'll Work

This role is onsite and will require you to work from our Bethlehem, PA Fulfillment Center daily. Relocation assistance is not available for this role.


What You'll Do

  • Serve as the senior engineering partner to site leadership, identifying, prioritizing, and executing opportunities that improve safety, quality, productivity, and cost performance.
  • Lead complex industrial engineering initiatives involving labor planning, process optimization, capacity analysis, workflow design, and facility layout improvements.
  • Develop data-driven solutions through statistical analysis, modeling, simulation, and operational research techniques to optimize labor utilization, throughput, and space utilization.
  • Partner with Operations, Automation, Technology, and Finance teams to evaluate, justify, and implement capital investments and automation technologies.
  • Design and refine fulfillment processes, material flows, and operating strategies that support both current operations and future business growth.
  • Influence network-wide standardization efforts by developing best practices, engineering methods, and scalable operational solutions across multiple fulfillment centers.
  • Identify technologies and build business cases supporting automation, equipment, labor, and process improvement initiatives.
  • Utilize warehouse management, labor management, and business intelligence systems to identify trends, uncover opportunities, and drive measurable performance improvements.
  • Lead implementation efforts for automation, process redesign, and operational transformation projects while ensuring successful adoption and sustainability.
  • Communicate engineering recommendations and project results to senior leaders through compelling analytics, visualizations, and operational insights.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Systems Engineering, Operations Research, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience in Industrial Engineering, Process Engineering, Operations Engineering, or Supply Chain Engineering within distribution, fulfillment, manufacturing, or logistics environments.
  • Demonstrated experience driving process improvement initiatives, workflow optimization, and operational efficiency.
  • Experience analyzing operational data and translating findings into actionable business recommendations.
  • Ability to collaborate with and influence cross-functional stakeholders and operational leadership.
  • Ability to travel 15–25% to support multi-site projects and network initiatives.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading large-scale process improvement, facility design, automation, or operational transformation projects.
  • Strong understanding of fulfillment operations, labor planning, capacity modeling, and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Experience with advanced analytics tools such as SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Python, R, or simulation software.
  • Familiarity with warehouse management and labor management systems, including Manhattan, Blue Yonder/JDA, Red Prairie, LaborPro, MOST, or similar platforms.
  • Experience supporting automation technologies such as conveyor systems, sortation, robotics, ASRS, goods-to-person systems, or autonomous mobile robots.
  • Lean Six Sigma or equivalent continuous improvement certification


Why Engineers Choose QVC

  • Lead projects that directly impact millions of customer orders annually.
  • Influence automation and fulfillment strategies across a multi-site distribution network.
  • Work on challenging problems involving labor optimization, automation, capacity planning, and operational analytics.
  • Join a team that invests in innovation, technical expertise, and continuous learning.

job.title: Sr Reporter, KMVT
job.description:
At KMVT, local journalism is about more than covering the news. It’s about building lasting relationships with the people and communities that make southern Idaho home. As a Senior Reporter, you’ll bring experience, curiosity, and strong journalistic judgment to investigative, long-form, breaking, and multi-platform reporting that matters to local audiences.


You’ll develop trusted sources, dig deeper into the stories shaping the region, and create meaningful journalism with accuracy, fairness, and authenticity at its core. This is an opportunity to become deeply connected to the community and make a lasting impact at a station where local relationships matter. For an experienced journalist looking for a place to put down roots, Twin Falls offers an appealing combination of community connection, an affordable lifestyle, and access to Idaho’s remarkable outdoors.



WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Develop a strong network of sources throughout southern Idaho and build authentic relationships with community members and local experts.
  • Investigate public records, cultivate personal sources, and conduct in-depth research to uncover and tell meaningful stories.
  • Lead coverage of significant breaking news and pursue investigative and long-form reporting that provides context and value to local audiences.
  • Create compelling multi-platform journalism using video, photography, graphics, digital storytelling, and other visual elements.
  • Report live from the field and operate cameras with still photography and video capabilities.
  • Connect audiences with a diversity of perspectives and stories that strengthen community belonging.
  • Collaborate with newsroom colleagues on editorial and content planning, workflows, best practices, and multimedia coverage that meets strategic goals and deadlines.
  • Maintain the highest standards of accuracy, objectivity, fairness, ethics, and sensitivity to community expectations.
  • Engage with the community beyond daily assignments by participating in local events and staying closely connected to the issues important to the region.
  • Drive a personal or company vehicle periodically to cover assignments throughout the market.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • A bachelor’s degree in a related discipline or equivalent years of experience is preferred.
  • Generally, 5+ years of news reporting experience, including in-depth or long-form reporting, is required; experience with community, digital, and solutions-based journalism is preferred.
  • A valid driver’s license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance meeting company-required limits are required.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Deep expertise in investigative and long-form reporting and a strong command of journalistic standards.
  • A talent for memorable storytelling and a distinct, engaging on-air presence.
  • A consumer-focused approach and commitment to understanding what matters most to local audiences.
  • Strong multimedia skills spanning reporting, writing, web publishing, still photography, online video, infographics, databases, and social media.
  • Knowledge of reporting fundamentals, including privacy, ethics, access, open meetings, public records, and applicable state and federal requirements.
  • Exceptional accuracy, fairness, editing, writing, and working knowledge of Associated Press style.
  • Ability to use digital, video, mapping, social networking, and other technology to strengthen reporting across platforms.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and Outlook, along with web publishing tools.
  • Adaptability, emotional intelligence, sound judgment, and the ability to produce strong journalism in a deadline-driven newsroom.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.

OUR TEAM:

At KMVT, you’ll join a newsroom that values curiosity, collaboration, and a genuine connection to the people it serves. Our team brings different experiences, interests, and perspectives to the work, but shares a commitment to journalism that helps southern Idaho audiences better understand their communities. We believe the strongest local reporting starts with listening, showing up, earning trust, and investing in the relationships that turn a station into a true community partner.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Twin Falls gives you the opportunity to build a life and a career in southern Idaho, with a strong sense of community and an affordable lifestyle that can make it easier to put down roots for the long term. It’s a place where a local journalist can truly get to know the people, organizations, and issues they cover, building the sources and relationships that lead to more meaningful reporting.

Outside the newsroom, southern Idaho’s landscape provides an unforgettable backdrop for life in the region. Whether you’re drawn to outdoor recreation, scenic surroundings, or simply the opportunity to become part of a close-knit community, Twin Falls offers a setting where you can invest in your career, your community, and the place you call home.

WCPO is looking for a Local Sales Manager who thrives at the intersection of media, marketing, and leadership. In this role, you'll guide a talented team of Account Executives to help local businesses grow by connecting them with customers through a powerful suite of multi-platform advertising solutions — from broadcast television to Over The Top (OTT) video, SEO/SEM, social media, digital display, and email targeting. If you're energized by coaching people, developing creative sales strategies, and making a measurable impact in your market, we want to hear from you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Collaborate with DOS and other sales managers and departments to accomplish the objectives of the station.
  • Organize, direct and manage the execution and performance of a team of local sales Account Executives.
  • Negotiate ratings, rates and budgets.
  • Develop new business for station utilizing and maximizing all station platforms including but not limited to broadcast, digital and mobile.
  • Develop working knowledge of Scripps Sales Process (SSP) and coach Account Executives regarding SSP in the field.
  • Utilize SSP, resources and tools provided to build effective sales strategies.
  • Collaborate with the Director of Sales and Sales Managers to train, develop and motivate the local sales team so that revenue goals are achieved.
  • Collaborate with the Director of Sales and Sales Managers to foster career growth and development of the local sales team so that a pipeline of talent for future Scripps sales management openings is ready.
  • Maintain positive working relationships with outside vendors.
  • Interface with traffic systems and personnel to ensure efficient management of airtime inventory.
  • Oversee accounts receivable and credit policies.
  • Develop and implement pricing and packaging to fill needs of both client and station.
  • Know the strengths and weaknesses of the competing stations, other advertising mediums and position the station accordingly.
  • Effectively forecast sales revenue and manage department expenses so that financial goals are achieved.
  • Other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Bachelor's degree in business or related field or equivalent experience preferred
  • Generally, 7+ years proven success in media sales
  • Experience in agency and direct strategic account management, broadcast inventory and digital/video capabilities required
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Demonstrated aptitude for informal leadership and mentoring; fosters open dialogue, empowers others, addresses conflict quickly and directly
  • Strong coaching and feedback skills
  • Strong ability to motivate others toward team goals
  • Able to foster an environment that enables creative and innovative thinking
  • Strong influencing, selling and upselling skills
  • Effective teamwork and collaboration skills
  • Very strong analysis and data interpretation - able to help others translate needs and research data into sound marketing proposals
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
  • Outstanding presentation abilities (in person/virtual, small/large groups, all levels)
  • Strong time management and organization skills
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and PowerPoint)
  • Working knowledge of Google Office (Sheets, Docs, Slides) and virtual conferencing platforms (E.g. Skype, WebEx, Zoom or MS Teams etc.)
  • Proven ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
  • May require some travel

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:


Cincinnati is a city that punches well above its weight — a vibrant, welcoming river city with a rich history, world-class culture, and a food scene that has earned national recognition. The Cincinnati Art Museum, the Cincinnati Symphony Orchestra, and the American Sign Museum are just a few of the cultural gems that make the city a destination in its own right. The revitalized Over-the-Rhine neighborhood, with its stunning 19th-century architecture, craft breweries, and acclaimed restaurants, has become one of the most celebrated urban districts in the Midwest.


Sports are a serious way of life here. Cincinnatians are passionate about the Bengals, the Reds, and FC Cincinnati — and attending a game at Paycor Stadium or Great American Ball Park along the Ohio River is an experience unlike any other. Beyond the stadiums, the region offers beautiful parks, miles of trails along the Little Miami Scenic Trail, and easy access to the rolling hills of both Ohio and Northern Kentucky, making it a great place for hikers, cyclists, and outdoor enthusiasts.


Cincinnati is also an incredibly affordable place to live, with a strong job market, diverse and distinct neighborhoods — from Hyde Park and Oakley to Covington just across the river in Kentucky — and a genuine sense of community. Whether you're raising a family, building a career, or simply looking for a city with authentic character and momentum, Cincinnati delivers on all fronts.

The MMJ will research, enterprise, develop, write, shoot and edit stories on deadline for recorded or live newscasts.   • Establish and maintain news contacts in the community.
  • Maintain a positive work atmosphere by behaving and communicating in a manner that works well with coworkers, supervisors, and the community at large.

Fox Cable Network Services, LLC seeks a Software Developer (Senior Salesforce Developer) to design, develop, and implement intelligent, data-driven salesforce solutions that enhance business efficiency and user experience across FOX divisions.  Play an essential role in bringing AI capabilities to life – integrating salesforce agent force, generative AI, and predictive analytics into FOX’s enterprise ecosystem.  Apply AI to real business scenarios at FOX, such as workflow automation for live event production and content operations as FOX’s own internal development lifecycle.  Specific duties include: 1) Design and develop custom Salesforce applications using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Visualforce.  2) Architect and implement AI-driven solutions using Salesforce AgentForce (Bots, Prediction Builder, Next Best Action) and external AI/ML platforms.  3) Integrate Salesforce with generative AI, NLP, and predictive analytics services to deliver smarter, automated workflows.  4) Lead the full software development lifecycle — from requirements and architecture to development, testing, and CI/CD deployment.  5) Write high-quality, scalable, and maintainable code that aligns with Salesforce best practices and enterprise standards.  6) Provide technical mentorship and guidance to junior developers and collaborating closely with architects, analysts, and administrators.  7) Troubleshoot complex technical issues and performance challenges across multiple Salesforce orgs and integrations.  8) Stay current with Salesforce releases, AI advancements, and emerging technologies to identify new opportunities for innovation and automation.  Telecommuting permitted from any location in the U.S.

Requires a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field, plus five (5) years of progressive, post-baccalaureate Salesforce development or related experience developing and configuring in Salesforce, including experience in Salesforce AI and custom AI/ML integrations

Universal Destination & Experiences’ Franchise, Products & Partnerships team (UDX FPP) extends NBCUniversal’s iconic brands, characters and stories through global consumer products and games, theme park merchandise and retail, in addition to the UDX enterprise function of franchise management and strategic partnerships. Supporting NBCUniversal’s owned portfolio of properties as well as third-party partners across the theme park business, UDX FPP creates products, experiences and partnerships that deepen fandom and connect audiences around the world with the characters, stories and worlds that define Universal.

UDX Franchise, Products & Partnerships

The Retail Commercial Specialist (Retail Merchandiser) independently owns assortment recommendations by location and the store merchandising financial strategy to ensure the right merchandise assortments are placed in each location. This includes executing merchandise placement in accordance with merchandiser-developed SKU-to-fixture plans, determining allocation quantities, allocating appropriate floor space for programs, and establishing product adjacencies. The Retail Commercial Specialist partners directly with Universal Studios Hollywood (USH) Retail Operations, UDX Franchise, Products & Partnerships (FPP) Global Merchandise Product Development/Buying, and Planning teams, the merchandise warehouse, and the Visual Merchandising team to develop location-specific retail strategies supported by analytics and business insights that inform and justify the overall retail master plan. The role is also responsible for managing inventory flow, monitoring out-of-stock conditions, and coordinating and directing floor sets, resets, and merchandise refreshes.

Here you can:

  • Own and manage the product assortment assignment within the Universal Studios Hollywood & CityWalk retail locations to define the short- and long-term strategic direction per location.
  • Work in tandem with the UDX Global Merchandise Product Development and Planning teams on location-based strategy planning to encompass line review attendance, mobilization milestone engagement, category, department, and program call-out via a grid implementation tool while providing location item display minimum quantity results.
  • Develop all store plans consistent with targeted guest mix, seasonal requirements, special event placement, attraction profile, and store concept profiles.
  • Regulate the balance of programs and inventory, direct the allocation strategy, re-evaluate program status, and negotiate changes as needed.
  • Manage the development of the multi-unit floor and SKU-to-fixture plans, the implementation of location plans while targeting post-mortem evaluation checks, and location financial results orientation, completed in accordance with Retail Creative (Visual Merchandise) and Retail Commercial Strategy (Merchandising), Universal Creative, UDX, and Intellectual Property (IP) brand standards and guidelines.
  • Conduct independent financial analysis to ensure program placement is meeting financial expectations and make decisions to re-assort or adjust tactics to address business trends. 
  • Communicate needs, suggestions, stock level concerns, and provide direction to the store operators and buyers/developers/planners on assortment issues, merchandise exit strategies, product replacement, expiration, and quality issues.
  • Directly monitor, track, and ensure the proper flow of goods, including new products, reorders, and delivery schedules.
  • Independently control updates to the auto replenishment schedules, parameter display minimums, replenishment adjustments, manual inventory orders, and support the store teams on caseline/confection concerns, inventory control, and RTV processes.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX/NBCU policy, procedures, training, and Team Member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

  • Individual Contributor.

Here you need:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited four-year college or university in a related field required, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be substituted in lieu of the degree requirement.
  • 3+ years of retail experience required.
  • 1+ year of operational retail management or merchandising/visual display experience required.

The Director, Sales Planning & Administration is responsible for leading title lifecycle management, deal administration, rights governance, and operational execution across assigned international territories. This role serves as a strategic operational partner to Commercial Sales, Account Management, Legal, Finance, Distribution, and Strategy, ensuring contractual compliance, inventory accuracy, and executional readiness throughout the licensing lifecycle. 

The ideal candidate is a seasoned distribution operations leader with deep expertise in rights management, window management, title availability, and enterprise system governance. This individual will possess a comprehensive understanding of the international television distribution business, including output and volume licensing structures, first-run title commitments, product qualification processes, and the end-to-end workflow from deal negotiation through operational execution. The successful candidate must demonstrate strong people leadership, operational rigor, strategic thinking, and cross-functional influence while ensuring accountability, data integrity, and executional excellence across the organization. 

Key Responsibilities:

Contract Governance & Rights Compliance 

  • Oversee all licensing activities in strict accordance with executed agreements, approved deal terms, distribution policy, and corporate SLAs. 
  • Conduct regular contract and rights audits to validate that system data matches active executed legal terms and mitigate operational exposure. 
  • Partner with Legal and Commercial Sales to evaluate amendments, waivers, title substitutions, and contract revisions prior to execution. 
  • Maintain official territory rules governing window structures, holdbacks, and commercial restrictions across transactional, output volume, and linear business models. 

Database Integrity, Pre-Submission QA & System Controls 

  • Oversee system setups in enterprise databases (SAFE) to ensure accurate configuration of rate cards, pricing, rights, and territory parameters prior to downstream release. 
  • Execute rigorous quality control over all outgoing tracking grids, budget files, and system setups to prevent fulfillment errors, data gaps, or feed disruptions. 
  • Manage database title blocking, pending order statuses, and configuration rules to ensure smooth supply chain feeds and eliminate artificial product availability blocks. 

  • Implement workflow improvements, automation initiatives, and reporting controls to enhance operational scalability and data accuracy. 

Strategic Operations & Cross-Functional Governance 

  • Manage day-to-day operational support and title volume commitments across assigned international territories, ensuring full launch readiness and customer fulfillment. 
  • Drive end-to-end visibility into active deal pipelines, rights availability constraints, and market-specific operational risks. 
  • Act as the primary Sales Administration lead to Commercial Sales, Legal, Account Management, and Distribution Strategy on deal execution, windowing strategy, and title prioritization. 
  • Partner with Finance to audit revenue recognition assumptions, billing readiness, and forecasting impacts prior to deal finalization. 
  • Foster a culture of transparency, collaboration, and operational rigor across all internal stakeholder groups. 

Team Leadership & Organizational Management 

  • Provide leadership and oversight for Managers and Assistant Managers, including second-line management responsibilities where applicable. 
  • Establish clear expectations around ownership, accountability, prioritization, and service delivery standards. 
  • Coach people leaders on issue resolution, workload management, stakeholder engagement, and employee development. 
  • Conduct performance management, talent development, and organizational capability building. 
  • Lead onboarding, training, knowledge transfer, and territory transition activities to ensure business continuity and operational consistency. 

Basic Requirements: 

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in Content Distribution, Sales Administration, Rights Management, Contract Administration, Account Management Operations, Distribution Operations, or related media entertainment functions. 
  • Minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing Managers and/or second-line teams within a major studio, broadcaster, streamer, or content distributor. 
  • Demonstrated experience supporting international television and film licensing businesses across multiple territories and distribution platforms. 
  • Experience supporting output, volume, package, and library licensing agreements across international markets. 
  • Comprehensive understanding of the end-to-end distribution workflow and stakeholder functions

Additional Requirements:

  • Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

  • Ensuring adherence to internal AI guardrails, SLAs, and security/compliance standards.

WBBM-TV, the CBS Owned & Operated station in Chicago, is seeking a dynamic, forward-thinking Anchor/Reporter (Sports) to help lead and shape our sports coverage across all platforms.


Local newsrooms and sports journalism are evolving rapidly, and this role is built for the modern era of media. The ideal candidate will be an anchor and multi-platform storyteller who actively drives engagement across digital channels, social media, and our 24/7 streaming network. Beyond the studio anchor desk, you will host key sports specials, anchor and report live remotely from major events, and enterprise compelling stories that connect with Chicago’s passionate sports community.
We are looking for an engaging, relatable personality and insightful expert who looks far beyond basic scores and stats and must be an exceptional writer capable of scripting concise, creative, and platform-tailored content for linear television, streaming broadcasts, and digital platforms.

 

Chicago is one of the greatest, most intense sports towns in the world. From legendary professional franchises to regional college sports and historic high school programs, our audience demands deep market knowledge, authentic connection, and modern storytelling that meets viewers wherever they consume news.

•    Anchor & Host: Lead energetic, authoritative sports segments on linear broadcasts; host high-profile station sports specials and digital/streaming original programming.

•    Remote & Field Reporting: Anchor and report live on location from marquee sporting events, breaking sports news, and deep-dive feature assignments.
•    Modern Storytelling & Enterprise: Move beyond traditional game recaps to enterprise original, character-driven stories; contribute consistently to daily editorial meetings with ideas built for a modern, digital-first newsroom.
•    Digital & Social Strategy: Execute a proactive social media strategy to engage Chicago sports fans in real time, build community, break news, and drive audience tune-in across platforms.
•    Linear Writing & Segment Scripting: Write sharp, conversational copy and craft well-structured segments and package scripts designed for high-impact linear and streaming broadcasts.
•    Journalistic Integrity: Maintain strict journalistic standards, accuracy, and strong editorial judgment in a fast-paced, rapidly shifting multi-platform newsroom.

 

REQUIREMENTS / QUALIFICATIONS:
•    Experience: Proven experience as a Sports Anchor/Reporter in a major market (Top 10 preferred), with a demonstrated track record of success across linear and digital platforms.
•    Modern Journalism Mindset: Strong understanding of how sports consumption habits are shifting and a passion for experimenting with new digital, streaming, and social storytelling formats.
•    On-Air & On-Screen Presence: Commanding, authentic, and versatile presentation style suited for linear studio anchoring, streaming coverage, and digital video content.
•    Market Expertise: Deep knowledge of Chicago and national sports—including professional leagues, regional college athletics, and high school sports culture.
•    Writing Excellence: Superior writing skills with the ability to adjust tone and format effectively for linear television, digital articles, streaming scripts, and social copy.
•    Collaboration & Adaptability: Ability to thrive under live pressure, multi-task, and collaborate seamlessly with newsroom producers, digital team members, photojournalists, and editors.

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

Overview:

The Director of Global Title Marketing, Kids & Family is tasked with leading the development, execution, analysis, and ongoing optimization of global marketing campaigns for select Paramount+ Kids & Family titles.   This role serves as a key cross-functional leader and steward of both individual titles and broader franchises. Developing campaigns that connect with kids across different age groups while also motivating parents, caregivers, and family co-viewers.   The ideal candidate has solid marketing strategy skills and deep knowledge of kids entertainment, family viewing habits, and franchise building. They also understand how young audiences discover and engage with content as those habits keep changing. The Director must be a great leader, compelling storyteller, collaborative partner, and forward-thinking problem-solver who can manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.   This is an onsite position at our New York or Burbank office.   

Responsibilities include but not limited to:

  • Lead the development, execution, analysis, and ongoing optimization of global go-to-market strategies
  • Translate series, film, character, and franchise attributes into differentiated campaign strategies that resonate with kids, parents, caregivers, and family co-viewers.
  • Develop audience strategies that account for distinct developmental stages, interests, viewing behaviors, and levels of parental influence across preschool, kids, tweens, teens, and family audiences.
  • Identify clear campaign objectives, audience priorities, strategic opportunities, and measures of success. Holding team members and partners accountable throughout campaign development and execution.
  • Apply a global perspective while recognizing regional differences in family dynamics, cultural relevance, content discovery, and children’s media consumption.
  • Ensure campaign strategies and executions are age-appropriate, inclusive, brand-safe, and aligned with applicable privacy, advertising, and platform guidelines.
  • Proactively identify key milestones, connect workstreams, resolve challenges, and ensure that creative and tactical executions ladder up to the overall strategy.
  • Brief cross-functional teams on campaign strategy so each discipline can develop a cohesive, audience-led plan.
  • Serve as a subject-matter expert and enthusiastic steward of assigned titles, characters, and franchises.
  • Build marketing strategies that support both the immediate title launch and long-term health, relevance, and growth
  • Partner with franchise, consumer products, licensing, retail, games, publishing, experiences, and other teams, where applicable. Creating related opportunities across the broader Paramount ecosystem.
  • Foster productive and trusting relationships with key stakeholders to ensure plans are developed and executed in a timely, collaborative, and efficient manner.
  • Maintain and build the team’s knowledge of the Kids & Family landscape, including audience behaviors, platform trends, franchise development, and responsible marketing practices.
  • Drive alignment among senior leadership and external partners. This includes: creators, executive producers, filmmakers, talent, studios, and co-production partners.
  • Clearly articulate the audience opportunity, campaign positioning, and strategic choices, behind recommendations.
  • Drive innovative thinking to develop 360-degree global stunts, partnerships, activations, and breakthrough campaign ideas that can generate excitement among kids and families.
  • Identify opportunities to bring titles and characters into the real world through family experiences, fan events, cultural moments, educational initiatives, and strategic brand partnerships.
  • Brief and lead “big idea” initiatives, managing internal teams and agency partners through execution.
  • Evaluate ideas through the distinct lenses of child appeal, parent or caregiver relevance, family participation, brand safety, and earned-media potential.
  • Partner with Media and Campaign Management teams to lead the development and execution of media campaigns across platforms that reach kids, parents, caregivers, and family audiences.
  • Understand the challenges of reaching young audiences. This includes streaming, digital video, social platforms, gaming environments, connected television, family programming, and media focused on parents.
  • Identify opportunities to reach parents and caregivers as content decision-makers while also building organic excitement and cultural relevance among young audiences.
  • Analyze audience research, campaign performance, competitive intelligence, and cultural trends to identify opportunities and inform strategy. Lead cross-functional reviews of awareness, consideration, engagement, viewing, acquisition, retention, co-viewing, repeat viewing, and franchise affinity. Turning data into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Combine quantitative data with qualitative audience knowledge. Recognizing that parents, caregivers, and children may each play different roles in content discovery and viewing decisions.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • 7+ years of entertainment marketing experience. With demonstrated experience developing campaigns for kids & family content, family entertainment, animation, or youth-focused brands.

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Experience leading multi-channel campaigns from strategy through execution and performance analysis.
  • Solid awareness of the distinct needs and behaviors of kids, tweens, parents, caregivers, and family co-viewing audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to market to young audiences responsibly and navigate relevant brand-safety, privacy, advertising, and platform considerations.
  • Solid interpersonal skills and a proven ability to manage relationships with senior internal stakeholders, creators, talent, filmmakers, studios, agencies, and external partners.

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

Overview and Responsibilities

This position is responsible for providing administrative and operational support to the Executive Vice President, Business Affairs & Partnerships, and for supporting the department’s work with internal teams and external partners. This position includes supporting the studio’s co-financing and strategic partnership activities, through financial analysis, deal tracking, and partnership management.

 

Responsibilities to include, but not limited to:

  • Provides high-level administrative support to the EVP, including assisting in the preparation of EVP work product

  • Supports the development and maintenance of strategic partnerships and relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners

  • Manages and maintains EVP calendar; schedules appointments, confirms meetings, and coordinates meeting logistics and travel arrangements

  • Prepares, proofreads, and distributes internal and external agreements, memos, and correspondence; backs up proofreading and editing of documents prepared by attorneys

  • Maintains and updates the status of projects, negotiations, and partnership initiatives in various status report databases and tracking systems

  • Prepares and processes expense reports, invoices, and purchase requests

  • Supports Business Affairs negotiations by gathering relevant information and precedent and creating “deal charts” and research projects

  • Supports the studio’s co-financing, distribution, and strategic partnership efforts

  • Support negotiations through review of terms sheets, comparables and talking points

  • Tracks active co-financing deals, including relevant deadline and milestone, performance against projections, and recoupment reporting

  • Tracks key deal terms, deliverables, and renewal dates across the partnership portfolio

  • 3+ years of administrative support experience, preferably in an entertainment, legal, and/or business affairs environment

  • Experience in film finance, investment banking, consulting, or entertainment deal-making a plus

job.description:

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KPNX-TV, the TEGNA NBC affiliate in Phoenix seeks a Broadcast Director. The primary responsibility of this position is intended to support new newscasts as well as directing daily newscasts and other local programs, utilizing both production automation and manual switching operations. The Broadcast Director will work closely with our news, production, and technical teams to produce fast-paced, compelling and comprehensive newscasts and programs.

We are looking for someone to bring forward-thinking production ideas, strong technical knowledge, and the ability to manage quality control at a high level. In addition, the candidate must also be familiar with all studio operations, including floor directing, camera operation, teleprompter, graphics creation, audio, lighting, non-linear editing, content management systems and master control systems.

 

Responsibilities: 

  • Direct daily live newscasts and recorded shows using both automation and manual switching.
  • Oversee the overall look of newscasts and on-air programming.
  • Identify and correct potential problems before they hit air.
  • Troubleshooting technical systems when required.
  • Use non-linear editing and content management systems for programming, commercial and digital content creation.
  • Other production department duties as assigned.

Requirements: 

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Communications or TV Production or related degree preferred or equivalent experience may be substituted.
  • Experience (3 years preferred) with production automation, video switchers, newsroom computer systems, video servers, and graphics systems.
  • Ability to adapt quickly and respond effectively for breaking news and unexpected events.
  • Excellent communication skills, with an emphasis on working as a team with multiple departments.
  • Experience with ENPS, Chyron, and BitCentral systems is a plus
  • Flexible scheduling: this position includes weekends, and may also cover early mornings, nights, or holidays as needed.

  • Use your natural curiosity to pitch compelling stories.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Account Executive– Outside Sales

Territory-Based | Hybrid | Client-Facing Market Role

Company: LocaliQ, powered by the USA TODAY Network

Location:  This is a hybrid, outside sales role supporting a designated geographic territory (Langhorne, PA and surrounding region in Pennsylvania and New Jersey).  Success in this position requires regular in-market client and prospect in-person engagement. While much of the work is performed remotely and in the field, periodic attendance at a company office for meetings, training, collaboration, and business activities may be required.

Why This Role Stands Out:

Competitive base salary with uncapped commission and strong earning potential

Contests, and recognition programs

Consultative, full-cycle sales

Hybrid flexibility with autonomy to manage your schedule and territory

Strong onboarding, coaching, and sales enablement

Access to an extensive mix of digital and traditional marketing solutions, enabling consultative, end-to-end strategies tailored to each client’s growth objectives

Career Development – Clear paths to career advancement, mentor programs, and tools to manage your long-term career.

Backed by marketing expertise, post-sale specialists, and industry-leading tools

About LocaliQ

At LocaliQ, part of USA TODAY Co., we help businesses grow by bringing together advanced marketing technology, trusted audience reach, and the expertise to turn it into results. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of digital marketing and one of the most trusted media networks in the country—helping businesses connect with customers across the full marketing funnel.

You’ll partner with clients to understand their goals, build strategies that combine performance-driven digital solutions with the reach of the USA TODAY Network, and deliver measurable outcomes. This is an opportunity to be part of a team that doesn’t just sell products. We bring together the right mix of solutions to drive real business growth.

About the Role

Our Account Executive (Integrated Media Specialist) – sales role is a consultative, relationship-driven sales position for someone who loves owning the full sales cycle—from net-new prospecting through long-term account growth—and who thrives in both hunting and managing client relationships.

In this role, you will actively hunt for net-new business, while also managing, growing, and expanding an ongoing book of clients. You’ll create tailored marketing strategies, guide businesses from first conversation through ongoing performance discussions, and continually identify opportunities to deepen partnerships over time. You’ll act as a trusted marketing partner—not a transactional seller—balancing new business development with retention, upsell, and account expansion to drive long-term client value.

Our Account Executive - Integrated Media Specialist role is partnered with a post-sales team that manages campaign performance, optimizes results, and prepares reporting. Additional support resources are available, including the Data and Insights team, Client Strategists, and other product-specific resources.

In your first 90 days, you’ll gain confidence in LocaliQ’s solutions, tools, and sales approach while building meaningful prospecting and discovery habits. By the end of this period, you’ll be owning your territory and sales cycle end-to-end, with the support and coaching needed to set you up for long-term success.

What You Will Do

Build a consistent prospecting cadence using cold calls, email, social outreach, networking, and in-person or virtual meetings to develop a strong pipeline.

Manage and grow a book of clients balancing new business development, client retention, and account expansion.

Lead thoughtful discovery conversations to understand business goals, marketing challenges, and growth opportunities.

Build and present data-informed digital and traditional marketing proposals that connect strategy, tactics, and budget to client goals.

Own the full sales cycle—from initial outreach through close—while maintaining accurate CRM activity, pipeline management, and forecasting.

Partner with internal account management, creative, and strategy teams to support strong client outcomes.

Stay engaged post-sale through reporting, optimization, and performance conversations that support renewals and continued growth.

Qualifications

2+ years of B2B sales experience with success in new business development, account growth, or business development roles.

Experience in media, digital marketing, advertising sales preferred.

Ability to run a full-cycle, consultative sales process—from discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close.

Strong prospecting skills across phone, email, social, networking, and relationship-based outreach.

Experience using CRM and sales tools with disciplined pipeline management and follow-up.

Comfort learning and discussing digital marketing solutions such as search, social, display, and video (direct experience is a plus, not required).

Excellent communication skills, business curiosity, and the ability to build credibility with diverse clients and stakeholders, influencing decisions through clear data-driven recommendations.

Proficiency with CRM, Microsoft Office Suite, and AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot.

Valid driver’s license and vehicle insurance

Who Thrives Here

High performers in this role are resilient, self-motivated, strategic and creative minded and competitive, with a strong drive to outperform and continuously take on greater impact. They are coachable and highly self-directed, comfortable initiating outreach, staying organized, asking thoughtful questions, and using data and tools to work efficiently. Energized by real-time results, they handle rejection well and maintain full ownership of their performance and trajectory.

Benefits

We believe high performance should be recognized and supported through compensation, development, and real opportunity to grow your skills.

Competitive base salary + Uncapped commission opportunity

401(k) with company match

Career progression opportunities

Flexibility and autonomy in a hybrid work environment

High-performance culture with recognition, incentives

Comprehensive health, dental & vision coverage options and more

Unlimited MTO time off, including paid holidays

Structured onboarding to get you ramped fast

Ongoing coaching from experienced leaders

Access to industry-leading tools, resources, and marketing expertise

Step into a territory where you can own the full sales cycle, bring smart marketing solutions to the table, and be recognized for the results you deliver. If you’re ready to grow your career and be part of a high-performing team, we encourage you to apply.

The annualized base salary for this role will range between $50,000 and $60,000. Base compensation is reflective of many factors, including, but not limited to, the market in which one lives/works, individual education level, skills, certifications and experience. Note: variable compensation is not reflected in these figures and based on the role, may be applicable.

The annualized base salary for this role is $50,000 with an On Target of $$83,333 and uncapped commission.  Base compensation is reflective of many factors, including, but not limited to, the market in which one lives/works, individual education level, skills, certifications and experience. Note: variable compensation is not reflected in these figures and based on the role, may be applicable.

Employee Referral Bonus Eligible

job.title: Program Manager, WP Studios
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post’s WP Studios team is seeking a highly organized and strategic Program Manager to lead the execution and delivery of custom advertising programs, branded content initiatives, and event-based sponsorships across digital, experiential, live, and emerging platforms.


This client-facing role serves as the primary owner of program execution and fulfillment, overseeing production timelines, creative development, event logistics, stakeholder alignment, operational workflows, and delivery from kickoff through launch, live execution, and post-campaign wrap-up. With a particular focus on event-based programs, the Program Manager will serve as a trusted partner to sponsors while coordinating across internal teams, venues, production partners, and external vendors to bring complex campaigns and experiences to life.


The ideal candidate combines strong program and production management expertise with operational judgment, cross-functional leadership, and creative problem-solving. This individual thrives in fast-paced environments, independently manages complex initiatives, proactively identifies risks and opportunities, and continuously looks for ways to improve the quality, efficiency, and scalability of WP Studios programs.


What Motivates You

  • Bringing complex, multi-platform ideas and live experiences to life through strong execution and collaboration.
  • Leading high-impact programs independently while balancing multiple priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines.
  • Building trusted relationships with clients, sponsors, agencies, and cross-functional partners.
  • Solving operational, creative, and event-production challenges proactively and with confidence.
  • Delivering innovative, high-quality advertising campaigns, branded content, and live or virtual experiences.
  • Anticipating risks, removing blockers, and keeping complex programs and activations on track.
  • Working collaboratively across creative, editorial, technical, event, and operational teams.
  • Continuously improving processes and identifying scalable solutions that support efficiency, consistency, and business growth.
  • Using data, automation, and AI-enabled tools thoughtfully to improve workflows and execution while maintaining strong human judgment and oversight.

How You'll Support the Mission


Program & Production Leadership

  • Lead the end-to-end execution of custom advertising programs, branded content campaigns, and event activations across digital, experiential, live, and virtual platforms.
  • Independently manage programs from kickoff and planning through production, launch, live execution, optimization, and post-campaign wrap-up.
  • Translate sold programs into clear execution plans that align stakeholders, resources, timelines, deliverables, event logistics, and client expectations.
  • Evaluate operational feasibility, resourcing needs, and executional tradeoffs and recommend solutions that balance quality, scalability, and business priorities.

Event & Sponsorship Execution

  • Serve as the primary production point of contact for event and program sponsors, guiding them through onboarding, asset collection, approvals, fulfillment, and execution.
  • Manage sponsor deliverables and branded integrations, including logos, speaking briefs, digital assets, event signage, marketing materials, and on-site or virtual activations.
  • Partner with Events, Editorial, Marketing, Creative, Production, venues, and external vendors to deliver engaging live and virtual experiences.
  • Manage event-related timelines, logistics, dependencies, and sponsor requirements to ensure activations are delivered on time and according to specifications.

Project Management & Operational Excellence

  • Serve as a central point of coordination across Creative, Events, Editorial, Design, Development, Video, Audio, Ad Operations, Product, Marketing, and external partners.
  • Develop and maintain detailed project timelines, workflows, status reporting, and delivery documentation across multiple concurrent programs.
  • Proactively identify risks, dependencies, and executional gaps and implement mitigation plans to keep programs on track.
  • Navigate competing priorities, evolving stakeholder needs, and shifting timelines while maintaining delivery quality and accountability.
  • Identify and implement process improvements that increase operational efficiency, scalability, consistency, and program quality.

Client & Stakeholder Management

  • Lead day-to-day client and sponsor communication related to production timelines, deliverables, approvals, requirements, and execution strategy in partnership with Sales and Account Management.
  • Independently facilitate meetings and discussions with clients, agencies, sponsors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Manage feedback and approval processes to maintain alignment between client expectations and execution realities.
  • Serve as a trusted operational partner by communicating updates, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly and proactively.

Custom Product, Performance & Optimization

  • Collaborate with Ad Operations and Product teams to implement custom advertising solutions and event programs across platforms, ensuring custom elements are built, tested, quality-checked, and launched according to specifications.
  • Support social media, content distribution, promotional, and audience-engagement strategies in partnership with internal teams.
  • Partner with Account Management and Performance teams to monitor campaign delivery, attendee engagement, sponsorship effectiveness, and other relevant performance indicators.
  • Contribute production insights, custom metrics, event engagement data, and sponsor recap materials to post-campaign analysis and recommend opportunities to improve future execution and client outcomes.

Automation & Efficiency

  • Use AI-enabled and automation tools where appropriate to improve project tracking, scheduling, status reporting, meeting documentation, production coordination, quality assurance, and launch validation.
  • Explore opportunities to use emerging tools for audience insights, sponsorship reporting, risk identification, event planning, and activation support while maintaining strong human oversight, strategic judgment, and relationship management.

The Skills and Experience You Bring


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in program management, project management, production, account management, client services, or campaign execution within advertising, media, events, branded content, or related environments.
  • Demonstrated experience independently managing complex, high-visibility, multi-stakeholder programs from initiation through delivery.
  • Experience executing custom, branded, or native advertising campaigns, including live or virtual event activations and sponsor fulfillment.
  • Strong understanding of digital media, content production, experiential logistics, advertising workflows, and integrated campaign execution.
  • Demonstrated experience managing sponsor or client relationships and leading communications with clients, agencies, and senior stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment while maintaining strong attention to detail.
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, project planning, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to proactively identify risks and drive solutions.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across creative, editorial, technical, event production, and operational teams.
  • Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, navigate ambiguity, and drive execution with minimal oversight.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and project management platforms such as Asana, Jira, Prisma, or MediaOcean.
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled productivity, workflow automation, collaboration, analytics, or reporting tools preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Media, Business, or a related field preferred.

 

Collaboration makes us stronger. That’s why our offices are designed with open layouts, modern technology, and easy access to transportation. With certain exceptions for newsgathering and business travel, we work on-site five days a week.

Compensation and Benefits

Wherever you are in your life or career, The Washington Post offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits for every step of your journey:

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage

  • Company-paid pension and 401(k) match

  • Three weeks of vacation and up to three weeks of paid sick leave

  • Nine paid holidays and two personal days

  • 20 weeks paid parental leave for any new parent

  • Robust mental health resources

  • Backup care and caregiver concierge services

  • Gender affirming services

  • Pet insurance

  • Free Post digital subscription

  • Leadership and career development programs

Benefits may vary based on the job, full-time or part-time schedule, location, and collectively bargained status.

The salary range for this position is:

$85,100 - $127,700 Annual

The actual salary within this range will depend on individual skills, experience, and qualifications as they relate to specific job requirements. This position may be eligible for a bonus or incentive program, and a member of the Talent Acquisition team will discuss bonus payment terms and conditions during the interview process.

Your story awaits. Apply today!

job.title: Senior Data Engineer
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How we LEAD:

We are seeking an experienced and driven Senior Data Engineer – Enterprise Data Products within the Global Data & Analytics team.


You are passionate about building scalable, reliable, and AI-ready data platforms that power enterprise decision-making and advanced analytics. You understand that modern data platforms must not only support reporting, but also enable machine learning, generative AI, and intelligent applications through high-quality, well-governed, and semantically consistent data.


In this role, you will lead teams of data engineers responsible for building and operating domain-specific data products, semantic layers, and data marts that serve as trusted, AI-ready sources of truth across the organization, with a strong emphasis on ecommerce data products and Shopify data pipelines.


You will play a key role in shaping how data is structured, governed, and exposed to support AI/ML use cases, feature engineering, and semantic consistency across tools and applications.


How you’ll CREATE:

  • Design and build scalable data pipelines and data products that support analytics and AI/ML use cases.
  • Build and scale ecommerce data products and pipelines, with particular focus on Shopify data such as orders, customers, products, transactions, fulfillment, and marketing events.
  • Develop and maintain AI-ready datasets, ensuring high quality, consistency, and usability for downstream applications.
  • Work with data scientists and analysts to support feature engineering, model training data, and experimentation needs.
  • Contribute to building and maintaining semantic layers that standardize business definitions and enable consistent reporting and analysis.
  • Implement data validation, testing, and monitoring to ensure data quality and reliability.
  • Build and optimize data models (dimensional, curated layers) aligned with business requirements.
  • Optimize data storage and query performance by leveraging columnar data structures and databases where applicable.
  • Support batch and real-time data pipelines using modern data stack tools.
  • Follow best practices for code quality, version control, and CI/CD in data engineering workflows.
  • Collaborate with product, analytics, and governance teams to ensure data is well-documented, discoverable, and trusted.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve data issues, ensuring minimal disruption to downstream users.

Bring your VIBE:

  • 8+ years of experience in data engineering or related roles.

  • 7+ years of experience collaborating, building alignment and communicating clearly.

As the Manager, Event Campaign Production, you do not attend external or client-facing partner meetings independently, but operate with authority within the production workflow. You will direct creative output, managing vendor relationships daily, and overseeing the project management infrastructure that keeps the campaign on track.

Responsibilities:

  • Build the Marketing Notion Board — the central project management tool tracking all creative tasks, owners, statuses, and deadlines across every active campaign.
  • Manage the creative production timeline for each event, from initial brief through final asset delivery.
  • Coordinate daily workflow across internal creative teams, external vendors, and agency partners to keep production moving without bottlenecks.
  • Brief the NYT Communications Systems team on landing page and event page updates and manage the production timeline for those deliverables.
  • Be the primary daily contact for external creative vendors and production agencies, under the strategic direction of the Director and Production Lead.

job.title: Sr. Program Manager
job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do. 

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious!

We are looking for a Sr. Program Manager to join Translation!

This role is based in Brooklyn, New York with four days in-office and one day remote.


What You'll Do

  • Own the how. Develop scopes, timelines, budgets and delivery systems for programs ranging from complex to “simple.” Don’t assume one size fits all. 
  • Coordinate internal and external meetings throughout the lifecycle of the program, and maintain close coordination with key stakeholders, including Business Leadership and Production.
  • Deliver strategic and creative deliverables directly to day to day clients. Own contact reports, internally and back to the client.
  • Manage talent allocations week over week. Work with the Group Engagement Director and Business Leadership to ensure programs are planned to achieve successful completion, including coming in on time and on budget.
  • Coordinate internal teams, ensure high quality delivery, and manage back to overarching strategy of the engagement.
  • Develop a strong understanding of client’s business and industry, key competitors, and audience demographics.
  • Help maintain integrated ways of working by reinforcing team processes and managing documentation and communications.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • A proactive, hands-on mentality. You take immense pride in your work. You’re results-driven and detail-oriented, but also passionate about people, culture, and creativity.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present ideas clearly, accurately, and succinctly.

job.title: Application Security Engineer
job.description:
About Us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide. At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world. In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing. Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere. Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We believe in the power of unique perspectives and want all voices in our organisation to be heard, respected and valued. A supportive workplace is one where employees feel they can be themselves and operate to their full potential. We are committed to removing barriers for everyone, with a focus on addressing those faced by underrepresented groups.

The Role Overview

We’re looking for a Cyber Security Engineer to help improve application security across the FT’s cloud-native technology estate. This is a hands-on role focused on making secure engineering easier for product, platform and software engineering teams.

Application security experience is essential for this role. You’ll help improve developer-friendly security guardrails across GitHub-based CI/CD pipelines, application repositories and engineering workflows. This includes working with SAST, software composition analysis, secret scanning, vulnerability management and secure coding guidance so that security findings are clear, actionable and owned by the right teams.

You’ll work closely with engineers to support practical threat modelling, triage application vulnerabilities, improve security playbooks and help teams remediate issues in a pragmatic way. You do not need to be a deep AWS or cloud security specialist, but some exposure to AWS, cloud security or infrastructure-as-code security would be useful.

We’re looking for someone with practical AppSec experience who wants to grow their impact - someone who enjoys working with engineers, improving tooling and helping security become part of normal delivery rather than a last-minute checkpoint.

What you’ll bring to the role

Application security experience: practical experience identifying, explaining and helping remediate application security risks in modern engineering environments.

Developer-friendly security mindset: you enjoy working with engineers, explaining risks clearly and helping teams adopt secure practices without unnecessary friction.

Vulnerability management experience: experience triaging and tracking application vulnerabilities from sources such as SAST, dependency scanning, secret scanning, penetration tests, bug bounty reports or third-party advisories.

CI/CD and code security awareness: familiarity with security tooling in development workflows, such as SAST, software composition analysis, secret scanning or repository security controls.

Threat modelling awareness: experience participating in, supporting or facilitating lightweight threat-modelling sessions for applications, services or new features.

Automation mindset: ability to write scripts or small tools, ideally in Python, to reduce manual effort, improve visibility or make security workflows easier.

Cloud security awareness: Some exposure to AWS, cloud security or infrastructure-as-code security would be useful, but is not essential.

Growth mindset: willingness to keep developing across application security, cloud security, secure development and modern engineering practices.

Required Experience, Essential

  • Practical experience in application security.
  • Experience working with software engineers to explain and remediate security issues.
  • Familiarity with common web application security risks and secure coding practices.
  • Experience with vulnerability triage, prioritisation and remediation tracking.
  • Experience using or interpreting findings from tools such as SAST, software composition analysis, secret scanning or similar.
  • Experience participating in or supporting threat-modelling activities.
  • Ability to write scripts or small tools, ideally in Python, to automate tasks or improve visibility.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Familiarity with Agile or Scrum ways of working.

Desirable

  • Exposure to AWS security, cloud security or infrastructure-as-code security.
  • Experience with Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Experience with container or Kubernetes security.
  • Experience with bug bounty, penetration testing or security testing programmes.
  • Experience with Splunk or similar logging/SIEM platforms.
  • Exposure to AI security, such as LLM-enabled applications, AI-assisted development workflows or prompt/data leakage risks.
  • Experience building dashboards, metrics or reports to support vulnerability management.
  • Relevant security certifications or training, such as AWS security training, secure coding training, GIAC, ISC2, CREST or equivalent practical experience.

 

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for all roles. We believe this balanced approach supports flexibility and protects our culture, making collaboration and communication easier, building stronger relationships and team cohesion, and supporting peer learning.  We reserve discretion on reasonable notice to change this approach either generally or for specific individuals or teams.

Using data and insight, you’ll help identify the audiences we need to reach, determine how best to engage them and uncover opportunities to grow our issuer and investor communities and support the commercial growth of our events.

  • Share audience insights and recommendations with Marketing and Issuer & Investor Relations colleagues to guide future strategy.

The Role

The Marketing Manager, B2B Lifecycle will own and develop defined areas of the B2B lifecycle strategy across FT Professional and the FT Specialist portfolio, with a primary focus on renewal and customer value growth through cross-sell and upsell.

You will own a portfolio of lifecycle programmes spanning renewal support, retention, cross-sell and upsell, delivering measurable improvements in account growth, renewal rates and customer lifetime value. The role will also flex across earlier lifecycle stages, including trial engagement, onboarding and in-life engagement, where required to support broader commercial priorities.

Working closely with the Head of B2B Lifecycle, you will translate the overall lifecycle strategy into quarterly plans, prioritised initiatives and commercial outcomes. Using customer insight and performance analysis, you will find opportunities, determine where resource should be focused and lead programmes designed to improve renewal outcomes and drive expansion within existing accounts.

You will work closely with collaborators across B2B Marketing, Sales, Data & Analytics and Marketing Automation to ensure lifecycle programmes support wider product, proposition and account strategies while remaining focused on customer outcomes. Marketing Automation will design and build campaigns and journeys from the briefs and strategic requirements you develop.

A core part of the role is ownership of business performance. You will define KPIs, monitor progress against commercial objectives, identify risks and opportunities, and recommend interventions that improve renewal performance, account growth and customer lifetime value.

As part of the Experience and Lifecycle Centre of Excellence, you will also help establish and embed consistent lifecycle frameworks, playbooks and ways of working across FT Professional, FT Specialist and Consumer Lifecycle.

Key responsibilities

Lifecycle strategy and planning

  • Own lifecycle plans and a portfolio of programmes focused on renewal, retention, cross-sell and upsell, translating the overall B2B lifecycle strategy into quarterly priorities and measurable commercial outcomes.

  • Define lifecycle approaches including audience segmentation, personalisation, contact strategy and customer experience, aligned with wider commercial and account priorities.

  • Strong analytical and commercial skills, with the ability to turn customer behaviour and business performance into strategic recommendations and measurable improvements.
