job.title: Principal Engineer - Integration Services
job.description:
About Us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Together, we help audiences stay better informed and deepen their understanding of the world around them.

Our Product & Tech teams drive us forward in an ever-evolving digital landscape, delivering cutting-edge products to over one million digital subscribers daily. Our growth relies on a diverse, dedicated and dynamic group of product, tech, delivery and data specialists.

With a supportive culture, entrepreneurial spirit and opportunities at every turn, there are no limits to where your FT career can take you.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion

We believe in the power of unique perspectives and want all voices in our organisation to be heard, respected and valued. A supportive workplace is one where employees feel they can be themselves and operate to their full potential. We are committed to removing barriers for everyone, with a focus on addressing those faced by underrepresented groups.

About you

You are an experienced Principal Engineer or senior engineering leader with a strong background in enterprise integration, shared engineering services or platform capabilities.

You have experience working across multiple teams and technology domains, with the judgement to distinguish between capabilities that should be centrally owned and standardised and those that should remain within individual engineering teams.

You are comfortable operating at both strategic and technical levels. You can define a direction for shared integration and engineering capabilities while still engaging deeply enough with architecture, engineering practices, reliability and delivery to make credible technical decisions.

You are also an experienced people leader who can build and develop senior engineers and create a high-performing team around a new capability. You are able to influence teams without relying solely on formal authority and can establish common approaches where responsibilities have historically been distributed.

You understand that shared services succeed only when they are useful to the teams that depend on them. You therefore approach platform and integration engineering pragmatically, balancing standardisation and reuse with the needs of individual products and domains.

About the team

Integration Services sits within Internal Products and provides shared engineering capabilities that enable connectivity, automation and engineering quality across the organisation.

The capability spans enterprise integrations, reusable engineering services and quality engineering practices that support multiple products, platforms and teams across Internal Products.

As the FT continues to evolve its enterprise technology landscape and undertake significant transformation, the need for consistent, reusable and reliable integration capabilities is increasing.

Two major programmes are currently running in parallel and both depend heavily on shared integration capabilities across multiple platforms and teams. At present, responsibilities are distributed across different parts of the organisation, creating risks around fragmented ownership, duplicated solutions, inconsistent approaches and limited reuse.

The Principal Engineer – Integration Services will establish and lead this capability, creating clear ownership for shared services while ensuring the team remains closely connected to the engineering teams and domains it supports.

What you’ll work on

As Principal Engineer – Integration Services, you will establish and lead the Integration Services capability across Internal Products.

You will own the technical direction, engineering capability, people leadership, delivery and operational performance of shared integration and engineering services.

A key part of the role will be defining what should become a reusable Internal Products capability and what should remain owned within individual domains. You will establish common integration approaches, reusable services and engineering patterns that reduce duplication and make it easier for teams to connect systems safely and reliably.

You will provide senior technical leadership across major transformation programmes, including the Commercial Technology Programme, ensuring integration decisions made within individual programmes contribute to a coherent and sustainable technology estate.

You will also build and develop the team itself, establishing the engineering capability, operating model and ways of working required for a successful shared service organisation.

Your responsibilities will include

Integration Strategy & Technical Direction

  • Defining the technical direction for integration services across Internal Products.
  • Establishing principles, standards and reusable patterns for enterprise integration.
  • Developing a clear strategy for shared integration capabilities, balancing centralisation, reuse and domain autonomy.
  • Identifying opportunities to simplify integration architecture, reduce duplication and improve interoperability.
  • Providing technical leadership on significant integration decisions spanning multiple platforms, teams and domains.
  • Ensuring integration approaches consider security, resilience, scalability, observability, operability and long-term maintainability.
  • Working with Architecture and senior engineering leaders to align integration direction with wider FT technology strategy.
  • Establishing a clear view of the integration landscape, including major interfaces, dependencies, ownership and technical risks.

Shared Services & Platform Engineering

  • Defining and building reusable integration services and engineering capabilities that solve common problems across Internal Products.
  • Establishing clear ownership for shared services and ensuring they have sustainable operational and engineering models.
  • Ensuring shared capabilities provide genuine value to consuming teams rather than becoming additional layers of complexity.
  • Setting appropriate expectations for reliability, performance, scalability, security and service availability.
  • Establishing effective lifecycle management for shared platforms and services.
  • Identifying opportunities for standardisation, consolidation and reuse.
  • Ensuring teams have clear guidance on when to use shared services and when to build capability within their own domains.

Engineering Quality & Automation

  • Establishing and evolving quality engineering capabilities that improve the reliability and confidence of software delivery across Internal Products.
  • Promoting consistent engineering practices around testing, automation, CI/CD and quality assurance where appropriate.
  • Identifying recurring quality problems across teams and developing reusable approaches to address them.
  • Working with engineering leaders to improve automated testing, release confidence and software quality.
  • Encouraging engineering teams to treat quality as part of engineering ownership rather than a separate activity.
  • Using metrics, operational insight and engineering feedback to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

Strategic Programmes & Transformation

  • Providing senior engineering leadership to major transformation programmes, including the Commercial Technology Programme.
  • Working across programme teams to establish coherent integration strategies across multiple platforms and workstreams.
  • Challenging programme-specific solutions where they create unnecessary duplication, complexity or long-term dependency.
  • Ensuring integration decisions made during transformation can be sustainably operated and evolved after programme delivery ends.
  • Supporting technology and vendor evaluations where integration architecture is a material consideration.
  • Helping programmes distinguish between capabilities that should be delivered as reusable Internal Products services and those that are specific to an individual initiative.

People & Engineering Leadership

  • Leading and developing the engineers within Integration Services.
  • Establishing a high-performing team with clear responsibilities, strong engineering standards and appropriate technical ownership.
  • Coaching senior engineers and developing technical leadership capability within the team.
  • Building an environment that encourages collaboration, constructive technical challenge and knowledge sharing.
  • Recruiting and developing the specialist skills required to build a sustainable integration capability.
  • Creating succession and reducing key-person dependency across critical integration knowledge.
  • Establishing clear expectations for engineering quality, operational performance and delivery.
  • Building strong relationships with engineering leaders across Internal Products so the shared capability is embedded rather than operating as a separate silo.

Delivery & Planning

  • Establishing a roadmap for the development and evolution of shared integration services.
  • Prioritising investment across reusable capabilities, programme commitments, operational work and technical improvement.
  • Working with Product and engineering leaders to understand demand for shared services and translate this into realistic delivery plans.
  • Managing capacity and ensuring the team can support both strategic initiatives and ongoing operational responsibilities.
  • Identifying dependencies and delivery risks across consuming teams and programmes.
  • Providing clear visibility of progress, risks, trade-offs and technical constraints.

Operational Excellence & Reliability

  • Owning the operational performance of shared integration services.
  • Establishing appropriate approaches to monitoring, observability, incident management, problem management and operational readiness.
  • Ensuring critical integrations have clear ownership, appropriate resilience and effective recovery mechanisms.
  • Leading the response to significant incidents affecting shared services and coordinating resolution across dependent teams.
  • Using operational data and incident learning to identify systemic improvements.
  • Ensuring operational responsibilities are sustainable and do not depend disproportionately on individual engineers.

Cross-Domain Collaboration

  • Building strong working relationships with Principal Engineers, Engineering Managers, architects and senior engineers across Internal Products.
  • Establishing effective mechanisms for teams to engage with Integration Services early in the lifecycle of significant initiatives.
  • Helping teams understand integration trade-offs and select appropriate patterns and capabilities.
  • Coordinating decisions where integration ownership crosses domain boundaries.
  • Encouraging reuse and consistency without imposing unnecessary central control.
  • Representing Integration Services in relevant architecture, engineering and technology forums across the FT.

Vendor & Technology Partner Management

  • Providing technical leadership in relationships with integration technology vendors and implementation partners.
  • Challenging vendor-led solutions where they conflict with long-term FT engineering direction or create unnecessary dependency.
  • Ensuring external partners complement rather than replace internal engineering capability.
  • Contributing to technology evaluation, procurement and platform selection decisions.
  • Ensuring partner-delivered work meets FT engineering, security, quality and operational expectations.

Technical and leadership experience we’re looking for

  • Significant experience in a Principal Engineer, senior engineering leadership or comparable technical leadership role.
  • Strong experience designing, building and operating enterprise integration capabilities at scale.
  • Deep understanding of integration architecture, APIs, event-driven systems, messaging, data flows and distributed systems.
  • Experience establishing reusable engineering services or shared platform capabilities across multiple teams.
  • Experience defining technical standards, engineering patterns or platform strategies across organisational boundaries.
  • Experience leading significant transformation programmes involving multiple platforms, teams and integrations.
  • Strong understanding of cloud technologies and modern engineering practices, preferably AWS.
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS ecosystems and integrating them with internally developed applications.
  • Experience with quality engineering, test automation, CI/CD and engineering productivity practices would be advantageous.
  • Experience leading and developing senior engineers and technical specialists.
  • Experience establishing new teams, capabilities or operating models would be highly advantageous.
  • Strong experience influencing teams and senior stakeholders without relying solely on formal authority.
  • Experience identifying and addressing duplicated capabilities, technical debt and fragmented ownership across complex technology estates.
  • Strong understanding of reliability, observability, security and operational excellence.
  • Experience working with vendors and implementation partners while maintaining clear internal technical ownership.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience balancing strategic technical direction with practical delivery realities.

Characteristics we value

  • Strong technical judgement and the confidence to make decisions across organisational boundaries.
  • A strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Pragmatism when balancing standardisation, reuse and the needs of individual engineering teams.
  • The ability to influence without relying solely on hierarchy.
  • A collaborative approach to building shared capabilities that teams want to use.
  • Curiosity and a willingness to understand problems across the wider technology estate rather than optimising a single domain.
  • Strong coaching and mentoring skills, particularly when developing senior engineers.
  • An instinct for reducing unnecessary complexity and duplication.
  • Confidence challenging established approaches constructively.
  • Calm and clear decision-making during complex delivery and operational situations.
  • An appreciation for reusable, sustainable and well-engineered technology capabilities.

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location, but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available on the FT Careers website.

We’ve embraced a 50% hybrid working model (averaging two to three days onsite) that fosters trust and remote adaptability while encouraging in-person camaraderie and peer learning. Additionally, we are open to accommodating specific flexible working pattern requests for all roles where feasible.

Develop a newsworthy career at the FT.

A nurturing workplace is one where employees feel free to be authentic and perform at their highest capability. We are dedicated to eliminating obstacles for all, especially concentrating on challenges encountered by underrepresented groups.

The Role

These processes assess proposed initiatives for strategic alignment, value creation, cost, risk, and feasibility before investment decisions.

Acting as the gateway between idea generation and implementation, you will enable informed, data-driven decision-making, balancing organisational priorities, capacity and investment to maximise business value. You will work closely with senior collaborators across Product, Technology, Editorial, Data, Commercial and Corporate functions to promote transparent governance and effective portfolio planning.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead portfolio intake and demand management processes, facilitating reviews of new initiatives and identifying duplication, consolidation opportunities and appropriate delivery pathways.
  • Partner with collaborators to shape and refine proposals, ensuring sufficient information is available for evaluation and prioritisation.
  • Ensure initiatives are consistently assessed against governance standards, impact criteria and investment requirements.
  • Challenge arguments, assumptions and benefit forecasts to support evidence-based investment decisions.
  • Highlight risks, dependencies, opportunity costs, trade-offs and capacity impacts to enable transparent prioritisation.
  • Manage the quality and completeness of submissions to governance forums for senior leadership review.
  • Lead portfolio capacity planning, maintaining visibility of demand, resource utilisation and delivery constraints.
  • Support quarterly and annual planning cycles with robust analysis and prioritisation recommendations.
  • Produce governance reporting, monitor delivery against approved arguments and provide actionable portfolio insights.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior collaborators, promoting cooperation, responsibility, and effective portfolio governance.
  • Drive continuous improvement by embedding standard portfolio management, lean governance and outcome-based investment approaches.
  • Support the automation and enhancement of portfolio management tools, reporting and governance frameworks.

A supportive workplace is one where employees feel they can be themselves and operate to their full potential. The Role Overview

We’re looking for a Senior Cyber Security Engineer to help mature application and cloud security across the FT’s cloud-native, AWS-hosted technology estate. This role has an approximate 50/50 focus across application security and cloud security, working closely with product, platform and engineering teams to make secure delivery easier by default.

You’ll shape and improve developer-friendly guardrails across GitHub-based CI/CD pipelines, AWS environments and infrastructure-as-code workflows. This includes improving SAST, software composition analysis, secret scanning, IaC scanning, vulnerability management and AWS misconfiguration management so that findings are actionable, low-noise and owned by the right teams.

Day to day, you’ll run practical threat-modelling sessions, review application and cloud designs, improve security playbooks, support vulnerability and misconfiguration remediation, and build automation that reduces toil. We’re looking for someone who has demonstrably improved security outcomes in real engineering environments, not just someone with theoretical knowledge of tools or frameworks.

Depending on team structure, you may also mentor or line-manage one or two security engineers, while remaining hands-on and close to the technical work.

What you’ll bring to the role

Application and cloud security experience: practical experience across both application security and cloud security, ideally in AWS-hosted, cloud-native environments.

Developer-friendly security mindset: you know how to work with engineers, explain risk clearly and design controls that help teams move securely without unnecessary friction.

Vulnerability management at scale: experience improving how application vulnerabilities, dependency risks, bug bounty findings, penetration test findings and advisories are identified, prioritised, owned and remediated across engineering teams.

Cloud misconfiguration & vulnerability management: experience identifying and reducing infrastructure-as-code and AWS vulnerabilities & misconfigurations at scale through pragmatic guardrails, tooling and clear remediation paths.

Threat modelling: confidence running lightweight, practical threat-modelling sessions that lead to useful engineering decisions and risk reduction.

CI/CD and code security: hands-on experience with security tooling such as SAST, software composition analysis, secret scanning and IaC scanning.

Automation mindset: ability to write scripts or small tools, ideally in Python, to reduce toil, improve visibility and surface meaningful risk.

Security leadership: ability to mentor other security engineers and influence engineers across the wider organisation. Depending on team structure, this may include line management.

AI security awareness: experience of leveraging AI to improve and scale appsec and cloud sec controls would be useful, but is not essential.

Key Responsibilities

Improve application security guardrails
 Tune and evolve SAST, software composition analysis, secret scanning and related controls so they are actionable, low-noise and useful to engineering teams.

Improve cloud and IaC security guardrails
 Help identify, prioritise and reduce AWS and infrastructure-as-code misconfigurations and vulnerabilities at scale.

Drive vulnerability management
 Improve how application vulnerabilities, dependency risks, bug bounty findings, penetration test findings and third-party advisories are triaged, prioritised and remediated.

Drive cloud misconfiguration management
 Help teams understand, own and remediate cloud security issues using pragmatic, developer-friendly workflows.

Run practical threat modelling
 Facilitate lightweight threat-modelling sessions for new products, features, services and architectural changes.

Build automation and tooling
 Create or improve scripts, integrations, dashboards and workflows that reduce manual effort and make risk easier to understand.

Support secure architecture decisions
 Provide application and cloud security input into design reviews, AWS architecture decisions and larger technical changes.

Partner with engineering teams
 Work closely with product, platform and software engineering teams to embed security into design, delivery and operational practices.

Support incidents and lessons learned
 Provide application and cloud security expertise during incidents and feed lessons learned back into patterns, tooling and guidance.

Mentor others
 Coach security engineers and engineering teams on practical security approaches. Depending on team structure, this may include line management of one or two security engineers.

Required Experience, Essential: 

  • Strong practical experience in application security and cloud security, ideally with a balanced focus across both.
  • Hands-on AWS security experience, including common misconfiguration patterns and practical remediation approaches.
  • Experience improving vulnerability management across engineering teams, including prioritisation, ownership, remediation tracking and noise reduction.
  • Experience in improving cloud or IaC misconfiguration management at scale in a developer-friendly way.
  • Experience integrating, tuning or improving security tooling in CI/CD workflows, such as SAST, software composition analysis, secret scanning or IaC scanning.
  • Experience running practical threat-modelling sessions that influence design, delivery or remediation decisions.
  • Ability to write scripts or small tools, ideally in Python, to automate security workflows or improve visibility.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence engineers and technical leaders without relying on gatekeeping.
  • Evidence of improving application security, cloud security or vulnerability management practices in a real engineering environment.
  • Familiarity with Agile or Scrum ways of working.

Desirable

  • Experience with leveraging AI for AppSec and CloudSec.
  • AWS Certified Security – Speciality or equivalent practical AWS security experience.
  • Terraform or CloudFormation expertise.
  • Incident-management or incident-response experience.
  • Experience with Splunk or similar logging/SIEM platforms.
  • Experience with security metrics, dashboards or reporting that helped drive measurable risk reduction.
  • Experience mentoring or line-managing security engineers.

 

What’s in it for You?

The successful applicant will collaborate with US-based news editors and correspondents across North America as well as colleagues in London, Hong Kong and beyond. Occasional weekend/flexible working may be required as part of covering fast-moving news.

You will have a strong portfolio of work in data journalism, ideally focused on business, finance, economics or politics in North America. In addition, we are looking for:

  • Experience using data journalism or data science techniques to find and tell news stories

SPRING INTERNSHIP

The Recording Academy Washington D.C. Chapter is seeking a “rock star” student for a spring 2027 Internship with our team. 


Celebrating music through the Grammy® Awards, The Recording Academy continues its legacy as the premier national organization for honoring achievements in the recording arts and supporting the music community. As a membership organization, we represent the most talented music professionals in the world. Our members include recording artists, producers, engineers, attorneys, music supervisors, composers/arrangers, managers, agents, social media and record label executives and many others.

  • Possess strong verbal, written and analytical skills.

  • Be a junior, senior or graduate student. 



PHYSICAL DEMANDS FOR CERTAIN ROLES:   

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.   


While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, and sit for long periods of time, and work at a computer for long periods of time. The employee will be required to lift and/or move up to 60 pounds.   

 

 

ABOUT THE RECORDING ACADEMY AND ITS AFFILIATES 

 

RECORDING ACADEMY

In addition to producing the Latin Grammy Awards to honor excellence in the recorded arts and sciences, The Latin Recording Academy provides educational and outreach programs for the Latin music community either directly or through its Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation. 

 

LATIN GRAMMY CULTURAL FOUNDATION 

The Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation is a charitable organization established by the Latin Recording Academy in 2014. A friend and ally of the music community, MusiCares was established by the Recording Academy to safeguard the health and well-being of all music people. The Grammy Museum is a nonprofit organization dedicated to celebrating and exploring music from yesterday and today to inspire the music of tomorrow through music preservation, education, exhibitions, and public programming and aims to create a world in which shared love of music sparks curiosity, creativity, and community. Programs include GRAMMY in the Schools education programs that are offered year-round for students, teachers, and schools throughout the United States.

job.title: Data Steward - People Platforms
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

As a Data Steward in the WPP’s Enterprise Technology Data team, you will be responsible for the hands-on administration and maintenance of master data across one or more enterprise data domains. Reporting to the Global Programme Director - Data, you will be the first line of stewardship, ensuring that golden records are accurate, source system mappings are maintained, and data governance standards are consistently applied.

You will execute matching and mapping activities, triage stewardship exceptions, and support the onboarding of new source systems into the MDM framework. Your work will directly impact the trustworthiness and completeness of master data flowing through WPP’s enterprise platforms.

This role involves daily data administration including investigating and resolving match conflicts, maintaining entity mappings and hierarchies, classifying data assets, and supporting the operational processes that keep master data healthy across the enterprise.

You will be part of a Data Steward team led by the Global Programme Director - Data, with the opportunity to develop deep expertise in master data management, data governance, and stewardship at enterprise scale.

What you'll be doing:

Master data stewardship and golden record maintenance

  • Execute day-to-day stewardship activities including reviewing, approving, and correcting master data records in line with governance standards set by the Global Programme Director - Data.
  • Maintain and curate golden records, ensuring survivorship rules are correctly applied and master entities remain accurate and complete.
  • Investigate and resolve match conflicts, potential duplicates, and merge exceptions, escalating complex cases to the Global Programme Director - Data with supporting analysis.
  • Process new entity creation requests, validating source data against matching rules before golden record creation.

Source system mapping and onboarding support

  • Manage and maintain mappings between source system entities and golden master records, ensuring traceability and accuracy.
  • Support the onboarding of new agencies and source systems by executing mapping activities and validating initial data loads against MDM standards.
  • Maintain reference data configurations, ensuring code sets and lookup values remain aligned across source systems.

Data governance and classification

  • Apply data classification standards to master data entities as defined by the governance framework, covering sensitivity, confidentiality, and regulatory categorisation.
  • Review and correct AI-generated data classifications, providing feedback to improve automated tagging accuracy over time.
  • Follow and enforce stewardship workflows including exception handling, approval processes, and escalation procedures.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of entity mappings, transformation rules, hierarchy structures, and stewardship decisions.

AI-assisted stewardship operations

  • Act as the human-in-the-loop for AI-assisted matching and entity resolution, reviewing model-suggested matches, adjudicating low-confidence merge candidates, and approving or rejecting proposed golden record updates.
  • Review and validate AI-generated mapping recommendations during source system onboarding, ensuring accuracy before mappings are committed.
  • Provide feedback on AI model outputs to support continuous improvement of match accuracy, classification quality, and enrichment relevance.
  • Work with AI-driven anomaly detection alerts, investigating flagged records and determining appropriate stewardship actions.

Data quality monitoring and remediation

  • Monitor data quality dashboards and alerts, investigating exceptions and applying remediation actions in a timely manner.
  • Execute data quality checks across master data entities, documenting findings and tracking resolution through to completion.
  • Maintain and update data quality rules as business requirements and source systems evolve, under the direction of the Data Manager.

WPP's Data & Technology Solutions is WPP's unified global data products and technology team. We work with our agencies and clients to build data driven solutions and technology products to power marketing transformation.

Role Purpose

As Incident Manager for the WPP Open Platform, you will own the end to end incident management lifecycle from detection through resolution to post incident review   ensuring platform stability, SLA compliance, and transparent communication across all stakeholders.

This is not a traditional incident management role. You will be expected to design, build, and continuously improve automated incident management workflows that connect our toolchain   Jira, Confluence, Statuspage, Intercom, Zendesk, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and WhatsApp   into a seamless, intelligent, and low friction incident response system.

You will serve as the central coordination point for all P1 and P2 incidents, driving rapid resolution, clear stakeholder communication, and proactive prevention.   • Track and report on incident metrics, SLA performance, MTTR, MTTD, and repeat incident trends

  • Design and implement automated incident workflows across the full toolchain: Jira, Confluence, Statuspage, Intercom, Zendesk, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and WhatsApp

  • Automate customer facing communication through Intercom and Zendesk   including incident acknowledgement messages, progress updates, and resolution notifications
  • Build WhatsApp and Teams notification workflows for executive and stakeholder briefings during critical incidents
  • Maintain and improve Confluence automation for RCA templates, incident documentation, and runbook generation triggered by incident closure
  • Integrate monitoring and alerting tools (Datadog, Statuspage, PagerDuty) with the communication stack to ensure zero gap detection to notification flows
  • Continuously evaluate and improve automation coverage   reducing manual steps, improving response speed, and ensuring consistency across all incident communication channels

Process & Knowledge Management

  • Develop, maintain, and enforce incident management playbooks, runbooks, and escalation procedures
  • Build and maintain a centralized incident knowledge base in Confluence   ensuring learnings from every major incident are captured and actioned
  • Define and own the post incident review process   including templates, timelines, and accountability tracking for preventive actions
  • Identify recurring incident patterns and work proactively with engineering teams to eliminate root causes
  • Drive continuous improvement of incident detection, response, and communication processes

Stakeholder Communication & Reporting

  • Own all incident communications   internal (engineering, product, leadership) and external (agency users via Intercom/Zendesk/Statuspage)
  • Produce regular incident reports, trend analyses, and SLA performance summaries for leadership and stakeholders
  • Present post incident reviews and improvement plans to the Support Manager and Platform leadership
  • Maintain stakeholder notification lists and communication templates across all channels

Collaboration

  • Work closely with L1/L2 Support Engineers and the Team Lead to ensure smooth ticket triage, escalation, and handover during incidents
  • Partner with DevOps and Platform Engineering to improve platform observability, alerting quality, and deployment safety
  • Collaborate with Product teams to communicate platform stability status and incident impact on feature delivery

  • Minimum 3+ years of hands on incident management experience in an enterprise SaaS or digital platform environment
  • Proven experience owning P1/P2 incident response end to end   coordination, communication, escalation, and resolution

  • Strong ability to manage multiple concurrent incidents calmly and effectively under pressure

  • Confluence: Automation templates, structured documentation, RCA frameworks, space management

  • Proven ability to remain composed and authoritative under pressure during major incidents
  • Strong stakeholder management skills   comfortable presenting to senior leadership during and after incidents

Desirable Skills

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Content and Editorial Strategy, you will work closely with the Corporate, CBC and Radio-Canada Communications teams as well as the Office of the President and CEO.

job.description:
Overview

Called to K-LOVE

 

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

 

At K-LOVE, every role is ministry.

 

We hire first for ministry alignment and a shared commitment to our faith, mission, vision, and values. We then seek talented professionals who can use their God-given gifts, skills, and experience to serve with excellence.

 

If you love Jesus and are called to be part of a ministry that places Christ at the center of everything we do, we invite you to explore this opportunity. If your heart aligns with our mission and you possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for the role, please keep reading.

 

 

K-LOVE is a nonprofit, multi-platform media company on a mission to draw people closer to Christ. Founded in 1982 in Santa Rosa, CA, with a singular radio station, K-LOVE today owns and operates the nation's two largest Christian music radio networks (K-LOVE and Air1) with over 1,000 broadcast signals across all 50 states, streaming audio reaching around the world, and a growing family of media ministries including pod-casts, books, films, concerts, and events. K-LOVE employs over 500 team members between its office in Nashville, TN and field locations around the country. You can view our mission and values here Mission, Beliefs & Values. 

 

 

On a day to day basis you will:

  • Process daily payable invoices, check requests, and employee expense reimbursements in a timely manner.
  • Maintain and update invoice journals for consistent and accurate entries.
  • Process weekly check runs.
  • Coordinate weekly check runs, ensuring accuracy and adherence to payment schedules.
  • Support the maintenance of an organized and up-to-date electronic invoice filing system.
  • Accurately code invoices using the Ministry’s chart of accounts and appropriate financial dimensions.
  • Collaborate with vendors and Team Members to resolve discrepancies and reconcile vendor accounts.
  • Communicate professionally with vendors, leadership, and other departments to address payment inquiries.
  • Work effectively with colleagues across the Accounting Operations team to ensure shared responsibilities are met.
  • Participate in special projects or assignments as directed by the Accounting Operations Supervisor.

 

Background and qualifications needed:

  • Minimum of six months of financial processing (payables, receivables, donor processing), or related experience.
  • Strong organizational and administrative skills.
  • Solid written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare reports and speak effectively with vendors and fellow team members.
  • Ability to define problems collect data, establish facts and draw valid conclusions.
  • Strong computer skills; proficient in Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).  Experience with NetSuite preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently; establishing and meeting performance/ministry goals.
  • Exhibits versatility and flexibility. Adapts to change while maintaining a positive attitude and high productivity.

 

Employment Requirements:

  • Must pass a pre-employment reference screen and background check.
  • Proof of legal authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must agree with K-LOVE Christ-Centered Life Covenant and Statement of Faith

 

What can we offer you?

  • Industry leading Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
  • Short/long term disability and life insurance
  • Robust 401K with company match
  • Parental leave with Baby Bonding pay
  • Generous PTO, holiday and sick pay
  • Unique company culture that includes exclusive access to concerts, movie premieres, media industry events, and more
  • Leadership and Career Development Programs

 

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, K-LOVE makes employment decisions based on merit and other legitimate reasons. The Company is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment and the promotion of equal employment opportunities regardless of protected class, characteristic or status. However, K-LOVE is also a religious non-profit organization where all team members contribute to the Company’s mission of encouraging our audiences “to have a meaningful relationship with Christ.” Therefore, pursuant to the Civil Rights Act of 1964, Section 702 (42 U.S.C. 2000e I(a)), K-LOVE has the right to hire only candidates who agree with the Company’s Statement of Faith. Also, as a religious non-profit organization, the Company is not governed by the CA Fair Employment and Housing Act.

job.title: VP, Media Technology Engineering
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Corporation

Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.

JOB DESCRIPTION

FOX Corporation is seeking a high-impact Vice President, Media Technology Engineering to lead the engineering, implementation, and operational reliability of the technology environment supporting FOX News Media and Fox Television Stations.


This leader will oversee the teams responsible for operating and continuously improving the critical infrastructure that supports news gathering, live broadcast, production, post-production, playout, master control, transmission, and digital media distribution.


The role will lead a high-performing engineering organization responsible for network, compute, storage, virtualization, cloud infrastructure, broadcast systems, disaster recovery, and platform resiliency. The successful candidate will have deep experience operating highly available media environments and implementing complex broadcast technology transformations, including SMPTE ST 2110 video-over-IP systems.


Reporting to the SVP, Media Technology & Engineering, this role will partner closely with the VP, Media Technology Architecture and other technology leaders. The VP of Architecture will establish future-state architecture, standards, and technical direction. This role will own engineering execution, implementation, operational readiness, reliability, lifecycle management, and incident response.


Role Scope


The major areas of responsibility include:

  • Broadcast technology engineering and operations
  • SMPTE ST 2110 implementation and operational reliability
  • Network, compute, storage, and virtualization engineering
  • Hybrid cloud infrastructure operations
  • Station automation and delivery platforms
  • OTT, streaming, and OTA technology support
  • News and local production support
  • Media technology and transmission
  • Disaster recovery and platform resiliency
  • 24/7 technical operations and incident response

Responsibilities


Engineering Operations and Reliability


  • Lead the day-to-day engineering and operational support of mission-critical broadcast and media technology environments.
  • Ensure 24/7/365 availability, reliability, and operational readiness across broadcast, production, distribution, and transmission platforms.
  • Establish operating procedures, escalation paths, service expectations, and incident response practices.
  • Partner with Critical Response and Operations teams to manage major incidents, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
  • Monitor system health and ensure timely resolution of reliability, performance, and availability issues.

Broadcast Systems Implementation and Support


  • Lead the engineering implementation, integration, testing, deployment, and lifecycle management of broadcast technology platforms.
  • Support live news gathering, contribution, production, post-production, playout, master control, station automation, and transmission workflows.
  • Implement and operate SMPTE ST 2110 video-over-IP environments, including routing, timing, packet integrity, latency, and system interoperability.
  • Support the transition from SDI-based workflows to synchronized, software-defined IP media facilities in partnership with the Media Architecture team.
  • Maintain operational compatibility across existing systems while implementing new technology platforms.

Network and Infrastructure Engineering


  • Lead engineering execution across WAN, LAN, contribution networks, routing, switching, QoS, multicast, and high-capacity media connectivity.
  • Operate and optimize on-premise data centers, hybrid cloud infrastructure, enterprise virtualization, containerized environments, compute, storage, and related platforms.
  • Manage infrastructure lifecycle activities, including upgrades, capacity planning, patching, migrations, integrations, and technology refreshes.
  • Implement approved architecture and security standards in partnership with Media Architecture, Network Engineering, and Information Security.
  • Ensure infrastructure supports high-throughput, low-latency media workflows and enterprise data distribution.

Resiliency and Disaster Recovery


  • Implement and maintain disaster recovery, business continuity, redundancy, failover, and resiliency capabilities.
  • Conduct readiness testing and ensure recovery procedures are documented, current, and operationally viable.
  • Identify single points of failure and lead remediation efforts.
  • Partner with architecture and security teams to ensure resiliency requirements are incorporated into new implementations and major upgrades.

Project and Program Delivery


  • Partner with the PMO and Critical Response teams to deliver technology upgrades, expansions, migrations, integrations, and operational improvements.
  • Translate approved architecture and technical requirements into executable engineering plans.
  • Manage dependencies, technical risks, resource requirements, milestones, and operational readiness.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and with appropriate testing, documentation, training, and support plans.
  • Coordinate production cutovers and post-implementation support.

Performance Management and Optimization


  • Establish operational KPIs and service-level measures for availability, reliability, capacity, latency, incident response, and recovery.
  • Optimize monitoring, alerting, and alarming systems to reduce noise and improve response effectiveness.
  • Use performance data and operational trends to identify risks, capacity needs, and improvement opportunities.
  • Drive continuous improvement across engineering processes, tools, and support models.

Vendor and Service Management


  • Manage operational relationships with key technology vendors and service providers.
  • Monitor vendor performance against service-level expectations.
  • Coordinate escalations, technical support, maintenance, and issue resolution.
  • Partner with Architecture and Procurement teams to validate technical requirements and support vendor evaluations.

Documentation and Compliance


  • Maintain accurate documentation for network, infrastructure, broadcast, transmission, security, and recovery environments.
  • Ensure engineering procedures align with applicable industry standards, regulatory requirements, security policies, and internal controls.
  • Maintain current system diagrams, runbooks, asset information, configuration records, recovery procedures, and support documentation.
  • Support operational audits, compliance reviews, and risk assessments.

Leadership and Talent Development


  • Lead and develop a high-performing engineering organization supporting complex, highly available media environments.
  • Establish clear team structures, accountabilities, operating rhythms, and performance expectations.
  • Mentor engineering leaders and technical talent.
  • Build a culture of operational excellence, accountability, collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to define requirements, manage expectations, and deliver reliable solutions.

Cross-Functional Partnership


  • Partner closely with the VP, Media Technology Architecture to execute approved technical strategies and standards.
  • Collaborate with Network Engineering, Information Security, Broadcast Operations, Media Services, Digital Platforms, News, Local Production, and Transmission teams.
  • Provide engineering input into architecture decisions based on operational requirements, reliability, supportability, and total cost of ownership.
  • Serve as the engineering voice during technology planning, implementation, and operational readiness reviews.

Continuous Improvement and Innovation


  • Evaluate emerging technologies for operational value, reliability, supportability, and compatibility with the FOX media environment.
  • Drive adoption of tools, frameworks, and methodologies that improve engineering effectiveness and standardize deployment procedures.
  • Maintain backward compatibility while modernizing technology platforms and operating practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve automation, observability, resiliency, and engineering productivity.

What You Will Need


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field, or equivalent executive experience.
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in media technology, broadcast engineering, enterprise infrastructure, or related environments.
  • At least 5 years of senior leadership experience managing engineering or technology operations teams.
  • Proven experience leading engineering implementation and operational support for large-scale broadcast or media technology environments.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing and operating SMPTE ST 2110 uncompressed IP video production systems.
  • Deep expertise in enterprise networking, including routing, switching, QoS, multicast, WAN, LAN, and contribution networks.
  • Strong experience with on-premise data centers, hybrid cloud infrastructure, virtualization, compute, storage, and containerized environments.
  • Experience leading disaster recovery, resiliency, high availability, incident response, and business continuity programs.
  • Experience supporting news gathering, live production, post-production, playout, master control, station automation, transmission, OTT, streaming, or OTA delivery environments.
  • Strong project and program management skills focused on implementation, operational readiness, and reliability.
  • Experience managing technology vendors, service providers, escalations, and service-level performance.
  • Knowledge of DCIM, CMDB, IPAM, monitoring, observability, and infrastructure management systems.
  • Executive presence and the ability to communicate complex technical matters clearly to senior stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams through complex technical transformations while maintaining operational stability.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, 24/7 media environment.
  • Occasional domestic travel, up to 25%.

  • Serve as a mentor and resource for newer reporters in the newsroom.
  • Represent KSBY throughout the community by participating in station and local events.
  • Meet daily and long-term production deadlines while managing multiple stories and priorities.
  • Drive a personal or company vehicle to cover assignments throughout the viewing area.

  • BS/BA in Journalism, Communications, or a related field preferred, or equivalent professional experience
  • 5+ years of reporting or related journalism experience preferred.
  • Valid driver's license, strong driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance meeting company requirements
  • Ability to drive regularly as part of daily news-gathering responsibilities

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Exceptional reporting and storytelling skills across multiple platforms
  • Strong verbal and written communication abilities
  • A dynamic on-air presence with the ability to connect authentically with viewers
  • Advanced critical thinking and sound news judgment
  • The ability to develop enterprise stories and pursue leads independently
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple assignments simultaneously
  • A collaborative, team-first mindset and a positive newsroom attitude.
  • A passion for community engagement and relationship building
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds

KSBY's newsroom is made up of curious, dedicated journalists who believe in the value of local news and community connection. We work collaboratively, support one another's growth, and celebrate great storytelling in all forms. Our team brings diverse experiences, perspectives, and interests to the newsroom, creating an environment where creativity, innovation, and public service journalism thrive.

Located along California's spectacular Central Coast, San Luis Obispo offers an exceptional quality of life with a unique blend of coastal beauty, outdoor adventure, and small-town charm. Whether you're catching sunrise along the Pacific, enjoying local restaurants and festivals, or discovering hidden stories throughout the Central Coast, San Luis Obispo is a place where professional fulfillment and personal lifestyle come together.

job.title: Information Security Engineer
job.description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented individual to drive quality-related security work for Sinclair’s Information Security program. You will fill the role of Information Security Engineer with a focus on supporting an enterprise Vulnerability Management program.  You will apply security in-depth principles to reduce vulnerability risk for Sinclair’s business units, cloud, and infrastructure environments. You will partner with internal stakeholders and consultants to develop security solutions to protect the confidentiality and integrity of Sinclair’s sensitive data. You will also work closely with security operations, engineering, to drive risk reduction across Sinclair’s enterprise.

Responsibilities:

Processes & Execution

  • Manage processes and solutions pertaining to vulnerability management, application security, CIS benchmarks, and other security services as required. 
  • Excellent communication skills with an ability to effectively and professionally collaborate with company stakeholders and business partners.
  • Ability to think strategically, plan methodically, and execute tactically.
  • Take ownership of professional development and training needed to excel in your role.
  • Lead initiatives to develop and mature vulnerability management services as they apply to team and organizational goals. 
  • Act as an advocate for Information Security objectives while identifying creative solutions to ensure progress is made. 
  • Drive remediation activities by understanding the impact of findings and developing communication channels with key stakeholders.

Engineering, Collaboration & Partnerships

  • Maintain knowledge of current trends, recent publications, and emerging technologies as they pertain to risk and vulnerability management.  
  • Identify, prioritize, communicate, and mitigate security risks for on-premises and hybrid/multi-cloud environments.  
  • Produce frequent metrics to measure the efficacy and effectiveness of the vulnerability program.
  • Identify business critical systems and environments including mapping data types in enterprise assets, databases, cloud environments, and applications. 
  • Work with outside vendors and consultants to identify tools to meet or exceed department needs.
  • Demonstrate good judgment in identifying and solving problems that aligns with team and corporate goals.
  • Enforce compliance with company policies and standards.
  • Contribute to the vulnerability management program by driving remediation activities pertaining to application (DAST) scans, security assessments, vulnerability scans, or risk management activities and tools.
  • Configure and tune security tools to identify weaknesses in systems, applications, databases, and cloud environments. 

Performance Improvement

  • Help the security team to maintain a level of excellence.
  • Develop and evaluate performance metrics to establish process success.
  • Design, document, and implement procedures and techniques that are consistent with best practices for analyzing and evaluating the risk (software & business), accuracy, completeness, internal integrity/consistency, testability, and overall quality of the system.
  • Research emerging technologies and identify opportunities for adoption within vulnerability management and application security.
  • Track progress for vulnerability management related processes, and constantly look for ways to make things work better, faster, and smoother.
  • Collaborate on and adhere to security engineering standards, methodologies, and sustainable processes.

 

Qualifications:

  • Associate’s degree in IT discipline, equivalent work experience, or equivalent IT certifications.
  • 3+ years of experience with vulnerability management, system and application scanning, coordinating remediation efforts, and building partner relationships to achieve programmatic success.
  • 4+ years of experience taking ownership of project, enhancement, or other assignments and seeing the process through to completion. 
  • Experience with all the main cloud vendors (Amazon Web Service, Azure, Google Cloud Platform)
  • Understanding of applying security controls to operating systems, cloud environments, databases, and applications.
  • Hands of experience using vulnerability scanning tools and driving remediation at an enterprise level (Qualys, Tanium, Bitsight, etc.).
  • Experience using Asset Management and Reporting Platforms.
  • Experience creating weekly metrics for vulnerability and risk reduction reporting.
  • Professional level security certifications preferred (e.g., Security+, Network+, CISSP, CEH, CISM)
  • Familiarity with security industry standards (ISO 27001, NIST 800-53 series, etc.) and best practices to implement control frameworks.
  • Working knowledge of network and/or security technologies
  • Other requirements as needed.

 

Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H-1B visa, OPT-STEM employment, etc.

Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidates’ relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. job.title: Community Empowerment Specialist
job.description:
The Community Empowerment Specialist reports to the Director of Community Empowerment.  Individual in this role will assists with all the duties related to the department, including, but not limited to community relations/partnerships (projects related to station partnerships with companies, governmental and non-profit organizations, as well as community events), community content creator/producer (production of the local weekly community affairs program, as well as public service announcements and digital content) local FCC (Federal Communications Commission) compliance (maintaining the Online Public Inspection File, Issues/Programs lists, EEO Officer, Children’s Programming Report and Political File) and employee engagement efforts.

 

ABOUT YOU:

You are passionate about community outreach, engagement, and development and you are experienced in building relationships and coordinating event logistics. You can create content that is relevant to the Hispanic community. You have a positive attitude, are a team player and no challenge is too large because you are accustomed to working in a fast-paced environment.

 

YOUR DAY-DAY: (aka Responsibilities)

 

Liaison with Corporate CSR/SIS

  • Primary Point Person for Corporate Social Impact team. Deliver and report back on CSR/Social Impact Corporate campaigns/Content initiatives.
  • Participate in regular community empowerment conference calls.

 

Community Partnerships:

  • Main market relationship person with community leaders, non-profit organizations, elected officials, and political candidates.
  • Assist with the planning, coordination, and execution of the stations’ participation at community events/campaigns.
  • Work closely with promotions, sales, and news to execute community events.
  • Help create agreements with community organizations.
  • Assist with TV/Radio talent to actively engage in community events.
  • Assist with station corporate initiatives and events.
  • Help create event recaps.

 

Content Creator/Producer and On-air Talent:

  • Assist with the production of the local weekly community affairs program.
  • Assist with the production of public service announcements and community calendar.
  • Schedule, manage and maintain TV/Radio PSAs and community calendar in Wide Orbit and V-Creative.
  • Upload community segments on the local station online page.
  • On-air talent of community segments and Despierta Austin.

 

Local FCC (Federal Communications Commission) Compliance:

 

  • Maintenance of the TV/Radio Online Public Inspection Files (OPIF.)
  • Creation and filing of the Quarterly Program Issues lists (QPIs) Reports for TV/Radio.
  • Filing of Political files.
  • EEO Officer responsibilities for TV/Radio and create the EEO Annual report.
  • Creation and filing of the Quarterly/Annual Children’s Programming Report.
  • Monitor closed caption emails.
  • Manage station tour requests.
  • Coordinate and manage participation in career or job fairs. 

Client Cause Partnerships:

  • Contribute to sales and business development by leveraging an entry point to a company or organization through community partnership or CSR.

 

Employee Engagement Efforts:

  • Assist with employee engagement efforts and local ERG (Employee Resource Groups) events/activities.

 

YOU HAVE: (aka Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree in public relations or another communications field, social science, or business.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, OneDrive.)
  • Ability to work well under pressure/stressful circumstances in a revenue goal and deadline driven environment.
  • Time management and organizational skills to meet tight deadlines.
  • Ability to work in a team setting. Maintains positive working relationships with co-workers.
  • Organized, detail-oriented and self-motivated.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Great people skills, enthusiasm and a true passion for helping the community.
  • Knowledge of iNews, Citrix (Wide Orbit,) VCreative, AKTA, BEX, Canvas, Google Workspace programs, Smartsheet, and Handshake is a plus, but not necessary.
  • Ability to be flexible and adapt to changes and updates in responsibilities, procedures, or systems.
  • Must be able to capture photos and videos on cell phone for event recaps.
  • Must have valid Driver’s License with good driving record.
  • Must be willing to work from office in Austin, TX.
  • Must be bilingual: English and Spanish.
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.
  • Performs additional duties, as assigned by Community Empowerment Director and/or General Manager.

 

OUR BENEFITS:

We offer a wide selection of perks and benefits including PTO; tuition reimbursement; wellness and employee support programs; 401K; and life and other insurance plans. This is all in addition to our comprehensive and competitive health benefits package featuring medical, dental and vision coverage options.

job.title: Becario de Capacitación y Desarrollo, Practicas Profesionales o Servicio Social
job.description:
¡TelevisaUnivision está en búsqueda de un Becario de Capacitación y Desarrollo! 

Ubicación:  Ciudad de México (Santa Angel) 


Forma parte del equipo de TelevisaUnivision, la empresa líder en el mundo de medios y contenido en español. TelevisaUnivision cuenta con la más extensa videoteca de contenido propio y es líder en capacidad de producción en el sector, lo que impulsa su contenido digital de streaming, televisión tradicional y plataformas de radio. 


Somos una empresa vibrante con más de 10,000 colaboradores en México, Colombia y EE. UU. Nos une la pasión por el entretenimiento, la creatividad y los grandes hitos. En TelevisaUnivision encontrarás un ambiente amigable y lleno de equidad para crecer personal y profesionalmente. 

Dirigido a estudiantes que desean cumplir con sus prácticas profesionales o servicio social en un entorno corporativo, esta experiencia representa una excelente oportunidad para aplicar tus conocimientos en la práctica. 

Esta experiencia formativa no contempla compensación económica, pero brinda acceso a procesos reales y acompañamiento profesional por parte de un equipo altamente capacitado. 


¡Únete y sé parte de este gran equipo dinámico! 

Acerca del puesto y equipo 

 

Formarás parte del equipo de Capacitación y Desarrollo tiene como objetivo fortalecer las competencias del talento dentro de la organización mediante programas de aprendizaje, formación continua y desarrollo profesional. Su función principal es diseñar, implementar y evaluar estrategias que impulsen el crecimiento personal y laboral de los colaboradores, alineando las acciones de desarrollo con los objetivos estratégicos de la empresa. 

Además, promueve una cultura de aprendizaje constante, innovación y colaboración a través de iniciativas que integran herramientas digitales, comunicación efectiva y experiencias de formación significativas  

 

Sobre ti 

Como Becario de Capacitación y Desarrollo  Apoyar en la edición de videos, manejo de bases de asistencia en execel, diseño de materiales didácticos y otras actividades que contribuyen a fortalecer la experiencia de aprendizaje de los colaboradores. 

 

Tu día a día incluirá: 

  • Elaborar materiales gráficos, presentaciones y contenidos digitales para los programas de desarrollo (manuales, infografías, invitaciones, videos, etc.). 
  • Apoyar en la logística y coordinación de cursos, talleres, webinars y eventos de capacitación. 
  • Participar en la comunicación interna de las iniciativas de capacitación (redacción de mensajes, publicaciones en intranet, carteles, comunicados). 
  • Dar seguimiento administrativo a los registros de capacitación: asistencia, evaluaciones, bases de datos y reportes. 
  • Apoyar en la aplicación de encuestas y evaluaciones de satisfacción o impacto de los programas. 
  • Colaborar en la creación de experiencias de aprendizaje innovadoras, incorporando elementos visuales, gamificación y herramientas digitales. 
  • Participar en proyectos de desarrollo organizacional, apoyo en diagnósticos, análisis de información y elaboración de presentaciones ejecutivas. 

 

Requisitos 

  • Estudiantes de los últimos semestres de Comunicación, Diseño Gráfico, Tecnologías de la educación, Diseño digital, Psicología, actuaria, sistemas o carreras afines. 
  • Manejo de paquetería Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word). 
  • Creatividad y atención al detalle. 
  • Habilidad para la redacción y comunicación visual. 
  • Organización y gestión del tiempo. 
  • Interés por el aprendizaje, la formación y el desarrollo humano. 
  • Manejo de herramientas digitales (Copilot, Canva, PowerPoint, Excel, plataformas LMS o similares). 

 

Lo que te ofrecemos: 
Experiencia práctica en una empresa líder en medios y entretenimiento 
Experiencia práctica en procesos reales de adquisición de talento. 
Ambiente de trabajo colaborativo y profesional 
Oportunidad de desarrollo y aprendizaje continuo 

Nuestro compromiso con la inclusión 

TelevisaUnivision es un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades. Todos los solicitantes calificados serán considerados para el empleo sin distinción de sexo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, raza, color, religión, nacionalidad, discapacidad, edad o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley.

job.title: Production Support Associate II
job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Production Support Associate II Job ID 10162962 Location Bristol, Connecticut, United States Business ESPN Date posted Oct. 30, 2026 Production Support Associate II Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements This position is the center of a highly coordinated and dynamic workflow that delivers content to multiple continents. Successful candidates will be able to seamlessly track and implement multiple, detailed priorities to ensure our obligations are fulfilled. In addition, this position will act as the main point of contact for content delivery worldwide; ensuring the day-to-day transactions between sales, clients, ESPN regions and production and Programming are handled smoothly and efficiently. An outgoing communication style across multiple departments, levels and countries is a must. Responsibilities: Fulfill Programming and Production feeds to all ESPN international regions (EMEA, APAC, Latam) and Syndication clients worldwide. Create 15-30 minute “Mini” highlights of NBA, NFL, NBL, NHL & other sports for the Global Disney+ tile, utilizing AI technology. Liaise with Programming and other stakeholders to create the calendar workflow for each sport season as it relates to the Mini creation and distribution process. Utilizing After Effects to create team matchups for the Mini’s that stream on Disney+. Upload/Pitch non-live content to the digital platforms ESPN+ and Disney+. Assist the Content Planning team with playouts for Disney+ and the ANZ linear channel. Liaise with ESPN Netherlands and Disney+ Philippines on all live content delivery. Create clips and highlights utilizing QCut and Framelight and distribute the content via feed or file delivery to stakeholders. Utilize ADT, Media Search, Media Shuttle and feed browser to locate content for distribution. Compile and maintain the Virtual Channel Schedule for Fiber feeds to the Caribbean Cruise Ships. Export and distribute daily live feed rundowns for ESPN International regions as well as Syndication clients. Partner with the Syndication Support Team on all live and non-live delivery to clients worldwide. Work closely with the China team on the weekly NBA Reporter feeds for Tencent. Maintain a communication workflow before each live hit and troubleshoot any issues with Transmission. Perform Prompting and Graphic duties for the ANZ Global shows as needed. Update and maintain the Production Support Dashboard, which contains up to the minute information on all content delivery requests. Support programming by utilizing Photoshop Artwork Manager to create and upload thumbnails for digital platforms. Coordinate and troubleshoot any feed issues with various internal and external stakeholders. Input clip and/or refeed requests into Syndication Manager for tracking and distribution to the regions. Act as point person for all International Bureau Cam needs. Assist the Assignment Desk during crunch times with creating web scrapes and Work Orders and provide camera support for internal events. Provide updated information in real time to all the stakeholders during live events. Expert Knowledge of delivery of content via file (Signiant, Disneysendit, Wetransfer, etc.). Assist with Syndication orders utilizing multiple platforms such as Syndication Manager, Media Search, Signiant, ADT, Media Shuttle, Wonderland, Transfer Monitor and Smartsheet Ensures the timely and accurate delivery of Syndication material and assets via live feed and file. Works closely with Remote Traffic, Third-Party vendors, and Transmission to arrange live feeds for clients worldwide. Coordinates feeds with Third Party Vendor for delivery of Sublicensed content. Required Qualifications: Knowledge of all Production aspects, including but not limited to: Studio, Events and ENG Detail oriented with the ability to solve problems and multi-task in a fast-paced environment Must have excellent interpersonal skills and strong communications skills, both written and verbal Ability to work nights, weekends, and holidays if necessary Basic working knowledge of Photoshop Minimum of 2 years of editing experience Preferred Qualifications: Minimum of 5 years of related administrative and production support work experience Strong knowledge of sports and television production Bilingual Spanish/English written and verbal Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Excel, Media Search, Media Shuttle, AIS, ADT, and Quantel Non-linear editing knowledge as well as familiarity with WSC type workflow Required Education: High School Diploma Preferred Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent preferred #ESPNMedia Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Bristol, CT is $54,800 to $73,400 per year based on a 40 hour work week. The amount of hours scheduled per week may vary based on business needs. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. This position is with ESPN Productions, Inc, which is part of a business we call ESPN. To learn more about Disney's guidelines on the use of AI for candidates, click here. ESPN Productions, Inc is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Disney champions a business environment where ideas and decisions from all people help us grow, innovate, create the best stories and be relevant in a constantly evolving world. DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION FOR EMPLOYMENT APPLICATIONS The Walt Disney Company and its Affiliated Companies are Equal Employment Opportunity employers and welcome all job seekers including individuals with disabilities and veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or apply for a position, visit the Disney candidate disability accommodations FAQs . We will only respond to those requests that are related to the accessibility of the online application system due to a disability. Having technical issues? View the FAQs for help. Apply Now Save Job About The Walt Disney Company: The Walt Disney Company, together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading diversified international family entertainment and media enterprise that includes three core business segments: Disney Entertainment, ESPN, and Disney Experiences. From humble beginnings as a cartoon studio in the 1920s to its preeminent name in the entertainment industry today, Disney proudly continues its legacy of creating world-class stories and experiences for every member of the family. Disney’s stories, characters and experiences reach consumers and guests from every corner of the globe. With operations in more than 40 countries, our employees and cast members work together to create entertainment experiences that are both universally and locally cherished. Hiring Process Where Does Your Story Begin? Explore Disney Careers and the Life at Disney blog to learn about all the amazing opportunities waiting to be discovered at The Walt Disney Company. Be Part of the Story There are many different brands and businesses to explore. Once you've found the opportunity that is right for you, take the next step by completing your application. The Next Chapter Once you've applied, you will receive an email allowing you to access your candidate dashboard. Create your login and make sure to check your dashboard often to see your application progress. Explore this Location Bristol, CT The Heart of Connecticut Bristol, Connecticut is just two hours from Boston and New York and just an hour from the shoreline. From the natural beauty of picturesque hills and fall foliage, to the high tech satellite dishes of ESPN, Bristol’s “City sized” with a small town vibe, offering wonderful memories no matter your pace.
