job.title: Commerce Writer
job.description:
The Fox News Deals team is seeking a shopping-obsessed writer with expertise in tech and home products. In this role, your daily tasks will include researching, pitching and writing multiple articles (round-ups, gift guides, product reviews, etc) for publication across FOX properties, including Fox News and FOX Weather. 

Along with daily assignments, this person will join the core writing team covering tentpole shopping events like Prime Day, Black Friday and Cyber Monday. This person should be a multitasker who can work effectively, efficiently and quickly while managing multiple assignments. The candidate should have excellent writing skills, experience in implementing SEO tactics and have a background in journalism or another related field.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Write daily articles and evergreen stories (6-10 a week)
  • Research new products and trends, as well as competitor content picks, to make sure we always make the best recommendations to our readers
  • Keep on top of new product launches to ensure our content always has the most up to date products. This may involve helping test and review new products
  • Research and pitch new content based on audience insights, historical performance, seasonal search trends and other revenue-generation measures. 
  • Work closely with our partnerships and growth teams to ensure content is optimized for maximum revenue generation
  • Follow in-house style and brand safety guidelines
  • Cover tentpole shopping events like Prime Day, Black Friday and Cyber Monday
  • Participate in team meetings to help strategize editorial coverage, optimize user experience and revenue generation, including for tentpole shopping events.
  • Explore and pursue ways to grow commerce partnerships via content coverage.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 3+ years of writing experience including writing samples illustrating commerce coverage across verticals.
  • Daily experience working within a CMS (familiarity with WordPress preferred)
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including knowledge of AP style
  • Excellent time management and prioritization skills, meticulous and consistent follow up
  • Proven track record of executing revenue-driving articles (both deals-centric and evergreen)
  • Attention to detail, an aptitude for working under tight deadlines and effectively handling multiple priorities simultaneously

ABOUT YOU

  • Strong leadership skills and collaborative work ethic
  • Keen attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Curiosity and willingness to learn
  • Critical thinker and creative problem solver
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced creative environment 

NICE TO HAVE

  • Bachelor's degree in journalism or related field, or equivalent experience
  • Familiarity with AP Style
  • Experience producing both short and long-form product reviews across a range of categories.
  • Knowledge of analytics platforms (Ex: Adobe Analytics, Chartbeat, etc.)

job.title: Weekend Host/Producer, LiveNOW (Phoenix, AZ)
job.description:
LiveNOW from FOX is looking for a Weekend Host/Producer to join FOX TV Stations’ national live streaming news offering. As the Weekend Host/Producer, you will be part of the team that keeps viewers informed and engaged at all hours of the day! You’ll get the best of both worlds – hosting live, on-air coverage and driving viewer engagement while supporting other hosts behind the scenes. This flexible role is ideal for a dynamic journalist who thrives both in front of the camera and behind the scenes. You’ll balance real-time coverage of what’s happening right now with forward-thinking content presentation and finding innovative ways to help viewers find the live events and latest updates they’re looking for.

LiveNOW brings viewers the most relevant and engaging live news coverage occurring right now across the country and the world. We are a team of passionate journalists and content producers seamlessly moving between the biggest events and stories as they happen to keep our audience informed. LiveNOW is always raw, live, and unfiltered, with limited commentary and no opinion.

**Only applications with a reel will be considered for this position. Reels may be submitted in your application as a link or attachment.

The schedule for this position will be Monday-Tuesday, Friday-Sunday.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Gather, produce, and present live coverage of breaking news and major events across digital, streaming, social, and broadcast platforms.

  • Host live streams, guiding viewers through developing stories in a clear, engaging, and informative manner.

  • Research, plan, and build editorial coverage, including booking guests, coordinating interviews, and preparing for upcoming news events.

  • Manage live video production elements including switching, graphics, and stream execution.

  • Monitor live feeds, wires, social media, and newsgathering tools to identify breaking news and emerging stories.

  • Execute and evolve the editorial plan, maintaining calendars and ensuring coverage is forward-looking and well-coordinated.

  • Collaborate with FOX O&O stations and internal/external partners to source live video, interviews, and content.

  • Pitch story ideas and contribute to editorial decision-making while upholding journalistic standards.

  • Monitor real-time analytics to inform coverage decisions and optimize content performance.

  • Support teammates across roles, including stepping in on-air or behind the scenes as needed.

  • Maintain strong relationships with key contacts and sources to support coverage.

job.title: VP, Media Technology Engineering
job.description:
FOX Corporation is seeking a high-impact Vice President, Media Technology Engineering to lead the engineering, implementation, and operational reliability of the technology environment supporting FOX News Media and Fox Television Stations.

This leader will oversee the teams responsible for operating and continuously improving the critical infrastructure that supports news gathering, live broadcast, production, post-production, playout, master control, transmission, and digital media distribution.

The role will lead a high-performing engineering organization responsible for network, compute, storage, virtualization, cloud infrastructure, broadcast systems, disaster recovery, and platform resiliency. The successful candidate will have deep experience operating highly available media environments and implementing complex broadcast technology transformations, including SMPTE ST 2110 video-over-IP systems.

Reporting to the SVP, Media Technology & Engineering, this role will partner closely with the VP, Media Technology Architecture and other technology leaders. The VP of Architecture will establish future-state architecture, standards, and technical direction. This role will own engineering execution, implementation, operational readiness, reliability, lifecycle management, and incident response.

Role Scope

The major areas of responsibility include:

  • Broadcast technology engineering and operations
  • SMPTE ST 2110 implementation and operational reliability
  • Network, compute, storage, and virtualization engineering
  • Hybrid cloud infrastructure operations
  • Station automation and delivery platforms
  • OTT, streaming, and OTA technology support
  • News and local production support
  • Media technology and transmission
  • Disaster recovery and platform resiliency
  • 24/7 technical operations and incident response

Responsibilities

Engineering Operations and Reliability

  • Lead the day-to-day engineering and operational support of mission-critical broadcast and media technology environments.
  • Ensure 24/7/365 availability, reliability, and operational readiness across broadcast, production, distribution, and transmission platforms.
  • Establish operating procedures, escalation paths, service expectations, and incident response practices.
  • Partner with Critical Response and Operations teams to manage major incidents, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
  • Monitor system health and ensure timely resolution of reliability, performance, and availability issues.

Broadcast Systems Implementation and Support

  • Lead the engineering implementation, integration, testing, deployment, and lifecycle management of broadcast technology platforms.
  • Support live news gathering, contribution, production, post-production, playout, master control, station automation, and transmission workflows.
  • Implement and operate SMPTE ST 2110 video-over-IP environments, including routing, timing, packet integrity, latency, and system interoperability.
  • Support the transition from SDI-based workflows to synchronized, software-defined IP media facilities in partnership with the Media Architecture team.
  • Maintain operational compatibility across existing systems while implementing new technology platforms.

Network and Infrastructure Engineering

  • Lead engineering execution across WAN, LAN, contribution networks, routing, switching, QoS, multicast, and high-capacity media connectivity.
  • Operate and optimize on-premise data centers, hybrid cloud infrastructure, enterprise virtualization, containerized environments, compute, storage, and related platforms.
  • Manage infrastructure lifecycle activities, including upgrades, capacity planning, patching, migrations, integrations, and technology refreshes.
  • Implement approved architecture and security standards in partnership with Media Architecture, Network Engineering, and Information Security.
  • Ensure infrastructure supports high-throughput, low-latency media workflows and enterprise data distribution.

Resiliency and Disaster Recovery

  • Implement and maintain disaster recovery, business continuity, redundancy, failover, and resiliency capabilities.
  • Conduct readiness testing and ensure recovery procedures are documented, current, and operationally viable.
  • Identify single points of failure and lead remediation efforts.
  • Partner with architecture and security teams to ensure resiliency requirements are incorporated into new implementations and major upgrades.

Project and Program Delivery

  • Partner with the PMO and Critical Response teams to deliver technology upgrades, expansions, migrations, integrations, and operational improvements.
  • Translate approved architecture and technical requirements into executable engineering plans.
  • Manage dependencies, technical risks, resource requirements, milestones, and operational readiness.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and with appropriate testing, documentation, training, and support plans.
  • Coordinate production cutovers and post-implementation support.

Performance Management and Optimization

  • Establish operational KPIs and service-level measures for availability, reliability, capacity, latency, incident response, and recovery.
  • Optimize monitoring, alerting, and alarming systems to reduce noise and improve response effectiveness.
  • Use performance data and operational trends to identify risks, capacity needs, and improvement opportunities.
  • Drive continuous improvement across engineering processes, tools, and support models.

Vendor and Service Management

  • Manage operational relationships with key technology vendors and service providers.
  • Monitor vendor performance against service-level expectations.
  • Coordinate escalations, technical support, maintenance, and issue resolution.
  • Partner with Architecture and Procurement teams to validate technical requirements and support vendor evaluations.

Documentation and Compliance

  • Maintain accurate documentation for network, infrastructure, broadcast, transmission, security, and recovery environments.
  • Ensure engineering procedures align with applicable industry standards, regulatory requirements, security policies, and internal controls.
  • Maintain current system diagrams, runbooks, asset information, configuration records, recovery procedures, and support documentation.
  • Support operational audits, compliance reviews, and risk assessments.

Leadership and Talent Development

  • Lead and develop a high-performing engineering organization supporting complex, highly available media environments.
  • Establish clear team structures, accountabilities, operating rhythms, and performance expectations.
  • Mentor engineering leaders and technical talent.
  • Build a culture of operational excellence, accountability, collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to define requirements, manage expectations, and deliver reliable solutions.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner closely with the VP, Media Technology Architecture to execute approved technical strategies and standards.
  • Collaborate with Network Engineering, Information Security, Broadcast Operations, Media Services, Digital Platforms, News, Local Production, and Transmission teams.
  • Provide engineering input into architecture decisions based on operational requirements, reliability, supportability, and total cost of ownership.
  • Serve as the engineering voice during technology planning, implementation, and operational readiness reviews.

Continuous Improvement and Innovation

  • Evaluate emerging technologies for operational value, reliability, supportability, and compatibility with the FOX media environment.
  • Drive adoption of tools, frameworks, and methodologies that improve engineering effectiveness and standardize deployment procedures.
  • Maintain backward compatibility while modernizing technology platforms and operating practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve automation, observability, resiliency, and engineering productivity.

What You Will Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field, or equivalent executive experience.
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in media technology, broadcast engineering, enterprise infrastructure, or related environments.
  • At least 5 years of senior leadership experience managing engineering or technology operations teams.
  • Proven experience leading engineering implementation and operational support for large-scale broadcast or media technology environments.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing and operating SMPTE ST 2110 uncompressed IP video production systems.
  • Deep expertise in enterprise networking, including routing, switching, QoS, multicast, WAN, LAN, and contribution networks.
  • Strong experience with on-premise data centers, hybrid cloud infrastructure, virtualization, compute, storage, and containerized environments.
  • Experience leading disaster recovery, resiliency, high availability, incident response, and business continuity programs.
  • Experience supporting news gathering, live production, post-production, playout, master control, station automation, transmission, OTT, streaming, or OTA delivery environments.
  • Strong project and program management skills focused on implementation, operational readiness, and reliability.
  • Experience managing technology vendors, service providers, escalations, and service-level performance.
  • Knowledge of DCIM, CMDB, IPAM, monitoring, observability, and infrastructure management systems.
  • Executive presence and the ability to communicate complex technical matters clearly to senior stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams through complex technical transformations while maintaining operational stability.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, 24/7 media environment.
  • Occasional domestic travel, up to 25%.

job.description:
The Senior Union Payroll Associate performs a variety of functions necessary for the accurate and timely processing of multi-state, multi-company, weekly and bi-weekly payrolls for union and non-union freelance employees. The Senior Union Payroll Associate coordinates, validates, and implements work procedures that require comprehensive operational knowledge of union collective bargaining agreements and federal and state regulations related to wage garnishment, taxation and wage‐hour law.

While there are no direct people responsibilities, the Senior Union Payroll Associate will coordinate independently with other associates, leaders, and teams outside of Payroll Shared Services to accomplish tasks, meet deadlines, champion process improvement initiatives, and enhance the employee experience.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Perform all duties necessary to ensure timely and accurate processing of multi-state, multi-company weekly and bi-weekly payrolls for union and non-union freelance employees in accordance with collective bargaining agreements and other contracts and in compliance with applicable FOX policies and federal, state, and local regulations
  • Process on demand payments, retroactive payments, one-time payments, tax adjustments, stop payments, void checks, direct deposit reversals, and overpayment collections in accordance with FOX policies, collective bargaining agreements, and in compliance with federal, state, and local regulations
  • Interpret and set up withholding orders for levies, garnishments, child support, and other involuntary wage assignment orders in the payroll system within the regulated period
  • Understand union pay and paid time off rules and the timekeeping system and address employee questions as needed
  • Provide testing support during the implementation of the new timekeeping system and assist with team training
  • Perform detailed pre-payroll processing audits of earnings, deductions, benefits, garnishments, and tax setups to prevent pay-impacting errors when payroll is processed
  • Audit and reconcile union-related inputs, including union dues, initiation fees, and retirement contributions, to ensure accuracy and strict adherence to collective bargaining agreements
  • Understand proper taxation of all employee payments, including employer paid union benefits, and address employee questions as needed
  • Review, test, and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) regularly to ensure operational accuracy, compliance, and continuous process efficiency
  • Provide subject matter expertise on union timekeeping rules and processes, to include paid time off plans. This requires the ability to interpret rules outlined in collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) and other union related documents
  • Assist employees and management with questions, concerns, or requests regarding union payroll. This includes properly applying technical knowledge and skills, communicating, and listening effectively
  • Serve as a go-to expert for union payroll questions, managing the timely resolution of customer issues, including handling customer escalations, performing and documenting Root Cause Analysis, and implementing remedial procedures to close gaps identified
  • Ensure compliance with all company policies, internal controls, and SOX controls

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 4+ years hands-on union payroll processing experience, preferably with IBEW, IATSE, AFTRA, and/or NABET collective bargaining agreements
  • Experience with interpreting and setting up withholding orders for levies, garnishments, child support, and other involuntary wage assignment orders
  • Experience and knowledge of automated time and attendance systems
  • Experience with initiating and leading standardization and process improvement initiatives
  • Strong working knowledge of FLSA, federal, state, and local wage and hour and tax regulations.
  • Ability to interpret collective bargaining agreements for pay and paid time off rules.
  • Strong interpersonal skills – you are approachable, responsive, and team focused
  • Intermediate Excel using VLOOKUP and pivots.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Excellent judgment, analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High degree of professionalism and solid ability in delivering high quality customer service and establishing/maintaining effective and collaborative working relationships

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Fundamental Payroll Certification (FPC) or Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) designation
  • Experience with Workday Payroll

This role will work closely with a Correspondent and production teams to pitch, develop, report, and execute compelling journalism—from breaking news to in-depth features, investigative reporting to national coverage.

The ideal candidate is a creative journalist with sharp editorial judgment, strong writing and research skills, and the confidence to thrive under pressure. This producer should be equally at home in the field, on location, or in the control room, and adept at delivering both live and taped segments that meet NBC’s highest editorial standards. The ideal candidate is a news junkie who can’t wait to get out the door and, on the road, to cover that next story. This producer should also enjoy storytelling for morning television, an evening newscast and everything in between. The ability to shoot and edit is a plus, along with a sense of what does well on social media or in vertical video formats.

This role is right for you if you’re a versatile storyteller who thrives on urgency and impact. You move seamlessly between producing, reporting, and writing, and you’re as comfortable leading coverage during breaking news as you are crafting enterprise stories. You’re highly organized, competitive, and relentless about accuracy and detail—yet collaborative, adaptable, and energized by working with correspondents and teams under tight deadlines. Most importantly, you’re passionate about journalism that informs, engages, and makes a difference.

NBCUniversal is seeking a Principal Material Artist to define and evolve the visual and technical standards for materials on an AAA open-world game set in a contemporary, real-world urban environment. This role will help ensure a high level of quality, realism, consistency, and performance across materials for environments, characters, props, and other game content.

The Principal Material Artist will work closely with the Lead Material Artist, Tech Art, Art, and Engineering teams to develop robust and scalable shader systems, master materials, and

pipelines. The role will also contribute to the R&D of new workflows, tools, automation, and AI-assisted solutions to improve efficiency, iteration, and large-scale content production.

Résumé du poste

NBCUniversal recherche un·e Artiste Principal·e Matériaux pour définir et faire évoluer les standards visuels et techniques des matériaux dans le cadre d’un jeu AAA en monde ouvert situé dans un environnement urbain contemporain. Ce rôle contribuera à garantir un haut niveau de qualité, de réalisme, de cohérence et de performance pour l’ensemble des matériaux du projet, couvrant notamment les environnements, personnages et props.

L’Artiste Principal·e Matériaux travaillera étroitement avec le·la Lead Material Artist, les équipes Tech Art, Art et Engineering afin de développer des systèmes de shaders, master materials et pipelines robustes et scalables. Le rôle participera également à la R&D de nouveaux workflows, outils, automatisations et solutions assistées par IA, afin d’améliorer l’efficacité, l’itération et la capacité de production à grande échelle.

 

Responsibilities

  • Define and maintain high-quality visual standards for materials across the project, including environments, characters, props, and procedural content.
  • Drive the development and evolution of master materials and shader systems to support the artistic and technical needs of different disciplines.
  • Solve complex artistic and technical challenges related to material definition, realism, rendering, and performance.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for PBR workflows, shader systems, and real-time material pipelines.
  • Collaborate closely with Tech Art, Art, and Engineering to ensure material systems are robust, flexible, and scalable.
  • Contribute to the design and evolution of material pipelines, tools, and workflows, identifying opportunities for automation and increased production efficiency.
  • Explore and prototype new approaches, including AI-assisted tools and workflows, to improve material and texture creation, iteration, variation, and scalability.
  • Define benchmarks and quality bars to ensure visual consistency across different types of content while supporting the established Art Direction.
  • Ensure material performance and scalability across platforms, from high-end hardware to mobile.
  • Support the Lead Material Artist and wider team with advanced artistic and technical expertise, while encouraging experimentation and the evolution of production practices.
  • Review and validate material implementation to ensure alignment with established artistic, technical, and performance standards.

Responsabilités

  • Définir et maintenir des standards visuels de haute qualité pour les matériaux à l’échelle du projet incluant personnages, props et contenu procédural.
  • Piloter le développement et l’évolution des master materials et des systèmes de shaders afin de repondre aux besoins artistiques et techniques de ces differentes disciplines.
  • Résoudre des problématiques complexes artistiques et techniques liées à la définition des matériaux, au réalisme et à la performance.
  • Agir comme expert sur les workflows PBR, systèmes de shaders et pipelines matériaux temps réel.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Tech Art , Art et Ingenieurs afin de garantir des systèmes matériaux robustes et scalables.
  • Contribuer à la conception et à l’évolution des pipelines, outils et workflows liés aux matériaux en identifiant les opportunités d’automatisation et d’amélioration de l’efficacité de production.
  • Explorer et prototyper de nouvelles approches, incluant les outils assistés par l’IA, afin d’améliorer la création, l’itération, la variation et la scalabilité des matériaux et textures.
  • Définir les benchmarks et niveau de qualité permettant une cohérence visuelle entre les différents types de contenu en se basant sur la direction artistique établie.
  • Garantir la performance des matériaux sur différentes plateformes, du haut de gamme au mobile.
  • Soutenir le·la Lead Material Artist ainsi que l’équipe grâce à une expertise artisitique et technique avancée, tout en encourageant l’experimentation et l’evolution des pratiques.
  • Réviser et valider l’implémentation des matériaux afin d’assurer l’alignement avec les standards artistiques et techniques

Basic Qualifications

  • Significant experience in AAA game development with a focus on real-time materials and shader creation.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating expertise across a wide variety of materials and surfaces, including environments, characters, and props.
  • Excellent understanding of PBR workflows, shaders, and material systems in Unreal Engine.
  • Strong understanding of real-time rendering pipelines, performance constraints, and modular, procedural, and scalable material systems.
  • Experience collaborating closely with Tech Art, Art, and Engineering teams.
  • Proven ability to solve complex artistic and technical challenges related to materials and rendering.
  • Interest in R&D, automation, and emerging technologies, including AI-assisted workflows, to improve production pipelines.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Qualifications de base

  • Expérience significative en développement de jeux AAA avec un focus sur la création de matériaux et shaders temps réel.
  • Portfolio solide démontrant une maitrise des matériaux sur une variété de surfaces et contenus, incluant environnements, personnages et props.
  • Excellente maîtrise des workflows PBR, shaders et systèmes de matériaux dans Unreal Engine.
  • Forte compréhension des pipelines de rendu temps réel, des contraintes de performance, création de systèmes de matériaux modulaires, procéduraux et scalables.
  • Expérience de collaboration étroite avec les équipes Tech Art, Art et Ingénieurs.
  • Bonne compréhension des systèmes de matériaux modulaires et des pipelines scalables.
  •  Capacité à résoudre des problématiques complexes artistiques et techniques.
  • Intérêt pour la R&D, l’automatisation et l’utilisation de technologies émergentes, incluant les workflows assistés par IA, afin d’améliorer les pipelines de production.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication et collaboration.

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience developing and maintaining master materials and shader systems at scale.
  • Strong knowledge of advanced shader techniques and material optimization.
  • Experience with material pipelines using Unreal Engine 5, Substance Designer, and Substance Painter.
  • Experience working with distributed teams and/or external partners.
  • Strong eye for realism, surface diversity, material definition, and visual consistency across a large-scale project.
  • A curious and experimental mindset, with a desire to innovate and evolve material workflows, tools, and shader systems.

Atouts souhaités

  • Expérience dans le développement et la maintenance de master materials et systeme de shaders à grande échelle.
  • Bonne connaissance des techniques avancées de shaders et de l’optimisation matériaux.
  • Expérience avec les pipelines matériaux Unreal Engine 5, Substance Designer et Substance Painter.
  • Expérience avec équipes distribuées ou partenaires externes.
  • Forte sensibilité au réalisme, à la diversité des surfaces et à la cohérence visuelle à l’échelle d’un projet.
  • Envie d’innover et de faire évoluer les workflows et systèmes de shaders.

Eligibility Requirements

  • Must be willing to work in our Montreal office a minimum of 4 days a week. 
  • Must be legally authorized to work in Canada. 
  • Must be willing to travel for work related business, if necessary

 The Director of EHS will be assigned feature productions to ensure overall compliance with all applicable company, federal, state, local and/or international environmental, occupational safety and health policies, rules, and regulations. Additionally, the Director of EHS will provide guidance and support to fellow EHS Managers as they encounter difficulties in their own feature safety oversight. 

Primary Responsibilities (essential functions):

Implement, maintain, and develop appropriate safety programs, (e.g., Injury and Illness Prevention Program) policies, and procedures as necessary to ensure a safe and healthful work environment for all employees and guests of the productions.

  • Communicate with Production Executives, Production Management, Cast and Crew to ensure that all EHS expectations are being met.
  • Establish, administer, and enforce a program of safe practices for all production personnel.
  • Ensure appropriate pre-lease inspections are conducted for all potential production spaces and resolve any identified EHS issues.
  • Conduct a review/breakdown of each script on their assigned film to identify potential EHS issues (e.g., special effects, stunts, use of props, unusual activities, and hazardous locations).
  • Participate and often attend each production’s tech scout and production meeting, as necessary, to understand scheduled production activities and provide guidance for any safety issues.
  • Prepare a location safety memo, as required, to inform the production employees of general location safety issues as well as specific location safety concerns.
  • Establish and implement procedures for proper hazardous waste accumulation and disposal following company policies.
  • Assist the production in following company’s hazardous waste procedure and that manifests are collected and submitted in a timely manner.
  • Facilitate and/or conduct EHS testing of any location that presents potential EHS hazards (e.g., testing water quality, air quality, coordinating abatement and/or encapsulation of areas or materials).
  • Attend stunt rehearsals and special effect tests to provide input from the EHS perspective and be on set during the shooting of these stunts and effects, as necessary.
  • Provide education and safety training to production crew, supervisors and management in safety awareness, safe work practices, documentation requirements, and general regulatory compliance, as necessary.
  • Establish a safety committee on productions lasting longer than one year in duration, or when governmental regulations require a committee.
  • Provide EHS equipment or instruments, when applicable, to assist in compliance of EHS laws and programs.  If equipment or instruments are not available, provide contacts where equipment can be procured.
  • Discuss the injury and illness paperwork process with the designated production contact and production medics to ensure forms are completed properly.
  • Conduct investigations of all accidents, incidents, significant events, and emergencies promptly in accordance with company policies and applicable laws and regulations.
  • Review Injury and Illness log to ensure that all cases are being properly entered into the Benchmark ESG GenSuite software program and follow-up is being entered and closure verifications are being done.
  • Review Benchmark ESG GenSuite Audits, Events and Inspections to ensure that they are being properly entered and that all findings are resolved in a timely manner.
  • Review Injury and Illness log data to identify trends and recommend program development and/or training to aid in reduction of workers’ compensation claims.
  • Report promptly to company management any serious injury or incident that triggers federal, state, and/or local reporting regulations informing them of the details of the event and schedule of follow-up activity.
  • On cases reportable to the Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) or other regulatory agencies, work with Production Management, production representatives and regulatory agency to resolve identified safety issues.
  • Review investigations of accidents, incidents, significant events and emergencies conducted by production to ensure compliance with company policies and applicable laws and regulations. Advise production of changes to prevent recurrence.
  • Ensure loaned equipment issued to productions are tracked and that equipment is returned or replaced promptly.
  • On international productions where an outside safety advisor has been engaged, work with the locally hired safety representative to ensure that all company policies and procedures are adhered to.
  • Assist in creating injury and illness data for staff and executive meetings.
  • Seek and maintain applicable training to ensure they are current in personal certifications or achieve additional certifications that are useful for advising the production on safety related matters.
  • Attend and participate in industry related meetings (i.e., AMPTP, SAFFE) and report information from the meetings back to fellow safety team members.
  • Work with EHS Senior Director to establish personal and departmental goals. 
  • Work with the EHS Senior Director and Managers to ensure consistent application of company policies across all productions and evaluate whether these policies are effective.
  • Actively participate in the weekly EHS departmental meetings and be prepared to discuss issues related to the group.
  • Interface with outside regulatory agencies as required (e.g., Fire Department, OSHA representatives).
  • Participate in the ongoing review of existing EHS programs and creation of new programs, policies, procedures, guidelines, and bulletins, as needed.
  • Represent NBCUniversal to external professional organizations, peers and employees in a professional manner.
  • Additional projects as assigned by Film EHS Senior Director

Required Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience handling complex safety issues
  • Demonstrated experience cultivating strong client relationships to leverage successful results
  • Must apply via nbcunicareers.com to be considered
  • Must be 18 years or older
  • Must be willing to work in the Los Angeles, CA office
  • Must be willing to submit to a background investigation
  • Must be willing and able to work varied hours as needed to fit the needs of EHS and production.
  • Must be able to climb ladders, stairs, wear fall protection or other PPE
  • International and domestic travel will be required
  • Must have unrestricted employment authorization to work in the United States

Desired Qualifications 

  • Minimum 7 years experience in EHS or relevant safety experience
  • Professional certifications, such as ASP, CSP, CIH, OHST, CHMM, is preferred
  • Strong computer skills (proficient in MS Word and Excel, Adobe; knowledgeable in MS Access or other database software)
  • Self-starter with strong project management and leadership skills
  • Excellent writing, communication, and interpersonal skills
  • Must be able to interact with all levels of employees and management
  • Good working knowledge of OSHA regulations, industrial hygiene practices, fire department codes, stunt and special effects operations

Additional Information 

Required On-Site: This position is required to be performed full-time from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary: $150,000 - $180,000 (Bonus & LTI eligible)

The Host/Producer will bring energy, authenticity, strong storytelling skills, and a deep connection to the community. The role requires someone equally comfortable engaging audiences on camera, interviewing guests and community leaders, developing original content, and collaborating with producers and other station teams to deliver relevant multiplatform programming.

Job Responsibilities

On-Air Hosting & Storytelling

  • Serve as a primary on-air host and representative of Acceso Total.
  • Deliver engaging, conversational, and authentic presentations across broadcast, digital, streaming, social, and other platforms.
  • Conduct compelling interviews with entertainers, community leaders, experts, local personalities, businesses, and other guests.
  • Develop, produce, and present sponsored segments, product integrations, and promotional content in collaboration with sales, clients, and production teams, ensuring engaging on-air delivery consistent with the program’s format and station standards.
  • Communicate naturally with audiences while maintaining strong editorial judgment and professionalism.
  • Participate in field shoots, community events, promotional appearances, and station initiatives.
  • Develop a recognizable and credible connection with viewers and the Southwest Florida community.

Editorial & Content Leadership

  • Partner with the production team to develop daily and longer-term content strategies for Acceso Total.
  • Identify and develop stories and segments focused on entertainment, lifestyle, culture, community, consumer interests, social trends, and topics relevant to local Hispanic audiences.
  • Generate original segment ideas and identify potential guests, experiences, and community stories.
  • Write and/or contribute to scripts, show copy, interview questions, opens, teases, promotional material, and digital content.
  • Help determine the appropriate tone, presentation, and storytelling approach for individual segments.
  • Maintain strong editorial standards and ensure content aligns with station and company expectations.

Producer Responsibilities

  • Take an active role in the planning and execution of the program from concept through air.
  • Work closely with producers, photographers/editors, MMJs, creative services, sales, community engagement, digital teams, and station leadership.
  • Help prioritize stories and segments based on audience relevance, timeliness, production requirements, and overall program strategy.
  • Provide editorial input and creative direction to strengthen the quality, consistency, and identity of the program.
  • Support special programs, sponsored integrations, community initiatives, and other station projects while maintaining appropriate editorial standards.

Digital & Social

  • Develop content specifically designed for social, digital, streaming, and emerging platforms.
  • Maintain an active and professional social media presence supporting Acceso Total and the station's brands.
  • Identify opportunities to extend on-air stories into digital and social conversations.
  • Participate in short-form video, behind-the-scenes content, live social coverage, and other multiplatform initiatives.
  • Collaborate with station teams to grow audience engagement beyond the traditional broadcast.

Community & Brand

  • Serve as a visible ambassador for Acceso Total and the station throughout Southwest Florida.
  • Build relationships with community organizations, cultural institutions, local businesses, artists, entertainers, and community leaders.
  • Identify stories and voices that authentically represent the interests and experiences of the local Hispanic community.
  • Represent the station at community events, promotional opportunities, and public appearances as assigned.
  • Help strengthen Acceso Total's position as a locally relevant lifestyle and entertainment brand.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in journalism, communications, broadcasting, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Professional experience in television, digital media, entertainment, lifestyle programming, journalism, or related content production.
  • Demonstrated on-camera hosting, reporting, or presenting experience.
  • Strong interviewing, writing, storytelling, and communication skills.
  • Ability to develop and produce engaging content for television, digital, streaming, and social platforms.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish with strong Spanish-language on-air communication skills.
  • Strong knowledge of social media and evolving audience-consumption habits.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced production environment and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Availability to work flexible hours, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, and community events as business needs require.

Eligibility Requirements

  • Submit a resume/CV and demo reel through nbcunicareers.com.
  • Must have unrestricted authorization to work in the United States and be at least 18 years old.
  • Must be willing to work in Fort Myers/Naples viewing area.

Desired Characteristics

  • Charismatic and authentic on-camera presence with the ability to connect naturally with viewers.
  • Strong knowledge of Southwest Florida and its Hispanic communities, culture, businesses, entertainment, and lifestyle.
  • Creative thinker who consistently identifies fresh story, guest, and segment opportunities.
  • Strong editorial judgment and understanding of the distinction between editorial, promotional, and commercial content.
  • Experience producing lifestyle, entertainment, community, or magazine-style programming.

Job Title

Team

Job Description

 

Overview
Paramount is seeking a Manager, Software Quality Assurance Engineering to lead the design and build-out of testing infrastructure supporting Paramount’s large-scale software development and deployment ecosystem. This role goes beyond traditional testing. You will drive a shift-left quality culture, anticipate risks and failure points before they reach customers or production, and represent GQE in Scrum ceremonies and cross-functional discussions.

You will manage and mentor a team of quality engineers, partner with engineering leaders at a technical level, and provide strategic input on test coverage, automation, reliability, and overall software quality across consumer-facing platforms.

This role requires a blend of hands-on QA/automation expertise, people leadership across on-site and offshore teams, and the ability to evaluate and scale modern AI-powered testing tools.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

Team Leadership & People Management

  • Lead virtual, geographically dispersed teams, fostering collaboration across locations and time zones.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and coaching to help team members grow and perform at their highest potential.
  • Manage people across on-site and offshore teams.

 

Technical Strategy & Execution

  • Lead and manage the implementation of solutions for test automation, CI/CD, and DevOps for Client teams.
  • Champion a shift-left quality mindset within a dynamic, fast-paced Agile environment.
  • Continuously assess Quality Engineering capabilities against organizational needs, developing pilots, POCs, and implementation plans to close gaps.
  • Evaluate, pilot, and scale AI-powered testing and coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or specialized AI test automation platforms) to boost Client teams’ productivity and automate repetitive QA workflows.

 

Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Partner with developers and technology leaders to drive quality throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Serve as a GQE representative in Scrum ceremonies and cross-functional discussions.
  • Clearly communicate technical concepts, quality risks, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.

 

Operational Excellence

  • Develop and continuously improve testing, quality assurance, and defect remediation processes.
  • Assess risk associated with identified defects and establish appropriate priority and severity levels.
  • Provide a holistic assessment of data quality across existing implementations and new feature development.
  • Develop data validation tests aligned with business and technical requirements within an Agile delivery methodology.

 

Qualifications

 

Required

  • 8+ years of testing experience in an Agile Software Development methodology.
  • 5+ years leading projects with minimal supervision.
  • 5+ years of people management experience, working with on-site and offshore teams.
  • 5+ years testing consumer-facing applications on WebCTV and built-in CTV platforms.
  • 5+ years developing test automation scripts using object-oriented frameworks (Selenium/WebDriver, Java).
  • Experience with Test Harness (TestNG), version control (GIT), SQL, CI/CD tools (Jenkins), build tools (Maven), debugging tools (Charles/Fiddler), Agile management tools (JIRA), and test management tools (TestRail).
  • Deep understanding of streaming playback fundamentals, with proven experience testing across WebCTV platforms (smart TVs, streaming devices) and hands-on use of QoE monitoring tools (e.g., Conviva, Mux) to identify and triage device-specific playback defects.
  • Hands-on knowledge of modern AI-powered testing and coding assistants, with the ability to evaluate, pilot, and scale AI tools that automate regression testing and enhance requirement validation.

 

Preferred

  • 2+ years of performance testing experience using commercial or open-source tools (jMeter, Curl, WebPageTest, etc.).
  • Working knowledge of NoSQL databases (MongoDB, etc.).
  • Experience working with Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

 

Education
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software, Electrical or Electronics Engineering, or a comparable field, and/or equivalent work experience.

About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KFSM 5NEWS, a TEGNA-owned CBS affiliate in Fayetteville–Fort Smith, Arkansas, is seeking an engaging Anchor / Multi-Skilled Journalist to lead our weekend morning newscasts and report stories that matter across Northwest Arkansas and the River Valley. This journalist will help viewers start their day informed, prepared and connected to their communities.
We are looking for a journalist with strong news judgment, clear and conversational on-air delivery, and the curiosity to find the people and context behind the headlines. The successful candidate will work closely with producers and the newsroom team to shape useful, accurate newscasts, while also reporting, shooting, writing and editing original stories for broadcast and digital platforms. This is a visible newsroom role that calls for a dependable teammate, a thoughtful community presence and a calm, flexible approach to breaking news.

Responsibilities
• Anchor 5NEWS This Morning on Saturday and Sunday with accuracy, warmth, authority and energy.
• Partner with producers, editors, photographers and newsroom leaders to plan and deliver clear, compelling newscasts; contribute ideas, editorial judgment and strong writing.
• Prepare for each broadcast by reviewing scripts, confirming facts and pronunciations, tracking developing stories and making timely updates as news changes.
• Report, write, shoot, produce and edit original stories and live reports for television, streaming, mobile and social platforms.
• Develop enterprise and community-focused stories through social listening, public records, independent research and trusted local sources.
• Build and maintain relationships with people and organizations throughout Northwest Arkansas and the River Valley, reflecting the range of communities in our viewing area.
• Use social media and digital tools to discover story ideas, engage with the audience and distribute accurate, useful journalism.
• Create or contribute to digital content, including web stories, video, live updates, images and social posts, in coordination with the newsroom.
• Deliver clear, authoritative live coverage during breaking news and severe weather, adapting quickly while following newsroom standards and direction.
• Represent 5NEWS professionally at community events
• Serve as a fill-in anchor and fulfill other duties as assigned

Requirements
• 1-3 years news anchor/reporting experience preferred
• Journalism, communications or related degree preferred
• Excellent writing, interviewing and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex issues in clear, conversational language.
• Sound editorial judgment and a demonstrated commitment to accuracy, fairness, ethics and accountability.
• Ability to shoot and edit video and produce content for broadcast and digital platforms.
• Experience with newsroom systems, editing tools and graphics
• Ability to report, publish and engage with the community on social media daily.
• Ability to work any shift in a 24/7 newsroom environment
• Knowledge of Northwest Arkansas and the River Valley is a plus

job.title: Sr. Search Strategist
job.description:
The Sr. Paid Search Specialist role is focused on defining strategy and driving success for top brands across the National, Enterprise and Multi-Location team. In this role, you will act as an advisor and investigator, understanding the clients’ business goals, analyzing current campaigns, the results, the set up, and recommending modifications and appropriate capabilities and implementation skillsets needed to help achieve set benchmarks.  This role will own the strategic recommendation elements to help campaigns reach client goals. This role will also take an active role in our pre-sales process and in making initial client recommendations prior to onboarding. The role we play is significant and we strive to exceed our goals and client expectations, while learning, growing, and having fun as a team along the way.

Are you in? Come talk to us, we would love to tell you more!

About the job:

The Senior Paid Search Strategist will focus efforts around four core functions:

Discovery

Implementation

Optimization

Results

Leveraging our in-house reporting dashboards, you will identify and select campaigns to review based on shortfalls you see from established client expectations.  In other circumstances, cases will come directly to you from our Sales and Brand Management team, soliciting your advice on recommendations to correct campaign performance.  Some brands will be existing, while new, large brands will be also folded in as they are closed by our sales team.

Our brands today are primarily focused on SEM, and you will work to ensure that this tactic is delivering stellar results across each brand and account within the brand, while helping to partner with colleagues to make strategic recommendations on how to diversify this approach through other advertising platforms.

Recommended changes will then be implemented.   Whether helping implement the changes directly or delegating tasks to associated client success managers attached to the brands, you will be accountable for ensuring implementation is completed correctly.  From there, continuous optimization will occur with consistent reviews that you will conduct leveraging reporting tools to help tell the story to clients.

Results will then be shared with internal and external clients.  Using the same reporting platforms, we will share results and format it in such a way that it tells a story and provides clients valuable insights and recommendations.

This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports and will own the strategic elements of the client relationship while the current/existing managers will own people management of teams and execution disciplines.

Expectations:  You must have applied experience in SEM at an expert level, with an advanced knowledge of shopping ads and paid search ads outside of search engine platforms, such as Yelp and Amazon. You should also have a cross-section of skills spanning:

Advertising Strategy

Project Management

Technology

Attention to detail

Consumer Insights

Analytics

Implementation of Data -Driven Decisions

Responsibilities:

Day-to-Day:

Develop and execute effective SEM and paid search strategies that align with clients’ goals and objectives.

Conduct in-depth keyword research to identify high-value keywords and phrases for both organic and paid search campaigns.

Oversee paid search campaigns, including budget management, ad copywriting, bid optimization, and performance tracking.

Monitor and analyze performance metrics using tools like Google Analytics, Google Ads, and internal software, and provide regular reports to external and internal stakeholders.

Stay current with industry trends, algorithm updates, and best practices in search marketing to ensure compliance and effectiveness.

Conduct competitive analysis to identify opportunities and threats in the search marketing landscape.

Collaborate with client or internal web development and UX teams to optimize landing pages and user experiences for improved conversion rates.

Manage the search marketing budget, allocating effectively to maximize ROI.

The Social Media Editor will be responsible for publishing and scheduling posts across accounts, monitoring breaking news, and ensuring top stories are amplified with smart framing and creative execution. This role requires deep expertise in social media trends, analytics, and platform best practices, as well as the creativity to develop fresh ideas that grow engagement and strengthen brand presence.


The role will work closely with our senior editorial leaders to ensure all content finds the audience.

job.title: Temporary Senior Editor, Visuals
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Application Deadline: Please submit your application materials by Friday, November 6th, 2026, at 5:00 pm EST

Intro to Position

As a member of the Visuals team, the Senior Visual Editor will be primarily focused on editing and producing content for NPR’s Investigations and Long Form Podcast Unit and projects. This producer will primarily work on commissioning and editing photography and illustration for all NPR platforms. This is a temporary position and ends in June 2027.

NPR Visuals is focused on creating and distributing content that reflects and serves America. We work with teams across NPR, our member stations, and content partners to tell stories and engage audiences on NPR.org, YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and other visual platforms.

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff are defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.    

This is a union-represented role covered under the terms of a collective bargaining agreement with SAG-AFTRA. 

Responsibilities

  • Commission and edit original photography and illustrations for NPR stories and podcasts.
  • Innovate, execute, assess and iterate visual projects for all platforms.
  • Edit, research and license images for all NPR platforms including NPR.org, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, TikTok  and emerging platforms.
  • Work with photographers, illustrators, agencies and vendors to process contracts and invoices from assignments. 
  • Handle photo imaging, captions and credits for stories you edit.
  • Attend meetings as needed with the Visuals team, desks, podcasts and shows.
  • Contribute to planning and creating strategic efforts to effectively reach new and existing audiences on digital platforms
  • Coordinate with member station journalists and other content partners as needed in order to acquire, publish and distribute visual assets for NPR and other public media platforms.
  • Effectively represents the interests and capabilities of NPR visuals with colleagues across the company
  • Provide guidance and feedback to other Visual team members.
  • Occasionally photo edit breaking news stories or large scale news events. 
  • Research, pitch, write and produce stories for NPR’s visuals blog, The Picture Show.
  • Uphold the highest standards for NPR’s visual journalism and storytelling.
  • Collaborate with NPR’s Instagram team on creating engaging visual content for the platform.
  • Stay up to date with NPR broadcasts, podcasts, reporters, news wires, competition and internal communications to make sure our visual storytelling is optimized and smart.
  • Additional duties as assigned by your manager.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Required Skills

  • Photographic storytelling experience, preferably with a major network or newsroom, studio or creative agency.
  • Mastery of Adobe Creative Cloud programs related to video and photo design. (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere).
  • Ability to handle multiple and complex projects simultaneously under stringent time frames and changing priorities/conditions.
  • Demonstrated commitment to increasing audience diversity.
  • Be well versed in copyright and ethical journalism practices.
  • Extensive experience in content management systems.
  • Excellent communication and writing skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills to handle multiple assignments across different teams and timelines.
  • Have a strong interest in current events.
  • Ability to work independently and with members of a cooperative team.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in work experience

Work Location & Requirements

  • SAG-AFTRA Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. The employee will be required to be in the office at the Washington, D.C. location at least 2 days a week. The employee must also reside in Washington, D.C. / Maryland / Virginia.

Job Type

  • This is a temporary (6-month) full-time position.

Compensation

Hourly Rate: The U.S. based anticipated hourly rate for this opportunity is $61.30 per hour. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum hourly rate NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

NPR Benefits: NPR offers access to comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.

job.title: Director, Product Design User Interface
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post is seeking a Director, Product Design User Interface to lead the visual and interaction design of our digital products across web, mobile apps, and emerging platforms.


This is a senior craft leadership role for a designer who can set a high bar for interface quality, establish the systems that allow teams to meet it consistently, and help create a more modern, distinctive, and coherent reader experience. The Director, Product Design User Interface will own the design language, component systems, interaction patterns, and quality standards that shape how readers experience The Post.


Working closely with Product, Engineering, Content Design, newsroom partners, and the broader Product Design organization, this leader will translate product and design strategy into consistently excellent execution while building scalable systems that help teams design and develop experiences more efficiently.


This role is distinct from the broader Product Design leader, who will own the Product Design organization and lead cross-company design alignment and the organization’s operational responsibilities. The Director, Product Design User Interface will serve as the organization’s senior leader for interface craft and execution.


This position is based in Washington, D.C.


What Motivates You

  • You care deeply about visual and interaction design and believe exceptional interface craft is fundamental to a great product experience.
  • You are energized by creating coherent design systems that give teams both clear standards and reusable tools to build better products.
  • You enjoy setting a high bar for design quality while helping designers and cross-functional partners consistently meet it.
  • You are excited by the challenge of bringing greater consistency and distinctiveness to experiences spanning web, mobile apps, and emerging platforms.
  • You enjoy working closely with Product and Engineering to turn ambitious ideas into intuitive, accessible, and scalable interfaces.
  • You value the details of typography, layout, interaction, motion, components, and patterns while understanding how those decisions contribute to a broader product experience.
  • You enjoy mentoring designers and strengthening interface-design craft across an organization.
  • You are curious about emerging design practices and AI-enabled tools and thoughtful about where they can improve quality and speed without replacing strong craft and judgment.

How You'll Support the Mission

  • Define and evolve The Post’s UI design language across web, mobile apps, and emerging product surfaces.
  • Establish a clear, high-quality bar for visual design, interaction design, motion, and interface craft.
  • Lead the development, adoption, and governance of a scalable design system in close partnership with Engineering.
  • Establish reusable components, interaction patterns, and standards that enable teams to build cohesive product experiences more consistently and efficiently.
  • Review and improve the quality of major product experiences from early concepts through launch, providing clear craft direction and feedback.
  • Partner with Product Management to translate product strategy and customer needs into intuitive, distinctive interfaces.
  • Partner with Engineering to ensure the design system is practical to implement, accessible, scalable, and able to evolve with the product.
  • Work closely with Content Design and newsroom partners to ensure interfaces reflect the quality, authority, and distinctiveness of The Post’s journalism.
  • Mentor and develop designers, strengthening visual and interaction-design craft across the organization.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify inconsistent experiences, reduce duplicate design and development work, and improve cohesion across The Post’s product ecosystem.
  • Stay current on interface-design practices, platforms, and tools—including AI-enabled design and development workflows—and determine where they can improve the quality and speed of our work.

The Skills and Experience You Bring


Qualifications

  • Significant experience in product design, UI design, interaction design, or a related discipline, with deep expertise designing high-quality digital product experiences.
  • Demonstrated experience defining or evolving visual design languages, interaction patterns, component systems, or large-scale design systems.
  • Strong visual and interaction-design craft, including expertise in areas such as typography, layout, hierarchy, interaction, motion, responsive design, and component-based interfaces.
  • Experience designing across multiple digital surfaces, including web and mobile applications.
  • Experience leading the development, adoption, or governance of reusable design systems in partnership with Engineering.
  • Demonstrated ability to provide design direction, critique complex product experiences, and raise the quality of work from concept through launch.
  • Experience partnering closely with Product Management and Engineering to translate product strategy and user needs into scalable, technically feasible product experiences.

  • Ability to identify inconsistencies and systemic design problems and translate them into reusable patterns, standards, and scalable solutions.
  • Familiarity with modern product-design and prototyping tools and emerging AI-enabled design or development workflows, with strong judgment about where and how to apply them.

job.title: Program Management Fellow
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post is seeking a Program Management Fellow to define, implement, and continuously improve the operating processes that enable Product and Engineering teams to plan, build, and ship their best work.


This is a senior program-management leadership role focused on the Product and Engineering operating system: the practices, tools, decision rights, and operating rhythms that determine how work moves from strategy and roadmap planning through design, development, launch, and learning. The Program Management Fellow will identify where that system creates friction, strengthen delivery discipline and visibility, and lead improvements that help teams deliver more predictably and efficiently.


Working closely with Product and Engineering leadership, this role will help translate roadmap priorities into executable plans while preserving Product Management's ownership of what we build and why. A central focus will be advancing an AI-enabled development lifecycle, identifying where AI can improve planning, development, testing, documentation, and operational work and embedding effective practices into how teams work.


This position is based in Washington, D.C.


What Motivates You

  • You enjoy solving complex organizational and delivery problems and creating systems that help teams do their best work.
  • You are energized by turning ambitious product roadmaps into clear, executable plans without adding unnecessary process or bureaucracy.
  • You care about improving delivery speed and predictability by addressing root causes rather than simply tracking deadlines.
  • You enjoy connecting work across Product, Engineering, Design, Data, and business teams and helping people navigate complex dependencies and tradeoffs.
  • You are comfortable challenging existing processes and using evidence to determine what should be simplified, standardized, changed, or stopped.
  • You believe strong program management creates clarity and accountability while enabling teams to move faster and make better decisions.
  • You are excited by the potential for AI to fundamentally improve how product and engineering organizations plan, build, test, document, and operate.
  • You enjoy influencing senior leaders and multidisciplinary teams through strong judgment, clear communication, and practical solutions.

How You'll Support the Mission

  • Define, implement, and continuously improve the Product and Engineering operating processes that move work from roadmap through planning, design, development, launch, and learning.
  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership to translate roadmap priorities into clear, executable plans with appropriate sequencing, ownership, and accountability.
  • Establish consistent and effective practices for planning, scoping, sequencing, dependency management, delivery reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Lead program management for high-priority cross-functional initiatives involving multiple Product, Engineering, Design, Data, and business teams.
  • Create clear visibility into commitments, progress, risks, capacity constraints, dependencies, and tradeoffs early enough for teams and leaders to act.
  • Diagnose recurring causes of missed commitments, stalled work, inefficient handoffs, and delivery friction and lead practical changes that address underlying causes.
  • Lead the implementation and adoption of an AI-enabled development lifecycle in partnership with Product and Engineering, embedding effective uses of AI across discovery, planning, design, development, testing, documentation, and operational work.
  • Establish and monitor measures of delivery performance, including predictability, cycle time, throughput, quality, and the impact of process improvements.
  • Lead regular reviews of Product and Engineering operating practices, using delivery evidence and team feedback to determine where processes should be simplified, standardized, improved, or eliminated.
  • Build and strengthen program-management practices that create rigor, alignment, and accountability while avoiding unnecessary process and enabling teams to operate efficiently.

The Skills and Experience You Bring


Qualifications

  • Significant experience in program management, technical program management, product operations, engineering operations, or a related discipline within complex product and technology organizations.
  • Demonstrated experience leading large, complex, cross-functional programs involving Product, Engineering, Design, Data, and business stakeholders.
  • Experience designing, implementing, or materially improving product-development or engineering operating processes at organizational scale.
  • Strong understanding of modern product and software development lifecycles, including planning, scoping, sequencing, dependency management, development, testing, launch, and continuous improvement.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate strategic priorities and roadmaps into clear execution plans, milestones, ownership, dependencies, and decision points.
  • Experience identifying systemic delivery bottlenecks and root causes and leading process improvements that measurably improve execution.
  • Experience establishing and using delivery metrics such as predictability, cycle time, throughput, quality, or comparable measures to evaluate organizational effectiveness.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and influencing skills, with the ability to drive alignment and accountability across teams without relying on direct authority.
  • Strong judgment and the ability to balance delivery rigor, organizational complexity, team autonomy, and the risk of unnecessary process.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate progress, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to senior leaders and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Experience using or implementing AI-assisted workflows, automation, or emerging technologies to improve product development, engineering delivery, or organizational processes.
  • Ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments, identify opportunities for improvement, and lead change from diagnosis through implementation and adoption.

 

Collaboration makes us stronger. That’s why our offices are designed with open layouts, modern technology, and easy access to transportation. With certain exceptions for newsgathering and business travel, we work on-site five days a week.

job.title: Editorial Intern (Spring 2027)
job.description:
AccuWeather’s Digital Team is seeking an Editorial Intern for Spring 2027. Join us in a hands-on newsroom role where you'll help shape daily weather coverage for AccuWeather.com. You’ll collaborate closely with editors and meteorologists to pitch compelling story ideas, research developing weather events, and write digital-first articles that inform and engage our audience. This role offers the opportunity to build real-world newsroom experience, sharpen your writing skills, and learn how data, SEO, and emerging AI tools support modern digital publishing. You’ll also assist with sourcing and clearing user-generated content to help bring impactful weather stories to life across platforms.

This paid internship spans 5 months and requires a commitment of approximately 20 hours per week. Morning and daytime availability is preferred, though some evening hours may be accommodated.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

● Finding and gathering information to pitch timely, weather-related story ideas for AccuWeather.com.

● Writing multiple digital stories per month for publication on AccuWeather.com.

● Conducting source gathering and research to support accurate, compelling weather coverage.

● Using ChatGPT and other AI tools to edit content, test prompts, and optimize stories for digital platforms.

● Sourcing and clearing user-generated content for use in articles and on social platforms.

● Collaborating with editors, meteorologists, and the social team to align coverage across platforms.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

● Pursuing a 4-year Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, Meteorology or a related field that requires experience in writing and research.

● Strong writing, editing, and research skills with attention to accuracy and detail.

● Interest in weather, climate, and science-based storytelling.

● Basic understanding of SEO and digital publishing best practices is a plus.

● Demonstrated ability to be self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working in a fast-paced newsroom environment.

● Must have excellent verbal and written communication skills.

● Must be willing to work occasional evenings or weekends as needed.

 

ABOUT ACCUWEATHER 

AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making.

Billions of people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™ across our consumer digital platforms. AccuWeather.com is the #1 weather destination and one of the top 100 most-visited websites in the world, and our award-winning AccuWeather app delivers detailed real-time forecasts to millions of smartphones.

AccuWeather forecasts also appear on digital signage, in 700 newspapers, are heard on over 400 radio stations, and viewed on 100 television stations. The AccuWeather Network and AccuWeather NOW® reach an audience of over 125 million on cable and streaming platforms including DirecTV, Charter Communications - Spectrum, Verizon, Philo, Frndly TV, Comcast’s Xfinity X1 and Xfinity Stream, Roku, Xumo, Rockbot, LG, and Amazon Freevee.

AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally.

Dr. Joel Myers, Founder and Executive Chairman, established AccuWeather in 1962 and is considered the “father of modern commercial meteorology.” Myers, a leading creative thinker and visionary, has been called “the most accurate man in weather” by The New York Times and has been recognized as one of the top entrepreneurs in American history by Entrepreneur’s Encyclopedia of Entrepreneurs.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity to all applicants and existing employees and we evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity/expression), sexual orientation, age, ancestry, physical or mental disability, marital status, political affiliation, religion, citizenship status, genetic information, veteran status, or any other basis protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.
