job.title: BROADCAST JOURNALIST: ARTS & CULTURE
job.description:
BROADCAST JOURNALIST: ARTS & CULTURE


Aspen Public Radio is a 45-year-old public media organization serving the vibrant Roaring Fork and Colorado River valleys, nestled in the heart of the Rocky Mountains. We seek a sharp, curious, and team-oriented person with a passion for covering the arts. Our culture is friendly and familiar, but we are professional broadcasters with high standards.


Who We Are Looking For:

We seek an experienced broadcast journalist with a strong skill set that includes reporting, writing, producing, and anchoring. We are looking for someone who is, above all, a good reporter and a team player. We also want you to be a strong writer, have solid broadcast production skills, and be comfortable delivering live newscasts and conducting live interviews on the air. Among other duties, you will be covering a fun and interesting beat that is focused on the local arts and culture sector throughout our coverage area, including both hard and soft news related to nonprofits and arts and cultural organizations and events.


On this beat, you will cover major events throughout our coverage region, such as X Games, Aspen Gay Ski Week, Aspen IdeasFest, and the annual Food & Wine Classic; internationally renowned institutions including the Aspen Institute, the Aspen Music Festival and School, and Jazz Aspen Snowmass; vibrant local arts organizations such as Carbondale Clay Center, The Performing Arts Center at Willis (TACAW), Aspen Words, the Anderson Ranch Arts Center, and countless other events and organizations large and small.


This broadcast journalist will join a growing team, under the direction of News Director Sage Smiley, responsible for bringing ideas forward that advance how the power of radio can be used to tell meaningful stories. You are a multitasker, able to work on in-depth stories and breaking news pieces simultaneously, and you care deeply about connecting with our unique community in a way that continually improves our public service to our community’s diverse stakeholders.


As a small station, every member of our news team is required to support evening breaking news and production duties (one day per week), weekend coverage (approx. once a month), and take substitute host shifts as needed. It is also assumed that each beat reporter will have approximately 25% of their coverage responsibilities held for general assignment.


Duties:

  • Produce high-quality, accurate, and ethical reporting.

  • Write and produce daily spot news and weekly features and interviews, including twice-monthly nonprofit spotlight interviews.

  • Cultivate a pool of sources throughout the Roaring Fork and Colorado River valleys.

  • Produce digital content for our website and social media channels.

  • Anchor morning and afternoon newscasts, as needed.

  • Serve as local show producer for Morning Edition and All Things Considered.

  • Participate in the production of live events.

  • Maintain a local Arts & Culture event calendar in collaboration with hosts and administrative staff.

  • Work with the news director and regional NPR editors to nationalize local stories.

  • Participate in training and workshops to continue honing your craft and skills.

  • Attend donor and station events and participate in on-air fundraising drives.


Required Qualifications:

  • Solid experience in radio reporting, audio editing and production.

  • Deep knowledge of the ethics and practices of journalism, including AP and NPR styles.

  • Excellent writing and editing skills.

  • Strong time management skills and ability to meet deadlines on a regular basis.

  • Well-practiced collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of nonprofit and arts and culture organizations in the Roaring Fork Valley.

  • On-air anchoring experience (knowledge of the Morning Edition or All Things Considered clocks is also a plus)

  • Understanding of the purpose and mission of public broadcasting.


To apply:

Please send a cover letter, resume, three references, and two to three audio reporting examples to jobs@aspenpublicradio.org with “Arts and Culture Reporter” in the subject line.

Application review will begin Monday, November 23, 2026. You may address the application to News Director Sage Smiley; position open until filled. No phone calls, please.

This is a full-time salaried position reporting to the Aspen Public Radio news director, requiring

availability for day, evening, weekend, and holiday shifts. It is required that this employee be a year-round resident in the Roaring Fork Valley. Aspen Public Radio offers full-time staff benefits including 100% employer-paid health insurance, paid vacation, and a 403(b) match. Ski pass financing and rapid transit bus pass financing are available.

Salary is $65,000.

Aspen Public Radio is an equal opportunity employer.

job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

About the role

As a Senior Accountant, you will combine general ledger accounting and month-end close responsibilities with financial planning and analysis. You will help ensure our financial results are accurate and well-controlled while translating data into clear insights that support business planning. Reporting to the Manager of Financial Accounting, you will partner with accounting teams, business managers, and operational leaders across our company. You will operate in a hybrid role requiring three days per week in our Norfolk, Virginia Shared Services Center office.

Responsibilities:

Accounting and Close

  • Partner with operational managers to prepare and process month-end journal entries, apply appropriate accounting treatment to transactions, and record entries in the general ledger.
  • Perform and support account reconciliations reviews of complex general ledger accounts. Assess account composition and validity, investigate unusual results, and resolve inconsistencies.
  • Contribute to the monthly close, including monthly income statement analysis and quarterly balance sheet analysis; research variances and coordinate resolution with relevant partners.
  • Respond to business-unit questions on general accounting and financial systems, and provide clear guidance on accounting processes and requirements.
  • Maintain accurate, well-documented accounting procedures and internal controls.

FP&A and Management Reporting

  • Support the development and refresh of budgets and forecasts for assigned areas; collect and review inputs, compare actual results with plan, and explain important variances and goals.
  • Assemble and summarize financial information for management. Develop reports, presentations, analyses, and recommendations that make complex data useful for decision-making.
  • Partner with business leaders to understand their goals, financial drivers, and information needs, and provide support.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in Accounting or Finance

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Active CPA license, MBA, or MS in Finance/Accounting.
  • Experience with media, subscription-based businesses, or digital transformation environments.
  • Proficiency with enterprise ERP systems (e.g., Workday, SAP, Oracle) and advanced financial modeling tools.

job.title: Visual Editor, Special Projects
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

Projects & Initiatives is a newsroom team dedicated to telling stories and serving audiences using innovative reporting and packaging techniques, sometimes sustained by commercial, nonprofit or other funders and advertisers. We prioritize projects that generate broader learnings for the newsroom, whether through new visual formats, audience engagement or reporting techniques.

This desk serves as a nexus between the newsroom, the business side, Research and Development (R&D) and our subbrands, aligning ambitions, priorities and major opportunities across these groups.

Recent examples of the team’s work include explorations of pasta tourism, the hidden LGBT history of Harlem, the scary future of New York flooding and the wildly popular series about the mathematics of everyday life. 
You will lead and coordinate large-scale and quick-turnaround visual projects that align with this mission. You bring an entrepreneurial mindset, strong journalistic and digital instincts, and the diplomatic skills to unite disparate groups while upholding Times values and our evolving visual storytelling.

Journalistic judgment, creativity and meticulous attention to detail are essential, as is a proven record of publishing ambitious work, collaborating across teams, and translating story ideas into compelling visual concepts and vice versa.

This is an in-office position based in New York and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance.

Responsibilities:
  • Conceive, commission and edit special projects in a variety of story forms.
  • Lead and coordinate large-scale and quick-turnaround visual projects that align with the Special Projects mission and incorporate opportunities for technological experimentation.
  • Serve as a nexus between the newsroom, the business side, R&D and subbrands, aligning ambitions, priorities and major opportunities across these groups.
  • Engage with business and advertising colleagues on confidential commercial partnerships and weigh commercial interests as a feature of the presentation of editorial content
  • Work in partnership with freelance staff, visual journalism desks, other newsroom departments, the R&D team and outside organizations to deliver ambitious visual projects.
  • Manage the work of staff and freelance reporters, among other contributors.
  • Work with Projects and Initiatives’s leadership to shape editorial ideas into visual and multimedia story opportunities.
  • Act as a point person/project manager for multimedia projects, calling meetings, setting deadlines, providing feedback and supporting development.
  • Collaborate closely with editors on other desks, as well as video, photo and graphics editors, designers and art directors across the newsroom.
  • Help drive the desk to create new digital experiences and story forms.
  • Guide the team toward greater fluency when it comes to conceptualizing, editing and executing new story forms.
  • Show strong editorial judgment, working with Times editors, standards and legal department for ethical and legal questions.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.
  • You will report to a Deputy Managing Editor.
Basic Qualifications:
  • 7+ years of editing experience in a newsroom environment, with a focus on visual journalism.
  • Substantive experience within one of the following visual journalism disciplines: Design, Information graphics, Video journalism or Photojournalism.
  • Demonstrated ability to conceive and create compelling stories that incorporate video, photography, text and audio.
  • Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong editorial judgment and design sensibility with a proven ability to translate editorial priorities into compelling and/or innovative multimedia storytelling
  • Knowledge of Adobe Photoshop and Premiere.
  • Technical and visual resourcefulness, including the ability to assess the relevance of emerging technologies to our journalism and their potential for strong journalistic outcomes.
  • Entrepreneurial and strategic mindset, with strong journalistic and digital instincts.
  • Deep understanding of the values of Times journalism and of our evolving visual storytelling.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Management experience
  • Willingness to work a flexible schedule as news demands
  • A passion for journalism across coverage areas
  • Experience meeting deadlines and to adapt to change in a daily, unpredictable news production environment.
  • Exceptional organizational and diplomatic skills to bring together disparate groups

job.title: Senior / Staff Software Engineer, Data Infrastructure
job.description: About Suno We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA). About the Role Suno is growing fast, and we’re hiring Staff and Senior Software Engineers to build and scale the foundational systems that power our data platform and personalized recommendations. You’ll design and operate infrastructure that ingests, processes, and serves PBs of data, helping connect listeners with music they love while supporting analytics, experimentation, and machine learning across the company. This is a high-impact, senior role at the intersection of Data Infrastructure and ML. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Data, and ML teams to build the pipelines, feature infrastructure, and low-latency data services that power recommendations and music discovery. Your work will help turn user interactions and content signals into reliable, fresh data for model training and real-time personalization. As Suno grows, you’ll help define the long-term architecture of our data platform, balancing scalability, reliability, latency, and cost. You’ll build systems that are observable and easy to extend, enabling teams to experiment quickly and improve how people discover and engage with music. You’ll own major systems end to end, from design through production operation, and drive architecture and technical direction across teams. Check out the Suno version of this role here: https://suno.com/s/yt9eiMi9aj0rmGX6 What You’ll Do Build and scale the data infrastructure behind personalized recommendations and music discovery, working closely with ML and product engineers. Design streaming pipelines that transform user interactions and content signals into fresh features for recommendation models. Develop infrastructure for computing, storing, and serving features across offline model training and online inference, with attention to consistency, reliability, and latency. Enable recommendation experimentation through reliable impression and interaction logging, supporting model evaluation and measurement of recommendation quality. Own the architecture and reliability of core streaming and batch infrastructure, using technologies such as Kinesis, Firehose, Lambda, S3, Flink, and Glue. Build and maintain data workflows and orchestration using Dagster, ensuring pipelines are modular, testable, and observable. Partner with backend and product engineers to define event schemas, data contracts, and ingestion patterns from production systems. Improve the reliability and observability of data pipelines through monitoring, alerting, lineage tracking, and automated recovery mechanisms. Optimize pipelines and storage for performance, cost efficiency, and scalability across AWS and Snowflake. Implement infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform) to manage AWS and Snowflake resources in a consistent, reproducible way. Contribute to data platform standards, including schema evolution, data quality enforcement, and pipeline reliability best practices. Lead technical design discussions and help shape the future architecture of Suno’s data platform. Mentor other engineers and raise the bar for engineering quality, reliability, and maintainability. What You’ll Need 7+ years of relevant experience in software engineering, data infrastructure, or distributed systems. Strong programming skills, preferably in Python, and experience building and operating production-grade distributed systems. Deep experience building and operating real-time streaming and batch processing systems. Experience building data or serving infrastructure for recommendations, personalization, search, or similar ML-powered product experiences. Understanding of feature computation, online/offline data consistency, and the latency and freshness requirements of production ML systems. Experience with streaming and cloud data infrastructure, such as Flink, Kinesis, Kafka, or equivalent technologies. Experience designing reliable, observable systems, including monitoring, logging, alerting, and recovery. Strong understanding of data modeling, schema evolution, and data quality. Ability to collaborate closely with ML, data, and product engineering teams, make pragmatic technical decisions, and deliver in ambiguous environments. A strong sense of ownership, with a track record of delivering scalable infrastructure and improving engineering practices. Excitement about music, creativity, and AI, and the infrastructure that helps people create and discover music. Nice to Have Experience with AWS services such as Kinesis, Firehose, Lambda, S3, and Glue. Experience with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse, including performance and cost optimization. Experience with Dagster, Airflow, or similar orchestration frameworks. Experience with dbt for transformations, testing, and modular data modeling. Experience with Terraform or similar infrastructure-as-code tools. Additional Notes Applicants must be eligible to work in the US. This role requires working from our Cambridge, MA or New York, NY office five days per week. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. job.title: Business Supervisor
job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do.

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious!

We are seeking a Business Supervisor to support our Eli Lilly business, helping bring culturally relevant creative work to life for brands that impact people’s health. This role is hybrid and requires 4 days a week in our Brooklyn office, with 1 day remote. 

Position Summary

The Business Supervisor (BS) is the day-to-day client partnership lead, responsible for managing client communication, translating business needs into actionable direction, and ensuring clarity across internal teams. Serving as the critical connection point between Business Leadership and Program Management, the Business Supervisor helps create exceptional client experiences while enabling efficient delivery.

This role operates with guidance while independently managing day-to-day client relationships and workstreams. Business Supervisors build trusted client partnerships, drive alignment across disciplines, proactively manage expectations, and help ensure every engagement is strategically grounded and executionally set up for success.

What You'll Do

Client Partnership & Communication

  • Own day-to-day client relationships and communication across assigned workstreams.
  • Lead routine client meetings, status calls, working sessions, and follow-up communications.
  • Build trust through proactive communication, responsiveness, and thoughtful partnership.
  • Ensure every client interaction is organized, productive, and aligned against business objectives.

Translation & Alignment

  • Translate client needs, feedback, and business objectives into clear direction for internal teams.
  • Partner closely with Strategy, Context, Creative, and Business Directors to develop and refine creative briefs.
  • Ensure cross-functional teams understand priorities, expectations, success metrics, and next steps.
  • Create alignment between client goals and agency recommendations throughout the life of a project.
  • Build a working understanding of the client’s brands, patient audiences, competitive landscape, and business priorities to inform day-to-day client partnership and internal direction.

Creative Development Support

  • Prepare clients for presentations and key decision-making moments.
  • Help articulate strategic and creative rationale in a clear, compelling, and client-ready manner.
  • Anticipate client feedback and guide internal teams on effective responses.
  • Support creative development by ensuring work remains aligned to client objectives, approved strategy, and client-provided medical, legal, and regulatory guidance.

Risk & Expectation Management

  • Proactively identify risks, ambiguities, or changing client needs before they become issues.
  • Manage client expectations through transparent communication and thoughtful problem solving.
  • Resolve day-to-day challenges independently, escalating only when appropriate.
  • Ensure alignment between what clients expect and what teams are prepared to deliver.

Team Contribution & Development

  • Mentor junior Business Leadership team members in client communication, relationship management, and presentation skills.
  • Support Business Directors in strengthening client relationships and identifying opportunities for organic growth.
  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, and positive team environment across disciplines.
  • Model strong judgment, professionalism, and ownership in client-facing situations.

Partnership with Program Management

  • Partner closely with Program Management to ensure alignment between client expectations and delivery plans.
  • Support scope definition by helping clarify client objectives, priorities, and desired outcomes.
  • Maintain awareness of timelines, budgets, and executional progress while allowing Program Management to lead delivery.
  • Work collaboratively to ensure clients receive a seamless experience from strategy through execution.
  • Partner with Program Management and client stakeholders to clarify review requirements, consolidate feedback, and ensure teams understand approval decisions and their implications.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in advertising, marketing, consulting, or related client leadership roles.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted client relationships and manage day-to-day business communications.
  • Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including Strategy, Creative, Production, Context, and Program Management.
  • Ability to balance multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional organization and attention to detail.
  • Experience mentoring junior team members and contributing to a collaborative team culture.
  • Strong understanding of integrated marketing, creative development, and client service best practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience supporting healthcare, pharmaceutical, or other regulated brands is a plus, but not required. Curiosity about the category and an eagerness to learn are valued.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Salary Hiring Range: $83,000 - $100,000

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. bonus, stock options, 401(k) match, etc.)

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.  We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. 

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.  If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for the NY/CA.  As a company, we have a location based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

job.title: Senior Android Engineer - Fan Monetization

Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is a creator-first platform helping artists build and grow their careers by providing them with the most advanced tools, services, and resources. With over 4x the music catalog of every other major streaming platform, spanning 40+ million artists across 190+ countries, SoundCloud is where emerging artists find their sound, hidden gems are discovered, and music culture is shaped in real time.

We are looking for a Senior Android Engineer to join the SoundCloud Fan Monetization team. Our mission is to deepen the connection between fans and creators, building features that enhance how fans engage with and support their favorite artists. In this role, you will operate as part of a truly global team, collaborating regularly with engineers and product partners in London, Berlin, and elsewhere to deliver high-quality mobile experiences. You’ll focus almost exclusively on a modern Jetpack Compose stack, shipping high-impact features to millions of users worldwide.

This role offers a fantastic growth runway. You'll work in a forward-thinking environment that fully embraces AI acceleration to streamline development, while focusing on building clean, intuitive user interfaces.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and scale SoundCloud's fan-facing features across Android, focusing heavily on building clean, responsive UI and features using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose
  • Embrace and utilize advanced AI tools to safely, securely, and responsibly accelerate your coding workflows, code reviews, and testing
  • Partner closely with product, design, and data teams across our international offices (including London and Berlin) to define, build, and iterate on features
  • Participate in feature scoping, product experimentation (A/B testing), analytics integration, and agile delivery to optimize user engagement
  • Engage in code reviews and engineering best practices to maintain a high standard of performance, accessibility, and platform consistency

Experience and Background:

  • 5+ years of experience building Android applications with a solid foundation in Kotlin and a strong familiarity with Jetpack Compose
  • You prefer looking forward; this role focuses entirely on our modern Kotlin/Jetpack Compose components, with no requirement to maintain or refactor legacy Java or outdated architectures
  • Excited about leveraging AI development assistants to optimize your productivity, code quality, and learning
  • Skilled at working within agile, distributed teams, proactively communicating, and breaking down problems into elegant, maintainable code
  • While your primary focus is Android, an openness or curiosity toward occasionally learning or collaborating across other tech stacks—such as iOS, Web, or Backend (Go)—is a welcome plus
  • You love music, mobile products, and the idea of helping creators build closer bonds with their audience

SoundCloud is for everyone. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to our organization; they help us lead what’s next in music by understanding and empowering our creators and fans, no matter their identity. We acknowledge the challenges in the music industry, and strive to influence an inclusive culture where everyone can contribute respectfully and thrive, especially the historically marginalized communities that many of our creators, fans and SoundClouders identify with. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment at SoundCloud for everyone, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, migration background, national origin, age, disability status, or care-giver status.

At SoundCloud you can find your community or elevate your allyship by joining a Diversity Resource Group. Diversity Resource Groups are employee-organized groups focused on supporting and promoting the interests of a particular underrepresented community in order to build a more inclusive culture at SoundCloud. Anyone can join, whether you share the identity or strive to be an ally.

job.title: Graphic Designer
job.description:
Company Information

AEG brings music, sports, and live entertainment together to create moments people remember around the world. Each year, more than 100 million fans experience live events across five continents—from global touring, concerts, and festivals to iconic sports and entertainment destinations.

Through our music division, AEG Presents, one of the world’s leading operators of tours, concerts, and music festivals, we help shape the sound of now. We work with artists at every stage of their careers to bring live music to life, connecting artists with fans on stages around the world.

Headquartered in Los Angeles, AEG Presents is driven by creativity, innovation, and purpose, and powered by people who want their work to show up in the real world.

If you’re ready to help create moments that matter, there’s a place for you here. Because it happens here.

Job Summary

The Graphic Designer is responsible for the creation of branding/marketing assets for print, banner ads, posters, e-cards, digital, social media and other print material. The Graphic Designer is also responsible for print and web design for venues.

Essential Functions

  • Create and update digital assets including but not limited to e-cards, newsletters, posters, banners, invites, flyers and social media accounts.

  • Create ad map and send out to the Talent Buyer and Marketer.
  • Responsible for creating engaging social and print advertisement for shows at various venues directed to the right audience.
  • Designs other assets as needed including but not limited to invitations, merchandise, stickers, and outdoor maps.

job.title: Manager Production- Rocky Mountains
job.description:
Company Information
For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

A Brief Overview The Manager Production advances all event details for all shows. The Production Manager will be responsible for the production team and to set a plan in motion to execute the show as per the agreed terms in the contract. The Production Manager will adhere to a budget to ensure all costs are being tracked and monitored. They will ensure that all the needs of the show and performer are met.

Essential Functions

  • Liaison between venue and artist to ensure all production needs are met and the contract is being adhered to.
  • Work with talent buyer and artist to work out a tour schedule, build offers and create show budget.
  • Work closely with the venue to make sure everything is in working order and that all the show needs are being addressed and met.
  • Responsible for solving any production issues that may arise at any given point in the show timeline.
  • Develop and foster relationships with artist, tour crew, artist management, venues and other important personnel to ensure streamlined communication and successful execution of each show on tour.
  • Set a workable budget for the show and make sure all the expenses are being tracked and are within the limits of spending.
  • Oversee the load in and load out of the show from artists, vendors and all that apply. In addition to managing production crew by interfacing and making production arrangements with local labor vendors, creating production crew schedules, diffusing employee relation situations and conflict resolution, review, approve and submit payroll for production staff.
  • May be responsible for show settlement after the show has concluded. Makes sure that artist(s) and venue are paid accordingly. The Production Manager will also close out the show and submit all pertinent information to accounting.
  • May also be responsible for hiring local labor, rentals and other show needs.
  • May be responsible for production management and logistics at other locations, venues, or projects within the venue as directed.

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS Degree (4-year) In a related field
  • 4-6 years Of related work experience
  • Experience interpreting event contracts and developing accurate production budgets
  • Experience working in music industry preferred
  • Working knowledge of technical aspects of concert production
  • Ability to solve logistical and technical problems including staging, lighting, sound
  • Ability to create and maintain budgets for events
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook); and ability to learn required business systems
  • Previous management experience with an emphasis on resolution management
  • Works well under pressure and in a fast paced environment
  • Must be extremely flexible to work long hours, nights, weekends and holidays

job.title: LN Concerts, Production Coordinator
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

 

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

 

THE JOB

The Production Assistant plays a vital role in supporting the successful planning, execution, and financial administration of live events from pre-production through show settlement. Working closely with Production Managers and cross-functional teams, this position helps coordinate logistics, manage budgets and administrative processes, facilitate communication with vendors and touring personnel, and ensure day-to-day production operations run smoothly. By providing organized, proactive support in a fast-paced environment, the Production Assistant contributes directly to delivering exceptional live event experiences while maintaining operational efficiency and financial accuracy.

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Production Assist(s) with all show related duties prior to on sale date through event completion.
  • Responsibilities to include employee scheduling and payroll, managing vendor rentals, processing invoices and payment confirmation.
  • Prepare show budgets, forecasts, cash reconciliation and show recaps.
  • Settle shows 
  • Assist Production Managers with Expense Reports and any other administrative tasks as needed
  • Schedule and participate in in person meetings and zoom meetings.
  • Facilitate proper interdepartmental communication and organization.
  • Assist and support all production department personnel with job functions as needed.
  • Review show riders to advance office and dressing room touring needs.
  • Work with production manager(s) to procure all necessary show rental items.
  • Liaise backstage directly with tour staff and dressing room coordinators to ensure comfortable working environment.
  • Responsible for procuring all required automobile rentals and coordinating required staff assigned to specific vehicles.
  • Document and record rental vehicle usage i.e. mileage, fuel costs, maintenance, damage etc.
  • Enter Department payroll as outlined by the Production Manager and Payroll Coordinator, develop reports as required.
  • Liaise with local caterer to ensure proper advanced communication between all parties.

 

 

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • 1-3 years of related work experience
  • High school diploma/equivalent or greater
  • Proficiency in Microsoft office preferred
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment

 

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

 

HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)

YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days

WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program

FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support

CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment

OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

 

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. 


Live Nation strongly supports equal employment opportunity for all applicants regardless of age (40 and over), ancestry, color, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), family and medical care leave or the denial of family and medical care leave, mental or physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), marital status, domestic partner status, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, military and veteran status, political affiliation, national origin (including language use restrictions), citizenship, race, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, and gender expression, sexual orientation, intersectionality, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law, rule, ordinance or regulation.

job.description:
Title: Business Operations Analyst
Schedule Format - Location: Hybrid - San Francisco
Pay Information: $77,600- $97,100 Annually 

Position Summary
KQED is seeking a Business Operations Analyst to support the development and optimization of revenue-generating initiatives across the organization. Working with the department head and other stakeholders, they will help identify and build data-driven business cases for new potential revenue streams and improvements to existing ones, develop proofs-of-concept for new products, conduct research to inform strategy, and help monitor the success of the team’s initiatives. There will be opportunity for increased responsibility as the function develops.

This is a deeply cross-functional role ideal for a highly entrepreneurial technical generalist with 2+ years of experience spanning entrepreneurship, software development, AI engineering, consulting, market research, analytics, or finance/investment. 

This is a hybrid position working three days a week in our San Francisco headquarters.

KQED envisions a public media organization with a culture that centers on human dignity, equity, and belonging. This will enable us to better serve and reflect the Bay Area through diverse and inclusive storytelling. 

We value the contributions of marginalized people in society — including Black, Indigenous, and all people of color,  people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people — and we believe that these communities must be centered in the work we do, and we strongly encourage members of these communities to apply.
KQED Code of Ethics  https://www.kqed.org/about/code-ethics

The mission that drives us:
KQED provide citizens of Northern California with a community-supported alternative to commercial media.   We provide citizens with the knowledge they need to make informed decisions; convene community dialogue; bring the arts to everyone and engage audiences to share their stories. We help students and teachers thrive in 21st-century classrooms, and take people of all ages on journeys of exploration- exposing them to new people, places and ideas.

This role will work hybrid between working in KQED's newly renovated headquarters and working remotely. KQED requires employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19.

Essential Functions
•    Conduct research and build business cases for new revenue opportunities 
•    Develop financial models and proofs-of-concept for revenue initiatives 
•    Partner with cross-functional teams to implement and track revenue programs 
•    Analyze audience data and market trends to inform monetization strategies 
•    Create dashboards, reports, and executive presentations on key metrics 
•    Support project planning and financial analysis
•    Document processes and help standardize revenue operations workflows 
•    Assist with vendor evaluation and partnership analysis 
•    Other duties as assigned
 
Candidate qualifications
•    Ideally 2+ years of experience in software development, AI engineering, business analysis, consulting, analytics, finance, or related field 
•    Founder and software development experience are a big plus
•    Experience with market research and data analysis/visualization 
•    Excellent presentation and communication skills 
•    Self-starter with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
•    Detail-oriented with ability to manage multiple projects 
•    Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience 
•    Interest in media and mission-driven work

Physical Demands
•    Ability to lift a minimum of fifteen (15) pounds;
•    Ability to exert maximum muscle force to lift, push, pull or carry;
•    Ability to use abdominal and lower back muscles over time without fatigue;
•    Ability to stand and/or sit for extended periods;
•    Ability to bend, stoop, stretch, twist, sit, and reach;
•    Fine motor skills;
•    Good visual and auditory acuity.

The physical demands described here represent those that an employee must meet to perform the essential functions of this job successfully.

job.description:
Title: Director, Payroll

Schedule Format - Location: Hybrid - San Francisco

Pay Information: $131,915 - $150,000



Position Summary:           

The Payroll Director will oversee accurate, compliant payroll operations for a complex non-profit organization in California. Working closely with both Finance and Human Resources, this role will combine deep technical payroll expertise with hands-on operational skills to oversee end-to-end payroll operations.  In addition, this role will partner closely with cross-functional teams to strengthen controls, resolve issues efficiently, and ensure timely payroll delivery from start to finish. 

KQED envisions a public media organization with a culture that centers on human dignity, equity, and belonging. This will enable us to better serve and reflect the Bay Area through diverse and inclusive storytelling.

KQED provide citizens of Northern California with a community-supported alternative to commercial media.   We provide citizens with the knowledge they need to make informed decisions; convene community dialogue; bring the arts to everyone and engage audiences to share their stories. This role will work hybrid between working in KQED's newly renovated headquarters and working remotely. 

Essential Functions:         
  • Oversee end-to-end payroll operations, ensuring each payroll cycle is completed accurately and on schedule.
  • Manage payroll processing with our PEO while maintaining compliance with applicable wage, tax, and reporting requirements.
  • Oversee payroll calculations involving regular earnings, commissions, and other variable compensation elements.
  • Handle payroll reconciliations and internal control activities to identify discrepancies and drive corrective action.
  • Audit and reconcile employee deferral and employer matching contributions between the payroll and retirement systems to ensure compliance with plan.
  • Continuously streamline workflows to automate manual inputs, reduce processing errors, and scale operations.
  • Partner with Human Resources, Finance, FP&A and business leadership to address payroll questions and support operational needs.
  • Monitor timekeeping inputs and related processes to improve payroll accuracy and reduce processing issues.
  • Use payroll systems and reporting tools, including Excel-based analysis, to investigate exceptions and support decision-making
  • Function as the primary lead for external financial audits, 403(b) retirement audits, worker's compensation audits, and tax authority inquiries. 
  • Maintain strict compliance with state/federal labor laws, wage/hour regulations, garnishments, final pay rules, and non-profit specific tax regulations (e.g., 403(b) rules, minister/clergy tax if applicable, state-by-state withholding). 
  • Act as primary cross-functional liaison across HR, Legal, and Accounting to assess financial and operational implications of contracts.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Knowledge/Experience Required:
 
  • 8-12 years+ of progressive payroll experience, including responsibility for complex payroll operations.
  • Hands-on experience with Payroll systems and strong familiarity with enterprise payroll platforms.
  • Background handling payroll for complex union/non-union employee rules
  • Knowledge of payroll tax administration, year-end processing, reconciliations, audits, and internal controls.
  • Proficiency with time and attendance systems, Microsoft Excel, and other Microsoft Office applications.


Knowledge/Experience Desired:
 
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience will also be considered.

job.title: Copy and Content Executive - TWITCH LAB - Burson
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Burson Creative:

You’ll be joining a creative team that’s been recognized with Cannes Lions, Clios, One Show, New York Festivals, SABER, and PRWeek awards, but more importantly, a team that’s curious, collaborative, and constantly pushing each other to do work that earns attention.

The Creative team works across the full Burson client roster to ideate, develop, and produce earned-first campaigns, building original ideas that cut through culture not just the noise. Our work connects people and brands by digging deeper, imagining more, and creating campaigns and content designed to live anywhere and travel everywhere.

We’ve intentionally brought together a mix of designers, writers, producers, and creators from different backgrounds, cultures, and points of view, because better work comes from diverse voices challenging each other.

We’re looking for people who love what they do, value different perspectives, and are excited to roll up their sleeves to help push our creative even further.

Check out our latest work here. https://www.bursonglobal.com/locations/us/creative-careers-at-burson-us

More about the role:

We are seeking a sharp, multi-talented Copy and Content Executive to join our TWITCH Lab. This hybrid role bridges strategic intelligence and high-impact copywriting, determining where AI can help build quick-turn content solves for real client reputational challenges and writing the critical copy that protects and elevates brand value. 

In this role, you will partner with team members who are analyzing real-time listening data, sentiment trends, and emerging reputational risks to craft and produce tailored messaging across fragmented stakeholder groups (media, employees, investors, regulators, consumers). Utilizing generative AI language models and prompt engineering, you will rapidly generate narrative options and build comprehensive, cross platform content at the speed of reputation. 

What you'll do:

AI-Driven Strategy & Intelligence Integration 

  • Translate Data into Copy: Interpret real-time media monitoring, sentiment analysis, and intelligence inputs to craft compelling copy and content. 
  • Identify AI Use Cases: Proactively identify where AI tools can accelerate strategic analysis, message customization, and audience-targeted content for clients in need of quick-turn solutions. 

Copywriting & Content Development 

  • Content and Copy Writing: Write clear, authoritative, and persuasive copy for largely digital content executions. 
  • Multi-Channel Adaptation: In partnership with account teams, tailor content for specific audiences (investors, internal employees, public media, regulators) while maintaining core brand voice consistency. 
  • AI-Assisted Drafting: Utilize AI writing platforms and customized prompts to rapidly draft, iterate, and create content options within time-challenged environments. 

Collaboration & Quality Control 

  • Accuracy & Tone Ownership: Ensure all written materials adhere to strict brand guidelines, nuance, legal standards, and facts. 
  • Cross-Disciplinary Partnership: Work closely with the Creative Director, designers, and account leads to ensure strategy seamlessly informs visual execution. 

Experience that contributes to success:

  • 3-5+ years of experience in corporate copywriting, strategic planning, or PR communications within an agency or corporate environment. 
  • AI Prompting & Writing Mastery: Demonstrated expertise using generative AI text tools (ChatGPT, Claude, WPP Open tools) to accelerate research, brainstorming, and copy generation. Political campaign experience is considered an advantage in this role. 
  • Exceptional Writing and Design Skills: Proven ability to craft flawless, nuanced, and persuasive copy and content under tight deadlines. 
  • Data & Sentiment Savvy: Comfort working with media listening data, sentiment tools, and audience insights to inform creative briefs. 
  • Agile Communicator: Strong presentation skills and the ability to articulate complex strategic rationale clearly to internal and client stakeholders. 

#LI-FB1

Burson is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. 

Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package; click here for more details: https://mybenefits.wpp.com/public/welcome.

The base salary for this position at the time of this posting may range between:$50,000—$105,000 USD

You belong at Burson:

Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.

At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Burson Creative:

You’ll be joining a creative team that’s been recognized with Cannes Lions, Clios, One Show, New York Festivals, SABER, and PRWeek awards, but more importantly, a team that’s curious, collaborative, and constantly pushing each other to do work that earns attention.

The Creative team works across the full Burson client roster to ideate, develop, and produce earned-first campaigns, building original ideas that cut through culture not just the noise. Our work connects people and brands by digging deeper, imagining more, and creating campaigns and content designed to live anywhere and travel everywhere.

We’ve intentionally brought together a mix of designers, writers, producers, and creators from different backgrounds, cultures, and points of view, because better work comes from diverse voices challenging each other.

We’re looking for people who love what they do, value different perspectives, and are excited to roll up their sleeves to help push our creative even further.

Check out our latest work here. https://www.bursonglobal.com/locations/us/creative-careers-at-burson-us

More about the role:

We are seeking a visionary and agile AI-enabled Creative Director to lead the creative direction for our newly concepted TWITCH LAB—an AI-enabled creative rapid-response capability dedicated to quick turn demands of creative assets requested by our clients. While many of the executions will lean toward digital content and story-telling in the corporate and crisis communication space, the North Star will be able building reputation enhancing content that can move at the speed of machine. Done well, this work will begin to redefine how corporate storytelling can be produced, blending cutting-edge generative AI tools with high-impact human craft. 

As the creative lead of the LAB, you will oversee the conceptualization and execution of quick-turn asset development that could range from ad-like digital content to quick-turn executive videos meant for internal employee campaigns, to infographics to help debunk disinformation in real-time and other multi-channel disciplines. You will partner closely with our senior most account leads, clients, strategic intelligence leads (data and intelligence team members), and extensions of our creative team to create and execute reputation driving content.  

What you'll do:

  • Creative Vision & AI Innovation 

    • Set a new Creative Benchmark: Champion and define the creative standard for the TWITCH LAB, blending technology with earned-first human storytelling. 
    • Rapid-Response Concepting: Lead creative concepting under compressed timelines, driving the production of rapid-response variants across digital, social, video, and executive communications channels. 
    • Oversight of Function and Execution: As a new concept, the Creative Director will oversee the proper use of the Twitch Lab while also tending to the work itself, creating a culture of creatives that seeks to define a new way of corporate story-telling at speed and scale.  

    Governance & Quality Control 

    • Brand Integrity & Compliance: Ensure all outputs uphold client brand standards, visual consistency, and legal/IP compliance. 
    • Ethical AI Leadership: Champion responsible AI workflows, implementing rules for executive likeness protection, synthetic media disclosures, and client data security. 

    Leadership & Stakeholder Consultation 

    • Executive Client Counsel: Present creative concepts and scenario-tested options confidently to C-suite executives, client leaders and internal partners. 
    • Team Leadership & Mentorship: Manage, direct and mentor a multidisciplinary studio team (writers, designers, editors, producers), fostering an environment of continuous learning, experimentation, and speed. 
    • Agency Cross-Collaboration: Integrate the LAB’s output seamlessly with Burson’s broader Creative, Strategy, and Insights & Intelligence (I&I) practices. 

Experience that contributes to success:

  • 8–10+ years of progressive creative leadership experience within an agency, production studio, or corporate communications environment. 
  • AI Competency: Experience and knowledge of generative AI creative tools (text, image, video, voice, and workflow automation). 
  • Reputation & Crisis Savvy: Proven track record of developing high-stakes corporate messaging, crisis responses, executive decks, and brand reputation campaigns. 
  • Portfolio of Excellence: A strong portfolio showcasing innovative visual and narrative campaigns, high-end content execution, and creative leadership. 
  • Agile Leadership: Exceptional ability to remain calm and decisive under high pressure, leading teams effectively during hour-one breaking news events. 
  • Strategic Thinker: Ability to bridge data-driven intelligence with creative execution that earns attention and protects client reputation.

We are seeking a versatile and hands-on Senior Content & Motion Creative to join our TWITCH LAB. In this multidisciplinary role, you will be the key visual builder for our AI-enabled rapid-response unit—turning strategic concepts into finished, polished creative work across graphic design, motion graphics, video editing, and camera/photography capture. 

You are a true hybrid creator who thrives in fast-paced environments. Whether directing a run-and-gun executive video shoot, animating rapid-response social infographics, developing leadership decks, or leveraging generative AI tools to generate image and video variants, you deliver work of the highest technical and aesthetic standards under tight deadlines. 

What you'll do:

  • Multidisciplinary Design & Motion Execution 

    • End-to-End Asset Creation: Design and produce a wide variety of visual content including executive video statements, animated infographics, social media content variants, message maps, and C-suite presentation decks. 
    • Motion Graphics & Animation: Create dynamic titles, lower thirds, logo animations, and motion graphics elements using Adobe After Effects and AI animation software. 
    • Video Editing & Post-Production: Edit high-quality corporate video content (sizzle reels, anthem films, interview clips, rapid-response crisis videos) to exact technical specifications. 

    On-Set & Run-and-Gun Content Capture 

    • Camera & Lighting Operation: Direct and execute run-and-gun video shoots, lighting setups, audio recording, and still photography for corporate executives and brand activations. 
    • AI Visual Generation: Integrate cutting-edge AI image and video generation tools into traditional design workflows to accelerate concepting and rapid variant production. 

    Technical & Quality Standards 

    • Spec Sheet & File Management: Ensure all final visual deliverables adhere to channel-specific technical specs, file taxonomies, and brand guidelines. 
    • Platform & Asset Ownership: Assist in managing studio video accounts (Vimeo, Frame.io) and maintaining project asset archives for future editing. 
    • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with the Creative Director, Strategy/Copy leads, and client leaders to deliver cohesive, high-impact creative. 

Experience that contributes to success:

  • 5+ years of experience in video production, motion graphics, graphic design, and camera capture within an agency, media company, or studio environment. 
  • Software Mastery: Expert proficiency across Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and PowerPoint. 
  • Generative AI Visual Experience: Hands-on skill using generative AI image/video tools (e.g., Runway, Midjourney, Photoshop Generative Fill, Firefly) to augment visual production. 
  • Field Production Skills: Solid expertise operating DSLR/Cinema camera systems, lighting, and audio equipment for run-and-gun studio or location shoots. 
  • Outstanding Portfolio/Reel: A strong reel showcasing high-end motion design, crisp video editing, corporate visual design, and social media content. 
  • Agile & Calm Under Pressure: Ability to manage tight deadlines, respond quickly to breaking news events, and maintain attention to detail under pressure.

We are seeking a highly organized, operational powerhouse to serve as Senior Producer/Editor PM for our TWITCH LAB. In this pivotal role, you will own the business operations, client workflow, resource allocation, and project delivery for our AI-enabled rapid-response studio. 

You will manage the end-to-end client experience—navigating strict hour-0 to hour-24 turnaround windows during reputational threats. By bridging account leads, creative specialists, legal/governance partners, and AI platforms, you will ensure seamless production, accurate scoping, and flawless execution across all studio engagements.

Rapid-Response Production & Workflow Management 

  • Spearhead Lab Operations: Manage intake, project scoping, production schedules, and asset delivery pipeline for all Twitch LAB projects. 
  • Full Content Lifecycle Execution: Drive the rapid-response workflow from initial requests to assessment, draft optioning, legal sign-off, and final deployment. 
  • Tool & Platform Management: Oversee project tracking tools (Asana), review platforms (Frame.io, Vimeo), and asset archives, establishing file management and taxonomy standards for the studio. 

Client & Financial Ownership 

  • Account & Client Interface: Serve as the primary operational contact for account leads and clients, clarifying briefs, setting turnaround expectations, and managing scope. 
  • Budgeting & Forecasting: Develop budget estimates, track project utilization, manage out-of-pocket costs, and report financial projections to department leadership. Eventually create best-practice around financial stewardship of this type of creative work and delivery through trial and error across the first 6-8 months of executions. 

Team Leadership & Governance Integration 

  • Resource Optimization: Staff and assign creative and technical talent to incoming briefs, balancing internal core studio resources with shared agency specialists. 
  • Governance Gatekeeper: Ensure legal, IP, security, and synthetic media disclosures are integrated directly into the production workflow without delaying deployment. 
  • Process Evolution: Partner with Creative Operations leads to continually refine studio processes, standard operating procedures, and turnaround benchmarks. 

Experience that contributes to success:

  • 8+ years of experience in creative project management, agency production, or studio operations within a fast-paced environment. 
  • Agile Workflow Expertise: Proven ability to manage rapid-turnaround video, design, and copy projects under tight deadlines and crisis conditions. 
  • Technical Proficiency: High command of project management and asset platforms (Asana, Frame.io, Vimeo, Adobe Creative Cloud workflows, Microsoft Office Suite). 
  • Financial & Scoping Acumen: Strong track record of scoping complex projects, building accurate estimates, and tracking financial performance. 
  • Client & Stakeholder Management: Excellent communication skills with the ability to maintain calm, authoritative leadership when dealing with senior stakeholders during high-pressure situations. 
  • Resourceful Problem Solver: Highly detail-oriented, adaptable, and proactive in solving logistical or operational roadblocks.

job.title: 21GRAMS- Senior Editor
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a Senior Editor—21GRAMS to join our growing team!

21GRAMS, part of Real Chemistry, is a full-service healthcare advertising agency built on the belief that healthcare should feel more human. We combine bold creativity, strategic rigor, and deep scientific understanding to create work that changes behavior, improves outcomes, and makes a meaningful impact on people's lives. Our culture is grounded in collaboration, curiosity, and a shared commitment to doing exceptional work. We believe in being good to each other while pushing ourselves to deliver ideas that move audiences, brands, and healthcare forward.

The Senior Editor maintains quality control of agency deliverables during all stages and is a liaison for the Editorial Department to other colleagues to own and reinforce established standard operating procedures. Grows professional relationships with internal brand team members and works collaboratively to ensure best practices. Performs all functions necessary to keep workflow running smoothly and able to maintain a good level of quality control even with crunched timelines.

This role can be remote within the United States or based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville, NJ, San Francisco, or Carmel, IN.

What you’ll do:

  • Establishes solid working relationships internally and with internal brand team accounts to which they are assigned; proactively and collaboratively engages with Copy, Medical, Account, Art/Studio, and Project Management teams to provide support

  • Is the lead editor for 1 or more accounts

  • Raises a red flag with brand teams and/or senior managers when timelines are too tight, additional resources are needed, or when there is a disruption to normal workflow, among other concerns

  • Maintains oversight for their own jobs to complete them on schedule whether by managing their own time or delegating promptly and responsibly to other resources
  • Supports and reinforces team and agency initiatives established by senior managers
  • Participates in team meetings and contributes to fostering a team mentality
  • Practices a positive “can do” attitude at all times
  • Mentors and trains new and/or junior employees and freelancers

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • Our Company values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I", genuinely resonate with how you work and lead.
  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.
  • You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact.

 

What you should have:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher desirable
  • 2+ years’ experience in medical advertising, medical publishing, and/or medical education, with 0+ years’ experience in medical advertising
  • Expected to be 95%+ billable
  • Advertising, marketing, business, English, or related degree preferred
  • Ability to interact with diverse internal population (e.g., account, creatives, project management)
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (i.e., Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and some Excel) and Adobe, and familiarity with digital routing/commenting platforms, spell-check/auto compare programs
  • Ability to comprehend scientific content and data to ensure accuracy of all claims made by agency or its clients

Pay Range: 105,000-120,000
The anticipated salary range for this position is listed above. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, and internal parity.

In addition to base salary, Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefits package and a variety of programs designed to support our employees' well-being, growth, and success.

Real Chemistry reserves the right to update compensation and benefits programs at any time.

 

Real Chemistry is proud to be Great Place to Work® certified; check out what our people shared about our culture and workplace on our Great Places to Work Profile here.

We believe we can do our best when feeling our best, which is why we’ve put together a benefits program designed to give you the support you and your family need at every stage of life. Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefit program and perks, tailored to your region. Globally, this includes offices in our key markets with free snacks to keep you running all day long, generous holiday and paid time off, options for private medical, dental, and vison plans, and support in saving for the future. Other perks include mental wellness coaching and support and access to more than 13,000 online classes with LinkedIn Learning.  Learn more about our great benefits and perks and search specific offerings in your region at: www.realchemistrybenefits.com.

At Real Chemistry, we believe we're at our best when we're connected. Our Real Hybrid and Regional Teams (Real HART) approach is designed to foster collaboration, learning, innovation, and meaningful relationships while providing flexibility where appropriate. Because our workforce spans multiple countries, regions, and client needs, work arrangements may vary by role and location. Some positions offer hybrid or remote flexibility, while others require regular in-office presence. For example, certain teams and regions, including some of our UK operations, have office-based requirements. Your recruiter will discuss the specific expectations for the role you're pursuing during the interview process and keep you informed throughout the hiring journey. For employees located within a one-hour commute of a Real Chemistry office, we require in-person attendance two days per week, either from a Real Chemistry office or when working onsite with clients. Employees in regions without a nearby office may work remotely and come together throughout the year for collaboration, culture-building, learning, and team connection opportunities. While these guidelines reflect our current workplace model, we understand that everyone’s circumstances are unique. If you require additional flexibility, we welcome an open conversation with your recruiter and our HR team to discuss your needs and determine what may be possible.

Real Chemistry is an Equal Opportunity employer. We continually strive to build and sustain an inclusive and equitable work environment where our employees feel empowered to leverage all they bring from their personal lived experience and professional expertise, to make our team the best in the industry. We encourage motivated and qualified applicants to apply without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, ethnic or national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, marital information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local employment discrimination laws where Real Chemistry operates. Should you require accommodations throughout the interview process please let your recruiter know.

*Notice: Real Chemistry and its affiliates' names are being misused by scammers through messaging services, fake websites, and apps. Do not share personal or financial information or make payments to any unverified sources claiming to be connected to Real Chemistry. We are working to stop these unauthorized activities and protect our community. Read more here.
