job.title: Workplace Services Lead
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Purpose of Role:

Serve as WPP's senior Workplace Services representative across an assigned portfolio, with overall responsibility for stakeholder relationships, workplace outcomes, financial stewardship and alignment with WPP & REWS standards, providing client-side operational governance.

Translate business priorities into workplace requirements and ensure outsourced service providers deliver against WPP standards, financial objectives and contractual commitments. 

Individual Accountabilities:

  • WPP Stakeholder & Business Partnership: Serve as the primary REWS relationship lead for assigned businesses and senior stakeholders, translating business priorities and employee needs into workplace requirements and outcomes.
  • Workplace Strategy & Experience: Ensure workplace services, space and experience align with WPP strategy, utilization objectives, employee needs and global standards. Oversee space planning activities and portfolio optimization initiatives to support effective workplace outcomes.
  • Financial Stewardship: Work with Finance stakeholders to prepare annual budgets and quarterly forecasts for the assigned portfolio, monitoring variances and savings opportunities. Challenge service-provider proposals and ensure spend aligns with approved WPP priorities.
  • Service Provider Governance: Hold outsourced providers accountable for contractual commitments, SLAs/KPIs, financial targets and service outcomes. Challenge performance gaps and ensure corrective action is taken by provider leadership.
  • Risk & Operational Governance: Ensure assigned properties comply with WPP and REWS risk, governance and operational excellence standards. Lead the identification, oversight, management and escalation of material resilience and service risks and incidents, ensuring appropriate governance, incident management and timely resolution across the assigned portfolio.
  • HSSE & Business Continuity Compliance: Compliance with WPP & REWS Health, Safety, Security and Environmental policies and Business Continuity certification process, and other operational standards, partnering with relevant WPP functions and service providers as required.
  • Performance & Insights: Use service-provider reporting, workplace data and stakeholder feedback to assess performance, identify continuous improvement opportunities and inform WPP decision-making.

Role Boundary:

The assigned portfolio may comprise a mix of campus and non-campus locations, requiring the AWSL to apply a flexible and adaptive approach to oversight, governance and stakeholder engagement in line with the evolving REWS operating model.

This is a WPP client-side leadership and governance role.

Day-to-day operational delivery and the direction, supervision and management of service-provider personnel remain the responsibility of the applicable service provider.

Onsite/In office role at one the larger campus locations within respective region.

Competencies, Knowledge and Experience:

Competencies:

  • Strategic Service Provider Relationship: Proven ability to build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with suppliers.
  • Stakeholder Leadership and Business Partnership: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to build strong relationships with stakeholders and understand their needs.
  • Commercial and Contract Governance: Understand contractual commitments, SLAs/KPIs and commercial models to govern provider performance, contract compliance and support WPP decision-making.
  • Leadership: Ability to lead through influence, establish clear client expectations to include stakeholder needs and hold service-provider leadership accountable for agreed outcomes.
  • Digital Dexterity: Ability to leverage workplace data, reporting and technology apply critical thinking to evaluate performance, inform decisions and challenge service-provider outcomes and provide accurate data to the central REWS team as required
  • Collaboration: Excellent ability to work collaboratively with internal teams, service providers, and stakeholders to achieve common goals.
  • Change Management: Lead WPP stakeholder engagement and business adoption associated with workplace change, partnering with service providers and REWS teams on implementation.
  • Strategic Business Acumen: Understanding of the business context and how workplace services contribute to overall organizational goals.
  • Responsible Procurement: Partner effectively with WPP Procurement to support responsible and sustainable supplier governance.
  • Continuous Improvement: Ability to identify opportunities to improve workplace performance through data innovation and best practice.
  • Adaptability and Continuous Learning: Commitment to continuous learning, professional development and the adoption of industry best practices to support the evolving REWS operating model.

 

Key Shared Accountabilities:

  • Working with Global REWS Coe teams to implement global standards and initiatives.
  • Collaborating with ET to ensure seamless technology integration in the workplace.
  • Partnering with HR to support employee well-being and engagement programs.
  • Working with Security to ensure a safe and secure environment.
  • Working with Procurement to ensure any changes or new contracts are routed through to this team.

Key Interfaces:

  • Regional Director REWS (Reporting Line)
  • Regional Procurement
  • Regional PMO
  • Outsourced FM Provider Leadership
  • Food & Beverage Providers
  • Global REWS COE Team
  • ET Department
  • People Department
  • Business Unit Leaders
  • Employees
  • Landlords
  • Sub-Contractors

 

Key Metrics and Targets:

Financial Performance: Performance against approved budgets and savings/value commitments.

  • Service Provider Performance: Performance against agreed contractual SLAs/KPIs.
  • Stakeholder Experience: Business and employee satisfaction with workplace services.
  • Portfolio Effectiveness: Space utilization and alignment with WPP workplace objectives.
  • Governance & Risk: Effective oversight and escalation of material operational , resilience and service risks.
  • HSSE & Business Continuity Compliance: Compliance with WPP and REWS Health, Safety, Security & Environmental (HSSE) standards, Business Continuity Planning (BCP) requirements and associated certification processes across the assigned portfolio.
  • Sustainability: Performance against agreed WPP and REWS sustainability targets across the assigned portfolio, including energy consumption and other applicable environmental commitments.

 

Critical Knowledge & Experience:

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders, build trusted relationships and drive alignment across a complex environment.
  • 5–7+ years in corporate workplace, CRE, workplace experience or outsourced-service governance, preferably within a complex global organization.
  • Bachelor's degree in Facilities Management, Business Administration, or a related field. Relevant professional certifications in workplace, facilities management, corporate real estate or related disciplines are desirable.
  • Demonstrated experience operating as an intelligent client within an outsourced FM environment and holding strategic service partners accountable for performance.
  • Strong financial and commercial acumen, with experience of budget development and forecasting and governing complex service-provider relationships through budgets, contracts, SLAs/KPIs and performance frameworks.
  • Understanding of workplace management systems, reporting and data analytics, with the ability to interpret outputs and use insights to support decision-making, performance management and service-provider governance.
  • In-depth knowledge of HSSE regulations and best practices
  • Strong understanding of workplace strategy, space planning principles and portfolio optimization practices.
  • Experience leading complex workplace, transformation or change initiatives across multiple locations and stakeholder groups.
  • Knowledge of sustainability principles and practices.

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: We are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

 

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Purpose of Role:

Serve as WPP's senior Workplace Services representative across an assigned portfolio, with overall responsibility for stakeholder relationships, workplace outcomes, financial stewardship and alignment with WPP & REWS standards, providing client-side operational governance.

Translate business priorities into workplace requirements and ensure outsourced service providers deliver against WPP standards, financial objectives and contractual commitments. 

Individual Accountabilities:

  • WPP Stakeholder & Business Partnership: Serve as the primary REWS relationship lead for assigned businesses and senior stakeholders, translating business priorities and employee needs into workplace requirements and outcomes.
  • Workplace Strategy & Experience: Ensure workplace services, space and experience align with WPP strategy, utilization objectives, employee needs and global standards. Oversee space planning activities and portfolio optimization initiatives to support effective workplace outcomes.
  • Financial Stewardship: Work with Finance stakeholders to prepare annual budgets and quarterly forecasts for the assigned portfolio, monitoring variances and savings opportunities. Challenge service-provider proposals and ensure spend aligns with approved WPP priorities.
  • Service Provider Governance: Hold outsourced providers accountable for contractual commitments, SLAs/KPIs, financial targets and service outcomes. Challenge performance gaps and ensure corrective action is taken by provider leadership.
  • Risk & Operational Governance: Ensure assigned properties comply with WPP and REWS risk, governance and operational excellence standards. Lead the identification, oversight, management and escalation of material resilience and service risks and incidents, ensuring appropriate governance, incident management and timely resolution across the assigned portfolio.
  • HSSE & Business Continuity Compliance: Compliance with WPP & REWS Health, Safety, Security and Environmental policies and Business Continuity certification process, and other operational standards, partnering with relevant WPP functions and service providers as required.
  • Performance & Insights: Use service-provider reporting, workplace data and stakeholder feedback to assess performance, identify continuous improvement opportunities and inform WPP decision-making.

Role Boundary:

The assigned portfolio may comprise a mix of campus and non-campus locations, requiring the AWSL to apply a flexible and adaptive approach to oversight, governance and stakeholder engagement in line with the evolving REWS operating model.

This is a WPP client-side leadership and governance role.

Day-to-day operational delivery and the direction, supervision and management of service-provider personnel remain the responsibility of the applicable service provider.

Onsite/In office role at one the larger campus locations within respective region.

Competencies, Knowledge and Experience:

Competencies:

  • Strategic Service Provider Relationship: Proven ability to build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with suppliers.
  • Stakeholder Leadership and Business Partnership: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to build strong relationships with stakeholders and understand their needs.
  • Commercial and Contract Governance: Understand contractual commitments, SLAs/KPIs and commercial models to govern provider performance, contract compliance and support WPP decision-making.
  • Leadership: Ability to lead through influence, establish clear client expectations to include stakeholder needs and hold service-provider leadership accountable for agreed outcomes.
  • Digital Dexterity: Ability to leverage workplace data, reporting and technology apply critical thinking to evaluate performance, inform decisions and challenge service-provider outcomes and provide accurate data to the central REWS team as required
  • Collaboration: Excellent ability to work collaboratively with internal teams, service providers, and stakeholders to achieve common goals.
  • Change Management: Lead WPP stakeholder engagement and business adoption associated with workplace change, partnering with service providers and REWS teams on implementation.
  • Strategic Business Acumen: Understanding of the business context and how workplace services contribute to overall organizational goals.
  • Responsible Procurement: Partner effectively with WPP Procurement to support responsible and sustainable supplier governance.
  • Continuous Improvement: Ability to identify opportunities to improve workplace performance through data innovation and best practice.
  • Adaptability and Continuous Learning: Commitment to continuous learning, professional development and the adoption of industry best practices to support the evolving REWS operating model.

 

Key Shared Accountabilities:

  • Working with Global REWS Coe teams to implement global standards and initiatives.
  • Collaborating with ET to ensure seamless technology integration in the workplace.
  • Partnering with HR to support employee well-being and engagement programs.
  • Working with Security to ensure a safe and secure environment.
  • Working with Procurement to ensure any changes or new contracts are routed through to this team.

Key Interfaces:

  • Regional Director REWS (Reporting Line)
  • Regional Procurement
  • Regional PMO
  • Outsourced FM Provider Leadership
  • Food & Beverage Providers
  • Global REWS COE Team
  • ET Department
  • People Department
  • Business Unit Leaders
  • Employees
  • Landlords
  • Sub-Contractors

 

Key Metrics and Targets:

Financial Performance: Performance against approved budgets and savings/value commitments.

  • Service Provider Performance: Performance against agreed contractual SLAs/KPIs.
  • Stakeholder Experience: Business and employee satisfaction with workplace services.
  • Portfolio Effectiveness: Space utilization and alignment with WPP workplace objectives.
  • Governance & Risk: Effective oversight and escalation of material operational , resilience and service risks.
  • HSSE & Business Continuity Compliance: Compliance with WPP and REWS Health, Safety, Security & Environmental (HSSE) standards, Business Continuity Planning (BCP) requirements and associated certification processes across the assigned portfolio.
  • Sustainability: Performance against agreed WPP and REWS sustainability targets across the assigned portfolio, including energy consumption and other applicable environmental commitments.

 

Critical Knowledge & Experience:

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders, build trusted relationships and drive alignment across a complex environment.
  • 5–7+ years in corporate workplace, CRE, workplace experience or outsourced-service governance, preferably within a complex global organization.
  • Bachelor's degree in Facilities Management, Business Administration, or a related field. Relevant professional certifications in workplace, facilities management, corporate real estate or related disciplines are desirable.
  • Demonstrated experience operating as an intelligent client within an outsourced FM environment and holding strategic service partners accountable for performance.
  • Strong financial and commercial acumen, with experience of budget development and forecasting and governing complex service-provider relationships through budgets, contracts, SLAs/KPIs and performance frameworks.
  • Understanding of workplace management systems, reporting and data analytics, with the ability to interpret outputs and use insights to support decision-making, performance management and service-provider governance.
  • In-depth knowledge of HSSE regulations and best practices
  • Strong understanding of workplace strategy, space planning principles and portfolio optimization practices.
  • Experience leading complex workplace, transformation or change initiatives across multiple locations and stakeholder groups.
  • Knowledge of sustainability principles and practices.

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: We are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

 

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

#LI-Hybrid 

The base salary range for this position at the time of this posting is indicated below. Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package, go to https://mybenefits.wpp.com/public/welcome for more details. 

.$100,000—$230,000 USD

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

job.title: Resource Specialist, Scheduling (On Call) (French Services) (On Site)
job.description:
Position Title:

Status of Employment:

Temporary Short-Term (Durée déterminée)

Position Language Requirement:

Language Skills:

Work at CBC/Radio-Canada

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance. 
 
Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

Unposting Date:

2027-01-31 11:59 PM

Your role


CBC/Radio-Canada is currently seeking a Resource Specialist to work in the newsroom on planning the human and technical resources required for all our radio, television and web productions. This posting is for backfill purposes for occasional work. This is an on call position.


You will be responsible to plan, organize and provide staff, schedules, facilities, and equipment needed for content production, in keeping with program constraints and requirements. They will also oversee schedule coordination and team assignment, aiming for efficient and cost-effective use of human/physical resources.


More specifically, you will plan for, select, organize, acquire or provide staff, facilities, and materials needed to produce programs or program segments. Planning responsibilities include pre-production, production, and post-production, following through to format and telecast requirements. General direction is provided but there is latitude for and an expectation of independent judgment and initiative. You will work on multiple projects at once with constant interruption, and you must meet critical deadlines within a live and recorded TV/radio/web segment. Tact and diplomacy are essential, as decisions must satisfy the needs of several stakeholders with varying priorities.


Key Tasks:

  • With senior managers, producers, unit managers and technical directors, contribute to long- and short-term planning for productions by attending meetings or receiving specific requests. 
  • Provide advice on cost saving and other possible advantages to clients. 
  • Resolve conflicting resource requests.
  • Identify and obtain the appropriate staff, facilities, materials and services for any given production. In so doing, ensure that resources are available when required. 
  • Provide an overview of all production activities and recommend corrective action to accommodate timeline changes or the needs of new and additional productions.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of all collective agreements and corporate policies.

This role requires full-time on-site presence.


We are looking for a candidate with the following: 

  • College graduate from a broadcasting program or equivalent TV broadcasting experience.
  • Minimum of five (5) years relevant experience demonstrating a solid understanding of the television/radio/web production processes is an asset.
  • Knowledge of ScheduAll and iNews software is an asset.
  • Mastery of the functionalities of the Google suite.
  • Strong leadership skills; able to work without supervision; highly tactful, well organized; very motivated self-starter.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Able to come up with creative solutions and assist in developing innovative procedures to ensure collaborative and responsive service.
  • Able to work alone as part of a team, under pressure and with tight deadlines.
  • Able to efficiently collaborate and develop synergy with various partners and clients, with a view to providing service adapted to production needs and expectations, while also aiming for cost savings and efficient use of human and material resources.
  • Able to manage multiple projects and priorities at once, while reacting and responding to the needs of clients, colleagues, employees, etc., in a timely and efficient manner.
  • Able to create accurate database records and update existing records.
  • Service-oriented outlook.
  • Bilingual (French and English) mandatory (CCC); able to communicate easily in spoken and written form.
  • Available to work various shifts and on rotation, both weekdays and weekends, as required.
  • Technical TV and radio knowledge are an asset.
  • Good familiarity with programming on all (TV-radio-web).

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.
 
We thank all applicants for their interest, but only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.
 
CBC/Radio-Canada is committed to being a leader in reflecting our country’s diversity. That’s because we can only create and tell the stories that connect Canadians, by having a workforce that mirrors the ever-changing makeup of our country. That’s why we, as an employer, value equal opportunity and nurture an inclusive workplace where our individual differences are not only recognized and valued, but also extend to and pervade all the services we provide as Canada’s public broadcaster. For more information, visit the Diversity and Inclusion section of our website. If you have accommodation needs at this stage of the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible by sending an e-mail to recruitment@cbc.ca.
 
You are invited to consult and familiarize yourself with our Code of Conduct, which can be found on our corporate website. All employees must adhere to the Code as a condition of employment. We also invite you to take a look at our policy on conflicts of interest. In the event that you become an employee, it will be important to inform us, as quickly as possible, of any situation that, because of your hiring, constitutes or could appear to constitute a conflict of interest.

Primary Location:

181 Queen Street, Ottawa, Ontario, K1P 1K9

Work Schedule:

Part time

job.title: Network Administrator II (Remote)
job.description: At Connoisseur Media, technology powers everything we do—from keeping our radio stations sounding their best to connecting technologies across markets, and ensuring our teams have the tools they need to create great content and serve our communities. We’re looking for a Network Administrator II to join our IT team, specializing in systems at the intersection of Information Technology and Radio Engineering (non-RF/Broadcast Engineering) across the company. In this remote position, you’ll play a critical role in providing high-level technical support. The ideal candidate is a strong troubleshooter with excellent customer service skills, a passion for technology, and the ability to support everything from broadcast automation systems to network and systems infrastructure. If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, collaborating with colleagues across multiple locations, and working in a fast-paced media environment, this is an exciting opportunity to make a meaningful impact at a growing media company. Responsibilities: Provide operational and technical support for core radio automation systems, including Wide Orbit, RCS Zetta, and Nexgen. Configure, install, and maintain network and firewall equipment such as routers, firewalls, and managed switches. Diagnose hardware and software failures, communicate remediation plans to users, and provide status updates. Support proprietary and 3rd-party applications used across the organization. Develop, maintain, and contribute knowledge to internal documentation, diagrams, IT, and Engineering SOPs and training manuals. Maintain a professional attitude and appearance, providing excellent customer service at all times, and building effective working relationships with internal customers and team members. Utilize strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities to prioritize and manage multiple tasks and meet service-level agreements (SLAs). Demonstrate self-motivation and adaptability to learn new technologies, work effectively both independently and in a team, and remain flexible in a fast-paced environment. Support continuous improvement in the process and quality of the operations. Perform any other duties assigned by the Director of IT or the Director of Engineering. Qualifications: Required Technical Skills & Experience: 5+ years of professional experience in Systems Administration on the Windows platform, including user/security management, file system administration, and patch management. (Familiarity with Linux is a plus). 5+ years managing and remediating endpoint protection and security systems. 3+ years of experience configuring and maintaining business-class networking equipment, including: Firewalls (NAT/PAT, routing, access rules, VPNs). Managed switches and VLANs. Strong working knowledge of radio broadcast automation systems such as Wide Orbit, RCS Zetta, and Nexgen. Additional Experience Considered A Plus: Experience with Google Workspace management. Experience maintaining Help Desk/RMM platforms (e.g., Zendesk, N-Central MSP). Experience with broadcast media-specific hardware and software. Proficiency in technical diagramming tools (e.g., Microsoft Visio). General Requirements: Excellent oral and written communication skills, with a focus on great customer service and interfacing with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to work remotely, under pressure, and meet strict deadlines. A company computer will be provided. Ability to be on-call after hours on a rotation schedule. Willingness to travel is a plus. Preferred: Applicants in the Eastern Time Zone who are willing to work early hours. Salary Range: $55k - $65k DOE Benefits: Connoisseur invests in people who invest in themselves and offers employees a competitive package of health and welfare benefits. Comprehensive Benefits Package: Medical, Dental, and Vision. Supplement Life Insurance, AD&D Coverage, STD, and LTD coverage. Paid Time Off: 17 PTO days and 10 company holidays. 401(k) Retirement Plan: Employer matching to support your future financial goals. Employee Assistance Program: Free support services for you and your household. Discover Your Passion at Connoisseur! We are Connoisseur Media, a broadcast and digital media company serving audiences, advertisers, and local communities. Recognized as one of the top 10 radio broadcasters in the U.S., we operate 182 radio stations in 40 markets and run a growing digital marketing business. From music and news to community events, we create media that matters. Through Connrex Digital, we help brands thrive with smart strategies, engaging stories, and expert PR. At our core, people are our passion and the heart of the Company, and we’re proud to be community-minded, with employees who love getting involved and making a difference. job.title: Marketing Consultant
job.description:
Marketing Consultant

#26-1343

Alexandria, Minnesota, United States

Apply

Business Unit

HBI Radio Alexandria

Employee Classification

Full Time Regular

About Us

Hubbard Radio is a full-service media company with 16 radio stations and cutting-edge digital solutions in four of northern Minnesota's most beautiful and active resort communities: Alexandria, Bemidji, Brainerd and Wadena. At Hubbard, we're looking for the best people in local media to help build dominant brands that connect consumers and advertisers to build better businesses and communities. We succeed by always doing the right thing with focus, urgency, and passion.

Job Overview

The Marketing Consultant is responsible for selling advertising to clients and developing new business relationships by prospecting, developing and selling new direct-business accounts, making sales presentations, performing collections, maintaining client relations and sales.

Job Responsibilities

Meet and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets including spot, digital, and new direct business. Prospect new businesses on a weekly basis.

Prepare and complete sales presentations with decision makers.

Make presentations to include a customer needs analysis, research and supporting documentation, and creative business solutions.

Follow up and close all pending business in a timely manner.

Update General Manager weekly on progress of pending business.

Work closely with other departments in creating effective promotional sales solutions for clients.

Create and make presentations to agency personnel, including selling and pre-selling the station audience attributes.

Provide exceptional customer service to direct and agency accounts. Personally contact each active account regularly- defined as an in-person meeting, including the presentation of pertinent sales information.

Obtain credit approval for new accounts.

Ensure all accounts are paid in a timely manner. Follow up and assist in the collection process for past due accounts.

Utilization of and proficiency with Sales software.

Attend special events, such as remotes and broadcasts, which involve clients. These events may occur after business hours and on weekends.

Complete all written business requirements within established deadlines. These requirements include but are not limited to: forecast reports, pending business updates, written orders and advertising copy.

Attend and participate in weekly sales staff meetings, individual meetings with manager and other necessary meetings and training as required by management.

Have a thorough understanding of rates, promotions, inventory, and personnel. Continue to learn and stay abreast of trends in digital and broadcast advertising industry.

Maintain regular, reliable attendance.

Work cooperatively and collaboratively with others. Build working relationships with co-workers, customers, vendors and the general public.

Complete other duties as requested and needed.

Qualifications

Previous sales, advertising, digital sales, or media experience preferred

Knowledge of, and familiarity with, (or ability to learn) broadcasting and digital terminology and methodology preferred.

job.title: MEDIA EXECUTIVE - WTVY
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WTVY:

WTVY News4 is the #1 local media organization producing news, weather, and original content for the Wiregrass region of Alabama, Florida, and Georgia. Located in downtown Dothan, AL, WTVY has been the area's favorite local broadcaster since 1955. News4 takes pride in our winning culture and reputation as the "Hometown News Leader". Leadership is about more than being the most popular. Come see how we're embracing our responsibilities to promote prosperity in the Wiregrass for all. Experience the energy of Dothan's impressive economic growth, while still enjoying a very comfortable cost of living.

Job Summary/Description:

A Media Executive at WTVY represents our brand to a community of local clients, advertising agencies, and the general public. You are a business partner and consultant providing media planning and creative strategy support to help local businesses meet their goals. This role offers work schedule flexibility and independence to those who perform at the highest levels, as well as significant compensation opportunities.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

- Manage and grow a list of clients by helping them meet their business goals through advertising with our #1 local media organization featuring a variety of broadcast and digital ad products.
- New business development through a variety of marketing tactics to introduce our products to local businesses and advertising agencies.
- Deliver exceptional customer service by connecting with clients frequently to monitor their advertising results and celebrate their success or quickly problem-solve as necessary.
- Meet monthly, quarterly, and annual budget goals, as well as driving the success of sales programs thoughout the year.
- Assist with billing and payment collections, as needed.
- Learn WTVY best practices and Gray Television training recommendations to help introduce new products to the market.

Qualifications/Requirements:

- The ideal candidate is a personable and convincing communicator who enjoys finding ways to help local businesses grow.
- Local media sales experience is preferred, but training resources are available to help the right individual get up to speed quickly on selling multi-platform media products.
- A competitive drive combined with a collaborative attitude is welcome on our team.
- Initiative is an absolute requirement.
- Knowledge of Wide Orbit & Matrix is a plus.

job.description:
The Leavenworth Packaging Specialist performs a variety of hand-oriented duties that may include any or all of the following:  unloading product (cards, packages, etc.) from a conveyor, table, etc. and placing on a skid, in stock boxes, on fixtures or cartons.  May pull and grip cards from a large sheet or single levels.  May scrap material from large sheets or one-up cards.  May feed batch heads or operate manual equipment.  May assist in production of envelopes by tending the press, feeding envelope blanks and boxing completed envelopes.  May set up and operate label machines to provide a variety of printed labels.  Incumbent is responsible for assisting with make ready, checking for production quality, preventive maintenance and handling required paperwork. 

 

Responsible for reporting production related information and cleaning the equipment and work area. May assemble and pack various display units. May read and follow store floor plans and merchandising instructions. Positively participates in performance dialogues and other team problem-solving activities to effectively influence how we will accomplish the department goals within shorter periods of time.  Flexibility is key as the incumbent will be expected to learn and perform multiple assignments within this job classification and may be assigned to multiple departments.

 

In this position you will:

  • Assist with all aspects of the different assignments with a focus on cross-training between departments.  Assist with make-readies and inspect cards. 
  • Assist the operator with maintaining specified production, such as throughput, OEE, etc., by placing cards/stock onto flat skid or in carton boxes or pack wholesale unit into cartons.  Feed envelope blanks, pack envelopes into cartons, stack cartons on a pallet and maintain specified production.
  • Execute Quality System including preflight, checking products for accuracy, sampling plan, and the removal of salvage/spoilage by using a guide, shop sample or other approved methods.

job.description:
HALLMARK – Because Connecting With Each Other Has Never Been More Important

We are seeking a dedicated Materials Movement Specialist to join our Warehouse Department at the Leavenworth Production Facility. Individuals in this role are responsible for transporting stock and recycled materials between the warehouse and production areas, supporting the seamless flow of materials essential to our operations.

As a Materials Movement Specialist you will:

  • Operate a variety of material movement equipment and attachments, including sit-down/stand-up propane and electric-powered forklifts, roll clamps, box clamps, push/pull slipsheeters, and hi-bay reach trucks.
  • Load and unload incoming and outgoing trailers, and move pallets on and off conveyors using freight elevators as needed.
  • Locate stock in the warehouse and fill manufacturing orders using powered equipment.
  • Operate corrugate and paper balers to compress recyclable materials into bales, and transport hazardous waste in accordance with Federal, State, and Local regulations.
  • Complete all documentation related to stock movement accurately and efficiently.
  • Coordinate with recycling and other contractors for the pick-up and delivery of storage containers and trailers.
  • Perform preventive and scheduled maintenance on balers and power equipment.
  • Demonstrate flexibility by moving to different work assignments as needed and learning multiple tasks within the job classification.
  • Participate positively in performance dialogues and team problem-solving activities, proactively identifying and resolving issues.
  • Communicate effectively with outside vendors and other departments.
  • Utilize good safety practices at all times.

The ideal candidate is:

  • Certified to operate forklifts and other power equipment, or able to obtain certification.
  • Skilled in preparing materials and supplies for shipment using banding equipment, power saws, drills, film wrappers, and string ties.
  • Flexible and a strong team player, able to adapt to changing assignments and priorities.
  • Effective in communication, both with internal teams and external vendors.
  • Committed to safety, with a strong understanding of PPE requirements and hazardous material handling.
  • Organized, with good planning skills to manage workflow and set up work areas efficiently.
  • Able to learn and retain new knowledge, and practice excellent customer service.

 

This position is on 2nd Shift (3:30pm – 12:00am).

 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent.
  • Ability to frequently move materials weighing 35 pounds and occasionally lift up to 50 pounds from the floor.
  • Ability to stand and walk approximately 95% of the time.
  • Ability to frequently push, pull, twist, bend, and reach above shoulder level.
  • Ability to obtain forklift certification.
  • Ability to work overtime as needed.

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Current forklift certification or certification held within the past 12 months.
  • Good math, written, and oral communication skills.

  • Ability to reorganize and change directions as necessary.
  • Understanding and adherence to established safety procedures for PPE and hazardous chemicals.
  • Strong planning and organizational skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn and retain knowledge.
  • Commitment to good customer service.

job.description:
Hallmark is seeking a Print Apprentice at our Leavenworth Manufacturing Facility in Leavenworth, KS. The Print Apprentice will gain print experience by assisting on a team or operating equipment in the print department. The print apprentice will operate a variety of medium complexity equipment to tint tissue paper with a solid color of ink or to slit/rewind printed gift wrap. They assist on a team to print gift wrap on a wide web flexography press and learn the basics of flexographic printing. They will also learn how to mix inks and may work in the ink room.

 

Pay for this role starts around $24 per hour

job.description:
The Leavenworth Packaging Specialist performs a variety of hand-oriented duties that may include any or all of the following:  unloading product (cards, packages, etc.) from a conveyor, table, etc. and placing on a skid, in stock boxes, on fixtures or cartons.  May pull and grip cards from a large sheet or single levels.  May scrap material from large sheets or one-up cards.  May feed batch heads or operate manual equipment.  May assist in production of envelopes by tending the press, feeding envelope blanks and boxing completed envelopes.  May set up and operate label machines to provide a variety of printed labels.  Incumbent is responsible for assisting with make ready, checking for production quality, preventive maintenance and handling required paperwork. 

 

Responsible for reporting production related information and cleaning the equipment and work area. May assemble and pack various display units. May read and follow store floor plans and merchandising instructions. Positively participates in performance dialogues and other team problem-solving activities to effectively influence how we will accomplish the department goals within shorter periods of time.  Flexibility is key as the incumbent will be expected to learn and perform multiple assignments within this job classification and may be assigned to multiple departments.

 

In this position you will:

  • Assist with all aspects of the different assignments with a focus on cross-training between departments.  Assist with make-readies and inspect cards. 
  • Assist the operator with maintaining specified production, such as throughput, OEE, etc., by placing cards/stock onto flat skid or in carton boxes or pack wholesale unit into cartons.  Feed envelope blanks, pack envelopes into cartons, stack cartons on a pallet and maintain specified production.
  • Execute Quality System including preflight, checking products for accuracy, sampling plan, and the removal of salvage/spoilage by using a guide, shop sample or other approved methods.
  • Utilize good safety practices.

 

This position is on 1st Shift (7:30am - 4:00pm), Monday through Friday

This position is located in Leavenworth, Kansas.  Relocation is not provided.

 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Ability to grasp, lift and carry product weighing up to 30 lbs frequently and 60 lbs occasionally
  • Ability to stand and walk approximately 95% of the time
  • Ability to reach, twist, bend, use repetitive hand/wrist motion and perform fine motor skills approximately 95% of the time
  • Ability to frequently work at or above shoulder level
  • Ability to work overtime as needed

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Good math, written and oral communication skills
  • High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent
  • Good planning and organization skills to set up area
  • Ability to understand and follow established safety procedures
  • Ability to accept other duties as assigned
  • Ability to learn quickly and retain knowledge
  • Ability to work in a team environment and positively contribute during problem-solving meetings 

 

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS:

You must show how you meet basic qualifications (listed below) in a resume or document you upload, or by completing the work experience and education application fields.  Accepted file types are Microsoft Word (DOC or DOCX), PDF, HTML, or TXT. 

 

Internal applicants will be considered in seniority order based on skills, qualifications and performance.  You must address how you meet the basic qualifications of the job in a resume or document you upload, or by completing the work experience and education application fields. In order to be considered for this position:

  • You must have satisfactory or better attendance for the rolling 12 months prior to the closing date of the internal job posting.
  • You must have been in your current job for at least 6 or 12 months, depending on the role.
    • GA 35, 36, 37 – at least 6 months
    • GA 38, 39, 40 – at least 12 months
  • You may not have any disqualifying CRs (quality, performance, safety, behavior, etc.) in the 6 months prior to the closing date of the internal job posting. 

 

If additional openings become available within 30 days of the posting coming down and the vacancy is still in an open status, applicants will be selected from the original posting. If interested in this job, please apply now. If you are offered and accept this position, you understand that you will be held within this position for 6 months.  If you are offered a new position once you accept, but have been in your position for less than 6 months you will not be able to move to a new role.

job.title: Production Associate - 2nd or 3rd Shift
job.description:
BUILD A SKILLED MANUFACTUTING CAREER WITH HALLMARK 

Hallmark's Leavenworth Production Center is growing the next generation of skilled manufacturing professionals, and we're looking for individuals who want more than just a job.

The Production Support Specialist is our facility's entry level position supporting multiple manufacturing departments by performing a wide range of tasks that keep production lines running efficiently. Flexibility is key, as assignments vary across work areas.

 

This Production Support Specialist position is in Leavenworth, KS on 2nd or 3rd shift (3:30pm - 12:00am or 11:30p - 8:00am), Monday through Friday.

Starting pay is $19.80/hour plus shift differential. 

 

GROWING YOUR CAREER WITH HALLMARK

Whether your experience comes from manufacturing, automotive repair, diesel equipment, HVAC, agriculture, military service, machine operation, or another hands-on field, we are interested in people who:

  • Enjoy learning new things
  • Like working with equipment and technology
  • Take pride in quality work
  • Solve problems and troubleshoot issues
  • Want to develop new skills
  • Are interested in building a long-term career

 

At Hallmark, we believe skilled talent is developed, not just hired. We invest in our employees through:

  • Structured hands-on training programs
  • Registered apprenticeship opportunities
  • Cross-training and skill development
  • Mentorship from experienced team members
  • Career development and advancement opportunities

Our goal is to help employees build the skills needed to become the next generation of Machine Operators and Maintenance Technicians.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Supply production lines with stock and materials; jog, stack, assemble, label, and pack product into cartons; move boxes to skids.
  • Perform make-ready procedures, operate equipment, adjust settings, troubleshoot malfunctions, and conduct preventive maintenance.
  • Assist press operators with make-readies, clean-ups, and adhesive mixing.
  • Operate equipment such as sealing, accumulating, punching, scrapping/extracting, and shrink wrapping machines.
  • Order and transport stock/components using hand or powered equipment; handle hazardous materials per regulations.
  • Maintain a clean, safe work environment and adhere to quality standards, correcting defects as needed.
  • Complete required SAP entries for production, scrap, and shipping documents.
  • Participate in team problem-solving, performance dialogues, and continuous improvement efforts.
  • Communicate effectively with the next shift to ensure consistent operations.
  • Be certified to operate power lift equipment and skid inverting machines.
  • Learn and perform multiple assignments across departments.
  • Demonstrate flexibility by rotating tasks and alternating breaks to keep equipment running.
  • Uphold safety practices and contribute positively to team goals
  • Must pass certification to operate power lift equipment and skid inverting machine

 

This position is located in Leavenworth, Kansas.  Relocation is not provided.


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent
  • Ability to grasp, lift and carry product weighing 20 – 50 lbs. frequently and up to 60 lbs. occasionally
  • Ability to constantly stand and/or walk
  • Ability to frequently reach, twist, bend, perform repetitive hand/wrist motion and fine motor skills, and work at or above shoulder level
  • Ability to work overtime as needed


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience running production equipment
  • Basic math, written and oral communication skills
  • Ability to organize and set-up work area and reorganize as priorities change.  Ability to work under pressure
  • Ability to understand the computer and ordering systems and successfully operate both systems
  • Ability to understand and follow established safety procedures and transport hazardous waste material in accordance with all Federal, State, and Local regulations
  • Ability to accept other duties as assigned

job.title: News Video Editor/Newscast Director
job.description:
The Director/Editor supports daily broadcast operations by performing a combination of directing and editing duties for newscasts and other programming. This position may initially focus on directing responsibilities and transition to editing responsibilities based on operational needs. The successful candidate will be adaptable, detail-oriented, and capable of working in a fast-paced television production environment.

  • Direct live and recorded newscasts, special programming, and other station productions.
  • Coordinate with producers, on-air talent, and production staff to execute broadcasts accurately and efficiently.
  • Organize and assemble raw footage into completed stories and programming according to scripts, rundowns, and instructions.
  • Review edited content to ensure accuracy, quality, and compliance with station standards.
  • Trim filmed segments and assemble sequences that effectively tell stories.
  • Determine and incorporate appropriate audio and visual effects.
  • Set up and operate computer editing systems, electronic titling systems, video switching equipment, production automation systems, and digital video effects units.
  • Select and combine the most effective shots to create logical and compelling content.
  • Confer with producers, photographers, reporters, and other personnel regarding assignments and desired production outcomes.
  • Troubleshoot production and technical issues as needed.
  • Maintain editing and production equipment.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Requirements & Skills

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Fluency in English.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Previous television production experience preferred.
  • Experience directing live broadcasts and/or operating video editing equipment preferred.
  • Proficiency with video editing software, broadcast production equipment, and computer systems.
  • Ability to operate under deadline pressure in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize multiple assignments simultaneously.
  • Ability to work flexible schedules, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed.
  • Team-oriented with strong attention to detail.
  • Must join NABET Union

Position Details


This position is posted under the Editor job profile and may include both directing and editing responsibilities based on station needs. Initial duties may focus on directing coverage while supporting staffing requirements, with long-term responsibilities expected to transition primarily to editing functions.


Work Environment/Physical Requirements: High stress environment with deadline pressures and the demands of breaking news, which can happen at any time. Position will require day-to-day multi-tasking, as well as managing multiple projects simultaneously with frequent change in direction and priority. Must be willing to work weekends (Saturdays and Sundays), as well as be able to work any and all shifts as necessary, including overnights/early mornings, nights, and holidays.

The employee in this position must be able to sit, conduct telephone conversations, use electronic mail, write letters and memos, conduct face-to-face discussions with individuals or groups, make decisions without supervision, make decisions that impact the results of co-workers, work near others, and work indoors in environmentally controlled conditions. Repetitive movements are required. Work may be conducted in extremely bright or inadequate lighting conditions.

NOTE: This job description contains the basic requirements for the position and is NOT intended to be a complete list of responsibilities; other duties may be assigned.

TO APPLY: Please visit the Work for us page at KOIN.com: http://bit.ly/2IsKviW or at the Nexstar Website at: https://nexstar.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/nexstar  to complete the application process.

 

ABOUT US: Broadcasting since 1953, KOIN-TV is Portland’s CBS affiliate, providing exceptional local news content on air and online (koin.com), CBS Network programming and syndicated entertainment to viewers across Oregon and SW Washington. KOIN News is Watching Out for You with 51 hours of local news broadcasts each week, featuring award-winning, in-depth investigations, news, weather, traffic, KOIN News AM-Extra and Game-On!  KOIN-TV is a Nexstar Media Group, Inc. television station serving Oregon and SW Washington from its studios in downtown Portland, OR. Nexstar is the largest local television broadcast and digital media company in the nation with 200 broadcast stations (including partner stations) in 116 markets reaching approximately 68% of US television households. Today, as one of the most powerful and trusted voices in America, Nexstar remains true to its mission to uphold the public interest principles of localism, diversity, and trustworthy, unbiased broadcast journalism. At the same time, the company continues to simultaneously raise its commitment to support the evolving needs and interests of the local viewers, hometown businesses and community organizations that it proudly serves each day.

 

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us.

 

 **** EOE/MINORITIES/FEMALES/VETERANS/DISABLED****

KOIN is an equal opportunity employer that seeks diversity in our workforce. All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

KOIN values the contribution of its employees. We recognize their efforts by offering a competitive compensation plan and an array of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, 401(K), and more. We are committed to a drug and alcohol-free workplace. Any job offer is conditional upon satisfactorily completing a background and DMV check.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, KSBY (Santa Maria/North Santa Barbara County)
job.description:
KSBY, The E.W. Scripps Company NBC station in beautiful San Luis Obispo, California, is looking for a creative, driven and community-focused Multimedia Journalist to join our North Santa Barbara County team. If you are passionate about telling impactful stories that engage people across broadcast, digital, and social platforms, this is a chance to bring your talent to a station that is committed to public service journalism. As a beat reporter based out of Santa Maria, you'll cover towns and cities along California's stunning Central Coast - a vibrant region packed with breathtaking scenery and diverse cultures.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Receive assignment or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.
  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interview, observation, and research.
  • Organize material, determine slant or emphasis, and write story according to prescribed editorial style and format standards.
  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.
  • Edit, or assists in editing, videos for all multimedia platforms.
  • Appear on television program when conducting taped interview or narration.
  • Give live reports from site of event or mobile broadcast unit.
  • Work cooperatively with photographer assigned to story, if one is assigned.
  • Assist news producer in preparing newscast.
  • Assist online staff in preparing for multi media stories.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 3+ years of experience in related field preferred
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Computer literacy required, including newsroom computer systems
  • Videography and non-linear editing experience preferred
  • Knowledge of broadcast quality camera equipment
  • Edit video on Final Cut Pro editing systems, or similar equipment
  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills
  • Bilingual (Spanish/English) skills, preferred
  • Proficient at posting content to various websites
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced deadline-driven environment
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Santa Maria puts you in the heart of California's beautiful Central Coast, surrounded by rolling vineyards, scenic open spaces, and easy access to the Pacific. Located in northern Santa Barbara County, Santa Maria Valley offers the relaxed feel of California wine country while serving as a convenient home base for exploring the Central Coast.


Food and wine are a big part of the Santa Maria experience. The region is known for its distinctive Santa Maria-style barbecue tradition, featuring meats grilled over native red oak, and the surrounding Santa Maria Valley is home to wineries and tasting rooms producing acclaimed Pinot Noir, Chardonnay, Syrah, and more. The Foxen Canyon Wine Trail winds through the valley, offering another way to experience the area's vineyards and landscape.


If you love the outdoors, you'll have plenty to explore. Santa Maria Valley combines mild weather and wide-open spaces with opportunities for hiking, cycling, golfing, birdwatching, and beach trips. When you're ready for a change of scenery, the surrounding Central Coast offers everything from ocean views and coastal adventures to wine-country escapes.


For a journalist, Santa Maria also offers the chance to live and work directly in the community you're covering, while enjoying everything that makes California's Central Coast such an appealing place to call home. It's a great fit for someone looking for a mix of local community, outdoor adventure, food and wine, and the California coastal lifestyle.

#LI-SM2 #LI-Onsite

COMPENSATION RANGE:

Hourly: $26.44 - $31.25


 

Pursuant to state and local salary transparency laws, the salary range posted is specific to candidates who will perform this work in California.


 

WHAT WE OFFER (ADDITIONAL BENEFITS):

  • A career path to grow your professional experiences

  • Full medical, dental and vision benefits, as well as certain other health and wellness benefits

  • Retirement savings plan with company match

  • Other key company benefits include disability accident insurance, hospital indemnity, critical illness, life insurance, AD&D, ID protection, pet discount program, and employee assistance program. More details about timing and conditions of benefits eligibility and other plan terms and conditions will be provided upon hire.

If you are a current Scripps employee, please do not apply on this site. Please access our internal career site at Worklife > My Info > View Open Positions at Scripps.

SCRIPPS’ COMMITMENT TO A CULTURE THAT CREATES CONNECTION:

At Scripps, we are committed to a culture that reflects the audiences and communities we serve. We are intentional about creating an environment where employees, our audiences and other stakeholders feel valued and inspired to reach their full potential and create connections. To successfully deliver on this commitment, we must understand and reflect the values and perspectives those around us embody. That process begins by looking inward to build and celebrate a respectful workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging and connection. By continuing to cultivate an environment where all employees have a fair chance to succeed, are included, valued, and seen, we will strengthen the connections that drive positive business impact and align with our core purpose. 

ABOUT SCRIPPS:

The E.W. Scripps Company (NASDAQ: SSP) is a diversified media company focused on creating connection. As one of the nation’s largest local TV broadcasters, Scripps serves communities with quality, objective local journalism and operates a portfolio of more than 60 stations in 40+ markets. Scripps reaches households across the U.S. with national news outlet Scripps News and popular entertainment brands ION, ION Plus, ION Mystery, Bounce, Grit and Laff. Scripps is the nation’s largest holder of broadcast spectrum. Scripps Sports serves professional and college sports leagues, conferences and teams with local market depth and national broadcast reach of up to 100% of TV households. Founded in 1878, Scripps is the steward of the Scripps National Spelling Bee and its longtime motto is: “Give light and the people will find their own way.”

job.description:

Strong analytical skills with attention to detail

creating reports and presentations Familiarity with the digital analytics space and how to evaluate the performance of websites and apps Knowledge of digital analytics and visualization tools is a plus (e.g. Adobe, Tableau, etc.) Passion for delivering world-class online, mobile, and application experiences for sports fans Comfortable proposing new ideas among various internal stakeholders and business units, and collaborating with design, technical, programming, marketing, and sales teams

with incident management and/or customer support tooling is preferred (e.g. Jira, ServiceNow, OpsGenie, ZenDesk, NewRelic, etc.) Active user of digital products Familiarity with all platforms, including web, mobile web, IOS, Android, game consoles and connected TVs Knowledge of and passion for basketball Willingness to learn and master multiple digital products Strong research and analytical skills Good multi-tasking and project management skills Ability to work in high-pressure environments Knowledge of the current digital sports landscape Familiarity with various premium sports packages inside and outside the NBA Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

job.description:
Job Description:



About the Role

As the Director, Consumer Insights & Analytics, you will create the shared source of truth about our customers and our business that we use to drive decisions about future growth in our core products and new ventures. You will collaborate with analytics and research teams across Dow Jones to harmonize metrics, align on a shared view of the customer, and drive insights-led decision making at the senior leadership level.


This is not a pure market research role: it requires a leader who can combine strategy and storytelling with hands-on analytical ownership. The focus here, at least in the beginning, will be on pulling together disparate measurements, research, data, and analysis from across the newly formed Dow Jones consumer group and using them to tell coherent stories about our customers that inform decision making.


You will also serve as the accountable owner of official consumer metrics, build the dashboards and reporting needed to manage the business, and turn cross-functional inputs into a clear view of what happened, why it happened, and what the team should do next.


You will work on-site in our Midtown Manhattan office 3 days a week and report to the SVP, Consumer Ventures & Strategy.


You Are

  • A strategist first: you can frame a question, structure an answer, and write an executive-level memo or build a deck
  • Able to analyze qualitative and quantitative data to derive insights
  • Able to navigate, unpack, and understand different metrics, definitions, and points of view
  • An analytics owner who can collaborate with other analytics teams and stakeholders establish clear metric definitions, build trusted reporting, and hold the organization to a consistent source of truth
  • Technically fluent and willing to work hands-on with data, dashboards, and analytical tools — especially while the function and reporting infrastructure are being built
  • Collaborative and adept at driving to consensus across functions
  • Relentlessly curious
  • A consumer of media and news with a point of view about the future of the content and data business
  • A data-driven storyteller who knows how to use analytics and insights to drive to decisions
  • Entrepreneurial: able to put a strategy into action

You Will

  • Develop a deep familiarity with all of the data and research sources across Dow Jones, identifying gaps and limitations
  • Use those sources — and new ones that you will work with our existing teams to create — to create a unified, coherent understanding of our customers that is digestible and actionable at an executive level
  • Own the definitions, governance, and official reporting of consumer metrics, creating a consistent source of truth across Finance, Marketing, Technology, Product, Strategy, and Consumer leadership
  • Build, maintain, and continually improve dashboards and recurring reporting that track the consumer  business
  • Own the end-to-end business performance narrative: partner with functional teams to investigate movements, pressure-test explanations, identify emerging trends, and synthesize one coherent view of what happened, why it happened, and what requires action
  • Collaborate closely with analytics and insights colleagues in product, marketing, and  Dow Jones newsrooms
  • Translate insights into recommendations on roadmap, pricing, and retention
  • Conduct proactive analyses and opportunity sizing to identify the most important subscriber and revenue growth opportunities
  • Track AI, platform, and consumer behavior shifts and feed signal into strategy
  • Identify ways to automate and enrich reporting using AI tools

You Have

  • 12+ years of consumer-focused experience in strategic analytics, data, and/or insights roles; experience at a top-tier consulting firm and/or a high-performing internal corporate strategy or insights team is preferred
  • Experience in a B2C subscription business is highly preferred, with a deep understanding of subscription drivers and metrics including conversion, starts, churn and retention, ARPU, CAC, and LTV
  • Demonstrated experience owning business-critical metrics, executive dashboards, and recurring performance reporting in a complex cross-functional environment
  • A proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and navigate complex organizations
  • Proficiency with SQL, data warehouses, and business-intelligence and visualization tools, with the ability to build and quality-control dashboards directly
  • Strong analytical judgment, including the ability to distinguish signal from noise, connect movements across a funnel, and select the right benchmark or comparison for a given metric
  • At least: fluency with AI and ideas about how to use it for synthesis and research; at best: experience deploying AI tools across an analytics or strategy function
  • A deep interest in the future of media and content businesses and ideas about how to navigate it
  • The willingness to work in our Midtown Manhattan office at least 3 days each week
  • Media and/or content experience is a plus

Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale.

The Data, Insights, Science and Optimization, Consumer Product and Tech (DISCO CPT) team is looking for a Data Scientist to join a team of Data Scientists, Analytics Leads, Business Intelligence Engineers and Data Engineers who analyze big data, provide analytics and insights as well as build models and algorithms that power product for personalized experiences. The team focuses on accelerating Amazon Music customer growth by empowering Product teams to make sound, customer-centric decisions through data and insights. We build data pipelines, science models, self-service analytics, insights and dashboards, deliver engagement and retention at scale. In this role, you will pioneer and execute advanced analytics and experimentation efforts for the Amazon Music product team. You will work with stakeholders and partners to deliver experimentation insights, author scientific artifacts, build scalable models to advance our analytics and science products. The ideal candidate must be willing to effectively lead science solutions, prioritize across multiple stakeholders and projects and be ready to jump into a fast-paced, dynamic and fun environment.

Key job responsibilities
1. Data Scientist I on this role will be a thought partner to Product and Engineering organizations through their expertise in experimentation, statistical modeling and advanced analytics
2. Conceptualize and drive strategic growth areas: app performance, stablity and latency experimentation, Gen AI initiatives, and product excellence.
3. Bridge science, analytics, and engineering to deliver solutions informing strategic decisions on AM technology investments and long-term business performance
4. Drive experimentation, measurement efficiency tooling, and ROI tracking for AM leadership
5. Build and maintain causal models to understand customer sentiment and its impact on key engagement/retention metrics
6. Develop structural and predictive models using data science workflows to deliver measurable customer results

A day in the life
1. Lead strategic initiatives across visual and voice experiences, experimentation and customer retention stakeholders
2. Conduct experimentation, build causal models to better understand key drivers for customer retention
3. Evaluate existing metrics and lead deep dives to ensure the right measurement framework is leveraged to measure and enhance user adoption through visual and voice interfaces
4. Partner with product managers to translate business questions into actionable science projects
5. Influence product roadmaps through data-driven insights on customer behavior patterns
6. Identify and resolve customer experience friction points with cross-functional teams
Drive adoption of best practices and innovative solutions across the organization

Basic Qualifications

- 1+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience
- 2+ years of data/research scientist, statistician or quantitative analyst in an internet-based company with complex and big data sources experience
- 1+ years of creating or contributing to mathematical textbooks, research papers, or educational content experience
- Master's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM), or experience working in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM)

Preferred Qualifications

- Ph.D. in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM)
- Knowledge of statistical packages and business intelligence tools such as SPSS, SAS, S-PLUS, or R
- Knowledge of machine learning concepts and their application to reasoning and problem-solving
- Experience with clustered data processing (e.g., Hadoop, Spark, Map-reduce, and Hive)
- Experience working with or evaluating AI systems
- Experience applying quantitative analysis to solve business problems and making data-driven business decisions
- Experience effectively communicating complex concepts through written and verbal communication
