job.title: Guest Booker Producer/Coordinator
job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

This role will be responsible for identifying, securing, and coordinating guests for the Dan Le Batard Show and the Le Batard and Friends Network. This would include booking prominent figures across the sports industry, friends of the network and news makers.

You will have a deep knowledge of sports, news and culture, exceptional communication skills, outstanding organizational abilities, and, most importantly, an established network of relationships throughout the sports industry. You should already have direct access to athletes, coaches, executives, agents, media personalities, publicists, and other influential figures who can contribute to compelling podcast content.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Leverage an existing network of sports industry contacts to consistently secure high-quality guests.
  • Research and identify new guests that align with the podcast's audience and content strategy.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with athletes, coaches, sports executives, journalists, broadcasters, agents, publicists, and influencers.
  • Conduct outreach through email, phone, social media, and professional networks.
  • Negotiate guest availability and schedule appearances.
  • Manage a guest pipeline and booking calendar to ensure shows have guest-related content


GUEST BOOKING

  • Confirm recording dates, times, and technical requirements.
  • Provide guests with pre-show information, talking points, and expectations.
  • Coordinate logistics across hosts, producers, and guests.
  • Send reminders and follow-up communications before and after recordings.
  • Ensure all required release forms and permissions are completed.


RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for guests.
  • Deliver a professional, high-quality guest experience.
  • Expand and strengthen the company's network of sports industry relationships.
  • Maintain an organized database of contacts, previous guests, and future prospects.
  • Foster long-term relationships that lead to repeat appearances and referrals.


This role may require irregular hours, weekend work and travel


QUALIFICATIONS

  • Strong research and story development skills, including the ability to identify timely, relevant guests and angles in sports and culture.
  • Experience in talent booking or coordinating guests for podcasts, digital shows, or broadcast content, preferably in a media or entertainment environment.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills for working with talent, representatives, and internal production teams.
  • Proven organizational and time-management abilities, including scheduling, coordinating logistics, and managing multiple projects and deadlines.
  • Familiarity with sports media, pop culture, and current events, and comfort working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven setting.
  • Ability to work collaboratively on-site in Miami, FL, while taking initiative and ownership of booking responsibilities.
  • Professional experience with production tools or workflows (e.g., shared calendars, project management software, call sheets) is beneficial.


Salary: $65,000-$85,000 depending on experience

job.title: DC Based Live Event Producer
job.description:
HOW TO APPLY

Send the following to careers@decibelevents.com with "Producer" in the subject line:

1.     A 60-second to 2-minute video cover letter (required). Tell us who you are, a show you're proud of, and why you want to work at dB. Send a link, not an attachment.

2.    Resume

3.    Example show paperwork (run of show, cue sheet, budget, or ground plan), with confidential details removed

4.    Sizzle reel or portfolio, with a note on your role in each event

5.    Three professional references

6.    Salary requirements

Applications without a video cover letter will not be considered.



Producer


Decibel Events | Washington, DC | Full-Time


ABOUT DECIBEL EVENTS

Decibel Events (dB) is a full-service event production and management company based in Washington, DC. We create stunning live events for federal agencies, associations, and corporations throughout the US and abroad, from broadcast-quality general sessions and multi-day conferences to trade shows and city-wide festivals.


Our clients include the Library of Congress, the U.S. Small Business Administration, the Department of War, Trane Technologies, and T. Rowe Price, and some have been with us for more than 15 years. We are experts at what we do. We work side by side with our clients to make every event seamless, and the work we put into preproduction is what our clients see onsite. We are a team of six, so everyone here has a hand in the work and a direct relationship with the client.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a full-time Producer to join our events team, reporting to Eric Bibbs, Senior Producer. You will own each event from the first planning call to the final cue. You'll lead discovery calls with the client, write the proposals, build the paperwork, hire the crew, and lead the team onsite. When the show needs a caller, you'll call it. When we're chasing new work, you'll help us win it. You’ll also support productions in our new Washington, DC studio, helping dB expand its podcast, video and content production capabilities


WHAT YOU'LL DO


Plan

·      Meet with clients to understand their goals, audience, budget, and what success looks like

·      Develop event concepts and production approaches with the client and the dB team

·      Build and manage production schedules and lead regular client calls from kickoff through load-out


Budget and Document

·      Build and manage event budgets, and write proposals, scopes of work, and pricing

·      Create show paperwork: run of show, cue sheets, crew schedules, and labor calls

·      Create or revise ground plans, stage plots, and room layouts in Vectorworks or CAD


Produce

·      Source and manage vendors, venues, and freelance crew, including federal facilities

·      Lead the production team through load-in, rehearsals, show, and strike

·      Call the show when needed, and back up our show callers on large general sessions

·      Support the operation of dB Studios, including podcast, video, virtual and hybrid productions; assist with studio setup, recording, switching, audio, lighting and client sessions as needed.


Grow

·      Mentor our production assistants

·      Lead the after-action review on your events

·      Support new business through proposals, site visits, pitches, and RFP responses


WHAT YOU BRING


Requirements

·      5+ years planning and producing live events, with deep experience in corporate, government, and association events in and around DC

·      Strong knowledge of DC venues, federal facilities, vendors, and labor

·      Experience managing budgets, proposals, vendors, and freelance crew

·      A solid understanding of audio, video, lighting, staging, and content

·      Excellent communication with clients, senior executives, government stakeholders, staff and crew

·      A flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays

·      A valid passport


The X factor

Ever wonder what could set you apart as a candidate? That X factor. These fit the bill, and there could be others. Let your experience shine here and tell us more.

·      Showcalling: you've called shows and can jump in and take the headset

·      Vectorworks or CAD experience

·      A book of business or clients that want to move with you

·      Experience with federal clients or events in secure facilities

·      Experience operating a podcast, broadcast, livestream or video production studio, including familiarity with multi-camera production, audio mixing, lighting, video switching and virtual meeting platforms.


CMP certification

Decibel Events is dedicated to the Certified Meeting Professional (CMP) program. A current CMP is preferred. If you don't have one, Decibel Events pays for the program, and you must earn your CMP within one calendar year of your start date. The experience required for this role should qualify you for the CMP program immediately.


LOCATION AND TRAVEL

Our office and planning work happens in Washington, DC, and we're lucky to have a few local shows. The rest are national and international, so a passport is a must. You must live in the DC metro area or be willing to relocate. This role requires long periods on your feet, climbing stairs and ladders, and lifting up to 50 lbs. This is a full-time position. Freelancers need not apply.


SALARY AND BENEFITS


$100,000 to $135,000, depending on experience.

·      CMP program paid by Decibel Events

·      Medical, dental, and vision stipend

·      Matching 401(k)

·      Flexible time off and paid holidays

·      Up to 2 remote days per week

·      Daily breakfast and craft coffee


HOW TO APPLY


Send the following to careers@decibelevents.com with "Producer" in the subject line:

1.     A 60-second to 2-minute video cover letter (required). Tell us who you are, a show you're proud of, and why you want to work at dB. Send a link, not an attachment.

2.    Resume

3.    Example show paperwork (run of show, cue sheet, budget, or ground plan), with confidential details removed

4.    Sizzle reel or portfolio, with a note on your role in each event

5.    Three professional references

6.    Salary requirements


Applications without a video cover letter will not be considered.

Decibel Events is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

job.title: LN Concerts, Settlement Manager
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

 

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

 

THE JOB

In this role, you’ll be the critical link between artists, partners, and Live Nation—driving seamless settlements, shaping venue deals, and ensuring every show closes as strong as it opens. If you thrive in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment where precision, partnership, and passion come together, this is your chance to make every show count.

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Liaison between Live Nation and artist representatives
  • Prepare pre-settlements as needed
  • Prepare and execute night-of-show event settlements
  • Coordinate, prepare, and settle with third-party buildings and any co-promoters
  • Communicate & coordinate with the local office and accounting team on all financial-related items as related to settlements/flash reports
  • Work cross-functionally with various internal teams to streamline settlement processes
  • Participate in strategic meetings with booking as finance representative for venue deals
  • Advise and prepare necessary analysis on business development projects as requested
  • Special Projects and other duties as assigned

 

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or other related field
  • Minimum 3 years of related experience
  • Strong Excel skills
  • Must be able to read and interpret ticket audits
  • 2+ years of contract review
  • Solid communication abilities, experience sharing ideas/needs with all levels of venue and artist representatives
  • Adaptable with work hours, supporting weekends and holidays as needed
  • Conversational Spanish fluency or better is preferred

HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)

Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. job.title: Senior Manager - Treasury
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

WPP is on a global transformation journey, and this is an opportunity to join support the treasury activities for operating companies in India.

What you'll be doing:

The role report to Regional Treasurer and responsible for overseeing India’s cashflow & liquidity, investments, banking relationships, foreign exchange risk to support business growth and financial stability.

This role will report into the Asia Pacific Treasurer, key responsibilities are:

Liquidity & Working Capital Management

  • Monitor daily cash position and manage liquidity planning to ensure adequate funding for business operations in India.
  • Prepare and maintain short-term and long-term cash flow forecasts (e.g., weekly, monthly, quarterly) to minimize idle excess cash.
  • Optimize working capital and manage the deployment of surplus funds in deposit placement for yield enhancement.
  • Lead and oversee the service fee settlement and dividend repatriation in timely manner.

Banking & Financial Institution Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for banking partners in India; negotiate terms, pricing, and facilities. Bringing their advice and expertise to bear as required for risk management or other purposes.
  • Manage banking documentation, KYC, and regulatory compliance.

Forex Exposure & Investment Management

  • Identify, manage, and report on foreign exchange (FX) exposure across the networks.
  • Design and implement foreign currency hedging strategies for business operation as to mitigate their financial risks.
  • Advise the business on FEMA (Foreign Exchange Management Act) compliance and requirements.

Business partnering

  • Build deep relationship with CFOs and FDs across diverse networks and influence decisions on working capital and foreign exchange management.
  • Support the communications of treasury policy and internal control standards, ensure it is applied in compliance with the related local treasury procedures.
  • Monitor and assess the impact of local market conditions such as regulation, currency controls, financial products and advise on this internally.
  • Support Treasury GBS team as required on joint or Treasury led developments.

Intercompany Funding & Debt Management

  • Support fund-raising activities through various instruments like bank loans, intercompany financing.
  • Manage the loan drawdown and repayment of operating entities in India, including refinancing and ensuring timely servicing of debt obligations.

Candidate Qualifications & Experience

  • Educational Background:
  • Experience graduate / postgraduate 
  • Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA), A CTP (Certified Treasury Professional) qualification is a strong plus.

Professional Experience:

  • 11-15 years of progressive experience in corporate treasury, cash management, or a similar finance role.
  • Proven experience with Treasury Management Systems (e.g., IT/2) is highly desirable.
  • Deep understanding of RBI regulations, FEMA, and local banking practices.
  • Strong experience in managing banking relationships and forex hedging instruments.
  • Knowledge of derivatives and hedging currency exposures directly or indirectly.
  • Knowledge of accounting in relation to FX gains and losses and where they arise.

Key Skills

  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Profound understanding and operation experiences in cash management and FX risk management products
  • Experience operating in a multi-currency, multi-entity global organization is a plus.
  • Experience in Power BI a plus

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

job.title: Lead Software Engineer - Apple
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

Location: NY/SFO/Burbank – Onsite

 

About This Role

Welcome to Paramount Streaming — the team behind Paramount+, home to a mountain of entertainment for audiences around the globe. As part of a leading global media and entertainment company, we deliver premium content and unforgettable experiences across iconic brands including CBS, Showtime, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, and Pluto TV. At Paramount Streaming, we leverage one of the industry's deepest libraries of film and television content to power compelling streaming and digital video products. From platform innovation to global distribution and advanced advertising solutions, our teams are building the future of entertainment. If you're excited to work at the intersection of media and technology, we'd love to hear from you.

Paramount+ has been at the forefront of streaming innovation for over a decade, beginning as CBS All Access and evolving into what is now Paramount+. Our Apple team builds and scales the iOS and tvOS apps that deliver that experience to millions of viewers worldwide.

 

We’re hiring a Lead Engineer on the AI Engagement Engine team. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. You’ll build high-performance, user-facing features that power content discovery and personalization within the Paramount+ and Pluto TV applications, integrating real-time personalization signals and expanding personalized experiences across key touchpoints.

You’ll work with backend, ML, data, and platform teams to deliver scalable experiences across Apple platforms, own complex technical problems end-to-end, contribute to iOS and tvOS architecture, and partner with existing technical leadership on engineering standards.

AI fluency is a baseline requirement. AI-assisted workflows should be a core part of how you design, build, and review software, supported by a high-level understanding of inference, context windows, harnesses, and tools.

 

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership:

  • Contribute to decisions on architecture, frameworks, and tooling for the iOS and tvOS apps in partnership with team leads and senior peers.

  • Explore, evaluate, and implement new technologies to improve development efficiency and productivity.

  • Evaluate opportunities to bring new technical features to mobile users.

  • Translate product goals into technical requirements and break them down into shippable work.

Application Development:

  • Design, build, debug, and deliver best-in-class native tvOS and iOS applications.

  • Drive performance, reliability, and accessibility across the full app surface.

AI-Assisted Engineering:

  • Use AI coding assistants and agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalent daily to design, write, review, and refactor code.

  • Evaluate emerging AI capabilities and adopt approaches that improve engineering quality and productivity.

  • Share useful AI techniques and workflows with teammates.

  • Build client experiences for personalization and recommendation features in partnership with ML and backend teams.

Mentorship:

  • Raise code quality through code review, design review, and pairing.

  • Model good engineering habits, technical writing, and clear decision-making.

  • Mentor and unblock other engineers without requiring a reporting line.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Partner with product, design, data, backend, and other client teams to define, design, and deploy features.

  • Cultivate strong working relationships with colleagues, customers, and company management.

  • Communicate technical trade-offs clearly to engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

Process Improvement and Ownership:

  • Work closely with your team to ensure the timely delivery of features and improvements.

  • Manage concurrent projects and surface delivery risks early.

  • Perform any other duties and responsibilities assigned by management.

 

Skills

Expertise in Apple Development:

  • Excellent programming skills in Swift.

  • In-depth knowledge of iOS and tvOS, and strong proficiency in Xcode.

  • Strong programming fundamentals, including memory management, concurrency, animations, and performance profiling.

  • Experience designing UI across size classes and device families.

  • Experience consuming RESTful APIs and integrating with backend services.

AI Fluency:

  • Understand core AI concepts at a high level, including inference, context windows, harnesses, and tools.

  • Have working familiarity with skills and plugins, how they extend AI coding tools, and when to use an existing one.

  • Write and refine prompts and context, and critically evaluate AI-generated output, including code.

  • Have some familiarity with how LLM- or ML-powered product features are built.

  • Exercise sound judgment around privacy, intellectual property, attribution, and when human review is required.

Architecture and Experimentation:

  • Strong problem-solving and architectural skills at the app and module level.

  • Experience with A/B testing, feature flagging, and client-side experimentation, including experiment assignment, holdout groups, and measuring feature impact within an existing testing framework.

  • Experience integrating ad-serving products into Apple applications, including ad surfaces, impression tracking, and working alongside ad tech teams in a production environment.

  • Working familiarity with ML-driven product features, including collaborating with data science teams on API contracts, identifying the signals clients should capture, and distinguishing between data, model, and rendering issues.

The Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) AI Lab at CBC/Radio-Canada operates as an agile, high-performance innovation hub. Our mission is to prototype, experiment with and deploy artificial intelligence solutions for media production systems across the organization. job.description:
Morning News Anchor

#26-1355

Duluth, Minnesota, United States

Apply

Business Unit

WDIO-TV

Employee Classification

Full Time Regular

About Us

WDIO-TV, News Channel 10/13 is the award-winning ABC network affiliate for Northeastern Minnesota and Northwest Wisconsin. Part of Hubbard Broadcasting, WDIO-TV is committed to excellence in all that it does-broadcast news with hyper-local coverage, important public service that deals powerfully with today's issues, and now, more than ever, top-notch digital content, to reach our viewers and followers with information the way they want to receive it. When you work for WDIO-TV, you will find yourself among dedicated, passionate people who work hard every day to improve our product and our community. If you have the qualifications, and you are a person of talent and integrity, we invite you to apply!

Job Overview

The anchor of Good Morning Northland has a pivotal role in the Newsroom, helping to lead the early morning news crew while facilitating communications into the early afternoon. The morning anchor contributes daily content to the early newscast, social media, and online that requires the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment, strong communication across all departments, and the ability to manage others.

Job Responsibilities

Anchor the morning newscast from 5:00-7:00am, with various live and recorded updates to follow.

Help make decisions about stories to be included in newscasts and in what order they should air.

Revise scripts and prepare to deliver them on-air.

Interview guests live in studio with engaging commentary.

Schedule & organize off-site interviews for newscast content.

Attend morning newsroom editorial meetings.

Work with News Director to plan short- & long-term content.

Work closely with Digital Manager, coordinating what & how to post stories on the web and on social media.

Is knowledgeable about local, national, and global events. Has a good understanding of government & legal policy and procedures.

Maintain extensive community contacts and awareness of local, state and national current events.

Complete other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

College degree in broadcast journalism or comparable experience.

Minimum of two years’ experience as a news anchor preferred.

Quick & effective decision-making, live ad-libbing, and maintain performance under extreme pressure.

Must be articulate in English, possess excellent written & verbal communication skills, the ability to read a teleprompter, and an ability to get along with and motivate a broad range of personalities.

Professional & maintained on-air appearance.

Demonstrated ability to take initiative, manage projects from start to finish, and meet deadlines without direct supervision.

Ability to work effectively under pressure, prioritize, and organize.

Ability to work evenings, early mornings, and weekends when needed.

Additional Information

This position is subject to pre-employment driving record background check. A conviction, violation pending adjudication, or adverse driving record more than 3 years old or does not meet the major violation definition per company policy will not, on its own, disqualify an applicant. The company will use background check information in a confidential, non-discriminatory manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Compensation and Benefits

When extending an offer, the company considers a variety of factors such as (but not limited to) the candidate's work experience, education/training & key skills as well as internal peer equity and other market and business considerations. The hourly rate of pay for this position is $19-$24. This is a full time position (40 hours weekly). Hubbard Broadcasting has been committed to representing the communities we serve since our founding over 100 years ago. The same holds true today. We know the best way to accomplish this is by recruiting and retaining top talent from diverse cultures, life experiences, and world views. With dignity and respect, we value YOU and everything that makes YOU uniquely YOU.

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.

Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!

job.title: Field Coordinator
job.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Paving field Coordinator is responsible for planning, posting, documenting, and monitoring temporary "No Parking" restrictions required for street paving, reconstruction, utility restoration, and public works projects throughout the City of Los Angeles. The position ensures compliance with City of Los Angeles permitting requirements, parking restriction regulations, traffic control plans, and project schedules to facilitate successful paving operations while minimizing disruptions to residents and businesses.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Coordinate and implement temporary parking restrictions for paving and roadway construction projects.
  • Install, maintain, and remove temporary "No Parking" signs in accordance with City of Los Angeles permit requirements.
  • Verify signs are posted within required notification timeframes prior to scheduled construction activities.
  • Photograph and document all posted signs, locations, dates, and times for compliance records.
  • Conduct field inspections to ensure parking restrictions remain visible, legible, and properly located.
  • Communicate with residents, business owners, property managers, and stakeholders regarding upcoming restrictions.
  • Coordinate daily with project managers, paving crews, traffic control personnel, inspectors, and City representatives.
  • Maintain accurate records of permits, posting logs, photographs, and project documentation.
  • Verify project addresses, limits of work, and parking restriction boundaries before posting.
  • Assist with lane closures, traffic control coordination, and field logistics as required.
  • Respond to public inquiries and complaints regarding temporary parking restrictions.
  • Ensure compliance with company safety policies and applicable traffic safety regulations.
  • Support emergency and short-notice paving operations when required.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • High School Diploma or GED required.

Experience

  • Minimum two (2) years of experience in construction coordination, traffic control, public works, paving operations, utility construction, or related field.
  • Experience working within the City of Los Angeles permitting environment is preferred.

License Requirements

  • Valid California Driver License.
  • Ability to operate company vehicles throughout Los Angeles County.

KNOWLEDGE OF

  • City of Los Angeles temporary no-parking requirements.
  • Public works and paving operations.
  • Traffic control practices and work zone safety.
  • Street and roadway nomenclature throughout Los Angeles.
  • Permit compliance procedures.
  • Microsoft Outlook, Excel, and mobile field documentation applications.
  • Customer service and public communication techniques.

ABILITY TO

  • Work independently in the field with minimal supervision.
  • Read maps, plans, permits, and work orders.
  • Maintain detailed documentation and photographic records.
  • Communicate professionally with residents, businesses, inspectors, and project personnel.
  • Organize and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Work flexible hours, including nights and weekends, as required by paving schedules.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Walk long distances in residential, commercial, and industrial areas.
  • Frequently lift and carry up to 50 pounds.
  • Install and remove temporary parking signs and signposts.
  • Work outdoors in varying weather and traffic conditions.
  • Stand, bend, climb, and perform field activities for extended periods.

PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS

  • ATSSA Traffic Control Technician (TCT).
  • ATSSA Traffic Control Supervisor (TCS).
  • OSHA 10-Hour or OSHA 30-Hour Construction Safety Certification.
  • CPR/First Aid Certification.

WORKING CONDITIONS

This position requires daily travel throughout the City of Los Angeles and surrounding areas. Work is performed outdoors near active traffic, construction zones, and paving operations during both daytime and nighttime hours.

This version is tailored for contractors performing paving, utility restoration, and street work that require temporary No Parking posting and compliance documentation for City of Los Angeles paving permits.

job.title: Producer, CTV News Channel
job.description:
Req Id: 433402

 

Connection is everything. It drives us to innovate, explore, and stay close to what matters to us most. At Bell, we’re building a more connected future through world-class networks, AI-powered solutions, and digital experiences that elevate how people live, work, and play every day. 

 

We believe in empowering people. That’s why we equip our teams with cutting-edge technology, AI tools, and a collaborative environment that supports creativity and growth. Want to be part of a diverse team where your work makes a real impact? If you’re inspired by innovation that advances how people connect and transforms what’s possible, you belong on #TeamBell. 

 

 

Be at the forefront of one of the most exciting and ever-changing industries. On the Bell Media team you will be a part of creating and delivering the best Canadian and international content across digital media, television, radio and out-of-home advertising platforms. You’ll join a team of passionate and driven innovators, who are breaking barriers and expanding the reach of Canada’s most-loved entertainment.

 

At Bell Media, you’ll redefine digital connections and pioneer next-generation services, propelling us to reach new heights, unlock untapped potential and expand horizons for our customers.

 

Summary

CTV News Channel is looking for a dynamic, experienced News Producer who is excited about delivering the news in a fast-paced, multi-platform news environment, and thrives in a breaking news situation. As Canada’s 24-hour news channel, CTV News Channel is leading the charge in delivering breaking news and informing Canadians about what matters to them.

 

Identifying news stories, generating enterprise news content, knowing how to element broadcast stories, lining up, producing and executing live television coverage, writing quickly and accurately are essential to the position, as is strong news judgement and the highest journalistic standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify, build, element & execute the LIVE on-air output of CTV News Channel during specified periods of the broadcast day
  • Generate original story ideas for execution 
  • Determine the daily editorial direction and execution of coverage
  • Collaborate with & assign editorial team members to define & execute content & coverage
  • Ensure CTV News Channel is delivering the latest developments in major news stories while covering breaking news quickly & accurately
  • Writing to include but not exclusive to story intros, voice overs, and promos
  • Vet scripts, video, audio, & banners
  • Ensure accuracy, consistency & adherence to CTV News standards of all material
  • Responsible for taking LIVE events to air & future planning for major events
  • Monitor wires, social media, e-mail & all other outlets for news updates or story ideas
  • Participate in news editorial meetings
  • Keep on top of news broadcasting trends on all platforms

Critical Qualifications

  • Degree/Diploma in Broadcast Journalism
  • Excellent skills & extensive experience as a live control room producer
  • Experience in managing news coverage
  • Experience in developing & structuring news coverage
  • Experience in vetting scripts
  • Superior news judgement & broadcast writing skills as well as knowledge of digital writing
  • Excellent knowledge of news & current affairs, domestically & internationally
  • Must have excellent command of the English language
  • Excellent decision-making & organizational skills, ability to prioritize, multi-task &  meet strict deadlines while maintaining strong editorial judgement & creativity
  • Excellent communication skills – oral & written

Ability to lead a team, motivate staff & personally set the highest professional standards

 

Adequate knowledge of French is required for positions in Quebec. 

 

Additional Information:

Position Type: Management 
Job Status: Regular - Full Time 
Job Location: Canada : Ontario : Scarborough 
Work Arrangement: Full-time in office (meaning that you will be required to perform your work on-site)
Application Deadline: 11/16/2026 

 

For work arrangements that are ‘Hybrid’, successful candidates must be based in Canada and report to a set Bell office for a minimum of 3 days a week.  Recognizing the importance of work-life balance, Bell offers flexibility in work hours based on the business needs.

 

Please apply directly online to be considered for this role.  Applications through email will not be accepted.

 

We know that caring for our team members is at the heart of a healthy, positive and thriving workplace. As part of our team, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive compensation package that includes a competitive salary and a wide range of benefits to support the well-being of you and your family. As soon as you join us, you'll be eligible for medical, dental, vision and mental health benefits that you can tailor to your specific needs. Plus, as a Bell team member, you'll enjoy a 35% discount on our services and access exclusive offers from our partners. 

 

At Bell, we are proud of our focus on fostering an inclusive and accessible workplace where all team members feel valued, respected, supported, and that they belong.

 

Bell is committed to clarity in our hiring process. All roles posted are opportunities we’re actively recruiting for, unless stated otherwise. We also want to make sure that everyone has an equal opportunity to join our team. We encourage individuals who may require accommodations during the hiring process to let us know. For a confidential inquiry, email your recruiter or recruitment@bell.ca to make arrangements. If you have questions or feedback regarding accessibility at Bell, we invite you to complete the Accessibility feedback form or visit our Accessibility page for other ways to contact us.

 

Artificial intelligence may be used to assess parts of your application. Please review our privacy policy (see Phenom for details) to learn more about how we collect, use, and disclose your personal information.

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. About WNDU:

WNDU boasts a history of more than 70 years and sits on the campus of the world-renowned University of Notre Dame. We cover northwest Indiana and southwest Michigan. We produce over 36 hours of live news each week and continue to expand our coverage. Our team is committed to the highest standards in news, entertainment, informational, and public service programming. Our viewers love having a major research university in their backyard, the history of a strong manufacturing sector, and a robust court system. They also demand accountability from those institutions. The stories are here. We need the right journalist to find the stories and tell them.

Job Summary/Description:

WNDU in South Bend, Indiana is looking for an Investigative Reporter/MMJ. You will dig. You will file records requests. You will work sources. You will gather documents. You will tell complex, consequential stories in ways that are clear, fair, and impossible to ignore. And you will do it across every platform, on air, online, and on social. This role is not just about producing lengthy series pieces; we expect you on air regularly as part of the 16 News Now team. When a breaking news story has an investigative angle, a document, a record, a source with context no one else has, we want you gathering and fronting that information, bringing depth and accountability to stories as they happen, not weeks later. If you have the chops and the experience, we want to hear from you; apply now.

Duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

- Drive original daily investigative and enterprise reporting for WNDU. We need more than a long-form series. We want accountability journalism that shows up in every newscast.
- File and manage public records requests (FOIA, state open records) as a core reporting tool, not an afterthought.
- Use data, documents, and records to build stories from the ground up.
- Develop, cultivate, and protect confidential sources across government, law enforcement, business, and the community.
- Examine breaking and day-of news through an investigative lens - gathering records, sourcing context, and fronting stories that go deeper than the surface.
- Manage longer-form investigations simultaneously at different stages of development.
- Shoot, write, edit, and present your own stories as a full MMJ. Own the story from pitch to air. We do have photographers who will work with you, but you shouldn't be reliant on them for every story or shoot.
- Translate complex investigative findings into compelling, accessible content for broadcast, digital, and social audiences.
- Collaborate with editorial leadership on story development, legal review, and publication strategy.
- Uphold the highest standards of accuracy, fairness, and SPJ ethics - every story, every time.

Qualifications/Requirements:

- Proven investigative or accountability reporting experience; we want to see the work.
- A track record of using public records, data, or documents to break original stories.
- The ability to work at two speeds simultaneously: daily investigative hits AND longer-term series development.
- Strong on-camera presence and MMJ skills; you shoot, edit, and present your own material, and you are comfortable being a visible, recognizable face of the 16 News Now brand.
- Source development skills built over time; you have relationships, and you know how to build new ones.
- The ability to take a dense, document-heavy story and make it matter to a general audience.
- Unshakable ethical standards; you understand the weight of this work, and you handle it accordingly.
- Comfort with legal and editorial scrutiny; you document your reporting, and you stand behind it.
- Resilience: investigations get complicated, sources go cold, and stories take longer than expected, but you do not quit.
- Valid U.S. driver's license and ability to drive a company vehicle.
- A journalism-related degree is preferred, but not required; your body of work must speak for itself.
- Must be able to carry 35+ pounds of gear, and be experienced in shooting and editing unique content. We do have photographers to partner with on appropriate assignments.
- Familiarity with ENPS, Arc, and Edius is a plus, but not required.

job.title: Engineer, IT Network
job.description:
The IT Systems & Network Engineer is responsible for the day-to-day support, maintenance, troubleshooting, and operation of information technology and related broadcast systems within the facility.

This is a hands-on technical position with a strong emphasis on end-user support, hardware break/fix, Microsoft technologies, network connectivity, and general IT infrastructure support. The position also works closely with the station’s Engineering team and supports technology used in newsroom, production, and broadcast operations.

The ideal candidate is a well-rounded IT professional who is comfortable troubleshooting everything from an end-user issue or hardware failure to a network switch, server, Microsoft 365 issue, or specialized broadcast-connected system.

Broadcast television experience is beneficial but is not required for a candidate with a strong IT foundation and the ability and desire to learn broadcast technologies.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Provide hands-on end-user technical support and hardware/software break-fix support throughout the organization.
  • Configure, deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot Windows workstations and laptops.
  • Support Microsoft 365 applications and services, including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Office applications.
  • Support Microsoft Intune endpoint management and on-premises Active Directory.
  • Support Windows Server environments, including basic administration, troubleshooting, patching, file services, permissions, and general server operations.
  • Troubleshoot TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN, Ethernet, wireless, and general network connectivity issues.
  • Perform basic configuration and troubleshooting of Cisco IOS network switches, including:
    • Switchport configuration
    • Access VLAN assignments
    • Interface status and error troubleshooting
    • Basic configuration review and validation
    • Common Cisco IOS show and configuration commands
  • Provide basic troubleshooting and support within environments containing Juniper network equipment. Deep Juniper engineering expertise is not required, but familiarity with Juniper networking concepts or the ability to work within a mixed-vendor environment is preferred.
  • Support cloud-based Webex Calling / VoIP systems, including phones, user configuration, basic troubleshooting, and connectivity issues.
  • Support physical network connectivity, patch panels, structured cabling, fiber connections, RJ45 cabling, and related infrastructure.
  • Maintain appropriate security, access controls, system configuration, endpoint protection, and data privacy practices.
  • Document system configurations, troubleshooting procedures, equipment changes, and technical solutions.
  • Manage and maintain the organization's IT service management/ticketing system and associated support workflows.
  • Work closely with Engineering, News, Production, Sales, and other departments to identify technology requirements and resolve operational issues.
  • Support specialized broadcast technology with assistance from Engineering staff and vendors as appropriate.
  • Read and interpret technical documentation, network diagrams, equipment manuals, and basic schematic drawings.
  • Assist vendors and other technical personnel with troubleshooting, installation, upgrades, and system maintenance.
  • Participate in planned maintenance, system upgrades, technology deployments, and infrastructure projects.
  • Respond to system outages and critical technology issues when required.
  • Ability to work occasional evenings, weekends, or extended hours for maintenance, upgrades, outages, major events, or other operational requirements.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong hands-on hardware troubleshooting and break/fix skills.
  • Strong Windows desktop and end-user support experience.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 / Office 365.
  • Experience supporting Microsoft Windows environments.
  • Experience with Microsoft Intune and on-premises Active Directory.
  • Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, Ethernet, and network troubleshooting.
  • Ability to troubleshoot problems methodically.
  • Strong customer service and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple technical issues in a fast-paced operational environment.
  • Ability to independently research problems, learn unfamiliar technologies, and work with vendors or other technical resources when necessary.
  • Ability to safely lift, carry, move, and position equipment weighing 50 pounds or more as required.

Preferred Technical Qualifications

Industry certifications are strongly preferred and may include:

  • CompTIA A+
  • CompTIA Network+
  • CompTIA Server+
  • Microsoft certifications related to Microsoft 365, Windows, Endpoint Management, Intune, Azure, or related technologies
  • Cisco certifications or equivalent Cisco networking experience

Equivalent hands-on professional experience may be considered in place of certifications.


Additional preferred experience includes:

  • Microsoft Intune
  • Active Directory
  • Windows Server
  • Microsoft 365 administration
  • Webex Calling / cloud-based VoIP
  • Cisco IOS switching
  • Juniper networking environments
  • Virtualization technologies
  • Server and storage hardware
  • IT service management / ticketing platforms
  • Familiarity with OBS Studio and/or vMix

Broadcast Technology Experience

Previous experience in television broadcasting, broadcast engineering, media production, newsroom technology, or similar environments is considered a plus.

Candidates are not required to be experienced broadcast engineers. A strong IT professional who has solid troubleshooting skills, understands networks and computer systems, and is willing to learn specialized broadcast technologies may be successful in this position.

Experience with broadcast automation, routing, storage, newsroom, editing, production, or related broadcast systems is beneficial.


Education and Experience

A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field is preferred but not required.

Relevant technical certifications, military technical experience, vocational training, or demonstrated professional IT experience may substitute for formal education.

Approximately 3–5 years of hands-on IT support, systems support, network support, or related technical experience is preferred.

Experience within a television station, broadcast facility, media organization, or other 24/7 operational environment is a plus.


Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate will be someone who enjoys hands-on troubleshooting and is comfortable working across a broad range of technologies.

A strong troubleshooting mindset, willingness to learn, good communication skills, and a “can do” attitude are more important than being an expert in every technology used within the facility.

job.title: Meteorologist
job.description:
They say Michigan only has two seasons: winter and construction. But WLNS-TV is looking for someone who is passionate about the new life in spring, beautiful summer days and nights, incredible foliage in the fall, and yes – some frigid winters.

We’re looking for a full time meteorologist or weather person.

This person must be passionate about the weather and an excellent communicator and forecaster. We want someone who understands the science and who can explain it in plain English.

A degree (or expected degree) in meteorology (or a related field) is required. So is some type of newsroom experience (either an internship or a job). This job involves doing the morning and evening shows on weekends and working two other days during the week. This person will often be responsible for “Weather Wednesday” – a franchise that explains weather-related issues and phenomena.

We’re also looking for a team player. You’ll be working closely with other meteorologists as well as the news team.

Experience with the WSI system is plus, but not essential. We have 2 Max systems, Max Reality, Prism, WSI Mobile, and numerous tower cams.

We take the weather seriously here. We track storms, we chase storms, and we win awards for our weather coverage. When there’s severe weather, we’re on first, we’re off last, and we broadcast on our website even when we’re not on TV.

While you’ll spent a lot of time in the weather center, we’ll also want you outside: showing us the elements and keeping track of road conditions. 

Lansing is a solid news and weather town and a great place to live. We’re a state capital, and with Michigan State University next door, we’ve got lots of arts, culture, and pretty good football and basketball teams, too.

Please include a link to your work on your application and/or your resume.

  • Produces and presents weather reports for all platforms.
  • Ensures that all weather content meets company standards for journalistic integrity and production quality.
  • Writes and delivers weather stories in a clear and concise manner.
  • Assists in writing, copy editing, researching and coordinating weather programming and other content.
  • Responds to breaking and/or severe weather events and other urgent newsrooms situations as required.
  • Works closely with the weather team to develop comprehensive weather coverage.
  • Participates in promotional activities including public appearances.
  • Performs special projects and other duties as assigned.
  • Writes web stories detailing the local forecast on a daily basis.
  • Interacts with viewers and users on social media sites.

 Requirements & Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Meteorology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience.
  • Fluency in English.
  • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written with the ability to ad lib when required.
  • Superior on-air presence.
  • Experience guiding, directing and motivating others.
  • Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize assignments and handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Ability to effectively listen to fully understand problems and communicate with a team to shape a solution.
  • Strong understanding of the field of meteorology and a proven track record of forecasting.
  • Valid driver’s license with a good driving record.
  • Flexibility to work any shift.

job.title: Senior Manager, International Football Development
job.description:

job.title: Senior Director of News, WKBW
job.description:
Senior Director of News, WKBW


Are you a proven news leader ready to elevate one of the most dynamic newsrooms in Western New York? WKBW, The E.W. Scripps ABC affiliate in Buffalo, New York, is seeking an experienced Senior Director of News to lead our newsroom and drive continued audience growth and journalistic excellence. This is your opportunity to lead a talented team of journalists committed to delivering critical community journalism that serves Buffalo and Western New York.

We're looking for a visionary leader who can inspire compelling storytelling, foster innovation, and navigate the rapidly evolving media landscape. If you're passionate about quality local journalism, digital innovation, developing great people, and building a positive, hard-charging newsroom culture, we want to hear from you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Create and implement strategic plans for audience growth and newsroom operations.
  • Develop and implement measurable strategies for audience growth while effectively managing news content delivered across multiple platforms.
  • Communicate a compelling and inspired vision consistent with company strategy.
  • Analyze and respond to trends affecting the industry and DMA.
  • Approve all newsroom personnel decisions.
  • Develop and control the annual budget in compliance with station guidelines.
  • Build and maintain key relationships to foster a positive news image within the Buffalo and Western New York community.
  • Monitor all on-air and online products for compliance with federal, state and local laws as well as First and Fourteenth Amendment requirements.
  • Work closely with other members of the station management team to develop and attain departmental and station goals.
  • Maintain knowledge of and proficiency in posting content to station websites.
  • Adapt current resources to emerging technology.
  • Supervise and provide regular feedback and yearly performance appraisals for direct reports, with ultimate responsibility for all newsroom personnel.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • At least 5 years of news management experience is required.
  • Bachelor's degree in journalism, communication or a related field preferred.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Demonstrated ability to track and select trending news stories.
  • Strong organizational skills.
  • Ability to lead and make sound decisions in a rapid, fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends and holidays.
  • Strong editorial judgment and knowledge of journalistic ethics and libel laws.
  • Ability to create tactics and strategies to increase audience performance in key target areas across multiple platforms.
  • Working knowledge of federal, state and local laws impacting operations.
  • Advanced oral and written communication skills.
  • Effectiveness in a variety of formal presentation settings, both inside and outside the organization.
  • Proven and effective leadership skills, including fostering open dialogue, empowering others, and addressing conflict quickly and directly.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY:

Buffalo, New York offers the energy and amenities of a major city with the accessibility and strong sense of community that make Western New York a distinctive place to call home. Located along the shores of Lake Erie and just a short drive from Niagara Falls, Buffalo combines rich history and architecture with professional sports, arts and culture, a vibrant food scene, and year-round opportunities to enjoy the outdoors.


Western New York is known for its passionate communities and strong local identity. From Buffalo's neighborhoods and waterfront to the surrounding communities of Western New York, the region offers plenty to explore. Whether you're taking in a Bills or Sabres game, experiencing the area's festivals and cultural attractions, exploring the waterfront, or making a quick trip to Niagara Falls, Buffalo offers a combination of big-city experiences and a welcoming community atmosphere.


For a news leader, Buffalo is a market where local journalism matters. At WKBW, you'll lead a newsroom focused on delivering important, relevant community journalism to audiences across Buffalo and Western New York while helping shape how that journalism reaches viewers across platforms. WKBW is Scripps' ABC affiliate in Buffalo.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, KGUN
job.description:
KGUN, The E.W. Scripps station in Tucson, AZ is looking for a driven, versatile Multimedia Journalist to research, write, shoot, and edit compelling stories across multiple platforms. In this role, you won't just report the news — you'll be out in the community, uncovering the stories that matter most to our viewers, capturing them with your own lens, and delivering them with impact. If you're energized by tight deadlines, passionate about community journalism, and ready to bring authenticity to every story you tell, we want to hear from you.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Pitch and develop story ideas.
  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interview, observation, and research.
  • Organize material, determine slant or emphasis, and write story according to prescribed editorial style and format standards.
  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.
  • Edit videos for all multimedia platforms.
  • Appear on-air and other online platforms
  • Give live reports from site of event or mobile broadcast unit.
  • Work cooperatively with photographer assigned to story, if one is assigned.

 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 3+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Computer literacy required, including newsroom computer systems
  • Videography and non-linear editing experience preferred
  • Knowledge of broadcast quality camera equipment
  • Edit video on Final Cut Pro editing systems, or similar equipment
  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills
  • Proficient at posting content to various websites
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced deadline-driven environment
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Tucson is a city where the desert comes alive — dramatic saguaro-studded landscapes, stunning sunsets, and a warm, welcoming culture that draws people in and keeps them here. Outdoor enthusiasts will love having Saguaro National Park split across both sides of the city, while Mount Lemmon offers hiking, skiing, and sweeping views that seem almost impossible given the desert below. The region's mild winters make year-round adventure the norm, not the exception. Beyond the outdoors, Tucson has a rich cultural identity rooted in its deep Native American, Spanish, and Mexican heritage. The vibrant Fourth Avenue district and downtown core are packed with independent restaurants, art galleries, live music venues, and local shops. Tucson's food scene earned it a spot as a UNESCO City of Gastronomy — the first in the United States — celebrated for its unique Sonoran cuisine and thriving farm-to-table movement. Home to the University of Arizona, Tucson pulses with youthful energy, sports fandom, and a growing tech and innovation sector. With a lower cost of living than many comparable cities and a tight-knit community feel, Tucson offers the perfect blend of big-city culture and laid-back desert living — an inspiring backdrop for any journalist ready to make their mark.

job.title: Meteorologist, WMAR
job.description:
WMAR, The E.W. Scripps Company ABC affiliate in Baltimore, Maryland, is seeking a Meteorologist to join our weather team. This is an exciting opportunity to deliver critical weather information to one of the Mid-Atlantic's most dynamic markets. You'll analyze meteorological data and prepare forecasts that help our community stay informed and safe, whether it's tracking severe weather or planning their week ahead.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Prepare and deliver daily weathercasts utilizing all available weather data and graphics computers.
  • Prepare and deliver urgent weather updates interrupting regular programming as necessary.
  • Prepare and deliver all weathercast materials over a variety of mediums, including, but not limited to: TV, Radio, Internet.
  • Assist management in evaluations of potential new weather data gathering and presentation computers.
  • Receive assignments or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.
  • Report live from event sites or mobile broadcast unit.
  • May write and produce quality news and weather stories for multiple media platforms.
  • May report, write, capture visual content, edit and produce stories for multiple platforms on deadline, such as Internet and digital channels.
  • Work cooperatively with photographer assigned to story, if one is assigned.
  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interview, observation, and research.
  • Perform other duties as needed and assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Bachelors degree in Meteorology preferred
  • Generally 3+ years experience in related field preferred
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Computer literacy required, including weather and newsroom computer systems
  • Knowledge of broadcast quality camera equipment
  • Knowledge of editing systems
  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills
  • Proficient at posting content to various websites
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY:

Baltimore, Maryland, is a vibrant city rich in history and culture, offering an exceptional quality of life on the Chesapeake Bay. Known as "Charm City," Baltimore boasts world-class attractions including the National Aquarium, historic Fort McHenry, and the iconic Inner Harbor. The city's diverse neighborhoods each have their own character, from the cobblestone streets of Fells Point to the artistic energy of Station North. Food lovers will appreciate Baltimore's famous crab cakes and thriving restaurant scene, while sports fans can cheer on the Orioles at Camden Yards or the Ravens at M&T Bank Stadium. With easy access to Washington, D.C., Philadelphia, and the beaches of the Eastern Shore, Baltimore offers the perfect blend of urban excitement and coastal living. The city's affordable cost of living compared to other major East Coast metros, combined with its strong sense of community and rich cultural heritage, makes it an ideal place to call home.

job.title: Live Broadcast Engineer
job.description:
Do you thrive when the stakes are highest and the cameras are live? Operations Shared Services is looking for a driven, detail-obsessed Live Broadcast Engineer to manage and drive reliability within a fast-paced, multichannel on-air operations environment — maintaining optimal on-air availability and reliability for live events. This is a critical role at the heart of what we do: keeping our broadcasts on air, our audiences engaged, and our team performing at the highest level, 24/7.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Coordinate with other engineers and master control; provide guidance for the execution of master control functions pertaining to live-event execution.
  • Coordinate with master control supervisor to train operators in operational best practices, issue resolution, and recovery of live events.
  • Develop a deep knowledge of the operation's technical architecture and on-air systems.
  • Resolve issues quickly and effectively to prevent on-air discrepancies.
  • Manage the end-to-end execution of all live events including preparation, in-event execution, and off-air adjustments.
  • Actively participate in the operation's change control procedures by approving and maintaining awareness of all on-air maintenances and by managing critical components of maintenance operating procedures.
  • Assume transmission responsibilities as needed, including monitoring of uplinks, booking, QCing (monitoring for quality control) and occasional remotes.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Associates degree in a related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally 2+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Ability to prioritize and adapt to changing scenarios preferred
  • Thorough understanding of television production, broadcast engineering operations, and/or news/sports/entertainment technical production requirements
  • Technological curiosity and an improvement-oriented approach
  • Unwavering composure in high-pressure situations
  • Demonstrated record of meeting or exceeding performance expectations preferred
  • Acute attention to detail
  • Excellent interpersonal communication skills
  • Willingness and availability to work flexible hours, including overnight shifts, weekends, and holidays is required to support 24x7 operation

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Clearwater, Florida is a sun-soaked Gulf Coast gem known for its strikingly clear turquoise waters and white-sand beaches — most notably Clearwater Beach, consistently ranked among the best beaches in the United States. The city offers an active, outdoor-forward lifestyle with year-round boating, kayaking, paddleboarding, and fishing right at your doorstep, along with easy access to dozens of parks and nature preserves throughout the region.

As part of the greater Tampa Bay area, Clearwater residents enjoy all the cultural amenities of a major metro while living at a more relaxed pace. The region is home to professional sports teams including the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, Rays, and Lightning, as well as a thriving restaurant scene, live music venues, and world-class attractions like the Clearwater Marine Aquarium. Spring training baseball brings added energy each year, with the Philadelphia Phillies calling nearby Spectrum Field home.

Beyond the beach, Clearwater and the surrounding Tampa Bay area are experiencing exciting growth across the arts, tech, and culinary sectors. With a relatively affordable cost of living compared to other Florida metros, no state income tax, and a warm climate virtually year-round, Clearwater is a place where your career and your quality of life can both flourish.

The ideal co-host will conduct live and taped paid and non-paid interviews, segments and packages, participate in product demonstrations, produce segments in the studio and in the field. job.title: Scheduling Coordinator
job.description:
TelevisaUnivision is seeking a detail-oriented Scheduling Coordinator to support Noticias 24/7, a News streaming channel on our streaming service, VIX. This position plays an essential role in ensuring the integrity of the streaming service to deliver viewer satisfaction.


The Scheduling Coordinator will accurately schedule content playlists, maintain program calendars, oversee playout, and manage all program data. Additionally, this role contributes to the execution of scheduling strategies and operations, including collaboration in the development of promotional materials, coordinating deliverables between multiple departments, and participating in the evaluation and implementation of workflows and systems.


ABOUT YOU:

The successful candidate will be organized, detail-oriented and deadline-driven, as well as very comfortable learning and using program scheduling and playout systems both on-site and remotely. As this is a 24-hour a day news service, this individual would be on-call to support breaking news or off-hour playlist changes as needed.

 

YOUR DAY-DAY: (aka Responsibilities)

  • Schedule all long-form programming for streaming news service based on strategic direction from supervisor.
  • Develop fluency in using the scheduling software and executing workflows for a flawless on-air experience.

job.title: Project Management Coordinator
job.description:
The Engineering Project Management department supports the planning and execution of engineering, technology, and broadcast infrastructure projects across the organization. The team works closely with Engineering, Broadcast Operations, Technology, Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, and external vendors to keep projects organized, on track, and moving forward. The Coordinator is the operational backbone of the team, providing day-to-day coordination, tracking, documentation, and follow-through across the project portfolio.


ABOUT YOU:

You are highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities at once. You enjoy keeping projects moving, making sure the right people have the right information, and following through on the details that drive successful execution. You are proactive, resourceful, and comfortable working across Engineering, Operations, Finance, Procurement, and vendors. You don't need to be the technical expert—you know how to coordinate people, information, schedules, and resources to help the team deliver.


YOUR DAY-DAY:

  • Support Project Managers with the day-to-day coordination and execution of engineering and operational projects.
  • Maintain project plans, schedules, trackers, action items, milestones, and deliverables.
  • Coordinate project meetings, agendas, notes, follow-ups, and stakeholder communications.
  • Track project deadlines, dependencies, and outstanding actions and proactively follow up with stakeholders.
  • Maintain project budgets, purchase orders, invoices, commitments, and spend trackers.
  • Support Project Managers with budget updates, forecasting, reconciliation, and reporting.
  • Coordinate with vendors on quotes, purchase orders, deliveries, schedules, and project requirements.
  • Track vendor deliverables, invoices, shipments, and outstanding issues.
  • Support Procurement and Finance processes related to project purchases.
  • Track equipment orders, shipments, deliveries, inventory, and installation schedules.
  • Coordinate logistics between vendors, Engineering, Operations, Facilities, and other stakeholders.
  • Maintain organized project files, contracts, purchase orders, schedules, and other project documentation.
  • Prepare project status reports, presentations, trackers, and other materials for project and leadership meetings.
  • Identify and escalate potential delays, risks, or issues to the Project Manager.
  • Support project closeout activities and ensure outstanding deliverables and documentation are completed.

YOU HAVE:

  • Bachelor's degree preferred in Business, Engineering, Project Management, Technology, or a related field.
  • 2–4 years of experience in project coordination, operations, administration, engineering, technology, or a related environment.
  • Experience coordinating vendors, purchase orders, invoices, procurement, or logistics preferred.
  • Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent follow-through and a proactive approach to problem solving.
  • Ability to work effectively across multiple functions and with both internal and external stakeholders.
