  • Access and Identity - enabling several authorization and authentication mechanisms as well as a powerful access decision engine
  • Data Platform - enabling storing, processing and getting insights from readership data

 

You will have the autonomy to select the tools and technologies you need to build and operate services responsible for FT brand critical capabilities. Someone who is comfortable with the ever changing technical landscape and is keen to contribute to the company’s processes and broader know-how would thrive in this role.

The Access & Identity team as the name implies is responsible for two sets of capabilities - deciding whether to give access to content in different FT domains and supporting a set of different authorisation and authentication APIs as well as different functionalities regarding our B2B customers, GDPR deletion flows and users' profiles.

You will be responsible for delivering innovative technical solutions as you build and operate world class platforms. You will have the autonomy, within defined guard rails, to select the tools and technologies you need to build and operate services.

We have recently published our Engineering Progression framework and associated competencies for a Software Engineer relevant to this position

 

The Tech Stack

We often use these, it's not an exhaustive list but gives you a taste of what our technology stack and tools look like:

  • Java/Spring Boot
  • Go Lang
  • Kubernetes (EKS)
  • AWS
  • GraphQL
  • CircleCI
  • DynamoDB
  • Kafka
  • Cloudflare
  • Prometheus/Grafana/Splunk 

 

The hiring process

We understand that tech interviews are often stressful for no good reason, so we designed our interview process to be rigorous but friendly. We have a friendly system design exercise and a set of questions to encourage you to tell us about your strengths and what makes you happy at work.

We're committed to equality and diversity in the tech industry, so we'll be especially happy to see applications from under-represented backgrounds. We encourage this by considering flexible working hours as well as tuning the hiring process to promote diversity.

 

This role will be right for you if you are happy to:

  • Work directly with product managers and senior stakeholders to fully shape solutions from inception to deployment and beyond
  • Work within a team of engineers in an agile delivery team
  • Design and implement low maintenance, well monitored, secure and scalable solutions, from cradle to grave
  • Understand and play an active part in designing the architecture, tooling and release cycle processes used by the engineering teams across Product & Technology
  • Contribute to company-wide processes, frameworks and guidelines
  • Develop a close relationship with our customers and provide operational support

 

The ideal candidate profile is: 

Essential

  • Minimum 5 years of proven project-based experience of building and maintaining distributed systems
  • Highly proficient in Java or/and Go (preferable Java)
  • Has a track record of delivering well engineered solutions using current technologies and best practices such as SOLID, TDD, CI/CD and pair programming
  • Being able to cover non-functional requirements such as performance, scalability, high availability, monitoring and security
  • Proof of designing and building RESTful APIs 
  • An active member of the broader technology community with an understand of current leading trends
  • Experience working as part of an Agile delivery team, using methodologies like Scrum and Kanban
  • Experience with Spring
  • Good understanding of the principles and trade-offs of a microservices architecture
  • Good working experience of at least one cloud infrastructure, ideally AWS
  • Good SQL/NoSQL knowledge
  • Comfortable working in a Linux environment
  • Comfortable working with code assisting AI tools such as Codex
  • Being able to establish and be promoter of good coding and engineering practices
  • Being able to architect and lead the development of solutions based on functional requirements
  • Conducting comprehensive and impactful code reviews
  • Being able to mentor other team members
  • Good command of written and spoken English

Desirable

  • Experience in an environment where operational support and monitoring of code and systems is part of the culture (DevOps)
  • Experience in building life systems with a high traffic/load
  • Ability to accurately monitor and analyse system performance using tools like Grafana/Splunk
  • Ability to troubleshoot and cope with live incidents
  • Holds an industry certification in a key platform, tool or domain used within Engineering at the FT. This could be any relevant certification but currently we are recommending it's an AWS Associate certificate

 

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

  • Annual bonus scheme
  • 25 days paid leave
  • 24/7 Employee Assistance Program
  • Life Insurance
  • Enhanced Parental Leave policy
  • Food Allowance
  • Multisport Card
  • Both in house and external training programs
  • Your own training dedicated budget (for conferences, courses etc.)

 

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help.

 

Further information

At the FT, we embrace innovation and the use of technology and appreciate that individuals may leverage AI tools as part of their job application process. job.title: On-Call Events Coordinator
job.description:
Title: On-Call Events Coordinator

Schedule Format : Hybrid - San Francisco

Pay Information: Hourly Rate: $25.37/hr - $31.71/hr

Position Summary

KQED is seeking organized and service-minded On-Call Event Coordinators to support the Events & Experiences team in delivering exceptional live programming and hosted gatherings for our audiences, donors, and partners. This position provides day-of-event support to producers and event managers, ensuring polished operations, excellent guest experience, and seamless coordination with vendors.

The On-Call Event Coordinator assists with a wide range of events serving our public programming series KQED Live at the theater in our studio headquarters, as well as larger, more logistically complex off-site events around the Bay Area. The Coordinators may also support social and informational events for members and philanthropic supporters, third-party rentals of KQED’s venue for mission-aligned client organizations, and other institutional events for staff and internal stakeholders, on assignment basis. This role is ideal for individuals who thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy problem-solving on the fly, and are enthusiastic about live events and the important role that in-person gatherings play in rooting local communities. Hours vary based on KQED’s event calendar and may include evenings, weekends, and occasional holidays.

 

KQED envisions a public media organization with a culture that centers on human dignity, equity, and belonging. This will enable us to better serve and reflect the Bay Area through diverse and inclusive storytelling. 

We value the contributions of marginalized people in society — including Black, Indigenous, and all people of color,  people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people — and we believe that these communities must be centered in the work we do, and we strongly encourage members of these communities to apply.

KQED Code of Ethics  https://www.kqed.org/about/code-ethics

The mission that drives us:

KQED provide citizens of Northern California with a community-supported alternative to commercial media.   We provide citizens with the knowledge they need to make informed decisions; convene community dialogue; bring the arts to everyone and engage audiences to share their stories. We help students and teachers thrive in 21st-century classrooms, and take people of all ages on journeys of exploration- exposing them to new people, places and ideas.

This role will work hybrid between working in KQED's newly renovated headquarters and working remotely.

Essential Functions

  • Provide on-site support for public programs, donor and internal events, and rental events, including onstage talks, receptions, performances, screenings, seated dinners, daylong seminars/workshops, multivendor festivals and markets, and other formats.
  • Assist producers and event managers with day-of logistics and run-of-show execution.
  • Coordinate with and support external vendors such as caterers, AV/technical teams, and rental clients to ensure smooth load-in, execution, clean-up, strike, and load-out. 
  • Coordinate with KQED facilities, custodial, security, and parking teams to ensure fulfillment of event requirements.
  • Support guest services, including check-in, ticketing, seating, and audience wayfinding.
  • Monitor event spaces to ensure safety, accessibility, cleanliness, and a welcoming environment.
  • Serve as a day-of liaison for onstage talent, vendors, donors, and guests as directed by the producer or manager.
  • Troubleshoot operational and logistical issues quickly and effectively, escalating to producers or managers when needed.
  • Uphold KQED’s standards for hospitality, inclusivity, and community engagement and serve as a friendly, professional ambassador for KQED with talent, attendees, and partners. 
  • Assume other event-related responsibilities as assigned.
     

Knowledge/Experience Required

  • Prior experience in event coordination, hospitality, production, or customer service.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills with attention to detail.
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing needs in live event and production environments.
  • Comfortable working with diverse audiences and external stakeholders in a professional manner.
  • Successful completion of California Food Handler training and California Responsible Beverage Service training by an accredited program will be required of candidates who do not already possess. 
  • Ability to work evenings, weekends, and occasional holidays on an on-call basis.
  • Must be able to lift up to 25 lbs and remain on feet for extended periods during events.
     

Knowledge/Experience Preferred 

  • Experience supporting live stage events, festivals, donor events, galas, or high-level client functions.
  • Familiarity with AV/technical production, catering logistics, and vendor coordination.
  • Experience in cultural institutions, nonprofits, or media organizations.
  • Spanish, Mandarin, Cantonese, Tagalog or other community language skills are a plus

job.title: Business Intelligence Solution Developer
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Role Overview

The Business Intelligence (BI) Solution Developer serves as a key member of the Measurement Enablement team, responsible for ensuring client healthcare marketing data is accurate, current, and ready for reporting and analysis. This role bridges the gap between Data Engineering, analytics teams, and client stakeholders by managing data ingestion processes, validating data quality, maintaining reporting-ready data structures, and resolving issues throughout the data lifecycle. 

The ideal candidate enjoys investigating data questions, identifying root causes of data discrepancies, improving data quality, and working across multiple teams to ensure reliable data powers business decisions. 

This role can be remote within the United States or based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville, NJ, San Francisco, or Carmel, IN. 

Primary Responsibilities 

Data Ingestion & Source Management 

  • Coordinate the onboarding of new client data sources and data feeds.  
  • Partner with Data Engineering to ensure successful ingestion of data into Databricks.  
  • Monitor data delivery schedules and ingestion processes.  
  • Maintain source documentation, field mappings, and data inventories.  
  • Work directly with internal teams and external partners to resolve source-related issues. 

Data Quality & Stewardship 

  • Monitor data freshness, completeness, and accuracy across client datasets.  
  • Perform ongoing quality assurance and reconciliation checks.  
  • Investigate missing, unexpected, or inconsistent data.  
  • Escalate, coordinate and resolve remediation efforts with the appropriate teams.  
  • Maintain documentation of data quality findings and resolutions.  
  • Support the development of automated data quality checks and monitoring processes. 

Data Modeling 

  • Develop and maintain client-specific standard, custom, and master tables and reporting views within Databricks based on a medallion architecture.  
  • Assist with transforming and standardizing data from multiple sources into reporting-ready structures. 
  • Solve problems and help build solutions related to the data model to meet evolving reporting and analysis needs. 
  • Document business rules, transformation logic, and metric definitions.  
  • Support maintenance of reusable reporting datasets and standardized data models. 

Stakeholder Support 

  • Act as the primary point of contact for routine data-related questions.  
  • Partner with Client Services, Media, Strategy, and Data teams to align on data outputs and expectations. 
  • Work with analysts and measurement leads to understand reporting requirements, translate into technical requirements, and provide database-modeled data for reporting.  
  • Communicate data issues, impacts, and resolutions to stakeholders.  
  • Assist with troubleshooting data discrepancies impacting reporting deliverables. 

Reporting Support 

  • Support Power BI developers and business analysts with data-related questions.  
  • Assist with report validation and troubleshooting.  
  • Help verify data displayed in dashboards aligns with source systems and business requirements.  
  • Provide support for semantic models and reporting datasets when needed. 

Qualifications

  • Strong SQL and Python skills, in a Databricks environment preferrable. 
  • Experience using ETL tools and data manipulation concepts (Funnel.io, DBT, or similar applications). 
  • Comfort partnering with Data Engineering on data sources, schemas, and refresh logic. 
  • Deep analytical and problem-solving skills related to data storage and structure for reporting.
  • Experience reviewing data logic, KPI definitions, and QA outputs. 
  • Basic BI (Tableau, Power BI) skills including data modeling, dashboard structure, calculated fields, usability, data storytelling. 
  • Strong written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
  • Ability to translate complex business reporting requests into modeled data to support current and future analysis. 

Preferred / Bonus 

  • Pharma, HCP, or healthcare media analytics experience, including experience with media PLD (Physician Level Data).  
  • Digital media measurement expertise (media KPIs, attribution concepts, omnichannel analysis). 
  • Experience inheriting or stabilizing existing data warehouse schemas. 

Pay Range: $90,000-$110,000

This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting.  Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, skills, certifications, and geographical location. The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. 

Real Chemistry is proud to be Great Place to Work® certified; check out what our people shared about our culture and workplace on our Great Places to Work Profile here.

We believe we can do our best when feeling our best, which is why we’ve put together a benefits program designed to give you the support you and your family need at every stage of life. Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefit program and perks, tailored to your region. Globally, this includes offices in our key markets with free snacks to keep you running all day long, generous holiday and paid time off, options for private medical, dental, and vison plans, and support in saving for the future. Other perks include mental wellness coaching and support and access to more than 13,000 online classes with LinkedIn Learning.  Learn more about our great benefits and perks and search specific offerings in your region at: www.realchemistrybenefits.com.

At Real Chemistry, we believe we're at our best when we're connected. Our Real Hybrid and Regional Teams (Real HART) approach is designed to foster collaboration, learning, innovation, and meaningful relationships while providing flexibility where appropriate. Because our workforce spans multiple countries, regions, and client needs, work arrangements may vary by role and location. Some positions offer hybrid or remote flexibility, while others require regular in-office presence. For example, certain teams and regions, including some of our UK operations, have office-based requirements. Your recruiter will discuss the specific expectations for the role you're pursuing during the interview process and keep you informed throughout the hiring journey. For employees located within a one-hour commute of a Real Chemistry office, we require in-person attendance two days per week, either from a Real Chemistry office or when working onsite with clients. Employees in regions without a nearby office may work remotely and come together throughout the year for collaboration, culture-building, learning, and team connection opportunities. While these guidelines reflect our current workplace model, we understand that everyone’s circumstances are unique. If you require additional flexibility, we welcome an open conversation with your recruiter and our HR team to discuss your needs and determine what may be possible.

Real Chemistry is an Equal Opportunity employer. We continually strive to build and sustain an inclusive and equitable work environment where our employees feel empowered to leverage all they bring from their personal lived experience and professional expertise, to make our team the best in the industry. We encourage motivated and qualified applicants to apply without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, ethnic or national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, marital information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local employment discrimination laws where Real Chemistry operates. Should you require accommodations throughout the interview process please let your recruiter know.

Do not share personal or financial information or make payments to any unverified sources claiming to be connected to Real Chemistry. job.title: Associate, Financial Situations
job.description:
Opportunity 

Brunswick Group is seeking an Associate to join our Financial practice.

Brunswick was founded in 1987 as a financial communications firm, expertise that continues to differentiate us. For nearly four decades, Brunswick has consistently ranked at the top of our industry’s league tables on a country, regional, and global basis.

Our global Financial practice has unparalleled experience developing and implementing campaigns to advise clients on both long-term positioning to enhance valuation and navigating complex capital markets transactions. Members of our Financial practice are deeply experienced and focus their client work on mergers & acquisitions, shareholder activism, IPOs, strategic investor relations and financial communications, and restructuring. These specialists partner with global colleagues to bring a powerful and complementary combination of perspectives across stakeholders to help clients manage their reputations during critical financial events.

About the Role

Client Contribution & Handling
  • Advise clients on the communications implications of complex financial and corporate situations.
  • Produce and refine press releases, strategic plans, presentations, talking points, Q&As, briefing materials and other client communications with precision, speed and sound judgment.
  • Develop and execute integrated communications strategies that connect business objectives with the needs of investors, financial media, employees, regulators and other influential stakeholders.
  • Translate complex financial, strategic and market developments into clear, compelling narratives, messaging frameworks and recommendations for varied audiences.
  • Contribute to strategic discussions with senior executives and collaborate closely with legal and financial advisors on sensitive, fast-moving matters.
  • Plan and deliver high-stakes announcements and campaigns, including transaction communications, corporate positioning, media engagement and executive preparation.
  • Understand how earned media, digital and owned channels, stakeholder engagement and executive communications work together to advance client objectives.
Team Management
  • Manage day-to-day workstreams and client deliverables across multiple engagements, maintaining quality, responsiveness and attention to detail.
  • Work with Partners and Directors to coordinate integrated account teams, collaborate across Brunswick practices and anticipate evolving client needs.
  • Manage drafting, review and approval processes across client teams and external advisors, often under significant time pressure.
  • Direct research and analysis of companies, sectors, financial developments, media coverage and stakeholder perspectives; convert findings into actionable advice.
  • Mentor junior colleagues, provide constructive feedback and help foster a collaborative, high-performing team.
Networking & Practice Development
  • Contribute entrepreneurially to the growth of Brunswick’s Financial practice through new business development, proposals and thought leadership.
  • Build trusted relationships with clients and prospective clients, journalists, financial and legal advisors, and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Identify emerging issues and opportunities where integrated financial communications advice can create value for clients.

What We're Looking For

  • 7 – 10+ years of relevant experience in financial or corporate communications, strategic advisory, a communications agency, financial journalism, or an in-house corporate role.
  • Experience supporting complex corporate situations or communications programs; exposure to M&A, activism, IPOs, restructurings or other capital markets events is strongly valued.
  • Strong commercial acumen and an understanding of how corporate strategy, financial performance and market developments shape reputation and stakeholder expectations.
  • Ability to interpret financial information and explain complex business issues clearly.
  • Demonstrated ability to counsel or support senior executives and work effectively alongside financial and legal advisors.
  • Excellent writing, editing and presentation skills, with experience creating high-quality materials for different stakeholder groups and communications channels.
  • Sound judgment, creativity and the ability to learn new companies and sectors quickly, prioritize competing demands and operate with imperfect information.
  • Experience managing projects and mentoring junior colleagues; a collaborative, proactive and entrepreneurial approach.
  • Discretion, integrity and commitment to confidentiality when handling sensitive client information.

Why Join Us  

Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of exceptional employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.  

The successful applicant will be eligible for the following compensation and benefits package:  

Base Pay: The annual base compensation range for this role is $130,000 - $170,000. The base pay offered will be determined by factors including experience, skills, training, office location, certifications, and education.  

Bonus Eligibility: Annual discretionary bonus contingent upon individual and firm-wide performance.  

Benefits: Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance. Disability insurance. Employee assistance program. Flexible spending account. Health savings account. Life insurance. Commuter Benefits. Generous Paid Time Off: 25 vacation days and 10 days sick leave, as well as 11 paid company holidays. Firm-sponsored 401(k) Plan with 3% automatic company contribution of base and bonus with an additional 1.5% profit share– immediate vesting. Career training and development opportunities. Employee discounts. 

Office Policy: At Brunswick, our work is a craft that thrives in teaching environments – whether in our offices or on-site with clients – through real-time observation, collaboration, human connection, clear guidance and by challenging one another to keep getting better. Our policy is that our team members are in person – either in the office or on-site with clients – at least four days each week.  

The firm will provide reasonable accommodation to qualified applicants or employees, as defined by applicable law. In addition to the application, the process may include virtual and in-person interviews, as well as an assessment, which may be timed. To request an accommodation during our application and hiring process, email americasaccommodations@brunswickgroup.com. 

About Brunswick

Brunswick is a global advisory firm. We help companies tackle high-stakes issues, navigate complex stakeholder relationships, and deliver high-impact outcomes. 

Our clients value our ability to anticipate, shape, and respond to the key players and forces in the financial and investment arena, regulatory and geopolitical universe, NGO community, workforce and beyond. They rely on us for deep experience, fresh perspectives and original thinking. So, in Brunswick you will find an exceptional range of experience and talent with a rich mix of backgrounds. From the beginning, we have prioritized attracting, developing, and retaining the best professionals in the industry, united by a culture of inclusivity, excellence, and intellectual curiosity.

Founded in 1987 in London, the firm has organically grown to 27 offices in 18 countries across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia and Australia. We operate as a “one-firm firm” with no individual profit centers. This allows us to assemble fully integrated, bespoke teams for each client, able to draw on the full resources of Brunswick anywhere in the world. 

 

Brunswick is an equal opportunity employer.  All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law. Please read our Global Privacy Notice to understand how your data is managed.

job.title: Manager - Statutory Accounting & Reporting
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

WPP Shared Service Centre (SSC)

The WPP SSC provides transactional financial services to WPP companies in the UK, including:

-             Accounts Payable, including Intercompany transactions

-             Accounts Receivable (Billing, Credit Control & Cash Allocation)

-             Treasury

-             Accounting and Reporting

-             Statutory Reporting

By consolidating activities, the WPP SSC takes advantage of volume to deliver increased efficiency.  This is achieved by standardising, streamlining, and aligning relevant processes, and introducing tools and technology to drive effectiveness across our operations. By taking over transactional financial activities, the WPP SSC enables our agencies to focus on commercial activities, client management as well as revenue and cost management.

In 2021, the WPP SSC UK organisation transferred specific process and transactional activities to the WPP SSC in India. The WPP SSC teams in the UK and India work together to provide services to WPP companies in the UK.

Why we're hiring:

The WPP SSC is on a global transformation journey, and this is an opportunity to join the UK team to help us deliver exceptional financial services to our UK companies.

What you'll be doing:

Management and delivery of the Statutory reporting for all UK registered entities at Companies House.  This role will report into the Head of Global Statutory Reporting.

  • The team manages the delivery of approximately 150 UK statutory accounts annually;
  • End-to-end production of statutory accounts using both an excel template for data collection and input on our statutory reporting software system, including generation of iXBRL files;
  • Key contact along with the Head of Global Statutory Reporting for CFOs, Finance Directors and Financial Controllers on statutory reporting requirements, issues and associated questions;
  • Working with the Head of Global Statutory Reporting to onboard a number of new operating companies supported by GBS UK for their statutory reporting needs;
  • Key point of contact for external auditors on statutory audit related issues and questions; to provide guidance and advice on auditing, audit tests and SoX guidelines across GBS UK;
  • Collation of corporation tax packs, working with the operating company teams on submission to the Group’s tax consultants to ensure timely submission of corporate tax returns;
  • The department also assists with the dissolutions of WPP Holding and operating companies in conjunction with WPP Legal, WPP Tax and the operating companies;
  • Review accounting step plans for dissolutions and assist WPP Legal in writing up the legal documentation surrounding dissolutions;

What you'll need:

  • Qualified accountant (ACA/ACCA) with strong technical accounting skills
  • Experience of reporting under IFRS and in a SOX control environment;
  • Experience producing UK statutory accounts for multiple entities using statutory reporting software (ideally Caseware or Workiva);
  • Experience dealing with external auditors and ability to drive the audit process;
  • Excellent communication skills – able to communicate effectively both internally and externally, verbally and in writing, as well as at different levels of an organization;
  • Commercially focused with a proactive service-oriented approach;
  • Able to build and maintain strong internal and external working relationships;
  • Excellent IT skills (Microsoft Office at intermediate to advanced level), particularly MS Excel, which should be intermediate/advanced (pivot tables; conditional formatting etc.)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high level of attention to detail;
  • Managing of own workload to ensure consistent service levels;
  • There may also be a requirement to work additional hours occasionally due to tight deadlines and month-end processes.

Who you are:

You’re open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You’re optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with confidence: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You’re extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we deliver extraordinary every day.

job.title: Senior People Partner
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we’re hiring

WPP is seeking a versatile and highly capable Senior People Partner to join our Corporate People Team and based in New York. This role will serve as a trusted right hand to the VP, People, North America while providing dedicated People partnership to assigned global functions, likely including Finance and People subfunctions. We are a company and a function driving critical simplification and modernization. Agility and judgement has never been more important in our work – and that is our global team mindset.

The Senior People Partner will support the employee experience for more than 600 WPP HQ employees in the US. This includes coordinating annual People core process cycles, overseeing hiring and onboarding activities, responding to employee and leader needs, and serving as a point of escalation for our global team of HR Business Partners on US-centric matters.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can move easily between strategic, operational, and administrative work as a key member of a global HRBP team. One day may involve helping a leader navigate a sensitive employee matter; the next may include coordinating a hiring exception, validating Workday data, updating an orientation presentation, or drafting communications for the annual compensation cycle.

The right person will bring strong judgment, discretion, warmth, resourcefulness, and exceptional follow-through. They will be comfortable with ambiguity, energized by change, and motivated to find practical solutions to whatever comes their way.

What you’ll do

People partnership and US support

  • Serve as the People Partner for assigned global corporate functions, building trusted relationships with senior leaders and employees in New York and other locations.  The portfolio may evolve as business needs change.
  • Develop an understanding of each HQ function’s business priorities, organizational structure, talent, and ways of working.
  • Advise leaders on day-to-day People matters, including organizational changes, workforce planning, performance management, employee engagement, and team effectiveness.
  • Serve as a trusted right hand to the VP, People, helping translate priorities into action and ensuring decisions and commitments are carried through.
  • Help support the broader experience of WPP’s 600+ HQ employees in the US.
  • Act as a point of escalation for HR Business Partners on US-centric People matters, resolving issues within the role’s scope and escalating to the VP, People when appropriate.
  • Partner closely with Finance, Legal, Employee Relations, and other specialist teams on sensitive or higher-risk matters.
  • Help oversee and support WPP’s US Executive Assistant population, including hiring, onboarding, performance, development, and employee experience needs.

Annual People cycles and communications

  • Coordinate annual People processes, including goal setting, performance reviews, salary and bonus planning, stock planning, and related talent activities.
  • Develop project plans, timelines, trackers, presentations, FAQs, manager resources, and other materials needed to execute these programs successfully.
  • Create and implement communication plans that help leaders and employees understand process requirements, deadlines, and available resources.
  • Draft clear employee communications, leader guidance, talking points, presentations, and follow-up messages.
  • Monitor participation and completion, follow up with leaders and employees, troubleshoot issues, and escalate risks where needed.
  • Coordinate with People Centers of Expertise (COEs), Global Business Services (GBS), Finance and other stakeholders to ensure decisions and employee changes are processed accurately and on time.

Hiring, onboarding, and employee support

  • Serve as the primary People point of contact for hiring within assigned Finance and People functions.
  • Act as the day-to-day liaison among Finance and/or People leaders, Talent Acquisition, GBS, and other stakeholders, maintaining momentum and resolving bottlenecks.
  • Manage the hiring exception approval process, including gathering information, coordinating approvals, maintaining trackers, communicating decisions, and following requests through completion.
  • Facilitate new-hire orientation and partner with managers to create effective onboarding plans.
  • Coordinate with GBS on onboarding workflows, Workday steps, documentation, and employee data, monitoring execution and resolving issues that could affect the new-hire experience.
  • Maintain and update orientation presentations, onboarding materials, and manager resources.
  • Serve as an accessible and trusted contact for employees, helping them navigate People policies, benefits, systems, and resources and connecting them with the appropriate specialist when needed.
  • Act as an authentic champion of WPP’s culture, helping employees feel welcomed, informed, and supported.

Operational oversight, data, and process improvement

  • Partner closely with the offshore Global Business Services (GBS) HR Operations team, which executes Workday transactions, onboarding workflows, employee lifecycle administration, and other recurring People activities.
  • Provide GBS with clear requirements, context, priorities, and deadlines; monitor progress and review work for accuracy and completeness.
  • Manage cross-team handoffs, address service gaps, and resolve or escalate delays and other delivery issues.
  • Remain accountable for the quality and timeliness of the employee and leader experience, even when administrative execution sits with GBS.
  • Navigate Workday to review, validate, and reconcile employee information and confirm that required transactions are completed accurately.
  • Respond to employee and leader data requests and use Excel to organize, reconcile, manipulate, analyze, and summarize employee data.
  • Create useful reports, trackers, presentations, and insights to support People processes and business decisions.
  • Identify inefficient or unclear processes and develop practical workflows, documentation, templates, and tools to improve them.
  • Bring structure and momentum to ambiguous assignments, clarify ownership, remove roadblocks, and drive work through completion.
  • Explore how technology, automation, and AI can improve People-team efficiency, data analysis, communications, and service delivery.

What you’ll bring

  • At least eight years of progressive experience in Human Resources, People Operations, HR business partnering, or a related People function.
  • Broad HR experience and the judgment to move confidently between employee support, leader advising, operational execution, detailed administration, and strategic problem-solving.
  • Experience supporting employees and leaders in a complex, fast-moving, and preferably global or matrixed organization.
  • Experience coordinating annual People processes such as performance reviews, goal setting, compensation planning, and talent activities.
  • Experience partnering with Talent Acquisition and managing hiring workflows, approvals, and stakeholder follow-up.
  • Experience overseeing HR operational delivery through GBS, offshore, or similarly matrixed teams and influencing outcomes without formal authority.
  • Working knowledge of US employment practices and the judgment to recognize when Legal, Employee Relations, or another specialist should be engaged.
  • Workday proficiency, including the ability to review employee information, validate transactions, and identify discrepancies.
  • Strong Excel, data-management, PowerPoint, project-management, and organizational skills.
  • Excellent writing skills, with the ability to create polished, concise communications and materials for employees and leaders.
  • The maturity, discretion, and composure required to handle sensitive information and interact credibly with senior leaders.

How you’ll work

You will thrive in this role if you:

  • Have a “get it done” mentality and take ownership through final resolution.
  • Are equally comfortable advising a leader, welcoming a new employee, analyzing a spreadsheet, updating a presentation, or chasing down an approval.
  • Exercise strong judgment without needing a playbook for every situation.
  • Anticipate needs and bring forward practical solutions—not just problems.
  • Communicate clearly, follow up reliably, and care about the details.
  • Build trust with employees while maintaining appropriate confidentiality and boundaries.
  • Remain calm, flexible, and solutions-oriented when priorities change.
  • Are an enthusiastic and credible champion of WPP, its people, and its continued transformation.

Working model

This position is based at 3 World Trade Center in New York City and requires four days per week in the office. Some flexibility may occasionally be needed to support global stakeholders, orientation sessions, employee events, or other business priorities.

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: We are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

 

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

job.title: Supervisor Tax
job.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

The Tax Supervisor is responsible for performing activities related to activities related to Indirect Tax & Statutory compliance procedures for Good and Service tax (GST), Withholding Tax and Corporate Income tax across multiple entities of the Group.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Calculation, filing preparation and remittance - GST, TDS/ Withholding tax
  • Ensuring all Monthly/Annual returns in Form GSTR 1, GSTR 3B, GSTR 6 (ISD) and GSTR 9 and 9C are filed within the due dates
  • Preparation of outward GL and outward report working file. Reconciliation of such working files i.e. Outward report and Output liability GL accounts
  • Preparation of inward GL and inward report working file. Reconciliation of such working files i.e. Inward report and inward GL accounts
  • Discussions with relevant teams in case of differences between outward register and the IRN portal data
  • Review of errors/ observations for outward and inward transactions
  • Co-ordination and discussions with agencies and relevant SSC teams for resolving the errors/ observations
  • Review of ITC matching files which includes the following –
    • Review of split-booking transactions
    • Review of invoices for resolving the transactions with document number mismatch and document date mismatch
  • Preparation of dashboard workings to ensure that the liability is discharged correctly in the monthly return
  • Review of 180 days deferment report shared by EY along with the interest workings
  • Timely payments to tax bank accounts and vendor related TDS payments processing
  • Support team members and Senior team members with audits – GST, client’s audit.
  • Prepare/ Review Vendor and Employee quarterly e-TDS processing and monthly remittances
  • Support Local Finance in Tax compliance documentation as required.
  • Liaise with tax consultant on ongoing matters such as Show Cause Notice, hearings with department, etc.
  • Review Corporate Income Tax calculation.
  • Review documentation prepared for filing of withholding tax
  • Prepare agencies with supporting documentation as per the local tax & statutory requirements
  • Prepare annual financial statements
  • Review Withholding tax calculation and filing preparation
  • Review 26AS Income tax provision, filing, and remittance
  • Income tax assessment and audit
  • Calculate roll forward of deferred income taxes and accrued income taxes payable
  • Estimate annual effective tax rate calculation
  • Ensure timely preparation of Other IPG Tax Reporting Schedules
  • Perform transfer pricing audit and assessment reconciliation
  • Update and send for TL review Month/Quarter end Tax compliance check list.

Other activities:

  • Resolve Agency Local Finance queries within defined timelines by meeting SLAs agreed
  • Assist client and external audit process when necessary
  • Supervising activities within process
  • Assisting Team Leads in productivity and work load management for their respective areas
  • Supporting TLs in Leave and Attendance management for their respective areas
  • Cross training activities
  • Act as Subject matter experts within the team.

EDUCATION, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

Essential

  • 5-8 years of work experience in a similar role
  • Experience in Advertising and Media industry preferred
  • Minimum Education Qualification – B. com/M. com with Chartered Accountant or other equivalent post qualification
  • Management of a high transaction volumes business, with good knowledge of associated controls and procedures
  • Knowledge of statutory requirements in relation to Tax & Compliance
  • Ability to provide high level of customer service for the R2R process
  • Strong written and oral communications skills in English
  • Strong problem solving, team management and organizational skills
  • Experience in managing people and processes through a sustained period of change
  • Excellent computer skills and competency in Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook)
  • Experience in Tax compliance tools, AI and Automation tools, S4 HANA, MS Dynamics or similar ERP systems

A distinct advantage:

  • Experience working in a Shared Services Centre focused on Finance & Accounting activities
  • Experience in document imaging software like SharePoint
  • Good knowledge of working with Government Portal and integrating with ERP.

Work at CBC/Radio-Canada

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance. 
 
Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

Unposting Date:

2026-11-16 11:59 PM

Saskatchewan Videographer (English Services)(On-Site)


Your role 

CBC Saskatchewan is looking for a full time permanent Regina-based Videographer to join our visual storytelling team. Videographers in our newsroom are a vital part of the strong editorial and production team that produces programs on our streaming, digital, social and TV platforms. This role requires someone that is a creative thinker and strong visual storyteller who brings original ideas and innovative video treatments to all platforms and has demonstrated skills capturing content at a high level. 

We are a diverse and inclusive region, a gold mine of interesting characters with stories that speak to the heart of our communities and cultures. Succeeding in this role will require a deep understanding of underrepresented communities and equity-deserving groups in Saskatchewan to help ensure that the images you choose reflect a diverse and contemporary Canada.


Under the general direction of News leadership, you will operate independently, or as part of the content teams to gather, edit, package, and distribute or deliver media for CBC’s platforms including CBC GEM, social media channels, CBC News website, television and. You will capture and edit audio, video and still images in a creative way to further CBC Saskatchewan’s creative visual storytelling. You care about the people you work with and have a deep appreciation for different perspectives, opinions, and experiences. You live and promote the values of diversity, inclusion, and respectful work culture.


Key responsibilities:


  • Prepares, aligns and sets up field cameras ensuring optimum visual and technical quality under prevailing conditions.
  • Lights the subject or scene, composes and records program material using professional field equipment. Ensures both visual and aural material meets technical and aesthetic requirements for editing.
  • Delivers all recorded materials and performs editing for all video platforms which could include linear broadcasting/ FAST channels, website, YouTube and TikTok.
  • In the field, performs simple maintenance of equipment.
  • Drives a motor vehicle on a daily basis and handles routine vehicle maintenance.
  • Performs all or part of the function or duties of an equivalent or lower classification.
  • As assigned or required, may perform any or all of the following tasks:
    • Ask questions of subjects being recorded.
    • Contribute to social media. 
    • Prepare documentation for international travel.  

Please note the work schedule can include working irregular hours to cover breaking news and events.


Your profile:


  • Excellent level of technical knowledge and understanding of daily Television News production methods.
  • Ability to operate and troubleshoot Electronic News Gathering (ENG) camera and associated technology such as wireless microphones, lighting equipment, and communication tools.
  • Ability to edit video/ audio using Non-Linear editing technology such as Adobe Premiere or Avid Media Composer in both an office or remote setting.
  • Strong image composition skills in videography, still photography and editing.
  • Ability to work in a deadline-driven environment while maintaining a calm, professional attitude.
  • Strong team player with experience and/or willingness to work with new reporters to help them develop their on-camera skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Aptitude for telling standalone visual stories which may require an ability to conduct interviews and make editorial decisions of visual treatments.
  • Ability and willingness to travel to remote locations.
  • Ability and willingness to work various shifts, including evenings and weekends, as well as extended hours for unforeseen overtime.
  • Experience with multi-camera production is an asset.
  • Possession of a valid driver's license as well as a driving record that meets the minimum requirements of CBC/Radio-Canada's insurance company.
  • Combination of education and experience equivalent to a post-secondary education and three (3) years of relevant experience in TV and media arts.

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.
 
We thank all applicants for their interest, but only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.
 
CBC/Radio-Canada is committed to being a leader in reflecting our country’s diversity. That’s because we can only create and tell the stories that connect Canadians, by having a workforce that mirrors the ever-changing makeup of our country. That’s why we, as an employer, value equal opportunity and nurture an inclusive workplace where our individual differences are not only recognized and valued, but also extend to and pervade all the services we provide as Canada’s public broadcaster. For more information, visit the Diversity and Inclusion section of our website. If you have accommodation needs at this stage of the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible by sending an e-mail to recruitment@cbc.ca.
 
You are invited to consult and familiarize yourself with our Code of Conduct, which can be found on our corporate website. All employees must adhere to the Code as a condition of employment. We also invite you to take a look at our policy on conflicts of interest. In the event that you become an employee, it will be important to inform us, as quickly as possible, of any situation that, because of your hiring, constitutes or could appear to constitute a conflict of interest.

job.title: Associate Pastor/Biblical Counselor - Evening Shift
job.description:
Overview

Called to K-LOVE

 

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

 

At K-LOVE, every role is ministry.

 

We hire first for ministry alignment and a shared commitment to our faith, mission, vision, and values. We then seek talented professionals who can use their God-given gifts, skills, and experience to serve with excellence.

 

If you love Jesus and are called to be part of a ministry that places Christ at the center of everything we do, we invite you to explore this opportunity. If your heart aligns with our mission and you possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for the role, please keep reading.

 

 

This role offers a unique ministry opportunity distinct from traditional church-based pastoral positions. Our K-LOVE & Air1 Pastors specialize in providing direct, one-on-one biblical guidance and urgent intervention for our listeners through phone ministry. They focus exclusively on offering biblical counsel, addressing theological questions, and connecting callers with appropriate resources. Our Pastors maintain scheduled office hours and participate in on-call rotations to ensure consistent availability for those seeking spiritual support and guidance.

 

* This is a Full-Time, on-site position based out of our Franklin, TN offices.*

 

* Available Schedule:   Tuesday - Saturday  2:00pm - 10:30pm or Sunday - Thursday 2:00pm -10:30pm

 

Here's some of what you will be doing.....

  • Provide pastoral and biblical counsel to K-LOVE/Air1 listeners via phone on a variety of life topics from Biblical questions to urgent intervention. As appropriate pray, counsel, and direct listeners to resources in their area for long-term assistance. As part of the goal to take listener calls live, the Associate Pastor will:
    • Maintain scheduled hours and participate in on-call rotation (nights and weekends), assuming the responsibilities of On-Call Pastor during assigned period.
    • Serve as back up for the on-call pastor as needed. Continue to grow in biblical knowledge and counseling skills. 
    • Make referrals to local assistance, e.g. churches, shelters, rehab facilities and counsellors.
  • Regularly pray with and for our listeners. Respond to prayer requests that come in on a daily basis via phone and/or e-mail.
  • Partner as appropriate, especially during pledge drive, with on air and social media staff; i.e. documenting listener stories or sharing listener call experiences.
  • Follow the legal requirements of a mandated reporter under state law.

 

Here's what we're looking for...

  • At least six (6) years’ of pastoral experience handling a wide range of pastoral functions, or equivalent education and experience.
  • Equipped with the knowledge of appropriate counseling methods in order to adequately respond to suicide, child abuse, elder abuse, marriage problems, personal problems, spiritual problems, and/or any other problems associated with life and its experiences and to provide biblical counseling.
  • Committed to grow and gain a further understanding of the pastoral/counseling profession by completing continuing education (i.e. reading and/or attending relevant courses or seminars).
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to build trust and value others; communicate effectively; focus on the listener; and collaborate with others. Customer service experience/orientation preferred.
  • Able to work independently, problem solve and be flexible as the field is constantly changing.
  • Strong computer skills; knowledge of Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, Outlook), Social Media forums and smart devices.
  • Proof of license and/or ordination.
  • Alignment with our values is top priority. Do our values align with yours?  Mission, Beliefs & Values.

 

Plus, all candidates MUST have both:      

  • Bachelors and/or Associate Degree in the Ministerial or Counseling field from an accredited educational institution
  • Licensed and/or Ordained with a recognized Christian church or Christian denomination and have recognition from the State & IRS as a Pastor.

 

Employment Requirements

  • Must pass a pre-employment reference screen and background check.
  • Proof of legal authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must agree with K-LOVE Christ-Centered Life Covenant and Statement of Faith

 

NOTE: Unfortunately, this position does not allow for Pastoral Housing Allowance

 

 

What can we offer you?

  • Industry leading Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
  • Short/long term disability and life insurance
  • Robust 401K with company match
  • Parental leave with Baby Bonding pay
  • Generous PTO, holiday and sick pay
  • Unique company culture that includes exclusive access to concerts, movie premieres, media industry events, and more
  • Leadership and Career Development Programs

Why work for K-LOVE?

 

K-LOVE is a nonprofit, multi-platform media company on a mission to draw people closer to Christ. Founded in 1982 in Santa Rosa, CA, with a singular radio station, K-LOVE today owns and operates the nation's two largest Christian music radio networks (K-LOVE and Air1) with over 1,000 broadcast signals across all 50 states, streaming audio reaching around the world, and a growing family of media ministries including podcasts, books, films, concerts, and events. K-LOVE employs nearly 500 team members between its office in Nashville, TN and field locations around the country. You can view our mission and values here Mission, Beliefs & Values. 

 

 

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS:

Writing sample required:  Please upload attachment or include a link to your writing sample.  Samples can include a blog post, devotional, etc. 

 

 

“As an Equal Opportunity Employer, K-LOVE makes employment decisions based on merit and other legitimate reasons. The Company is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment and equal employment opportunities regardless of protected class, characteristic or status. However, K-LOVE is a religious non-profit organization where all team members contribute to the Company’s mission of encouraging our audiences “to have a meaningful relationship with Christ.” Therefore, pursuant to the Civil Rights Act of 1964, Section 702 (42 U.S.C. 2000e I(a)), K-LOVE has the right to hire only candidates who agree with the Company’s Statement of Faith, Mission, Vision, and Values. Also, as a religious non-profit organization, the Company is not governed by the CA Fair Employment and Housing Act.”

job.title: Product Director
job.description:
Description

Hope Media Group is a multi-brand ministry. Every story we share, every event we host, and every song we play is done to engage people to love Jesus, serve others, and spread Hope. Hope Media Group is the home of KSBJ, WayFM, Worship 24/7, Vida Unida, NGEN radio. Way Loud, Way New, Way Back, Gospel 24/7, God Listens Prayer App and Hope Events. We invite you to apply and become a part of our growing ministry to Love Jesus, Serve Others, and Spread Hope. Our team describes our environment as fun, encouraging, collaborative, engaging, caring, family-oriented, and friendly. We would love for you to join us and be part of what God is doing in our ministry! 

Our Next Digital Product is Hope Media Group's first digital product: a music app built for Christians, offering a generosity-funded alternative to ad-driven and algorithm-driven streaming. Rather than inferring what to play from behavioral data, The Next Digital Product starts by asking how you're doing and curates a path in response. It's built to give back to the people who use it, not extract from them. 


Product Director

Job Summary:

This role is the business owner for Next Digital Product: accountable for the platform's overall performance, from product and partnerships through growth. It sets the plan that content, rights, and product engineering work toward, and is the point of escalation when those pieces need to align. 


Essential Functions:

Strategy and Go-to-Market:

  • Set Next Digital Product's business and platform strategy. Aligning content, partnerships, engineering, and growth around one plan. 
  • Own go-to-market strategy and sequencing, from launch through scale. 
  • Own the Next Digital Product brand and partner with marketing on acquisition channels and campaigns. 

Business Ownership:

  • Own the P&L: revenue performance, cost discipline, and the path to sustainability. 
  • Hold the product organization accountable to growth and engagement outcomes, not just feature delivery. 
  • Shape how the Next Digital Product earns: subscription tiers, giving programs, sponsorship, and pricing. 
  • Define the measures the business runs on, and work with data science to keep them honest. 

Team and Leadership:

  • Hire, lead, and coordinate the roles that build and run Next Digital Product's content and partnerships, growing the team as the platform scales, based on budget allocation and CIO approval. 
  • You serve as the Primary Representative for Next Digital Product to Hope Media Group's executive leadership. 

Risk and Stewardship:

  • Manage vendor and consultant relationships that touch product or business strategy. 
  • Own risk management for the platform: track what could keep it from working, and mitigate it. 
  • Balance headcount and budget responsibly alongside growth as the team comes online. 

Demonstrated Faith:

  • Committed to a personal relationship with Jesus Christ 
  • Grounded spiritually and biblically literate 
  • Comfortable praying for co-workers in team meetings, leading spoken prayer, and participating in ministry prayer meetings and Bible studies 
  • Live Christian principles defined by the ministry's Statement of Faith & Biblical Beliefs 
  • Participate in on-air fundraisers and prays for donors as needed 
  • Passion for leveraging the HMG's media platforms for evangelism and discipleship 
  • Exhibit a strong moral character 
  • Active member of a Bible believing local church 


Requirements

Non-Essential Functions:

  • Other duties as requested. 

Requirements and Qualifications:

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, Product Management, Media, or a related field, or at least 10 years of equivalent experience. 

Experience:

  • 7+ years in product leadership with direct P&L or business-unit ownership, ideally in streaming media, audio, or subscription apps. 
  • A track record taking a consumer product from pre-launch through its first years of growth. 
  • Comfort owning a number the business is counting on, not just a roadmap. 
  • Cross-functional leadership across product, content, and partnerships-adjacent teams. 
  • Alignment with a generosity-funded, non-extraction model rather than an ad- or data-driven one. 

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Experience in Christian/faith media or a comparable subscription-and-giving nonprofit product. 
  • Prior work with music licensing or rights-holder relationships. 
  • Startup or 0-to-1 product experience at an early stage
  • Heart for Christian ministry 
  • Strong moral character 
  • Has a personal relationship with Jesus Christ. Spiritually grounded and working knowledge of scripture 
  • Must be an active member of a Bible believing local church 

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • The Head of Music & Streaming Content and the Head of Music Partnerships & Rights, plus later hires as the team grows. 

Working Conditions and Environment:

Travel: 

  • As needed for industry events, conferences, and label and partner meetings. 

Nights/Weekends/Holidays:

  • Occasional evenings, weekends, or holidays may be required for board meetings, ministry events, fundraising events, urgent employee matters, or organizational needs. 


Physical Requirements:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 

Physical Activity may include Talking. Expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word. Those activities in which they must convey detailed or important spoken instructions to other workers accurately, loudly, or quickly. Hearing. Perceiving the nature of sounds at normal speaking levels with or without correction. Ability to receive detailed information through oral communication, and to make the discriminations in sound. Repetitive motion. Substantial movements (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.

Light work. Exerting up to 20 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 10 pounds of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to move objects. If the use of arm and/or leg controls requires exertion of forces greater than that for sedentary work and the worker sits most of the time, the job is rated for light work.

The worker is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as: preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; extensive reading.


Full-Time Benefits Offerings:

  • Medical
  • Dental
  • Vision
  • Health Savings Account w/employer contribution
  • Flexible Savings Accounts
  • Company Paid Short Term Disability/Long Term Disability
  • EAP (Employee Assistance Program)
  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Three (3) Paid Mission Days
  • Twelve (12) Company-Paid Holidays
  • 403B Retirement with Company Match
  • Group Life Insurance
  • Legal Shield/Identity Theft Protection
  • Access to Marketplace Ministry Chaplains 
  • Third-Party Recruiter Policy:

We are grateful for the interest of those who wish to support our hiring efforts. However, Hope Media Group does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate referrals from external staffing agencies or search firms. Submissions from third parties will not be considered and may be retained without obligation or payment or fees.

  • Participate in news editorial meetings.
  • Keep on top of news broadcasting trends on all platforms.

  • Experience in managing news coverage.
  • Experience in developing & structuring news coverage.
  • Experience in vetting scripts.
  • Superior news judgement & broadcast writing skills, as well as knowledge of digital writing.
  • Excellent knowledge of news & current affairs.
  • Must have excellent command of the English language.

job.title: Director of Engineering
job.description:
KTBC FOX 7 Austin is seeking an experienced Director of Engineering to lead the Station’s Engineering Team. This position is responsible for the maintenance, reliability, security, technical compliance, and strategic development of the infrastructure and systems that support the station’s broadcast, production, transmission, and digital platforms. Applying strong Project Management Institute (PMI) principles, the Director of Engineering will provide strategic leadership to the engineering team while partnering with Broadcast Operations, IT, station leadership, and TVHO Engineering on major technology initiatives, capital projects, and infrastructure lifecycle planning.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Human Resource Management

  • Lead, mentor, and supervise the Engineering team, applying PMI team building, stakeholder engagement, and resource optimization techniques to foster a culture of safety, accountability, continuous improvement, and technical excellence.
  • Manage resource allocations, technical schedules, and performance management across all engineering initiatives.

Project & Operations Management

  • Direct the end-to-end lifecycle of technical operations—from initiating and planning through executing, monitoring, controlling, and closing complex broadcast and facility initiatives.
  • Develop and manage comprehensive preventive maintenance programs, risk mitigation strategies, equipment lifecycle management plans, and technical baseline documentation.
  • Identify root causes of technical issues using formal risk management and quality control frameworks, implementing corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to optimize operational reliability.

Compliance, Security, & Quality Control

  • Oversee station transmission facilities and technical quality assurance programs, ensuring strict compliance with FCC regulations, EAS requirements, CALM Act standards, ATSC requirements, and industry benchmarks.
  • Maintain enterprise emergency preparedness programs, business continuity planning, disaster recovery (DR) testing, and emergency management protocols.
  • Partner with IT and cybersecurity teams to ensure all broadcast systems adhere to FOX security protocols, network architecture standards, and governance policies.

Capital Planning, Procurement, & Vendor Management

  • Consult with the VP of Engineering/Operations to develop and manage operational (OPEX) and capital (CAPEX) budgets, leveraging cost management methodologies (earned value, cost baseline, and variance analysis).
  • Lead procurement processes, contract negotiations, service level agreements (SLAs), vendor management, and contract administration for major equipment purchases and third-party services.
  • Oversee critical facility infrastructure scope and lifecycle maintenance, including generators, UPS systems, HVAC supporting technical operations, and specialized building systems.
  • Collaborate with TVHO Engineering and executive leadership on enterprise technology initiatives, standardized engineering governance, and system implementation roadmaps.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated leadership experience in television broadcast engineering, media technology, production systems, information technology, or a related technical domain.
  • Proven track record of applying formal project management principles (PMI framework) to direct complex broadcast, production, transmission, or IT infrastructure projects.
  • Strong knowledge of the PMBOK (Project Management Body of Knowledge) groups: Integration, Scope, Schedule, Cost, Quality, Resource, Communications, Risk, Procurement, and Stakeholder Management.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, risk assessment, organizational, and executive communication skills.
  • Practical knowledge of broadcast, production, high-availability networking, and file-based media technologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate high-pressure, live broadcast environments with strong agile problem-solving capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PMP® (Project Management Professional), CAPM®, or equivalent PMI certification
  • 5+ years of progressive leadership experience in television broadcast engineering within a local station, network, or major production facility.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Broadcast Technology, Information Technology, Project Management, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and experience).
  • Expertise in broadcast transmission systems, FCC regulatory compliance, EAS, ATSC 1.0, ATSC 3.0/NextGen TV, and digital media workflows.
  • Advanced proficiency in IP-based media infrastructure (SMPTE ST 2110), broadcast automation, newsroom systems, cloud workflows, enterprise networking, and cybersecurity.
  • SBE (Society of Broadcast Engineers) certification or other relevant industry technical credentials

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

job.title: Senior Analytics Engineer, People Data and Insights
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

About the Role

The New York Times is rebuilding how we use people data. Instead of one-off reports and ad hoc pulls, we are building governed, reusable data tools that HR leaders, HR partners, and their counterparts use to make decisions. You will help build this layer. People data at The Times lives in several systems, each with its own definitions and history. You will turn that into a modeled, tested, documented foundation that products can be built on repeatedly. You will lead the models, transformations, and data quality behind every product this team ships. You will report to the Senior Director, People Data and Insights. You will work out of the New York office on a hybrid schedule. 

Responsibilities:

  • You will design, build, and maintain the data models and databases that our products run on.
  • You will oversee the transformation layer from source systems into governed, tested, documented models.
  • You will turn metric definitions from the data dictionary into executable logic, so that a definition and the number it produces cannot drift apart.
  • You will build data quality into the pipeline: tests, validation, and reconciliation across sources that surface problems before team members do.
  • You will work with the Program Manager to translate product requirements into models, and push back when a requirement and the underlying data do not agree.
  • You will handle effective-dated and historical data correctly, so that point-in-time questions get point-in-time answers.
  • You will implement and maintain access controls appropriate to compensation, demographic, and other sensitive data.
  • You will document models and lineage so that all can understand why something was built the way it was.
  • You will demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or an equivalent role building production data models.
  • You are a SQL expert
  • Strong dimensional modeling skills, and the judgment to know when to normalize and when not to.
  • 5+ years of experience with a transformation framework such as dbt, and with version control and code review as part of normal practice.
  • 5+ years of experience handling slowly changing dimensions, dated records, and point-in-time reporting.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience with HR or people data, and with systems such as Workday, Greenhouse, or One Model.
  • Python for orchestration, API work, or data validation.
  • 2+ years of experience with AWS data services.
  • Familiarity with BI and analytics tooling such as Hex, Tableau, or Looker.
  • 2+ years of experience in an organization with distinct populations operating under different rules, such as union and non-union groups.

REQ-020839
