job.title: Senior E-Commerce Product Designer, NYT Wirecutter (Temp)
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

Mission Overview & Responsibilities: 

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to own the design evolution of the Wirecutter Store. You will be the lead designer for our shopping experience, balancing high-conversion UX design with rigorous visual standards. You will oversee the visual and structural integrity of our store, designing intuitive interfaces for our homepage, product detail pages (PDPs), and checkout flows.

You are a strategic partner who will help shape the future of our retail experience. We are looking for someone to bring their expertise in e-commerce best practices, user psychology, and conversion rate optimization (CRO) to help us identify opportunities we haven't seen yet.

This is a remote friendly position.

  • Translate complex business requirements into elegant, high-fidelity designs. You will wireframe, prototype, and refine the interface to create a cohesive store experience across desktop and mobile.

  • Analyze the shopping funnel to identify friction points. You'll design solutions that improve navigation, product discovery, and the overall checkout process.

  • Be the subject matter expert on e-commerce design trends. Audit the site experience to identify growth opportunities and propose improvements to site architecture.

  • Partner with the business team to drive our A/B testing roadmap. You will design and implement UI experiments (e.g., layout variations, navigation updates, promotional treatments) and use data to iterate on those designs.

  • Use your knowledge of the Shopify platform to build, configure, and manage pages. You understand the capabilities and constraints of the platform, allowing you to design features that are both beautiful and technically feasible.

  • Be the design advocate in meetings with our technical partners to ensure our visual standards are maintained during technical implementation.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of relevant design experience.

  • A portfolio showcasing your ability and process to design for e-commerce. You show an understanding of information architecture, interaction design, and visual hierarchy.

  • Experience designing for Shopify. You know how to navigate the theme editor, manage product assets, and collaborate with developers to bring custom layouts to life.

  • Experience designing templates for e-commerce email platforms (e.g., Klaviyo, Shopify Email). You understand how email layout, typography, and clear CTAs impact click-through and open rates.

  • Experience using analytics to understand site performance. You use insights to influence your design process and prioritize changes.

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Experience using design to solve for conversion and usability.

  • Experience presenting the "why" behind your design choices and working with developers, PMs, and stakeholders to move projects across the finish line.

job.title: Director Marketing
job.description:
Company Information

AEG brings music, sports, and live entertainment together to create moments people remember around the world. Each year, more than 100 million fans experience live events across five continents—from global touring, concerts, and festivals to iconic sports and entertainment destinations.

Through our music division, AEG Presents, one of the world’s leading operators of tours, concerts, and music festivals, we help shape the sound of now. We work with artists at every stage of their careers to bring live music to life, connecting artists with fans on stages around the world.

Headquartered in Los Angeles, AEG Presents is driven by creativity, innovation, and purpose, and powered by people who want their work to show up in the real world.

If you’re ready to help create moments that matter, there’s a place for you here. Because it happens here.

Job Summary

The Director Marketing, Las Vegas will create detailed promotional and advertising plans identifying targeted demographics for each show across multiple venues.   This position will develop new strategies for existing events by analyzing statistics regarding market development; acquiring and analyzing data; consulting with internal and external sources.  The Director Marketing, under guidance of the VP Marketing, will oversee the marketing department including progress and performance to ensure assigned work is completed correctly and on deadlines.

Essential Functions

  • Create detailed marketing and promotional campaigns identifying targeted demographics for each individual show.   Strategize and research new marketing trends and practices to apply to AEG Presents Las Vegas shows, events, residencies and tours.   Purchase and monitor media plans, develop national, regional and local promotions, and strategize with local talent buying team, property and venue partners and public relations team.
  • Under the guidance of VP Marketing, oversee marketing department team members including progress and performance to ensure assigned work is completed correctly and on deadline.  Provide mentorship and guidance to develop marketing staff by providing information, educational opportunities, and experiential growth opportunities.  Manage marketing workflow by completing department operational requirements by scheduling and assigning employees; following up on work results.
  • Serve as the primary local marketing contact for artist marketing representatives regarding show and residency marketing plans and approvals.
  • Develop new strategies for existing events by analyzing statistics regarding market development; acquiring and analyzing audience and artist data; consulting with internal and external sources.
  • Responsible for overseeing the creation and approvals of advertising materials and creative.  Order creative including signage, digital assets, and video content, coordinate with legal on sensitive material and vendor contracts.
  • Collaborate with booking team to create unique artist and venue pitch decks for new business and presentations.
  • Coordinate with PR agencies to write and send out press releases and manage day of show press lists.  Coordinate press interviews, secure artist availability for promotions and artist availability.
  • Identify short-term and long-range issues that must be addressed; provide information and commentary pertinent to deliberations; recommend options and courses of action; and implement directives.
  • Build and cultivate partner and industry relationships by attending live events, networking lunches, meetings.  Maintain professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops; reviewing professional publications; establishing personal networks; participating in professional societies.
  • Follow up with media outlets and artist management on additional marketing opportunities to increase ticket sales.   Liaison with media, venues, vendors, label and artists management.
  • Organize and submit ticket holds for promotions, media and artist management to ticketing department.  Work with Regional Ticketing Director on ticketing strategies.

 

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS Degree (4-year) Marketing/ Business Communications, PR Preferred
  • 8-10 years experience working with and creating budgets
  • 8-10 years experience working as a promoter a plus
  • Excellent computer skills with proficiency in Microsoft Word, Outlook and Excel and Photoshop
  • Knowledge of brand identity, advertising, digital marketing and social media strategy and best practices
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to create and foster relationships
  • Knowledge of media buying, negotiating and documenting agreements
  • Knowledge of the music industry and artist demographics
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail
  • Excellent written, verbal and listening communication skills

Payscale: $84,046.89 - $130,000.00

Bonus: his position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings.

job.description:
Job Summary:

Job Summary:

Who Are We?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment and eCommerce company, comprised of four market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, Front Line Management Group and Live Nation Network.

As the largest producer of live music concerts, Live Nation Concerts operates over 45 venues across the United States.  For additional information, visit http://www.livenationentertainment.com/.

Who Are You?

Employees have a leading role in the service experience our guests have. The extent to which we recognize our employees for service well done, is the extent to which they will care not only for the guests, but for each other.

That’s why SAFETY for employees and guests is our first priority. We show CARE around every corner and look to create ENCORE moments of service excellence for everyone. And our commitment to EFFICIENCY, is our way of staying well-organized.  So join us! We need these kinds of skills and talents as we Create Once in a Lifetime Experiences for our Fans.

The Role:

Responsible for performing highly diversified duties to install, troubleshoot, repair and maintain equipment according to safety, predictive and productive maintenance systems and processes to support the achievement of the venue's business goals and objectives.

Job Functions:

  • Keep the venue safe and clean at all time, including by not limited to: clean and disinfect all fixtures, floors, mirrors, doors and walls of restrooms, keep all guest facing area free of trash, restock restroom paper materials and hygiene products as needed.
  • Keep work areas neat and orderly, clean equipment and assist with other cleaning duties as assigned.
  • Provide emergency/unscheduled repairs of production equipment during production and performs scheduled maintenance repairs of production equipment during machine service.
  • Show CARE by participating in venue recycling efforts before, during and after the show.
  • Perform simple machinist duties and responsibilities.
  • Perform mechanic skills including, but not limited to, mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, hydraulic, troubleshooting and repair of production machines.
  • Read and interpret equipment manuals and work orders to perform required maintenance and service.
  • Diagnose problems, replace or repair parts, test and make adjustments.
  • Perform regular preventive maintenance on machines, equipment and plant facilities.
  • Perform a variety of plumbing maintenance and carpentry functions.
  • Use a variety of hand and power tools, electric meters and material handling equipment in performing duties.
  • Detect faulty operations, defective material and report those and any unusual situations to proper supervision.
  • Comply with safety regulations and maintain clean and orderly work areas.
  • Perform all other duties as assigned or needed.

  • Must be highly motivated and able to work independently.

job.description:
Overview

Called to K-LOVE

 

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

 

At K-LOVE, every role is ministry.

 

We hire first for ministry alignment and a shared commitment to our faith, mission, vision, and values. We then seek talented professionals who can use their God-given gifts, skills, and experience to serve with excellence.

 

If you love Jesus and are called to be part of a ministry that places Christ at the center of everything we do, we invite you to explore this opportunity. If your heart aligns with our mission and you possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for the role, please keep reading.

 

 

The Care Team Supervisor leads the Care Team in a way that exemplifies the mission and values of K-LOVE and Air1 by offering hope to our callers in each interaction. This is a working supervisor role who assists the Pastoral Care Team Manager with leadership of the team while demonstrating a positive, energetic influence throughout the ministry.

 

* This is a Full-Time, on-site position based out of our Franklin, TN office.

* Available schedule:  Monday - Friday  1:00pm - 9:30pm

 

 

Here's some of what  you will be doing:

  • Develop an understanding of work production, workflow, and priorities to effectively direct team members in daily activities and fill positions as needed.
  • Work collaboratively with Care Team Manager to schedule team in an efficient and effective manner. Proactively review shift objectives and adjust team focus as necessary.
  • Assist with hiring initiatives, including recruitment and evaluation of candidates.
  • Assist with identification and development of new leaders and Subject Matter Experts within the Care Team.
  • Manage Pastoral Care team’s performance. Set agreed upon expectations with Team Members, hold team accountable for results, and celebrate success. Regularly provide feedback to team members and partner with the Pastoral Care Team Manager to provide formal feedback on a semi-annual basis via the Performance Conversation Tool.
  • Focus on short-term daily objectives and immediate needs without losing sight of the long-term values. Look at projects and tasks not from a limited view of volume and output, but a perspective on impact of output.
  • Report progress towards goals and objectives to the Care Team Manager on a regular basis.
  • Assist in additional necessary Care Team trainings discovered through Quality Assurance evaluations and performance analysis.
  • Collaborate with co-workers, other departments, and external partners as appropriate. Represent the department as needed at meetings and with other team members and leaders throughout the Ministry.
  • Assist Pastoral Care Team Manager in coordination and implementation of special projects as needed.
  • Serve as point of contact in absence of Pastoral Care Team Manager. Escalate issues as appropriate.
  • Demonstrate competence in own area and acquiring a higher-level understanding of the role.
  • Respond sensitively and appropriately to all listener prayer needs, complete daily “Pray4One” edits, respond to emails. Maintain a high degree of confidentiality with listener information and member records.
  • Model and communicate best practices while maintaining your own spiritual, mental, physical, and relational health.

 

Talent and Leadership Development

  • Provide leadership, mentoring, and developing a highly competent and responsive Pastoral Care team, ensuring alignment of goals and ministry initiatives with EMF’s mission. Foster a learning environment where training, risk management, operational best practices, and biblical values go hand in hand with creative and entrepreneurial solution that best fulfill the ministry’s mission.
  • Help to build a strong, healthy, and productive team, with defined processes, and caring relationships. Serve as a professional, positive role model for team.
  • Help to monitor, develop, and create an environment for team and individual mental, emotional, and spiritual health.
  • Utilize the K-LOVE Leadership Framework in setting professional goals for self and direct reports. Actively seek and partake in training & education to deepen Biblical understanding, media/business acumen, leadership knowledge, interpersonal awareness, and communication skills.

 

Here's what we are looking for:

  • Minimum two years hands-on ministry experience.
  • Minimum of two years of experience working in a customer service environment, with leadership experience preferred.
  • Basic to advanced knowledge of computers and common software applications. Knowledge of Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, Outlook), SharePoint, Studio Enterprise, “Pray4One”, and Interactive Scripter software in addition to Social Media forums and smart devices.
  • Ability to effectively transmit ideas, thoughts, and information clearly and concisely to others in verbal and written form through the appropriate person/channel. Demonstrates effective listening skills.
  • Ability to work as part of a high customer service, multi-task, fun, and performance-oriented team.
  • Demonstrates a strong attention to detail, with a keen eye for accuracy for day to day activities as well as in an environment that will become very busy during and after Pledge Drive weeks.
  • A collaborative and flexible style, with strong service mentality. Need to be seen as a team player.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to develop sincere business/ministry relationships.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
  • Demonstrated commitment to the social sector with a passion for our mission and values.

 

Employment Requirements

  • Must pass a pre-employment reference screen and background check.
  • Proof of legal authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must agree with K-LOVE Christ-Centered Life Covenant and Statement of Faith

 

 

What can we offer you?

  • Industry leading Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
  • Short/long term disability and life insurance
  • Robust 401K with company match
  • Parental leave with Baby Bonding pay
  • Generous PTO, holiday and sick pay
  • Unique company culture that includes exclusive access to concerts, movie premieres, media industry events, and more
  • Leadership and Career Development Programs

 

Why work for K-LOVE?

 

K-LOVE is a nonprofit, multi-platform media company on a mission to draw people closer to Christ. Founded in 1982 in Santa Rosa, CA, with a singular radio station, K-LOVE today owns and operates the nation's two largest Christian music radio networks (K-LOVE and Air1) with over 1,000 broadcast signals across all 50 states, streaming audio reaching around the world, and a growing family of media ministries including podcasts, books, films, concerts, and events. K-LOVE employs nearly 500 team members between its office in Nashville, TN and field locations around the country. You can view our mission and values here Mission, Beliefs & Values. 

 

 

“As an Equal Opportunity Employer, K-LOVE makes employment decisions based on merit and other legitimate reasons. The Company is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment and equal employment opportunities regardless of protected class, characteristic or status. However, K-LOVE is a religious non-profit organization where all team members contribute to the Company’s mission of encouraging our audiences “to have a meaningful relationship with Christ.” Therefore, pursuant to the Civil Rights Act of 1964, Section 702 (42 U.S.C. 2000e I(a)), K-LOVE has the right to hire only candidates who agree with the Company’s Statement of Faith, Mission, Vision, and Values. Also, as a religious non-profit organization, the Company is not governed by the CA Fair Employment and Housing Act.”

About Us

Job Overview

This position is responsible for operating the board for live, satellite delivered content and syndicated programming. The Board Operator ensures that all preplanned components of a broadcast are carried out as designed, including, set-up, operation and maintenance of electronic equipment used to transmit programs.

Job Responsibilities

Run the board, play the appropriate music, features, billboards, commercials, etc. during live or recorded news and/or brokered radio programs.

Operate and troubleshoot radio equipment used in the course of the production of a live or recorded broadcast.

Technical perfection and flawless execution of control board and equipment to regulate the volume and sound quality during radio broadcasts.

Observe monitors and manage outgoing audio and sounds levels.

Follow program log.

Monitor all systems and make sure they are all running on schedule. Note any issues or concerns on log.

Monitor and update severe weather forecasts.

When required, go on-air to report on life-threatening or emergency situations until further support arrives.

Record, edit or play back any sound requested from broadcasts.

Voice and produce news stories/features as requested/needed.

Answer phone calls during shift and screen calls.

Monitor automation, transmitter controls, which includes pattern/tower changes and record required readings.

Assess emergency situations for the station, and make decisions on when to call for additional support.

Knowledgeable of, and applies as needed, all current FCC rules and regulations.

Report to work on time and work established schedule/hours. Ability to work other hours or alternate schedules as needed, as assigned or requested by Program Director with little or no notice. Such alternate/additional work can include weekdays, evenings and weekends.

Complete other duties as requested and needed.

Qualifications

High School diploma, GED or equivalent required, with a minimum one (1) year experience running a radio board preferred; or a combination of education and work experience to perform the essential functions of the job.

Must be able to respond and work well in a crisis and handle last minute and unexpected changes during work shift.

Be able to communicate quickly and clearly to co-workers and others as needed.

Ability to hear and speak clearly and follow both oral and written direction.

Ability to think critically and quickly and to articulate information in clear, concise manner to others.

Ability to think spontaneously and ad lib while on air in a coherent manner in situations that can change quickly.

Ability to learn automation systems.

Knowledge of transmission, broadcasting, switching, control, and operation of telecommunications systems.

Project a professional appearance and demeanor.

Ability to work in compliance with company and FCC policies and procedures.

Multi-task with a variety of duties while running the board.

Must be flexible and able to deal with unexpected changes calmly.

Able to make decisions and judgments quickly.

Follow directions well, especially over the phone.

Work well under pressure.

Available to work with short notice including early mornings, late evenings and weekends.

Ability to work established schedule and other hours as needed.

Physical Requirements: Ability to communicate in English, both verbally and in writing. Manual dexterity and fine motor skills to manipulate computer keys and board controls as well as general office equipment (telephone, copier, etc.) for extended periods of time. Wear headsets and be confined to a specific space during the course of work. Sit and/or stand for extended periods of time. Average pushing, pulling, bending, stooping and reaching over head. job.description:
Location: FL-Jacksonville

Job Title:  Traffic Assistant - WFOX TV

 

Position Overview

The Traffic Assistant at WFOX TV Jacksonville will be responsible for entering precise traffic instructions/materials as well as maintaining daily log placements to maximize inventory and revenue within the WideOrbit Traffic system. They will also be responsible for the accuracy of the administrative duties outlined in this description. Candidates must have solid organizational skills and demonstrated ability to use good judgment able to multi-task and switch seamlessly between competing priorities. Must be able to work under pressure in a deadline-driven environment. 

 

Requires high-level attention to detail and excellent oral and written communication skills.  Ability to work independently in a hybrid environment and collaborate with multiple departments to achieve business objectives. 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Generate daily “missing material instruction” report for multiple days.
  • Follow up on missing materials and instructions with agencies, clients, and/or sales reps.
  • Implement accurate traffic instructions and spots.
  • Maximize Inventory and revenue by preparing and maintaining daily logs through detailed log placement and frontloading. 
  • Adapt and adopt all standardization procedures and other initiatives. 
  • Collaborate effectively with others (sales, creative, client contacts, and agencies). 
  • Complete other Traffic and/or Continuity related duties as may be assigned, including back-up of other traffic personnel as needed. 
  • This role requires responsiveness, organization, attention to detail, and the independent judgment needed to plan, prioritize, and organize in a fast-paced, quickly changing environment.

Minimum Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED equivalent required 
  • WideOrbit experience (at least 1 year) 
  • Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and MS Teams
  • Ability to produce accurate and timely information by transcribing, formatting, inputting, editing, retrieving, copying, and transmitting text, data, and graphics
  • Resourceful self-starter with the ability to work independently with minimal supervision
  • Proven ability to manage multiple tasks at once
  • Requires exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Excellent communication skills both oral and written
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dead-driven environment with attention for details
  • Creative problem-solver

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s in Marketing, Communications, Media or related (preferred) 
  • 3-5 years of broadcast traffic experience (preferred) 
  • Bilingual in English/Spanish (both written and verbal preferred)

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com

job.title: New Business and Sports Sales Manager - WSOC TV
job.description:
Location: NC-Charlotte

Job Title:  New Business and Sports Sales Manager - WSOC TV

 

Position Overview

Join WSOC-TV, a leading local media brand within Cox Media Group, as our New Business and Sports Sales Manager. In this role, you’ll lead new-client acquisition, grow sports sponsorship and advertising revenue, and accelerate growth across television, streaming, and digital marketing platforms.

 

This player-coach role is built for an accomplished media sales leader who thrives on building a disciplined new-business engine, expanding digital and sports revenue, and developing a high-performing sales team. You’ll bring strong leadership along with expertise in linear television, sports programming and sponsorships, connected TV (CTV)/OTT, streaming video, audience-based advertising, and the broader digital marketing ecosystem.

 

You’ll guide Account Executives through the full sales cycle—from target-account identification and prospecting through discovery, solution design, presentation, negotiation, close, renewal, and expansion. You’ll set clear activity and pipeline expectations, strengthen the team’s digital and sports selling skills, package and sell sports programming, sponsorships, and events, and collaborate across WSOC-TV and Cox Media Group to deliver integrated, measurable marketing solutions for local and regional advertisers.

 

If you’re a competitive, collaborative sales leader ready to shape the future of local media sales in Charlotte while helping clients achieve meaningful business results, we’d love to hear from you.

 

At WSOC-TV, you’ll combine the strength of a trusted local media brand with the resources of Cox Media Group to help Charlotte-area businesses grow. This is a chance to lead with impact, build something meaningful, and grow your career with a team that values results, collaboration, and community.

  • Sell with powerful assets. Bring clients trusted local news, sports programming, streaming, and digital solutions that reach audiences across the region.
  • Own the strategy. Shape the new-business and sports sales approach, build your team, and see the direct impact of your leadership on revenue growth.
  • Be part of a dynamic market. Work in Charlotte’s growing business community and passionate sports culture, with opportunities to connect brands with the fans and communities they want to reach.
  • Collaborate with talented teams. Partner with News, Sports, Creative Services, Digital Operations, and Traffic to deliver creative, high-impact solutions.
  • Grow your career. Develop as a leader within Cox Media Group, with opportunities to expand your expertise across television, streaming, and digital media.

How You'll Make an Impact

  • Build a focused, accountable sales team that consistently generates qualified new business opportunities and advances them through the pipeline.
  • Achieve or exceed new-business, digital revenue, total revenue, client retention, and market-share goals.
  • Achieve or exceed sports revenue and sponsorship goals by securing new sports advertisers, renewing, and expanding sponsor partnerships, maximizing sell-through of sports inventory, and delivering on all sponsor commitments.
  • Improve key performance indicators, including prospecting activity, pipeline coverage, conversion rates, average deal size, forecast accuracy, and digital revenue mix.
  • Help advertisers achieve measurable business outcomes through integrated, insight-led solutions and effective campaign optimization.
  • Build productive partnerships across Sales, News, Creative Services, Digital Operations, and Traffic to deliver a seamless client experience.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Sales Leadership

  • Lead and develop Account Executives focused on new clients, digital growth, retention, and account expansion.
  • Build a high-performance culture grounded in prospecting, consultative selling, digital expertise, and accountability.
  • Set clear expectations for sales activity, pipeline coverage, conversion, forecasting, and revenue performance.
  • Coach sellers through one-on-ones, pipeline reviews, call preparation, field support, and deal strategy.
  • Support priority presentations, negotiations, and closes while removing barriers to growth.

 

New Business Development

  • Execute a market-level new-business strategy focused on priority categories, target accounts, and prospecting campaigns.
  • Coach sellers to generate qualified opportunities through research, outreach, networking, referrals, and insight-led conversations.
  • Build relationships with businesses, agencies, and key decision-makers across the market.
  • Turn advertiser objectives into integrated strategies using WSOC-TV and Cox Media Group assets.

 

Sports Sales and Sponsorships

  • Lead sports sales strategy across sponsorships, programming, special events, and multi-platform sports packages.
  • Identify and develop new advertisers and categories for local, regional, high school, college, and professional sports opportunities.
  • Build integrated sports packages across broadcast, streaming, digital, social, and on-site activations.
  • Cultivate relationships with teams, leagues, schools, venues, and sports organizations to create new revenue opportunities.
  • Manage sports inventory, pricing, and sponsor fulfillment to maximize revenue and deliver on every client commitment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

Multi-Platform Advertising Solutions

  • Champion integrated solutions across television, CTV/OTT, streaming, display, search, social, digital audio, email, and audience targeting.
  • Coach sellers on discovery, positioning, audience strategy, measurement, and outcome-based selling.
  • Ensure proposals are strategic, accurately priced, executable, and aligned with client objectives.
  • Use campaign results to optimize performance, demonstrate value, renew business, and uncover growth opportunities.

 

Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Partner with WSOC-TV News and Sports on sponsorships, content integrations, and community-focused revenue opportunities.
  • Work with Creative Services to develop compelling, differentiated advertising solutions.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Digital Operations, Traffic, and other teams to execute multi-platform campaigns.
  • Create revenue opportunities around station initiatives, partnerships, special projects, and events.

 

Client Success and Retention

job.title: Senior Engineer, Commerce
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

FOX LATAM

FOX Latinoamérica inició operaciones en junio de 2025 y se ha posicionado como uno de los líderes en la programación deportiva en México y Centroamérica, ofreciendo un sólido portafolio de contenidos deportivos y derechos de transmisión de algunas de las ligas y torneos más prestigiosos del mundo, incluyendo la Liga MX, la Copa de Campeones de la Concacaf, la MLB y una selección de partidos de la NFL. La compañía transmite más de 2,000 eventos deportivos al año y cuenta con un equipo conformado por algunos de los talentos, periodistas y analistas deportivos más reconocidos de la región. La amplia oferta de contenido deportivo de FOX Latinoamérica está disponible a través de FOX y FOX+ en televisión lineal, del servicio de streaming directo al consumidor FOX One y del canal FOX en Tubi, la plataforma gratuita de streaming con publicidad (AVOD).

JOB DESCRIPTION

Sobre Fox Tech


Fox Tech desarrolla los productos digitales detrás de las marcas de deportes y entretenimiento de FOX. Nuestras aplicaciones funcionan en web, móvil y dispositivos de sala de estar, y millones de personas las usan, generalmente todas al mismo tiempo cuando comienza un partido. Esos picos de tráfico determinan cómo construimos todo.

Estamos contratando ingenieros para construir la próxima generación de nuestros productos de streaming.


Sobre el puesto


Te unirás al equipo de Comercio, que es responsable de los sistemas que manejan el dinero: pagos, impuestos, facturación y suscripciones en todos nuestros productos directos al consumidor. Un error aquí cuesta dólares reales, y un checkout lento cuesta un suscriptor, por lo que el estándar de corrección y disponibilidad es más alto que en casi cualquier otra parte de la infraestructura.


La mayor parte del trabajo ocurre detrás de la interfaz de checkout: autorización y captura de pagos; reembolsos, disputas y reconciliación; el ciclo de vida de las suscripciones, incluyendo renovaciones, upgrades, downgrades, cancelaciones y todos los estados intermedios; idempotencia y procesamiento de webhooks contra APIs de proveedores que reintentan, llegan fuera de orden y a veces “mienten”; cálculo de impuestos a través de proveedores externos; y el alcance de PCI DSS, manteniendo los datos sensibles de los clientes donde deben estar.


Trabajarás con stakeholders de distintas áreas de negocio de FOX, que no todas venden de la misma forma ni al mismo público. Parte del trabajo consiste en construir capacidades de comercio que puedan reutilizarse entre ellas sin homogeneizar la experiencia de cada una.


Cómo trabajamos


El ecosistema de desarrollo ha cambiado drásticamente en los últimos dos años, y nosotros hemos cambiado con él. Nuestros ingenieros usan agentes de código y herramientas de IA generativa como parte de su flujo de trabajo normal, no como un experimento ocasional. Esperamos que llegues con fluidez real: que sepas en qué casos estas herramientas son confiables y en cuáles no lo son, y que ya tengas tus propios hábitos para revisar, probar y proteger lo que producen.


Las herramientas en sí seguirán cambiando. Lo que funcionaba hace seis meses ya está desactualizado, y lo que estandaricemos este trimestre probablemente no será lo que usemos el próximo año. Buscamos ingenieros que vean esto como algo normal y que estén dispuestos a seguir replanteando su propio flujo de trabajo.


Para ser claros sobre el estándar: las herramientas de IA elevan lo que esperamos de ti, no lo reducen. Tú eres responsable del código, de las decisiones de diseño y del comportamiento en producción, sin importar quién (o qué) escribió el primer borrador.


Responsabilidades

  • Liderar la dirección técnica de las principales capacidades de comercio, desde el diseño hasta la operación en producción.
  • Liderar discusiones de arquitectura y tomar las decisiones de compromiso entre confiabilidad, costo, seguridad y velocidad de entrega.
  • Escribir código de alta calidad con cobertura de pruebas significativa y automatización.
  • Asumir la responsabilidad de producción: respuesta a incidentes, análisis de causa raíz y el trabajo de seguimiento que evita que el mismo incidente vuelva a ocurrir.
  • Mentorear a otros ingenieros y elevar el estándar de ingeniería del equipo.
  • Evaluar tecnologías emergentes de pagos y comercio, y argumentar a favor de cambios que mejoren de forma medible la conversión, la confiabilidad o el costo operativo.

Cómo se ve el éxito

  • Comercio se mantiene estable durante los grandes eventos en vivo, cuando el tráfico llega todo de una vez.
  • Los cambios de pagos y suscripciones se lanzan de forma segura, y puedes señalar la métrica que se movió.
  • Otras áreas de negocio de FOX pueden construir sobre tu trabajo sin heredar el flujo de checkout de otro equipo.

Calificaciones

  • Licenciatura en Ciencias de la Computación, o experiencia equivalente.
  • 5+ años de experiencia en ingeniería de software, con enfoque en APIs escalables y seguras, y sistemas basados en eventos.
  • Sólido dominio de Go. Nuestros servicios de comercio están escritos casi en su totalidad en Go, y necesitamos que empieces a escribir código de producción en este lenguaje desde el inicio.
  • Experiencia demostrable usando herramientas de IA generativa en desarrollo de software profesional. Puedes explicar dónde mejoraron tu flujo de trabajo, dónde introdujeron riesgos, y cómo revisas, pruebas y proteges el código asistido por IA.
  • Experiencia en el dominio de comercio. Has trabajado con Stripe, Adyen, Braintree o similares, y entiendes cómo se conectan las piezas entre sí.
  • Bases sólidas de ciencias de la computación e instintos fuertes de resolución de problemas.
  • Experiencia con decisiones de diseño y arquitectura de software a gran escala.
  • Sólida experiencia con SQL y NoSQL, idealmente DynamoDB y Redis.
  • Experiencia profesional con AWS u otro proveedor de nube.
  • Experiencia práctica con contenedores y Kubernetes.
  • Nuestros sistemas dan soporte a eventos en vivo y nuestro equipo está distribuido globalmente, por lo que el puesto implica algo de trabajo fuera del horario habitual: llamadas programadas entre regiones, además de respuesta a incidentes durante eventos importantes.

Deseable

  • Aplicaciones de streaming, especialmente aquellas que manejan eventos en vivo a gran escala.
  • Comercio electrónico, particularmente tráfico de alta disponibilidad en eventos como Black Friday.
  • Gestión del ciclo de vida de suscripciones: renovaciones, upgrades, downgrades y cancelaciones.
  • Idempotencia, procesamiento de webhooks, reintentos y consistencia eventual.
  • Comercio integrado directamente en una experiencia de streaming de video. Si has explorado esto, nos gustaría saberlo.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

FOX LATAM

FOX Latinoamérica inició operaciones en junio de 2025 y se ha posicionado como uno de los líderes en la programación deportiva en México y Centroamérica, ofreciendo un sólido portafolio de contenidos deportivos y derechos de transmisión de algunas de las ligas y torneos más prestigiosos del mundo, incluyendo la Liga MX, la Copa de Campeones de la Concacaf, la MLB y una selección de partidos de la NFL. La compañía transmite más de 2,000 eventos deportivos al año y cuenta con un equipo conformado por algunos de los talentos, periodistas y analistas deportivos más reconocidos de la región. La amplia oferta de contenido deportivo de FOX Latinoamérica está disponible a través de FOX y FOX+ en televisión lineal, del servicio de streaming directo al consumidor FOX One y del canal FOX en Tubi, la plataforma gratuita de streaming con publicidad (AVOD).

JOB DESCRIPTION

El Director de Operaciones de Producto y Delivery es el enlace principal entre el negocio de FOX One México y las áreas centralizadas de Producto, Operaciones de Producto, Delivery e Ingeniería.


Este puesto existe por tres razones, en este orden:


  • México está migrando. FOX One México está migrando de extremo a extremo desde sus plataformas de proveedor actuales —aplicaciones, identidad, comercio, derechos de acceso (entitlements), playout y distribución— hacia el stack tecnológico de FOX DTC, con un lanzamiento de primera fase previsto para el 15 de febrero de 2027. El mercado necesita una contraparte operativa dedicada dentro de la organización que lo está construyendo.
  • Después hay que operar México. Tras el lanzamiento, la salud del producto y de la operación debe medirse de forma continua, convertirse en trabajo de producto priorizado y en optimización de procesos de negocio, y llevarse a través de Delivery hasta un resultado validado.
  • América Latina es el siguiente paso. México es la primera instancia de un modelo replicable, no un caso aislado. Este puesto construye el modelo operativo, los procesos y la automatización que hacen que los siguientes mercados sean más rápidos y económicos, y asegura que las necesidades locales se resuelvan configurando una plataforma multi-tenant en lugar de desarrollos específicos por mercado.

La posición está facultada para actuar con autonomía —identificar oportunidades, formarse un criterio propio e iniciar trabajo sin esperar una solicitud formal— acompañada de la colaboración y comunicación necesarias para alinear a los líderes y aplicar las mejores prácticas de la organización DTC en favor de la escala y la eficiencia.


Responsabilidades Principales


Liderazgo de la Operación y del Negocio


  • Ser el responsable operativo del día a día y el punto de contacto único de FOX One México dentro de la organización de tecnología.
  • Investigar incidencias, llegar a conclusiones e impulsar mejoras de forma independiente, presentando una recomendación y no solo un reporte.
  • Construir relaciones de confianza con la dirección del negocio local, merchandising, mercadotecnia, finanzas y atención al cliente, y con sus contrapartes centralizadas en Estados Unidos.
  • Responsabilizarse de la preparación del mercado durante la migración y el lanzamiento: habilitación de merchandising, preparación de atención al cliente, operaciones locales de finanzas y negocio, y operación del día del lanzamiento.
  • Representar la realidad operativa del mercado en la planeación central, incluyendo aquello que no puede posponerse sin impacto al cliente.

Salud del Producto y de la Operación


  • Definir y ser responsable del marco de salud de producto y operación: qué se mide, qué se considera un buen resultado y dónde se ubican los umbrales.
  • Asegurar que existan los dashboards, las alertas y las revisiones recurrentes para que la salud sea visible sin que nadie tenga que solicitarla, en colaboración con los equipos que las construyen.
  • Detectar de forma temprana deterioros y riesgos emergentes, asegurar el diagnóstico de la causa y convertirlo en una corrección operativa o en una mejora de producto definida.
  • Establecer la línea base de medición de cada nuevo mercado de LATAM desde el lanzamiento, en lugar de reconstruirla después.

Gestión de Producto y Mejoras


  • Traducir las necesidades del negocio y de la operación en planteamientos de problema y SOPs que Delivery e Ingeniería puedan ejecutar sin una reunión de aclaración.
  • Facilitar la recepción y priorización de iniciativas del mercado dentro del modelo operativo DTC, y negociar capacidad en el roadmap frente a otros mercados y productos.
  • Validar que las soluciones entregadas cumplieron el objetivo que las justificó, medido contra el marco de salud, y señalarlo con claridad cuando no haya sido así.

Mejora de Procesos y Automatización


  • Tratar el modelo operativo como un producto: identificar dónde los procesos son manuales, lentos, propensos a error o dependientes de una sola persona, y corregirlos.
  • Mejorar la recepción de solicitudes, la priorización, el seguimiento de la ejecución, la gestión de liberaciones, la atención de incidentes y los reportes, alineados a las prácticas de gestión de portafolio de DTC.
  • Automatizar el trabajo operativo y de reporteo recurrente junto con Ingeniería, Analytics y los equipos de herramientas internas. Lo que es aceptable hacer a mano para un mercado resulta inviable con varios.
  • Documentar el modelo operativo para que pueda transferirse a un nuevo mercado, a una nueva persona o a un equipo.

Coordinación de la Entrega (Delivery)


  • Dirigir la ejecución con los equipos centralizados de Delivery y los equipos de Ingeniería distribuidos: requerimientos, dependencias, secuenciación, riesgos y fechas.
  • Mantener la visión de ejecución, dependencias y riesgos como un documento vivo, con una persona responsable y un siguiente paso en cada punto abierto.
  • Administrar la ruta crítica y poder expresar en una sola frase qué está bloqueando el lanzamiento o la liberación.
  • Eliminar bloqueos de forma activa: escalar de manera temprana, convocar a las personas correctas y cerrar el ciclo por escrito el mismo día.
  • Responsabilizarse de la preparación para la liberación y el cutover: criterios de go/no-go, ensayos, operación del día del lanzamiento, plan de reversión (rollback) y comunicación de incidentes.
  • Hacer cumplir la disciplina operativa: decisiones registradas, cambios de alcance documentados y acuerdos verbales asentados por escrito.

Reportes y Comunicación


  • Ser responsable del ritmo operativo del mercado: señal operativa diaria, estatus semanal de ejecución y riesgos, y revisión mensual de negocio y plataforma.
  • Reportar salud de plataforma y producto, desempeño del negocio, riesgos y dependencias, incidentes con impacto al cliente y estado del pipeline — con análisis y recomendación, no volcados de datos.
  • Servir de puente entre Negocio, Producto, Operaciones de Producto, Delivery, Ingeniería, Atención al Cliente, Mercadotecnia y Finanzas, en dos idiomas y entre husos horarios.
  • Gestionar de forma bilingüe la comunicación de escalamientos e incidentes con impacto al cliente. Un retraso debe surgir desde esta posición antes de manifestarse como una fecha incumplida.

Expansión Regional (LATAM)


  • Convertir lo aprendido en México en un manual replicable de lanzamiento de mercados: preparación operativa, línea base de medición, atención al cliente, comercio y habilitación de merchandising.
  • Definir qué es genuinamente específico de cada mercado y qué debe resolverse configurando la plataforma multi-tenant, y cuestionar las propuestas de desarrollos aislados.
  • Responsabilizarse de la preparación operativa de los siguientes mercados de LATAM y hacer crecer la función regional conforme aumente el alcance.

job.title: Senior Engineer, Commerce
job.description:
Fox Tech desarrolla los productos digitales detrás de las marcas de deportes y entretenimiento de FOX. Nuestras aplicaciones funcionan en web, móvil y dispositivos de sala de estar, y millones de personas las usan, generalmente todas al mismo tiempo cuando comienza un partido. Esos picos de tráfico determinan cómo construimos todo.

Estamos contratando ingenieros para construir la próxima generación de nuestros productos de streaming.

Te unirás al equipo de Comercio, que es responsable de los sistemas que manejan el dinero: pagos, impuestos, facturación y suscripciones en todos nuestros productos directos al consumidor. Un error aquí cuesta dólares reales, y un checkout lento cuesta un suscriptor, por lo que el estándar de corrección y disponibilidad es más alto que en casi cualquier otra parte de la infraestructura.

La mayor parte del trabajo ocurre detrás de la interfaz de checkout: autorización y captura de pagos; reembolsos, disputas y reconciliación; el ciclo de vida de las suscripciones, incluyendo renovaciones, upgrades, downgrades, cancelaciones y todos los estados intermedios; idempotencia y procesamiento de webhooks contra APIs de proveedores que reintentan, llegan fuera de orden y a veces “mienten”; cálculo de impuestos a través de proveedores externos; y el alcance de PCI DSS, manteniendo los datos sensibles de los clientes donde deben estar.

Trabajarás con stakeholders de distintas áreas de negocio de FOX, que no todas venden de la misma forma ni al mismo público. Parte del trabajo consiste en construir capacidades de comercio que puedan reutilizarse entre ellas sin homogeneizar la experiencia de cada una.

El ecosistema de desarrollo ha cambiado drásticamente en los últimos dos años, y nosotros hemos cambiado con él. Nuestros ingenieros usan agentes de código y herramientas de IA generativa como parte de su flujo de trabajo normal, no como un experimento ocasional. Esperamos que llegues con fluidez real: que sepas en qué casos estas herramientas son confiables y en cuáles no lo son, y que ya tengas tus propios hábitos para revisar, probar y proteger lo que producen.

Las herramientas en sí seguirán cambiando. Lo que funcionaba hace seis meses ya está desactualizado, y lo que estandaricemos este trimestre probablemente no será lo que usemos el próximo año. Buscamos ingenieros que vean esto como algo normal y que estén dispuestos a seguir replanteando su propio flujo de trabajo.

Para ser claros sobre el estándar: las herramientas de IA elevan lo que esperamos de ti, no lo reducen. Tú eres responsable del código, de las decisiones de diseño y del comportamiento en producción, sin importar quién (o qué) escribió el primer borrador.

  • Liderar la dirección técnica de las principales capacidades de comercio, desde el diseño hasta la operación en producción.
  • Liderar discusiones de arquitectura y tomar las decisiones de compromiso entre confiabilidad, costo, seguridad y velocidad de entrega.
  • Escribir código de alta calidad con cobertura de pruebas significativa y automatización.
  • Asumir la responsabilidad de producción: respuesta a incidentes, análisis de causa raíz y el trabajo de seguimiento que evita que el mismo incidente vuelva a ocurrir.
  • Mentorear a otros ingenieros y elevar el estándar de ingeniería del equipo.
  • Evaluar tecnologías emergentes de pagos y comercio, y argumentar a favor de cambios que mejoren de forma medible la conversión, la confiabilidad o el costo operativo.
  • Comercio se mantiene estable durante los grandes eventos en vivo, cuando el tráfico llega todo de una vez.
  • Los cambios de pagos y suscripciones se lanzan de forma segura, y puedes señalar la métrica que se movió.
  • Otras áreas de negocio de FOX pueden construir sobre tu trabajo sin heredar el flujo de checkout de otro equipo.
  • Licenciatura en Ciencias de la Computación, o experiencia equivalente.

job.title: Director, Product Operations & Delivery
job.description:
El Director de Operaciones de Producto y Delivery es el enlace principal entre el negocio de FOX One México y las áreas centralizadas de Producto, Operaciones de Producto, Delivery e Ingeniería.

Este puesto existe por tres razones, en este orden:

  • México está migrando. FOX One México está migrando de extremo a extremo desde sus plataformas de proveedor actuales —aplicaciones, identidad, comercio, derechos de acceso (entitlements), playout y distribución— hacia el stack tecnológico de FOX DTC, con un lanzamiento de primera fase previsto para el 15 de febrero de 2027. El mercado necesita una contraparte operativa dedicada dentro de la organización que lo está construyendo.
  • Después hay que operar México. Tras el lanzamiento, la salud del producto y de la operación debe medirse de forma continua, convertirse en trabajo de producto priorizado y en optimización de procesos de negocio, y llevarse a través de Delivery hasta un resultado validado.
  • América Latina es el siguiente paso. México es la primera instancia de un modelo replicable, no un caso aislado. Este puesto construye el modelo operativo, los procesos y la automatización que hacen que los siguientes mercados sean más rápidos y económicos, y asegura que las necesidades locales se resuelvan configurando una plataforma multi-tenant en lugar de desarrollos específicos por mercado.

La posición está facultada para actuar con autonomía —identificar oportunidades, formarse un criterio propio e iniciar trabajo sin esperar una solicitud formal— acompañada de la colaboración y comunicación necesarias para alinear a los líderes y aplicar las mejores prácticas de la organización DTC en favor de la escala y la eficiencia.

Responsabilidades Principales

Liderazgo de la Operación y del Negocio

  • Ser el responsable operativo del día a día y el punto de contacto único de FOX One México dentro de la organización de tecnología.
  • Investigar incidencias, llegar a conclusiones e impulsar mejoras de forma independiente, presentando una recomendación y no solo un reporte.
  • Construir relaciones de confianza con la dirección del negocio local, merchandising, mercadotecnia, finanzas y atención al cliente, y con sus contrapartes centralizadas en Estados Unidos.
  • Responsabilizarse de la preparación del mercado durante la migración y el lanzamiento: habilitación de merchandising, preparación de atención al cliente, operaciones locales de finanzas y negocio, y operación del día del lanzamiento.
  • Representar la realidad operativa del mercado en la planeación central, incluyendo aquello que no puede posponerse sin impacto al cliente.

Salud del Producto y de la Operación

  • Definir y ser responsable del marco de salud de producto y operación: qué se mide, qué se considera un buen resultado y dónde se ubican los umbrales.
  • Asegurar que existan los dashboards, las alertas y las revisiones recurrentes para que la salud sea visible sin que nadie tenga que solicitarla, en colaboración con los equipos que las construyen.
  • Detectar de forma temprana deterioros y riesgos emergentes, asegurar el diagnóstico de la causa y convertirlo en una corrección operativa o en una mejora de producto definida.
  • Establecer la línea base de medición de cada nuevo mercado de LATAM desde el lanzamiento, en lugar de reconstruirla después.

Gestión de Producto y Mejoras

  • Traducir las necesidades del negocio y de la operación en planteamientos de problema y SOPs que Delivery e Ingeniería puedan ejecutar sin una reunión de aclaración.
  • Facilitar la recepción y priorización de iniciativas del mercado dentro del modelo operativo DTC, y negociar capacidad en el roadmap frente a otros mercados y productos.
  • Validar que las soluciones entregadas cumplieron el objetivo que las justificó, medido contra el marco de salud, y señalarlo con claridad cuando no haya sido así.

Mejora de Procesos y Automatización

  • Tratar el modelo operativo como un producto: identificar dónde los procesos son manuales, lentos, propensos a error o dependientes de una sola persona, y corregirlos.
  • Mejorar la recepción de solicitudes, la priorización, el seguimiento de la ejecución, la gestión de liberaciones, la atención de incidentes y los reportes, alineados a las prácticas de gestión de portafolio de DTC.
  • Automatizar el trabajo operativo y de reporteo recurrente junto con Ingeniería, Analytics y los equipos de herramientas internas. Lo que es aceptable hacer a mano para un mercado resulta inviable con varios.
  • Documentar el modelo operativo para que pueda transferirse a un nuevo mercado, a una nueva persona o a un equipo.

Coordinación de la Entrega (Delivery)

  • Dirigir la ejecución con los equipos centralizados de Delivery y los equipos de Ingeniería distribuidos: requerimientos, dependencias, secuenciación, riesgos y fechas.
  • Mantener la visión de ejecución, dependencias y riesgos como un documento vivo, con una persona responsable y un siguiente paso en cada punto abierto.
  • Administrar la ruta crítica y poder expresar en una sola frase qué está bloqueando el lanzamiento o la liberación.
  • Eliminar bloqueos de forma activa: escalar de manera temprana, convocar a las personas correctas y cerrar el ciclo por escrito el mismo día.
  • Responsabilizarse de la preparación para la liberación y el cutover: criterios de go/no-go, ensayos, operación del día del lanzamiento, plan de reversión (rollback) y comunicación de incidentes.
  • Hacer cumplir la disciplina operativa: decisiones registradas, cambios de alcance documentados y acuerdos verbales asentados por escrito.

Reportes y Comunicación

  • Ser responsable del ritmo operativo del mercado: señal operativa diaria, estatus semanal de ejecución y riesgos, y revisión mensual de negocio y plataforma.
  • Reportar salud de plataforma y producto, desempeño del negocio, riesgos y dependencias, incidentes con impacto al cliente y estado del pipeline — con análisis y recomendación, no volcados de datos.
  • Servir de puente entre Negocio, Producto, Operaciones de Producto, Delivery, Ingeniería, Atención al Cliente, Mercadotecnia y Finanzas, en dos idiomas y entre husos horarios.
  • Gestionar de forma bilingüe la comunicación de escalamientos e incidentes con impacto al cliente. Un retraso debe surgir desde esta posición antes de manifestarse como una fecha incumplida.

Expansión Regional (LATAM)

  • Convertir lo aprendido en México en un manual replicable de lanzamiento de mercados: preparación operativa, línea base de medición, atención al cliente, comercio y habilitación de merchandising.
  • Definir qué es genuinamente específico de cada mercado y qué debe resolverse configurando la plataforma multi-tenant, y cuestionar las propuestas de desarrollos aislados.
  • Responsabilizarse de la preparación operativa de los siguientes mercados de LATAM y hacer crecer la función regional conforme aumente el alcance.

Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

  Overview  As a member of the Paramount Privacy engineering team, you’ll support the day-to-day operational management and implementation of the global Paramount Privacy Program. You’ll put user data protection first by building and supporting scalable tools, utilities, and infrastructure that keep consumer data secure across platforms—including connected TVs, mobile apps, and web ecosystems. You’ll partner closely with legal, product, and cross-functional technology teams to translate complex privacy regulations (such as GDPR and CCPA) into concrete engineering requirements and embed privacy-by-design principles directly into our systems. You’ll take technical ownership of privacy codebases while facilitating automated testing and compliance frameworks across the company.     Responsibilities
  • Partner with legal, product, and technology teams to embed privacy-by-design principles into products and backend infrastructure.
  • Translate global privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) into concrete engineering requirements, technical specifications, and system architectures.
  • Take technical ownership of privacy codebases and build, enhance, and maintain scalable Privacy infrastructure.
  • Develop new privacy technologies and extend existing tools, utilities, automation, and diagnostic scripts.
  • Conduct comprehensive privacy compliance audits across Web, Mobile, and Connected TV (CTV) platforms.
  • Automate consent management platform (CMP) compliance testing and execute cross-functional integration testing with engineering teams across different business units.
  • Create, maintain, document, and execute manual and automated test plans and test cases against our software platforms and applications.
  • Research, evaluate, and recommend new developer tools, frameworks, and methodologies to assist the privacy engineering team.
  • Document existing and new technical processes, maintaining clear architectural documentation for internal teams.

 

Basic Qualifications
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience with proficient engineering fundamentals (Git, testing, code review, CI/CD).
  • 5+ years of hands-on development experience with JavaScript or TypeScript.
  • 5+ years of experience building software tools, utilities, automation, and diagnostics using Python, Ruby, or Ruby on Rails.
  • 3+ years of experience developing and deploying cloud infrastructure on AWS or GCP.
  • Proven ability to execute automated and manual testing, extend test frameworks, and maintain CI/CD quality gates.

 

Bonus Skills (Nice-to-Haves)
  • 3+ years of experience developing, testing, or debugging mobile and OTT/CTV applications across Apple, Amazon, Android, and Roku platforms.Hands-on experience with SDK development, JavaScript bundlers, and build utilities (e.g., Webpack).
  • Experience conducting privacy compliance audits and diagnosing configuration issues with IAB frameworks.
  • Experience implementing or managing Consent Management Platforms (CMPs).
  • Active IAPP Certification (CIPT preferred).
  • An affinity for data protection, consumer trust, and privacy-by-design principles in media and entertainment.

TEGNA is seeking an experienced and business-oriented attorney to provide legal support on a part-time basis.   • Draft, review, revise, and negotiate a broad range of commercial agreements, including:
    • Content licensing and distribution agreements
    • Vendor and supplier agreements
    • Software licensing and SaaS agreements
    • Professional services agreements
    • Non-disclosure agreements
    • Marketing, advertising, and sponsorship agreements
  • Provide timely legal advice and risk assessments to internal business teams.
  • Support contract management initiatives and legal process improvements.
  • Assist with compliance, privacy, and corporate governance matters as needed.
  • Partner with procurement, technology, finance, HR, and other departments to facilitate business objectives while appropriately managing legal risk.
  • Handle special projects and legal research assignments as requested.

  • Juris Doctor (JD) from an accredited law school.

  • Strong understanding of contract law and commercial transactions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize competing demands, and meet deadlines.

Money, Power & Influence Reporter, based in Miami and working as part of the state team

South Florida is one of the most consequential regions in the nation, where politics, development, business, wealth, international investment and public policy intersect daily. This position supports Florida's One Team strategy by producing enterprise and accountability journalism that can drive readership across multiple markets while establishing the network as the leading source of reporting on power and influence in Florida.

South Florida is one of the most dynamic, complex and consequential regions in America, where billion-dollar development deals, political power, corporate interests, international investment and cultural influence intersect every day.

We're seeking an ambitious, competitive and deeply curious Money, Power & Influence Reporter to cover the individuals, institutions and networks shaping South Florida's future. This reporter will deliver exclusive accountability journalism, break news, follow the money, explain how decisions are made behind closed doors and reveal the impact on residents, businesses and communities.

The ideal candidate thrives on cultivating high-level sources, uncovering hidden connections and translating complex financial, political and business issues into compelling journalism that resonates with a broad audience. This reporter will produce a mix of breaking news, watchdog reporting, investigations, enterprise features, analysis, video and audience-focused explainers.

This beat spans Miami-Dade, Broward and Palm Beach counties and examines how money and influence flow through politics, business, development, real estate, philanthropy, sports, higher education and major cultural institutions.

Key Responsibilities:

Break exclusive stories involving government, business, development, lobbying, campaign finance, economic power and influential decision-makers.

Track major real estate and development projects, following the money behind transformative projects and public-private partnerships.

Examine how political, business and civic leaders shape public policy, economic growth and community outcomes.

Build and maintain a sophisticated source network that includes elected officials, executives, developers, investors, attorneys, lobbyists, nonprofit leaders and community advocates.

Investigate campaign spending, government contracts, regulatory decisions and influence networks.

Analyze public records, financial disclosures, corporate filings, campaign finance reports and property records.

Produce accountability journalism that reveals who benefits, who is affected and what readers need to know.

Collaborate with reporters across Florida to connect regional stories to statewide and national trends.

Develop video, social and newsletter content that expands the reach and impact of key stories.

Pursue stories from inception through aftermath, tracking consequences and holding institutions accountable over time.

What You'll Cover:

Real estate development and growth

Wealth, philanthropy and influence

Corporate power and economic development

Government transparency and accountability

Sports, entertainment and cultural power centers and people

Housing, affordability and economic opportunity

Emerging industries and innovation

The individuals and institutions driving South Florida's future

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in journalism, communications or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Minimum of 3-5 years of reporting experience, preferably covering business, politics, government, investigations or accountability journalism.

Demonstrated ability to break news and produce exclusive enterprise reporting.

Strong source-building and interviewing skills.

Experience working with public records, databases and financial documents.

Ability to explain complex subjects with clarity and authority.

Strong news judgment and understanding of audience interests.

Experience with data journalism and investigative techniques is preferred.

Ability to collaborate across newsroom teams and contribute to statewide coverage.

Multimedia skills, including video and social storytelling, are a plus.

job.title: Director, Advertising Sales
job.description:
AccuWeather is seeking an accomplished, strategic and results-driven Advertising Sales Director in New York to help build and sell digital advertising solutions. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced sales leader with a proven track record to navigate complex digital media and data targeting solutions, work cross-functionally to develop innovative advertising solutions and build lasting client relationships. You’ll contribute to a high-caliber team in a business that is experiencing rapid and dramatic growth. We are looking for demonstrated performance in a constantly changing, ambiguous environment and problem-solving leadership with limited oversight.

This role will manage Holding Company agency relationships with a focus on the C-Suite, Agency Investment Leads, Brand Teams, Buying Teams, Programmatic Buying Arms and Data Analytics & Strategy Teams. In partnership with senior leadership, this role will develop a strategy specific to assigned holding companies, while driving AccuWeather’s media, data, measurement and analytics revenue. This position requires extensive knowledge of the changing agency & media landscape, the drive to develop industry-transforming strategies and the ability to build relationships with senior agency management and brands direct. The ideal candidate has media agency planning experience, a deep knowledge of measurement & analytics used to evaluate performance, ability to develop and effectively communicate creative ideas and solutions along with a proven ability to influence multiple levels of an organization.

This position will be located onsite at AccuWeather’s New York City office with the expectation of being in office with teammates three days a week.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Achieve and exceed revenue goals set by the company for existing and new accounts. Focus on selling AccuWeather digital advertising products to advertising agency and brand direct partners maintaining and fostering positive relationships across both new and existing clients.
  • Build and elevate relationships at the highest levels within the assigned agencies, C-Suite, Senior Agency Influencers to continuously uncover strategic opportunities to drive AccuWeather revenue on a global, regional, and local level.
  • Serve as internal voice of the agency customer to help shape product and marketing roadmaps. Assess the revenue potential of assigned account list and identify highest value targets.
  • Prospect new business opportunities within territory through regular, thoughtful outreach to new clients/agencies with face-to-face meetings, presentations, events, entertainment and other related efforts.
  • Identify revenue opportunities to grow existing clients/advertising agencies relationships.
  • Client account management including, but not limited to: maintaining contact lists, establishing meeting cadence with (internal and external) key stakeholders, seeking out new relationships/contacts, developing quarterly business reviews, organizing and coordinating agency education initiatives (cross discipline agency days and/or training sessions), fulfilling ad hoc client requests, campaign performance reviews along with client entertaining.
  • Consistent pipeline maintenance, and strong internal communications skills to ensure leadership and cross functional partners are apprise of pipeline updates, progress to goal, territory updates and opportunities, along with challenges
  • Contribute to AccuWeather’s tentpole senior-level events, conferences and activations within assigned agencies.
  • Collaborate with internal specialists (i.e. marketing, strategy, data, operations/analytics) as needed to meet revenue requirements and to continuously identify relevant opportunities for agencies/brands.
  • Contribute to agency holding company partnership level agreements, with opportunity to lead specific initiatives in addition to capturing revenue opportunities at the account level
  • Be a trusted thought leader to both external stakeholders and investment teams by leading consistent customer and prospect education initiatives and events.
  • Operate at the ‘tip of the spear’, immersing in industry shifts (in-housing, rise of independent agencies and consultancies etc.) and competitive offerings, to bring an ‘outside-in’ perspective, framing new sales initiatives and recommendations
  • Demonstrate thought leadership in the industry; act as an ambassador and spokesperson for AccuWeather in the advertising community.
  • Other duties as assigned.

 

QUALIFICATIONS 

  • BA/BS degree required with 5+ years digital ad sales experience with a focus on digital media, programmatic, first party data and analytics; experience executing large scale brand partnerships across channels ideal.
  • High performer – achieve and exceed revenue targets through effective sales strategies, performance optimization and development of innovative campaign strategies.
  • Demonstrated ability to think strategically about a particular industry and/or product set to achieve customer goals and KPIs; ability to think creatively to solve problems to maintain and grow revenue, and to break new business
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills along with strong presentation skills in both small and large groups.
  • Familiarity with agency holding companies and strong relationships across the agency and brand direct
  • Ability to work collaboratively amidst cross-functional teams including but not limited to strategy, marketing, ad operations and analytics.
  • Tenacious and driven self-starter who takes a hands-on approach in discovering new business opportunities and proactive outreach with a focus on high-value prospects.
  • Hunter mentality – focus on cold outreach and prospecting to secure meetings with new clients and expanding relationships with existing.
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration skills. Ability to build internal networks to accomplish goals through collaboration with resources across teams.
  • Driven and solution-oriented and can overcome obstacles to drive projects through completion and can balance the need for quick turnaround with longer-term strategic efforts.
  • Strong writing and copy-editing skills.
  • Comfortable with a fast-paced, always-on, start-up environment
  • Strong belief in AccuWeather's vision and goals

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Demonstrated marketing abilities, programmatic advertising expertise and experience pitching first party data
  • Exhibits a high level of competency in oral and written communication skills
  • Demonstrated expertise in building relationships with senior agency decision makers.

 

Pay Transparency: AccuWeather offers a competitive salary commensurate to experience in the range of $130K - $150K base + commission.

 

ABOUT ACCUWEATHER
 
AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making.

A billion people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™ across our consumer digital platforms. AccuWeather.com is the #1 weather destination and one of the top 100 most-visited websites in the world, and our award-winning AccuWeather app delivers detailed real-time forecasts to millions of smartphones.

AccuWeather forecasts also appear on digital signage, in 700 newspapers, are heard on over 400 radio stations, and viewed on 100 television stations. The AccuWeather Network and AccuWeather NOW® reach an audience of over 125 million on cable and streaming platforms including DirecTV, Charter Communications - Spectrum, Verizon, Philo, Frndly TV, Comcast’s Xfinity X1 and Xfinity Stream, Roku, Xumo, Rockbot, LG, and Amazon Freevee.

AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally.

Dr. Joel Myers, Founder and Executive Chairman, established AccuWeather in 1962 and is considered the “father of modern commercial meteorology.” Myers, a leading creative thinker and visionary, has been called “the most accurate man in weather” by The New York Times and has been recognized as one of the top entrepreneurs in American history by Entrepreneur’s Encyclopedia of Entrepreneurs.  

 

COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY & INCLUSION

AccuWeather is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity to all applicants and existing employees and we evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity/expression), sexual orientation, age, ancestry, physical or mental disability, marital status, political affiliation, religion, citizenship status, genetic information, veteran status, or any other basis protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

If you need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process, please send an e-mail to human.resources@accuweather.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

The New York Times is continuing to expand its video journalism, identifying compelling video and audio stories across the depth and breadth of our report. We showcase the expertise of Times journalists on-camera, share urgent news updates, produce on-the-ground reporting, pioneering Visual Investigations, and Shows. We are looking for a Director of Post Production Operations and Support to oversee the video post-production workflows, systems, and technical support that enable reliable newsroom video and show production at scale. This role sits within the newsroom's Media Operations team, works across all field and studio production, and manages a team of post production and technical specialists charged with developing, implementing, and supporting best-in-class workflows for our video journalism.

You will report to the Head of Media Operations and partner closely with the senior leaders overseeing our video journalism, the Director of Studios, and the leaders of production management, editorial operations, and cinematography. This is an in-office position based in New York and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week.

  • Establish, socialize, and maintain quality control standards for color, and other disciplines central to publishing video assets

  • Collaborate closely with Editorial leadership to align post-production resources with editorial priorities and initiatives

  • Maintain current documentation, training and technical onboarding for producers, editors, journalists, engineers and other newsroom partners
