  • 5+ years of management experience

  • Experience supporting both studio and field production

  • Proven deep knowledge of production and post-production systems, media asset management, cloud workflows, networking and digital publishing workflows

  • Proven ability to build and continuously improve scalable systems while supporting urgent, deadline-driven production

  • Demonstrated experience managing technology budgets, vendors, procurement and equipment lifecycles

  • Proven experience leading technical teams in a fast-moving newsroom, media or broadcast environment

job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

About the Role:

The Times has an unparalleled reputation for excellence in visual journalism. We have defined multimedia storytelling for the news industry and established ourselves as the clear leader. Over the past several years, our work with 3D and spatial formats has revealed new and unique opportunities to tell stories that expand our readers’ understanding of the world and help them navigate it.

The New York Times is seeking a temporary Graphics Editor/Developer to explore how Web XR can expand the possibilities of journalism and visual storytelling. This role will sit at the intersection of graphics, visual journalism, design, engineering, and R&D.

You will conduct hands-on research and development, build experimental prototypes, and help establish reproducible approaches for immersive storytelling.

Potential subject areas include climate change, environmental data, science and other complex global issues that benefit from immersive explanation.

The role is designed to advance both published journalism and the wider field through public documentation, open experimentation, and knowledge sharing. In addition to being a part of a team that builds cutting-edge visual experiences, you will collaborate on opportunities to share technical findings, contribute to reproducible approaches for the field, and participate in industry knowledge sharing.

This is a temporary (12 month) in-office position based in New York and includes regular attendance in the office four days a week.

Responsibilities:
  • Conceive, prototype, and test web and WebXR experiences for journalism.
  • Conduct technical experiments across immersive storytelling formats, interaction models, and web-based XR technologies.
  • Develop new methods for translating complex environmental data, systems, and scenarios into understandable immersive experiences.
  • Work with journalists, graphics editors, designers, engineers, and R&D partners to shape concepts from early exploration through prototypes or publication.
  • Apply strong editorial judgment to ensure that immersive experiences are accurate, clear, accessible, and grounded in journalistic principles.
  • Document and share technical decisions, discoveries, and reproducible frameworks throughout the R&D process, disseminating insights to internal teams and the wider creative ecosystem via public posts, conference presentations, peer workshops, or open-source resources.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.
  • You will report to the Special Projects Editor on the Graphics desk.
Basic Requirements:
  • 3+ years of relevant professional experience
  • A portfolio of 3D/immersive work
  • 3D web development
  • Familiarity with Unity or Unreal
  • Expertise in Blender, Maya or Cinema 4D
  • Proficient in 3D modeling, optimization and animation
  • Familiarity with Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop and After Effects and Figma
  • An appetite for experimentation and prototyping
  • Experience translating complex technical workflows, engineering challenges, and 3D graphics concepts into clear, accessible written documentation and case studies.
Preferred Requirements:
  • Experience developing for Apple Vision Pro, Meta Quest or similar HMDs
  • WebXR experience
  • Familiarity with Python and/or Javascript
  • Experience with GLSL a plus
  • Experience using machine learning and AI tools for building 3D scenes and interactions
  • Comfort presenting technical work to diverse audiences, ranging from newsroom journalists and product designers to external developer communities and industry panels.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
This position is represented by the NewsGuild of NY.   REQ-020897

About the Role

The New York Times is hiring a Vice President, Audience Insights to lead a high-impact team of researchers working to inform company-wide priorities. 

You will oversee rigorous, insightful, and actionable research for partners spanning our data, design, growth, product, marketing, and strategy organizations, as well as the newsroom. Responsibilities

job.title: Financial Analyst
job.description:

We are seeking a self-motivated and detail-oriented Financial Analyst with excellent communication and critical thinking skills who thrives working in a collaborative fast-paced environment. This role will serve as essential support for the Accounting and Finance operations for TITOL. 

The primary function of the role is performing financial analysis and preparing 3rd party artist reporting including project P&Ls, profit split statements, and royalty statements. job.title: Deputy head of multimedia
job.description:
Guardian Australia is part of Guardian News & Media (GNM), publisher of theguardian.com. As a leading global media organisation, we are renowned for our pioneering independent journalism and our award-winning digital products.

We are seeking for a deputy head of multimedia to help lead Guardian Australia's multimedia department, fostering an experimental culture to ensure it stays ahead of market trends and remains at the cutting edge of audio, video and social media journalism.

This role is being offered on a full-time, permanent basis, with early starts or late finishes. This role is open to candidates based in both Sydney and Melbourne.

In this role you will…

  • Manage the production and oversight of audio, video and off-platform content to ensure it meets editorial goals, standards, objectives and purpose.
  • Stay across developments in video, audio and off-platform storytelling and innovate to find and engage new audiences.
  • Manage the planning, development and execution of content across platforms, including budget considerations.
  • Liaise with UK and US audio, video and off-platform teams to make sure Guardian Australia is benefitting from their work and innovation, and is reaching  global audiences where appropriate.  
  • Provide team leadership, strategic direction and management to executive producers, producers and hosts. 
  • With the head of multimedia, manage video and off-platform teams, including day-to-day editorial tasks.  

 

You’ll bring….

Knowledge and experience

  • At least 8 years of experience editing in a national newsroom, including multimedia reporting and editing 
  • Proven experience in managing staff, news editing and editorial decision making 
  • Able to commission compelling and accurate stories to tight deadlines
  • Wide knowledge of and interest in news and current affairs, domestically and internationally
  • Proven experience in multimedia production and commissioning 
  • Excellent knowledge of Australian media law
  • Excellent knowledge social media platforms and how to effectively use them to boost reputation and engagement
  • Expert understanding of the evolving ways people consume news video and audio on and off platform
  • Track record in journalism innovation 
  • Excellent team leadership skills
  • Experience mentoring and developing talent
  • Familiarity with the issues that prompt debate within Guardian Australia’s  readership
  • Clear vision of the purpose, aims and values of Guardian Australia
  • Understanding of the demands of a fast-moving news organisation
  • Able to respond quickly to changing events and breaking new

 

Skills / behaviours

  • A passion for independent journalism and an understanding of our editorial code and values
  • Proactive self-starter and strong team player
  • Excellent interpersonal and management skills
  • Ability to work under pressure, to prioritise and meet deadlines
  • Imaginative and able to work independently as well as generate ideas and motivate others 
  • High attention to detail
  • Good organisation, planning and time-management skills 
  • Collaborative team player who is also open to feedback, correction and is comfortable with performance accountability
  • Resilient and comfortable working under pressure
  • Willingness to experiment with new ideas and formats

 

About working at Guardian Australia… 

  • Hybrid working

The Director Sales is responsible for the sales, management and production of special events, advertisements, and maintaining the budgets. In addition, the Director Sales will execute special event contracts and letter agreements, and plan and successfully execute special events.

Job Summary

  • Network, research, and cold call potential clients to create new business opportunities.

  • Prepare contracts and letter agreements once proposals are accepted.
  • Initiate creation of invoices and new customer setup.
  • Submit budgets and change orders.

  • Advanced degree preferred

WHO ARE WE?

Versatile, autonomous high performer in multiple disciplines, and specifically in augmenting each discipline with an AI practice. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

 

THE ROLE

Live Nation Core Data Services is looking for a world class Lead AI Development Experience Engineer to architect and build the foundational AI tooling and platform enabling teams across the organization to create, deploy, and manage AI agents, workflows, applications, and automations. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, developer tooling, productivity tools, and generative AI, focused on democratizing AI capabilities for both technical and non-technical users. We are a global org, and we need someone comfortable working globally across time zones.

This role requires enterprise cross-functional team experience and engineering expertise with hands-on experience in generative AI tooling. ABOUT THE RECORDING ACADEMY AND ITS AFFILIATES

 

RECORDING ACADEMY

The Recording Academy represents the voices of performers, songwriters, producers, engineers, and all music professionals. Dedicated to ensuring the recording arts remain a thriving part of our shared cultural heritage, the Academy honors music's history while investing in its future through the Grammy Museum, advocates on behalf of music creators, supports music people in times of need through MusiCares, and celebrates artistic excellence through the Grammy Awards—music's only peer-recognized accolade and highest achievement. As the world's leading society of music professionals, we work year-round to foster a more inspiring world for creators.

 

LATIN RECORDING ACADEMY

The Latin Recording Academy is an international, membership-based organization comprised of Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking recording artists, musicians, songwriters, producers and other creative and technical recording professionals. The organization is dedicated to improving the quality of life and cultural condition for Latin music and its makers. In addition to producing the Latin Grammy Awards to honor excellence in the recorded arts and sciences, The Latin Recording Academy provides educational and outreach programs for the Latin music community either directly or through its Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation.

 

LATIN GRAMMY CULTURAL FOUNDATION

The Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation is a charitable organization established by the Latin Recording Academy in 2014. The organization is dedicated to creating opportunities for the next generation of Latin music creators through scholarships, educational programs, grants, and access to creators and industry executives.

 

MUSICARES

A friend and ally of the music community, MusiCares was established by the Recording Academy to safeguard the health and well-being of all music people. A four-star charity and safety net in times of need, MusiCares offers confidential preventative, recovery, and emergency programs to address financial, medical, and personal health issues. Through the generosity of our donors and volunteer professionals, our dedicated team works across the country to ensure the music community has the resources and support it needs.

 

GRAMMY MUSEUM

The Grammy Museum is a nonprofit organization dedicated to celebrating and exploring music from yesterday and today to inspire the music of tomorrow through music preservation, education, exhibitions, and public programming and aims to create a world in which shared love of music sparks curiosity, creativity, and community. Programs include Grammy in the Schools education programs that are offered year-round for students, teachers, and schools throughout the United States. 

 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Hoe versterken we de reputatie van één van de grootste werkgevers van Nederland? Welke influencers schakelen we in bij een lancering van een nieuw product? Hoe zorgen we dat de onze klant goed in de media komt? Als jouw hart sneller gaat kloppen van deze vragen, dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Wat ga je doen?

Stage lopen bij Burson betekent dat je meteen veel verantwoordelijkheden krijgt. Als stagiair maak je écht onderdeel uit van ons team en word je zoveel mogelijk betrokken bij verschillende activiteiten.

Je werkt nauw samen met je collega’s aan opdrachten voor merken zoals SharkNinja, Jaguar Land Rover en Procter & Gamble (o.a. Gillette, Always en Olay). Afhankelijk van de klanten in jouw portfolio ondersteun je bijvoorbeeld bij andere inhoudelijke taken als het verzamelen van relevante informatie, het maken van media-, concurrentie- of stakeholderanalyses, het meedenken over de invulling van nieuwe social media- of influencer-campagnes en het creëren van content voor verschillende kanalen. Er wordt hard gewerkt in de diverse klantteams, maar de werksfeer is open, informeel en eigen initiatief wordt zeer gewaardeerd!

Wie zijn wij? 

Burson staat voor strategie en communicatie, met adviseurs die door opdrachtgevers worden ingeschakeld als het er echt om gaat. Wij helpen bedrijven en organisaties in de meest uiteenlopende en vaak uitdagende omstandigheden, waarbij wij ze adviseren in hun transities en transformaties. Met het creëren van stakeholderacceptatie als doel. Nooit om de status quo te beschermen, niet om op elke hype in te gaan, maar om ze met een gegronde strategie toekomstbestendig te maken.

Onze adviseurs zijn met hun brede ervaring, vakmanschap en integriteit erkende boardroompartners. Onafhankelijk en kritisch zetten zij de discussie met onze opdrachtgevers op scherp. Burson heeft jarenlange ervaring in het adviseren van bedrijven in complexe situaties, onder meer op het gebied van strategie, stakeholdermanagement en geloofwaardige communicatie.

We zijn onderdeel van Burson Group, een internationaal communicatiebureau bestaande uit een groot netwerk met meer dan 95 kantoren in ruim 40 landen. Samen maken wij onderdeel uit van WPP: het grootste marketing- en communicatiebedrijf ter wereld. Sinds 2019 zijn wij onder één dak gevestigd op onze Amsteldok-campus in Amsterdam. Daarnaast hebben wij in Nederland ook een kantoor in Den Haag.

Wie ben jij?

Heb jij je altijd al afgevraagd hoe het is om stage te lopen bij een internationaal communicatiebureau? Ben je goed op de hoogte van het laatste nieuws? Weet je je weg te vinden in de onlinewereld? Ben je communicatief vaardig, leergierig en stel je altijd de juiste vragen? Dan past deze stage perfect bij jou.

Je staat open voor nieuwe ideeën en opvattingen, bent breed geïnteresseerd en zoekt graag dingen tot op de bodem uit. Bij ons zijn studenten van alle studieachtergronden welkom die geïnteresseerd zijn in communicatie, marketing en media.

Wat bieden wij?

Tijdens je stage ontvang je een maandelijkse stagevergoeding van €650 (gebaseerd op een volledige werkweek) en word je begeleid door twee collega’s. Elke maand heb je een coachingsgesprek over je eigen ambities en wensen. Halverwege je stage is er een tussentijds feedbackgesprek waarin genoeg ruimte is om aan te geven wat je nog meer uit je stage wil halen. Daarnaast kun je altijd terecht bij andere Young Professionals (trainees), consultants en senior-adviseurs met vragen. Tenslotte worden je reiskosten vergoed en is het mogelijk om op vrijdagen  vanuit huis te werken.

Enthousiast?

Je kunt solliciteren t/m 1 december. De gesprekken zullen dan in de weken erna plaatsvinden. De startdatum van de stage is flexibel, maar idealiter 1 februari.

job.title: KSL Content Producer, Social Media (Part-time)
job.description:
Our company is committed to being trusted voices of light and truth reaching hundreds of millions of people worldwide.

Who We Are

KSL is Utah’s leading local news source across digital and broadcast platforms, delivering trusted, award‑winning journalism through KSL.com and KSL‑TV. We provide in‑depth local reporting, investigative journalism, and up‑to‑the‑minute coverage that serves communities across the state. Committed to being a trusted voice of light and knowledge, KSL helps Utahns stay informed, connected, and engaged with the issues that matter most.


Position Overview

The Social Media Producer is responsible for creating, publishing, and optimizing content across all KSL social platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X, YouTube, Threads, and emerging channels. This role plays a key part in growing audience, increasing engagement, supporting newsroom priorities, and ensuring KSL’s social presence reflects strong journalism and brand identity.


The producer collaborates closely with News, Digital, Creative Services/Marketing, Promotions, and the broader social team to translate daily content, enterprise stories, special projects, and initiatives into compelling, platform-native posts.


Note: Work configurations are subject to change based on business needs and at company discretion.

  • This position is an hybrid role that requires the employee to sometimes work at our Salt Lake City site. Specific hybrid schedules will be determined based on business needs and evaluated by managers and senior management. Employee will need to be on-site during the training period.

What You Will Do:

Primary job duties will include, but are not limited to:


Daily Content Production 

  • Produce and publish social posts across all platforms, including:  
  • Headlines, captions, and teases 
  • Vertical and horizontal video 
  • Graphics and thumbnails 
  • Reels, TikToks, Shorts, carousels, and live updates 
  • Create and monitor live streams on YouTube and Facebook 
  • Package newsroom content (breaking news, enterprise, features) into engaging social formats. 

Platform Management & Scheduling 

  • Maintain daily posting cadence across KSL’s social accounts. 
  • Monitor posts for accuracy, engagement, and community response. 
  • Looking for opportunities to live stream.  
  • Participate in real-time coverage for breaking news and major events. 

Audience Engagement & Community Management 

  • Respond appropriately to user comments when needed; escalate issues for moderation. 
  • Identify engagement opportunities and trends that align with brand safety and editorial standards. 

Trend Monitoring & Creative Development 

  • Track emerging trends, formats, audio, and platform features across all networks. 
  • Pitch social-first ideas and series that reflect KSL priorities and audience interest. 

Collaboration & Cross-Department Support 

  • Work with reporters, producers, and editors to build social versions of stories. 
  • Support branding, promotions, and station campaigns with social content. 
  • Assist in producing social deliverables for special projects or advertiser campaigns as assigned. 

Analytics & Best Practices 

  • Review platform insights to understand what topics and formats perform best. 
  • Apply best practices for timing, format, thumbnails, hooks, and retention. 
  • Contribute performance insights in team meetings. 


Skills and Experience We Are Looking For:


Required 

  • 1–3 years of experience in social media, digital content creation, or video production. 
  • Proven ability to create content for multiple social platforms in a professional or brand setting. 
  • Strong writing and editing skills tailored to social platforms. 
  • Experience with basic video editing and graphic tools (CapCut, Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, etc.). 
  • Solid understanding of best practices for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X, and YouTube. 
  • Ability to work quickly and calmly in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. 
  • Flexibility to work occasional nights, weekends, or holidays for major news events or station priorities. 

Preferred 

  • Experience working in a newsroom or media organization. 
  • Knowledge of Utah, local issues, and KSL’s audience. 
  • Familiarity with social analytics tools (native insights, YouTube Studio, etc.). 
  • Comfort appearing on-camera occasionally (not required but a plus). 

Physical Demands

  • Receive, process, and maintain information through oral and/or written communication effectively.
  • Manual dexterity and fine motor skills to operate computer keys and general office equipment. Ability to work on a computer for prolonged periods of time.
  • Sit and/or stand for extended periods of time.
  • Lift, move, and carry up to 30 pounds on occasion.

Compensation

 $16.00 - $20.00 an hour. Hourly rate to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to evaluation of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant along with internal equity and alignment with market data.


What We Offer You: Check Out Our KSL Benefits!

Employees at KSL can enjoy a broad offering of benefits, including:

  • 401(k) with Company match, fully vested from day one
  • Paid time off for volunteering
  • Employer-funded retirement account, fully vested from day one
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) services
  • Access to an entire team of free financial planners
  • Matches on contributions to charitable organizations after one year of service
  • Continuous growth and development opportunities
  • Dynamic team culture that values teamwork, having fun, and collaboration

KSL is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law. Minority/female/disability PWDNET/veteran are encouraged to apply.

job.title: KSL Cougar Tracks Producer (Full-time)
job.description:
Our company is committed to being trusted voices of light and truth reaching hundreds of millions of people worldwide.

Who We Are

KSL is Utah’s leading local news source across digital and broadcast platforms, delivering trusted, award‑winning journalism through KSL.com and KSL‑TV. We provide in‑depth local reporting, investigative journalism, and up‑to‑the‑minute coverage that serves communities across the state. Committed to being a trusted voice of light and knowledge, KSL helps Utahns stay informed, connected, and engaged with the issues that matter most.

 

Position Overview

Cougar Tracks is KSL Sports' podcast about BYU athletics. It is where Cougar fans go for news, analysis, and conversation about the teams they follow. We are hiring a full-time Podcast Producer to own production of the show from start to finish and grow its audience on YouTube and social media.


In this role, you will film and edit every episode and turn each one into short clips that bring new viewers to the show. The ideal candidate understands how audiences find and watch content on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and X and can turn that knowledge into more views, subscribers, and engagement.


You do not just finish edits; you want the show to grow. You look at an episode and know which 45 seconds will get shared. You check the analytics because you want to know why one video took off and another did not. You are excited by the chance to build the biggest place online for BYU sports conversation.

 

Note: Work configurations are subject to change based on business needs and at company discretion.

  • This position is an on-site role that requires the employee to regularly work at our Salt Lake City site.
  • This role follows the sports calendar and requires flexibility for game days, evenings, weekends, and breaking news, especially during football and basketball seasons.

 

What You Will Do:

Primary job duties will include, but are not limited to:

  • Film regular episodes, interviews, and remote or on-location recordings using multi-camera video production.
  • Edit the audio and video for each full episode with clean pacing, consistent sound, and polished graphics, then publish on schedule to YouTube and podcast platforms.
  • Identify strong moments from each episode, including hot takes, breaking-news reactions, funny exchanges, and compelling analysis, and turn them into short vertical and horizontal clips tailored to each platform.
  • Add captions, graphics, hooks, and thumbnails that encourage viewers to stop scrolling and click.
  • Grow the YouTube channel by writing titles, descriptions, and tags; designing thumbnails; and using YouTube Analytics to improve future videos.
  • Lead the social strategy by planning when and where to post, reacting quickly to BYU news, and testing new formats and trends to reach more fans.
  • Partner with the host and editorial staff on episode planning, guest-booking logistics, and promotion across KSL platforms.

 

Skills and Experience We Are Looking For:



  • Proven experience editing long-form podcast or video episodes.
  • Hands-on experience filming video, including camera setup, framing, lighting, and audio capture.
  • Strong ability to identify and edit short-form social clips.
  • Proficiency with video-editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro.
  • Clear understanding of YouTube, including thumbnails, titles, audience retention, and the platform algorithm.
  • Fluency with Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and X, with an understanding of what works on each platform.
  • Ability to work quickly during news cycles and meet recurring publishing deadlines.

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.

 

Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

 

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

 

This is a hybrid position with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

 

Role Summary

 

As our Junior Specialist, Real Estate Transactions, you provide core operational, analytical and administrative support to the Real Estate Transactions team. Operating with a high degree of autonomy on day-to-day assignments, you maintain real estate portfolio data, track critical lease milestones, ensure regulatory compliance, prepare quarterly management reports and deliver administrative support to regional offices. This role directly assists the Senior Co-ordinator and Senior Manager in ensuring data integrity and operational excellence across the corporate real estate portfolio.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

Lease Portfolio Administration and Data Validation

  • Develop strategic planning reports at the beginning of each fiscal year to establish the planned transactions road map and team delivery milestones.
  • Monitor critical lease life-cycle dates (including renewal notice deadlines, option windows and expiries), proactively issuing monthly reminders.
  • Prepare and distribute internal client satisfaction surveys, actively tracking responses to facilitate timely lease renewal approvals.
  • Reconcile and integrate monthly accounts payable and receivable statements from the third-party property management service provider (BGIS) into the real estate portfolio database, supplementing entries with strategic and operational metrics; maintain the database by incorporating unbilled or forecasted transactions not included in BGIS reports to ensure strict deadline tracking and accurate reporting.
  • Prepare baseline financial forecasting assumptions for payable and receivable leases under team supervision to assist BGIS with budget planning and operational administration.

 

Operational Reporting and Data Analysis

  • Extract, compile and validate statistical data from the real estate portfolio database; generate quarterly performance indicators and draft executive summaries highlighting key trends for management presentations.
  • Deliver error-free reporting through automated pivot table reconciliations as well as year-over-year (YoY) and quarter-over-quarter (QoQ) comparative analyses.
  • Query the real estate portfolio database to produce custom reports, fulfil routine information requests and Access to Information and Privacy (ATIP) inquiries, and prepare qualitative and quantitative analyses for executive briefings.


Management of Operational Tools and Real Estate Microsites

  • Maintain the active transaction tracker, draft transaction summaries and briefing notes, and prepare building guidelines for personnel at newly opened sites to support lease compliance.
  • Oversee and update the bilingual real estate microsite, maintaining an interactive Google Maps portfolio view and a live master property directory to provide real-time visibility across the organization.
  • Administer the property microsite to ensure official directories for owned properties and revenue leases remain current, while keeping building profile sheets up to date.
  • Maintain the centralized interface microsite bridging Google Drive repositories with the corporate records management system (Livelink), ensuring disciplined document life-cycle management for all team files.
  • Co-ordinate comprehensive post-execution lease administration for new site openings, closures and renewals by updating all relevant databases, official registries, mapping tools, critical date schedules and Livelink archives.
  • Maintain and refresh the team’s operational resources, including the transaction playbook, standard templates and site transition checklists.
  • Create and standardize tenant guidelines for regional offices and auxiliary locations to ensure full compliance with lease obligations.
  • Maintain and regularly update divisional operational and secondary databases for audit tracking, statutory filings and key registries to preserve record accuracy and support broader organizational mandates.
  • Oversee the commercial lease insurance database by collecting, validating and tracking certificates of insurance, securing certificates promptly for incoming sites, administering annual renewal cycles and ensuring systematic filing within corporate archives.

 

Operations Support, Insurance Management and Data Governance

  • Respond to operational and administrative requests from regional offices, including processing mailing address updates and arranging local custodial or maintenance services.
  • Monitor team communications and departmental documentation to maintain operational visibility; organize, structure and maintain the Google Drive repository feeding the team microsite to ensure consistent data updates and systematic archiving in Livelink.
  • Draft routine lease extension agreements, renewal correspondence and related documents proactively or upon request.
  • Identify files requiring priority action to provide proactive support to the team, ensuring seamless deadline management and operational continuity across the portfolio.

 

Job Requirements (Knowledge and Skills)

  • Education: College diploma (DCS) or a bachelor’s degree in business administration, real estate management, contract management or a related field.
  • Experience: Minimum five years’ experience in commercial lease administration, real estate operations, portfolio data analysis or specialized executive administrative support.
  • Software and Tool Proficiency:
    • Strong proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite (advanced Excel formulas and pivot tables, Word, PowerPoint), Adobe Acrobat and Google Workspace.
    • Demonstrated aptitude in database administration, web platform/microsite maintenance and data governance.
    • Familiarity with commercial real estate property management and accounting software an asset.
  • Organizational Skills and Autonomy: Strong initiative and a proven ability to work independently with minimal direction; highly methodical, organized and detail-oriented, with the demonstrated capacity to manage competing priorities simultaneously under tight deadlines.
  • Interpersonal Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a proven ability to collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders (executives, Legal, Finance, Risk Management, and business units) and external service providers.
  • Bilingualism: Bilingualism (English and French), spoken and written, required.

 

Working Conditions

  • Professional office environment with a hybrid work arrangement in accordance with corporate policy.
  • Occasional extended hours may be required during peak periods, such as fiscal year-end or quarterly reporting cycles.

job.title: SVP of Product
job.description:
Description

Hope Media Group is a multi-brand ministry. Every story we share, every event we host, and every song we play is done to engage people to love Jesus, serve others, and spread Hope. Hope Media Group the home of KSBJ, WayFM, Worship 24/7, Vida Unida, NGEN radio. Way Loud, Way New, Way Back, Gospel 24/7, God Listens Prayer App and Hope Events. We invite you to apply and become a part of our growing ministry to Love Jesus, Serve Others, and Spread Hope. Our team describes our environment as fun, encouraging, collaborative, engaging, caring, family-oriented, and friendly. We would love for you to join us and be part of what God is doing in our ministry!  


SVP of Product


Job Summary

The SVP of Product is responsible for the creative and product direction of Hope Media Group's

family of brands - ensuring each product has a strong identity, product roadmap, clear audience

strategy, and content that connects. This role sits on the Senior Leadership Team alongside

peers such as the Chief of Technology and Chief of Content, working with the Chief Impact

Officer to align brand strategy with organizational mission and growth goals. The SVP of

Product oversees Product Directors across all HMG brands, guiding teams in audience building,

storytelling, and content delivery that reflects HMG's values and mission.


Essential Functions

Portfolio Leadership and Strategy:

  • Lead Product Directors across KSBJ, WayFM, Vida Unida, Worship 24/7, NGEN Radio, and Hope Events
  • Set the strategic direction for each product’s content, audience growth, and market position
  • Represent product strategy in Senior Leadership Team discussions and organizational planning
  • Partner with the Chief Impact Officer on long-range portfolio decisions


Data-Driven Product Development:

  • Utilize user behavior analytics, A/B testing, and digital performance metrics to guide product evolution and feature prioritization 
  • Define and monitor key product health and engagement metrics across all digital platforms to optimize user experience and conversion

Brand Performance and Financial Accountability:

  • Track and assess brand performance across audience metrics, engagement, and growth indicators
  • Partner with brand teams to identify gaps and opportunities in content strategy
  • Set clear performance expectations for Product Directors and review outcomes regularly
  • Connect brand results to organizational goals and report progress to the Chief Impact Officer
  • Use audience data and ministry metrics to inform strategic pivots and investment decisions

Cross-Functional Partnership:

  • Collaborate with the VP of Brand, Chief of Technology, and Chief of Content to align product and content direction
  • Work with the Director of Creative and Director of Marketing Platform to ensure content quality and distribution reach audience goals
  • Serve as the product voice in cross-departmental planning and budgeting processes
  • Build relationships with external partners, network affiliates, and ministry stakeholders in active collaboration with the VP of Strategy & Innovation


Budget Management:

  • Develop department or functional area budget annually and provide FP&A monthly input to accurately forecast costs and revenue
  • Review expenses/invoices using the RAMP platform as they are submitted, ensuring proper coding by department, project, brand and location, and that all departmental spend follows HMG credit card, travel and company policies 
  • Regularly review and monitor department performance vs. budget and forecast using Intacct Dashboard Reporting, ensuring they stay within annual budgeted amounts each month and for the full year
  • Partner with Finance to forecast and plan resource needs across brands
  • Ensure responsible stewardship of organizational resources aligned with ministry priorities

Demonstrated Faith

  • Committed to a personal relationship with Jesus Christ
  • Grounded spiritually and biblically literate
  • Comfortable praying for co-workers in team meetings, leading spoken prayer, and
  • participating in ministry prayer meetings and Bible studies
  • Live Christian principles defined by the ministry's Statement of Faith & Biblical Beliefs
  • Participate in on-air fundraisers and prays for donors as needed
  • Passion for leveraging HMG's media platforms for evangelism and discipleship
  • Exhibit a strong moral character
  • Active member of a Bible believing local church

Requirements

Non-Essential Functions

  • Represent HMG at industry events, conferences, and speaking engagements
  • Any other duties assigned.
  • Attend and participate in regular staff meetings and training

Requirements:

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in communications, Marketing, Business, or a related field required 

Experience:

  • 10+ years of experience in media, content, or brand leadership
  • 5+ years in a senior leadership role overseeing multiple brands or product lines
  • Demonstrated record of building and leading high-performing teams
  • Experience in digital product management or technology-led product strategy preferred


Skills and Abilities:

  • Strong understanding of content strategy, audience development, and brand management
  • Ability to think across multiple brands simultaneously and maintain strategic clarity
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, including executive-level stakeholder engagement
  • Comfortable with data and performance metrics as tools for decision-making
  • Ability to develop leaders and build a healthy, high-trust team culture
  • Proficiency in data analytics platforms and digital product stacks

Role-Specific Competencies:

  • Strategic Vision: Sees across brands, anticipates shifts, and builds toward what is next
  • Culture Creation: Models and builds healthy team culture at the organizational level
  • People Development: Identifies and grows the next generation of brand leaders across the portfolio
  • Financial Accountability: Manages budgets responsibly and connects spending to outcomes
  • Brand Stewardship: Protects the integrity and identity of each brand while enabling growth
  • Audience Insight: Understands what audiences want and how to build lasting loyalty
  • Executive Communication: Communicates clearly with C-suite peers, external partners, and board-level stakeholders
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Builds strong working relationships across departments and brings alignment without friction
  • Decision-Making: Makes clear, values-aligned decisions under uncertainty and time pressure
  • Business Acumen: Understands how brand strategy connects to organizational sustainability and growth
  • Digital Product Vision: Ability to conceptualize and build new digital offerings
  • Technical Acumen: Understanding the interplay between software development, content delivery, and audience platforms
  • Agile Leadership: Championing fast-paced, iterative improvement in product development


Working Conditions and Environment

Travel:

  • 0%-10%

Nights/Weekends/Holidays:

  • 0%-10%

an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable

accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the

essential functions. Physical Activity may include Talking. Expressing or exchanging

ideas by means of the spoken word. Those activities in which they must convey detailed

or important spoken instructions to other workers accurately, loudly, or quickly. Hearing.

Perceiving the nature of sounds at normal speaking levels with or without correction.

Ability to receive detailed information through oral communication, and to make the

discriminations in sound. Repetitive motion. Substantial movements (motions) of the

pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 10 pounds of force frequently, and/or a

negligible amount of force constantly to move objects. If the use of arm and/or leg

controls requires exertion of forces greater than that for sedentary work and the worker

visual acuity to perform an activity such as: preparing and analyzing data and figures;

transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; extensive reading.

iHeartMedia

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

iHeartMedia is looking for a strategic, creative, and highly independent Senior Manager to join our Digital Media Strategy & Planning team. In this role, you’ll help shape innovative digital campaigns that span streaming audio, podcasts, social platforms, and live events positioning iHeartMedia as the leading force in digital audio and entertainment.

You’ll serve as a key strategic partner to the sales organization, leading RFP responses, driving creative ideation, and crafting compelling narratives that bring our capabilities to life. You’ll be expected to work independently, navigate complex internal systems and business rules, and proactively escalate issues when necessary, articulating challenges and solutions with clarity and confidence.

The ideal candidate role will have a strong understanding of the digital landscape including fast growing platforms like social, emerging platforms (i.e. connected devices, OTT) and podcasting. We’re looking for a digital expert that can craft compelling stories for clients as well as determine effective media strategies. They will be self-starters with polished written and oral communication skills to effectively communicate their ideas coupled and analytical skills to accurately translate those ideas into media plans. Collaboration is key as they will be working with Go to Market, Sales, Packaging, Research, Creative Services and Product Teams.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Own the creation and writing of presentation decks, translating strategy and insights into clear, persuasive storytelling
  • Collaborate with sales, marketing, research, and inventory teams to bring fully integrated programs to market

  • Interpret and apply internal business rules to ensure compliant, feasible proposals

  • Excellent communication skills—both written and verbal—with the ability to distill and present complex ideas clearly
  • Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel (or Google Slides/Sheets)

job.title: Systems Engineer
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox News Media

FOX News Media operates the FOX News Channel (FNC), FOX Business Network (FBN), FOX News Digital, FOX News Audio, FOX News Books, the direct-to-consumer digital streaming services FOX Nation and FOX News International and the newly announced platform FOX Weather. Currently the number one network in all of cable, FNC has also been the most watched television news channel for 20 consecutive years, while FBN currently ranks among the top business channels on cable. Owned by FOX Corporation, FOX News Media reaches 200 million people each month.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Systems Engineer is an individual contributor on the Digital Newsroom (DNR) Systems Administration team responsible for the engineering, automation, and operational reliability of the Dalet media-asset-management platform and related production systems in New York and Washington, DC. This backfill position replaces a retiring engineer and restores capacity for scripting, proactive monitoring, data migration, and frontline production support across NY and DC.


The Systems Engineer works closely with editorial, media desk, library, and operations teams, partners with Dalet support and internal engineering groups on Mimir, Pyramid, and Project Fresh Start initiatives, and contributes to the team's transition from reactive ticket handling to automated detection and remediation. Success requires strong Dalet platform knowledge, disciplined scripting in PowerShell and Bash, and dependable ownership through completion — including weekends and live production windows.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITES:

  • Dalet Platform Engineering & Administration
    • Administer and troubleshoot the Dalet MAM environment in NY and DC — including Dalet Admin Tool configuration, BPM workflows, proxy generation, WebSpace, Wowza load balancers, workflow servers, and ingest/recording components (Brio).
    • Resolve escalated production issues: proxy-not-generating failures, media sync problems, ZID-to-DCID transfer errors, mount failures, TRINT workflow disruption, and slug/metadata special-character recording failures.
    • Configure Dalet Admin Tool settings and BPM rules to prevent recurring operational failures (e.g., illegal-character handling, recording-stuck conditions).
    • Support restricted-folder lifecycle, asset restore/purge requests, and media-desk coordination for NY and DC editorial workflows.
    • Partner with Dalet iCare/support on complex escalations; document root cause and remediation in ServiceNow (DNRNYD) and Confluence.
  • Monitoring, Scripting & Automation
    • Develop, maintain, and extend production monitoring and remediation scripts (PowerShell and Bash) covering recurring Dalet failure modes — Brio recording stuck, MDS/MDD agent health, AuditTrail freshness, BPM thresholds, NetXchange agents, WebSpace/Wowza restarts, send-to-NEXIO catchers, EDL agent errors, and DST offset checks.
    • Tie monitoring automation to tracked DNRNYD tickets with documented thresholds, alert logic, and remediation steps.
    • Contribute to the team's proactive monitoring posture and eventual integration with broader observability initiatives (e.g., Grafana).
    • Apply Python and modern tooling to extend operational automation where practical.
  • Mimir, Migrations & Platform Programs
    • Support Object Store-to-Mimir image and metadata migration work — including XML mappings, JSON watch-folder definitions, VOS re-tagging, shared-asset import logic, and batch validation.
    • Execute and validate large-scale content and metadata migrations (e.g., transcript backfill, person/non-person image regeneration) with minimal production impact.
    • Participate in Mimir Phase 2 and Pyramid platform testing — TestRail case authoring, post-upgrade retesting in DEV and PROD, and permissions/workflow validation with platform owners.
    • Support Project Fresh Start and Dalet upgrade activities (MFP testing, MS-SQL maintenance, version upgrades) as assigned.
  • Production Pipelines & Linux Administration
    • Own or support recurring production delivery workflows — including the Fox News Sunday Hulu unified-delivery package (format updates, captioning conversions, container changes, illegal-character handling, and external QA coordination).
    • Administer Linux systems supporting Dalet and related DNR infrastructure in NY and DC.
    • Perform MS-SQL queries and data tasks tied to Dalet metadata, migration, and reporting workflows.
    • Transform and validate XML metadata for ingest, migration, and platform-integration use cases.
  • Operations, Documentation & Collaboration
    • Provide frontline and weekend production support for NY and DC Dalet users — editors, media desk, library, and operations teams.
    • Respond to ServiceNow incidents and requests; maintain clear written documentation in Confluence for systems, scripts, and troubleshooting procedures.
    • Collaborate with peer DNR engineers (Mimir, Pyramid, ingest, editing platform) and BMT teams on cross-platform initiatives.
    • Participate in on-call and weekend coverage rotation aligned to live news production schedules.
    • Work a flexible schedule including evenings, weekends, and maintenance windows as required.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3–5+ years of systems engineering, Linux administration, or broadcast/media platform support experience.
  • Hands-on experience with Dalet Galaxy / Dalet Plus or comparable MAM platforms strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency in PowerShell and Bash scripting; ability to build and maintain production monitoring automation.
  • Working knowledge of Linux administration, MS-SQL, XML/metadata workflows, and basic networking.
  • Experience supporting live production or newsroom editorial environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills, attention to detail, and ownership through completion.
  • Clear written and verbal communication; comfortable partnering with vendors, editorial staff, and engineering teams.

Step into an opportunity with an established account list and the ability to expand your business by developing new client relationships and growing existing accounts.

From locally produced programming and Action News to connected TV (CTV/OTT), Weather.com, streaming video, digital display, search, social, and other targeted advertising solutions, you will help advertisers reach the right audiences across screens.

We’re looking for a seller—not simply an account manager. The ideal candidate is proactive, competitive, comfortable initiating new business conversations, and motivated to grow revenue by bringing innovative advertising solutions to clients. You should have a solid foundation in sales, a consultative approach to client relationships, and a genuine interest in developing business across both linear television and digital platforms.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and grow an established account portfolio: Build on existing client relationships, identify opportunities for increased investment, and develop strategies to expand account revenue.
  • Develop new business: Proactively identify, prospect, and secure new advertising clients to expand your portfolio and create additional revenue opportunities.
  • Drive revenue growth: Build and execute strategic account plans that achieve sales objectives, increase client investment, and maximize revenue potential.
  • Sell integrated advertising solutions: Develop customized campaigns that combine linear television and Nexstar’s digital products to address clients’ marketing objectives.
  • Embrace digital advertising: Learn, understand, and confidently present digital capabilities, including CTV/OTT, streaming video, digital display, search, social, Weather.com, Amazon, and other available targeted advertising solutions.
  • Lead consultative sales conversations: Ask the right questions, identify client needs, understand business challenges, and translate those insights into effective advertising recommendations.
  • Own the sales process: Take opportunities from prospecting and initial presentation through proposal development, negotiation, closing, and ongoing account growth.
  • Expand existing business: Introduce additional products, develop integrated campaigns, and identify opportunities to increase the value of client relationships.
  • Build lasting client relationships: Establish credibility with business owners, marketing leaders, and other key decision-makers through responsiveness, strategic thinking, and a focus on results.
  • Collaborate and innovate: Partner with sales management, digital specialists, and internal teams to develop compelling proposals, strengthen client solutions, and capitalize on emerging opportunities.
  • Stay accountable: Maintain an active sales pipeline, manage priorities effectively, and consistently pursue opportunities that contribute to individual and team success.

Qualifications & Experience

  • A minimum of four years of sales experience preferred, ideally in media, advertising, digital marketing, or a related business-to-business sales environment.
  • A demonstrated ability to prospect, develop relationships, present solutions, negotiate, and close business.
  • An understanding of the advertising landscape and a willingness to sell across both traditional television and digital platforms.
  • A growth mindset and the motivation to continually learn new products, sharpen sales skills, and develop new revenue opportunities.
  • Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Confidence engaging business owners, senior executives, and marketing decision-makers.
  • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple opportunities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and the ability to work effectively with sales and customer relationship management tools.
  • A self-starter mentality, strong work ethic, competitive drive, and commitment to achieving measurable results.
  • A bachelor’s degree preferred.

Why WPHL-TV?

Join a team that combines the power of a major broadcast television brand with the reach and capabilities of a comprehensive digital advertising portfolio.

You’ll have an established account portfolio to build upon, the opportunity to develop new client relationships, and the ability to grow your business by delivering integrated advertising solutions that help local businesses succeed.

We value sales professionals who take initiative, embrace new opportunities, continually develop their skills, and recognize that the best results come from understanding clients’ needs and delivering the right solutions.

If you’re a motivated seller who wants to build on an established book of business, expand your digital expertise, and make an impact in the Philadelphia market and beyond, we want to hear from you.

Your work will help ensure these communities remains an essential, responsive, and trusted part of community life. This position will be located on-site at KSBY in San Luis Obispo, CA.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with civic, nonprofit, business, educational, government, and other community stakeholders to understand emerging issues, priorities, and opportunities.
  • Gather, analyze, and share community insights with station leadership, newsroom teams, and partners to help inform decision-making, journalism, and local engagement.
  • Partner with News to identify story opportunities, connect journalists with trusted sources, and strengthen audience engagement across community channels.
  • Represent the station throughout the community and develop partnerships that create long-term value, trust, and local impact.
  • Respond to community members, partners, and stakeholders with timely, professional communication, ensuring audience questions, concerns, and story tips are acknowledged, routed, and resolved appropriately.
  • Lead the planning and execution of forums, town halls, public-service initiatives, educational programs, and other community engagement activities.
  • Collaborate with News, Sales, Marketing, Operations, and station leadership to develop meaningful opportunities that strengthen audience relationships and community impact.
  • Oversee event logistics and stakeholder coordination while measuring effectiveness to ensure engagement activities are inclusive, relevant, and impactful.
  • Develop and execute a market-wide community engagement strategy aligned with station and regional priorities, advising leadership on community needs, emerging issues, and opportunities to strengthen trust and local impact.
  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional community engagement efforts, sharing best practices, tracking outcomes, and helping build engagement capabilities across teams.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline or equivalent years of relevant experience preferred.
  • Generally, 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in community engagement, journalism, nonprofit leadership, communications, public affairs, partnership development, government relations, or a related field.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Exceptional relationship-building and networking skills, with the ability to establish credibility across a wide range of communities and organizations.
  • Strong community listening skills and the ability to recognize emerging issues, needs, and opportunities.
  • Strategic thinking and sound judgment, with the ability to translate community insights into meaningful action.
  • Strong facilitation, public speaking, writing, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to influence and collaborate effectively across News, Sales, Marketing, Operations, station leadership, and external community organizations.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to balance multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Empathy, cultural awareness, diplomacy, discretion, and integrity when working with diverse communities and sensitive topics.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative, and adapt effectively to changing community and business needs.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM or community relationship platforms, and collaboration tools.
  • A strong customer-service mindset, conflict-resolution skills, and sound judgment when responding to audience questions, concerns, and sensitive community issues.

Application Review: Applications received by November 9, 2026 will receive priority consideration. Applications received after this date may continue to be reviewed as needed.


OUR TEAM:

We’re a team of journalists, storytellers, relationship builders, and community advocates who care deeply about the people and places we serve. At KSBY, we bring different backgrounds, perspectives, interests, and experiences to our work, united by a shared commitment to meaningful local journalism and stronger communities. You’ll work alongside collaborative colleagues who value curiosity, authenticity, responsiveness, and finding new ways to connect with audiences both inside and outside the newsroom.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

San Luis Obispo offers an incredible Central Coast lifestyle, surrounded by rolling hills and within easy reach of California’s coastline. The area blends an active outdoor lifestyle with a welcoming community, local restaurants, wineries, farmers markets, arts, and plenty of opportunities to hike, bike, explore, and enjoy the outdoors.

As Sr. Manager, Community Connections, you’ll have the opportunity to build relationships with the people and organizations that shape San Luis Obispo and communities across the Central Coast. Whether you’re attending a community event, meeting with local leaders, or discovering the stories people are talking about, you’ll be immersed in the communities KSBY serves.

job.title: Executive Reporter, KNXV
job.description:
KNXV, The E.W. Scripps ABC affiliate in Phoenix, Arizona, is looking for an Executive Reporter who is as passionate about the craft of storytelling as they are about the community. In this role, you'll leading, inspiring, and mentoring reporters and MMJs at every level to discover powerful ways to grow their storytelling skills. You'll partner with newsroom leaders to execute a content strategy rooted in authenticity, impact, and journalistic integrity, all while shaping a culture where great stories aren't just told — they're felt. If you're ready to elevate the voices that matter most and leave a lasting mark on local journalism in one of the country's most vibrant and fast-growing cities, we want to hear from you. 

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Lead, develop, and enhance the storytelling skill and abilities of all reporters and MMJs in the station.
  • Collaborate with other newsroom leaders to consistently execute the content strategy through authentic, meaningful storytelling .
  • Oversee the writing of stories for all platforms; provide timely feedback to foster continuous improvement.
  • Develop and supervise effective workflow strategies and procedures for multiple news programs and outlets.
  • Ensure that all content adheres to journalistic standards and ethical guidelines.
  • Deliver a vision and create trust among reporters, photographers and newsroom staff.
  • May provide on-air, multi-platform coverage for breaking news as needed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred, or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 7+ years of experience in related field preferred 

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Demonstrated expertise in storytelling
  • Knowledge and demonstration of editorial judgment, journalistic ethics and libel laws
  • Curiosity for the community, city, state and world we report on daily
  • Deep understanding of the content strategy
  • Ability to work a variety of shifts including nights, weekends, early morning, and holidays

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Phoenix, Arizona, is one of the most dynamic and fast-growing cities in the United States — a sprawling desert metropolis that blends stunning natural beauty with a thriving urban energy. Surrounded by the Sonoran Desert, Phoenix offers year-round sunshine and unmatched outdoor adventures, from hiking the iconic trails of Camelback Mountain and South Mountain Park to exploring the scenic beauty of the Tonto National Forest just an hour away. The city is a haven for golf enthusiasts, cyclists, and outdoor lovers of all kinds.

Beyond the desert landscape, Phoenix boasts a rich and diverse cultural scene. The city is home to world-class museums like the Heard Museum, dedicated to Native American art and culture, and the Phoenix Art Museum, one of the largest art museums in the Southwest. The downtown core is alive with acclaimed restaurants, craft breweries, and a vibrant nightlife, while neighborhoods like Roosevelt Row serve as the beating heart of the local arts community. From the Phoenix Symphony to the bustling farmers markets and food halls, there is always something new to discover.

Sports are a way of life in the Valley of the Sun. Phoenix is home to the NFL's Cardinals, the NBA's Suns, the MLB's Diamondbacks, the NHL's Coyotes, and the WNBA's Mercury — giving residents a full calendar of live sports action. Whether you're catching a game, exploring a new trail, or dining at one of the city's award-winning restaurants, Phoenix offers an extraordinary quality of life in one of America's most exciting and welcoming cities.

job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Video Editor Job ID 10163580 Location Los Angeles, California, United States Business ESPN Date posted Nov. 03, 2026 Video Editor Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements ESPN Creative Studio is a unit within the Content division of ESPN. Our staff comprises of Motion Graphics, Edit, Visual Storytelling, Production Enhancements and Innovations, Creative Operations, and the Music group. Positions within Creative Studio include; Video Editors, Post Editors, Producer Editors, Sound Design, Graphic Designers, Project Managers and Art Directors, etc. We are the go-to destination to conceptualize, develop, and execute content creation across all domestic and international ESPN distribution platforms. The Video Editor, Creative Studio position possesses an advanced ability for non-linear video editing in a fast-paced sport news environment. The Video Editor is expected to be an effective collaborator within various Edit areas and partners to help support the creative process, while editing at an advanced creative level. They help develop personnel, projects, and individual skillsets that propel Edit and Creative Studio into the future. Responsibilities: Exhibits advanced skill to assemble and create content using non-linear editing software in a fast-paced sport news environment. Strong editing skills, effective communication, and ability to perform well under pressure, high demand, strict timelines and/or live conditions with little supervision. Ensure all created content meets ESPN’s high standards for video and audio quality. Conducts quality control measuring and corrective action steps to ensure and/or enhance video content. Demonstrates a strong knowledge of edit workflow, software and facility layout in assigned areas. Responsible for adhering to established organization of media and naming conventions. Establish strong relationships and gain knowledge of our partners, including their impact and/or specific integration with Creative Studio. Advanced organizational, creative, communication, and planning skills are required for team collaborative success. Provides strong service to all collaborative partners. Must have the skill and attitude to train less experienced editors on edit workflows and software. Will write and provide feedback in training initiatives and project contributions. Keep updated on knowledge of industry technology and help establish new workflows to create accurate and effective results on specific or future assignments. Must have the ability to train and learn new techniques/software platforms that aligns with industry needs and trends. Ability to identify and quickly escalate issues. Recommend solutions and/or resolve operational errors and equipment failures. Provide strong multi-directional communication to ensure success of assignments and accomplishments. Self-initiate creative projects and pitch ideas towards departmental objectives. Strong understanding of multiple file-based formats and provide file-based ingest support. Qualifications: A minimum of 4 years of editing or related experience. Advanced understanding of non-linear editing software (Adobe Premiere, Avid, Grass Valley Edius or Qube, etc.). Strong knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud (After Effects, Audition, Illustrator, Photoshop, etc.). Skilled in media transfer workflows (ingest/publish/export). Strong understanding of audio and video broadcast quality control (video scopes, audio levels, CALM Act compliance, etc.). Ability to collaborate and work in a quick turn-around, sport newsroom environment. Candidates must have a good computer background (Microsoft Office, Slack, Workfront, etc.). Demonstrates strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Ability to work nights, weekends, and holidays. Flexibility to work overtime and alter shifts/days off to accommodate projects and departmental objectives. Preferred Qualifications : Has in-depth background in non-linear editing in an area including Adobe (Premiere, AE, Audition, etc.) Grass Valley, Edius, etc. Strong understanding of linear, non-linear, social media production workflows. Knowledge of PC or Mac operating system. Bilingual (written and spoken) in both English and Spanish. Required Education : High School Diploma or Equivalent Preferred Education : Bachelor's Degree in Communications, Studio Production, Journalism, or related field Vocational School or related experience. job.title: Systems Engineer
job.description:
The Systems Engineer is an individual contributor on the Digital Newsroom (DNR) Systems Administration team responsible for the engineering, automation, and operational reliability of the Dalet media-asset-management platform and related production systems in New York and Washington, DC. This backfill position replaces a retiring engineer and restores capacity for scripting, proactive monitoring, data migration, and frontline production support across NY and DC.

The Systems Engineer works closely with editorial, media desk, library, and operations teams, partners with Dalet support and internal engineering groups on Mimir, Pyramid, and Project Fresh Start initiatives, and contributes to the team's transition from reactive ticket handling to automated detection and remediation. Success requires strong Dalet platform knowledge, disciplined scripting in PowerShell and Bash, and dependable ownership through completion — including weekends and live production windows.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITES:

  • Dalet Platform Engineering & Administration
    • Administer and troubleshoot the Dalet MAM environment in NY and DC — including Dalet Admin Tool configuration, BPM workflows, proxy generation, WebSpace, Wowza load balancers, workflow servers, and ingest/recording components (Brio).
    • Resolve escalated production issues: proxy-not-generating failures, media sync problems, ZID-to-DCID transfer errors, mount failures, TRINT workflow disruption, and slug/metadata special-character recording failures.
    • Configure Dalet Admin Tool settings and BPM rules to prevent recurring operational failures (e.g., illegal-character handling, recording-stuck conditions).
    • Support restricted-folder lifecycle, asset restore/purge requests, and media-desk coordination for NY and DC editorial workflows.
    • Partner with Dalet iCare/support on complex escalations; document root cause and remediation in ServiceNow (DNRNYD) and Confluence.
  • Monitoring, Scripting & Automation
    • Develop, maintain, and extend production monitoring and remediation scripts (PowerShell and Bash) covering recurring Dalet failure modes — Brio recording stuck, MDS/MDD agent health, AuditTrail freshness, BPM thresholds, NetXchange agents, WebSpace/Wowza restarts, send-to-NEXIO catchers, EDL agent errors, and DST offset checks.
    • Tie monitoring automation to tracked DNRNYD tickets with documented thresholds, alert logic, and remediation steps.
    • Contribute to the team's proactive monitoring posture and eventual integration with broader observability initiatives (e.g., Grafana).
    • Apply Python and modern tooling to extend operational automation where practical.
  • Mimir, Migrations & Platform Programs
    • Support Object Store-to-Mimir image and metadata migration work — including XML mappings, JSON watch-folder definitions, VOS re-tagging, shared-asset import logic, and batch validation.
    • Execute and validate large-scale content and metadata migrations (e.g., transcript backfill, person/non-person image regeneration) with minimal production impact.
    • Participate in Mimir Phase 2 and Pyramid platform testing — TestRail case authoring, post-upgrade retesting in DEV and PROD, and permissions/workflow validation with platform owners.
    • Support Project Fresh Start and Dalet upgrade activities (MFP testing, MS-SQL maintenance, version upgrades) as assigned.
  • Production Pipelines & Linux Administration
    • Own or support recurring production delivery workflows — including the Fox News Sunday Hulu unified-delivery package (format updates, captioning conversions, container changes, illegal-character handling, and external QA coordination).
    • Administer Linux systems supporting Dalet and related DNR infrastructure in NY and DC.
    • Perform MS-SQL queries and data tasks tied to Dalet metadata, migration, and reporting workflows.
    • Transform and validate XML metadata for ingest, migration, and platform-integration use cases.
  • Operations, Documentation & Collaboration
    • Provide frontline and weekend production support for NY and DC Dalet users — editors, media desk, library, and operations teams.
    • Respond to ServiceNow incidents and requests; maintain clear written documentation in Confluence for systems, scripts, and troubleshooting procedures.
    • Collaborate with peer DNR engineers (Mimir, Pyramid, ingest, editing platform) and BMT teams on cross-platform initiatives.
    • Participate in on-call and weekend coverage rotation aligned to live news production schedules.
    • Work a flexible schedule including evenings, weekends, and maintenance windows as required.
