We are looking for a Director of Product to lead Audience Decisioning & Marketing Effectiveness within NBCUniversal Enterprise Product. This role leads products that help marketers identify and engage the right audiences, measure the impact of those decisions, and continuously improve marketing effectiveness. The portfolio spans audience exploration and creation, predictive decisioning, experimentation, measurement, and optimization.

As Director, you will own portfolio strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities and lead a product team responsible for turning consumer intelligence into scalable marketing capabilities. You will build, lead, and grow a high-performing product team establishing clear ownership, strong product practices, and the capabilities needed as the portfolio evolves. You will partner closely with Marketing, Marketing Strategy & Success, Consumer Data, Consumer Identity, Data Science, Engineering, Analytics, and activation teams to build reusable products that serve brands and businesses across NBCUniversal.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead and develop product team members, establish clear ownership, and use marketer feedback, product usage, experimental results, and business outcomes to guide prioritization, adoption, and ongoing improvement.
  • Define and communicate the product vision, portfolio strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities for audience decisioning and marketing effectiveness products.
  • Lead products across the marketing decision-and-learning lifecycle, including audience exploration and creation, predictive recommendations, measurement, learning, and optimization.
  • Develop audience and decisioning capabilities that help marketers understand consumers, identify relevant behavioral signals, compare and prioritize audiences, and determine appropriate marketing actions, including capabilities such as affinity, propensity, response prediction, and next-best-action.
  • Lead marketing effectiveness capabilities including experimentation, incrementality, promotional effectiveness, audience treatment effects, creative effectiveness, channel effectiveness, and cross-channel learning.
  • Establish a closed learning loop in which measured outcomes improve future recommendations, models, targeting strategies, campaign design, and product capabilities.
  • Partner directly with marketers and Enterprise Product Strategy & Success to understand workflows, business objectives, constraints, and opportunities, and translate those needs into scalable product capabilities.
  • Partner with Consumer Data and Consumer Identity to define the reusable behavioral signals, exposure and outcome data, semantic definitions, and identity capabilities required for decisioning and measurement.
  • Partner with Governance, Privacy, and Cyber Security teams to ensure compliance.
  • Work with Data Science, Analytics, Engineering, and Data teams to operationalize predictive models, experimentation, causal measurement, and optimization techniques within scalable and reliable products.
  • Evaluate and deliver AI and agentic capabilities that simplify marketer workflows, improve decision quality, and make sophisticated decisioning and measurement capabilities easier to use.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • 10+ years of experience in Product Management, Program Management, Marketing Science, Engineering, or Applied Science
  • Experience defining product strategy, portfolio roadmaps, and investment priorities.
  • Demonstrated experience building, managing, and developing high-performing product teams, including hiring, coaching, performance management, career development, and team structure.
  • Strong understanding of paid and owned marketing workflows, including audience development, targeting, activation, measurement, and optimization.
  • Experience building products that use customer data, behavioral signals, predictive models, analytics, or machine learning to support business decisions; experience with AI-enabled or conversational products is a plus.
  • Experience with marketing measurement concepts such as experimentation, incrementality, attribution, and statistical uncertainty.
  • Ability to work cross functionally, influencing without authority

RESPONSIBILTIES 

  • As an Associate Design Director, you will support the Design Director in driving the execution, alignment, and day-to-day coordination of the project’s design vision across pillars and disciplines. You will act as a key operational and creative partner, helping ensure design decisions, priorities, and follow-through remain consistent across the project. 

  • Partner closely with the Design Director to define the architecture of shared systems at the intersection of design and programming, including the creator facing-UGC API through which creators build their own experiences. Strong architectural thinking is central to this role: defining clear systems, reusable capabilities, and consistent interfaces. 

  • Support the execution and communication of the gameplay systems and player experience. 

  • Maintain visibility across multiple pillars, strike teams, and cross-disciplinary initiatives to help ensure alignment and consistency. 

  • Help drive follow-up, coordination, and resolution of cross-team design topics and dependencies. 

  • Support design decision-making on gameplay systems, player experience, workflows, and feature implementation. 

  • Collaborate closely with Production, Engineering, Art, UX, Animation, Audio, and other disciplines to ensure alignment between creative goals and execution realities. 

  • Help identify risks, blockers, communication gaps, and production challenges, and proactively work toward solutions. 

  • Mentor and support designers across the team by providing feedback, guidance, and design oversight. 

  • Ensure documentation, communication, and design intentions remain clear and actionable across teams. 

  • Contribute to reviews, playtests, iteration, and feature evaluations to help maintain quality and consistency across the experience. 

  • Help maintain consistency between long-term vision, short-term priorities, and day-to-day execution. 

RESPONSIBILTÉS 

  • En tant qu’Associate Design Director, vous soutiendrez le Design Director dans l’exécution, l’alignement et la coordination quotidienne de la vision design du projet à travers les différents piliers et disciplines. Vous agirez comme un partenaire créatif et opérationnel clé afin d’assurer la cohérence des décisions, priorités et suivis design à l’échelle du projet. 

  • Collaborer étroitement avec le directeur du design pour définir l’architecture de systèmes partagés à la croisée du design et de la programmation, notamment l’API de création de contenu utilisateur (UGC) permettant aux créateurs de construire leurs propres expériences. La capacité à penser en termes d’architecture est au cœur de ce rôle : définir des systèmes clairs, des fonctionnalités réutilisables et des interfaces cohérentes. 

  • Collaborer étroitement avec le Design Director afin de soutenir l’exécution et la communication de la vision globale du gameplay et de l’expérience joueur. 

  • Maintenir une visibilité sur plusieurs piliers, strike teams et initiatives transversales afin d’assurer l’alignement et la cohérence entre les équipes. 

  • Aider à assurer le suivi, la coordination et la résolution des sujets et dépendances design entre les équipes. 

  • Soutenir la prise de décision design concernant les systèmes de gameplay, l’expérience joueur, les workflows et l’implémentation des fonctionnalités. 

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de Production, Ingénierie, Art, UX, Animation, Audio et les autres disciplines afin d’assurer l’alignement entre les objectifs créatifs et les réalités de production. 

  • Identifier les risques, blocages, problèmes de communication et défis de production, puis contribuer activement à leur résolution. 

  • Encadrer et soutenir les designers de l’équipe en fournissant du feedback, du mentorat et de la supervision design. 

  • Veiller à ce que la documentation, la communication et les intentions design demeurent claires et exploitables pour les équipes. 

  • Participer aux revues, playtests, itérations et évaluations de fonctionnalités afin de maintenir la qualité et la cohérence de l’expérience. 

  • Contribuer à maintenir l’alignement entre la vision long terme, les priorités court terme et l’exécution quotidienne. 

QUALIFICATIONS 

Basic Requirements:  

  • Demonstrated experience defining system architectures at the intersection of design and programming, translating complex needs into clear abstractions, reusable building blocks, and well-defined interfaces. 

  • Strong understanding of modularity, abstraction, and composition, with the ability to explain architectural decisions and their tradeoffs to both designers and engineers. 

  • Strong experience in game design on AAA or high-quality indie productions. 

  • Experience leading or coordinating multidisciplinary teams or large gameplay initiatives.

  • Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to align multiple teams and stakeholders.

RESPONSIBILTIES

The Development QA Tester partners directly with designers, engineers, and artists to test features throughout the development cycle. You’ll validate functionality, identify issues early, analyze root causes, and help maintain build stability. You will collaborate closely with developers, review requirements, and use tools to perform functional, regression, and performance tests, ensuring software is reliable, secure, and user-friendly.

  • Test new features during development and provide clear, actionable feedback to developers.
  • Identify, reproduce, and document bugs with detailed steps, logs, and supporting evidence.
  • Analyze issues to determine severity, patterns, and potential root causes.
  • Collaborate with engineers and designers to understand feature intentions, edge cases, and technical constraints.
  • Verify bug fixes and ensure regressions are caught early.
  • Create and maintain test plans, test cases, and checklists for ongoing features.
  • Support integration testing when new systems, builds, or content are merged.
  • Participate in daily stand‑ups, feature reviews, and sprint planning to stay aligned with development progress.
  • Use debugging tools, logs, and engine features to investigate issues more deeply.
  • Provide feedback on usability, clarity, and player experience from a QA perspective.
  • Help maintain build stability by identifying blockers quickly and communicating them effectively.

RESPONSABILITÉS

La personne occupant le poste de testeur QA en développement travaille directement avec les équipes de conception, d’ingénierie et d’art afin de tester les fonctionnalités tout au long du cycle de développement. Vous validerez le bon fonctionnement des fonctionnalités, repérerez rapidement les problèmes, analyserez leurs causes profondes et contribuerez à maintenir la stabilité des builds. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes de développement, examinerez les exigences et utiliserez différents outils pour effectuer des tests fonctionnels, de régression et de performance afin de garantir que le logiciel est fiable, sécuritaire et convivial.

  • Tester de nouvelles fonctionnalités pendant leur développement et fournir aux équipes de développement une rétroaction claire et exploitable.
  • Repérer, reproduire et documenter les bogues en fournissant des étapes détaillées, des logs et des éléments probants à l’appui.
  • Analyser les problèmes afin d’en déterminer la gravité, les tendances et les causes profondes potentielles.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes d’ingénierie et de conception afin de comprendre l’intention derrière les fonctionnalités, les cas limites et les contraintes techniques.
  • Vérifier les correctifs de bogues et s’assurer que les régressions sont détectées rapidement.
  • Créer et tenir à jour des plans de test, des cas de test et des listes de vérification pour les fonctionnalités en cours de développement.
  • Soutenir les tests d’intégration lorsque de nouveaux systèmes, builds ou contenus sont intégrés.
  • Participer aux stand-ups quotidiens, aux revues de fonctionnalités et à la planification des sprints afin de rester en phase avec l’avancement du développement.
  • Utiliser des outils de débogage, des logs et les fonctionnalités du moteur afin d’analyser les problèmes plus en profondeur.
  • Fournir une rétroaction sur la convivialité, la clarté et l’expérience des joueurs selon une perspective QA.
  • Contribuer à maintenir la stabilité des builds en repérant rapidement les éléments bloquants et en les communiquant efficacement.

Basic Requirements: 

  • Familiarity with tools such as Selenium, Jira, SQL, or scripting languages.
  • Knowledge of software development lifecycles (SDLC) and debugging tools.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to simulate real-world user scenarios.
  • Strong understanding of game development workflows and common tools (Unity, Unreal, or proprietary engines).
  • Ability to write clear, concise, and reproducible bug reports.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and comfort working directly with developers.
  • Ability to stay organized and detail‑oriented in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Passion for games and curiosity about how systems and features are built.

Exigences de base : 

  • Connaissance d’outils tels que Selenium, Jira et SQL, ou de langages de script.
  • Connaissance des cycles de développement logiciel (SDLC) et des outils de débogage.
  • Grand souci du détail et capacité à simuler des scénarios d’utilisation réels.
  • Solide compréhension des processus de développement de jeux et des outils couramment utilisés (Unity, Unreal ou moteurs propriétaires).
  • Capacité à rédiger des rapports de bogues clairs, concis et reproductibles.
  • Solides compétences en analyse et en résolution de problèmes.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication et aisance à travailler directement avec les équipes de développement.
  • Capacité à rester organisé et à faire preuve de minutie dans un environnement au rythme rapide.
  • Passion pour les jeux et curiosité quant à la façon dont les systèmes et les fonctionnalités sont conçus.

Desired Characteristics: 

  • Experience with console certification requirements or platform‑specific testing.
  • Knowledge of version control systems (Perforce, Git).
  • Experience in embedded QA, feature‑focused QA, or Dev QA roles.

Caractéristiques souhaitées : 

  • Expérience des exigences de certification des consoles ou des tests propres à une plateforme.
  • Connaissance des systèmes de contrôle de version (Perforce, Git).
  • Expérience dans des rôles de QA intégré, de QA axé sur les fonctionnalités ou de Dev QA.

 Eligibility Requirements:

  • Interested candidates must apply to be considered.
  • Must be willing to work in our Montreal office a minimum of 4 days a week.
  • Must be willing to work overtime when required, in accordance with Quebec labor standards.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in Canada.
  • Must be willing to travel for work related business, if necessary

Conditions d’admissibilité :

  • Les personnes intéressées doivent soumettre leur candidature afin d’être prises en considération.
  • La personne retenue doit être disposée à travailler à notre bureau de Montréal au moins 4 jours par semaine.

In this role, you will be the key HR partner for several functions in the operation of a unique Hollywood-style, full-service studio lot.  In addition to providing HR leadership for all corporate employees at the Assembly Studio site, you will also provide regional support for employee relations matters and training needs in support of the production teams. Working closely with the Director, HR, this role will help drive HR projects that span: onboarding, rewards and recognition, performance feedback, talent attraction and development, and HR’s business impact.  In the day to day, you will strategize in the areas of: organization design & integration, staffing, compensation planning, manager coaching, employee development, workforce planning and performance management. 

Responsibilities:

  • Deliver consistent, high-quality HR support and ensure alignment across teams
  • Be the chief interpreter and implementer for HR policies, practices and procedures for all level of employees, looking to further the mission, values and strategic vision of the business.
  • Build trusting, supportive relationships with leaders and employees; proactively identify themes and recommend thoughtful, practical solutions.

  • Partner with leadership to design and implement action plans that address performance, culture, and operational challenges; use data and insights to proactively identify and solve issues in a highly matrixed environment
  • Champion both the employee perspective and the company needs to promote a positive, collaborative, respectful, and engaging work environment.
  • Be a talent magnet, partnering with clients and our internal talent acquisition team, to create innovative and effective recruitment strategies seeking candidates from a diversity of backgrounds and life experiences, and using exceptional candidate selection skills to build the best team for the organization.
  • Be a project driver as needed for strategic HR team projects both local and company-wide, looking to ideate and execute programs that develop and engage our employees throughout their career life-cycle

  • Trusted counselor – You quickly gain trust and respect with anyone you come in contact with and can influence as needed, keeping a client-focused mindset
  • Coach – You help bring the best potential out of the employees, managers, and partners you work with helping them to continue to develop and create a great place to work with one another
  • Translator – You have vision – see the “big picture” and be able to boil it down to the appropriate HR and business strategy to make it work
  • Self-starter – Motivated and can work with minimal guidance, finding the resources to help you out

  • Minimum 2 years of experience conducting complex employee relations investigations

job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

The Regional Marketing Director is the senior marketing leader for the regional marketing team — setting strategy, owning station relationships, and directing the full ecosystem of centralized capabilities toward outcomes that grow audiences and drive business results across the portfolio of markets.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution: close enough to station leadership to understand what each market needs, and senior enough to direct how Production, Paid Media, Social, CRM and Lifecycle work together to deliver it. The RMD leads a lean operational team and is accountable for the marketing performance of every station in the region.

Strategy & Direction

  • Own the audience and market point of view; be the authority on who each station serves and what their market requires, and carry that perspective into every strategic decision and campaign investment.
  • Set the marketing strategy; translate enterprise priorities, station business objectives and competitive dynamics into market-specific plans that direct the full scope of centralized capability investment and drive results.
  • Synthesize audience research, ratings, digital performance and market intelligence into strategic insight that sharpens plans over time and informs enterprise-level decisions.
  • Review and approve campaign briefs before execution begins; serve as the final review before campaigns reach market, ensuring every initiative meets the standard for strategy and quality.

Station Partnership & Leadership

  • Serve as the senior marketing relationship for station general managers, news directors and content leaders across the region; build the trust and institutional knowledge that positions marketing as a strategic voice in station leadership decisions.
  • Own the strategic marketing conversation, aligning with station leadership on business objectives, campaign priorities and resource commitments; manage expectations when capacity or strategy requires adjustment.
  • Serve as the final escalation point for station-level marketing decisions, stakeholder conflicts and cross-market trade-offs.

Capability Direction & Performance

  • Direct the deployment of centralized capabilities — Production, Paid Media, Social, CRM and Lifecycle — across markets; ensure resources are allocated against the highest-priority campaigns and that each channel lead has clear strategic direction.
  • Own marketing performance accountability for the region; track results against station KPIs to evaluate campaign effectiveness and guide resource allocation.
  • Own the regional brand marketing budget; partner with the Paid Marketing Director to manage station performance marketing investment, allocating resources against the right priorities and delivering measurable return.
  • Identify patterns across the portfolio and bring those insights back to inform enterprise strategy and best practice.
  • Own the decision to activate marketing channels in response to breaking news or urgent market situations; the Marketing Lead and Specialist execute under that direction.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead and develop the regional team — Marketing Lead and Marketing Specialist — providing strategic direction, coaching and the clarity of priorities that allows the team to operate with confidence and speed.
  • Model the standard for strategic thinking, stakeholder partnership and campaign discipline.

Requirements

  • 8–12 years in marketing, brand strategy or integrated campaign leadership — media, broadcast or a multi-market content environment strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to set and execute marketing strategy across multiple markets simultaneously; track record of connecting campaign work to measurable audience and business outcomes.
  • Exceptional stakeholder leadership skills; able to earn the trust of station GMs and news directors, align on competing priorities and navigate complex organizational dynamics with credibility.
  • Strong command of the full channel ecosystem — Production, Paid Media, Social, CRM, Lifecycle, CTV — and how to direct each toward a shared strategic outcome.
  • Analytical and data-driven; comfortable with audience research, ratings, digital analytics and performance measurement in a media or broadcast context.
  • Proven people leader and developer of talent; able to direct, coach and elevate a lean team operating across a large and complex portfolio.
  • Comfortable operating as both a strategic leader and a hands-on contributor in a fast-moving, 24/7 news-driven environment.
  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, journalism or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

job.description:
Job Title

Senior Data Scientist

Job Description

 

About The Position |

As a Senior Data Scientist for personalization, you will own the science behind the recommendation engine that powers each user’s personalized product feed. Starting from our user-saved product signals and a live catalog ingested from thousands of retailer feeds, you will design, build, evaluate, and continuously improve the models that learn each user’s taste across brand, category, color, price point, and fit.

 

This is a hands-on, full-cycle role. You will take a recommendation problem from raw data all the way to a production model running on our existing MLOps stack — you own the model layer, not the infrastructure. Our platform team already operates the feature store, serving, and autoscaling; your job is to decide what to model, prove it works through rigorous offline and online experimentation, ship it, and iterate as behavioral signals accumulate.

 

A defining challenge of this role is cold-start. We are launching with a small behavioral dataset and a catalog scaling from hundreds of thousands of products toward tens of millions. You will need strong commerce and product-data intuition to produce high-quality recommendations before rich click data exists — and the experimental discipline to keep improving them as it arrives. This is a foundational hire that will shape how millions of users discover products they love.

 

Remote or Hybrid 3x a week NYC

In-office Expectations: This position offers remote work flexibility; however, if you reside within a commutable distance our offices in New York, the expectation is to work from the office three days per week.

 

About The Team: |

_______________________________________________________________________________

Our next-generation product discovery platform connects shoppers with the things they love across thousands of retail partners. Users save, organize, and share products they're excited about — and our platform turns those signals into a deeply personalized shopping experience. We ingest live product feeds from thousands of retailers and use a rich understanding of each user's taste to surface the right product at the right moment.

 

We're building the recommendation engine at the heart of this shopping experience — a system that understands not just what people save, but why they save it. This is a foundational hire that will shape how millions of users discover products they love.

About The Positions Contributions:

  • 35% Recommendation & Personalization Modeling

    Own the design and development of the core recommendation models that turn user-saved product data into a personalized feed. Develop multi-signal models spanning brand affinity, category, color/visual attributes, fit and sizing, price sensitivity, and trend. Select and justify approaches across collaborative filtering, matrix factorization, content-based, and hybrid/neural methods (e.g., two-tower and other embedding models), and know when each applies. Build product and user embeddings that capture semantic similarity across the catalog and power candidate generation and retrieval. Design cold-start strategies that produce high-quality recommendations for new users and newly ingested products with little or no behavioral history.

    25% Experimentation & Measurement

    Define what “good” personalization means and how it is measured. Establish rigorous offline evaluation (ranking and relevance metrics, sound holdout design) and connect it to online outcomes. Design, run, and read out A/B and multivariate experiments, and translate results into clear product and business decisions. Bring statistical discipline — sound experiment design, awareness of bias and confounding, and honest interpretation — so the team can trust which changes actually move engagement.

    20% Data, Signals & Feature Understanding

    Develop deep intuition for Picksy’s product catalog and user signals. Turn implicit behavior (saves, clicks, dwell, shares) and catalog attributes into meaningful model features, writing SQL against BigQuery to pull, join, and shape raw data into training/evaluation datasets. Apply NLP and computer-vision techniques — including modern embedding and LLM-based approaches — to extract structured attributes (category, color, material, fit) from unstructured product descriptions and imagery, and to enrich sparse catalog data. Partner with data engineering on data quality, freshness, and coverage as the catalog scales from hundreds of thousands toward tens of millions of products.

    20% Full-Cycle Ownership & Productionization

    Take models from prototype to production yourself. Write clean, production-quality code and deploy into the existing MLOps pipeline (feature store, training, serving, monitoring) rather than building infrastructure from scratch. Own model performance in production: instrument it, watch for drift and degradation, and iterate as behavioral signals accumulate. Document models, features, and decisions clearly, and collaborate closely with the MLOps, engineering, and product teams to integrate the model layer into the live product.

Education:

Master's degree or higher in Computer Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative field; or equivalent practical experience.

Experience:

You combine the modeling depth of an applied/data scientist with the pragmatism to ship end-to-end. You bring:

  • Strong data science fundamentals: statistics, experimental design, and evaluation methodology, with the analytical ability to turn model results into clear product and business decisions.

  • Demonstrated ownership of the full A/B testing lifecycle: designing experiments, running them, reading them out, and deciding; not just reporting offline metrics.

  • Experience designing, training, and deploying embedding models and vector retrieval (e.g., Milvus, Pinecone, or Vertex AI Vector Search) for product or content similarity at catalog scale.

  • Direct experience with cold-start / sparse-signal personalization: building useful recommendations from a new catalog, new users, or both. This is a core, day-one challenge of the role.

  • Strong Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX) plus the standard scientific stack (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn). You write production-quality code, not just notebooks.

  • Strong SQL: hands-on experience querying large datasets in a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery preferred) to pull, join, and assemble the training and evaluation datasets that feed your models. This is a daily part of the role.

  • Experience deploying and serving models on a cloud ML platform: GCP Vertex AI strongly preferred (SageMaker or equivalent acceptable) and you are comfortable owning the full model lifecycle: training, deployment, versioning, and monitoring.

  • Commerce intuition: you’ve worked with product catalogs and understand merchandising, category, and PM concerns. It shows up in how you talk about catalogs and taste, not just models.

  • Curiosity and pragmatism about emerging AI, particularly LLMs and modern retrieval/ranking, with a track record of bringing new techniques into real production use.

  • Strong written and verbal communication; able to explain technical tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 

Nice to have:

  • Applied NLP and/or computer vision for extracting structured attributes from product text and imagery.

  • Experience with adaptive recommendation and experimentation methods; multi-armed or contextual bandits.

  • Public writing or conference talks on recommendation, personalization, or ranking work.

  • Early-stage or commerce experience where you wore multiple hats and shipped against real business metrics (e.g., commerce SaaS or a vertical commerce startup).

As a key member of the Internal Audit team, the Automated Controls Audit Lead supports the planning and execution of AI audits and internal controls work, along with related initiatives and projects, across Finance Operations. The role evaluates both traditional control frameworks and automated, machine-learning-enabled systems, and assesses AI internal controls supporting business process improvement initiatives. The Lead supports ongoing compliance monitoring and drives the resolution of internal control inquiries and enhancements. Because the AI landscape shifts quickly, the role demands knowledge agility: continuously evaluating and integrating fast-changing AI capabilities and audit tooling into internal processes and controls, and communicating clearly with stakeholders across departments as the Finance organization adapts. The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The Real Estate section of the New York Times is looking for an experienced, ambitious and creative reporter to focus on interior design and home coverage. The beat will include covering design trends, renovations, celebrity home tours and service around the home. Our ideal candidate is well versed in visual formats, including video. You should be conversant in the world of design but able to write to the everyday New York Times reader who is not a design or architecture enthusiast.

While much of the work will involve service coverage and home tours, this reporter should be prepared to jump on breaking news and come with ideas for enterprise stories and projects in the world of renovation and design that require real reporting skills and experience. You will constantly develop sources within the industry and deliver regular scoops.

This is an in-office position, based in New York City or Los Angeles and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance.

You will report to the Real Estate editor.

  • Report, write and publish multiple stories a week (a mix of news, service, and features).
  • Cover design trends, create service guides, profile notable houses.
  • Oversee our celebrity-focused home tours and spinoff franchises.
  • Cultivate sources and regularly deliver scoops.
  • Develop stories that include a range of voices and perspectives.
  • Collaborate with visual editors on new story formats and multimedia, including reporter video.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

About the Role, Mission or Department Overview

The New York Times is looking for a strategic, analytical marketer to help improve how AI-generated answers represent our brand, products, subscription value, pricing and customer experience.

In this role, you will build an ongoing understanding of the commercial questions people ask AI systems, the sources shaping their answers, and opportunities to improve the visibility and accuracy of our information. You will identify where to focus, guide experiments, measure results, and turn what you learn into practical recommendations for product marketers and the teams that own or oversee relevant consumer-facing surfaces.

This role sits within the enterprise Marketing team and partners closely with cross-functional colleagues across teams, including Product, Growth, Audience, Communications and Customer Care. It is a full-time, hybrid role based in our New York City headquarters. You are expected to come into the office 3 days per week.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor how AI systems answer commercially important consumer questions about The New York Times, including questions about our brand, products, subscription value, pricing and customer experience.
  • Prioritize topics and opportunities based on their strategic importance to the business.
  • Identify the sources shaping AI-generated answers and diagnose gaps in how our brand and commercial value are represented.
  • Recommend experiments to improve the visibility and accuracy of AI answers, guide their execution with partners, and measure whether interventions are effective.

job.title: AI Fellow
job.description:
The big picture: AI is now central to how Axios builds, operates and innovates. We believe AI is a force multiplier - not a side experiment, not a siloed function, but a capability we are embedding at every level and in every role across the company. We are hiring an AI Fellow to work directly with our co-founders as an in-house AI guide and builder. One seat. Three months. Real impact.

Why you matter: This is a highly selective opportunity for a technically sophisticated builder who lives and breathes AI, and is eager to apply that expertise inside a fast-moving, mission-driven media company. The AI Fellow will work directly with the founders to track and interpret major developments in large language models and emerging AI tools, prototype new product ideas, and pressure-test initiatives that could meaningfully shape how Axios leverages AI across editorial, product, and business functions. 

This is not a traditional internship. You won’t be shadowing someone. You’ll be the person we’re learning from.

The details:
The AI Fellow will work directly with Axios co-founders and senior leaders to accelerate how AI is embedded across the organization. This role will combine research, prototyping, experimentation, and strategic advisory work.

You will:

  • Brief founders and leadership on key developments in LLMs and applied AI
  • Build and test prototypes for internal tools, workflows, and product ideas
  • Pressure-test emerging AI use cases across editorial, revenue, product, and operations
  • Identify high-leverage opportunities where AI can meaningfully increase speed, quality, and impact
  • Help translate complex technical concepts into clear, practical applications for non-technical leaders

About you:

  • You are deeply curious about AI and its real-world applications
  • You think in systems and frameworks, not just prompts
  • You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and experimenting quickly
  • You can clearly explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences
  • You can operate at both the technical and strategic level — building something in the morning and briefing founders in the afternoon
  • Strong preference for a Winter 2026 college graduate
  • Strong preference for candidates located in the DC metro area

Skills:

  • Extensive experience working hands-on with LLMs and generative AI tools
  • Experience building and shipping applied AI projects or prototypes
  • Familiarity with model fine-tuning, embeddings, APIs, or AI orchestration frameworks
  • Strong problem-solving and structured thinking skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Program details:

  • Three-month paid fellowship

The salary for this role is $ $6,000-$7,000 per month (3 month term) and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. This range does not include other compensation or benefits.

job.title: Senior Research Manager, Food Regulation
job.description:
Job Description:

POLITICO is seeking a Senior Research Manager to help lead part of its regulatory intelligence and information services product, AgencyIQ. Since its founding in early 2020, AgencyIQ has quickly become the premier source of regulatory intelligence and analysis for professionals working in the life sciences and food industries.


As a subject matter expert in U.S. food regulations issued by the Food and Drug Administration, Department of Agriculture, and state agencies, the Senior Research Manager will be responsible for analyzing the relevance of regulatory changes and developments, articulating the type and degree of impact on food companies, and providing contextualization to an audience of knowledgeable regulatory intelligence professionals.

 

The Senior Research Manager will join a team of experienced researchers responsible producing a mix of daily content, in-depth research, weekly insights, directed deliverables and presentations. The role will cover a variety of food related regulatory topics including labeling, ingredients, packaging, nutrition, safety, and compliance.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Produce daily (3-4 per week) topical intelligence articles and other content for our subscribers based on emerging regulatory and legislative developments related to food regulatory topics
  • Serve as a subject matter specialist on several food topics for AgencyIQ (e.g., labeling, packaging, nutrition, ingredients, safety, compliance, etc.)
  • Lead or participate in the development and delivery of in-depth analysis, deep-dive research, webinars and email newsletters
  • Collaborate with other members of the AgencyIQ research team focused on chemical, food and life sciences regulation
  • Participate in subscriber- and prospect-facing events, briefings, and business development activities

What you’ll need

Required:

  • Have 5+ years’ experience analyzing U.S. food regulations, guidance and policies from the FDA, USDA, and state authorities (e.g., working for a company, trade group, regulator, or consulting company).
  • Have prior experience writing about regulatory developments in a deadline-driven environment for an executive or industry audience (e.g., for an internal company newsletter or for externally-facing publications); 
  • A strong affinity for writing – efficiently and effectively, and for a business or policy audience – paired with a knowledge of (and passion for) regulation and regulatory policy
  • Experience and comfort working in fast-paced, research-driven environments in which daily delivery of regulatory analyses is the norm
  • An excellent working knowledge of food regulatory frameworks and processes (and in particular the FDA) and capable of delivering expert insights to our knowledgeable subscribers
  • Find enjoyment in reading, analyzing, writing, speaking and learning about challenging or new regulatory topics; Have strong attention to detail and accuracy

 

Preferred:

 

  • Have an advanced degree or certification related to food science, law or policy (i.e., a JD, PhD, or relevant master’s degree); or
  • Have prior experience working in media, including as a journalist or writing a product widely read by others (i.e., a business intelligence product or internal newsletter).
  • Experience presenting on regulatory topics to a variety of different audience types (small groups, large groups) in different environments (virtual and in-person)

Compensation: $135-160k Annual Base. The final salary offered will be based on factors including relevant experience, skills, and qualifications.


We value our people. Click here for more on what we offer and what it’s like to work for POLITICO. 


Let’s keep in touch. You can view our list of open positions here and email us careers@politico.com. We hope to see your application soon! 


About Us. 

POLITICO illuminates the forces shaping global power. Since 2007, we have delivered intelligence that anticipates tomorrow's headlines, not reports on yesterday's news. As politics has increasingly become the defining force of our era, our work has never been more vital. 


Cabinet secretaries and Ministers start their mornings with our analysis. CEOs shape strategy around our reporting. Advocacy leaders rely on our insights to move policy. We deliver the straightforward facts and clear-eyed analysis they need to navigate the most complex political landscape of our lifetimes. 


Our 1,100+ publishing professionals across the world's key democratic capitals—Washington, Brussels, London, Paris, Berlin, Sacramento, and New York—form the world's premier politics and policy newsroom. We tell the story of how power really works by explaining who wields it and how they plan to exercise it, connecting dots others miss and delivering scoops from sources others don't even know exist. 


Innovation has always been a core tenet of our story. At launch, we bet that depth would trump scale, that talent would trump traffic, and that politics would become central to modern life. In 2011, we made another bet and launched POLITICO Pro to help decision-makers understand the business of government, transforming both how they shape government action and the business of journalism itself. 


These bets have made POLITICO the most successful digital news startup of its generation and the indispensable resource for leaders who shape the future. Today, we are a rarity in media: a growing, profitable, and sustainable news organization. 


POLITICO is a subsidiary of Axel Springer SE, a family-owned transatlantic media company headquartered in Berlin and New York. Axel Springer is dedicated to shaping the future of journalism in the free world, believing that a free and informed society is essential to democracy. The company’s guiding principles - first articulated as  The Essentials by founder Axel Springer in the aftermath of World War II - remain a cornerstone of the company’s foundation today. Learn more about Axel Springer.

The company has worked with some of the world’s biggest artists, including Diana Ross, Lionel Richie, Britney Spears, Kylie, Lewis Capaldi, Sam Fender, Stevie Wonder, Justin Timberlake, Noah Kahan, Alanis Morissette, Robbie Williams, Richard Ashcroft, Becky Hill, Biffy Clyro and Fatboy Slim.

Cuffe & Taylor also operates a successful UK and international theatre touring division, programming thousands of performances across live entertainment, podcasts, screen-to-stage adaptations and musical theatre. In 2023, its original production Hey Duggee – The Live Theatre Show won the Olivier Award for Best Family Show.

The role covers all aspects of event management, including operational planning, procurement, supplier and stakeholder management and budget control, while working closely with Finance, Marketing, Ticketing, Promoting and Production teams.

Previous experience within event management, project management, event coordination or production coordination would be advantageous, particularly within live music, festivals, touring or large-scale outdoor events. Flexibility and a willingness to travel and work on site, including evenings and weekends during event periods, will be essential.

Cuffe & Taylor is made up of a diverse group of individuals, but we all share the same passion for putting our employees first. We have a fun atmosphere within the team, which helps us maintain an open, approachable department, which can partner and build genuinely authentic and valuable relationships with our employees and leaders. We are committed to working as a team and so support each other to achieve wins.

 

Who you are

Essential

  • Detailed project management / planning experience
  • Experience in budget management
  • Ability to work efficiently under pressure and tight deadlines
  • Excellent organisational and administrative skills
  • Excellent IT skills including Microsoft Office and Excel
  • Extremely well organised and self-motivated

 

Desirable

  • Proactive approach to problem solving

Cuffe and Taylor is part of Live Nation Entertainment which is the world’s leading live entertainment company comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, LN Media and Artist Nation Management.

The Associate Director, Client Experience (Media) leads integrated media and omnichannel planning across complex pharmaceutical and life sciences accounts. This role is responsible for translating business objectives, customer insights, and audience needs into strategic media programs that engage healthcare professionals, patients, and caregivers while driving measurable business performance.

This role can be remote within the United States or based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville, NJ, San Francisco, or Carmel, IN.

job.title: Director of Employee Listening & Insights
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

The Director of Employee Listening & Insights will lead WPP’s global approach to understanding and responding to employee sentiment, creating a scalable, insight-led listening ecosystem that drives visible action and sustains trust through transformation.

At the heart of the role is connecting employee voice with leadership decisions and tangible employee experience outcomes. The Director will harness technology, analytics and automation to provide timely, actionable workforce insights and embed employee sentiment more deeply into decision-making across WPP.

Partnering closely with HR, People Analytics, Communications, GBS and business leaders, the role will help create a single, trusted view of workforce insights and ensure employee feedback leads to meaningful action and measurable improvements throughout Elevate28 and beyond.

What you'll be doing:

Employee Listening Strategy & Delivery
  • Lead the evolution of WPP’s global employee listening strategy, developing a clear roadmap for implementation from 2027 onwards.
  • Build and embed a scalable, insight-led listening ecosystem that strengthens employee voice, drives visible action and sustains trust through transformation.
  • Review and optimise WPP’s employee listening technology landscape, leveraging technology, analytics and automation to deliver more timely and actionable insights.
  • Lead and continuously enhance WPP’s global listening framework, including engagement surveys, pulse surveys, lifecycle surveys, exit feedback and employee advisory forums.
  • Deliver monthly pulse surveys and transformation sentiment tracking across major geographies, providing leaders with timely visibility of employee sentiment and experience.
  • Ensure listening activities are closely aligned to business priorities, transformation milestones and employee experience objectives.
  • Lead survey governance, stakeholder engagement, vendor relationships and communications, ensuring a consistent and effective global approach.
  • Monitor participation, engagement and feedback quality, identifying opportunities to strengthen employee voice and increase the impact of listening.
  • Partner with the broader People Experience team to identify key employee experience pain points and prioritise areas for improvement.
  • Partner closely with People Analytics, GBS and Technology teams to create a more connected, automated listening ecosystem and a single source of truth for workforce insights.

Employee Insights & Action

  • Define and embed WPP’s employee insights strategy, establishing clear governance, reporting and action-planning frameworks.
  • Translate employee feedback and listening data into clear, actionable insights that strengthen the connection between employee voice, leadership decisions and employee experience outcomes.
  • Analyse data to identify emerging trends, organisational risks, opportunities and areas requiring intervention.
  • Provide executive-ready insights and recommendations for People Leadership, EMT reviews and transformation governance forums.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards that provide real-time visibility of employee sentiment, engagement and experience trends.
  • Track key indicators including engagement, transformation sentiment, change readiness, retention risks and wellbeing.
  • Identify leading indicators and early warning signals, enabling leaders to take proactive action.
  • Partner with HR and business leaders to translate insights into measurable actions and track their impact over time.
  • Build a data-driven culture where employee sentiment and experience are embedded into decision-making at all levels.
  • Lead the development of WPP’s “You Said, We Did” communications, demonstrating how employee feedback is influencing decisions and driving tangible change.

Key Measures of Success & Year One Deliverables

Success in the first year will be focused on establishing a stronger, insight-led listening approach and demonstrating a clear connection between employee feedback and action. Key priorities will include:

  • Delivering a reimagined WPP Employee Listening Strategy and roadmap for 2027.
  • Establishing a Continuous Listening Model, including monthly pulse surveys across major geographies.
  • Developing an Employee Insights Dashboard providing timely visibility of employee sentiment, engagement and experience trends.
  • Delivering the first cycle of the “You Said, We Did” programme, clearly demonstrating how employee feedback translates into action.
  • Driving strong listening participation and satisfaction, ensuring employees see value in sharing their feedback.
  • Increasing the insight-to-action ratio, with listening insights translated into tangible and communicated actions.
  • Monitoring transformation sentiment and fatigue, identifying emerging risks and enabling timely intervention.

What you'll need:

  • Significant experience in a senior HR, Employee Experience, People Insights or Employee Listening role, with a strong track record of delivering listening programmes at scale.
  • Proven experience shaping and activating employee listening and insights strategies, translating feedback into meaningful organisational change and action.
  • Strong partnership skills, with experience working across People Analytics, HR, GBS, Communications and Technology to deliver an integrated listening and insights approach.
  • A highly data-driven and insight-led mindset, with the ability to turn complex employee data into clear recommendations, executive-level insights and measurable improvements to the employee experience.
  • Experience working within large, complex, global and federated organisations, balancing global consistency with local and regional needs.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the credibility to engage senior leaders and drive action through compelling data and insights.
  • A strong understanding of how technology, analytics and automation can enhance employee listening, provide more timely insights and strengthen organisational decision-making.

 

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

 

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

#LI-Hybrid 

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

job.title: Videographer/Editor (Part Time)
job.description:
Our company is committed to being trusted voices of light and truth reaching hundreds of millions of people worldwide.

Who We Are

KSL is Utah’s leading local news source across digital and broadcast platforms, delivering trusted, award‑winning journalism through KSL.com and KSL‑TV. We provide in‑depth local reporting, investigative journalism, and up‑to‑the‑minute coverage that serves communities across the state. Committed to being a trusted voice of light and knowledge, KSL helps Utahns stay informed, connected, and engaged with the issues that matter most.


POSITION OVERVIEW

KSL-TV is looking for a talented Video Editor & Photographer to create engaging, character-driven stories for both in-depth projects and daily news. This role requires strong creative storytelling skills and the ability to deliver high-quality video edits efficiently under deadline pressure.


Note: Work configurations are subject to change based on business needs and at company discretion.

  • This position is an onsite role that requires the employee to regularly work at our Salt Lake City site.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Edit video material per needs of KSL, using non-linear computer-based equipment.
  • Edit video material to meet the various deadlines while maintaining and using professional editing skills, i.e., creativity, speed, technique and use of equipment.
  • Newsgathering; capturing and covering daily news events, as assigned by the assignment desk.
  • Correctly operate and maintain photographer and microwave equipment (Maintain a working knowledge of setting up and receiving live shots and satellite feeds and camera equipment.)
  • Perform routine editing duties as assigned (i.e., line editing, Feedroom, training etc.).
  • Proficiently use professional editing software to perform all editing tasks (trimming, sequencing, color correction, audio, graphics, effects).
  • At events of news interest, gather information, shoot video, communicate with producers and editors to effectively and accurately present events.
  • Maintain communication with the station, alerting the desk by radio or phone of any story or personal status change that may affect the assignment.
  • Willing and able to perform on-call, and weekend duties on a rotating basis.
  • Ensure the accuracy and quality of all final video content.

Skills and Experience We Are Looking For:  

  • Two years previous journalism broadcast experience, related field, or equivalent
  • Experience as video editor or photographer preferred
  • Experience with microwave and satellite operations preferred
  • Prefer degree in journalism or communications, or equivalent, with an emphasis in broadcast news style writing
  • Experience with non-linear editing equipment required, preferably Adobe Premiere
  • Prefer news photography or equivalent experience, including basic field lighting and audio skills
  • Good vision, a sense of news value and creative abilities in editing techniques.  An audition link or file is required, demonstrating accuracy, fairness and video editing news style.
  • Ability to work, lift, and carry photography equipment, at times in harsh conditions.
  • Self-starter, capable of making accurate journalistic editing decisions on stories in an innovative and creative way
  • Ability to work effectively in team environment
  • Strong computer skills and able to get video from various computer-based formats and sources
  • Valid Driver's license required

Physical Demands  

  • Receive, process, and maintain information through oral and/or written communication effectively
  • Substantial physical movements (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers
  • Ability to extend hand(s) and arm(s) in any direction with good eye and hand coordination
  • Good vision and hand coordination
  • Lift, move, and carry equipment that weighs 50-60 lbs. Able and willing to carry equipment for whatever distance is necessary to completely cover an event

 

Compensation  

$17.00 - 18.50 per hour. Hourly rate to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to evaluation of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant along with internal equity and alignment with market data.  

 

What We Offer You: Check Out Our KSL Benefits!

  • Paid time off for volunteering
  • Employer-funded retirement account, fully vested from day one

  • Matches on contributions to charitable organizations after one year of service
  • Continuous growth and development opportunities
  • Dynamic team culture that values teamwork, having fun, and collaboration

 

KSL is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law. Minority/female/disability PWDNET/veteran are encouraged to apply.

job.title: NOC Technician II
job.description:
Overview

Called to K-LOVE

 

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

 

At K-LOVE, every role is ministry.

 

We hire first for ministry alignment and a shared commitment to our faith, mission, vision, and values. We then seek talented professionals who can use their God-given gifts, skills, and experience to serve with excellence.

 

If you love Jesus and are called to be part of a ministry that places Christ at the center of everything we do, we invite you to explore this opportunity. If your heart aligns with our mission and you possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for the role, please keep reading.

 

As a NOC Technician II, you’ll serve as a central point of communication and action during incidents, partnering closely with Engineering and other teams to monitor systems, resolve issues, and maintain the performance of our nationwide network and IT infrastructure. If you're ready to make an impact in the world of broadcast operations, we want to hear from you!

 

*This is an on-site position that will provide coverage for various shifts (1st, 2nd, or 3rd) depending on the need.*

 

Here's some of what you will be doing:

  • Advanced RF Broadcast Support
    • Respond to complex or recurring RF alarms and outages, using deep system knowledge to identify root causes and implement long-term solutions.
    • Analyze telemetry trends and performance data across multiple transmitter sites to proactively detect degradation or abnormal behavior.
    • Coordinate corrective action plans with Field personnel, ensuring resolution timelines, testing protocols, and proper documentation are followed.
    • Proficiency in database script generation for all equipment and all rack configurations with proper logic for effective SNMP alarm management.
    • Support advanced troubleshooting of audio chain components, including signal flow analysis across encoders, processors, multiplexers, and satellite backhauls.
    • Contribute to RF system upgrades and rollouts, supporting configuration, validation, and remote commissioning of new broadcast equipment.
    • Train and mentor junior NOC Technicians in interpreting remote control data, handling RF alerts, and understanding FCC compliance requirements.
  • Enhanced Network Infrastructure Oversight
    • Resolve escalated network issues involving routing protocols, VLAN configurations, firewall policies, or cross-site connectivity problems.
    • Monitor and validate complex network relationships, including multicast configurations, VPN tunnels, and hybrid cloud infrastructure dependencies.
    • Participate in network maintenance windows, supporting firmware upgrades, config changes, or failover testing as part of the operations team.
    • Support integration between broadcast systems and IT infrastructure, such as IP-based audio transport, SNMP monitoring, or broadcast-over-IP platforms.
    • Lead investigation of intermittent or chronic IT service issues, working with cross-functional teams (IT, InfoSec, Broadcast Engineering) as needed.
  • Operational Process & Reliability
    • Review and improve SOPs for alarm handling, troubleshooting procedures, and shift handoffs to increase team efficiency and consistency.
    • Identify systemic issues and recommend improvements to monitoring thresholds, alert routing, or preventative maintenance plans.
    • Act as lead technician on shift, coordinating team response to major incidents, validating troubleshooting steps, and ensuring accurate documentation.
    • Manage escalations with external vendors, such as satellite service providers, remote connectivity carriers, or equipment manufacturers.
  • Reporting, Documentation & Quality Control
    • Oversee accuracy of log entries, work orders, and event tracking, ensuring completeness and compliance with internal and regulatory standards.
    • Perform root cause analysis and produce post-incident summaries that contribute to long-term operational improvements.
    • Create training documentation and job aids for new tools, procedures, or systems introduced to the environment.
  • Leadership & Professional Development
    • Serve as a technical resource and escalation point for entry-level team members, providing informal leadership and mentoring support.
    • Participate in cross-team meetings, offering NOC perspectives on operational impacts, monitoring needs, or deployment readiness.
    • Demonstrate ownership of assigned systems or regions, proactively ensuring their health, uptime, and documentation accuracy.
    • Continue professional development in areas such as networking (e.g., CCNA-level topics), broadcast engineering, or cloud systems (e.g., AWS fundamentals).

Here's some experience we are seeking: 

  • Associate’s degree in Broadcast Engineering, Networking, or Information Technology.
  • Industry certifications preferred (e.g., CompTIA Network+, SBE CBT).
  • 2–4 years of experience in a NOC, broadcast, network support, or hybrid technical environment.
  • Proficiency in troubleshooting RF broadcast and IT infrastructure issues.
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools (e.g., SolarWinds, PRTG, Kybio) and alarm escalation.
  • Strong documentation skills, able to contribute to process guides and job aids.
  • Ability to mentor entry-level technicians and provide guidance in troubleshooting.
  • Solid teamwork and communication skills across broadcast, IT, and field engineering.
  • Demonstrated capacity to manage multiple incidents and prioritize effectively.
  • A collaborative and flexible style, with a strong service mentality. Need to be seen as a team player.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to develop sincere business/ministry relationships.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
  • Demonstrated commitment to the social sector with a passion for our mission and values.

What can we offer you?

  • Industry leading Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
  • Short/long term disability and life insurance
  • Robust 401K with company match
  • Parental leave with Baby Bonding pay
  • Generous PTO, holiday and sick pay
  • Unique company culture that includes exclusive access to concerts, movie premieres, media industry events, and more
  • Leadership and Career Development Programs

Why work for K-LOVE? 

K-LOVE is a nonprofit, multi-platform media company on a mission to draw people closer to Christ. Founded in 1982 in Santa Rosa, CA, with a singular radio station, K-LOVE today owns and operates the nation's two largest Christian music radio networks (K-LOVE and Air1) with over 1,000 broadcast signals across all 50 states, streaming audio reaching around the world, and a growing family of media ministries including podcasts, books, films, concerts, and events. K-LOVE employs nearly 500 team members between its office in Nashville, TN and field locations around the country. You can view our mission and values here Mission, Beliefs & Values.

 

“As an Equal Opportunity Employer, K-LOVE makes employment decisions based on merit and other legitimate reasons. The Company is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment and equal employment opportunities regardless of protected class, characteristic or status. However, K-LOVE is a religious non-profit organization where all team members contribute to the Company’s mission of encouraging our audiences “to have a meaningful relationship with Christ.” Therefore, pursuant to the Civil Rights Act of 1964, Section 702 (42 U.S.C. 2000e I(a)), K-LOVE has the right to hire only candidates who agree with the Company’s Statement of Faith, Mission, Vision, and Values. Also, as a religious non-profit organization, the Company is not governed by the CA Fair Employment and Housing Act.”

job.description:
Company Overview

CUMULUS| New Orleans, LA currently features 4 stations in the New Orleans area and surrounding counties.  Our stations include: 92.3 WZRH-FM Alternative, 106.1 WRKN-FM NASH Country, 102.9 KMEZ-FM Urban AC and 106.7 KKND-FM The Krewe Classic Hits.  The cluster of 4 stations reaches thousands of listeners on a daily basis.  

 

 

Cumulus Media is an audio-first media company delivering premium content to a quarter billion people every month — wherever and whenever they want it. Cumulus Media engages listeners with high-quality local programming through 377 owned-and-operated radio stations across 84 markets; delivers nationally-syndicated sports, news, talk, and entertainment programming from iconic brands including the NFL, the NCAA, the Masters, US Soccer, and AP News, across more than 7,800 affiliated stations through Westwood One, a leading national audio network; and inspires listeners through the Cumulus Podcast Network, an established and influential platform for original podcasts that are smart, entertaining, and thought-provoking. Cumulus Media provides advertisers with personal connections, local impact and national reach through broadcast and on-demand digital, mobile, social, and voice-activated platforms, as well as integrated digital marketing services, powerful influencers, full-service audio solutions, industry-leading research and insights, and live event experiences. For more information visit www.cumulusmedia.com.


Position Overview

 

CUMULUS MEDIA | New Orleans, LA has an immediate opening for a full-time Multimedia Account Executive to join the Sales Team in assisting their clients in our New Orleans market – as well as contacts across the US – with multi-media business options that include both traditional media and highly targeted digital products, such as:

 

• Radio, Audio Streaming and Podcast Advertising
• Website Design, Optimization, and Repair
• Digital Display Advertising
• Reputation (Online Review) Monitoring & Management
• DNA Digital (Data Driving Digital Advertising)
• Call tracking
• YouTube and Online Video Advertising
• OTT (App Based & Online Television)
• Mobile Geofencing
• Search Engine Optimization
• Google AdWords
• Social Media Advertising and Content Creation
• Political Advertising
• Event Marketing and Management
• Recruitment Advertising

 

 

The Mutlimedia Account Executive successfully manages relationships with dozens of local and regional businesses, protects and grows the revenue base, identifies and creates new business opportunities with existing and new clients; provides marketing solutions to help customers achieve their business goals; strategically plans and implements initiatives to meet personal, company and corporate directives, recognizes that achieving budgeted revenue targets is the minimum expectation of performance. The right individual will invest in personal professional development, understanding technology, marketing and the full suite of company products and services.


Key Responsibilities & Qualifications

Key Responsibilities:

  • Able to create and identify client business needs by gaining a deep understanding of their goals, objectives and processes as well as their external environment including key market and consumer trends to proactively develop customized marketing solutions to meet client objectives
  • Deliver and develop effective and informed marketing solutions via multi-platform, integrated sales presentations identifying Cumulus broadcast, digital, and event tactics to foster brand loyalty and deliver results for the client
  • Ability to negotiate and close business that drives revenue results and fosters long term client relationships, regardless of medium or platform
  • Commitment to having a proficient understanding of the Cumulus Media assets and resources and a desire to constantly learn and grow your product knowledge thus staying relevant and current with industry advertising opportunities for your clients
  • Represent the full suite of products and services as marketing solutions to new and existing clientele. This includes station digital assets, internet-based marketing, social media, streaming, events and specialized programming
  • Ability to appropriately manage time to optimize revenue opportunities, client interaction, implementation and fulfillment of successful sales agreements. Individual must be able to assist in the development of creative messaging, regardless of platform
  • Excel at prospecting and aggressively seeking new clientele by networking, cold calling, canvassing, referrals or other means to maintain a full pipeline of sales prospects at all times
  • Follow all station and corporate procedures for preparing orders, resolving billing issues, submitting regular reports regarding sales, pipeline lists, forecasts and competitive analysis
  • Collaborate, create, and capitalize on opportunities to best represent our brand while working to help your clients achieve success


Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of sales experience required; with background in broadcast, media or digital advertising sales highly preferred.

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing or related field preferred, but not required.

  • Valid driver's license required. Driving is an essential function of this position because regular travel is required to perform key job duties, including meeting with clients & prospects, as well as attending business-related events.

  • Passion for developing new business relationships in an outside sales role, including preparing and presenting sales opportunities and post-sale successes to clients/potential clients.

  • Strong understanding of lead generation and ability to connect with viable prospects.

  • Comprehension of sales metrics in order to fill a sales funnel and maintain a constant pipeline of new business.

  • Excellent communication skills.

  • Self-motivating and entrepreneurial spirit; with a positive and friendly attitude and willingness to collaborate.

  • High energy and passion for sales.

  • Flexible, creative and curious.

  • Digitally savvy - proficient in Microsoft Office suite, social networking platforms and CRM tools highly preferred.


Pay Range

USD $3,000.00 - USD $5,000.00 /Mo.
Pay Range

The monthly pay range listed above reflects your guaranteed income during your first year, with additional opportunities to earn commissions
What We Offer

  • Commission-based organization with uncapped earning potential and guaranteed income in year one of employment
  • Focused, responsible and collaborative work environment with the ability to ask, “what if” and try innovative solutions
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance coverage
  • 401K with company match
  • Paid Vacation, Sick & Holiday time off
  • Life insurance, disability insurance, wellness, and an employee referral bonus program
