job.title: Business Office and Traffic Manager
job.description:
Curtis Media Group is seeking an organized, dependable, and detail-oriented Business Office & Traffic/Production Manager to oversee essential administrative, business, traffic, and production operations for our three radio stations.

This multifaceted position plays an important role in keeping daily station operations running smoothly. Responsibilities include office administration, vendor coordination, promotional support, commercial scheduling, order entry, production coordination, billing, financial reporting, and maintaining accurate station records.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable managing multiple priorities, possesses strong communication skills, and can work independently while supporting a team-oriented radio broadcasting environment.

Key Responsibilities
Office Management & Business Administration
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for incoming telephone calls, taking messages and directing inquiries to the appropriate personnel.
  • Serve as the primary contact for the station's alarm company, respond to alarm notifications, and coordinate ongoing alarm system maintenance.
  • Coordinate and manage client prize giveaways and station promotions.
  • Prepare, design, and print prize winner sheets for the on-air staff and maintain organized winner records and files.
  • Communicate promotional details and prize giveaway information to on-air personnel.
  • Create social media content and sports graphics to support high school football coverage.
  • Coordinate ticket promotions and giveaways for concerts and events in partnership with Live Nation.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for various vendors and service providers.
  • Retrieve mail from the station's post office box and station mailbox.
  • Process incoming checks, prepare deposits, and forward payments and related information to the appropriate corporate personnel.
Traffic Management & Commercial Operations
  • Enter all new advertising orders into the traffic system and send order confirmations to the appropriate Account Executives.
  • Enter order cancellations and maintain accurate client and advertising records.
  • Prepare and distribute weekly reports, including sales revenue, new orders, and aging reports, each Friday.
  • Upload weekly revenue information into ShareBuilders.
  • Prepare daily commercial logs for all three radio stations and upload logs.
  • Schedule and distribute commercials throughout the broadcast day while ensuring appropriate separation of competing advertisers.
  • Monitor commercial schedules to ensure all client advertising is running correctly and according to approved orders.
  • Distribute production orders (POs) to local talent for commercial recording.
  • Assign cart numbers to new commercial spots and enter all required information into the traffic system.
  • Submit commercial production requests through Just Say Spots and complete additional production work as needed.
  • Load network commercials and prepare required monthly affidavits.
Production Management & Billing
  • Dub commercial spots into production as needed.
  • Process monthly client billing.
  • Print and mail required hard-copy invoices.
  • Prepare and provide notarized affidavits for clients when requested.
  • Forward electronic invoices to clients.
  • Prepare monthly corporate reports and submit them to the appropriate corporate contact by the fifth day of each month.
Qualifications & Skills
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities and meet firm deadlines.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and general computer applications.
  • Ability to learn and navigate radio traffic, scheduling, billing, and production software.
  • Experience with social media platforms and basic graphic design is beneficial.
  • Basic bookkeeping, billing, and administrative experience preferred.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Professionalism when communicating with clients, vendors, co-workers, and the public.
  • Dependable, resourceful, and able to prioritize daily responsibilities.

Interested applicants please send resume to Craig Hahn, chahn@curtismedia.com

job.title: Digital Program Coordinator - Western Canada
job.description:
Logo: Teal, Red and Yellow shapes with Nimble by Pattison black text

‍

Pattison Media is looking for a Digital Program Coordinator to join Nimble Digital, our digital division, in a client-facing role. You bring a passion for digital marketing, real knowledge of how digital campaigns and websites perform, and the ability to work across multiple teams to deliver integrated media solutions for clients throughout Western Canada.

This full-time permanent role is open to candidates anwhere in Western Canada, with prefence for our Edmonton and Vancouver offices (hybrid); other locations are remote.

You'll coordinate the execution of client programs from onboarding through launch and ongoing support. Each client has a sales rep who owns the relationship; you make sure the program gets delivered, working alongside them and directly with the client. Most of your work will be on marketing & SEO programs. You'll also work on website projects, and you may support branding or design projects.

This is a fast-paced role with plenty of variety, across a wide range of local and regional businesses. You'll step into an open seat and manage clients from early on, with the team behind you.

What you'll do

ONBOARDING AND KICKOFF

  • Onboard assigned clients and make sure we have everything needed to execute their program, whether it's marketing, website, branding or SEO
  • Brief internal execution teams so they have the information and tools to deliver effectively
  • Set up projects with clear timelines and deliverables that keep everyone on track
  • Translate client goals and objectives into actionable tasks for the team

EXECUTION

  • Lead internal team meetings and client calls
  • Work alongside our sales teams to execute programs, keeping sales and the client informed
  • Work with execution teams and bring marketing know-how, to how programs are set up and run
  • Keep clients up to date on timelines and what stage their project is at
  • Manage client approvals across their programs and projects, and deliver feedback thoughtfully, thoroughly and in a timely manner
  • Capture ideas and notes in meetings and turn them into actionable tasks
  • Stay mindful of project timelines, scope and budget

ONGOING SUPPORT

  • Support live marketing programs and handle whatever comes up along the way, from creative refreshes to one-off client questions and requests
  • Act as liaison between clients and our ad ops and website teams: relay feedback, gather recommendations and see changes through
  • Walk clients through their reporting and answer questions about their program, marketing best practices and technical details
  • Keep a big-picture view of what each client needs next
  • Work with the wider Pattison Digital team to develop best practices across markets

What you bring

  • 2+ years in a client-facing role in a marketing environment, such as account management or program management
  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment with a variety of clients and can prioritize across many at once
  • You're comfortable with AI tools and have a real willingness to explore and experiment with them to work more efficiently
  • Strong understanding of SEO, SEM, paid social and programmatic tactics, enough to answer client questions confidently (you won't be setting campaigns up yourself)
  • Understanding of website best practices and how an optimized website drives conversions (no hands-on platform work required)
  • Ability to learn client businesses and recognize industry patterns and trends
  • Experience monitoring and interpreting client performance dashboards
  • Experience with Google Analytics
  • Familiarity with Meta business portfolios, Google Ads and Google Business Profile
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace (Gmail, Google Meet, Google Drive)
  • Basic understanding of SEO and HTML
  • Strong organization and clear, confident communication with clients and internal teams
  • Up to date on trends in social, search and display advertising

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience assessing active programs and making recommendations based on performance
  • Experience with website platforms such as WordPress, Squarespace or Webflow
  • Agency experience
  • Experience with project management tools like Teamwork

What success looks like

First 30 Days

  • You're running client programs independently, with hands-on support from the team

First 90 Days

  • You're up to speed on our programs and processes and handling a full client load, with support from the team

First Year

  • Your clients onboard smoothly, their programs launch on time and on scope, handoffs with sales and ad ops run without friction and clients are happy and sticking with us.

Justine Lawlor

Customer Success Lead

Flexibility to work weekends, holidays and varied hours required.

Regularly stand; walk; sit; reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear.  Occasionally required to climb or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.  Regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.  Vision abilities include close vision, distance vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

Senior Software Development Engineer – Backend (PNR API Platform)


OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Corporation is home to industry-leading brands including FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations, Tubi Media Group, and FOX One, our recently launched direct-to-consumer (DTC) platform. Across our portfolio, we build and operate large-scale digital platforms that serve millions of users globally. Our teams combine innovative technology, deep data insights, and world-class content to deliver highly personalized, reliable, and scalable consumer experiences across web, mobile, and connected TV platforms.


ABOUT THE ROLE


As a Senior Software Development Engineer on the Personalization & Recommendations (PNR) API Platform team, you will build and operate the backend systems that power personalized content discovery and recommendation experiences across FOX's digital products. The PNR API platform serves real-time personalized recommendations at scale, combining user behavioral signals, content metadata, vector similarity search, and ML model inference to deliver individualized experiences to millions of users.

You will work at the intersection of backend engineering and ML infrastructure - building recommendation engines, reranking services, user profile systems, and model serving pipelines. This role requires engineers who take end-to-end ownership - from understanding the problem and designing systems to implementing, deploying, and operating them in production.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Design, build, and operate high-throughput, low-latency backend microservices for real-time personalization and content recommendations
  • Take complete ownership of assigned problem areas, from system design to production rollout and ongoing operations
  • Build and evolve distributed systems that are resilient, fault-tolerant, and observable in production
  • Work with multiple data stores including relational databases, vector databases, search engines, key-value stores, and caching systems to build efficient data access patterns
  • Integrate ML models into real-time serving pipelines, working closely with ML Engineers and Data Scientists
  • Perform high-level and low-level system design, clearly articulating trade-offs and architectural decisions
  • Optimize systems for performance, latency, scalability, and cost at scale
  • Collaborate with Product, Data Science, Machine Learning, Analytics, and Platform Engineering teams to deliver recommendation capabilities across Web, Mobile, and Connected TV
  • Participate in on-call rotation and drive production reliability and operational excellence
  • Contribute to engineering best practices around architecture, testing, CI/CD, observability, and security

WHAT YOU WILL NEED


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field
  • 5+ years of experience building backend software systems in production environments
  • Strong programming skills in one or more backend languages, preferably Golang
  • Experience designing and building distributed systems with a focus on scalability, availability, and reliability
  • Hands-on experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL/Aurora) including query optimization and data modeling
  • Experience with caching systems (Redis/ElastiCache) and cache invalidation strategies
  • Experience working with NoSQL databases (DynamoDB) and understanding of access patterns and cost trade-offs
  • Hands-on experience with cloud-based systems on AWS
  • Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and their application in backend and distributed systems
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership, and deliver systems end-to-end with minimal guidance

NICE TO HAVE


  • Experience with vector databases (Milvus, Zilliz, Pinecone) and similarity search systems
  • Experience with search engines (OpenSearch/Elasticsearch)
  • Experience with ML model serving and real-time inference systems (Triton, KServe, SageMaker)
  • Experience building recommendation engines, personalization platforms, or content ranking services
  • Experience with event-driven architectures (SNS/SQS, Kafka)
  • Kubernetes and container orchestration (EKS, pod tuning, HPA)
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)
  • Observability stack (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog)
  • Service mesh experience (Istio)
  • Experience with experimentation / A/B testing platforms
  • Experience with streaming platforms, digital media, or consumer-facing applications

job.title: MEDIA EXECUTIVE - KOLO
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second highest rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group, with 46 markets, and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency that offers national and local clients digital marketing strategies and the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About KOLO

KOLO-TV isn't just a station; it's a multi-platform powerhouse deeply woven into the fabric of Reno and Northern Nevada. As home to ABC, Telemundo, MeTV, The CW, and the Silver State Sports & Entertainment Network, we're here to inform, entertain, and connect our community across every screen.

Innovation at the core: Gray Media is evolving on purpose, and you’ll be at the forefront of how we define the future of local media.

· Prepare and deliver professional sales presentations and proposals.

· Develop, negotiate, and execute multi-platform advertising campaigns.

· Collaborate with sales support, digital teams, and station leadership to ensure campaign success.

· Strong consultative selling, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

· Understanding of digital advertising solutions, including display, video, social media, streaming/OTT, programmatic, search, and audience targeting preferred.

· Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed revenue goals.

· Excellent communication, organizational, and time-management skills.

· Proficiency with CRM platforms, Microsoft Office, and digital sales tools.

· Self-motivated, competitive, and driven to succeed in a fast-paced environment.

job.title: Executive Assistant
job.description:
The Executive Assistant provides high-level administrative and operational support to two senior executives in a fast-paced, highly visible environment. This role manages complex calendars, meeting preparation, travel, expenses, communications, and projects while anticipating priorities and helping the executives remain organized and focused.   The Executive Assistant serves as a key liaison with internal and external stakeholders and regularly handles highly confidential information. Success requires exceptional judgment, discretion, attention to detail, organization, adaptability, and the ability to anticipate needs and act proactively with limited supervision.

Responsibilities

  • Manage complex, frequently changing executive calendars, coordinating meetings across multiple time zones, resolving scheduling conflicts, and proactively protecting time for critical priorities.
  • Anticipate the executives' day-to-day needs and priorities, proactively identifying scheduling issues, meeting requirements, emerging developments, and matters requiring timely attention or follow-up.
  • Coordinate and prepare executives for meetings and appointments, including agendas, briefing and presentation materials, conference rooms, audio/visual requirements, conference calls, external guests, and related logistics.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, KSTU
job.description:
News is changing, and we’re looking for journalists who want to help shape what comes next. At KSTU Fox 13, an E.W. Scripps station, you’ll do more than report the news. You’ll help reimagine how stories are discovered, told, and experienced across every platform.


As a Multimedia Journalist, you’ll be part of a newsroom that believes local journalism can spark conversation, strengthen communities, and make a real difference. If you’re energized by breaking news, meaningful storytelling, and the opportunity to connect with one of the nation’s rapidly growing communities, this is your chance to be part of something bigger.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Receive assignments or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.
  • Gather and verify factual information through interviews, observation, and research.
  • Organize materials and write stories according to editorial style and format standards.
  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.
  • Edit or assist in editing videos for all multimedia platforms.
  • Appear on TV in live or pre-recorded situations.
  • Work cooperatively with photographers assigned to stories, if one is assigned.
  • Assist news producer in preparing newscasts.
  • Assist online staff in preparing for multimedia stories.
  • Other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 3+ years of experience in a related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Computer literacy required, including newsroom computer systems
  • Videography and non-linear editing experience
  • Knowledge of broadcast-quality camera equipment
  • Edit video on non-linear systems
  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills
  • Proficient at posting content to various websites
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a deadline-driven environment
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company-required insurance limits

OUR TEAM:

You’ll join a newsroom filled with curious, creative people who believe great journalism starts with understanding the community we serve. Our team brings different perspectives, backgrounds, interests, and experiences to the table, united by a shared drive to tell stories that matter. Whether you thrive on breaking news, unforgettable characters, accountability reporting, or finding the story everyone else overlooked, there’s room here to make your mark.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Salt Lake City gives you the rare chance to pursue ambitious journalism in a place where adventure is practically part of the commute. The Wasatch Mountains rise just outside the city, putting legendary skiing, hiking, biking, and mountain landscapes within easy reach, while Utah’s red rock country and five national parks make weekend road trips hard to beat.

Beyond the outdoors, Salt Lake City offers a vibrant mix of neighborhoods, restaurants, arts, culture, sports, and a thriving tech scene. It’s a place where your career can grow alongside the community you cover, with no shortage of people to meet, places to explore, or stories waiting to be told.

At Scripps, we are committed to a culture that reflects the audiences and communities we serve. We are intentional about creating an environment where employees, our audiences and other stakeholders feel valued and inspired to reach their full potential and create connections. To successfully deliver on this commitment, we must understand and reflect the values and perspectives those around us embody. That process begins by looking inward to build and celebrate a respectful workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging and connection. By continuing to cultivate an environment where all employees have a fair chance to succeed, are included, valued, and seen, we will strengthen the connections that drive positive business impact and align with our core purpose. 

ABOUT SCRIPPS:

The E.W. Scripps Company (NASDAQ: SSP) is a diversified media company focused on creating connection. As one of the nation’s largest local TV broadcasters, Scripps serves communities with quality, objective local journalism and operates a portfolio of more than 60 stations in 40+ markets. Scripps reaches households across the U.S. with national news outlet Scripps News and popular entertainment brands ION, ION Plus, ION Mystery, Bounce, Grit and Laff. job.description:
Senior Software Development Engineer – Backend (PNR API Platform)

OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Corporation is home to industry-leading brands including FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations, Tubi Media Group, and FOX One, our recently launched direct-to-consumer (DTC) platform. Across our portfolio, we build and operate large-scale digital platforms that serve millions of users globally. Our teams combine innovative technology, deep data insights, and world-class content to deliver highly personalized, reliable, and scalable consumer experiences across web, mobile, and connected TV platforms.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Software Development Engineer on the Personalization & Recommendations (PNR) API Platform team, you will build and operate the backend systems that power personalized content discovery and recommendation experiences across FOX's digital products. The PNR API platform serves real-time personalized recommendations at scale, combining user behavioral signals, content metadata, vector similarity search, and ML model inference to deliver individualized experiences to millions of users.

You will work at the intersection of backend engineering and ML infrastructure - building recommendation engines, reranking services, user profile systems, and model serving pipelines. This role requires engineers who take end-to-end ownership - from understanding the problem and designing systems to implementing, deploying, and operating them in production.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, build, and operate high-throughput, low-latency backend microservices for real-time personalization and content recommendations
  • Take complete ownership of assigned problem areas, from system design to production rollout and ongoing operations
  • Build and evolve distributed systems that are resilient, fault-tolerant, and observable in production
  • Work with multiple data stores including relational databases, vector databases, search engines, key-value stores, and caching systems to build efficient data access patterns
  • Integrate ML models into real-time serving pipelines, working closely with ML Engineers and Data Scientists
  • Perform high-level and low-level system design, clearly articulating trade-offs and architectural decisions
  • Optimize systems for performance, latency, scalability, and cost at scale
  • Collaborate with Product, Data Science, Machine Learning, Analytics, and Platform Engineering teams to deliver recommendation capabilities across Web, Mobile, and Connected TV
  • Participate in on-call rotation and drive production reliability and operational excellence
  • Contribute to engineering best practices around architecture, testing, CI/CD, observability, and security

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field
  • 5+ years of experience building backend software systems in production environments
  • Strong programming skills in one or more backend languages, preferably Golang
  • Experience designing and building distributed systems with a focus on scalability, availability, and reliability
  • Hands-on experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL/Aurora) including query optimization and data modeling
  • Experience with caching systems (Redis/ElastiCache) and cache invalidation strategies
  • Experience working with NoSQL databases (DynamoDB) and understanding of access patterns and cost trade-offs
  • Hands-on experience with cloud-based systems on AWS
  • Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and their application in backend and distributed systems
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership, and deliver systems end-to-end with minimal guidance

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with vector databases (Milvus, Zilliz, Pinecone) and similarity search systems
  • Experience with search engines (OpenSearch/Elasticsearch)
  • Experience with ML model serving and real-time inference systems (Triton, KServe, SageMaker)
  • Experience building recommendation engines, personalization platforms, or content ranking services
  • Experience with event-driven architectures (SNS/SQS, Kafka)
  • Kubernetes and container orchestration (EKS, pod tuning, HPA)
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)
  • Observability stack (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog)
  • Service mesh experience (Istio)
  • Experience with experimentation / A/B testing platforms
  • Experience with streaming platforms, digital media, or consumer-facing applications

We're looking for a Roku Software Engineer to own and evolve our Roku channel, from the SceneGraph UI layer down to the playback pipeline and the APIs that feed it. Roku is one of the largest surfaces in our streaming footprint, and it's also the most constrained: the same channel has to feel fast on a top-tier Roku Ultra and on a five-year-old Roku Express with a fraction of the memory.

This role is for someone who treats those constraints as the interesting part of the job. You'll be measuring texture memory and node counts, chasing down rebuffer events in HLS manifests, and working with backend teams to shape the microservice responses that make a channel launch in under two seconds instead of six.

  • Design, build, and ship features in BrightScript and SceneGraph, with a strong bias toward maintainable, well-factored component architecture rather than monolithic screens.
  • Own video playback quality end to end: startup time, ABR behavior, seek responsiveness, trick play, DRM handshakes, and graceful failure and recovery.
  • Profile and tune channel performance against real device constraints: memory ceilings on legacy hardware, render thread contention, task node usage, image and texture budgets, and cold-start latency.
  • Instrument and act on QoE telemetry (startup time, rebuffer ratio, exit-before-video-start, bitrate distribution), and drive those numbers down over time.
  • Partner with backend teams to define and refine the microservice and BFF APIs that power the channel: catalog, playback authorization, entitlement, continue-watching, recommendations, and search.
  • Implement and maintain Roku platform integrations: deep linking, Roku Search and content feeds, Continue Watching, Roku Pay / Instant Signup, and the Roku Advertising Framework.
  • Build and maintain internal tooling and automation scripts in JavaScript/TypeScript: build and packaging steps, feed and manifest validators, release utilities, device-farm and smoke-test harnesses, and whatever else removes manual toil from the team's day.
  • Own the channel's CI/CD pipeline: automated builds, test execution, static analysis, artifact packaging, sideloading to test devices, and promotion through environments. You treat pipeline code as real code, with the same review and maintenance standards.
  • Shepherd releases through Roku channel certification, including performance and memory requirements, and manage the beta-to-production promotion process.
  • Establish and uphold engineering standards: code review, automated testing, static analysis, and clear documentation.
  • Debug production issues across the stack using the Roku debug console, profiler, ECP, and network capture, and turn root causes into durable fixes.
  • 3+ years of software engineering experience, including shipping production Roku channels with BrightScript and SceneGraph.
  • Demonstrated experience with performance tuning on constrained devices. You can talk specifically about a time you cut memory usage, reduced startup latency, or eliminated frame drops, and how you measured it.
  • Strong grounding in software engineering best practices: separation of concerns, testability, meaningful abstractions, code review discipline, and refactoring as a habit rather than a project.
  • Hands-on experience with video playback and streaming formats: HLS and/or DASH, adaptive bitrate behavior, manifest structure, buffering strategy, and DRM (Widevine and PlayReady on Roku).
  • Practical experience consuming and integrating with RESTful APIs in a microservice architecture, including pagination, caching, retry and backoff strategies, error contracts, and versioning.
  • Working proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript (Node.js) for internal tooling and build automation. You can write a maintainable CLI or script that other engineers will actually use, not just a one-off.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, CircleCI, or similar), including automated testing, build artifacts, and multi-environment deployment.
  • Comfort with debugging tooling and telemetry: you're at home in a debug console, a profiler, and a dashboard.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, especially when explaining tradeoffs to non-client engineers.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with the Node-based Roku toolchain: BrighterScript, Rooibos (or another BrightScript test framework), roku-deploy, and ropm.
  • Experience with reusable workflow patterns, composite actions, or shared pipeline libraries across multiple repositories.

  • Familiarity with SSAI/CSAI, VAST/VMAP, and ad-supported playback flows.

  • Background in another living-room platform (tvOS, Android TV / Fire TV, Vizio, Tizen, or webOS), and an understanding of where Roku differs.

  • Experience with CDNs, edge caching, and manifest manipulation.

  • Familiarity with QoE analytics platforms such as Conviva, Mux, or Datadog RUM.

  • Experience defining backend contracts (REST or GraphQL) alongside server teams rather than just consuming them.

  • Accessibility experience: captions, audio description, and voice navigation on TV platforms.

Your expertise will ensure rapid issue mitigation, operational excellence, and continuous improvements across Paramount’s live streaming platform.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the primary technical escalation point for the Live Event Operations team during live events.
  • Support global Tier-1 live streaming events by troubleshooting complex issues across the complete video delivery chain.
  • Investigate service-impacting issues involving contribution feeds, cloud encoding, packaging, DRM, origin, CDN delivery, playback, and client applications.
  • Perform detailed technical analysis using streaming manifests, player logs, encoder metrics, QoS/QoE analytics, SCTE-35 signaling, transport stream analysis, and cloud monitoring tools.
  • Coordinate technical response across Engineering, Platform, Network Operations, CDN providers, cloud vendors, and third-party partners to restore service quickly.
  • Lead technical bridge calls during critical incidents, providing real-time updates, impact assessments, mitigation strategies, and recovery coordination.
  • Support Live Event Operators by providing technical guidance during event execution, validating mitigation actions, and assisting with operational decision-making.
  • Perform pre-event technical validation, redundancy verification, workflow testing, and production readiness reviews.
  • Conduct post-event root cause analysis (RCA), identify systemic issues, and drive corrective actions to improve platform reliability.
  • Develop and maintain troubleshooting documentation, operational runbooks, monitoring procedures, and knowledge base articles.
  • Support certification, onboarding, and production rollout of new streaming technologies, cloud workflows, monitoring tools, and vendor integrations.
  • Participate in on-call rotations supporting global live streaming operations and high-severity production incidents.

 

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years supporting large-scale live streaming, OTT platforms, broadcast technology, or video delivery systems.
  • Experience serving as a technical escalation resource supporting live operations teams during Tier-1 live events.
  • Strong troubleshooting experience across end-to-end streaming architectures including:
    • Contribution and video transport
    • Cloud encoding and transcoding
    • Packaging and origin services
    • DRM
    • SSAI/DAI
    • CDN distribution
    • Player playback
  • Deep understanding of HLS, DASH, CMAF/fMP4, MPEG-TS, SCTE-35, timed metadata, and adaptive bitrate streaming.
  • Experience analyzing manifests, transport streams, encoder logs, player telemetry, QoS/QoE metrics, and cloud infrastructure metrics.
  • Familiarity with AWS Media Services, CDN technologies, cloud networking, and streaming observability platforms.
  • Working knowledge of contribution protocols including SRT, Zixi, RIST, RTP, UDP, and multicast workflows.
  • Strong understanding of DRM, SSAI, client playback behavior, redundancy architectures, and failover strategies.
  • Excellent incident management, root cause analysis, and cross-functional communication skills in high-pressure live production environments.

You’ll build and lead the data engineering capability for 5 Streaming in-house. You’ll own the pipelines, data models and quality controls that join streaming, advertising, marketing and registration data into a single trusted view of content and audience performance.

  • Own analytics implementation and tagging governance across all streaming platforms. You’ll cover technical specification creation, naming standards and defect prioritisation, working closely with product, technology and QA teams.
  • Establish data quality monitoring, alerting and scorecards across all streaming data sources, with defined thresholds, clear ownership and escalation routes.
  • Establish an experimentation capability, providing templated test setup, instrumentation standards and analysis patterns so that product and marketing teams can run and interpret tests autonomously.
  • Build in-house data modelling capacity for churn prediction, reactivation, ad targeting, segmentation and personalisation.
  • Own the technical data roadmap, identifying AI and automation opportunities to improve the accuracy, timeliness and cost of the data stack.

This role will lead a team of approximately 5 Commercial Production Managers, who collectively oversee a distributed team of commercial producers, and will have responsibility for the broader operating model that enables the team to deliver high-quality commercial creative efficiently and consistently at scale. 

The Director will set the strategy, standards, workflows, and tools for commercial production, with a focus on consistent creative quality, operational efficiency, resource optimization, and an exceptional experience for our sales teams and clients. This role will also oversee TEGNA’s network of freelance production resources, ensuring we have the right talent and capacity available to support changing business needs across markets.

The ideal candidate is an experienced people and operational leader who understands commercial video production but also knows how to build and improve systems at scale. This person will be a strong cross-functional partner to sales and other key stakeholders, a pragmatic problem solver, and an effective change leader who can bring teams along as workflows, technology, and expectations evolve.

This position can be located at any TEGNA station location.

Responsibilities

  • Leadership and Team Development: Lead, coach, and develop a team of approximately 5 Commercial Production Managers, establishing clear expectations and accountability while building strong, consistent leadership practices across the organization. Create a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, accountability, and high performance.
  • Commercial Production Strategy: Establish and execute the strategy and operating model for commercial production across TEGNA markets. Translate business priorities into clear production standards, processes, resource strategies, and team priorities.
  • Quality and Creative Standards: Establish clear standards for commercial creative and production quality across markets. Build mechanisms for sharing best practices, reviewing work, providing feedback, and increasing consistency while preserving the ability to meet individual client and market needs.
  • Operational Excellence and Efficiency: Continuously evaluate how work moves through the organization and identify opportunities to simplify processes, reduce unnecessary work, improve turnaround times, increase capacity, and make better use of internal and external resources.
  • Resource and Capacity Management: Develop a holistic view of production demand and capacity across markets. Partner with Commercial Production Managers to balance workloads, deploy resources effectively, identify capacity constraints, and determine when work should be handled locally, shared across markets, or supported by freelance resources.

Ensure production processes support revenue goals, client needs, and a strong customer experience while establishing realistic expectations around timelines, resources, and production capabilities.

  • Change Leadership: Lead the organization through changes in workflows, technology, team structure, and production practices. Clearly communicate the rationale and expected outcomes of change, engage managers and producers in implementation, and create the structure and accountability needed to drive sustained adoption.

Job Title

Principal Designer

Job Description


About The Position:


People Inc. is looking for a Principal Designer to take on some of the company’s most varied, visible, and important work.


You’ll work directly with the Chief Communications Officer and Chief Design Officer on the work that most visibly represents People Inc.: our events, our brand identity, our sites, what we put in front of investors, and the spaces we work in. Much of it has no precedent, so not every project starts with a defined brief. You’ll frame the problem, set the creative direction, and decide what the work should become.


From there, you’ll lead designers and outside partners project by project while staying hands-on. This is a role for someone highly experienced and influential who still loves making the work.


In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.



About The Team:

_______________________________________________________________________________


The Design Group at People Inc. brings together multiple teams supporting Revenue Design, Brand & Editorial Design, Product & UX Design, Design Systems, Creative Operations, Transactional Creative, and Events.

 

This role will work across corporate, brand, communications, and experiential design, partnering closely with senior leadership and designers across the organization.



About The Positions Contributions:


Weight %

Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results


Corporate, Brand & Communications Design ›› 70%

  • Lead high-visibility work from problem definition through final execution, including:
    • People Inc. Villa at Cannes, People Talks, Dinner with People, and Brand Showcases
    • People Inc. and People Incorporated sites, corporate and brand identity, and presentation systems
    • Investor Relations materials, including earnings decks, campaigns, and employee communications
    • Office and experiential design, video walls, sizzle reels, and other motion-led experiences
  • Work directly with senior leadership and cross-functional partners to establish creative direction, present work, make decisions, and maintain a high standard of craft. 


Creative Direction, Mentorship & Design Development ›› 30%

  • Define loosely defined problems and develop clear creative approaches before execution.
  • Direct designers, agencies, and creative partners project by project; provide feedback, run creative reviews, and mentor designers and emerging leaders.
  • Introduce new tools and approaches, including AI, when they improve the quality or efficiency of the work.
  • Remain accountable for the quality of the result without requiring an ongoing people-management structure.

Education:


Bachelor's degree preferred in design, graphic design, visual communication, or related field, and/or equivalent experience.

Experience:

  • 10+ years of professional design experience

job.description:
Chief Product Officer (CPO) serves as a core member of the executive team, reporting to the Chief Executive Officer, leading the transformation of our product ecosystem into a growth engine for a modern, digital-first media enterprise. This role is central to transforming USA TODAY Co. into a customer-centric, product-led, digitally scaled media enterprise. The CPO will help unlock new growth pathways, leveraging the diversity of the product portfolio, to modernize the product ecosystem, and ensure the company remains competitive in a rapidly evolving media and technology landscape.

This role will define and execute an integrated product vision, strategy, and roadmap across consumer, advertising, and platform experiences—ensuring alignment with company strategy, changing customer needs, and long-term growth objectives. The CPO will partner closely with the CEO and executive leadership team to drive product-led growth, innovation, and differentiated user experiences across USA TODAY and the broader network. Consistent with enterprise priorities, this leader will combine deep product expertise, media industry knowledge, and technology-driven innovation to accelerate revenue growth, audience engagement, customer expansion and loyalty and platform scalability.

• This role is central to transforming USA TODAY Co. into a product-led, digitally scaled media enterprise

• The CPO will leverage the breadth of the product portfolio and potential to unlock new growth pathways, modernize the product ecosystem, and ensure the company remains competitive in a rapidly evolving media and technology landscape

Key Responsibilities

1. Define and Align Enterprise Product Strategy

• Define and communicate a clear, compelling multi-year product vision and strategy aligned with company growth goals

• Translate strategy into actionable product roadmaps, investment priorities, and measurable outcomes

• Ensure product initiatives directly support revenue growth, customer acquisition, retention, and engagement, purposefully elevating the overall quality and reliability of the experience across channels and platforms, and safeguarding consumer trust across our product portfolio

• Serve as the executive owner of product portfolio performance across consumer, B2B, and platform products

2. Drive and Scale Product-Led Growth & Innovation

• Drive a product-led growth model across all digital products and platforms

• Identify and scale new opportunities across subscriptions, advertising, data products, and emerging revenue streams

• Lead innovation across AI, personalization, content experiences, and platform capabilities

• Ensure rapid experimentation, testing, and data-driven iteration across the product lifecycle

• Build efficient and fast-cycle development and learning as a practice and cultural norm

3. End-to-End Product Lifecycle Ownership

• Oversee the full product lifecycle: discovery, development, launch, optimization, and sunsetting

• Ensure a strong focus on customer needs, user experience, and product-market fit

• Deepen understanding of the customer, championing customer-centricity throughout the entire product lifecycle.

• Establish clear product KPIs, OKRs, and performance management systems tied to business outcomes

• Leverage analytics to continuously optimize product performance and decision-making

4. Cross-Functional Leadership

• Partner with Technology, Data, Content, Revenue, Marketing, and Operations leaders to deliver cohesive product experiences

• Align engineering capabilities, monetization strategies, and go-to-market execution to achieve product strategy

• Act as a key connector across teams to ensure speed, prioritization clarity, and execution discipline

• Collaborate with the executive team on capital allocation, strategic tradeoffs, and transformation priorities

5. Organization Leadership & Talent Development

• Shape and lead a high-performing design and product organizations (product management, UX, product analytics)

• Establish best-in-class product management disciplines, operating rhythms, and governance models

• Attract, develop, and retain top product and digital talent

• Foster a culture of customer-centricity, innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement

6. Market Leadership & External Engagement

• Act as a visible leader externally representing USA TODAY Co.’s product vision with partners, investors, and the broader market

• Monitor industry trends, competitive landscape, and emerging technologies to inform product strategy

• Bring external perspective from high-growth technology environments to accelerate transformation

Qualifications & Experience

Leadership Experience

• 15+ years of progressive product leadership experience, including senior executive roles

• Proven success leading product organizations in high-growth technology companies

• Demonstrated impact driving product-led growth, digital transformation, and revenue expansion

Industry Expertise

• Strong experience in both:

o Technology-driven product environments (SaaS, platforms, marketplaces, or digital ecosystems)

o Media, content, or digital publishing companies with scaled audiences

Functional Expertise

• Deep expertise across:

o Product strategy and roadmap development

o Customer experience and user-centered design

o Data, analytics, and experimentation frameworks

o Monetization models (subscription, advertising, data-driven products)

• Proven ability to align product, technology, and commercial strategies

Leadership Capabilities

• Strategic thinker with strong business and financial acumen

• Exceptional cross-functional leader with ability to influence at executive and board levels

• Track record of building and scaling high-performing teams and organizations

• Comfort operating in complex, fast-changing environments with competing priorities

Personal Attributes

• Visionary and growth-oriented, with an entrepreneurial mindset

• Customer-obsessed with strong intuition for user needs and product-market fit

• Data-driven decision-maker with bias for action and experimentation

• Highly collaborative, capable of aligning diverse stakeholders

• Resilient, adaptable, and energized by large-scale transformation and change

job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

NPR’s Marketing team is responsible for building and growing our audience for podcasts, programs, and platforms. The team seeks to grow the reach and impact of everything NPR puts out in the world—from our up-to-the-minute digital and broadcast content to our on-demand podcasts, events, videos, website, and app  The Vice President, Marketing leads the operational planning and execution of comprehensive marketing strategies across NPR's portfolio. Reporting directly to the Chief Marketing Officer, this role manages a team of marketing professionals to execute targeted initiatives that attract, grow, and retain diverse audiences for NPR while driving brand alignment and engagement across all channels. 

Responsibilities

  • Partner across divisions to identify emerging audience opportunities and propose initiatives and campaigns aligned with NPR’s strategic goals.
  • Directly manage, guide, and mentor a team of marketing professionals overseeing audience development work on NPR products, podcasts, and platforms.
  • Define target audiences, perform competitive landscape analyses, identify market opportunities, establish messaging frameworks, and set KPIs to launch new properties and sustainably grow audiences.
  • Create cohesion and consistency across marketing strategy work by lifting up best practices, strengthening and reimagining workflows, and deepening team collaboration.
  • Maintain and enforce a consistent brand expression, voice, and positioning across all channels and consumer touchpoints.
  • Partner with internal and external stakeholders to develop third-party publisher and brand partnerships to grow, diversify, and acquire new audiences.
  • Strengthen the marketing team’s commitment to cultivating meaningful, collaborative partnerships with our network of Member stations.
  • In close collaboration with the CMO, set operational priorities, allocate staff effectively, and manage project workflows.
  • Build and maintain strong cross-functional relationships to ensure Marketing’s capabilities, role, and integration across the organization are clear.
  • Measure project success using industry-standard metrics (Nielsen ratings, Cume, AQH, CTR, downloads, etc.) to evaluate show and podcast campaign performance.
  • Support and optimize NPR’s consumer products marketing strategy to expand brand reach and complement revenue initiatives.
  • Select, manage, and hold accountable external partners, such as digital ad agencies.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 12 to 15+ years of progressive marketing experience, with at least 7+ years in a senior management role overseeing multidisciplinary teams and project budgets.
  • Proven track record of operationalizing strategic goals into execution roadmaps, managing competing priorities, and leading cross-functional project teams through complex, deadline-driven product or campaign launches. 
  • Hands-on experience conceptualizing, building, and executing end-to-end integrated marketing campaigns across multiple distribution touchpoints—including broadcast, podcasting, digital display, social media, email lifecycle marketing, and mobile app ecosystems. 
  • Demonstrated proficiency in establishing performance benchmarks and leveraging audience measurement metrics (such as Nielsen ratings, Cume, AQH, CTR, downloads, active users, and conversion rates) to evaluate, optimize, and report on campaign ROI. 
  • Strong listening, writing, and speaking skills.
  • Knowledge of best marketing practices for email, display ads, websites, and apps.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of the public media landscape, preferably with direct experience either at a Member station or in close collaboration with federated systems.
  • Experience managing external creative or digital advertising agency relationships.
  • Experience supporting product marketing, merchandising, or consumer brand expansion
  • Demonstrated understanding of the unique dynamics, revenue models, and collaborative touchpoints between national network programming and local station engagement. 
  • Hands-on experience working alongside product development, digital design, and editorial teams to align marketing strategy directly with audience UX and content lifecycle management. 

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Exceptional collaboration skills with a proven ability to work cross-functionally and gain the respect and support of internal and external clients.
  • Deep knowledge of modern audience acquisition, retention, and engagement practices across broadcast, podcasting, digital display, social media, lifecycle email marketing, and mobile app ecosystems. 
  • Outstanding written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Creative mindset with a passion for marketing, advertising, design, and storytelling.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust, drive consensus, and maintain productive relationships across diverse departments (editorial, product development, legal, finance, and revenue teams). 

Education Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience. Advanced degree (e.g., MBA) preferred.

Work Location & Requirements

NPR Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid-permitted role. The employee will be required to be in the New York City office at least 3 days a week. The employee must also reside in New York City.

Job Type

This is a full-time, exempt position.

Salary Range: The U.S.-based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $216,000-$243,000 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

NPR Benefits: NPR provides comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.

job.title: Global Member Services Representative
job.description:
About ASCAP

The American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers (ASCAP) is a membership association of more than one million songwriters, composers and music publishers, and represents some of the world’s most talented music creators. Founded and governed by songwriters, composers and publishers, it is the only performing rights organization in the U.S. that operates on a not-for-profit basis. ASCAP licenses a repertory of over 20 million musical works to hundreds of thousands of businesses that use music, including streaming services, cable television, radio and satellite radio and brick and mortar businesses such as retail stores, hotels, clubs, restaurants and bars. ASCAP collects the licensing fees; identifies, matches and processes trillions of performances every year; and returns nearly 90 cents of every dollar back to its members as royalties. The ASCAP blanket license offers an efficient solution for businesses to legally perform ASCAP music while respecting the right of songwriters and composers to be paid fairly. ASCAP puts music creators first, advocating for their rights and the value of music on Capitol Hill, driving innovation that moves the industry forward, building community and providing the resources and support that creators need to succeed in their careers. Learn more and stay in touch at www.ascap.com, on X and Instagram @ASCAP and on Facebook.

# # #

Job Overview:

The Global Member Services Representative provides customer service to ASCAP’s members via telephone, email and ASCAP’s proprietary online account management system (Member Access). The position serves the goals of the ASCAP Global Members Services department in ensuring ASCAP writers, publishers, and internal partners receive the best experience possible. This is a hybrid position with currently a minimum 3 day per week in-office requirement, based out of the ASCAP New York Office.

Areas of Responsibility & Accountability:

  • Member Customer Service:
    • Provide customer service to ASCAP’s writer and publisher Members via telephone, email and ASCAP's proprietary online account management system
    • Communicate effectively with individuals from both within and outside of the organization in order to resolve writer and publisher Member issues and answer all questions
    • Resolve and track inquiries and other types of incoming requests by researching and resolving any issues that may arise from writer and publisher Members and/or their representatives
    • Inquiry subjects vary, but often regard the following:
      • Performance crediting
      • ASCAP’s repertory
      • Royalty distribution
      • Overpayment recoupment
      • International collections and distributions
      • Membership elections
      • General membership concerns
    • Escalate and resolve Member issues by effectively leveraging your expert knowledge of ASCAP’s business and communicating with other departments within ASCAP as necessary
    • Use sound judgment to determine if claims need to be escalated
  • Distribution Support:
    • Liaise with Members on behalf of ASCAP’s Distribution Team whenever additional information is required to process a writer or publisher claim
    • Liaise with other departments to seamlessly resolve Member issues

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Excellent administrative, written, and verbal communication skills
  • The ability to clearly and simply communicate complex issues
  • Skilled at prioritizing multiple tasks or projects simultaneously
  • Self-motivated and organized to ensure internal and external responsiveness
  • Effective and creative problem solver
  • Prior customer service experience
  • Knowledge of ASCAP’s systems, policies and procedures is a plus
  • Music and music industry interest a plus
  • This position currently requires the incumbent to be in the office 3 days per week- In-office requirements are subject to change

Compensation/Benefits:

Besides providing a unique and dynamic work environment, there are a few other reasons you should consider ASCAP in your career planning. We also offer generous benefit options that are comprehensive and provide the flexibility that most employees want and need. These health care and financial plan options include the following:

  • A choice of either network-only provider medical and dental plans or more flexible medical and dental plans where you can see providers in or out-of-network
  • Vision plan that offers both in and out-of-network provider options
  • 401(k) Plan that offers pre-tax, Roth, and an after-tax employee contribution option, including a company match for pre-tax and Roth contributions
  • An additional employer paid discretionary profit share contribution, regardless of your participation in the 401(k) Plan
  • Generous time-off policy
  • Health care and dependent care flexible spending accounts
  • Short-term disability insurance/salary continuation and long-term disability insurance
  • Company provided basic life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance

job.title: Senior Manager, Strategic Finance
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How we LEAD:

The Strategic Finance team at Virgin Music Group [VMG] spearheads global improvement and business integration projects, constructing comprehensive execution plans with a strong focus on finance and global strategy.  The Sr. Manager role will report to the team’s VP and will be based at our New York City office with an in-office presence of 3-4 days/week.  (Note: VP is located in Miami, FL.)

 

How You’ll CREATE:

 

The ideal candidate will be a proactive person with exceptional organizational skills and a strong analytical mindset.  This role will work across many business verticals, driving forward global projects and ensuring timely execution of strategic deliverables.

 

  • Manage internal strategic analyses by working with department leaders across VMG and wider UMG on growth and integration initiatives, business process optimization and global cost reduction.
  • Drive forward implementation of VMG’s strategic goals by managing workstreams and tracking project initiatives with many stakeholders
  • Develop financial models and create concise presentations to communicate project progress to VMG senior management and other UMG leaders.
  • Recommend best practices for improving current processes to facilitate better decision making, team communication, and cost savings.
  • Proactively identify potential opportunities, evaluate strategic implications, and initiate related analyses.
  • Manage finance related communications with label/artist partners and internal UMG stakeholders to ensure transparency of strategic goal achievement.

 

Bring your VIBE:

 

  • Minimum 6+ years of relevant work experience in accounting, bookkeeping, finance, consulting/strategy or similar field
  • Prior relevant experience in the music industry preferred
  • Ability to take ownership of and drive forward projects independently
  • Superior Excel skills and advanced proficiency Microsoft Office Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and other office tools.  GPT building experience a plus.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to successfully prioritize multiple tasks with minimal oversight
  • Excellent critical thinking and problem-solving abilities
  • High level of intellectual curiosity, especially around music, technology, and entertainment
  • Highly personable with strong team-working skills

Perks Playlist:

Join an entrepreneurial, global organization where authenticity, boldness, creativity, connection, drive, and insight aren’t just values—they’re how we work every day. Here are some of the ways we support you along the way (and just a few of the benefits we offer):

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience building and optimizing multiple, simultaneous marketing campaigns
- Experience managing or working within cross-functional marketing and creative teams
- Experience across affiliate marketing, PPC, SEM and social media advertising

- Experience in multi-territory campaign management

job.title: Distribution Processor - Foreign Incoming (Hybrid)
job.description:
Every royalty payment starts with accurate information.

As a Distribution Processor at BMI, you’ll help turn music usage information into the accurate, timely royalty distributions that support the songwriters, composers and publishers we represent. You’ll process information from different sources, use specialized systems and tools, and contribute to a team that values accuracy, consistency and meeting deadlines.

Depending on your team, your work may involve processing cue sheets, identifying reported performances, handling music reports or supporting incoming international royalty payments. You’ll learn established processes, build knowledge of the music industry and work closely with colleagues and management to resolve questions and maintain quality.

If you enjoy detail-oriented work, solving practical problems and seeing how your contributions support the people who create music, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

POSITION SUMMARY

Processes information from a variety of sources using systems, tools and resources that support the accurate and timely distribution of royalty payments to BMI affiliates.

FUNCTIONS OF THE JOB

Essential Functions: which may be representative but not all inclusive of those commonly associated with this position.

Processes cue sheets, links performances and performs other necessary tasks to meet team goals and deadlines.

Maintains best practices as learned from continuous training on systems, procedures and decision-making.

Applies policies, procedures and guidelines relevant to this business function.

Communicates with management on a regular basis regarding work-related issues and questions.

Meets established departmental goals for quantity and quality.

Performs all tasks and functions handled by a specific team.

Maintains knowledge of industry and affiliate changes through a variety of sources (industry blogs, BMI360, on-line content, and/or updates shared by co-workers and leaders).

Regular attendance.

Supports BMI Core Values and cultivate a culture of diversity and inclusion.

Other duties as assigned.

Specific to Distribution and Administration Services Foreign Incoming Team

Processes Audio and Audio-Visual distribution payments made by foreign Performing Rights Organizations.

Creates manual payments to our affiliates.

Reviews and reconciles quality assurance reports related to resolution and payment of Foreign Incoming royalties.

Physical/Visual Activities or Demands

Physical/visual activities or demands that are commonly associated with the performance functions of this job.

Sitting, talking, hearing, walking.

Concentrated mental and visual attention with normal hand-eye coordination.

Clarity of vision at 20 inches; corrected or uncorrected.

Generally negligible physical effort, but occasional moving of 1 to 10 lb. items.

Environmental/Atmospheric Conditions

Environmental and atmospheric conditions commonly associated with the functions of this job.

Normal office conditions.

POSITION QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

Education: High school diploma or GED. Bachelor’s degree in related field preferred.

Experience: Experience or familiarity with an operational/processing role.

Skills and Abilities: which may be representative but not all inclusive of those commonly associated with this position.

Knowledge of music industry or active participation in the music community highly preferred.

Effective written and verbal communication skills.

Proficient keyboard and PC skills.

Ability to perform well in a fast-paced, ever-changing, detail-oriented work environment.

Effective decision-making skills to determine when and how to escalate problems or questions.

Demonstrate a passion for music.

Foreign language helpful but not required.

Ability to organize and prioritize work.

Ability to interact professionally with others at all levels.

Ability to work in a team or independently with minimal supervision.

Initiative.

Good problem-solving ability.

MACHINES, TOOLS, EQUIPMENT, AND WORK AIDS

Personal computer and associated software. Normal office equipment.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

job.title: Sr. Manager, Licensing Accounting
job.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:   Leads the Licensing Accounting function through a Licensing Accounting Manager and Senior Accountant, owning revenue recognition and technical accounting for the company and ensuring compliance with ASC 606 across all revenue streams. Sets team direction, standards and workflow while remaining directly engaged in the highest-judgmental technical matters, the revenue close, review, reporting, controls and audit processes and keeps revenue accounting diligence-ready to support transactions and builds scalable revenue and billing processes as the company grows. Builds scalable revenue and billing processes as the company grows, identifies and implements process improvements pertaining to area of responsibility and works directly with financial accounting, FP&A, licensing, legal, operations, collections services, IT and other departments to uphold company best practices, ensure proper controls are in place and deliver excellent customer service.

FUNCTIONS OF THE JOB

Essential Functions: representative but not all inclusive of those commonly associated with this position.

Revenue Recognition & Technical Accounting

Owns revenue recognition policies and ensures compliance with ASC 606 across all revenue streams, applying judgment appropriate to the company's size and complexity, and reviews and updates related company policies and procedures.

Reviews customer contracts, including non-standard terms, bundled arrangements, variable consideration, and contract modifications and determines the correct accounting treatment.

Writes clear technical memos documenting key revenue judgments for auditors, investors and future diligence.

Revenue Close, Reporting & Controls

Oversee the monthly revenue close performed by the Manager and staff, personally reviewing and approving the most complex or judgmental entries (deferred revenue, unbilled receivables, contract asset balances), and ensuring successful coordination and completion of the month-end process.

Prepares revenue schedules and footnote disclosures for annual GAAP audited financial statements.

Designs and maintains a practical internal controls framework over the revenue cycle, scaled to the company's stage and ready to mature toward SOX if needed.

Leads the fiscal year-end audit and manages the revenue portion of the annual external audit, including PBC requests and auditor inquiries, maintaining relations during the audit.

Diligence, Transactions & M&A

Keeps revenue accounting "diligence-ready" to support fundraising, debt financing, a potential sale, or IPO, including quality of earnings (QoE) reviews.

Supports M&A activity through due diligence and integration of acquired revenue streams.

Team Leadership & Development

Builds and leads the Licensing Accounting team, setting direction and standards while empowering the Manager to own day-to-day execution; remains directly hands-on engaged with the Senior Accountant on complex technical matters, and available for escalation on staff-level, ensuring proper internal control and delivering excellent customer service.

Ensures the manager provides proper on-boarding, cross training and coaching to staff specific to Licensing Accounting; directly coaches and develops senior accountant and periodically reviews the manager's coaching effectiveness with the staff.

Develops the Licensing Accounting Manager's leadership capability, delegating operational ownership of the team's day-to-day work while providing guidance on complex technical or personnel matters.

Schedules, coordinates and leads broader team meetings and regular 1:1 with manager and senior accountant to ensure successful communication and collaboration; ensures the Manager runs effective staff level meetings and communication.

Cross functional partnership

Works directly with Licensing, Legal, Operations, Collections Services, IT and other departments to review deal terms before signing, flag revenue impacts early, uphold company best practices, ensure proper controls are in place and deliver excellent customer service.

Educates non-finance teams on how contract terms affect revenue.

Systems & Process Improvement

Ensures CRM, ERP and other financial systems function properly (as related to area of responsibility), and lead or support the selection and implementation of new systems, coordinating with Accounting Technology and IT, as needed.

Accesses and analyzes data to answer business questions and improve processes, leveraging available technology tools.

Builds or rebuilds revenue processes, often moving from spreadsheets toward automation as the company scales, researching, recommending and implementing process and procedural improvements by coordinating with management, team members and internal/external customers.

Acts as project manager for Licensing Accounting projects when appropriate

Supervisory Responsibilities: Directly supervises a licensing accounting manager and accountant and indirectly oversees additional team members in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring and training employees; planning, assigning, directing and ensuring reliability of work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining team members; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

POSITION QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

Education:  Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance required.

Experience: Minimum 8–10+ years' progressive accounting experience, with significant hands-on ASC 606 work. Three (3) or more years' people management experience required. Comfort operating in a fast-paced, less-structured environment.

Skills and Abilities: which may be representative but not all inclusive of those commonly associated with this position.

Experience with ERP and revenue/billing systems, plus advanced Excel skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office

Experience with Oracle Financial modules and Salesforce preferred

Familiarity with AI-powered tools for data analysis and process improvement preferred

Ability to write clear technical memos, reports, business correspondence and procedure manuals

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret professional literature and technical procedures. Strong working knowledge of U.S. GAAP, particularly ASC 606, with the ability to apply technical guidance to non-standard or complex transactions

Effective communication skills, including presenting to executives and effectively responding to questions from groups of managers, vendors, internal and external customers

Must be capable of building, fostering and working in a team environment focused on quality and customer service

Excellent time management, analytical, decision making and organizational skills

Ability to  develop and lead a multi-tiered team, delegating prioritized operational execution to a Manager while maintaining accountability for team output and quality

Ability to establish good working relationships and interact competently with others at all levels of management

Experience in a PE-backed or multi-entity company preferred

License(s)/Certifications Required: None; CPA license (active or inactive) preferred.

job.title: Senior Product Manager
job.description:
AccuWeather is seeking a strategic and results-oriented Senior Manager, Digital Subscriptions to grow our subscription offerings across mobile, web, and connected platforms. This role is instrumental in defining the roadmap for our digital subscription services, driving audience growth and revenue, and ensuring competitiveness in a fast-evolving landscape. Reporting directly to the SVP of Digital Strategy, the successful candidate will bring deep expertise in subscription ecosystems, customer segmentation, product packaging, pricing strategy, and cross-functional leadership.

 

Key Responsibilities:

· Define and execute end-to-end product and go-to-market strategies for digital subscription offerings across all consumer segments.

· Conduct assessments of Total Addressable Market (TAM), perform customer segmentation and needs analysis, and develop pricing models and packaging strategies to drive business growth.

· Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including design, engineering, marketing, sales, operations, and business development—to ensure a unified approach to product development and market execution.

· Monitor market trends, competitive landscape, and emerging technologies to identify strategic opportunities and potential threats.

· Analyze user behavior and business performance using quantitative and qualitative data to inform product roadmap and feature prioritization.

· 7+ years of experience in digital product management, with at least 5 years developing and executing go-to-market strategies.

· Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Digital Media, or related field; MBA preferred.

· Deep understanding of the digital subscription ecosystem and associated business models.

· Experience across product marketing, pricing, sales enablement, and communications, with a strong ability to resolve complex internal and external challenges.

· Strong strategic thinking, analytical rigor, and creative problem-solving abilities.
