job.description:
Job Description

Legal Content is a foundational capability within Westlaw. It helps legal professionals understand and navigate legal authority with confidence, including how a case or statute has been treated over time.

We are looking for a Senior Manager, AI Engineering to build and lead a team that is evolving Legal Content for the next generation of AI-powered legal research. You will lead engineers across AI, large-scale data processing, backend services, and platform modernization. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will lead the team and stay close enough to the technology to make sound architecture and delivery decisions.

This role includes both modernizing a critical, long-running platform and building new AI capabilities. The work involves some ambiguity. Priorities are clear, but the approach may change as the team learns and the market evolves.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and lead the team. Hire, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of backend, platform, and AI engineers.
  • Set technical direction. Partner with Product, Editorial, Research, and engineering teams to turn the KeyCite product vision into a scalable technical strategy and roadmap.
  • Deliver AI capabilities. Lead the development and productionization of generative AI and machine learning capabilities that help customers understand legal information and the relationships within it.
  • Modernize the platform. Evolve KeyCite's processing, publishing, and services to improve scalability, reliability, and the speed at which new capabilities ship.
  • Apply AI to complex domain problems. Work with AI researchers and legal domain experts to decide how generative AI, machine learning, and traditional software can work together in trusted professional workflows.
  • Establish engineering excellence. Set standards for architecture, reliability, observability, experimentation, testing, and AI evaluation.
  • Take ideas to production. Lead work from prototype through productionization, measurement, and continuous improvement.
  • Lead across boundaries. Remove blockers and build strong working relationships across Engineering, Product, Editorial, and AI teams.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years experience with at least 7 years of software engineering experience, including work that began before the wide adoption of generative AI and at least 2 years of people-management experience, with teams of 10 or more people, and experience leading multi-team initiatives rather than small groups only.
  • Hands-on proficiency in Python and Java, and experience building scalable backend or distributed systems.
  • Strong cloud experience, with AWS preferred. Strong experience on Azure or GCP is also considered.
  • Experience taking machine learning or generative AI systems from prototype into production.
  • Experience leading teams through modernization of existing systems while keeping them reliable.
  • Ability to work with ambiguity and drive change in a fast-moving environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with LLM evaluation, retrieval, grounding, or agent-based architectures.
  • Experience in legal technology, legal research, or other regulated or high-accuracy professional-data domains.
  • Experience at a company that is actively navigating an AI transformation.
  • Experience with data processing at large scale, such as search, knowledge graph, or data platform systems.
  • Experience leading or working alongside engineering managers in a matrixed organization.

Job Description

The Risk Solution Consulting Manager leads a high-performing, experienced US-focused team responsible for translating customer risk, fraud, identity, compliance, investigation, and integration requirements into compelling solutions involving the Thomson Reuters CLEAR public records data and analytics product. The role owns the Solution Consulting strategy for the Corporates Risk business, partners with Sales and cross-functional leaders to improve revenue outcomes, and develops a high-performing team of CLEAR Product Specialists and Integration Specialists.

1. Lead and Develop the Risk Solution Consulting Team

·    Build, lead, and retain a high-performing, inclusive team spanning both pre-sale CLEAR Product Specialist (Corporate customer remit) and pre/post-sale Integration Specialist (Corporate and Government customer remit) roles.

·    Set clear goals and expectations; maintain a consistent coaching cadence through one-on-ones, call reviews, in-the-moment feedback, and documented development plans.

·    Onboard and support cross-training of new team members across CLEAR products, customer use cases, discovery, demonstration, integration, presentation, and value-articulation skills.

·    Differentiate coaching and success measures for product-focused and integration-focused roles while increasing bench strength and reducing single points of failure.

·    Lead the team’s professional development through stretch assignments, mentoring opportunities, etc.

·    Represents Risk Solution Consulting in leadership forums and serves as a visible advocate for the team, customers, and business.

2. Drive Sales Strategy and Revenue Outcomes

·    Partner with Risk Sales and Sales Management on new and existing customer opportunities, including qualification, discovery strategy, solution alignment, competitive positioning, demonstrations, proofs of concept, and executive presentations.

·    Prioritize Solution Consulting capacity toward the opportunities with the greatest customer value, revenue potential, strategic importance, and probability of progression.

·    Support pipeline creation as well as pipeline conversion through customer education, webinars, industry events, partner activities, thought leadership, and targeted account programs.

3. Own Team Readiness for CLEAR Product Positioning and Customer Value

·    Ensure the team can position the CLEAR portfolio against customer workflows including investigations, identity verification, fraud prevention, risk assessment, enhanced due diligence, know your customer (KYC), and adverse media/sanctions monitoring.

4. Support Integrated Solutions via Strategic Partnerships

·    Partner with Corporate & Government Partnerships & Alliances, Product & Innovation, Product Management, Marketing, Sales, and external technology partners to shape repeatable Risk solutions.

·    Guide Solution Consulting support from early solution design through go-to-market preparation, field enablement, customer opportunity support, technical onboarding, and post-launch refinement/support.

·    Establish clear ownership and operating rhythms for partner opportunities, including qualification, discovery, demonstrations, technical alignment, deal progression, and implementation handoffs.

·    Help scale CLEAR product usage through pre-integrated partner solutions and customer-specific workflow integrations.

5. Strengthen Customer Experience and Cross-Functional Execution

·    Serve as a senior escalation and coordination point for complex customer, product, solution, and integration issues that affect strategic opportunities or relationships.

·    Represent customer and field feedback to Product and Product Management to improve roadmap decisions, product readiness, documentation, and overall customer experience.

·    Model ownership and proactive problem solving while maintaining clear role boundaries and sustainable team capacity.

6. Run the Business with Data and Operational Discipline

·    Establish and maintain operating metrics that show Solution Consulting activity, capacity, opportunity engagement, win rate, revenue influence, deal progression, discovery compliance, and customer or partner outcomes.

·    Use Salesforce, Gong, Workday, dashboards, and other approved tools to guide prioritization, coaching, forecasting, and continuous improvement.

·    Create regular leadership views that identify trends, capacity risks, skill gaps, process issues, and actions needed.

·    Work with Solution Consulting leadership to standardize core Solution Consulting practices while allowing appropriate flexibility for distinct product, integration, customer, and partner motions.

·    Use and promote AI and automation responsibly to improve team productivity, knowledge access, call coaching, content preparation, and scalable enablement, with measurable outcomes.


Key Deliverables and Measures of Success

·    Achievement of Risk business financial targets in partnership with Sales leadership, with clear evidence of Solution Consulting influence.

·    Improved win rate, deal progression, late-stage conversion, and time-to-close on SC-supported opportunities.

·    A healthy, engaged, and continuously developing Product Specialist and Integration Specialist team with documented coaching and succession coverage.

·    Consistent, high-quality customer discovery, demonstrations, technical consultations, and integrated solution designs.

·    Effective support for launch and execution of strategic CLEAR solution partnerships and repeatable integrated solutions.

·    Actionable operational and value metrics used regularly to make prioritization, staffing, coaching, and go-to-market decisions.


Required Qualifications

·    Substantial experience in solution consulting, pre-sales, technical consulting, product consulting, or a related customer-facing role in risk, fraud, identity, compliance, investigations, data, or enterprise software.

·    Demonstrated leadership experience, including goal setting, mentoring, and leading through change.

·    Strong knowledge of CLEAR or comparable public-records, risk, identity, fraud, due-diligence, compliance, investigation, or data-integration solutions.

·    Experience leading complex sales cycles involving business, technical, legal, security, procurement, implementation, and executive stakeholders.

·    Ability to guide both functional product demonstrations and technical discussions involving API and batch services.

·    Proven collaboration across Sales, Product, Partnerships, Marketing, Customer Success, and senior leadership groups.

·    Strong executive communication, presentation, facilitation, negotiation, and written communication skills.

job.title: Associate Knowledge Manager
job.description:
Job Description

Thomson Reuters provides intelligent information and solutions for law firms, corporations, government agencies, tax, audit, and accounting firms, and academic institutions. The Procurement and Proposal Management (PPM) team is an integrated shared service organization that coordinates proposal responses to formal government and corporate solicitations (RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, collectively RFXs) for the U.S. and U.K. markets, and responds to customer inquiries such as forms, certifications, and disclosures. The work is collaborative, flexible, fast-paced, and deadline-driven.


As an Associate Knowledge Manager, you will help maintain a comprehensive, accurate knowledge base that serves our growing organization and centralized RFX processes. In partnership with product managers, solutions consultants, and subject matter experts (SMEs), you will create and maintain reusable proposal content and tools, apply AI tools under expert editorial oversight, and support special procurement projects. This role is essential to mitigating risk for Thomson Reuters and maintaining proposal excellence, compliance, and sustainable team capacity.


Key Responsibilities

Repository management

  • Maintain and expand an electronic content repository for designated products (e.g., product descriptions, Q&A pairs) used for RFXs, forms, and customer inquiries.
  • Monitor product roadmaps and enhancement announcements to identify new content for the repository.
  • Respond to content and feedback submissions from proposal team members. Edit, tag, and index submissions with related or new terms.
  • Provide quality assurance for AI-assisted content, ensuring consistent tone, voice, and messaging. Balance AI assistance with human editorial judgment to protect brand integrity, regulatory compliance, and professional standards.
  • Organize and index the repository so proposal team members can use it efficiently.
  • Regularly review and optimize content by removing duplicates, improving messaging clarity, and refining formatting.
  • Write, format, and proof content to meet approved brand and style guidelines, and ensure it integrates easily into proposal templates.
  • Use the repository to help answer customer and internal inquiries and basic formal and informal solicitations with consistent, accurate responses.

New product integration

  • Contribute to all phases of new-product integration under the standard onboarding plan.
  • Work with proposal team members and SMEs to expand the RFX content repository with new proposal and forms content.
  • Support development of sole source letters, capabilities statements, RFX templates, and other materials built from repository content.
  • Review existing RFX libraries to identify reusable work product, such as templates, completed responses, informal proposals, forms, certifications, and vendor registration data.

Proposal materials and tools

  • Assist in developing proposal materials for formal and informal requests for designated products.
  • Support creation of tools and resources for the sales team and other internal staff for new sales and renewals.
  • Assist in maintenance of Proposal Resource Center (PRC) tools and resources for designated products on a regular schedule.
  • Keep the SME list and contact information current, accurate, and complete.
  • Keep the Knowledge Manager Guidebook up to date.

Procurement operations and training

  • Help create and deliver ongoing training on the Qvidian proposal automation system and the RFX content repository.
  • Support development of best practices and streamline processes and tools to manage increasing workload volume.
  • Stay current on Qvidian enhancements, Thomson Reuters product development and acquisitions, proposal best practices, and market trends, including through training from Upland Software (for Qvidian) and the Association of Proposal Management Professionals (APMP).

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required. A degree in journalism, corporate communications, marketing communications, or library science, with an emphasis on writing, is preferred.
  • Minimum of two years of professional content management experience, preferably developing content for proposals, marketing, or sales. Working knowledge of the proposal response process.
  • Professional-level English proficiency, with mastery of writing, editing, proofreading, and advanced formatting skills. Ability to apply company style guidelines and maintain consistent brand voice and tone.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI tools (such as Claude or Copilot) to create and optimize content, with the judgment to balance AI assistance with human editorial review.
  • Excellent organizational, interpersonal, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build rapport and trust with internal partners at all levels, including SMEs.
  • Understanding of content and database management principles, including how to write content that communicates product value.
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Strong analytical skills and technical aptitude, including advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint).
  • Demonstrated drive and initiative, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, changing environment.
  • Investigative and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify process improvements.
  • Flexibility to work additional hours during peak proposal deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Qvidian or similar proposal management automation or content repository tools.
  • Experience writing proposals for corporate and government customers in a high-volume, deadline-driven environment.
  • Experience managing content repositories for tax, compliance, or global trade software solutions.
  • Prior experience in information technology, software, or legal publishing.

  • Participar do processo de seleção/admissão de novos colaboradores para o time.

  • Participar de sessões de discussão de ideias com demais .líderes da área de suporte, identificando e propondo melhorias nos processos e fluxos de atendimento.
  • Desenvolver as aptidões dos colaboradores, tornando-os cada vez mais completos e preparados para o atendimento com excelência.
  • Garantir que as estratégias definidas para o setor sejam aplicadas, auxiliando na busca pelos objetivos do negócio
  • Orientar as decisões por dados que norteiem a tomada de decisão e planos de ação.

Required Qualifications

  • Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, áreas de tecnologia ou correlatas.
  • Experiência com rotinas de Escrita Fiscal e Contabilidade.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar de forma híbrida em Campinas ou São Paulo.
  • Experiência em gestão de equipes.
  • Capacidade de análise crítica e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.

A Thomson Reuters informa o caminho adiante ao reunir conteúdo confiável e a tecnologia que pessoas e organizações precisam para tomar decisões corretas. job.title: Senior Director, GTM AI Product Leader
job.description:
Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Director to own the AI roadmap and strategy for our go-to-market organization: Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Partnerships. You will partner with our segments and RevOps to decide where AI creates the most value across the customer lifecycle, and work with Engineering to deliver it through a deliberate mix of best-in-class SaaS platforms and custom-built solutions where off-the-shelf products fall short.


You will work with internal stakeholders to define the problems worth solving, prioritize ruthlessly, and measure adoption and business impact. You will be the accountable leader for how AI shows up in the way we sell, onboard, deliver, retain, and grow with customers and partners.


Key Responsibilities

GTM AI strategy and roadmap

  • Define and own a multi-year AI vision and a quarterly roadmap spanning Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Partnerships.
  • Identify, size, and prioritize AI use cases by revenue impact, productivity gain, cost to serve, and feasibility.
  • Establish clear principles for build vs. buy vs. configure, and make those calls transparently with business cases and total cost of ownership.
  • Align the GTM AI roadmap with company strategy, revenue targets, and the broader enterprise AI and data strategy.
  • Rationalize and govern overlapping tools and prevent AI sprawl across the GTM organization.
  • Run discovery, prototyping, pilots, and scale-up with clear success criteria and stage gates.

AI across the GTM functions

job.title: Event Services & Production Manager (Crypto.com Arena)
job.description:
For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

Crypto.com Arena is where the world comes to play, perform, and come together. As one of the most iconic venues in sports and live entertainment, we host unforgettable moments, from championship games and global tours to once in a lifetime events that define the culture of Los Angeles. 

Owned and operated by AEG, our team brings live experiences to life with creativity, precision, and pride. Every role plays a part in creating nights fans remember, powered by people who care about the details and the impact of getting it right. 

If you want your work to show up in real moments, in a venue where history is made every night, there’s a place for you here. Because it happens here. 

Job Summary:

The Event Services & Production Manager is responsible for managing all aspects of assigned sports team, as well as support all concerts and special events at the venue(s). In addition, the Manager is responsible for the supervision, scheduling and coordination of the stage crew, including members of stagehands from the local union hall. The incumbent will act as the main liaison between the venue(s) tenants, promoters and all facility departments to ensure successful events. 

Essential Functions:

  • Serve as the primary contact to one or more of the  Arena Tenants (Lakers, Kings, Sparks) and act as the primary liaison in providing and determining their needs in order to make their event successful.
  • Manage and oversee long and multiple load-in, event and load-outs of assigned event(s) (Concerts, private events, award shows, etc.)
  • Interface with LAFD on all permit requirements and obtain approval for special setups
  • Work closely with Finance in execution and delivery of accurate estimates, settlements, invoicing, etc
  • Ensure that all tenants/clients operate in the venue(s) within company and venue safety and security parameters.
  • Manage communication lines between the Show, the company and Local 33 Union stagehands to provide top of the line service for events.
  • Prepare and distribute detailed production notes for each event and schedule production meetings with the venue’s department heads (including but not limited to operations, security, food & beverage, and guest services).
  • Manages and supervises in-house crew, stagehand and other technicians, including those not in the direct employ of the facility, engaged in producing a stage or non-stage production, in varying degrees of interactions, possibly from concept to production. This includes determining priorities of event coordination; hanging of soft goods, electric, sound, supplemental rental equipment and building modification
  • Oversees the setting up and working of support equipment for all stage presentations, and assembles stage crews for setting up, working, and tearing down all stage shows
  • Manages and coordinates the scheduling of repair and maintenance of all stage equipment.
  • Files reports and payroll processing regarding stage personal
  • Advance preparation with production crew and personnel regarding technical rider requirements.

Required Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma or its equivalency (BA/BS Degree Preferred)
  • Must have 5+ years of related work experience
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word and Excel); and ability to learn required business systems
  • Knowledge of “front of house” patron practices and procedures
  • Ability to coordinate all components in presenting major theatrical productions, awards shows and concerts.
  • Knowledge of the occupation hazards and safety precautions of the trade
  • Must be able to work in a fast-paced, high energy environment and handle high stress situations
  • Ability to read, understand and implement artist riders
  • Ability to understand and follow oral and written instructions.
  • Extremely organized and detailed oriented
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relations
  • Tolerance and patience under adverse conditions, such as loud noises
  • Ability to work long irregular hours for an extended period of time as dictated by events and schedule.  This will include weekends and holidays.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of sports and entertainment industry preferred
  • Experience of stagehand practices and techniques including IATSE stagehand practices and union contracts is preferred
  • Experience with AutoCad software strongly preferred

Payscale: $73,266 - $106,698

Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings.

job.title: LA Galaxy, Program Operations Coordinator
job.description:
LA Galaxy is where soccer, culture, and community come together. As one of Major League Soccer’s most storied clubs, the Galaxy deliver unforgettable matchdays and moments that connect fans across Los Angeles and beyond.

Owned by AEG, the LA Galaxy are powered by teams who bring energy, creativity, and commitment to everything they do, from matchday operations and fan engagement to the work that happens behind the scenes. Every role plays a part in shaping the experience on and off the pitch and building a club that reflects the city it represents.   If you want to be part of a team where your work shows up live, in real time, and in front of passionate fans, there’s a place for you here. Because on matchday, it happens here.

Job Summary

The Program Operations Coordinator plays a hands-on role in the delivery, quality, and growth of LA Galaxy Youth soccer programs, combining strong soccer knowledge with the operational skills needed to create organized, engaging experiences for players, families, and coaches. Supporting Galaxy Juniors, Skills Training, Grassroots, Camps, and the Galaxy Discovery Program, this position works on-site and serves as a key resource for coaches, participants, and families. The Coordinator supports assigned program processes and initiatives, while contributing to coach development, program operations, local marketing and outreach, and the identification of opportunities for new or expanded programming that expand the LA Galaxy pathway, community impact, and long term program growth across Southern California.

Essential Functions

  • Facilitate the on-site execution of assigned youth programs by preparing spaces, coordinating setup and teardown, organizing equipment and materials, supporting staff readiness, managing participant check-in, and ensuring the site is prepared for a successful program experience.
  • Create a welcoming and professional experience for players and families by serving as a visible LA Galaxy representative, responding to questions and concerns, addressing day-to-day participant needs, and helping resolve issues with care and efficiency.
  • Assist with coach development through on-site observations, constructive feedback, regular communication, and follow-up on coaching needs, and escalating performance or development concerns.
  • Support operational processes including registration information, program communications, administrative tasks, program materials, and other systems that support efficient program delivery.
  • Coordinate marketing and outreach efforts by helping promote youth programming, providing program information and resources, and identifying opportunities to increase awareness, enrollment, and participation.
  • Research and evaluate potential locations for new or expanded youth programming by considering facility suitability, community access, program demand, and operational requirements, and share recommendations with the Department Leadership.
  • Contribute to program equipment and inventory by preparing supplies in advance, maintaining organized storage and distribution processes, monitoring inventory levels, and identifying replenishment, replacement, or other operational needs.
  • Collaborate with the Programming team on new program ideation, development, and execution to assist with pathway expansion, increased participation, brand awareness, and revenue growth.
  • Perform other programming department duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or its equivalency (BA/BS Degree Preferred)
  • 2-4 years Related work experience
  • Coaching and event related work experience preferred
  • Commitment to the mission, vision and core values of the LA Galaxy
  • Ability to multi-task and prioritize work assignments in a fast paced environment
  • Ability to be a clear thinker, analyze and resolve problems, exercising good judgement
  • Ability to work cooperatively and professionally with other departments
  • Experience with working with youth (ages 1.5-16)
  • Knowledge of youth soccer landscape in Southern California
  • Proficient in account management database systems and ability to learn required business systems
  • Excellent Customer Service Skills
  • Must be proficient with Microsoft Excel and Outlook
  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication skills
  • Highly motivated, with a positive attitude
  • Detail oriented and ability to work independently
  • Fluency in Spanish preferred

job.title: Systems Engineer III, Datacenter Operations
job.description:
Job Summary:

JOB DESCRIPTION – SYSTEMS ENGINEER III, DATACENTER OPERATIONS

Location: Ashburn, VA (On-Site)

Division: Ticketmaster NA

Line Manager: Senior Manager, Datacenter Operations

Contract Terms: Permanent, full-time/40h per week

 

THE TEAM


This position will be part of Ticketmaster’s Data Center Engineering team. The team is responsible for building, maintaining and keeping the company’s physical infrastructure footprint running smoothly to keep fans happy and support our internal customers.


THE JOB


Ticketmaster is seeking Talented Infrastructure Engineers responsible for overseeing data center-based projects and Operations tasks crucial to supporting our critical Data Center devices and infrastructure. 

You will be handling requests from and supporting internal service teams by responding to requests for hardware installations, maintenance, troubleshooting and recycling efforts.  This role is also responsible for proactively monitoring critical hardware systems and focusing on higher level initiatives that include firmware management, hardware monitoring and alerting and metrics collection. 


This is an exciting time to come on board with Ticketmaster, as we will be focusing on efforts towards hardware modernization and operability, expanding capacity and expanding our internal services for internal customers.


WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING


·       Provide expertise on hardware deployments and working with internal service team to build rack elevations and deploy hardware

·       Work with our Data Center Asset Management system to keep automated systems up to date with critical asset information

·       Work with service teams and Network teams to build port configurations

·       Lead projects to rack and install new hardware and decommission old hardware

·       Respond to requests for support of hardware in the datacenter as well as manage hardware lifecycle

·       Maintain key relationships with internal Engineering customers

·       Manage and maintain the hardware monitoring platform to keep internal customers hardware operating smoothly

·       Deploying systems firmware updates to keep the hardware platforms up to date and compliance with standards

·       Monitor the data center environment to keep things running within specifications

·       Work with the data center facility to receive and ship hardware

·       Keep the data center organized and efficient

·       Able to troubleshoot P0 incidents in a timely manner, supporting a 24/7 mission critical environment

·       Understanding of Data Center Power infrastructure for capacity planning, monitoring and deployment

 

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (or TECHNICAL SKILLS)

 

·       Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs

·       7+ supporting Enterprise Data Centers

·       Strong technical troubleshooting skills

·       Excellent understanding of modern server and networking hardware, Dell, HP, Cisco and Arista offerings for example

·       Excellent verbal and communication skills

·       Great Documentation and peer review skills

·       Familiarity with automation

·       Familiarity with observability (Prometheus, Grafana)

·       Knowledge and experience with DCIM (Data Center Inventory Management) solutions

·       Ability to use SSH and other remote access solutions

·       Server+ certification or equivalent experience

·       Network+ certification or equivalent experience

·       Strong background with network architecture and server provisioning

·       Language ability a plus (python, go)

·       Experience with Linux preferable

 

YOU (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS)

 

·       Detail oriented

·       Autonomous and proactive

·       Passionate about hardware

·       Self-motivated activator, energetic and tenacious

·       Comfortable with working in cross functional and multidisciplinary teams

·       Excited about taking on challenging technical problems and devising creative solutions


BENEFITS & PERKS

Through our ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ program, we provide benefits across six key pillars:

  • HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)
  • YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days
  • WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program
  • FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support
  • CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment
  • OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

 

LIFE AT TICKETMASTER

We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.

 

Our mission at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. Ticketmaster is the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the global market leader in live event ticketing products and services. Through official partnerships with thousands of venues, artists, sports teams, festivals, performing arts centers and theaters, Ticketmaster processes 550 million tickets per year across 35+ different countries.

 

We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.

 

Our work is guided by our values:

 

Reliability - Fans and clients count on us to power their live event experiences and we rely on each other to make it happen.

 

Teamwork – While we celebrate individual achievements, we know have more success as a team.

 

Integrity - We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent.

 

Belonging - We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive.

 

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.

job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

 

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward-thinking, and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

 

THE JOB

Venue Nation is seeking a technical leader to help transform how our Finance organization operates - from automating complex workflows to enabling smarter decision-making at scale. You will partner directly with Finance leadership and Accounting teams to identify high-impact opportunities, then design and build the AI-powered solutions that deliver on them, spanning financial reporting, close, reconciliation, and forecasting.

 

This is a builder-leader role: your solutions ship to production, and your judgment shapes how AI is applied across the finance function. Based within Venue Nation Analytics alongside our Data Science team, you will own solutions from discovery through production. Your work will span a growing portfolio of projects sponsored by the Division CFO. We are looking for a self-starter who brings structure to undefined problems - someone who knows finance from the inside and can build the AI solutions it needs.

 


WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

 

Partner and Prioritize

  • Partner with Finance leadership and accounting teams to identify and prioritize the highest-impact opportunities across financial reporting, transaction accounting, close, reconciliation, and forecasting.
  • Map accounting workflows end to end and redesign processes around AI where it adds the most value.
  • Serve as a translator between finance and technical stakeholders, ensuring solutions reflect business needs and adhere to necessary controls. 

Build and Ship

  • Design and build AI-powered solutions across the accounting lifecycle, from high-volume transactional work (invoice coding, cash application, account reconciliations, journal-entry support, and close-task coordination) to management reporting, forecasting, and decision support.
  • Apply large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, and agentic workflows to real business problems, selecting the right approach for each use case.
  • Stand up pilots in development environments to validate solutions with finance users, and partner with Data Services to deploy to production.
  • Collaborate with the Data Science team to apply AI to forecasting and planning workflows, including variance detection and driver analysis.

 

Build for Trust and Auditability

  • Develop evaluation frameworks that measure solution accuracy and reliability against defined thresholds, and produce the documentation needed to meet Finance governance and audit requirements.
  • Design human-in-the-loop review workflows, exception handling, and confidence-based routing so that AI-enabled solutions earn trust incrementally.
  • Ensure financial calculations are performed through deterministic, auditable logic rather than generative outputs.

 

Compound the Capability

  • Contribute reusable components, patterns, and best practices that accelerate AI delivery across the Analytics organization.
  • Monitor deployed solutions for accuracy drift, performance, cost, and adoption, and iterate based on what you learn.

job.title: Assistant Companies News Editor
job.description:
About us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

 

Our commitment to inclusion and fairness

We believe everyone should have a fair opportunity to contribute, succeed, and reach their full potential. That means ensuring everyone is heard, respected, and valued, while identifying and removing barriers that may get in the way. Our commitment is to be an employer role model, grounded in inclusion and fairness for all.

We want every application to receive fair and thoughtful consideration; therefore, all applications are reviewed by a member of our recruitment team, not by AI.

 

The role

The Financial Times is looking for a smart and energetic business editor to join the Companies desk in London. This is an important role on the desk, helping steer the coverage of key sectors, ensure the smooth running of the desk and editing some of our highest profile stories, whether splash-worthy scoops or corporate deep dives. 

This person will be liaising with correspondents around the world, helping steer coverage of everything from banks and oil majors, to carmakers, luxury giants and defence start-ups. This is a wide-ranging job, where a good command of corporate reporting, smart news judgement and the ability to make complicated stories sing are essential. 

Business knowledge and a reporting background are important qualifications. This person needs to be able to confidently handle longer investigative stories and take care of legally contentious pieces. 

 

Key responsibilities

  • Commission sharp news stories and original analysis in conjunction with other editors
  • Help maintain a healthy pipeline of scoops and reads that will populate prime slots on the homepage
  • Edit copy so stories have appropriate length, pace and punch
  • Closely co-ordinate with other desks, especially New York, Hong Kong and Markets
  • Project stories to the main news desk with smart headlines and strong graphics to maximise their audience
  • Work on longer term data projects with the long form and visual journalism teams
  • Weekend and some early morning shifts are required as part of the team rota

 

What we are looking for

The right candidate will be news driven, a team player and will ideally have been an accomplished reporter and writer of corporate stories. Good communication and planning skills are essential. This editor must be comfortable exercising editorial judgement on legally contentious stories and be experienced working to tight deadlines and producing stories very quickly on breaking news. Experience editing long form would also be a plus. 

 

Please submit your application by the end of the day, Sunday 22nd November 2026.

 

The use of AI

Original reporting, great writing and intelligent commentary lie at the heart of FT journalism. Our readers trust us to produce quality journalism that is accurate, fair and insightful. This is why FT editorial staff do not by default use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to write articles or create other reader-facing content. For specific and pre-approved cases, AI can be harnessed for certain tasks, such as assisting data research for investigations.  

We expect applicants to the FT newsroom to refrain from using AI in their test submissions, and any written materials should be a genuine reflection of their own knowledge, skills and experiences. We encourage candidates only to employ AI as a tool to help with research and interview readiness for a role. 

Candidates should be aware that the use of AI throughout the application process is monitored to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process for all.

 

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

FT Newsroom staff are expected to work onsite a minimum of three days per week, subject to role requirements and regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for Editorial roles.

 

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help.

*LI-RS1

job.description:

ROLE OVERVIEW

  • The Senior Executive – Integrated Communications (PR & Social) is responsible for supporting the day-to-day execution of integrated communications campaigns, ensuring high-quality delivery across PR, social media, influencer engagement, and digital communications. The role requires strong execution capabilities, proactive project coordination, and the ability to independently manage assigned tasks and workstreams while meeting Edelman Standards and client expectations.
  • S/he demonstrates a solid understanding of integrated Communications Marketing principles, with hands-on experience in media relations, content development, social media communications, influencer engagement, and online community activation. S/he is able to adapt key messages and communications content across different channels to ensure consistency and relevance to target audiences.
  • This role requires the ability to translate communications plans into effective execution, proactively identify opportunities and challenges, and collaborate closely with clients, internal teams, and external partners to deliver impactful integrated communications activities that support client objectives.

RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Integrated Communications Execution

  • Demonstrates a solid understanding of integrated Communications Marketing principles and how PR, social media, influencer engagement, and digital communications work together to achieve client objectives.
  • Supports the implementation of integrated communications plans, translating approved strategies and directions into actionable activities across relevant channels.
  • Coordinates the execution of communications activities across PR and social channels, ensuring consistent messaging, quality, and timely delivery.
  • Contributes ideas, relevant trends, and tactical recommendations to enhance campaign execution and audience engagement.
  • Proactively identifies execution challenges and opportunities, recommending practical solutions to the account team.

2. PR & Media Relations

  • Executes day-to-day PR activities, including media outreach, press release distribution, media pitching, interviews, press events, and other earned media initiatives.
  • Develops, edits, and proofreads high-quality PR materials, including press releases, media pitches, key messages, briefing documents, and feature stories.
  • Builds and maintains working relationships with journalists, editors, publishers, and relevant media contacts.
  • Identifies relevant media angles and opportunities to secure earned media coverage aligned with approved communications objectives.
  • Coordinates media engagement activities, including interviews, press conferences, media events, and other outreach programs.
  • Monitors media coverage and supports the evaluation of PR activities, identifying key highlights and areas for improvement.

3. Social Media & Influencer Communications

  • Executes social communications activities in line with approved campaign directions, ensuring content relevance, consistency, and alignment with brand objectives.
  • Develops social content angles, editorial calendars, content briefs, captions, and other channel-appropriate communications materials.
  • Demonstrates a good understanding of social media platforms, audience behaviors, content formats, and emerging trends within the Vietnamese digital landscape.
  • Coordinates influencer/KOL/KOC and online community engagement activities, including influencer research, selection recommendations, briefing, content review, and execution follow-up.
  • Works closely with creative, content, digital, and external production teams to ensure the quality and timely delivery of social communications materials.
  • Monitors social conversations, content performance, and audience engagement to identify relevant insights and tactical optimization opportunities.

4. Account & Project Management

  • Independently manages assigned tasks and workstreams, ensuring timely delivery, attention to detail, and adherence to client requirements and Edelman Standards.
  • Supports day-to-day client communications, including status updates, meeting notes, activity reports, and follow-ups on assigned deliverables.
  • Coordinates effectively with internal teams, media, influencers, vendors, and external partners to ensure smooth campaign execution.
  • Maintains project timelines, tracks deliverables, and proactively flags potential risks or issues to the account manager.
  • Supports the preparation of client presentations, campaign proposals, status reports, and other account-related materials.
  • Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and a solution-oriented approach in managing daily responsibilities.

5. Research, Monitoring & Reporting

  • Conducts desk research on industry developments, competitors, consumer trends, media landscapes, and social conversations to support communications activities.
  • Monitors media coverage, social conversations, and campaign performance across relevant channels.
  • Collects, consolidates, and analyzes campaign results using relevant PR and social performance metrics.
  • Prepares activity reports and post-campaign reports with accurate data, key observations, and actionable learnings.
  • Identifies relevant insights and provides recommendations to improve ongoing campaign execution.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in communications, Public Relations, Marketing, Journalism, or a related field.
  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in PR, social media, or integrated communications, including a minimum of 1 year in a Senior Executive or equivalent role.
  • Previous experience in PR, communications, digital, or integrated marketing agency is an advantage.
  • Hands-on experience in both PR and social communications, with the ability to independently execute activities across media relations, social media, influencer engagement, and online community activation.
  • Solid understanding of the Vietnamese media landscape, social media ecosystem, influencer landscape, and evolving digital communications trends.
  • Strong writing, editing, and storytelling skills, with the ability to develop compelling, channel-appropriate content for both PR and social media platforms.
  • Experience working with journalists, publishers, influencers, content creators, and online communities, with the ability to build and maintain effective working relationships.
  • Good understanding of integrated communications execution, including media outreach, social content development, influencer coordination, and campaign performance measurement.
  • Strong project coordination and organizational skills, with the ability to independently manage assigned workstreams, prioritize tasks, and meet multiple deadlines.
  • Good research and analytical skills, with the ability to identify relevant insights, monitor campaign performance, and recommend tactical improvements.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with clients, internal teams, and external partners.
  • Excellent Vietnamese writing and editing skills, with good working proficiency in English.
  • A proactive, detail-oriented, collaborative, and solution-oriented mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

By investing heavily in specialty areas – and by focusing on collaboration, agency position, innovation, and establishing a culture of creativity – Edelman is well-positioned to continue to deliver best-in-class work to our clients in today’s complex media landscape.


Edelman has an exciting opportunity for a Vice President, Creator Marketing to join our team in Los Angeles. This role requires a strategic, collaborative and highly organized leader who can oversee complex creator marketing engagements, serve as a trusted advisor to senior clients, and drive excellence across strategy, execution, operations and team development.


The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in creator marketing, social media and the evolving creator economy, with a demonstrated ability to translate cultural trends, platform developments and audience insights into impactful brand strategies. They are equally comfortable shaping big-picture recommendations, navigating complex client and internal stakeholder relationships, and providing hands-on leadership when needed.


This individual will partner closely with senior practice leadership to drive business growth, strengthen operational effectiveness, develop high-performing teams and deliver best-in-class creator marketing programs within a highly integrated, matrixed agency environment.

  • Strategic Leadership & Creator Expertise
    • Lead the development of innovative, insight-driven creator marketing strategies that align with client business objectives, audience behaviors, and the evolving social and cultural landscape.
    • Serve as a senior subject matter expert across creator marketing, social platforms and the broader creator economy, proactively bringing informed POVs, emerging trends and strategic recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders.
    • Advise clients on creator partnerships of varying scopes and complexities, identifying opportunities to elevate creative thinking, drive innovation and deliver measurable business impact.

    • Establish and maintain trusted relationships with senior-level clients, serving as a strategic advisor and independently leading complex conversations, presentations and decision-making.

    • Oversee the operational and financial health of creator marketing engagements, including resource planning, scope management, budgets, profitability and overall delivery excellence.
    • Establish and uphold processes, standards and best practices that drive efficiency, accountability and consistency across creator marketing programs.
    • Proactively identify business and operational risks, anticipate downstream implications, and implement solutions to ensure teams are positioned for success.

  • Experience independently managing senior-level client relationships, leading strategic conversations and navigating complex stakeholder dynamics.

  • Ability to work a hybrid schedule (3x a week) in the Los Angeles office, with ability to travel to clients as needed.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience managing managers and developing emerging leaders, including succession planning and building high-performing teams.
  • Strong understanding of agency business operations, including financial forecasting, profitability, staffing models and commercial decision-making.

We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging. Consistent with this approach, we hire the best qualified candidates for all positions.

Are you curious by nature? Do you always seek to understand human behaviors in your everyday life? Do you believe strategic communications can help make the world a better place? Do you think the world of research needs to change and adapt to a more complex and ever-evolving world? Do you have an entrepreneurial mindset and want to shape a consulting division? If so, Edelman Intelligence is looking for you to join our team! 


Edelman is seeking an Associate Director of Analytics to join our expanding team. We are seeking an analytics leader who is passionate about learning, problem-solving, and leveraging data to re-define how businesses and brands interact with their customers. This role will oversee a team of analysts and work directly with internal and external stakeholders to define, build, and execute multi-channel measurement strategies for brand and acquisition programs for global clients. The ideal candidate should have experience in a cross-functional, collaborative client-facing environment and bring a balance of a left-brained analytical fact-finding, paired with right-brained intuition and storytelling to service Edelman’s top clients.


Responsibilities:

  • Own the development of measurement frameworks, learning agendas, and data integration across multiple workstreams for global clients.
  • Contextualize and apply data to generate a holistic view of the consumer and inform the development of programs, content, and experiences.
  • Apply knowledge of the client and the digital analytics craft to evaluate new data opportunities in the form of new sources, methodologies, technology partnership, client priorities, etc.
  • Foster creative thinking around how to use data and how data can solve business challenges in support of marketing and communication activities
  • Collaborate with cross-discipline leads in Creative, Channel Strategy, Planning, Paid Media, and Business Intelligence to guide decision-making with technical and non-technical groups.
  • Provide day-to-day management and mentorship to a team of analysts on both short and long-term projects.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in marketing analytics, or a related field.
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working with integrated marketing and comms tactics (earned, owned, influencer, paid) and developing insights, ideally in a fast-paced client services environment.
  • Possess a bachelor or graduate degree from an accredited post-secondary institution.
  • Experienced marketing analytics leader with experience onboarding, and developing talent ideally within an advertising agency, consulting, or other client-services environment.
  • Expertise in cross-channel performance analytics with technical knowledge of web analytics, organic social analytics, influencer marketing and paid analytics.
  • An excellent storyteller and data visualizer with experience in Tableau, CreatorIQ, Brandwatch, Sprinklr/Sprout, Supermetrics, etc. preferred.
  • High level understanding of AI landscape with how to apply AI solutions to workstreams being a plus.
  • Ability to simultaneously manage multiple deliverables with various stakeholders
  • Prospers in a dynamic & fast-paced environment.
  • Strong team player who naturally possesses selfless, amicable, and supportive personal characteristics.
  • A graduate degree from an accredited post-secondary institution highly preferred

job.description:

Great brands don't just follow culture. They help shape it.

If you're passionate about beauty, wellness, culture, and the power of earned media, this is an opportunity to bring compelling stories and creative brand experiences to life.

Basic Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in beauty, wellness, consumer, or lifestyle PR, with an understanding of industry trends, media landscapes, and brand storytelling.

job.description:
We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging. Consistent with this approach, we hire the best qualified candidates for all positions.

About Us 

At Edelman Health, we believe Health is everyone’s business. Our goal is to help our clients confidently rise to the challenges of our changing world. We believe Health is beyond purely physician – rather, it’s everything from self-care to prevention, diagnosis to caregiving to finding cures. We challenge our colleagues and clients alike to embrace the new demands of a wider set of stakeholders and to act boldly to earn and keep their Trust.


Overview 

We are seeking a highly motivated Health Senior Account Supervisor to lead client relationships, drive strategic communications initiatives, and oversee project execution. This role requires a strong understanding of the healthcare landscape, the ability to develop and execute integrated communications plans, and expertise in account management. The ideal candidate has excellent leadership skills and is comfortable providing strategic counsel to both clients and internal teams.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the development of integrated communications strategies, ensuring alignment with client goals and the evolving healthcare environment. 
  • Anticipate client needs and identify opportunities for growth, offering innovative solutions and strategic counsel. 
  • Lead cross-functional teams to execute client programs, working closely with creative, media, and digital teams. 
  • Establish and maintain strong client relationships, serving as the day-to-day contact and strategic lead. 
  • Manage account budgets, ensuring financial efficiency and identifying opportunities for increased profitability. 
  • Identify and contribute to new business opportunities, supporting proposals and pitches when needed. 
  • Mentor and coach junior team members, providing guidance to help them grow professionally. 
  • Provide strategic oversight on team deliverables, ensuring quality and alignment with client expectations. 
  • Connection is central to how we support each other and advise clients. Being together in the workplace strengthens our Culture, Community, and Collaboration. Show your commitment to our shared values by actively contributing to a strong, inclusive culture in all interactions. 
  • Embrace and engage with Edelman’s local market communities—they’re a core part of the Edelman experience. Active participation is expected of all colleagues and adds to the richness of the unique Edelman culture. 
  • Model collaborative behavior that encourages teams to build relationships beyond their immediate group, engaging individuals and teams across our network. Our strength lies in uniting diverse expertise—crisis and creative, public affairs and brand—to share insights, ideas, and learnings across practices. This begins with cultivating strong connections across skillsets, perspectives, and levels. 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience 
  • 6+ years of health communications experience (agency or in-house preferred).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Deep understanding of the healthcare landscape, including regulatory considerations, industry trends, and key stakeholders. 
  • Strong strategic thinking skills with the ability to provide high-level counsel to clients. 
  • Experience leading integrated communications campaigns across earned, owned, and paid channels.

As part of Edelman's Associate Practice, you'll gain hands-on client experience, collaborate with talented colleagues across disciplines, and build the skills needed to grow your career in healthcare communications. If you're curious, detail-oriented, and excited about building your career in healthcare communications, we'd love to hear from you.

You're an organized, proactive communications professional who enjoys keeping projects moving and collaborating with others. You take pride in delivering accurate, high-quality work, managing multiple priorities, and anticipating what your team needs next.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in healthcare or pharmaceutical communications, particularly supporting branded pharmaceutical products or campaigns.
  • Familiarity with medical, legal, and regulatory (MLR) review processes, pharmaceutical content approvals, or regulated communications environments.
  • Strong organizational and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing meeting recaps, client updates, and presentations.

We're looking for an Account Supervisor to join our growing U.S. Health team, supporting one of the most recognized names in healthcare and retail.

From earned media campaigns and product storytelling to influencer engagement and experiential activations, you'll help shape how consumers discover and connect with products that are part of their everyday lives.


Whether your background is in consumer PR, retail, consumer packaged goods (CPG), or healthcare communications, we're interested in the perspective and experience you bring.


If you're someone who takes ownership, thrives on collaboration, and is always thinking a few steps ahead, we'd love to meet you.

You're a proactive, detail-oriented communications professional who knows how to keep projects moving, clients informed, and teams aligned.


You bring curiosity, sound judgment, and a solutions-oriented mindset to everything you do. You enjoy working across different teams, can manage competing priorities without losing sight of the details, and take pride in delivering thoughtful, high-quality work.

  • Drive consumer-focused communications campaigns, supporting earned media, product storytelling, influencer engagement, and integrated PR initiatives.

  • Bring fresh ideas and strategic thinking, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and helping clients connect with consumers in relevant and meaningful ways.

job.title: Account Director, Technology - Burson
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

The stakes in tech storytelling today are higher than ever. Gone are the days of technology simply “saving the world.” The double-edged sword of today’s technologies creates as much reputational risk as opportunity across diverse stakeholder groups.

Want to be on the front lines, shaping the narrative around the innovations and products changing the way people live, work, connect and experience the world?

With nearly a century of behavioral science and state-of-the-art AI helping us understand the changing dynamics of reputation, Burson partners with many of the world’s leading technology companies to develop communications strategies and stories that resonate, inspire and drive real impact. We’re not just about press releases and blogs. We help companies introduce breakthrough products, navigate complex issues and build reputations that stand the test of time.

If you’re obsessed with all things tech, love solving complex communications challenges and want to be part of a growing and collaborative team, Burson’s US Technology practice is the place for you.

As an Account Director on our growing US Technology team, you’ll play a leadership role in developing and delivering integrated communications strategies for leading technology and consumer brands. You’ll serve as a trusted client counselor, lead significant account workstreams, translate complex technologies into compelling stories and guide multidisciplinary teams from strategy through execution.

An initial area of focus will be supporting the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service, providing strategic communications leadership across its product and technology portfolio. You’ll help shape communications around new products, features and innovations, including advancements in AI and personalization, and develop integrated launch strategies encompassing earned media, social, influencer, owned and internal channels.

You’ll work closely with stakeholders across product, marketing, trust and safety, legal and communications, helping teams anticipate opportunities and reputational considerations while bringing complex technology stories to life for consumers.

This is an opportunity for a seasoned communications professional who combines consumer technology expertise, strategic and creative thinking, strong media instincts and confident client counsel with the curiosity and agility required to navigate fast-moving technology and product environments.

What you'll do:

  • Serve as a strategic counselor to clients, building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and providing thoughtful communications counsel across product, corporate reputation and integrated communications priorities.
  • Lead significant client relationships and account workstreams, setting priorities, anticipating needs and ensuring teams consistently deliver strategic, creative and high-quality work.
  • Develop and lead integrated communications strategies for technology products, features and innovations, including major product launches, media relations, reputation programs and executive thought leadership.
  • Translate complex technologies into compelling narratives, helping clients explain sophisticated products, including AI-powered and personalized experiences, in ways that resonate with consumers, media and broader stakeholder audiences.
  • Lead product and feature launch communications, guiding strategy from early planning and positioning through launch and post-launch storytelling.
  • Bring a 360-degree communications mindset, ensuring strategies consider earned media, social, influencer, owned, internal and paid channels and bringing together the right specialists to deliver integrated programs.
  • Provide strategic media counsel, developing compelling storylines, overseeing proactive media strategies and maintaining strong relationships with influential technology, business and consumer journalists.
  • Counsel clients on emerging technology and reputational considerations, identifying potential risks or stakeholder concerns and helping teams determine when and how issues should be addressed or escalated.
  • Lead cross-functional planning, partnering effectively with product, marketing, social and influencer, trust and safety, legal, analytics, creative and communications stakeholders to build cohesive strategies.
  • Turn trends and insights into strategic opportunities, using an understanding of technology, media, culture and consumer behavior to help clients anticipate conversations rather than simply react to them.
  • Set the strategic direction and quality standard for client deliverables, providing senior oversight of messaging, media materials, executive content, briefing documents and presentations.
  • Lead client presentations and strategic discussions, confidently articulating recommendations, challenging thinking when appropriate and adapting strategies based on client and stakeholder feedback.
  • Oversee multiple complex workstreams, ensuring teams effectively manage timelines, priorities, budgets and deliverables across fast-moving accounts.
  • Manage and develop junior and mid-level talent, providing coaching, feedback and clear accountability while creating opportunities for team members to grow.
  • Partner with senior account leaders on account health and growth, proactively identifying opportunities to expand existing relationships and introduce new capabilities.
  • Contribute to new business and practice growth, including proposal development, strategic planning, pitch participation and broader initiatives that strengthen Burson’s Technology offering.

Experience that contributes to success:

  • 6–8 years of experience in public relations or strategic communications, with significant experience supporting technology and/or consumer technology clients. Agency experience strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience leading major account workstreams and serving as a trusted client counselor, with the confidence to independently guide client conversations and strategic recommendations.
  • Strong experience developing and leading integrated communications programs for consumer-facing technology products, services, features or launches.
  • Experience across relevant technology sectors such as consumer technology, AI and emerging technologies, digital platforms and services, consumer electronics, gaming, automotive technology or semiconductors.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex technology and product information into clear, compelling and consumer-friendly narratives.
  • Strong experience with product communications and launches, including positioning, messaging, earned media strategy and integrated campaign planning.
  • Deep media relations experience and established relationships with relevant technology, business and consumer journalists, paired with strong news judgment and storytelling instincts.
  • Experience developing integrated, 360-degree communications strategies that extend beyond earned media to social, influencer, owned, internal and paid channels.
  • A strong understanding of AI, personalization and emerging technology trends, including the communications opportunities and potential reputational considerations surrounding these technologies.
  • Experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders such as product, marketing, legal, trust and safety, social, influencer and communications teams.
  • Demonstrated experience with issues and reputation management, including the judgment to recognize emerging risks, counsel clients appropriately and determine when concerns should be escalated.
  • Strong strategic and creative problem-solving abilities, with the ability to move fluidly between big-picture strategy and the details required for excellent execution.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of developing compelling narratives and delivering persuasive presentations to senior audiences.
  • Excellent organizational and project leadership skills, with the ability to oversee multiple complex workstreams, teams and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Proven ability to manage, mentor and develop junior and mid-level team members, delegate effectively and maintain accountability for the overall quality of account work.
  • Experience contributing to account growth or new business, including identifying opportunities, developing scopes or proposals and participating in pitches.
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and the confidence to form a point of view, make recommendations and challenge thinking constructively.
  • A genuine passion for technology and curiosity about the platforms, products, innovations and cultural trends shaping how people live and communicate.

#LI-FB1

Burson is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. 

Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package; click here for more details: https://mybenefits.wpp.com/public/welcome.

You belong at Burson:

Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent.
