job.title: Account Manager
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a Account Manager to join our growing team!

 

As an Account Manager, you will act as the key day-to-day client contact, managing relationships and taking responsibility for the delivery of several medium-sized projects. As a captain, you will be responsible for managing the execution of parallel ongoing projects and take an active role in coaching your junior team and ensuring projects are delivered effectively alongside the account lead.

 

 

What you’ll do:

Client delivery

  • Act as day-to-day client contact: provide regular status updates to your client; respond to client queries and share recommendations (following discussion with your account lead); manage client expectations on timelines, scope of project, etc.; take client briefs and clearly communicate to team members, implementing realistic project plans
  • Take responsibility for the day-to-day management of your account, including managing the processes of the account (including running regular internal team meetings), flow of work (review content developed by more junior team members), delegation of tasks (oversee status reports to ensure all team actions are complete) and the status of jobs across the account (not just your own)
  • Ownership of and accountability for medium-sized client projects, ensuring that projects are delivered to highest possible standards within budget and agreed timeframes
  • Actively demonstrate an understanding of your clients’ needs (building an awareness of their strategy and brand) and preferences in your interactions and the delivery of work
  • Confidently develop written content (briefing documents, etc) and gain experience reviewing junior team members’ work, ensuring content is accurate and developed to a high standard ahead of more senior review

 

Business development

  • Start to identify areas for growth (evolving existing programmes and/or additional tactics), proactively sharing new ideas with your team and client
  • Take an active role in new business, which may include undertaking and presenting research to the pitch team, or facilitating team input via brainstorms/presenting as part of the pitch team

 

Team management

  • Maintain an awareness of the professional development of more junior team members on your accounts, through regular catch ups and interactions
  • Develop your coaching, delegation and briefing (both internally and externally with suppliers) skills, and lead by example; use these approaches to upskill, develop and inspire more junior team members
  • Buddy new SAA/AM starters

 

Financial management

  • Develop a greater understanding of the account finances beyond your projects, proactively supporting your account lead with financial management including managing Salesforce opportunities, invoicing and forecasting
  • Develop accurate budgets for clients, reflecting on previous projects and gathering cost quotes
  • Manage the budget for projects that you own, feeding into your account lead as part of the broader programme finances; identify where project is going out of scope and alert your account lead with details of additional budget required
  • Input into the resourcing process by sharing with your account/medical writer lead the requirements for your projects
  • Complete your timesheets and expense claims accurately and on time and take an active role in reviewing timesheets across some of your projects

 

Agency environment

  • Participate in internal initiatives which contribute to the culture or development of the Medical Communications team, or Real Chemistry more broadly (e.g., compliance/socials/inspiration)
  • Immerse yourself in the medical communications and pharma industries, and your client companies and therapy areas: engage with every opportunity to establish an awareness of developments, innovations and trends. Look for opportunities to reflect these in your work and flag your ideas to your teams and wider team to raise your internal profile

 

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • ​Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

 

 

What you should have:

  • Relevant degree in a scientific subject
  • Highly organised with a mindfulness of deadlines, the ability to manage multiple tasks based on priorities and a strong attention to detail
  • Independent thinker confident in taking ownership of assets and material development, but a team player who enjoys collaboration
  • Ability to mentor junior staff and delegate accordingly in order to achieve project deadlines
  • Has confidence to manage upward when required; able to communicate with managers when deadlines will not be met or when issues are foreseeable
  • Demonstrated strong work ethic, with a track record of following through on client requests and with high-quality deliverables on schedule and on budget
  • Ability to develop project scopes and vendor contracts
  • Excellent business communication ability, including informal/formal presentation and writing skills
  • High energy, able to effectively operate in fast-paced, growing and evolving environment

 

Real Chemistry is proud to be Great Place to Work® certified; check out what our people shared about our culture and workplace on our Great Places to Work Profile here.

We believe we can do our best when feeling our best, which is why we’ve put together a benefits program designed to give you the support you and your family need at every stage of life. Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefit program and perks, tailored to your region. Globally, this includes offices in our key markets with free snacks to keep you running all day long, generous holiday and paid time off, options for private medical, dental, and vison plans, and support in saving for the future. Other perks include mental wellness coaching and support and access to more than 13,000 online classes with LinkedIn Learning.  Learn more about our great benefits and perks and search specific offerings in your region at: www.realchemistrybenefits.com.

At Real Chemistry, we believe we're at our best when we're connected. Our Real Hybrid and Regional Teams (Real HART) approach is designed to foster collaboration, learning, innovation, and meaningful relationships while providing flexibility where appropriate. Because our workforce spans multiple countries, regions, and client needs, work arrangements may vary by role and location. Some positions offer hybrid or remote flexibility, while others require regular in-office presence. For example, certain teams and regions, including some of our UK operations, have office-based requirements. Your recruiter will discuss the specific expectations for the role you're pursuing during the interview process and keep you informed throughout the hiring journey. For employees located within a one-hour commute of a Real Chemistry office, we require in-person attendance two days per week, either from a Real Chemistry office or when working onsite with clients. Employees in regions without a nearby office may work remotely and come together throughout the year for collaboration, culture-building, learning, and team connection opportunities. While these guidelines reflect our current workplace model, we understand that everyone’s circumstances are unique. If you require additional flexibility, we welcome an open conversation with your recruiter and our HR team to discuss your needs and determine what may be possible.

Real Chemistry is an Equal Opportunity employer. We continually strive to build and sustain an inclusive and equitable work environment where our employees feel empowered to leverage all they bring from their personal lived experience and professional expertise, to make our team the best in the industry. We encourage motivated and qualified applicants to apply without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, ethnic or national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, marital information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local employment discrimination laws where Real Chemistry operates. Should you require accommodations throughout the interview process please let your recruiter know.

Do not share personal or financial information or make payments to any unverified sources claiming to be connected to Real Chemistry. We are working to stop these unauthorized activities and protect our community. Read more here.

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

Title: Lead Software Engineer

Level: Lead Engineer, Data & Technology Solutions

Location: Copenhagen

Reporting to: Director of Engineering

About Open Intelligence:

We are the Activation arm of WPP Open Intelligence. Our team builds the foundational data infrastructure and high-performance edge services that power WPP’s position in the market. With approximately one-third of all global media spend flowing through WPP, our platform operates at the core of this massive network-deeply integrated and adopted by the largest supply-side partners in the AdTech industry. Operating at our scale presents unique engineering challenges. Our edge services currently handle over 60,000 classification requests per second, while our contextual classification pipelines process 10,000 requests per second. With operations spanning the US, UK, and ongoing expansion into EMEA and APAC, our infrastructure continuously interacts with up to 98% of the population in our active markets. We are an engineering-led team focused on building robust, scalable, and highly reliable systems.

 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a Lead Software Engineer who thrives on owning backend systems end to end — architecture, delivery, and the people who build them. You care more about sound software design, reliable APIs, and clear ownership than about any single framework or language.

You are comfortable setting technical direction for a squad, mentoring engineers, and turning product roadmap into shippable, versioned contracts. Hands-on when it matters, you design and operate services, partner integrations, and orchestration components in production — authentication, retries, idempotency, rate limiting, and the operational discipline that keeps live systems healthy. You are likely highly proficient in a backend language such as Python, Go, or Java/Kotlin, and experienced with cloud platforms, containers/Kubernetes, CI/CD, and production observability. Interest in infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform), durable workflows, and AI coding assistants is a plus when it helps the team ship faster without lowering the quality bar.

Beyond the technical craft, you are a strong communicator who can explain trade-offs to engineers, Product, and non-technical stakeholders, and align sibling teams on interfaces. You take ownership of reliability and technical debt for the systems your squad runs, escalate blockers early with clear options, and are motivated by growing both the platform and the engineers who build it.

 

WHY ARE WE HIRING We are at a critical inflection point in our growth and need to scale our engineering team to tackle an expanding set of complex challenges. As the digital ecosystem evolves, we are actively developing and releasing a new catalog of privacy-preserving data products. These solutions are designed to scale advanced targeting capabilities while remaining uncompromising on our promise to protect user privacy.

To support this product evolution, our infrastructure is undergoing massive global expansion. By the end of this year, we will be fully operational across the rest of the EMEA and APAC regions. Concurrently, we are deepening our integrations to support even more of the largest supply-side partners in the AdTech industry. We are hiring because we need strong engineering talent to help us architect for this next order of magnitude in scale-ensuring our systems remain resilient, performant, and compliant as our global footprint and feature set rapidly expand.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

· Lead an engineering squad: set technical direction, prioritize delivery, run design and code reviews, and grow engineers through mentoring and clear ownership.

· Own the architecture and health of activation and orchestration services — API, databases, partner gateways, internal integrations, MCP and agentic integrations.

· Partner with Product and sibling teams to turn roadmap phases into shippable, versioned contracts — not ad hoc

integrations.

· Drive API integration engineering: authentication, rate limiting, idempotency, retries, partial-update patterns, and runbooks as partner APIs evolve.

· Establish and uphold production standards — CI/CD, testing, observability, auditability, and safe release practices.

· Keep an end-to-end overview of how data flow through activation — what is live, what is in progress, and where dependencies or technical debt block the next phase.

· Contribute hands-on where it matters: critical paths, new gateways, framework foundations (e.g. tool registry, workflow runtime, guardrails hooks).

· Identify and address technical debt deliberately; balance speed with reliability for systems that support live campaigns.

· Share knowledge in design reviews, stand-ups, and cross-team forums; escalate blockers early with clear options.

· Stay curious about agentic orchestration, durable workflows, and AI coding assistants to improve how the team designs and ships software.

 

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

· Strong communication — you explain trade-offs to engineers, product, and non-technical stakeholders and align multiple teams on interfaces.

· 6+ years in software engineering with 2+ years leading engineers or owning a significant technical area (team lead, staff, or equivalent).

· Proven delivery of backend and API-centric systems in production — services, integrations, or platforms at meaningful scale.

· Solid experience building and operating REST/HTTP APIs and event- or workflow-driven systems (durable state, async jobs, or orchestration).

· Comfort owning third-party integrations — auth, errors, versioning, operational monitoring, and partner-driven change.

· Strong proficiency in at least one backend language (e.g. Python, Go, or Java/Kotlin) and sound software design (patterns, testing, code review).

· Experience with CI/CD, Git, and testing — unit, integration, and boundary/contract tests where APIs matter.

· Experience with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and deploying services with containers and Kubernetes.

· Familiarity with infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform) and production observability (metrics, logs, tracing).

· A track record of technical debt and reliability ownership — incidents, postmortems, and systemic fixes, not one-off firefighting.

· Interest in leveraging AI coding assistants and prompt engineering to improve team productivity without lowering the production bar.

 

NICE TO HAVE

· Experience leading delivery of orchestration, workflow, or agentic systems (tool registries, policy/guardrails, human-in-the-loop flows).

· Full-stack exposure — internal UIs or ops tools (e.g. change logs, escalations) backed by the same APIs you own.

· Familiarity with AdTech / MarTech — SSPs, DSPs, deals, audiences, or campaign activation terminology.

· Experience in a monorepo or large shared codebase with many integration surfaces.

· Awareness of data privacy and safe handling of sensitive data in distributed deployments.

· Prior work on audit trails or decision logs for high-trust or automated systems.

About WPP Open: 

WPP Open is at the forefront of transforming how WPP delivers value to its clients. We are building a unified product ecosystem that empowers our agencies and clients with cutting-edge tools and data-driven insights. Our product organisation is driven by a clear vision, strategic execution, and a commitment to continuous innovation.

The Opportunity: 

We are seeking a highly autonomous and results-driven Senior Product Owner to join our WPP Open product team. In this pivotal role, you will be instrumental in driving the execution and optimisation of a critical, often specialised, product capability.

You will translate defined product strategies into meticulously prioritised and actionable backlogs, proactively guide complex feature sets through the development lifecycle, and ensure the delivery of measurable, high-impact product outcomes.

You will work closely with Product leadership, engineering teams, and various stakeholders to deliver value that directly contributes to WPP Open's success. This role requires deep domain expertise, a strong understanding of agile methodologies, exceptional communication skills, and a relentless focus on delivering value to users and the business.

What you'll do:

Complex Product Backlog Ownership & Execution Leadership:

  • Own and manage complex or high-impact product backlogs for your designated, often specialised, product capability. Ensure these backlogs are meticulously prioritised, well-defined, and directly support the overarching product strategy and roadmap defined by the Product Lead.
  • Drive the execution of the product roadmap for your capability, translating strategic objectives into actionable epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and ensuring timely delivery of high-quality solutions.
  • Focus on defining clear, measurable outcomes for each initiative and feature, and track progress against these metrics, providing regular updates to the Product Lead.

 Proactive Requirement Definition & Refinement:

  • Translate defined product strategy and user needs into clear, concise, and actionable epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria that lead to clear, testable outcomes.
  • Proactively engage with engineering and design to refine requirements, identify technical dependencies, and ensure feasibility and optimal implementation for complex features.
  • Act as the primary source of truth for the development team regarding product requirements and user needs for your specialised capability.

 Cross-functional Orchestration & Collaboration:

  • Act as the central orchestrator within your agile development team, working closely with engineering teams, UX/UI designers, and other product stakeholders throughout the entire product development lifecycle, from concept to release.
  • Drive alignment and resolve impediments within the development team to ensure smooth and efficient delivery of complex features.
  • Facilitate agile ceremonies (e.g., sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews) to ensure effective team collaboration and progress.

Strategic Stakeholder Engagement & Communication:

  • Proactively engage with relevant stakeholders, including Product leads, engineering leads, and end-users, to gather feedback, clarify requirements, and ensure strong alignment for your product capability.
  • Communicate product progress, plans, and insights to your Product leads and relevant stakeholders, ensuring clarity in complex discussions with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Articulate the "why" behind product decisions at the feature level and the measurable impact of delivered features.

Continuous Improvement & Optimisation:

  • Establish and manage robust mechanisms for gathering user feedback, analysing product performance data, and identifying areas for continuous improvement within your product capability.
  • Translate insights from market performance, user feedback, and data analytics directly back into the product backlog and inform the Product Leads of potential strategic adjustments.
  • Champion continuous optimisation of features post-launch, ensuring they meet user needs and business objectives.

  • Act as a subject matter expert and informal mentor to less experienced Product Owners or Product Analysts, sharing best practices and contributing to their professional development and the overall product team's capabilities.

  • Analyse and resolve complex product-related problems within your capability, collaborating with the Product Lead and engineering to find efficient and effective solutions.
  • Demonstrate strong prioritisation and decision-making skills for your product backlog, especially under ambiguity, to ensure the most valuable features are delivered and the product area's strategic goals are met.

  • Actively contribute insights and data from your product capability to inform the Product Lead's strategic direction and the overall WPP Open product vision and roadmap.
  • Ensure your product area's backlog consistently aligns with the defined product strategy and broader strategic themes and business objectives.

For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Role summary:

The Solution Consultant is a trusted advisor and hands-on solution partner within Professional Services. The role combines solution consulting, business and product analysis, technical understanding, stakeholder management, project management, and disciplined delivery thinking.

Working across agency and client teams, Product, Engineering, Growth, Enablement, Training, Support and delivery colleagues, the consultant discovers needs, shapes requirements, designs and demonstrates solutions, supports scoping and implementation, and feeds learning back into reusable patterns and product improvements.

Success means clients and WPP teams understand what is possible, requirements are clear before delivery starts, proven capabilities are configured appropriately, hand-offs are clean, and repeatable solutions can be deployed with less friction and faster time to value.

Key responsibilities:

Discovery & requirements:

  • Lead structured discovery with agency, client and internal stakeholders to understand objectives, users, workflows, data, constraints and expected outcomes.
  • Analyse current-state processes, usage and needs, separating problems to solve from requested features.
  • Translate needs into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, solution specifications and, where required, scope inputs for statements of work.
  • Identify dependencies, assumptions, risks and gaps early, and ensure the right Product, Engineering, Enterprise Solutions or Professional Services owners are engaged.

Solution design & consulting:

  • Map business needs to proven, ready-to-deploy WPP Open capabilities and recommend an appropriate foundation or configured solution.
  • Design and present solution options that explain the value, trade-offs, dependencies and delivery implications in language suited to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Create and deliver demonstrations that show how selected WPP Open capabilities address the defined use case.
  • Support business-case and value-realisation thinking by linking the proposed solution to measurable client or operational outcomes.

Technical & platform expertise:

  • Build and maintain strong knowledge of WPP Open architecture, capabilities, agents, configuration options, data and integration touchpoints.
  • Stay current on platform releases, capabilities and deployment guidance, and distinguish proven, scalable capabilities from functionality still in development or testing.

Delivery partnership & quality:

  • Partner with Project Managers, Product Analysts, Deployment Specialists, Configuration Admins and implementation teams from scope through go-live and handover.
  • Ensure solution intent, requirements and acceptance criteria remain traceable through configuration, testing and delivery.
  • Support UAT, solution validation and issue resolution, escalating material scope, quality or dependency risks through the appropriate delivery route.
  • Contribute to clear handovers into Enablement, Training or Support where those teams own the next stage of adoption.

Project management & delivery coordination:

  • Develop and maintain clear delivery plans that define milestones, dependencies, ownership, decision points and critical path activities for assigned engagements.
  • Coordinate day-to-day project activity across stakeholders, ensuring actions are tracked, blockers are surfaced early and progress remains visible to the right delivery and leadership audiences.
  • Maintain disciplined RAID management, including proactive identification of risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies, with clear mitigation plans and escalation routes.
  • Support governance routines such as status reporting, checkpoint reviews, decision logs and delivery readiness assessments, ensuring stakeholders have confidence in progress and next steps.
  • Balance speed, scope and quality by making delivery trade-offs explicit, aligning expectations early and ensuring changes are assessed for impact before commitments are made.
  • Drive clean closure by confirming acceptance criteria, documenting outcomes, capturing lessons learned and ensuring handover routes are agreed before the engagement is considered complete.

Scale, product feedback & continuous improvement:

  • Convert lessons from engagements into reusable solution patterns, templates, playbooks and configuration standards.
  • Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering on recurring client needs, friction, feature gaps and opportunities for improvement.
  • Help standardise intake and scoping so requests arrive with the information needed to route and estimate work accurately.
  • Use delivery and usage evidence to identify opportunities to improve solution quality, reduce avoidable effort and accelerate time to value.

Stakeholder relationships:

  • Act as a credible, pragmatic bridge between business, product and technology stakeholders.
  • Build trust through transparent recommendations, clear documentation, realistic commitments and proactive communication.
  • Work collaboratively across WPP, maintaining client-team ownership of client relationships while providing the expertise needed to make good solution decisions.
Skills & experience:
  • 5+ years of experience in solutions consulting, business analysis, product analysis, implementation consulting or a comparable role, ideally within marketing technology or professional services.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with experience turning ambiguous business needs into structured, actionable requirements and solution options.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation and facilitation skills, including the ability to translate between technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working across product, engineering, delivery and commercial stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
  • Working knowledge of Agile delivery and backlog practices, including user stories, acceptance criteria and prioritisation.
  • Ability to manage and coordinate the intake of features and change requests, clarifying need, priority, impact and ownership so requests can be translated into actionable outcomes.
  • Understanding of digital marketing technology and related cloud, data, integration and workflow concepts.
  • Experience with platform implementation, configuration, adoption or service design is advantageous.
  • Experience with WPP Open, agent deployment, API integration, data modelling, Jira/Confluence or process-mapping tools
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, make sound trade-offs and maintain high-quality documentation and stakeholder communication.
Working principles:
  • Client value first: recommend capability because it improves an outcome, not simply because it exists.
  • Deliver what is available: favour proven, ready-to-deploy capabilities and be explicit about anything that is not yet scaled.
  • Enable the enablers: design solutions and handovers so administrators, champions and enablement teams can sustain adoption.
  • Client teams stay in control: provide expertise behind the scenes while respecting ownership of client conversations and ongoing relationships.

You are curious, structured and commercially aware, with enough technical depth to be credible with engineers and enough empathy and communication skill to make complexity understandable. You are comfortable challenging unclear requirements, bringing the right people together and turning a good bespoke answer into a better repeatable pattern. Above all, you focus on outcomes: dependable delivery that builds trust, scalable ways of working and faster realisation of value from WPP Open.

job.title: (Senior) Data Engineer – Data Modeling & Core Systems
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

Why We’re Hiring

We are scaling the core engineering capability behind real-time, high-throughput ad-tech infrastructure that processes large-scale audience data at global scale.

This is not a role for basic ETL scripts or glue code. In this role, data engineering is treated as a true software engineering discipline. You will take deep technical ownership of complex, multi-layered data models (canonical schemas, high-dimensional behavioral signals, and vector embeddings) that power live targeting and measurement decisions for advertisers worldwide.

You’ll help evolve a distributed, production-grade data platform while collaborating with a high-trust engineering team that values clean architecture, continuous improvement (kaizen), and modern development standards.

 

Who You’ll Be Working With

You’ll work closely with fellow engineers across backend systems, Quality Assurance, Analytics, and connector teams. We value teamwork over ego, collaboration over competition, open and honest communication, strong opinions held with curiosity, and delivering well-tested, maintainable code.

Our Technology Environment

  • Languages & Core: Scala, functional programming, strongly typed distributed services
  • Processing & Streaming: Apache Spark for large-scale distributed processing, event-driven architectures
  • Cloud & Storage: Google Cloud Platform (GCP), BigQuery, Parquet
  • Engineering Standards: Automated CI/CD, robust unit & integration testing, Git workflows, and Tyda (our open-source, automation-driven SDLC process)

 

What You’ll Do

  • Own and evolve production data models spanning input/output models, schema evolution, field types, and partitioning strategies across multi-stage distributed pipelines.
  • Maintain and extend our audience framework, normalizing high-velocity raw inputs into standardized, canonical formats across behavioral signals, demographics, and brand affinity.
  • Design and manage models handling relational structures, real-time behavioral signals, high-dimensional embeddings, and anomaly detection.
  • Develop and maintain Spark-based data services in Scala and GCP, adhering to software design patterns, modular architecture, and edge-case resilience.
  • Lead by example with automated unit/integration testing, strict code reviews, Git branching discipline, and CI/CD best practices.
  • Partner with QA, Analytics, and downstream product teams to guarantee contract integrity, data correctness, and reliable system consumption.

 

What You’ll Need

  • 3+ years of software engineering or data engineering experience, with a proven track record of shipping production-grade distributed data systems.
  • Production experience writing quality code in Scala OR another statically typed language (Java, Kotlin, C#, Go). If your background is in Java/Kotlin/Go, you are eager and excited to build in a Scala-first environment.
  • Hands-on experience collaborating on large codebases with automated testing (unit/integration testing), version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and structured code reviews.
  • Proven ability to design and reason about complex, multi-layered data architectures (e.g., canonical schemas, dimensional modeling, Data Vault, or domain-driven data design).
  • Solid experience with Apache Spark (or similar distributed frameworks) handling high-volume datasets.
  • Experience with GCP (BigQuery, Cloud Storage) or equivalent cloud data platforms (AWS/Azure).
  • The ability to explain complex data models, schema trade-offs, and technical designs clearly to both technical and product stakeholders.

job.title: Beasley Media Group
job.description:
Thanks for visiting our Career Page. Please review our open positions and apply to the positions that match your qualifications.

Account Executive

Detroit, MI Full Time Mid Level Share Account Executive

Position Summary

As an Account Executive, you will serve as a trusted marketing consultant to local businesses and advertising agencies, helping clients achieve their business goals through innovative advertising and marketing solutions. This role combines prospecting, relationship building, strategic planning, and revenue generation across Beasley Media Group's portfolio of broadcast, digital, streaming, event, and experiential marketing assets.

The ideal candidate is a motivated self-starter with a passion for sales, strong communication skills, and the ability to develop long-term client partnerships while driving new business growth.

Key Qualifications

  • Self-motivated, goal-oriented professional who thrives both independently and in a collaborative team environment.
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and time management abilities with attention to detail.
  • Effective negotiator with a customer-focused, consultative sales approach.
  • Ability to identify client needs, develop strategic recommendations, and deliver impactful marketing solutions.
  • Proficiency with CRM systems and sales pipeline management.
  • Passion for building relationships and creating measurable results for clients.
  • Valid driver's license, proof of insurance, and reliable transportation required.
  • Employment is contingent upon successful completion of an MVR check

Essential Responsibilities

Business Development & Sales

  • Generate new business opportunities through prospecting, networking, referrals, and outreach efforts.
  • Maintain and grow existing account relationships while increasing revenue and market share.
  • Develop integrated marketing solutions utilizing Beasley Media Group's full suite of advertising platforms.
  • Create and deliver compelling sales presentations and marketing proposals to local businesses and advertising agencies.
  • Identify client business challenges and recommend customized advertising and marketing strategies.
  • Secure sponsorships, promotional partnerships, experiential marketing opportunities, and digital advertising campaigns.
  • Consistently achieve or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue goals.

Client Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers, stakeholders, and business owners.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts, ensuring exceptional customer service and responsiveness.
  • Regularly communicate with clients regarding campaign performance, marketing initiatives, sponsorships, and business objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to expand partnerships through upselling and cross-selling solutions.

Strategic Planning & Market Research

  • Prepare thoroughly for all client interactions by researching industries, market conditions, business objectives, and competitive trends.
  • Analyze client needs, target audiences, and historical advertising investment to develop effective recommendations.
  • Stay informed on emerging advertising, media, digital marketing, and consumer behavior trends.
  • Utilize market insights and audience data to enhance client outcomes and sales effectiveness.

Product & Industry Expertise

  • Maintain comprehensive knowledge of Beasley Media Group's products, platforms, pricing, audience insights, and marketing capabilities.
  • Continuously expand expertise in radio, digital advertising, streaming audio, video, events, promotions, and experiential marketing.
  • Understand competitive offerings and effectively position Beasley Media Group's advantages in the marketplace.

Administrative & Reporting Responsibilities

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer records, activity logs, and sales opportunities within the company CRM.
  • Effectively manage schedules, appointments, account plans, and follow-up activities.
  • Provide timely sales forecasts, pipeline updates, and performance reports as requested by management.
  • Document client interactions and strategic account activities to support business growth and customer retention.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Maintain regular communication with leadership regarding sales activity, pipeline development, client opportunities, and business needs.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure successful execution of advertising campaigns and client initiatives.
  • Support client events, promotions, and experiential marketing activities as needed.
  • Contribute positively to a culture of teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently meeting or exceeding revenue goals.
  • Developing strong client relationships that result in long-term partnerships.
  • Generating new business opportunities and expanding existing accounts.
  • Delivering strategic marketing solutions that help clients achieve measurable business results.
  • Serving as a knowledgeable and trusted advisor within the local advertising community.

Beasley Media Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Accounts Payable Specialist/Receptionist.

Naples, FL Full Time Mid Level Share About Beasley Media GroupBeasley Media Group is an innovative media company operating in one of Florida’s most desirable locations. Join our corporate team in beautiful Naples and contribute to the financial and administrative operations of a dynamic, forward-thinking organization.
 Position SummaryWe are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and professional individual to serve as Accounts Payable Specialist/Receptionist. This role is the first point of contact for visitors, clients, and vendors while simultaneously supporting the accounts payable cycle for the corporate finance team.  
 Key ResponsibilitiesFront Desk & Office Operations
  • Serve as the primary point of contact at the front desk, greeting and assisting visitors, clients, and vendors in a professional and welcoming manner.
  • Answer, screen, and direct incoming phone calls and emails; take and relay accurate messages.
  • Manage incoming and outgoing mail and deliveries, including courier coordination.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and professional reception area and common spaces.
  • Coordinate and order meals for executive staff, company meetings, and corporate events.
  • Oversee daily office operations and maintain adequate office supply inventory; coordinate with vendors as needed.

job.title: KSL Digital Content Producer (Full-time)
job.description:
Our company is committed to being trusted voices of light and truth reaching hundreds of millions of people worldwide.

Who We Are

KSL is Utah’s leading local news source across digital and broadcast platforms, delivering trusted, award‑winning journalism through KSL.com, KSL‑TV, and KSL NewsRadio. We provide in‑depth local reporting, investigative journalism, and up‑to‑the‑minute coverage that serves communities across the state. Committed to being a trusted voice of light and knowledge, KSL helps Utahns stay informed, connected, and engaged with the issues that matter most.

Position Overview

The Digital Content Producer leads KSL’s efforts to create content that supports and reinforces on-air shows. The ideal candidate will pioneer approaches for online conversation and community engagement. You will identify and advance conversations generated by KSL; create a culture of collaboration, connecting our station's voice with our most influential listeners; and collaborate with news, programming and promotions. 

Note: Work configurations are subject to change based on business needs and at company discretion.

  • This position is a hybrid role that requires the employee to sometimes work at our Salt Lake City site. Specific hybrid schedules will be determined based on business needs and evaluated by managers and senior management.

What You Will Do:

Primary job duties will include, but are not limited to:

  • Responsible for working in conjunction with News and programming to consistently manage content published on KSL's platforms.
  • Deep understanding of station brand to appropriately publish content
  • Write breaking news stories as needed
  • Communicate clearly with the newsroom team
  • Edit photos, graphics, videos, audio clips and text using appropriate editing tools
  • Optimize story performance using various analytical tools
  • Maintain careful documentation of story day planning and publishing schedules
  • Participate in station's digital marketing efforts, as well as staying on top of trending digital developments
  • Video switching and editing capabilities
  • Create content for use on web/social only platforms
  • Other duties as assigned

Skills and Experience We Are Looking For:

  • College degree in journalism or related field. If no degree, 1-2 years of digital project experience
  • Ability to write clear, conversational and accurate content in AP style
  • Ability to work under pressure and on deadline
  • Ability to work well with others on a team
  • Detail-oriented in reviewing content
  • A passion for the news
  • Prefer experience working in graphic design, using Photoshop, Illustrator and Final Cut Pro
  • Prefer 2+ years successful experience working in social media, with a deep understanding of social media techniques and tools
  • Ability to research and implement new social media practices a significant plus, specifically experience with Facebook and Twitter ads and analytics
  • Flexible personality in order to connect news, programming and promotions
  • Self-motivated, creative individual who can also organize and consistently display good judgement
  • Capable of performing under stress while meeting company deadlines and needs
  • Excellent communication abilities
  • Capable of managing multiple projects in various stages of the project life cycle

Physical Demands

  • Receive, process, and maintain information through oral and/or written communication effectively
  • Substantial physical movements (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers

Compensation

 $18.00 - $22.00 an hour. Hourly rate to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to evaluation of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant along with internal equity and alignment with market data.

What We Offer You: Check Out Our KSL Benefits!

Employees at KSL can enjoy a broad offering of benefits, including:

  • Robust, affordable medical, dental and vision coverage with no wait period for enrollment
  • Paid leave for new parents under our Medical Maternity and Parental Leave policies
  • Opportunities to apply for tuition reimbursement
  • Paid time off for vacation and sick leave in addition to paid company holidays
  • 401(k) with Company match, fully vested from day one
  • Paid time off for volunteering
  • Employer-funded retirement account, fully vested from day one
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) services
  • Access to an entire team of free financial planners
  • Matches on contributions to charitable organizations after one year of service
  • Continuous growth and development opportunities
  • Dynamic team culture that values teamwork, having fun, and collaboration

KSL is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law. Minority/female/disability PWDNET/veteran are encouraged to apply.

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.

 

Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

 

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

 

This is a hybrid position with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

 

Your Role

 

As a part of the Architecture and strategic development, production systems architecture team, you will be mandated to design and plan CBC/Radio-Canada future media infrastructure, with a specific eye toward our media production systems. Working in collaboration with the corporation's different stakeholders, you will help translate the needs and requirements into a robust Strategies.

  

Your judgment, knowledge, experience and analytical skills will help you achieve the following:

  • Plan, develop and design CBC/Radio-Canada media production systems (PAM, MAM, television and radio studios), Define solutions for heterogeneous environments that span across functional, technical, and business domains.
  • Collaborate with the enterprise architects (Software, Media, and information security) in order to align all aspects of our media infrastructure and the business requirements to prepare roadmaps that will influence our strategic investments.
  • Designs and develop innovative solutions, documents technical specifications, with an eye towards simplicity, reliability, manageability, scalability, extensibility, performance and reuse.
  • Play a technology expert consulting and coaching role with the various media lines (TV, radio, Web) and IT staff. 
  • Conduct specialized studies and technical assessments of the latest media technologies.
  • Identify and propose innovative ideas for optimizing our infrastructure in regard to media production and distribution.
  • Synthesize and explain to non-experts’ technological innovations to make them understandable and accessible across the Corporation.

 

You possess:

 

General qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer science, or an IT related degree, P.Eng. qualification is a strong asset.
  • Four or more years of media, broadcast technologies architecture or design experience.

 

Technical skills and experience:

  • Experience with new and emerging media technologies (DMF, MXL, SMPTE-2110, Generative AI for media production).
  • Expertise and knowledge of audio/video production and post-production methods including file formats and related technologies (File wrappers, video & audio codecs, media processing, file-based workflows etc.).
  • Expertise and knowledge of audio/video production methods related technologies (Radio and television studios, production switchers, cameras, etc.).
  • Hand-on technical working experience with media production platforms (Avid Interplay MAM, Dalet, Suite Adobe, etc.) and its related various media production software (Avid ¸Media Composer, One Cut, Adobe Premiere, etc.).
  • Must have functional knowledge of cloud technologies, virtualization, networking, storage.
  • Experience with Cloud provider (Azure, AWS, Google, or other).
  • You must have a proven track record in designing, planning and deploying solutions in a highly available and scalable 24/7 environment.

 

Personal skills and experience:

  • Most mandates involve direct daily contact with CBC/Radio-Canada employees of different technical skills levels, strong communication skills (both written and oral) along with good negotiation abilities is key for this position.

  • Excellent team player with strong interpersonal skills is a must.
  • Ability to draft complex reports and presentations; thoroughness, attention to detail and accuracy in calculations and writing are essential.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment, work independently and take the initiative.

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.

 

Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

 

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

 

This role requires full-time on-site presence.

 

The Opportunity

 

We are looking for a Broadcast and IT Systems Specialist to support the studio, content creation, and presentation groups with technical issues as well as help implement groundbreaking technologies across our sites. From the virtualization of services to the implementation of video-over-IP and beyond, to the introduction of centralized and automated workflows, your input will impact CBC/Radio Canada across the country.

 

Every day your hands-on knowledge, your growing expertise, your problem-solving skills and your ability to translate technical issues will be called into play as you work closely with clients facing issues with content creation, backend systems, studios and control rooms. Your patience, sense of urgency and responsiveness will ensure that our content is prepped, scheduled and on the air or digitally available.

 

Who you are and where are you now?

 

You may be a Computer Science or Electronics grad with interest in working at the cutting edge of media and broadcast technology from cloud services to video-over-IP. Or, you may be an industry or technical analyst elsewhere seeking an opportunity to join a nationally respected brand and organization where you can grow your career.

 

What’s in it for you?

 

Challenges. We spend our days solving problems on an unbelievable scale. Media files are highly nuanced and incredibly complicated; updating, installing and supporting technologies that are organization-wide and that impact broadcasting content is a time-sensitive, complex technical feat. And that’s just the beginning. This is an opportunity to learn and work with the most cutting-edge broadcast infrastructure in the world. There is nothing else out there like this, at this scale...yet. You will be an expert in the industry and you will continue to grow and expand your skills as you install, configure, test, troubleshoot, repair, maintain, update and modify equipment, software, systems and facilities ensuring their proper operating condition and optimal performance.

 

Be part of the change. Right now we are looking for people who can execute our strategy. Innovators who want to push future-forward thinking. Builders who want to be hands-on, building the next generation of media technology for the CBC/Radio-Canada audience. We want to hear the ideas, see the designs and implement the innovations brought to us by our teams. You want to be part of a team actively transforming the workspace for every individual at CBC/Radio-Canada. Our priority is to proactively and
in-the-moment solve problems and ensure the users can engage with new functionalities, new tools and conduct their day-to-day work seamlessly.

 

Cutting-edge tech. Data management. Virtualization. IP for broadcast. AI. Security and reliability. The road ahead changes every day. By joining us now, you will become both pioneer and expert with a highly specialized, in-demand skill-set as you help us take steps towards the next frontier of media. As the official providers of technology to CBC/Radio-Canada, you will be joining the team that touches the latest technologies. You will work closely with vendor and internal partners across the organization. You will contribute ideas, develop methods and make recommendations to overcome problems, achieve desired results and permit better utilization of equipment.

 

Why join us?

 

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance. We offer a rare-in-tech work-life balance with an excellent benefits package and a pension plan noted as one of the best in the country; we want to ensure you are happy in and out of the office.

 

We are a dynamic, in-flux team, brimming with potential. There’s a lot of exciting work ahead of us and while we aren’t there yet, we have a plan. Our focus is fulfilling our mandate to exceed audience expectations. We weigh our options, research, explore and evaluate. When we make a decision, we follow through with purpose. We don’t have one static future ahead of us, but a fluid set of options. This means a chance to be part of that change whether you are an idea generator or an executor.

 

What You Bring:

  • The education. You have a diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Broadcast, or a related field.
  • The experience. You have a general understanding and knowledge of computers, networking, IP infrastructure and maintenance of equipment, systems and relevant software technologies. You are familiar with Windows Server Systems, MacOS and Linux.
  • The extra skills. You may have exposure to managing backend systems, databases and remote support of server systems.
  • The interest. You want to learn more about audio, video and TV & Radio Broadcast networks.
  • The communication skills. You are skilled at communicating effectively with internal partners, relaying your opinions with sensitivity. You know how to listen and you understand perspectives. You can expertly analyze and synthesize information and document technical specifications.
  • The positive, collaborative attitude. You can work in a stressful and demanding environment of a production centre, in carrying out its duties effectively under tight deadlines while providing quality work and maintaining a professional and positive attitude.
  • The relationship building finesse. You are empathetic and patient. You understand the user perspective and your priority is providing rapid, stable solutions and support. You are guided by a sense of urgency. You can nurture strong two-way relationships with peers, partners, clients, staff, senior managers and vendors.
  • The analytical skills and creativity. You can think through issues and innovate solutions. You are proactive and creative in your approach. You are a problem-solver, a researcher and a detail-oriented planner.
  • The bridging capability. You work on the cutting edge of technology and pick up new tools quickly. You are aware of modern, best practices and you thrive in an agile environment. You understand how to dig into issues, remove the roadblocks and present solutions both immediate and long-term.
  • The flexibility. You are willing to work as part of an on-site rotating shift (day, evening and overnight).

job.title: Human Resources Ministry Partner
job.description:
Overview

Called to K-LOVE

 

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

 

At K-LOVE, every role is ministry.

 

We hire first for ministry alignment and a shared commitment to our faith, mission, vision, and values. We then seek talented professionals who can use their God-given gifts, skills, and experience to serve with excellence.

 

If you love Jesus and are called to be part of a ministry that places Christ at the center of everything we do, we invite you to explore this opportunity. If your heart aligns with our mission and you possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for the role, please keep reading

 

 

In addition, a VALUES FIT is top priority. Do our values align with yours? Mission, Beliefs & Values. If so, please read on.

 

The Human Resources Ministry Partner is an experienced human resources professional responsible for providing comprehensive HR support to team members and leaders across the Ministry. This role requires expertise in employee relations, compliance, onboarding, orientation, HRIS administration, and HR operations.  Will also serve as the first point of contact for HR related questions or concerns.

 

* This is an in-office role at our Franklin, TN Office

 

 

Here’s just some of what you will be doing daily…

  • Serve as the primary administrative resource for the HR team, including, but not limited to: development of correspondence for both confidential and non-confidential matters regarding people operations and employee relations processes.
  • Act as the first point of contact for HR related questions or concerns – redirecting team members and elevating issues as appropriate. Clearly and positively communicate solutions with exceptional follow through. Effectively and efficiently route and answer questions within scope of knowledge and authority.
  • Enter and maintain team member data within the HRIS system, ensuring a high level of accuracy, confidentiality, compliance, and timeliness with internal standards. This includes keying new hires, terminations, compensation adjustments, and other changes to team member status.
  • Facilitate new hire onboarding and new hire orientations, ensuring a smooth transition for team members into the Ministry and promoting engagement from day one.
  • Ensure the organization of team member files; maintain confidential records, I-9 documents, and other related employment documentation.
  • Support the VP of Human Resources with conducting investigations into team member complaints, policy violations, worker’s compensation investigations, vehicle accidents, and other workplace issues, ensuring thorough documentation in the Ministry’s case management system.
  • Advise leaders on corrective actions, performance improvement plans, and performance support procedures in alignment with Ministry policies and legal requirements.
  • Partner with payroll to submit Team Member vacation cash out requests, retro-pay amounts, bonus payments (i.e., relocation, sign on, or discretionary bonus amounts).
  • Maintain list of active team members on the Ministry Driver’s Insurance policy. Notifying vendor of changes.
  • Partner with the HR team as needed for Leave of Absences, Workers Compensation, Disability, Unemployment, Employment Verifications, EEO reporting, Public Student Loan Forgiveness, and other related projects.
  • Partner on exit paperwork and interviews.
  • Collaborate with HR leadership and other HR team members to support Ministry initiatives and continuous improvement projects.
  • Assist in the administration of the compliance portal where team members acknowledge policies and trainings.

 

We are looking for a very specific skill set. If you can say yes to each of these requirements, then we want to meet you!

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
  • PHR and/or SHRM-CP an added plus.
  • 5+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 2 years focused on employee relations.
  • Proficiency in HRIS system (ADP preferred), Microsoft Office Suite, and HR reporting tools.

job.title: Operations & Innovation Specialist
job.description:
Operations & Innovation Specialist 

(ESPN Network | Milwaukee, WI)

The ESPN Radio Network and Good Karma Sports are seeking a full-time Operations & Innovation Specialist to join the Home Office Innovation Team, with a dedicated focus on supporting ESPN Network teammates.


This role will help teammates work smarter by identifying opportunities to improve existing workflows, eliminate repetitive tasks, and implement practical solutions using AI, automation, and technology.


The ideal candidate is curious, creative, analytical, and action-oriented. We are looking for someone who enjoys understanding how things work, challenging the status quo, experimenting with new technology, and turning ideas into meaningful operational improvements.


Career responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Build strong relationships with ESPN Network teammates to understand their workflows, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Identify repetitive, inefficient, or manual processes across ESPN Network departments and prioritize opportunities for improvement.
  • Evaluate existing workflows, recommend improvements, and design, build, test, implement, and maintain AI-enaabled solutions and automations that improve operational efficiency and consistency.
  • Partner with ESPN Network leadership and the Home Office Innovation Team to prioritize projects and execute improvements.
  • Experiment with emerging AI tools and technologies to identify new ways to improve productivity and operations.
  • Develop clear processes, documentation, and training materials that help teammates adopt new solutions.
  • Support the successful rollout and ongoing adoption of new tools, systems, and workflows.
  • Measure and communicate the impact of innovation initiatives, including time saved, improved efficiency, and increased operational capacity.
  • Collaborate with the Home Office Innovation Team and other teammates across Good Karma Sports to share successful solutions, improve workflows, and implement best practices.
  • Complete additional responsibilities and projects as assigned.
  • Represent Good Karma Sports by demonstrating our core values: Listen, Be Honest, Work Hard, Over Deliver, Follow Through, and Teamwork.

Preferred knowledge, skills and qualifications:

  • Strong curiosity, analytical thinking, and creative problem-solving abilities.
  • Passion for AI, emerging technology, automation, and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to understand complex workflows and translate challenges into practical solutions.
  • Experience with AI platforms, workflow automation, low-code/no-code tools, CRM systems, or reporting tools is a plus.
  • Resourceful, self-directed, and comfortable experimenting with unfamiliar technology.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to influence and support change across teams without direct authority.
  • Ability to balance experimentation, execution, accuracy, and responsible technology use.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-changing environment and managing multiple priorities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and willingness to learn new platforms and systems.
  • Valid driver’s license required.

Hours/Salary/Benefits

This is a full-time, in-office, exempt salaried position offering a competitive base salary based on experience and qualifications.

This role is eligible for full benefits including health, dental and vision insurance, Life Insurance, STD, LTD, 401(k) Plan, Dependent Care, paid parental leave, and more, with opportunities for growth as responsibilities and impact expand.

The position may require occasional evenings and weekends depending on project needs and operational priorities.

Opportunity for Growth  

Teammates have the opportunity to continuously learn and grow within Good Karma and are responsible for representing Good Karma Sports, our story, and our core values inside and outside the workplace. Teammates are encouraged to take a proactive role in building relationships and seeking opportunities throughout the company.  

How to Apply  

Apply by submitting resume to www.goodkarmasports.com/careers no later than November 18, 2026. All are encouraged to apply.  

About Good Karma Sports

Good Karma Sports is a sports media and marketing company that helps brands build meaningful connections with fans in and around the game. Combining national reach, regional expertise and deep local relationships, the company develops and executes multi-platform strategies across audio, podcasts, video, digital, social, talent, live experiences and premium sports partnerships. 

For nearly 30 years, Good Karma has paired sports-first expertise and trusted relationships with best-in-class execution to deliver results for brands, publishers, leagues, teams, communities and fans. Today, Good Karma Sports has more than 500 teammates across 12 offices nationwide and has been recognized as a Best Place to Work by Front Office Sports, Sports Business Journal and USA TODAY. 

## 

Good Karma Sports is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  We consistently renew our commitment to creating and maintaining an inclusive workplace for all.  We foster integrity, respect within the workplace, and believe that the foundation of our success is our collective differences and diversity of thought.  We welcome all to help us continue to build a community that embodies and promotes diversity, inclusion, and belonging for all.

job.title: Manager of Music & Streaming Content
job.description:
Description

About Hope Media Group

Hope Media Group is a multi-brand ministry. Every story we share, every event we host, and every song we play is done to engage people to love Jesus, serve others, and spread Hope. Hope Media Group is the home of KSBJ, WayFM, Worship 24/7, Vida Unida, NGEN radio. Way Loud, Way New, Way Back, Gospel 24/7, God Listens Prayer App and Hope Events. We invite you to apply and become a part of our growing ministry to Love Jesus, Serve Others, and Spread Hope. Our team describes our environment as fun, encouraging, collaborative, engaging, caring, family-oriented, and friendly. We would love for you to join us and be part of what God is doing in our ministry! The Next Digital Product is Hope Media Group's first digital product: a music app built for Christians, offering a generosity-funded alternative to ad-driven and algorithm-driven streaming. Rather than inferring what to play from behavioral data, the Next Digital Product starts by asking how you're doing and curates a path in response. It's built to give back to the people who use it, not extract from them.


Manager of Music & Streaming Content


Job Summary:

Hope Media Group is seeking a Head of Music & Streaming Content to lead the overall music and content strategy for the Next Digital Product. This role owns the sound, content direction, playlist philosophy, programming standards, and listener content experience, working closely with product engineering to make sure the platform reflects the intended vision. It directs contractors who execute playlisting, production, and interactive streaming, and it directs the Director of Digital Audio Streams.

Essential Functions:

Content Strategy and Sound:

  • Own the Next Digital Product's content strategy and sound direction: genre mix, mood and path curation logic, tone.
  • Set and uphold content standards grounded in a Christian worldview, applied to every song on the platform regardless of where it comes from.
  • Own the Next Digital Product's audio identity: imaging, voiceover, and sound design.
  • Shape how content strategy shows up in-product — the check-in flow, path structure, discovery surfaces.

Programming Standards:

  • Set and maintain programming standards. Decide what qualifies for a path, how playlists are built, and how the catalog is curated across moods and life moments.
  • Build the editorial and programming framework future content roles will execute against day to day.
  • Own the content taxonomy: the mood, genre, and activity attributes that drive curation and personalization.
  • Monitor listening data — skips, completions, saves, repeat listening — to refine programming over time. 

Team Leadership:

  • Direct contract resources supporting playlisting, production, and interactive streaming, and manage the production budget.
  • Lead and develop the Director of Digital Audio Streams, delegating day-to-day streaming operations while retaining ownership of standards.
  • You serve as the Next Digital Product's primary representative within the Christian music industry.

Demonstrated Faith

  • Committed to a personal relationship with Jesus Christ
  • Grounded spiritually and biblically literate
  • Comfortable praying for co-workers in team meetings, leading spoken prayer, and participating in ministry prayer meetings and Bible studies
  • Live Christian principles defined by the ministry's Statement of Faith & Biblical Beliefs
  • Participate in on-air fundraisers and prays for donors as needed
  • Passion for leveraging the HMG's media platforms for evangelism and discipleship
  • Exhibit a strong moral character
  • Active member of a Bible believing local church


Requirements

Non-Essential Functions

  • Other duties as requested.

Requirements and Qualifications

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Music, Communications, Media, or a related field, or at least 10 years of equivalent experience.

Experience:

  • 7+ years in music programming, editorial, or content strategy at a streaming service, radio network, or comparable audio platform.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a playlist or programming philosophy at scale, not just execution of someone else's standards.
  • Experience directing contractors or a small team delivering production work against a budget and deadline.
  • Working knowledge of the Christian/gospel music industry, or a demonstrated ability to build that knowledge fast.
  • Comfort operating without an established playbook.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Direct experience with Christian radio or Christian streaming programming.
  • Experience building or scaling a listening product's editorial function from near-zero.
  • Familiarity with licensing and rights constraints on programming decisions.
  • Heart for Christian ministry
  • Strong moral character
  • Has a personal relationship with Jesus Christ. Spiritually grounded and working knowledge of scripture
  • Must be an active member of a Bible believing local church


Supervisory Responsibilities

  • The Director of Digital Audio Streams, and contract resources supporting playlisting, production, and interactive streaming.

Working Conditions and Environment

Travel:

  • As needed for industry events, conferences, and label and partner meetings.

Nights/Weekends/Holidays:

  • Occasional evenings, weekends, or holidays may be required for board meetings, ministry events, fundraising events, urgent employee matters, or organizational needs.

Physical Requirements:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 

Physical Activity may include Talking. Expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word. Those activities in which they must convey detailed or important spoken instructions to other workers accurately, loudly, or quickly. Hearing. Perceiving the nature of sounds at normal speaking levels with or without correction. Ability to receive detailed information through oral communication, and to make the discriminations in sound. Repetitive motion. Substantial movements (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.

Light work. Exerting up to 20 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 10 pounds of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to move objects. If the use of arm and/or leg controls requires exertion of forces greater than that for sedentary work and the worker sits most of the time, the job is rated for light work.

The worker is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as: preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; extensive reading.


Full-Time Benefits Offerings:

  • Medical
  • Dental
  • Vision
  • Health Savings Account w/employer contribution
  • Flexible Savings Accounts
  • Company Paid Short Term Disability/Long Term Disability
  • EAP (Employee Assistance Program)
  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Three (3) Paid Mission Days
  • Twelve (12) Company-Paid Holidays
  • 403B Retirement with Company Match
  • Group Life Insurance
  • Legal Shield/Identity Theft Protection
  • Access to Marketplace Ministry Chaplains 
  • Third-Party Recruiter Policy:


We are grateful for the interest of those who wish to support our hiring efforts. However, Hope Media Group does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate referrals from external staffing agencies or search firms. Submissions from third parties will not be considered and may be retained without obligation or payment or fees.

About Us

Hubbard Radio is a full-service media company with 16 radio stations and cutting-edge digital solutions in four of northern Minnesota's most beautiful and active resort communities: Alexandria, Bemidji, Brainerd and Wadena. At Hubbard, we're looking for the best people in local media to help build dominant brands that connect consumers and advertisers to build better businesses and communities. We succeed by always doing the right thing with focus, urgency, and passion.

Job Overview

The position of General Sales Manager is responsible for all aspects of the sales operations of the markets. The General Sales Manager will monitor and control sales efforts to maximize the inventory and revenue opportunities for digital and the stations broadcast media.

Job Responsibilities

Develop short and long-term sales strategies to ensure effective client services and achievement of maximum sales and digital sales revenues.

Monitor and modify sales strategies to ensure viability in the constantly changing marketplace.

Effectively lead, develop, train, cross-train and motivate the sales and support staff.

Organize sales department and develop sales procedures, including sales contract forms, commission/incentive, and pricing/inventory procedures that garner maximum revenue in current market conditions.

Develop creative and special concepts, promotions and programs to maximize revenue.

Establish individual annual sales goals for team members, with quarterly benchmarks.

Manage major sales presentations and client relationships to aid in the business close and/or visibility in the market.

Provide continual flow of station and community information to all AE 's, sales representatives, and national agencies.

Provide input to the General Manager regarding programming decisions related to sales performance.

Qualifications

Minimum of (6) years sales experience with at least (4) years sales management experience within a broadcast environment.

Proven ability to work effectively with management to establish acceptable sales budgets; meet revenue goals and objectives as a result of an effectively coordinated, organized and well-executed sales team effort.

Proven ability to develop systems procedures to regularly monitor and evaluate progress.

Proven ability to coach and supervise staff, including-but not limited to, organizing, delegating, training, interviewing and motivating others to produce at their maximum potential.

Knowledge and success with NTR, with emphasis on vendor programs.

Proven ability to monitor modify current sales strategies to insure viability in a constantly changing marketplace.

Knowledge and experience in the use of marketing research for direct selling and ability to train others in its use.

Must be goal-oriented with a strong focus on business performance.

Project desired company image with respect to dress and demeanor.

Must have a good driving record and a valid driver's license, both will be checked.

Ability to travel to various locations.

The company will use background check information in a confidential, non-discriminatory manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

The starting base compensation is $100,000 to $120,000 annually. Additional commissions (or bonuses) can be earned above and beyond this amount.

Hubbard Broadcasting has been committed to representing the communities we serve since our founding over 100 years ago. The same holds true today. We know the best way to accomplish this is by recruiting and retaining top talent from diverse cultures, life experiences, and world views. With dignity and respect, we value YOU and everything that makes YOU uniquely YOU.
