The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team.

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.  


Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!  

                                                                             

Location:

Rochester, NY: 1700 HSBC Plaza, 100 Chestnut St, 14604

                                                                             

Position Type:                                                                                             

Regular

                                                                             

Time Type:

Full time

                                                                                 

Pay Type:

Salaried

                                                                                 

Benefits:

iHeartMedia’s benefits offering is flexible and offers a variety of choices to meet the diverse needs of our changing workforce, including the following:

  • Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision with a variety of coverage options

  • Company provided and supplemental life insurance

  • Paid vacation and sick time

  • Paid company holidays

  • A Spirit day to encourage and allow our employees to more easily volunteer in their community

  • A 401K plan

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost – services include telephonic counseling sessions, consultation on legal and financial matters, emotional well-being, family and caregiving

  • ​A range of additional voluntary programs, such as spending accounts, student loan refinancing, accident insurance and more!

We’re seeking a skilled Broadcast Producer assist with the planning and production of live and pre-recorded radio shows featuring news, music, talk, sports, traffic and feature productions

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Generate original ideas, encourage ideation from others, and carry out thorough research

  • Research information, obtain materials and assist with contacting and scheduling guests

  • Give direction to presenters, content providers, assistants and other crew members

  • Manage budgets and ensure the efficient use of resources

  • Obtain permission or licenses for recording or broadcasting on location, and for the use of music, sound effects and audio archive material

  • Monitor listener emails, inquiries and responses related to shows

  • Use various broadcasting technologies such as soundboards and editing/production software

  • Schedule and monitors the radio stream during live recordings

  • Assist with time-keeping, saving show recordings, archiving show files and post-production editing as directed

  • Creative mindset with the ability to formulate and communicate original ideas
  • Excellent writing and storytelling skills; ability to tailor and adapt content for different audiences and platforms
  • Knowledge of the radio market, different station/program styles, audience demographics
  • Experience using a variety of recording equipment and operating a radio studio
  • Ability to build rapport and draw information from people
  • Confidence and tenacity to pursue information, overcome obstacles and pitch ideas to senior colleagues
  • Stress tolerance with ability to work calmly and effectively under pression, and to react quickly to changes
  • Ability to plan and organize, set priorities, multi-task and meet tight deadlines
  • Full knowledge of the law, rules and industry regulations around radio productions; know when it necessary to acquire relevant clearances and licenses
  • Knowledge and experience with Microsoft Office, including MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint and SharePoint as well as social media platforms

job.title: RCS Product Support Specialist
job.description:
iHeartMedia

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The World's Largest Broadcast Software Provider.

 

RCS Worldwide is home to four industry-defining brands: RCS, Media Monitors, Mediabase, and Florical Systems — serving the broadcast, music, and media intelligence markets across 120 countries. Every day, thousands of radio and television stations around the world rely on RCS technology to stay on air, sound great, and compete in a rapidly changing landscape.

 

Here is what makes us different:

 

We are the company behind the scenes of media that billions of people consume every day. When a song plays on your favorite radio station, when a song charts in the music industry, when a TV network stays on air without a second of downtime — there is a good chance RCS technology played a role. Our portfolio touches every corner of the media ecosystem, from playout and music scheduling to international advertising intelligence and airplay analytics.

 

We are a global team passionate about the industry we serve and moving with the speed and ambition to lead it forward.

 

If this opportunity excites you, but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. At RCS Worldwide, we know that great talent comes from many different backgrounds and experiences. We're committed to building an inclusive, collaborative workplace where people can grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact.

                                                                              

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Love solving issues? Join us as a Product Support Specialist and be the primary point of contact with clients. You'll be handling phone calls and emails from customers in the United States and other countries 24x7. You'll provide timely and accurate answers on a wide range of topics. Examples include software clock building, configuring audio devices, network infrastructure, or reviewing a SQL Server database. This is a remote position.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Document interactions with customers; provide answers by identifying problems; research and guide customers through corrective steps. 
  • Troubleshoot problems in software, hardware, networks, and systems.
  • Write up technical documentation that can be used to repair software defects and deliver enhancements. 
  • Work with customers to improve software system performance by identifying problems and recommending changes. 
  • We ask that you keep your skills up to date by participating in educational opportunities and maintaining personal networks. 
  • Handling phone calls, emails, and social interactions from customers in the United States and other countries. 
  • Working with other departments within RCS teams to further extend our product capabilities. 
  • Have fun!

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

The ideal candidate should possess a background in Radio automation software. They should also have excellent customer service skills and a team focus. Attention to detail and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment is necessary. Candidates should have a fundamentally sound knowledge of networking technologies, Microsoft Windows, and  broadcast systems.


  • We are looking for people with experience working in a Radio, IT, or an Engineering environment. Knowledge of broadcast software such as GSelector, Zetta or NexGen is highly desirable.
  • If you have prior Customer Service experience, we want to hear from you. 
  • We need people with a built-in ability to prioritize. Your experience in Radio or TV means you know what to do when the Off-Air call comes in. 
  • Ideally, you already have well-developed troubleshooting and investigative skills.
  • We never close! Alternate schedules may be required.
  • Bilingual English\Spanish abilities are a plus.
  • We need someone with a can-do attitude!

Compensation:


Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and alignment with market data.


$23.07 - $28.84

                                                                             

Location:

VIRTUAL MST, NE

  • Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision with a variety of coverage options
  • Company provided and supplemental life insurance (pursuant to the collective bargaining agreement if applicable)

  • A Spirit day to encourage and allow our employees to more easily volunteer in their community

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. Broadcast Operations Manager

Raleigh, NC Full Time Manager/Supervisor Share Curtis Media Group is seeking a Broadcast Operations Manager for our multi-market North Carolina radio stations.  The Operations Manager will work closely with the programming, engineering, traffic and IT staff to oversee the day-to-day operations of our FCC licensed radio stations, digital, networks and additional enterprises.  The Operations Manager will work with ownership and senior management in the administration of operational, compliance and administrative activities.
Duties and Responsibilities

As part of its evolution into a modern next-gen studio, FOX Entertainment is expanding its digital storytelling ecosystem with investments across vertical video with Holywater, Chain’s experiential storytelling, podcasting with Meet Cute, a two-way content pipeline with HarperCollins Publishing, and creator-led formats through the newly formed FOX Creator Studios. Through these strategic initiatives, the company is investing earlier in emerging ideas and new forms of audience engagement, while maintaining the ability to grow successful concepts into premium franchises across broadcast, streaming and global platforms. A prolific content creator and production partner, FOX Entertainment collaborates with leading studios, creators, and platforms worldwide to produce and distribute premium content at scale across broadcast, streaming, and digital ecosystems, while continuing to grow its portfolio of owned IP and next-generation storytelling formats.

JOB DESCRIPTION

FOX Entertainment Global (FEG) is FOX Entertainment's centralized content sales division, providing the worldwide multi-platform marketplace with exclusive access to its diverse, rapidly expanding production pipeline and library of owned original programming and co-production partnerships. A central component of FOX Entertainment's long-term growth strategy is to fortify its globally recognized, world-class brand and owned distribution platforms spanning broadcast and streaming with FOX Entertainment Global's singular focus on broadly distributing the company's full portfolio of owned intellectual property across all genres of scripted, unscripted, and animated programming, including both film and television titles.

FOX Entertainment is seeking a Manager, Business & Legal Affairs to serve as a hands-on attorney supporting FEG.  

Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace for a minimum of four (4) days per week is an essential function of the position. The selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.

  • Direct background working with rights management, content operations, or marketing teams within a content sales organization)

job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

FOX LATAM

FOX Latinoamérica inició operaciones en junio de 2025 y se ha posicionado como uno de los líderes en la programación deportiva en México y Centroamérica, ofreciendo un sólido portafolio de contenidos deportivos y derechos de transmisión de algunas de las ligas y torneos más prestigiosos del mundo, incluyendo la Liga MX, la Copa de Campeones de la Concacaf, la MLB y una selección de partidos de la NFL. La compañía transmite más de 2,000 eventos deportivos al año y cuenta con un equipo conformado por algunos de los talentos, periodistas y analistas deportivos más reconocidos de la región. La amplia oferta de contenido deportivo de FOX Latinoamérica está disponible a través de FOX y FOX+ en televisión lineal, del servicio de streaming directo al consumidor FOX One y del canal FOX en Tubi, la plataforma gratuita de streaming con publicidad (AVOD).

JOB DESCRIPTION

Descripción de la empresa

La plataforma directa al consumidor (DTC) de FOX es una iniciativa nueva y visionaria dentro de Tubi Media Group que lleva el incomparable portafolio de contenido de FOX —noticias, deportes y entretenimiento— directamente a los consumidores a través de un innovador servicio de streaming por suscripción.

Impulsado por un equipo de liderazgo altamente experimentado, con trayectorias en la intersección de los medios, la tecnología, el streaming y el contenido, y respaldado plenamente por Fox Corporation, este proyecto combina energía emprendedora con un profundo conocimiento de la industria de los medios.

Nuestra visión es crear una experiencia de visualización unificada y moderna que ponga al consumidor en primer lugar, integrando de forma fluida el contenido en vivo y bajo demanda en todas las plataformas.

En la intersección entre la tecnología de vanguardia y la narrativa de confianza, esta es una oportunidad para dar forma al futuro del streaming en uno de los momentos más decisivos de la industria de los medios. Estamos formando un equipo de clase mundial para cumplir esa visión, y apenas estamos comenzando.


Sobre el puesto

FOX ONE es la aplicación de streaming directa al consumidor de FOX Corporation, ya activa y en operación en Estados Unidos. FOX ONE se está expandiendo ahora a América Latina, y buscamos a un(a) Sr. Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) con base en la Ciudad de México para liderar la ingeniería de calidad de esa expansión. Este es un rol de ingeniería altamente técnico y práctico, para alguien que ve la calidad como una disciplina central de la ingeniería y que pueda definir cómo se construye, prueba, lanza y monitorea la versión de FOX ONE para LATAM.

Como Sr. SDET, colaborarás estrechamente con los equipos de Producto, Ingeniería, Operaciones y Delivery desde las primeras etapas de planeación hasta producción. Te asegurarás de que la calidad se diseñe dentro del trabajo de expansión a LATAM, en lugar de validarse al final. Al comprender el producto actual de FOX ONE, los requisitos del mercado de LATAM y la arquitectura de la plataforma, identificarás riesgos de forma proactiva, definirás estrategias de pruebas y construirás capacidades de automatización en paralelo con el desarrollo de funcionalidades para la región.

Extenderás la plataforma de ingeniería de calidad ya existente de FOX ONE para dar soporte a la expansión en LATAM, adaptando los frameworks y las herramientas construidas para el producto de EE. UU. de modo que funcionen de forma confiable en los distintos idiomas, monedas, dispositivos y entornos regulatorios de México. Este rol requiere un fuerte criterio técnico e implementación práctica, junto con una colaboración cercana con el equipo de plataforma de EE. UU. para decidir qué se debe reutilizar y qué se debe reconstruir para la región.

El candidato o candidata ideal combina sólidas habilidades de ingeniería de software, experiencia consolidada en automatización de pruebas, una mentalidad orientada al producto y un enfoque “AI-first” hacia las pruebas y la ingeniería. Te sientes cómodo(a) cuestionando supuestos, contribuyendo a la dirección técnica y generando resultados de calidad dentro de tu equipo y de los equipos con los que colaboras de cerca, a medida que FOX ONE se expande a un nuevo mercado. Y lo más importante: entiendes que la calidad va más allá de las pruebas previas al lanzamiento y requiere una validación continua de la experiencia del cliente a lo largo de todo el ciclo de vida del producto.


Un vistazo a tus responsabilidades

  • Colaborar con los Product Managers y los equipos de Ingeniería, Operaciones y Delivery durante las fases de descubrimiento, planeación y diseño, para identificar desde el inicio los requisitos de calidad y los riesgos.
  • Traducir los requisitos de producto, los objetivos de negocio y los recorridos del cliente en estrategias de pruebas escalables y frameworks de validación automatizada.
  • Construir frameworks de pruebas, herramientas y capacidades de automatización en paralelo con el desarrollo de funcionalidades, para garantizar la preparación para el lanzamiento.
  • Definir quality gates, criterios de lanzamiento y estándares de preparación para el lanzamiento de tu(s) área(s) de producto dentro de FOX ONE.
  • Diseñar e implementar arquitecturas de pruebas end-to-end que validen la experiencia del cliente en web, móvil, TV conectada, servicios backend, APIs e integraciones de plataforma.
  • Contribuir a la estrategia de pruebas de las capacidades de plataforma usadas por tu equipo y por los equipos con los que colaboras de cerca.
  • Desarrollar capacidades automatizadas de generación de datos de prueba, configuración de entornos y orquestación que den soporte a pruebas continuas a gran escala.
  • Crear suites de regresión automatizadas que validen de forma continua los recorridos críticos del usuario en todos los clientes y plataformas soportados.
  • Construir validación automatizada para experiencias complejas como Multiview, autenticación, derechos de acceso (entitlement), suscripción, comercio, descubrimiento de contenido, reproducción y flujos de transmisión en vivo.
  • Asegurar que Multiview y otras capacidades de la plataforma se prueben automáticamente en todos los dispositivos, configuraciones, tipos de contenido y escenarios de reproducción soportados.
  • Validar de forma continua los recorridos del cliente antes y después de cada lanzamiento, para asegurar que la experiencia en producción se mantenga estable, confiable y con buen desempeño.
  • Extender la plataforma de ingeniería de calidad, los frameworks de pruebas y las capacidades de automatización ya existentes de FOX ONE, para dar soporte a la expansión en LATAM.
  • Ayudar a establecer prácticas de ingeniería de calidad dentro del equipo que puedan compartirse con equipos de producto e ingeniería afines.
  • Aprovechar herramientas y flujos de trabajo impulsados por IA para mejorar la generación de pruebas, la cobertura de automatización, el análisis de defectos, el mantenimiento y la productividad de ingeniería.
  • Influir en las decisiones de ingeniería, el enfoque de pruebas y las prácticas de calidad dentro de tu equipo y de los equipos con los que colaboras de cerca.
  • Mentorear a ingenieros junior y de nivel medio, y promover las mejores prácticas de ingeniería de calidad dentro del equipo.
  • Validar la localización e internacionalización del contenido en español mexicano, incluyendo interfaz traducida, subtítulos/doblaje, formatos de fecha/moneda/números, y problemas de expansión o truncamiento de texto.
  • Construir pruebas automatizadas para los flujos de comercio y pago específicos de México (por ejemplo, pagos en efectivo en OXXO, transferencias SPEI, MercadoPago y tarjetas emitidas localmente), así como la lógica de suscripción y derechos de acceso propia del mercado mexicano.
  • Validar el licenciamiento de contenido, las restricciones geográficas y la lógica de gestión de derechos regionales, para garantizar la disponibilidad correcta del contenido por país.
  • Realizar pruebas en el panorama de dispositivos, operadores y redes de México (por ejemplo, gamas comunes de dispositivos Android, operadores principales como Telcel, AT&T México y Movistar, y las marcas de smart TV más populares en México), así como en condiciones variables de red y CDN.
  • Colaborar con los equipos de localización y contenido para validar los requisitos culturales y regulatorios del contenido (por ejemplo, los sistemas regionales de clasificación de contenido).

Lo que necesitas

  • 5+ años de experiencia como Sr. SDET, Software Engineer in Test, Quality Engineer o en un rol de ingeniería similar, dando soporte a productos de consumo masivo y gran escala.
  • Habilidades de desarrollo de nivel experto en Python o TypeScript, con capacidad para aprovechar frameworks, herramientas, servicios de automatización y plataformas de ingeniería de calidad.
  • Sólido dominio trabajando en entornos de aplicaciones basados en TypeScript, incluyendo la capacidad de leer, depurar y colaborar de forma efectiva con los equipos de ingeniería de aplicaciones.

Coastal Mississippi offers affordability, tasty cuisine, and top-tier arts and entertainment in the communities we serve. We blend that together with our own rich history to make WLOX the station for South Mississippi.

job.title: Digital Media Buyer & Planner
job.description:
General Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Plan, execute, manage, and optimize paid media campaigns across Facebook, Instagram, X, Google, YouTube, and other digital advertising platforms.
  • Develop media plans and buying strategies based on campaign objectives, target audiences, budgets, and performance goals.
  • Develop and manage audience targeting strategies, including demographic, behavioral, interest-based, remarketing, and lookalike audiences.

  • Monitor campaign performance and make ongoing adjustments based on key performance indicators, audience behavior, costs, and campaign objectives.

  • Evaluate the performance of creative assets, messaging, audiences, and placements and assist with A/B testing strategies.
  • Manage campaign setup, trafficking, tracking, quality assurance, and implementation to ensure accurate campaign launches.
  • Partner with creative, marketing, digital, and other internal teams to coordinate campaign assets, messaging, landing pages, and tracking requirements.
  • Prepare campaign performance reports and translate data and audience insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Track campaign spending and ensuring budgets are appropriately paced and aligned with approved media plans.
  • Leverage AI tools, including ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, and other emerging technologies, to support audience research, campaign analysis, reporting, and optimization.
  • Monitor emerging digital platforms, advertising products, audience trends, and technologies and recommend new opportunities when appropriate.
  • Manage multiple campaigns and priorities while meeting campaign launch and reporting deadlines.
  • Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Position Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, Business, Analytics, or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in digital media buying, media planning, paid social, paid search, performance marketing, or programmatic advertising.
  • Hands-on experience planning, launching, managing, and optimizing paid digital advertising campaigns.
  • Strong working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads required; experience with X Ads, YouTube, and other digital advertising platforms preferred.
  • Experience with programmatic advertising platforms and DSPs such as DV360, The Trade Desk, Yahoo DSP, or similar platforms is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of audience targeting, segmentation, retargeting, campaign optimization, and digital advertising performance metrics.
  • Experience analyzing campaign performance and using data to make media buying and optimization decisions.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel; experience with Google Analytics, data visualization, or other reporting tools preferred.
  • Familiarity with AI tools and an interest in applying emerging technologies to digital advertising, analysis, and campaign optimization.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple campaigns, budgets, platforms, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

     Compensation & Benefits

    • Competitive salary - $85k -$110k depending on skills and relevant experience.
    • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans.
    • 401(k) retirement plan with company match.
    • Paid time off and holidays.
    • Professional development and training opportunities.
    • Collaborative and inclusive work environment.

job.title: Sr. News & Corporate Researcher
job.description:
Core Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Company research: Prepare profiles of potential partners, customers, acquisition targets, vendors, investors, and other organizations.
    • Financial research: Review public filings, earnings reports, investor presentations, industry data, and other financial information.
    • Strategic research: Support management in evaluating new markets, products, geographic expansion, partnerships, licensing opportunities, and investments.
    • Executive briefings: Produce concise research memos, background reports, talking points, charts, and briefing materials for executives.
    • Market research: Analyze industry size, growth rates, trends, competitive conditions, and emerging opportunities.
    • Data collection and analysis: Gather information from databases, government records, surveys, trade associations, research firms, and credible online sources and turn it into actionable findings.
    • Fact checking: Verify statistics, claims, quotations, company information, and other material before it is used internally or externally.
    • Regulatory and policy research: Track legislation, regulations, government policies, court decisions, and agency actions relevant to the company's operations.
    • Special projects: Conduct rapid research for senior executives on acquisitions, business development opportunities, corporate communications, litigation, presentations, or other priority matters.
    • Cross-department support: Work with finance, legal, business development, marketing, communications, and senior management on research-intensive projects.
    • Recommendations: Go beyond simply collecting information by identifying key findings, risks, opportunities, and recommended next steps.
    • News and developments: Monitor news, government actions, regulatory developments, economic trends, and other events that could affect the company.

    News Research to Include:

    • Conduct in-depth research on breaking news, developing stories, current events, public figures, organizations, government agencies, businesses, and other topics relevant to Newsmax programming.
    • Provide producers, anchors, reporters, and editorial leadership with timely background research, facts, statistics, timelines, and other information needed for news coverage.
    • Monitor news developments throughout the day and identify relevant information, updates, and potential story angles.
    • Research and develop background materials for interviews, guest appearances, breaking-news coverage, and special programming.
    • Prepare concise research briefs, background documents, timelines, fact sheets, and other materials for producers, anchors, and newsroom leadership.
    • Research potential guests, experts, newsmakers, and other individuals relevant to developing stories and planned programming.
    • Review government reports, court records, public filings, studies, polling data, transcripts, news reports, and other primary and secondary sources.
    • Conduct research across multiple sources and evaluate the credibility, accuracy, and relevance of information.
    • Quickly respond to research requests from producers and newsroom leadership during breaking-news situations.
    • Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned.

    Position Requirements:

    • Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, Political Science, History, English, Liberal Arts International Relations, Research, or a related field preferred.
    • Previous experience in corporate research, news research, television production, digital media, investigative research, or a related field preferred.
    • Strong knowledge of current events, politics, government, business, international affairs, and the broader news landscape.
    • Exceptional research and fact-checking skills with demonstrated ability to locate and evaluate information from credible sources.
    • Ability to quickly research unfamiliar or complex subjects and summarize findings clearly and accurately.
    • Experience researching public records, government documents, court records, public filings, databases, and other primary sources preferred.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
    • Strong attention to detail with a commitment to accuracy and factual integrity.
    • Ability to clearly organize and present research findings for staff.
    • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple assignments simultaneously.
    • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, online research tools including artificial intelligence and databases.
    • Flexibility to work outside standard business hours as required by breaking news and major events.

    • Paid time off and holidays.
    • Collaborative and inclusive work environment.

job.title: Congressional Reporter
job.description:
Congressional reporter

The Hill, a division of Nexstar Media Group, is hiring a Congressional Reporter to cover the House. The position will have a focus on healthcare, and the reporter must have the ability to extend coverage to the Senate. It also requires a familiarity and comfort with writing about a broad range of policies.


About the role: 

The person filling this role will be responsible for a mix of spot news stories, regular briefs and features. A successful candidate will have the ability to build sources that can help provide daily scoops to be used across The Hill’s platforms, including our newsletters. We want to write stories that make people stop and think, and that grab their attention. Candidates who gravitate toward news stories that are unique, and who can write in a compelling and informative way, will have the best chance of success in this role.

The ability to work collaboratively with others on the Congress, White House and campaign teams and on various policy beats is key.

Responsibilities include: 

-Working with the rest of our House team to provide full coverage of the House of Representatives, from committee hearings and press conferences to floor votes.

-Recognizing news immediately when it happens, while also recognizing trend stories that affect the political scene.

-Writing a mix of short and longer news briefs and features for The Hill’s website and newspaper.

-Writing stories on healthcare, which will be a major part of the next congressional session. These stories can include legislative efforts to change and improve the healthcare system and enterprise stories about steps the administration is taking.

- An ability to go on television or take the stage at Hill events to discuss complex policies and political fights in a digestible manner.


Skills and qualifications: 

A degree in journalism or a related field is required, and previous reporting experience in a metro or national media environment is preferred. 

Candidates should have good instincts for understanding what readers want and be able to produce error-free, clean journalism on a tight timetable. Basic familiarity with Google Trends, SEO skills and real-time analytics are a plus. 


Flexibility to adjust schedule and assignments as business needs evolve

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, KTNV - 2
job.description:
At Scripps-owned KTNV, you’ll tell the stories that help Las Vegas viewers understand what’s happening in their community and why it matters. As a Multimedia Journalist, you’ll take stories from idea to air, researching, writing, shooting and editing compelling content for television and digital platforms.


You’ll be out in the community, talking with the people at the center of the story and bringing clarity and context to fast-moving news. From breaking news and live reports to memorable enterprise stories, you’ll have the opportunity to showcase strong journalism, visual storytelling and your own creative voice.


If you’re a self-starter who thrives on deadlines and wants to make an impact through local journalism, this is an opportunity to do meaningful work in one of the country’s most dynamic news markets.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Develop compelling story ideas by evaluating assignments, news leads and tips.
  • Gather and verify information through interviews, observation and research.
  • Write accurate, engaging stories that meet broadcast and AP style standards.
  • Shoot high-quality video and still photography that strengthens your storytelling.
  • Edit video and produce content for television, digital and other multimedia platforms.
  • Deliver taped interviews, narration and live reports from the scene of breaking and developing news.
  • Collaborate with photographers on assigned stories to create cohesive, visually strong coverage.
  • Partner with producers to help prepare newscasts and meet daily editorial needs.
  • Work with digital team members to develop multimedia stories and extend coverage across platforms.
  • Respond quickly and effectively as stories evolve in a fast-paced, deadline-driven newsroom.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred.
  • Generally, 3+ years of related experience preferred.
  • Valid driver’s license, good driving record and ability to provide proof of insurance that meets company-required limits are required. Driving is an essential part of this role.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills with a focus on accuracy, clarity and engaging storytelling.
  • Knowledge of broadcast-quality camera equipment and experience capturing video in the field.
  • Videography and nonlinear editing experience preferred, including Final Cut Pro or similar editing systems.
  • Computer literacy, including familiarity with newsroom computer systems.
  • Confidence posting and adapting content for websites and multimedia platforms.
  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively with photographers, producers and digital teams.
  • Self-motivation, sound news judgment and the ability to perform in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Flexibility to move between reporting, shooting, editing and live storytelling as the news demands.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.

OUR TEAM:

At KTNV, you’ll be part of a collaborative newsroom focused on serving the Las Vegas community with relevant, compelling journalism. Our team brings different backgrounds, perspectives, interests and storytelling strengths to the newsroom, all with a shared goal: connecting audiences with the stories that affect their lives. You’ll work alongside journalists who value teamwork, curiosity, creativity and the energy that comes with chasing a great local story.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Las Vegas gives journalists a remarkable range of stories to tell and experiences to enjoy outside the newsroom. Beyond the world-famous Strip, the Las Vegas Valley offers distinctive neighborhoods, a vibrant food and entertainment scene and a community with plenty of personality.

When you're off the clock, Southern Nevada's landscape offers a dramatic change of pace, with desert scenery and abundant opportunities to get outdoors. Whether you're drawn to live entertainment and restaurants or prefer exploring the desert and surrounding natural areas, Las Vegas offers plenty to discover.

job.title: Facilities, CW Maintenance Supervisor
job.description:
Are you a hands-on problem solver who takes pride in keeping a facility running at its very best? Scripps is looking for a Facilities, CW Maintenance Supervisor to join our team in Clearwater, FL. In this essential role, you'll be the backbone of our operations, ensuring our building, equipment, and work environment are safe, clean, and fully functional so our teams can do their best work every single day. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, love variety in your workday, and enjoy being the person everyone counts on, this is the opportunity for you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Learn and understand all facilities department safety rules, including chemical safety, hearing conservation, etc. Participate in monthly facilities departmental safety meetings.
  • Store, inventory, and deliver supplies to all personnel as assigned.
  • Maintain all facility equipment properly. This includes repair or replacement of light fixtures, painting, remodeling, plumbing, electrical, carpentry, cement repair/replacement, and all other general repairs to building or building equipment as required.
  • Clean, repair, and troubleshoot office chairs, filing cabinets, desks, and other office furnishings.
  • Move equipment, furniture, cubicle components, etc.
  • Keep facilities and departmental area safe, clean, and organized. Properly handle waste disposal (used chemicals, etc.).
  • Perform general facility cleaning, waste removal, floor maintenance, exterior and grounds maintenance, and facilitate company recycling programs.
  • Keep restrooms, break/kitchen areas properly cleaned and stocked with janitorial supplies such as toilet paper, paper towels, trash can liners, etc.
  • Foster good relations between the facilities department and other departments.
  • Handle all other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Generally, a minimum of two years of experience in a facilities department is preferred.
  • High school education or general education degree (GED) preferred.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Excellent problem-solving and basic math skills.
  • Must be familiar with building codes and maintenance trades.
  • Must have familiarity with OSHA requirements applicable facility-wide and have experience with safety programs.
  • Must be able to operate and have a solid understanding of all material handling equipment.
  • Excellent people skills. Must be able to work well and constantly communicate (both written and verbally).
  • Must be able to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Must have solid organizational and computer skills, including good working knowledge of general software programs.
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Clearwater, Florida, is one of the crown jewels of the Tampa Bay region, offering a lifestyle that blends coastal beauty with big-city convenience. The city is home to Clearwater Beach, consistently ranked among the best beaches in the United States, where sugar-white sand, sparkling Gulf waters, and legendary sunsets make every day feel like a vacation. Year-round warm weather means outdoor adventures are always on the agenda, from kayaking and paddleboarding to waterfront dining along the Coachman Park promenade.


Beyond the beach, the Greater Tampa Bay area gives residents access to world-class sports with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, Rays, Lightning, and Rowdies all calling the region home. The area also boasts a thriving arts scene, with the Clearwater Marine Aquarium, the Capitol Theatre, and proximity to Tampa's Hyde Park Village and Ybor City historic district offering something for everyone. With a diverse culinary scene, strong job market, and no state income tax, Clearwater and the Tampa Bay region deliver an outstanding quality of life for those who put down roots here.

job.title: Master Control Operator
job.description:
Sinclair’s content technology is at the core of our operational excellence. We thrive on innovation and a passion for connecting people with the best local news and sports content. As we grow our content offerings and expand our broadcast, cable, and digital distribution channels, we are embracing modern technologies to fuel that growth. We are excited by the promise of cloud-first approaches and artificial intelligence in media systems. Sinclair believes that flexibility and agility will address rapidly changing media environments and we are confident that great people and great technology equal great solutions.

The role of Master Control Operator is responsible for operating the multi-channel and multi-brand control point for Sinclair Television Stations located in Bristol, VA. Duties include, but are not limited to, Live event operations, graphics insertion, playlist manipulation, and monitoring on-air quality of the TV Station to ensure all content airs accurately and reflects the traffic and programming schedules.

Additional responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Understand and follow standard operating procedures for various networks, including high profile live events and disaster recovery.
  • Modification and verification of playlists for current and future broadcast times.
  • Manipulate playlist for the different “join in progress” scenarios.
  • Consistently monitor on-air material and communicate any discrepancies to Managers.
  • Consistently ensure that playlist information and media content are accurate, which may include but is not limited to:
  • SOM/EOM of segments
  • Database Information
  • Audio specifications
  • Video specifications
  • Secondary events (GPI,SCTE104 and Graphic Insertion)
  • Content
  • Closed Captioning
  • Active Format Descriptor.
  • Ensure proper video routing.
  • Record, Ingest and Prepare content for playout.
  • Monitor equipment for performance / device failures.
  • Capture and document network processes such as timing of log elements, program run times and on air discrepancies.
  • Setup and review content prior to scheduled airtime.
  • Communicate effectively with Managers and Operators to ensure a smooth transition between shifts.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Understand and follow departmental policies.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum 1 Year experience in Master Control Operations functions.
  • Experience in Local TV Station Operations. (A PLUS)
  • Experience in Switching Live Local News and Sporting Events. (A PLUS)
  • Must have great attention to detail and ability to multitask, monitoring multiple playlists and video monitors simultaneously.
  • General understanding of industry regulations and standards for video, audio, captioning and loudness.
  • Understanding of broadcast technology such as switchers, server playout, automation systems, waveform monitors and rasterizers.
  • Ability to communicate effectively, work under stress and perform as part of a team.
  • Aptitude for operating electronic equipment and the capability to learn specialized applications.
  • Experience with Systems and Hardware for Content Ingest, Playout and Distribution.
  • Knowledge of Amagi CLOUDPORT Automation system. (A PLUS)  
  • Available to work any shift in a 24/7 Operation as well as holidays and weekends.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite. 

 

 

The hourly compensation range for this role is $16.75 per hour. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate’s relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, 15 paid vacation days, 2 paid personal days, 9 paid holidays, 40 hours of paid sick leave, parental leave, and employee stock purchase plan.

TelevisaUnivision is seeking a detail-oriented and highly organized News Media Desk Coordinator to join its News Department.

The News Media Desk Coordinator is responsible for ensuring the timely retrieval, processing, and delivery of media content for live and pre-recorded news programming. This role also ensures that all video assets are properly logged, tagged, and assigned accurate metadata to support efficient archival storage and future retrieval.


ABOUT YOU

You thrive in a fast-paced, highly technical, and automated broadcast environment. You are resourceful, detail-oriented, and capable of making sound decisions under pressure. You communicate clearly, provide accurate instructions, and take pride in delivering exceptional service and support to producers, journalists, and field personnel.


YOUR DAY-TO-DAY


  • Provide creative input and assist producers in identifying and sourcing relevant content for news programming.
  • Utilize Avid systems to search for, retrieve, and deliver media content to news bureaus and field personnel.
  • Use iNEWS to transfer and synchronize metadata from program rundowns to the PAM archival system.
  • Ensure all video assets are properly logged, categorized, and assigned accurate metadata for archival and future retrieval.
  • Perform basic video editing and clip selection using Avid Media Composer.
  • Ingest and process video files in various formats and codecs to prepare content for the editing workflow.
  • Maintain a working knowledge of current events and breaking news developments.
  • Respond promptly to media requests while providing proactive, service-oriented support to the News Department.
  • Prioritize and manage multiple requests while maintaining accuracy and meeting tight deadlines.

YOU HAVE


  • Previous experience working with Avid media management systems.
  • Strong typing skills with a high level of speed and accuracy.
  • Excellent multitasking, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to maintain accuracy under pressure.
  • Full professional proficiency in both English and Spanish (bilingual required).
  • Basic video editing skills and hands-on experience with Avid Media Composer.
  • The ability to make quick decisions and communicate clear, accurate instructions.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • A proactive, service-oriented approach and the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • The ability to work in a fast-paced newsroom, including during breaking news situations.
  • Physical ability to lift and move boxes as required.

TECHNICAL SKILLS & SYSTEMS

Working knowledge or experience with the following systems and equipment:

  • Avid Media Composer
  • Avid Interplay Access
  • Avid Interplay | MAM Desktop
  • MediaCentral
  • iNEWS
  • MediaPulse
  • File Transfer
  • DIVA
  • Video converters and media ingestion equipment

job.description:

We’re investing in our content, our people, and our platforms across digital, streaming, social, audio, linear, and live events. As we continue to grow our global streaming platform, ViX, we are focused on leveraging emerging technologies, artificial intelligence, and scalable digital solutions to enhance content management, operational efficiency, and the overall streaming experience.

 

TelevisaUnivision is seeking an experienced Technical Product Manager to lead product strategy, development, and execution for ViX's Content Management System (CMS), supporting backend engineering teams and driving AI-powered platform transformation.

This technical leadership role combines strategic product management, AI implementation, cross-functional collaboration, and Agile delivery. The position will play a critical role in modernizing editorial and content management workflows, translating business needs into scalable technical solutions, and advancing AI initiatives from experimentation to production-ready capabilities.

·       Coordinate cross-functional initiatives involving backend engineering, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), APIs, and other technical integrations to ensure alignment and timely execution.

job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Decision Scientist Job ID 10141552 Location Lake Buena Vista, Florida, United States Business The Walt Disney Company (Corporate) Date posted Nov. 05, 2026 Decision Scientist Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements The Disney Decision Science and Integration (DDSI) team leverages advanced technologies, data analytics, and scientific approaches such as optimization and statistical modeling to build innovative tools that shape business decisions across The Walt Disney Company. We support Disney Entertainment (ABC, The Walt Disney Studios, Disney+, Hulu), ESPN, Disney Experiences (Theme Parks, Cruise Line, Consumer Products, DVC), and Corporate Finance with strategic applications that enable data-driven decision-making. In DDSI, we sit at the intersection of business strategy, advanced analytics, and technology integration to help our partners explore opportunities for analytics, shape business decisions, and drive value. As an analytical Center of Excellence, we are responsible for developing and delivering data science courses to business professionals across the enterprise, including individual contributors and executives. As a Decision Scientist – Course Developer/Instructor, you will play a pivotal role in designing and teaching these courses. In addition, you will have opportunities to develop innovative decision science solutions that support critical projects for internal clients. This team is based in Lake Buena Vista, FL and works in office. The role reports to the Senior Manager, Decision Science. What You Will Do Responsibilities as a Decision Scientist Course Developer/Instructor Develop and deliver applied data science courses covering topics such as probability and uncertainty, mathematical optimization, coding for automation and data analytics, machine learning, and data visualization. Support learning across the enterprise through “office hour”-style consultations that help business professionals apply methods and ideas from our courses in their day-to-day work. Responsibilities as a Decision Scientist: Drive value through analytics – Research, develop, and implement decision science frameworks as a consultant to business units across The Walt Disney Company. Pursue innovation – Conduct research on analytical techniques and translate that research into practical solutions for users and clients. Tell the story – Present science results to business partners and clients. Support a global and enterprise-wide mission – Identify and apply best practices in the field of advanced analytics for multiple lines of business. Required Qualifications & Skills: Minimum of 3 year of related work experience. Ability to teach concepts on technical subject matter to non-experts in a clear and memorable way. Ability to craft technical slides, animations, and scripts to be used in teaching live or remote audiences. Excellent written and spoken English. Proficient at writing code in at least one programming language like R, Python, Julia, or other programming language. Competence in at least one quantitative field, as indicated by the completion of advanced coursework and original research. Fields include, but are not limited to: Statistics (two or more topics): Bayesian statistics Generalized linear models Design of Experiments Mixture models Nonparametric regression Structural equation models Time series (state space models, ARIMA, etc.) Optimization (at least one topic): Decision analysis or multiple criteria decision making Mixed-integer optimization Nonlinear optimization Stochastic optimization Discrete-event simulation and stochastic models Econometrics/Economics (two or more topics): Difference in differences Instrumental variables Panel data Regression discontinuity design Simultaneous equations models Dynamic stochastic general equilibrium modeling Game Theory Machine learning (two or more topics): Boosting CART Clustering Graphical models Neural networks Random forests Reinforcement learning Support vector machines Preferred Qualifications: Experience using advanced analytics to shape high‑impact strategic or enterprise‑level decisions, ideally in complex or fast‑moving business environments. Expertise in decision theory, system dynamics, industrial organization, or other approaches for understanding and influencing decisions in complex systems. Ability to translate sophisticated analytical methods into clear, actionable insights for leaders and non‑technical partners. Experience developing data science training for business professionals. Required Education Master’s degree in advanced Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, or comparable field of study, and/or equivalent work experience Preferred Education Ph.D. degree in Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, Econometrics, Economics, Machine Learning, or comparable field of study, and/or equivalent work experience/or equivalent work experience​ Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY Job Posting Statement The hiring range for this position in Lake Buena Vista, FL is $111,900 to $150,000 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. Job Summary: At Disney, we‘re storytellers. We make the impossible, possible. We do this through utilizing and developing cutting-edge technology and pushing the envelope to bring stories to life through our movies, products, interactive games, parks and resorts, and media networks. Now is your chance to join our talented team that delivers unparalleled creative content to audiences around the world. “We create happiness.” That’s our motto at Walt Disney Parks and Resorts. And it permeates everything we do. At Disney, you’ll help inspire that magic by enabling our teams to push the limits of entertainment and create the never-before-seen! The Sanitation Systems Operator is responsible for performing maintenance at an RCID Utility potable water treatment facility. Analyze and troubleshoot concerns using data and use proper action to meet the operating objective. Conduct preventative and routine maintenance on facilities and equipment. Ensure the sanitation of the water system and validate the quality and quantity customers receive. The field service position may include work from elevated platforms and confined spaces throughout the Walt Disney World Parks and Resort property. Responsibilities: Collect water samples Monitor chemical feed and other system components Maintain daily maintenance log, including records of meter readings, tests, equipment, and chemical use Regularly read meters and gauges, making adjustments as needed Periodically flush distribution system using hydrants and blow-off valves Periodically assess efficiency of system components (e.g., pumps and valves) Conduct frequent system and security inspections Conduct routine inspections of wells Exercise valves, flow test meters, hydrant testing and repairs Cast members may be required to handle cleaning chemicals and supplies Additional Personal Protective Equipment (face shields, goggles, refillable hand sanitizers, etc.) may be required Basic Qualifications: Valid Florida driver’s license Minimum of Florida Class C Water Operator’s License Possess the ability to interpret blueprints Ability to lift up to 50 pounds Excellent written and interpersonal communication skills Proficiency in standard office software programs and mobile electronic devices Preferred Qualifications: Prior experience with pump stations Knowledge of monitoring chemical feed Familiarity with distribution system flushing Prior experience with well inspections and hydrant testing Additional Information: Schedule Availability : Our Theme Parks and Resort Hotels operate 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. Schedules and start times are subject to vary. ©Disney is an equal opportunity employer. job.title: Sr Mgr Product Software Engineering
job.company: Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology
job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Sr Mgr Product Software Engineering Job ID 10161243 Location New York, New York, United States Business Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Date posted Oct. 28, 2026 Sr Mgr Product Software Engineering Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements Job Summary As a Senior Software Engineering Manager in the Experimentation & Experience Controls team, you’ll lead several squads through their engineering leads, and set the direction for multiple domains within the WeaponX product. You will be empowered to set technical and architectural direction, and to influence the roadmap for your squads and the wider organization - working in partnership with your peers across Product, Project Management and Engineering. You will collaboratively define the team’s OKRs, and ensure our work has a measurable impact on these objectives. You’ll be working on our high-scale in-house A/B testing and feature flagging product, capable of serving billions of requests with single digit millisecond response times. Deeply integrated into our platform to enable experimentation, feature, & release management, and real-time user targeting across multiple brands and products including Disney+, Hulu, ESPN, & ABC. Responsibilities As a Senior Software Engineering Manager, you'll: Own the roadmap for your domains with your Product partner. You’ll decide on priorities together and take joint ownership of the OKRs. Represent engineering to the product teams at Disney+, Hulu, ESPN and ABC who leverage our platform. Make the trade-offs and reasoning clear, and be comfortable saying no. Drive adoption of experimentation and feature management across Disney, and the best practices that go with it. We measure scale by the teams using the platform well, as much as by the traffic it serves. Lead squads that own their services end to end, including in production. You’re accountable for reliability, on-call health and incident follow-through across your domains. Set and communicate the engineering vision for your squads, and make sure it lines up with the roadmap you own with Product and with the organization’s goals. Manage and mentor engineering leads and senior ICs, and stay close enough to the technical and architectural problems to challenge them. Build a diverse software development team through training, career development, recruiting, and process improvements. Creating an inclusive environment where people can do their best work. Required Experience Strategic Alignment: Proven experience in gaining alignment across multiple teams & stakeholders to deliver significant, enterprise-level products or features. Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, especially in framing and simplifying complex technical requirements for business stakeholders. Leadership: Experience leading multiple agile teams that build and run large scale distributed systems. Experimentation & Platforms: Experience building or running a platform used by other engineering teams, and a working understanding of how A/B tests are designed and their results read. Scaling Delivery: A preference for delegating outcomes and empowering your team, but with the ability to be hands on when required. Engineering & AI: Experience leading teams that use AI across the delivery cycle, from planning through to release, and getting better quality and faster delivery as a result. Cloud Infrastructure: Proficiency with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Ambiguity: Comfortable working from loosely defined requirements, and leading conversations where our customers disagree with each other, or with us, about what the platform should do next. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software, Electrical or Electronics Engineering, or comparable field of study, and/or equivalent work experience. At least 10 years of experience in the software engineering field At least 3 year of experiences in a leadership or management role in technology Other Relevant Skills Experimentation Tooling: Working knowledge of A/B testing and feature flagging platforms such as Statsig, LaunchDarkly, Optimizely, Eppo or Split, and the best practices that go with them. JVM Languages: Experience with a JVM language such as Java, Scala or Kotlin. Our platform is written in Scala. Distributed Systems: Experience building micro/web services - including REST and GraphQL. Data Modeling: Experience with relational and NoSQL databases, particularly PostgreSQL, Aurora, or DynamoDB, with expertise in modeling and optimizing query performance. Advanced Data Platforms: In-depth experience with data warehouse and pipeline platforms, specifically Snowflake or Databricks. Real-time Data: Experience with streaming data platforms such as Kinesis or Kafka. Infrastructure as Code: Experience with Terraform or other IaC tooling. Coaching & Mentoring: Experience mentoring and coaching more junior engineers on both technical and soft skills. Community Contribution: Active contributions to the technical community through white papers, blogs, workshops, or conferences. Job Summary: Job Requirements Disney Entertainment & ESPN Technology On any given day at Disney Entertainment & ESPN Technology, we’re reimagining ways to create magical viewing experiences for the world’s most beloved stories while also transforming Disney’s media business for the future. Whether that’s evolving our streaming and digital products in new and immersive ways, powering worldwide advertising and distribution to maximize flexibility and efficiency, or delivering Disney’s unmatched entertainment and sports content, every day is a moment to make a difference to partners and to hundreds of millions of people around the world. A few reasons why we think you’d love working here: Building the future of Disney’s media business: DE&E Technologists are designing and building the infrastructure that will power Disney’s media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. Reach & Scale: The products and platforms this group builds and operates delight millions of consumers every minute of every day – from Disney+ and Hulu, to ABC News and Entertainment, to ESPN and ESPN+, and much more. Innovation: We develop and execute groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms and enhance how audiences experience sports, entertainment & news. Media Engineering is an innovative organization that is focused on providing the best possible video playback experience, art, and metadata to customers around the world, powered by exceptional technology. This strategic work requires streamlining and repurposing technology across different business and distribution channels – including streaming, linear, and theatrical – so that technology can ebb and flow across the needs of the business. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Technology is looking for a Product Software Engineer II to join the Playback Services team within the Media Engineering organization! Our mission is to build highly available, high throughput services that are crucial to delivering high quality content to our subscribers. We are responsible for the backend of media playback, facilitating media selection, device customization, and antipiracy technologies. If you enjoy streaming media, are interested in live sports and entertainment, or just want to join a fast-growing team that plays a significant role in the core functionality of our streaming products, then this role is for you! Responsibilities Work with a team of engineers to build high-performance, stable, scalable systems to be deployed in an enterprise setting Lead high-level architecture discussions and planning sessions, author and share feedback on technical proposals and root cause analyses, and establish standards within the team to drive quality and excellence Participate in the on-call rotation, supporting systems and services during production incidents Provide mentoring and advice for other engineers Participate in the DSS technical community through presentations, tech talks, and other knowledge-sharing efforts Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Electrical or Electronics Engineering, or comparable field of study, and/or equivalent work experience 3+ years related experience crafting backend architectures and delivering backend applications in a production environment. Validated knowledge of operating large-scale high-availability backend services and JVM services Expertise in functional programming patterns and experience building RESTful services (Scala APIs) Understanding of async programming models (events, callbacks, promises, async/await) and threading/concurrency Strong grasp of computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, databases, etc.) and strong understanding of design patterns and principles Experience operating within a Public Cloud Provider (e.g., AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud) Understanding of source control concepts and systems, CI/CD pipelines and exposure to Git Experience with build and deployment technologies such as Jenkins and Docker. Experience with messaging technologies (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis, SQS, etc.) Experience with observability tools for metrics, logging, and monitoring (e.g., Datadog, Splunk, Grafana) Knowledge of caching technologies Knowledge of AGILE/Scrum practices Strong written and verbal communication skills Self-learner, independent, excellent problem-solving skills #DISNEYTECH Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Santa Monica, CA is $119,200 - $159,800 per year, and in New York, NY, it’s $124,900 - $167,400 per year.
