job.title: Senior Analyst, DTC Subscriber Growth & Monetization
job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Senior Analyst, DTC Subscriber Growth & Monetization Job ID 10156995 Location Santa Monica, California, United States Business Disney Direct to Consumer Date posted Nov. 05, 2026 Senior Analyst, DTC Subscriber Growth & Monetization Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements The Walt Disney Company's Disney Entertainment (DE) group includes the company’s full portfolio of entertainment media and content business globally, including streaming (Disney+ and Hulu). DTC Subscriber Growth & Monetization is a highly visible team of professionals with backgrounds in consulting, investment banking, private equity, media & entertainment, and technology who serve as in-house advisers to the Direct-to-Consumer’s executive leadership and own the global subscriber, engagement, and revenue growth planning and reporting. The team’s activities and accomplishments have contributed to the rapid growth and success of the Direct-to-Consumer business. Job Summary: Disney is seeking a Senior Analyst to play a key role in supporting the direct-to-consumer business, focused on Disney+ International. They will assist the subscriber and revenue business planning and communication with the local team, helping to identify key business issues, provide solutions, and evaluate strategic initiatives. This is inclusive of but not limited to: modeling subscriber growth, developing and tracking KPI’s to drive execution and operational improvement, identifying new business and product opportunities, and more. The right person for this role has phenomenal problem solving and analytical skills paired with outstanding strategic and conceptual thinking. The person is an excellent communicator, sets a high bar for themselves and their team, and has a track record of success when partnering with key business operators. A successful candidate will be able to confidently navigate a rapidly evolving, dynamic environment and seek opportunities to drive efficient processes and challenge the status quo. The pace and cadence for change at DTC necessitates an ability to manage multiple projects, collaborate with multiple stakeholders, and roll up sleeves to support this important segment of the Disney business. Responsibilities and Duties of the Role: Assist the region manager in collaborating with local regional teams on the subscriber business planning process with full understanding and justification of key underlying subscription metrics based on in-depth trending analysis and assessment of future initiatives. You will help forecast and model how subscribers will be impacted by internal factors (content, product, etc.) and external factors (macroeconomics, competitors, etc.). You will work closely with the local regional teams and centralized DTC teams such as marketing, product, content and data to incorporate the latest initiatives and trends to enhance model accuracy. Maintain a strong understanding of operating performance (e.g., acquisition, retention), major deals and transactions, issues and challenges facing the businesses, and relevant trends in the streaming business. You will assist in developing impactful, compelling presentation materials (decks, notes, write-ups, backup materials, etc.) that effectively communicates subscriber projections, drivers, business performance, and risks & opportunities to leadership. Work with region manager to provide strategic recommendations for new business initiatives, help quantify any business issue, and analyze large amounts of subscriber data from previous similar events at DTC. Most of the work requires advanced analytical interpretation, paired with a strategic view on market developments, consumer behavior, and the Disney+ product/content. Work with the local team to understand and build both future and existing partnerships into subscriber forecast model. Support structuring of partnership deals with the goal of maximizing net subscriber growth and operating income, while minimizing cannibalization of retail subscribers and time deal launch dates in line with capital market expectations. Required Education, Experience/Skills/Training: Bachelor’s degree with a major in Finance, Economics or similar field with an analytical bias. Minimum two years of professional work experience in media, tech, strategy, business planning, management consulting, or investment banking/private equity Advanced Excel-based business modeling skills are required, including analyzing large amounts of data to drive decision making; experience modeling subscription or recurring-revenue businesses is a plus. Strong verbal and written communication skills (including PowerPoint) and ability to simplify sophisticated matters for an executive audience Ability to work cross functionally in a team environment, managing many stakeholders and building relationships throughout the company Extremely organized with the ability to prioritize activities, manage timelines, and deal effectively with pressure Self-motivated and comfortable working without mentorship, in a fast-growing environment with multiple partners A passion for the media industry, international business, and content as well as a natural curiosity Preferred Qualifications: Familiarity with working in or with global, large organizations Demonstrated experience and/or knowledge of international business Disability accommodation for employment applications The Walt Disney Company and its Affiliated Companies are Equal Employment Opportunity employers and welcome all job seekers including individuals with disabilities and veterans with disabilities. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Senior Data Analyst - Disney DTC Sports & ESPN Analytics Job ID 10163175 Location New York, New York, United States Business Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Date posted Nov. 05, 2026 Senior Data Analyst - Disney DTC Sports & ESPN Analytics Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements SUMMARY The Disney DTC Sports & ESPN Analytics team is seeking a Senior Data Analyst who will be an exceptional addition to our team. You will be responsible for turning data into information, information into insights, and insights into key business decisions that steer the strategic direction of ESPN's direct-to-consumer product strategy. The right person for this role has exceptional analytical capabilities, thrives in a fast-paced environment, loves problem-solving, is a good communicator, and is passionate about high quality digital product experiences. You will play a key role in building out ESPN's product analytics function from the ground up, serving as a dedicated point of contact and thought partner for the ESPN product and product engineering teams. You will lead the foundational work streams for ESPN app measurement: standing up a governed, centralized source of truth for ESPN app performance metrics — canonical definitions, consistent logic, and numbers the business can align on — and building the self-serve tooling that lets stakeholders not only see that a KPI moved, but locate what drove the movement. You will also be the experimentation partner to the product organization, shaping how ESPN app features are tested and how those results are read. This role is hands-on and technical. You will design and maintain the aggregation logic and metric tables that sit underneath executive reporting, and you will be expected to defend the numbers you publish — including the measurement caveats that travel with them. RESPONSIBILITIES • Own and evolve the source-of-truth metric layer for ESPN app performance — headline KPIs (DAU, time spent, watch minutes), their definitions, their dimensional breakouts, and the documented caveats that accompany each • Design and maintain pre-aggregated metric tables and serving views in Snowflake, and the scheduled pipelines that refresh them, ensuring metrics are correct at every level of aggregation • Build the monitoring and decomposition logic that identifies when a KPI movement is real and where it is concentrated — baselines, significance thresholds, contribution ranking, and volume-versus-mix splits • Distinguish genuine behavioral movements from measurement artifacts and instrumentation breakage, and partner with product engineering to close the analytics QA gap on client releases • Build dashboards and self-serve tooling in Looker that reduce stakeholder reliance on ad-hoc analyst pulls • Conduct analyses using SQL and Python to access and manipulate multivariate product and behavioral data, and ideate new metrics and analytical approaches for in-app user behavior • Partner with product and engineering on experimentation end-to-end — translating a product question into a testable hypothesis, selecting primary and guardrail metrics, sizing and powering the test, validating assignment and exposure, analyzing the readout, and diagnosing what happened when a test misbehaves or reads flat • Reconcile ESPN app metrics across teams and systems, and drive alignment on definitions with Research, Data Product, and data engineering partners • Serve as a dedicated point of contact and thought partner for ESPN product and product engineering teams, taking projects end-to-end from vague business need to socialized insight • Communicate results through compelling data storytelling to product leadership and the broader ESPN business BASIC QUALIFICATIONS • Degree in an analytical area such as Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, Computer Science, Economics, or equivalent practical experience • 5+ years of relevant work experience in analytics, product analytics, and/or business intelligence • Advanced SQL — able to read and write complex analytical queries, and to reason about correctness of aggregation logic (for example, why a distinct-count metric cannot be summed across segments) • Working proficiency in Python for data manipulation, analysis, and pipeline work • Practical understanding of data warehousing and dimensional modeling — how metric tables are structured, refreshed, and served to downstream consumers • Applied statistical judgment: constructing baselines, assessing whether a change is meaningful versus noise, and handling seasonality and day-of-week effects • Hands-on product experimentation experience — designing and executing A/B and multivariate tests, analyzing results (significance, confidence intervals, minimum detectable effect, guardrail metrics), and diagnosing common failure modes such as sample ratio mismatch, assignment or exposure leakage, interaction effects, and novelty decay • Experience with data visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, or equivalent) coupled with strong storytelling skills for technical and non-technical audiences • Experience taking vague requirements and manipulating them into polished final products • Strong and effective communication and presentation skills PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS • Hands-on experience with digital clickstream or behavioral analytics data (Adobe Analytics, Amplitude, or similar), including its identity and measurement limitations • Experience with Databricks, PySpark, or comparable large-scale data processing • Experience establishing metric governance — canonical definitions, reconciliation across teams, and change management on metric logic • Experience with an experimentation platform (Optimizely, Statsig, Amplitude Experiment, or in-house) and with scaling experimentation practice across product teams • Familiarity with identity resolution across web, app, and connected TV, and the practical consequences of cookie-based measurement • Prior experience in Sports or Media/Entertainment #TECHATDISNEY Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in New York, NY is $124,900 - $167,400 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. job.title: Manager, Business & Legal Affairs
job.description:
FOX Entertainment Global (FEG) is FOX Entertainment's centralized content sales division, providing the worldwide multi-platform marketplace with exclusive access to its diverse, rapidly expanding production pipeline and library of owned original programming and co-production partnerships. A central component of FOX Entertainment's long-term growth strategy is to fortify its globally recognized, world-class brand and owned distribution platforms spanning broadcast and streaming with FOX Entertainment Global's singular focus on broadly distributing the company's full portfolio of owned intellectual property across all genres of scripted, unscripted, and animated programming, including both film and television titles.

FOX Entertainment is seeking a Manager, Business & Legal Affairs to serve as a hands-on attorney supporting FEG.  

Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace for a minimum of four (4) days per week is an essential function of the position. The selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Draft, review, and negotiate various agreements as assigned, across all media windows (Network, Pay Cable, Pay TV, FAST, AVOD, SVOD, TVOD, EST, and digital platforms), possibly including distribution agreements, tape license agreements, format license agreements, amendments, non-disclosure agreements, etc.
  • Conduct detailed contract analysis and rights research to confirm underlying rights, holdbacks, exclusivity, windowing, territorial restrictions to prevent rights conflicts
  • Field day-to-day legal inquiries from internal stakeholders (Sales, Deal & Rights Management, Marketing, Digital, Publicity) and legal team
  • Compile, manage, interpret and synthesize advertising & edit restrictions and disseminate to Operations for exploitation of programming
  • Maintain accuracy of deal tracker and ensure agreements are being assigned and processed in a timely manner
  • Handle general corporate issues as assigned and support the legal with any special projects that may arise from time-to-times

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree from an accredited law school and active bar admission in good standing (California Bar or Registered In-House Counsel preferred)
  • 2+ years of attorney experience in entertainment transactional law, preferably within a television studio, network, media distributor, streaming platform, or entertainment law firm
  • Equal proficiency in contract drafting and rights research, with demonstrated experience reviewing license agreements, and distribution terms
  • High precision and attention to detail when analyzing contracts, including specific language, rights, holdbacks, exclusivity, etc.
  • Working knowledge of media distribution
  • Excellent time management and self-motivation, with a proven ability to prioritize assignments and manage a high volume of active deals in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact professionally across all levels of personnel and cross-functional departments

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Hands-on experience navigating rights management systems and databases (e.g., Rightsline, Salesforce)
  • Familiarity with international television licensing, international format rights, or foreign distribution nuances
  • Direct background working with rights management, content operations, or marketing teams within a content sales organization)

job.title: Video Production & Studio Manager
job.description:
Red Seat Ventures partners with the world’s top creators across multiple genres to grow and monetize their content through advertising, subscriptions, live events, and beyond. We take a multiplatform approach spanning podcasting, video, FAST, and more, backed by our proprietary technology stack, including Supercast for subscriptions and Speakeasy for hosting, distribution, and monetization.

Named after Ted Williams’ longest home run at Fenway Park, Red Seat Ventures was built with a simple mandate: swing for the fences. Today, we are the fastest-growing creator network, backed by Tubi Media Group and Fox Corporation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Red Seat Ventures is seeking a Video Production & Studio Manager, to support day-to-day studio and technical production operations from our New York office. This role is responsible for owning onsite and remote production workflows, maintaining studio systems, supporting creators’ technical production needs, and ensuring reliable execution across live and recorded productions.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on production professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys solving technical challenges, and is comfortable stepping into multiple production roles as needed. Success in this role requires strong technical expertise, exceptional troubleshooting skills, and a proactive approach to maintaining high-quality production standards.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the day-to-day operation, maintenance, and readiness of Red Seat Ventures’ production studios

  • Configure, operate, and maintain production equipment, including cameras, studio microphones, lighting, sets, background displays, video switchers, recording systems, and transmission paths

  • Support onsite and remote productions by operating technical equipment and stepping into key production roles as needed

  • Assist with technical production functions, including camera shading, audio level management, intercom programming, and remote guest feed management

  • Operate and support live productions using TriCaster and vMix production switchers

  • Perform preventative maintenance and proactively identify, troubleshoot, and resolve hardware and software issues

  • Coordinate production equipment requests and technical support for creators and internal teams

  • Maintain accurate documentation for production systems, workflows, procedures, and equipment

  • Support media operations through content capture, media management, and delivery workflows

  • Coordinate hardware and software updates to maintain production system reliability

  • Travel as needed to support productions and technical operations

job.title: Platform Ops & Delivery (Sr. SDET)
job.description:
La plataforma directa al consumidor (DTC) de FOX es una iniciativa nueva y visionaria dentro de Tubi Media Group que lleva el incomparable portafolio de contenido de FOX —noticias, deportes y entretenimiento— directamente a los consumidores a través de un innovador servicio de streaming por suscripción.

Impulsado por un equipo de liderazgo altamente experimentado, con trayectorias en la intersección de los medios, la tecnología, el streaming y el contenido, y respaldado plenamente por Fox Corporation, este proyecto combina energía emprendedora con un profundo conocimiento de la industria de los medios.

Nuestra visión es crear una experiencia de visualización unificada y moderna que ponga al consumidor en primer lugar, integrando de forma fluida el contenido en vivo y bajo demanda en todas las plataformas.

En la intersección entre la tecnología de vanguardia y la narrativa de confianza, esta es una oportunidad para dar forma al futuro del streaming en uno de los momentos más decisivos de la industria de los medios. Estamos formando un equipo de clase mundial para cumplir esa visión, y apenas estamos comenzando.

FOX ONE es la aplicación de streaming directa al consumidor de FOX Corporation, ya activa y en operación en Estados Unidos. FOX ONE se está expandiendo ahora a América Latina, y buscamos a un(a) Sr. Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) con base en la Ciudad de México para liderar la ingeniería de calidad de esa expansión. Este es un rol de ingeniería altamente técnico y práctico, para alguien que ve la calidad como una disciplina central de la ingeniería y que pueda definir cómo se construye, prueba, lanza y monitorea la versión de FOX ONE para LATAM.

Como Sr. SDET, colaborarás estrechamente con los equipos de Producto, Ingeniería, Operaciones y Delivery desde las primeras etapas de planeación hasta producción. Te asegurarás de que la calidad se diseñe dentro del trabajo de expansión a LATAM, en lugar de validarse al final. Al comprender el producto actual de FOX ONE, los requisitos del mercado de LATAM y la arquitectura de la plataforma, identificarás riesgos de forma proactiva, definirás estrategias de pruebas y construirás capacidades de automatización en paralelo con el desarrollo de funcionalidades para la región.

Extenderás la plataforma de ingeniería de calidad ya existente de FOX ONE para dar soporte a la expansión en LATAM, adaptando los frameworks y las herramientas construidas para el producto de EE. UU. de modo que funcionen de forma confiable en los distintos idiomas, monedas, dispositivos y entornos regulatorios de México. Este rol requiere un fuerte criterio técnico e implementación práctica, junto con una colaboración cercana con el equipo de plataforma de EE. UU. para decidir qué se debe reutilizar y qué se debe reconstruir para la región.

El candidato o candidata ideal combina sólidas habilidades de ingeniería de software, experiencia consolidada en automatización de pruebas, una mentalidad orientada al producto y un enfoque “AI-first” hacia las pruebas y la ingeniería. Te sientes cómodo(a) cuestionando supuestos, contribuyendo a la dirección técnica y generando resultados de calidad dentro de tu equipo y de los equipos con los que colaboras de cerca, a medida que FOX ONE se expande a un nuevo mercado. Y lo más importante: entiendes que la calidad va más allá de las pruebas previas al lanzamiento y requiere una validación continua de la experiencia del cliente a lo largo de todo el ciclo de vida del producto.

  • Colaborar con los Product Managers y los equipos de Ingeniería, Operaciones y Delivery durante las fases de descubrimiento, planeación y diseño, para identificar desde el inicio los requisitos de calidad y los riesgos.

  • Contribuir a la estrategia de pruebas de las capacidades de plataforma usadas por tu equipo y por los equipos con los que colaboras de cerca.

  • Asegurar que Multiview y otras capacidades de la plataforma se prueben automáticamente en todos los dispositivos, configuraciones, tipos de contenido y escenarios de reproducción soportados.

job.title: Engineer Networking
job.description:
Descripción del puesto: Ingeniero de Networking Broadcast

Objetivo del puesto

Diseñar, implementar, operar y mantener la infraestructura de redes que soporta la producción, transmisión y distribución de contenido audiovisual.

La persona será responsable de garantizar la disponibilidad, estabilidad, seguridad y rendimiento de las redes utilizadas en estudios, centros de transmisión, operaciones de producción y plataformas de distribución.

Responsabilidades

  • Diseñar y administrar redes IP para ambientes de broadcast, producción y transmisión.
  • Implementar y mantener soluciones de video sobre IP utilizando estándares como SMPTE ST 2110 y ST 2022-6.
  • Configurar y solucionar problemas relacionados con routing, switching, multicast, QoS, VLAN, OSPF, BGP, IGMP y PIM.
  • Administrar soluciones de sincronización y referencia de tiempo mediante PTP y GPS.
  • Monitorear el rendimiento, disponibilidad, latencia, pérdida de paquetes y calidad de las señales.
  • Atender y resolver incidentes críticos durante transmisiones en vivo y eventos de alta audiencia.
  • Implementar esquemas de redundancia, alta disponibilidad, failover y recuperación ante desastres.
  • Colaborar con los equipos de Ingeniería, Transmisión, Producción, TI, Ciberseguridad y proveedores externos.
  • Participar en proyectos de expansión, modernización y migración de infraestructura broadcast.
  • Documentar arquitecturas, configuraciones, procedimientos operativos y planes de recuperación.
  • Aplicar controles de seguridad, segmentación de red y buenas prácticas de gestión de cambios.
  • Contribuir a la automatización y optimización de procesos operativos de networking.

Requisitos

  • Licenciatura o Ingeniería en Telecomunicaciones, Redes, Sistemas, Electrónica o carrera afín.
  • Experiencia en diseño, operación y soporte de redes empresariales o de broadcast.
  • Conocimientos sólidos de TCP/IP, VLAN, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP y NAT.
  • Conocimiento de protocolos y tecnologías de transmisión, como RTP, UDP y SRT.
  • Experiencia con herramientas de monitoreo y diagnóstico de redes.
  • Conocimiento de infraestructura de centros de datos, fibra óptica y enlaces WAN.
  • Capacidad para analizar incidentes, identificar causas raíz y responder bajo presión.
  • Disponibilidad para atender mantenimientos, eventos especiales e incidentes críticos.
  • Inglés técnico para la lectura de documentación y comunicación con proveedores.
  • Conocimiento de protocolos de contribución y distribución, como RIST, Zixi, NDI y WebRTC.
  • Experiencia en streaming, OTT, CDN y distribución digital de contenido.
  • Conocimientos de audio sobre IP, como Dante y AES67.

Conocimientos deseables

  • Experiencia práctica con SMPTE ST 2110, ST 2022-6 y PTP.
  • Experiencia con cloud networking en AWS, Azure o Google Cloud.
  • Conocimientos de SDN, SD-WAN, virtualización y redes híbridas.
  • Conocimientos de ciberseguridad aplicada a redes y sistemas broadcast.
  • Certificaciones Cisco, Juniper, AWS, Microsoft u otros fabricantes de tecnología broadcast.
  • Experiencia en gestión de incidentes y continuidad operativa.

Competencias

  • Pensamiento analítico y resolución de problemas.
  • Orientación a la disponibilidad y continuidad del servicio.

job.description:
Red Seat Ventures partners with the world's top creators across multiple genres to grow and monetize their content — through advertising, subscription, live events, and beyond. We take a multiplatform approach spanning podcasting, video, FAST, and more, backed by our own proprietary tech stack including Supercast (subscription) and Speakeasy (hosting, distribution, and monetization).

Named after Ted Williams' longest home run at Fenway Park, RSV was built with a simple mandate: swing for the fences. Today, we're the fastest-growing creator network, backed by Tubi Media Group and Fox Corporation.

POSITION OVERVIEW

Red Seat Ventures is seeking a creative and highly organized Sales Marketing Presentation Designer to support our Sales and Marketing teams. This person will develop compelling, visually engaging presentations and sales materials that help communicate the value of our creators, content, audience, and advertising solutions.

The ideal candidate combines strong visual design skills with an understanding of sales storytelling. They will be able to take complex information, data, and ideas and turn them into clear, polished, and persuasive materials for advertisers, agencies, partners, and internal stakeholders.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design and develop high-quality sales presentations, pitch decks, RFP responses, media kits, one-sheets, case studies, and other marketing materials.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Programming teams to understand business objectives and translate them into effective visual stories.
  • Create customized presentations for advertisers, agencies, and strategic partners.
  • Organize complex information, audience data, campaign results, and advertising solutions into clear and compelling presentations.
  • Develop layouts, graphics, charts, infographics, and other visual assets that enhance the sales narrative.
  • Maintain consistency across RSV’s brand, creator, show, and advertising materials.
  • Help build and maintain presentation templates, sales collateral libraries, and design standards.
  • Review materials for accuracy, grammar, formatting, and brand consistency before distribution.
  • Manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Incorporate feedback from multiple stakeholders while maintaining strong design judgment and attention to detail.
  • Stay current on presentation design trends, advertising formats, media industry developments, and emerging tools.
  • Support special projects, events, and other marketing initiatives as needed.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3–5 years of experience in presentation design, graphic design, sales enablement, marketing design, or a related field.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating presentation design, storytelling, information design, and visual communication.
  • Advanced experience with PowerPoint and/or Google Slides.
  • Experience with design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Canva, or similar platforms.
  • Strong understanding of typography, layout, color, composition, and visual hierarchy.
  • Ability to turn complex information and data into simple, understandable visuals.
  • Excellent attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities at the same time.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with senior leaders and cross-functional teams.
  • Interest in media, advertising, podcasting, creators, and digital content.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience supporting a media, advertising, sales, entertainment, or technology organization.
  • Experience creating materials for advertisers, agencies, or brand partners.
  • Familiarity with media measurement, audience insights, advertising terminology, and campaign reporting.
  • Experience designing materials for live presentations and executive meetings including senior leadership offsites, financial planning, and revenue operations discussion..
  • Basic knowledge of motion graphics, video editing, or interactive presentation tools.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced start-up or high-growth environment.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Sales teams have polished, persuasive, and on-brand materials that help them win business.
  • Presentations clearly communicate the value of RSV’s creators, content, audiences, and advertising solutions.
  • Materials are delivered accurately and on time, even when priorities shift.
  • Sales and Marketing teams have organized, reusable templates and collateral.

  • The RSV brand is represented consistently across all sales and marketing materials.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Red Seat Ventures is seeking a curious, detail-oriented Research Analyst to help tell the story of our podcast and creator audiences and demonstrate the value of advertising across our portfolio.

Working closely with Research, Sales and Marketing, you will translate audience research and campaign performance data into clear insights that support advertiser proposals, campaign evaluation and renewals. You will gain hands-on experience with podcast audience measurement, brand lift studies and attribution while helping connect advertiser objectives to measurable results.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop audience profiles that highlight listeners’ demographics, interests, purchasing behaviors and relevance to prospective advertisers.
  • Use syndicated research, audience data and marketplace intelligence to support sales proposals, advertiser requests and competitive positioning.
  • Track podcast consumption, creator trends and competitive advertising activity to identify opportunities for our sales teams.
  • Maintain recurring reports, research databases and presentation materials, ensuring accuracy and documenting sources.
  • Support the design and execution of custom surveys and brand lift studies, including questionnaire review, fieldwork tracking and analysis.
  • Help evaluate campaign results against advertiser objectives, including awareness, favorability, consideration, purchase intent and behavioral response.
  • Assist with attribution reporting to understand website visits, conversions and other advertiser outcomes associated with podcast campaigns.
  • Create clear campaign recaps, charts and case studies that explain findings, highlight limitations and identify useful recommendations.
  • Translate research insights, audience behavior and industry trends into compelling sales presentations and marketing initiatives that demonstrate RSV’s value to advertisers.
  • Partner with the research lead in client-facing meetings to present research findings and communicate key insights that inform ad sales strategies and client recommendations.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Approximately 1–2 years of relevant experience in media research, advertising analytics, consumer insights or a related field. Relevant internships may count toward this experience.
  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with close attention to data quality and accuracy.
  • Proficiency in Excel, including formulas, pivot tables and charts, and the ability to create clear PowerPoint presentations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain what findings mean for a business question.
  • Foundational understanding of survey research, sample sizes, comparisons and advertising performance metrics.
  • Strong organization and follow-through, with the ability to balance recurring assignments and time-sensitive requests.
  • Interest in podcasts, digital creators, audience behavior and advertising effectiveness.

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Familiarity with podcast audience research and intelligence sources such as Edison Research, Podtrac, Triton Digital, MRI-Simmons, Magellan AI or MediaRadar.
  • Exposure to attribution and campaign measurement platforms such as Podscribe, Spotify Ad Analytics, Claritas or ArtsAI.
  • Experience supporting brand lift studies or working with research partners such as Veritonic, Nielsen, Dynata or YouGov.
  • Familiarity with podcast advertising formats, including host-read sponsorships and dynamically inserted ads.
  • Basic understanding of attribution, incrementality and the distinction between audience delivery, brand impact and conversion outcomes.
  • A bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience

NBCUniversal’s Ad Sales Creative Group, part of Rock Studios, is an industry-leading, award-winning team that develops groundbreaking creative campaigns and premium marketing experiences for the world’s most influential brands. We partner closely with advertisers to deliver custom, multi-platform solutions that leverage the power of NBCUniversal’s iconic content, talent, intellectual property and audiences across linear, streaming, digital, social and live experiences.

We are seeking a Senior Executive Producer to serve as one of the senior production leaders within Rock Studios. You will oversee a significant slate of advertising and marketing productions, partnering with creative, sales, clients and internal business teams to bring ambitious ideas from concept through final delivery.

As an ideal candidate, you will have deep production expertise with strategic leadership, strong creative instincts and exceptional business judgment. You'll need extensive experience producing integrated campaigns across a wide range of budgets, timelines and production models and be equally comfortable developing a production approach, negotiating a major production bid, finding smart solutions within limited resources, advising senior stakeholders, managing high-profile talent, leading a set, and solving problems when the unexpected happens.

This is both a hands-on Executive Producer and senior leadership role. You will directly oversee marquee projects while mentoring production teams, strengthening external partnerships and helping evolve how Rock Studios approaches production at scale.

This position reports directly to the Vice President, Production & Operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as Executive Producer across a diverse portfolio of advertising, branded content and integrated marketing initiatives—from lean, fast-turn assignments to complex marquee productions—overseeing work from early creative development and scoping through production, post-production and final delivery.

  • Lead production across a broad range of formats, including custom branded content, digital and social campaigns, talent-led content, original branded entertainment series.

  • Maintain strong working knowledge of production contracts, rights and clearances, music licensing, releases, insurance, labor requirements and applicable union and guild considerations.
  • Serve as a trusted senior production partner to internal stakeholders, clients and agencies, helping teams understand production implications, solve challenges and establish realistic scopes, budgets and timelines.
  • Participate in the development and pitching of major opportunities when production strategy, feasibility, budgeting or executional expertise is required.
  • Build trusted relationships across NBCUniversal and with clients, agencies and external partners, representing Rock Studios with credibility and authority in senior-level conversations.
  • Oversee and mentor producers and freelance production teams, establishing clear expectations and helping develop the next generation of production leaders.
  • Partner with the Vice President, Production & Operations on resource planning, production forecasting, staffing strategy, vendor strategy and allocation of production resources across the broader slate.
  • Help evolve Rock Studios’ production organization by identifying opportunities to improve workflows, methodologies and infrastructure while fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, creative ambition and responsible financial stewardship.
  • Proactively assess creative, financial, logistical, legal and reputational risk and develop solutions before those risks affect the work.

Requirements

  • Deep expertise in advertising and marketing production, with significant experience leading multi-platform campaigns across a range of scales and budgets—from lean, fast-turn productions to complex, high-budget work.

  • Ability to operate simultaneously as a strategic production leader and hands-on Executive Producer, leading multiple concurrent productions while maintaining command of creative, financial and logistical details.
  • Exceptional understanding of physical production and post-production workflows across live action, editorial, VFX, motion design, music, audio and finishing.
  • Strong command of production finance, including estimating, bidding, negotiating, cost management, forecasting and reconciliation, with the ability to maximize production value at varying budget levels.
  • Extensive experience managing directors, production companies, freelance producers, crews and post-production partners.
  • Strong knowledge of production business affairs, talent agreements, music and footage licensing, releases, rights and clearances, union and guild requirements and other production-related legal considerations.
  • Proven experience producing with celebrity or high-profile talent and managing sensitive, high-stakes productions.
  • Strong creative judgment with the ability to contribute meaningfully to creative conversations while understanding the distinction between creative leadership and production leadership.
  • Exceptional business judgment, communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to balance creative ambition, client objectives, production realities and financial responsibility while working with senior executives, clients, creative leaders and external partners.

  • Strong leadership and mentorship skills with experience developing producers and building high-performing production teams.

  • 12+ years of professional production experience, including substantial experience in advertising, branded content, marketing or agency production.
  • Significant experience serving as an Executive Producer or equivalent senior production leader on integrated advertising and marketing campaigns.
  • Proven track record of delivering complex productions on time, on budget and at a consistently high creative standard.
  • Experience managing production budgets of varying scale and complexity and negotiating with production companies, vendors and creative partners.
  • Willingness to travel and work outside traditional business hours when productions require it.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The Product Manager, Enterprise Data & AI will be part of our Enterprise Data + AI Product organization and will help turn business problems into products, solutions and experiences that create measurable value across NBCUniversal. 

This is a hands-on product builder role at the intersection of business, product, data and AI. The Product Manager will work directly with business and product teams to understand how they work, uncover meaningful problems and opportunities, connect those needs to our enterprise capabilities, and help move ideas from discovery through validation and adoption. 

The ideal candidate combines strong product judgment with business curiosity, technical fluency and a bias toward action. You should be equally comfortable talking with a business stakeholder, understanding how a data or AI capability works, shaping a use case, building or prototyping a solution with modern tools, developing a clear product story and determining whether the resulting experience is creating value. 

This is not a traditional Product Manager role centered solely on managing a feature backlog. It is a role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, operates with high ownership and uses technology… particularly AI, to shorten the distance between an idea and a meaningful business outcome. 

What you will own (day-to-day): 

  • Business discovery and stakeholder engagement to identify meaningful problems, opportunities and use cases 
  • Translation of business needs into clear product opportunities, hypotheses, outcomes and success measures 
  • Rapid prototyping and experimentation to make ideas tangible and accelerate learning 
  • Product positioning, demos, enablement and other go-to-market motions that drive understanding and adoption 
  • Voice of the Customer and product feedback loops that inform future priorities 
  • Adoption and business-value measurement for priority initiatives 
  • Clear communication between business, Product, Data, Engineering and AI teams 
  • AI-enabled ways of working that increase speed, quality and individual leverage 

Responsibilities: 

  • Business Discovery & Use-Case Development: Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across the enterprise, understand their workflows and proactively uncover problems, opportunities and unmet needs — including needs that may not initially be well articulated. 
  • Product Opportunity Development: Translate stakeholder needs into clear use cases, product opportunities, hypotheses and measurable outcomes; connect those opportunities to existing enterprise products and capabilities whenever possible. 
  • Build, Prototype & Validate: Use modern AI-assisted development, prototyping and workflow tools to rapidly bring ideas to life, test assumptions and create tangible experiences that accelerate learning and decision-making. 
  • Product Adoption & Enablement: Develop the positioning, demonstrations, enablement materials and engagement motions necessary to help stakeholders understand, adopt and successfully use enterprise products and capabilities. 
  • Voice of the Customer & Feedback Loops: Establish structured feedback loops using stakeholder input, qualitative insights, usage signals and business outcomes to identify friction, unmet needs and opportunities for improvement. 
  • Data & Success Measurement: Define and track appropriate measures of adoption, engagement and business value; use quantitative and qualitative data to tell a clear story and drive decisions. 
  • Product Strategy Partnership: Bring business, customer and adoption signal back to Product Managers and product leaders to help inform roadmap priorities, investment decisions and future portfolio direction. 
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner across Product Management, Product Operations, Engineering, Data, AI and business teams to determine the right path from opportunity to scalable solution without relying on formal authority. 
  • Translate Complexity into Clarity: Make sophisticated data, technology and AI capabilities understandable and actionable through clear product narratives, demos, executive-ready materials and reusable enablement assets. 
  • AI-Enabled Ways of Working: Apply AI throughout discovery, research, analysis, prototyping, documentation and workflow automation, while continually identifying new opportunities to increase organizational leverage and self-service. 

Primary Stakeholders: 

  • Product Managers and Product Operations teams across Enterprise Data + AI 
  • Engineering, Data and AI product teams 
  • Business teams that consume enterprise data, technology and AI products, including Marketing, Advertising, Analytics and other enterprise functions 
  • Executive leadership and business partners evaluating new capabilities and opportunities 
  • External technology partners and vendors, where appropriate 

Requirements:  

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. 
  • 5+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Strategy, technical Product Marketing, MarTech/AdTech, Solutions, Data/AI products, customer-facing technology or a related product and technology discipline. 
  • Demonstrated ability to take an ambiguous customer or business problem from discovery through a clear product opportunity, solution or measurable outcome. 
  • Strong product judgment and customer-discovery skills, including the ability to challenge a stated request and uncover the underlying business need. 
  • Strong data fluency and comfort working with analytics, metrics, data products and technical concepts. 
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development, prototyping or automation tools to turn ideas into working prototypes, workflows or other tangible solutions. 
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling and actionable guidance for both technical and non-technical audiences. 
  • Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership skills with demonstrated ability to influence without formal authority. 
  • Proven ability to operate independently, create structure from ambiguity and drive work from problem through outcome with minimal oversight. 
  • Excellent written, verbal and visual communication skills. 

Desired Characteristics:  

  • Experience with enterprise data platforms, MarTech, AdTech, identity, CRM, analytics, AI platforms or other data-intensive product environments. 
  • Experience with GitHub Copilot strongly preferred; experience with Claude Code, Cursor or similar AI development environments is also valuable. 
  • Experience building prototypes, lightweight applications, automations or agentic workflows without relying exclusively on an Engineering team. 
  • Experience developing product positioning, go-to-market strategies, demonstrations, enablement or adoption programs for technical products. 
  • Experience establishing Voice of the Customer, customer-success, product usage or adoption feedback loops. 
  • Familiarity with modern product and collaboration tools such as GitHub, Jira, Confluence, Figma and analytics/BI platforms. 
  • Builder mentality with a bias toward experimentation, learning and tangible outcomes over process for process’s sake. 
  • Intellectual curiosity and willingness to rapidly learn unfamiliar business and technical domains. 
  • Strong ownership mindset and follow-through; proactive driver who identifies gaps and moves work forward without waiting for perfect clarity. 
  • Ability to move fluidly between strategy and execution — from senior-level business conversations to hands-on building and problem solving. 

Additional Requirements:

  • Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $110,000 - $145,000

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. As Learning Experience Designer within the Leadership Capability & Learning COE, you are the team’s primary design expert responsible for translating strategic capability priorities into high-quality, engaging, and effective development experiences (e-learning, instructor-led training, etc.). You create solutions that are modern, immersive, and genuinely impactful. Where others see a slide deck, you see an opportunity for a simulation. Where others see a workshop, you see a multi-modal experience that extends into the flow of work. Where others see a leadership program, you see a design challenge. 
You work in close partnership with the Sr. Manager, Leadership Capability, who sets the strategic design direction – diagnosing capability gaps and defining what behavior change needs to happen. Your role is to bring that direction to life with craft, creativity, a deep understanding of how adults learn, and a strong point of view on the tools, technologies, and emerging practices that can make learning more effective. You operate with significant creative autonomy within that partnership, bringing your own ideas, pushing the boundaries of what development experiences can be, and continuously raising the bar for what great looks like. 
Beyond individual experiences, you are also the visual and design standard-bearer for the COE. You own how this function presents itself to leaders, the business, and the broader organization. That means owning the COE's visual design standards and templates so that every deliverable that comes out of this function looks and feels like it belongs to the same world. 

Major Responsibilities
Design & Build Immersive Learning Experiences 

  • Design and build simulations, scenario-based experiences, experiential labs, and immersive learning environments that put leaders in realistic situations and require them to make real decisions. 
  • Develop engaging, high-quality e-learning and digital learning assets that extend development into the flow of work, not just for formal learning moments but for the spaces in between. 
  • Translate the defined capability priorities and design direction into concrete learning experiences, bringing creative solutions to the build. 
  • Prototype rapidly, pilot with real learners, gather feedback, and iterate, always optimizing for behavior change over production polish. 
  • Build a reusable library of design assets, templates, and components that accelerate future work and ensure design consistency across the COE's portfolio. 

Set & Own Visual Design Standards 

  • Establish and maintain visual design standards for the Leadership Capability & Learning COE – defining the look, feel, and quality bar for all deliverables including program materials, participant guides, presentations, and digital assets. 
  • Build a template library that is practical, flexible, and easy for others to use so that design standards get maintained even when you are not the one producing the output. 
  • Bring visual storytelling expertise to the design of leadership experiences, ensuring that the narrative arc of every program, module, and asset is as intentional as its instructional design. 
  • Translate complex leadership concepts, capability frameworks, and development models into visuals that are immediately legible to a theme park operations leader as much as to an HR professional. 
  • Elevate the quality of how the COE communicates its strategy, impact, and value through decks, one-pagers, infographics, and other visual communication formats.

Own Learning Technology & Innovation 

  • Own all internal instructional design and learning production tools – selecting, managing, and maintaining proficiency in the technologies that power the COE's design work. 
  • Actively monitor and experiment with emerging learning technologies including AI-powered development tools, immersive and simulation platforms, adaptive learning technologies, and other innovations reshaping how people develop. 
  • Bring a point of view on what the COE should be doing differently based on what you are seeing in the field – not just executing on existing ideas but challenging the standard. 
  • Partner with Learning Operations on any technology decisions that intersect with leader-facing platforms, ensuring alignment on sustainability, budget, and operational support. 
  • Integrate AI meaningfully into design and delivery – not as a gimmick but as a genuine capability enabler that makes development more personalized, more scalable, and more effective.

Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.

Perform other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibility

  • ​​Individual Contributor​  

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required. 

  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, Learning Technology, experience design, or a related field – or equivalent demonstrated experience with a portfolio that proves it. 

Experience

  • 3+ years of experience designing and building learning or development experiences end to end. 
  • Demonstrated proficiency in e-learning authoring tools such as Articulate Storyline, Articulate Rise, Adobe Captivate, or equivalent. 
  • Strong visual design and visual communication skills with a portfolio that demonstrates high-quality, polished work across multiple formats and modalities. Portfolio submission is required with application. 
  • Working knowledge of adult learning theory and learning science, with the ability to articulate why design choices work and how they connect to how adults actually learn.  
  • Experience designing beyond the classroom (simulations, scenario-based learning, experiential modules, or immersive digital learning assets).

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, and we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is…YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team that values authenticity and embraces inclusion for all. We are searching for individuals who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees. You fuel our culture of purpose, passion, and collaboration. We’re in this together.

Senior Software Engineer, Front End – CBS Sports Digital

Req: 45930 | Department: CBS Sports.com Technology | Type: Full-Time, On-Site Locations: Nashville, TN; Louisville, KY; Fort Lauderdale, FL

 

 

 

About the Role

Join CBS Sports Digital and help build the web experiences that millions of sports fans use every day across CBSSports.com and our apps. We are looking for a Senior Front End Engineer to join our Content Management team, a small engineering group that partners closely with design and product to turn ideas into fast, accessible, production-grade fan experiences.

 

You will own the quality of what fans see and feel: how fast pages load, how components behave, and how reliably we ship. Candidates with Lead-level scope are also encouraged to apply.

What You Will Do

  • Build Front-End Features: Design and ship production-grade features for web using React, Next.js, and TypeScript, from prototype through launch.

  • Own Performance: Improve and protect Core Web Vitals through rendering strategy, code splitting, lazy loading, and image and asset optimization.

  • Contribute to Standards: Build and evolve reusable components and shared patterns that scale across the organization.

  • Collaborate and Prototype: Work with design and product to quickly design, develop, and test solutions to key business challenges.

  • Raise the Bar on Code Quality: Review code for style, testability, accessibility, and efficiency, and mentor engineers on front-end best practices.

  • Type Safety: Contribute to TypeScript standards (strict mode, shared types, codegen) so our codebases stay maintainable and refactor-safe.

  • Monorepo Workflows: Use and contribute to monorepo tooling (e.g., Turborepo, Nx) to support build, test, and deploy across web applications.

  • Operational Excellence: Build with reliability in mind, including testing, front-end monitoring, and alerting.

  • Document: Contribute clear documentation and diagrams to help onboard other engineers.

  • Use AI Tools: Use AI development tools to speed up your workflow and share what works with the team.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience building scalable, production-grade web applications with React and Next.js.

  • Strong expertise in JavaScript and TypeScript, including asynchronous programming, generics, strict typing, and modern ES6+ features.

  • Deep knowledge of HTML and CSS, including responsive layout, cross-browser compatibility, accessibility, and performance optimization.

  • Solid understanding of browser behavior, rendering, and front-end performance (e.g., Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, code splitting).

  • Experience consuming APIs (REST and GraphQL), including Apollo Client.

  • Experience with monorepo tooling and workflows (e.g., Turborepo, Nx), including shared packages and task pipelines.

  • Experience with component libraries or design systems and with testing front-end code (unit, integration, end-to-end).

  • Working knowledge of Node.js for server-side rendering and API layers.

  • Strong debugging and performance troubleshooting skills, including monitoring tools (e.g., New Relic, OpenTelemetry).

  • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.

  • BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

  • Passion for sports and a dedication to creating exceptional fan experiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with multiple styling approaches (StyleX, CSS Modules, SASS, CSS-in-JS) and design tokens.

  • Exposure to CMS platforms such as WordPress, Drupal, Joomla, or Magento.

  • Experience with AI development tools (Cursor, Copilot, etc.) and with setting up guardrails (rules, commands, skills, sub-agents) to keep AI-generated code clean and production-ready.

  • Familiarity with Generative AI and RAG concepts, or experience building AI-powered features.

  • Cloud experience (AWS preferred) and familiarity with containers (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Familiarity with caching (Redis, Memcached) and messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ).

  • Cloud certifications (AWS, GCP, OCI).

 

CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR. 

In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage. 

CBS Sports also delivers an extensive lineup of global soccer coverage on Paramount+, including every UEFA club competition match, all Serie A matches as well as Concacaf national team competitions, and produces INSIDE THE NFL for Paramount+. CBS Sports Digital's multi-platform offerings include CBSSports.com and the CBS Sports apps for mobile and connected TV devices; the 24/7 streaming sports news network CBS Sports HQ; 247Sports; MaxPreps; CBS Sports fantasy games; and SportsLine.

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.
 
Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.  If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO! 
 
In Australia, we deliver premium content on any screen, anytime, anywhere, via an enhanced viewing ecosystem.   We pride ourselves on creating content that gets people talking and you can watch and stream for free on 10, 10 Drama, 10 Comedy and Nickelodeon, plus a vast array of Free Ad-Supported Streaming TV (FAST channels) as well as our subscription video on demand service Paramount+.  

 

 

We now have an opportunity for a junior video editor to join our team at Paramount and Network 10 based in Pyrmont. 

 ** this role is permanent full-time, and you must be available to work a 7-day rotating roster.

 

Enough about us! What you’ll do as a Video Editor:

 

You’ll combine your creative flair and technical skills to produce broadcast-quality video content for News, Programming and Production across both linear and digital platforms.

 

Day-to-day, you’ll support our fast-paced News operations, predominantly reformatting international content and editing assets for 10 News programs, while also gaining exposure to a diverse mix of projects and productions.

 

Working with state-of-the-art editing tools in a supportive, high-morale team, you’ll have the chance to expand your skills, collaborate across business units, and engage in storytelling that informs and inspires.   This is a place where variety is the norm, teamwork is strong, and learning opportunities are everywhere!

  

Functions will include:  

  • Manage the ingest, asset management, quality control, distribution, and receipt of News media assets across the network, affiliates, and third parties
  • Edit and deliver high-quality media content for News, Programming and Production using Avid Media Composer and other NLE tools
  • Prepare, QC, and adapt broadcast programs to meet technical and compliance standards across free-to-air, catch-up, and streaming platforms
  • Operate studio EVS systems (IP-Director, LSM-VIA and X-File) to support live studio productions, archive, and restore media assets
  • Contribute to pre-production and creative editing processes, ensuring all content is delivered accurately, on time, and to broadcast-ready standards.

 

What are we looking for in a Video Editor? What’s important?   

  • Proven experience with non-linear editing systems (preferably Avid Media Composer) and technical literacy across video production workflows
  • Ability to thrive under tight deadlines while maintaining attention to detail, accuracy, and editorial integrity in a fast-paced news production environment
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a customer-focused approach and the ability to build positive relationships across teams
  • Creative mindset with a genuine interest in storytelling and crafting engaging content, alongside adaptability to reformat, edit, and deliver content for multiple platforms

job.title: Chief Photographer
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

WTSP-TV (10 Tampa Bay News), the TEGNA-owned CBS affiliate in Saint Petersburg, FL, is looking for a Chief Photographer to lead our team of photojournalists to visual excellence across broadcast, streaming, digital and social platforms.
This is a hands-on leadership role. Our Chief Photographer sets the bar in the field, shooting and editing daily and breaking news, while scheduling, supervising and coaching our photojournalists and MSJs. You'll own our field equipment and fleet, plan crew coverage for hurricanes and other major events, and partner with news managers to recruit and develop the next generation of visual storytellers at 10 Tampa Bay News.

The Ideal Candidate
You are a highly skilled, creative photojournalist and storyteller who loves local news. You lead by example, coach with clear and constructive feedback, and inspire a team to raise its standards every day. You're organized, calm on deadline, a breaking news champion, and always looking for the next tool or technique that helps us tell better stories for our audience.

Responsibilities:
In this role, you will:
• Shoot, edit and go live on daily news, enterprise and breaking stories, leading by example in the field
• Set and maintain visual and storytelling standards for the photojournalism team
• Coach photojournalists and MSJs on storytelling, lighting, audio, natural sound, composition and editing through regular critiques and hands-on training
• Build and manage photojournalist schedules covering all newscasts, streaming and digital needs, including nights, weekends, holidays and severe weather
• Supervise photojournalists day to day, including assignments, time and attendance, overtime and performance
• Manage field equipment and the news fleet, including inventory, maintenance, repairs, budgeting and purchase recommendations for cameras, audio, lighting, bonded cellular units and news vehicles
• Oversee the station's drone program in partnership with news leadership and TEGNA's drone team, including FAA compliance and pilot certification
• Plan crew deployment and logistics for hurricanes, elections, major sporting events and other large-scale coverage
• Work closely with the assignment desk, producers and managers to match crews to stories
• Partner with news managers to source, interview, onboard and train new photojournalists
• Uphold TEGNA's ethics, safety and legal standards in the field
• Take part in the management on-call rotation
• Perform other tasks as required by the news leadership team

Requirements:
Here's what you need:
• 7+ years of experience as a news photojournalist/editor, preferably in a local TV newsroom

job.title: Consumer Product Strategist
job.description:
The Associated Press is an independent global news organization dedicated to factual reporting. Founded in 1846, AP today remains the most trusted source of fast, accurate, unbiased news in all formats and the essential provider of the technology and services vital to the news business. More than half the world's population sees AP journalism every day.

The Associated Press seeks a Consumer Product Strategist for AP News based in New York City. We are a hybrid environment, with employees on site Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.  

  

About the Role  

As a Consumer Product Strategist, you will help AP News better understand its audience and use those insights to shape the future of our digital products and user experience. You will look beyond the numbers to uncover the story of how users discover, experience and engage across web and app platforms, turning those findings into clear, actionable recommendations that inform product strategy, experimentation and long-term growth.  

 

This role sits at the intersection of consumer insights, product strategy and analytics. The ideal candidate is naturally curious about consumers, comfortable digging into data and skilled at communicating what the data means with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.  

  

What You'll Do: 

  • Analyze how audiences discover, navigate and engage with AP News by building repeatable analyses and dashboards in BigQuery, Looker, Omni and Hex to identify patterns in user behavior, feature adoption, engagement and friction points 

  • Connect behavioral data across journeys, funnels, features and retention to explain not just what is happening, but why 

  • Support tracking implementation in Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager to ensure the right data is captured to answer critical product and business questions  

  • Translate complex product and user data into clear recommendations that inform product priorities, audience growth and monetization decisions  

  • Identify strategic opportunities to improve user journeys, feature design and engagement funnels to deepen loyalty   

  • Development and evaluate product experiments and A/B tests, turning results into actionable product recommendations  

  • Build trusted relationships across product, editorial and technical teams to bring consumer insights into product decisions 

  • Translate business questions into meaningful analysis and clearly communicate what the data means  

  • Collaborate with technical teams to ensure data infrastructure supports critical decisions 

  

Who You Are:  

  • You have 3+ years of professional experience in digital product analytics, product strategy, growth analytics, audience insights, user analytics or a related role  

  • You have a bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as communications, journalism, Data Science, Marketing or equivalent professional experience 

  • You communicate effectively and are a strong storyteller who can take complex or ambiguous data and turn it into a clear narrative about consumers, products and business opportunities 

  • You have demonstrated ability to analyze user behavior, product performance and using those insights to influence product or business decisions 

  • You bring curiosity, consumer empathy and sound judgment to open-ended questions and are comfortable making recommendations  

  • You have strong SQL skills and working knowledge of Python or R for querying large datasets, identifying trends and building repeatable analyses  

  • You have hands-on experience with analytics and visualization tools such as BigQuery, Hex, Omni and Looker

  • You have experience with Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager, including event tracking and measurement strategy  

  • You are comfortable collaborating with product managers, engineers, editorial teams and other cross-functional stakeholders 

 

What will set you apart:  

  • Experience using consumer insights to influence the strategy or development of a digital consumer product 

  • Experience in digital publishing, media subscription, marketplace or other content-driven consumer products  

  • Background working with BigQuery or other large-scale data warehousing platforms  

  • Familiarity with content recommendation systems or personalization strategies  

  • Experience with experimental design and A/B testing platforms  

  

  

Why join us:  

  • A mission-driven, inclusive environment focused on both individual and collective success.   

  • Opportunities for professional development to help you reach your career goals.   

  • Access to tools, mentorship, and resources tailored to elevate your proficiency and contributions.      

  

The anticipated salary range for this position is $103,000 – $128,000, based on a candidate’s skills and qualifications. The Associated Press offers comprehensive benefits, which include:      

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage      

  • Retirement benefits      

  • Company paid life insurance      

  • Paid vacation and sick days      

  • Paid parental leave for any new parent      

  • Mental well-being resources

We support all aspects of diversity and provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, status as a veteran, or other characteristic protected by law.
