job.title: VP, Ad Operations & Campaign Management
job.description:
About the Daily Beast

The Daily Beast delivers award-winning original reporting and sharp opinions from big personalities in the arenas of politics, pop culture, world news, and more. Fiercely independent and armed with irreverent intelligence, The Daily Beast now reaches more than 20 million readers per month.

Job Description

The Daily Beast is seeking a dynamic and dedicated VP, Ad Operations & Campaign Management to join our news team.

About the Role

We're hiring an analytical, hands-on and detail-oriented leader to run our ad business across our audience of nearly 50 million. You'll lead a small team, manage ad tech and inventory performance, and make sure every campaign delivers and every client comes back.

What You'll Do

  • Lead, coach and grow a small team across ad operations, media planning and campaign management, including full-time contractor resources
  • Partner with Sales and Marketing on RFPs, media plans and avails that win business and are built to deliver
  • Bring fresh thinking to how we manage and package our wide range of inventory, including web, in-app, podcasts, newsletters, social and more, and partner with Sales and Product to develop new ad products across these and emerging channels
  • Set the standard for flawless campaign execution, from launch, trafficking and QA through pacing, delivery and post-sale reporting, and turn results into renewals
  • Drive ad tech and performance across all inventory: viewability, fill, ad load, page speed and discrepancies
  • Lead the ad tech stack strategy and operations (GAM, header bidding, SSP integrations, ads.txt, CMP), plus verification and measurement vendors
  • Partner with EPD (Engineering, Product & Design) and Programmatic as a key stakeholder on all things ad product
  • Work with the Programmatic team on new partner integrations and A/B tests of new products and solutions, balancing revenue growth with page experience
  • Build the workflows and reporting that give leadership a clear view of campaign and delivery health
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for priority clients

What You Bring

  • 10+ years in digital ad operations or campaign management, ideally at a publisher; 5+ years leading teams
  • Expert in ad tech platforms (GAM, SSPs, OMS) and programmatic
  • Cross-channel campaign experience beyond web display
  • Full sales cycle experience: RFPs, media planning, execution, reporting and renewals
  • Hands-on with Boostr (or similar), DoubleVerify/IAS, Comscore and Google Analytics
  • Track record of improving delivery, efficiency and retention, with the numbers to show it
  • Analytical, detail-oriented and hands-on with data; calm and decisive in a fast-paced environment

Pay Range Salary

The pay range for this position is $140,000 - $175,000.

The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high ends of the salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location, experience, performance, and other factors.

Additional Information

Don’t meet every single requirement listed here? If you’re interested in joining the Beast but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with this job description, we encourage you to give it a shot all the same. It might turn out that you’re just the right candidate for this or other roles. See more about our commitment to diversity at https://www.thedailybeast.com/company/diversity

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

job.title: Intern, Membership Accounts
job.description:
INTERNSHIP DETAILS 

 

SPRING INTERNSHIP 

APPLICATION DEADLINE FOR STUDENTS: 11/20/2026 

SPRING INTERNSHIP PROGRAM DATES: 1/11/2027 – 4/16/2027  

*The Membership Accounts Intern position pays county/state minimum wage rates, based on work location. 

 

 

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 

 

The Recording Academy Membership Accounts team is seeking a “rock star” student for a spring 2027 Internship with our team. 


Celebrating music through the Grammy® Awards, The Recording Academy continues its legacy as the premier national organization for honoring achievements in the recording arts and supporting the music community. As a membership organization, we represent the most talented music professionals in the world. Our members include recording artists, producers, engineers, attorneys, music supervisors, composers/arrangers, managers, agents, social media and record label executives and many others. 


Our paid Internship Program offers a unique opportunity for full-time college students (juniors or seniors) to gain on-site training in office administration, events management and artist relations, in exchange for college credit. Candidates should be energetic, hard-working and have aspirations of a career in the music industry.



WHAT YOU'LL DO


  • Internship duration is for a semester (12 weeks or equivalent).
  • Hours are part-time (20-24 hours a week).
  • Intern will work in support of the membership outreach team that works on membership recruitment strategy.  
  • Internship will provide in-depth exposure to professional recording industry.
  • Projects may include research across genres for prospective members, data entry, correspondence, database management and general administrative support. 



SKILLS & EXPERIENCE


  • Currently enrolled in a college/university. One year of course work towards degree in related field is preferred.
  • Letter from school stating that intern will receive college credit for the Recording Academy internship.
  • Display an interest in music and commitment to a career in the recording industry.
  • Possess strong verbal, written and analytical skills.
  • Exhibit proficient computer skills.
  • Be a junior, senior or graduate student.
  • Salesforce experience a plus.



PHYSICAL DEMANDS FOR CERTAIN ROLES:   

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.   


While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, and sit for long periods of time, and work at a computer for long periods of time. The employee will be required to lift and/or move up to 60 pounds.   

 

 

ABOUT THE RECORDING ACADEMY AND ITS AFFILIATES 

 

RECORDING ACADEMY 

The Recording Academy represents the voices of performers, songwriters, producers, engineers, and all music professionals. Dedicated to ensuring the recording arts remain a thriving part of our shared cultural heritage, the Academy honors music's history while investing in its future through the Grammy Museum, advocates on behalf of music creators, supports music people in times of need through MusiCares, and celebrates artistic excellence through the Grammy Awards—music's only peer-recognized accolade and highest achievement. As the world's leading society of music professionals, we work year-round to foster a more inspiring world for creators. 

 

LATIN RECORDING ACADEMY 

The Latin Recording Academy is an international, membership-based organization comprised of Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking recording artists, musicians, songwriters, producers and other creative and technical recording professionals. The organization is dedicated to improving the quality of life and cultural condition for Latin music and its makers. In addition to producing the Latin Grammy Awards to honor excellence in the recorded arts and sciences, The Latin Recording Academy provides educational and outreach programs for the Latin music community either directly or through its Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation. 

 

LATIN GRAMMY CULTURAL FOUNDATION 

The Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation is a charitable organization established by the Latin Recording Academy in 2014. The organization is dedicated to creating opportunities for the next generation of Latin music creators through scholarships, educational programs, grants, and access to creators and industry executives. 

 

MUSICARES 

A friend and ally of the music community, MusiCares was established by the Recording Academy to safeguard the health and well-being of all music people. A four-star charity and safety net in times of need, MusiCares offers confidential preventative, recovery, and emergency programs to address financial, medical, and personal health issues. Through the generosity of our donors and volunteer professionals, our dedicated team works across the country to ensure the music community has the resources and support it needs. 

 

GRAMMY MUSEUM 

The Grammy Museum is a nonprofit organization dedicated to celebrating and exploring music from yesterday and today to inspire the music of tomorrow through music preservation, education, exhibitions, and public programming and aims to create a world in which shared love of music sparks curiosity, creativity, and community. Programs include GRAMMY in the Schools education programs that are offered year-round for students, teachers, and schools throughout the United States. 

 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY 

The Recording Academy, its affiliates, and the music industry have a strong culture of inclusion and respect for everyone. The Recording Academy makes intentional, courageous, and principled decisions for stronger business outcomes and ensures that all creators and professionals live and work in a fair and safe environment. It is the Recording Academy's policy to provide equal employment opportunities for all applicants and employees. The Recording Academy does not discriminate on the basis of race (nor traits historically associated with race, including, but not limited to hair texture and protective hairstyles), color, religion (including religious dress and grooming), creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), national origin, ancestry, age, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by law. The Recording Academy will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities unless doing so would result in an undue hardship to the Recording Academy. This policy governs all aspects of employment, including selection, job assignment, compensation, promotion, discipline, termination, access to benefits and training, recruitment, hiring, transfer, and social and recreational programs.

job.description:
Opportunity

Brunswick Group is seeking a curious, resourceful, and ambitious Executive to join our U.S. Digital practice.

As an Executive, you will work alongside experienced advisers to support a diverse portfolio of clients and high-stakes issues. You will contribute to research, strategic recommendations and hands-on execution, developing the skills to become a trusted digital adviser.

  • Client Contribution & Handling
    • Support the development and execution of digital communications strategies across a range of high-stakes issues, including corporate reputation, financial situations, litigation, crisis, and public affairs.
    • Draft high-quality client materials, including strategy presentations, research reports, messaging, campaign plans, and performance updates.
    • Analyze online conversations, media coverage, platform activity, and other sources of intelligence, translating findings into clear, actionable insights.
    • Support the planning, implementation, and evaluation of digital campaigns across paid, owned, and earned channels.
    • Leverage digital analytics, social listening, AI, and other research tools to support client work and uncover emerging risks and opportunities.
    • Contribute creative ideas and practical recommendations to client discussions, brainstorms, and new business pitches.
    • Leverage in-house AI tools and other resources to manage workload and keep deliverables on track, on time, and of the highest quality.
  • Teamwork and Collaborative Approach
    • Collaborate with colleagues across Brunswick, bringing digital expertise to integrated client teams.
    • Proactively share relevant digital developments, emerging trends, platform changes, and new technologies with colleagues.
    • Take ownership of assigned responsibilities, anticipate team needs, and contribute solutions without waiting to be asked.
    • Develop strong working relationships with colleagues and clients, demonstrating professionalism, responsiveness, and discretion.
    • Participate in and contribute to training sessions where appropriate and take advantage of the learning and engagement opportunities Brunswick provides.

What We're Looking For

At Brunswick, we seek smart and curious individuals dedicated to learning and growth. We value potential, strong work ethic, sound judgement, and excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Standout Executive candidates demonstrate:

  • 1-3 years of relevant professional experience; experience in strategic communications, campaigns, digital marketing, or an agency environment a strong plus.
  • Experience working on paid digital campaigns, social media management, and digital content development.
  • Working familiarity with digital analytics, social listening, or audience research tools (such as Google analytics, Sprinklr, Brandwatch).
  • Experience using AI and large language models to support research and analysis.
  • A strong understanding of the digital media landscape, including major social and LLM platforms, online communities, the creator economy, and emerging technologies, and familiarity with online formats, features, and content conventions.
  • An interest in business, current affairs, and the issues affecting major corporations and their leaders.
  • Excellent research, analytical, writing, and verbal communication skills.
  • Resourcefulness and proactivity, with the curiosity and agility to tackle unfamiliar challenges, learn quickly, and find creative, practical solutions.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced environment.
  • A collaborative, entrepreneurial mindset.
  • Sound judgment and discretion when handling sensitive or confidential information.

Why Join Us

Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of exceptional employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.

The successful applicant will be eligible for the following compensation and benefits package: 

Base Pay: The annual base compensation range for this role is $70,000 - $80,000. The base pay offered will be determined by factors including experience, skills, training, office location, certifications, and education.

Bonus Eligibility: Annual discretionary bonus contingent upon individual and firm-wide performance.

Benefits: Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance. Disability insurance. Employee assistance program. Flexible spending account. Health savings account. Life insurance. Commuter Benefits. Generous Paid Time Off: 25 vacation days and 10 days sick leave, as well as 11 paid company holidays. Firm-sponsored 401(k) Plan with 3% automatic company contribution of base and bonus with an additional 1.5% profit share– immediate vesting. Career training and development opportunities. Employee discounts.

Office Policy: At Brunswick, our work is a craft that thrives in teaching environments – whether in our offices or on-site with clients – through real-time observation, collaboration, human connection, clear guidance and by challenging one another to keep getting better. Our policy is that our team members are in person – either in the office or on-site with clients – at least four days each week.

The firm will provide reasonable accommodation to qualified applicants or employees, as defined by applicable law. In addition to the application, the process may include virtual and in-person interviews, as well as an assessment, which may be timed. To request an accommodation during our application and hiring process, email americasaccommodations@brunswickgroup.com.

About Brunswick

Brunswick is a global advisory firm. We help companies tackle high-stakes issues, navigate complex stakeholder relationships, and deliver high-impact outcomes. 

Our clients value our ability to anticipate, shape, and respond to the key players and forces in the financial and investment arena, regulatory and geopolitical universe, NGO community, workforce and beyond. They rely on us for deep experience, fresh perspectives and original thinking. So, in Brunswick you will find an exceptional range of experience and talent with a rich mix of backgrounds. From the beginning, we have prioritized attracting, developing, and retaining the best professionals in the industry, united by a culture of inclusivity, excellence, and intellectual curiosity.

Founded in 1987 in London, the firm has organically grown to 27 offices in 18 countries across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia and Australia. We operate as a “one-firm firm” with no individual profit centers. This allows us to assemble fully integrated, bespoke teams for each client, able to draw on the full resources of Brunswick anywhere in the world.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

  • 3 years of experience owning engineering standards adopted beyond your own team, and mentoring senior engineers.
  • Experience working in globally distributed teams across time zones, with engineering, product and business stakeholders in other regions.
  • Backend language and craft. You are an expert in TypeScript with Node.js or in Python, and a practitioner in the other. You set our backend and frontend coding patterns, framework choices and upgrade path, and you are a practitioner in at least two other crafts. • React and frontend. You set our full-stack conventions across teams: where logic lives, how APIs serve user interfaces, and how shared components are built and maintained.
  • APIs and data formats. You design REST APIs with OpenAPI from first principles: resource modelling, HTTP semantics, pagination, consistent error formats, versioning, idempotency and rate limiting. You know when to use JSON and when to use Protocol Buffers, and how to evolve both without breaking consumers. You set our API and serialisation standards and decide on exceptions.
  • Data. You are fluent in PostgreSQL, including schema design, indexing, query plans, transactions and zero-downtime migrations with Prisma, TypeORM or SQLAlchemy. You design DynamoDB and MongoDB models around access patterns, use Redis for caching, and choose the right store for each workload. You own our data-architecture standards, including how datastores are introduced and retired.
  • Asynchronous systems and reliability. You design event-driven systems on queues and streams such as SQS, Kafka and BullMQ or Celery, using retries, dead-letter queues and idempotent consumers so that at-least-once delivery is safe. You know the outbox and saga patterns and when orchestration is better than choreography. You own our reference architecture for reliability.
  • Cloud and platform. You have built and run production services on AWS or GCP, both as Lambda functions and as Kubernetes workloads, and you understand the trade-offs between them: cold starts, concurrency, cost, capacity and deployment risk. You define infrastructure as code with Terraform or AWS CDK and release safely with canary and blue/green deployments. With Platform Engineering, you decide when we use serverless and when we use Kubernetes, and you set the reference architectures for both.
  • Testing and quality. You practise test-driven development and expect every team to do the same. You build balanced test suites: unit tests with Jest, Vitest or pytest, integration tests with Testcontainers, contract tests with Pact, and Playwright end-to-end tests that gate releases. You set our quality standard and approve any exceptions to it.
  • Observability and performance. You instrument services with OpenTelemetry and use Datadog and CloudWatch to find problems before users do. You profile with flame graphs, measure p95 and p99 latency, and fix causes rather than symptoms. You set our standards for SLOs, dashboards, alerting and performance budgets, and you lead the hardest incidents to their root cause.
  • Security and identity. You write secure code by default and apply the OWASP Top 10 and API Security Top 10 in practice. You design authentication and authorisation with OAuth 2.0 and OIDC, secure service-to-service traffic with mTLS and workload identity, and integrate identity providers such as Okta, Keycloak and Cognito. You set our identity and security standards and own security reviews with the Security team
  • Architecture and design. You design systems that span many services and teams, and you write architecture decision records that make the trade-offs explicit. You own our technical roadmap and style guide, act as the arbiter on standards, and decide on evidence rather than authority. You are able to trace many symptoms back to a single root cause and fix it once.
  • Engineering practices. You work trunk-based with GitHub Flow, small changes and feature flags, and you know CI/CD pipelines inside out. You have led deprecations and migrations all the way to switching the old system off. You set our Git, CI/CD and dependency policies, and you make large-scale change routine rather than exceptional.
  • AI-first engineering and LLMs. You use Claude Code every day and understand how large language models work: tokens, context windows, cost, structured output, embeddings and retrieval. You have built production features with the Anthropic and OpenAI SDKs, including tool calling and evaluations, and designed agentic services with clear guardrails and human review. You set our AI-first operating model, covering approved models and frameworks, Claude Code conventions, evaluation and release gates, and governance.
  • Communication, collaboration and initiative. You communicate clearly and concisely in writing and in conversation, and you adapt your message for engineers, product leaders and executives. You understand complex problems quickly, ask the right questions and confirm shared understanding before acting. You collaborate well across locations and cultures, working asynchronously and handing over cleanly between time zones. You are proactive: you spot problems and opportunities before you are asked, propose solutions and innovations of your own, and drive them through without waiting for instructions.
  • Leadership and behaviours. You lead without authority and influence engineering heads and teams across the organisation. You define the hiring bar for each level, calibrate interviewers and give Talent Acquisition clear screening criteria. You mentor senior engineers into technical leaders, build an engineering practice that does not depend on you, and hold the bar under commercial pressure. You say "I don't know" when you don't, and you dig in until you do.

Preferred qualifications:

  • B.Tech or B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
  • Experience maintaining a widely used open-source library.
  • Experience with multi-region and disaster-recovery architecture.
  • Experience mapping engineering controls to SOC 2 or ISO 27001.

  • Experience running an engineering-productivity measurement programme.
  • Experience in the second backend language.

job.title: Helpdesk Support
job.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

The IT Helpdesk role provides Level 1/2 end-user on-site and remote support to agency end users in a predominantly Mac OS environment in the country. This includes end-user support to VVIP and other senior executives on-site. This role provides audio-visual support as needed for high-visibility meetings on-site, as well as advanced smart-hands support as needed to support other Omnicom IT centralized services. The role requires flexibility and adaptability to supporting multiple agencies in the region and supporting “ad-hoc” or otherwise custom support as needed.

The ideal candidate has 5+ years of IT end-user support experience desktop, mobile device , and audio-visual support.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Provides executive and VVIP support and audio visual (AV) support.
  • Provide quality assurance over any 3rd party IT services provided on-site.
  • Facilitate and coordinate site-specific activities (e.g., office moves, weekend power downs) as needed.
  • Support “ad-hoc” agency IT support as needed and directed by the IT Support Manager.
  • Works directly with internal and external 3rd party resources to ensure that end-user issues are resolved efficiently.
  • Manage the end-user experience delivered to agency end-users on-site and remote in the region.
  • Provide Level 1/2 end-user on-site support to agency end users, including troubleshooting, resolving, and documenting issues with desktop, laptop, mobile device, printer, and peripheral hardware and software.
  • Maintain rapport with agency end-users and be a go-to resource for IT troubleshooting.
  • Provide end-user support to VVIP and other senior executives on-site, including setting up, configuring, and testing devices, applications, and network connectivity.
  • Engage IT Support Manager(s) as needed to identify systemic issues with end-user support.
  • Maintain asset inventory and track IT hardware in the region.
  • Follow Omnicom IT policies, procedures, and standards for end-user support and service delivery. And report any violations of Omnicom security policies to management.
  • Provide attended meeting support for high-visibility internal and external meetings.
  • Provide “ad-hoc” or otherwise custom IT support to agencies, while also documenting the support requirements for review as a consolidation opportunity for Omnicom IT centralized services.
  • Provide advanced smart-hands support on-site, supporting other Omnicom IT centralized services that may not have an on-site presence.
  • Support cross-functional IT processes such as onboarding, offboarding, device replacement, incident resolution and request fulfillment.
  • Use ServiceNow ITSM platform to receive and manage incident and request tickets, maintaining proper ticket management protocols such as detailed comments and close notes.
  • Manage assigned tickets to complete within service level criteria.
  • Participate / provide after-hours support and flexibility to travel as needed.

Individual must also maintain an extreme level of confidentiality in dealing with all information that flows through the office.

EDUCATION, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

  • 5+ years of IT end-user support experience desktop, mobile device, and audio-visual support.
  • Strong technical knowledge and skills in Mac OS
  • In-depth knowledge of end-user platforms and services, including but not limited to, MacOS, Office365, Windows OS, Active Directory, etc., current desktop and mobile computing technology, core media business applications and their operation.
  • Familiarity with networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN).
  • Excellent customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Must possess a “can-do” attitude and be ready to roll up their sleeves to get the job done.
  • Ability to function within a group and support other team members to resolve problems.
  • Ability to quickly analyze problems, interpret operational needs, and resolve or escalate problems in a timely manner as well as ability to provide real time support for end-user issues.
  • Ability to work calmly under high pressure situations.
  • Ability to maintain good rapport with agencies being supported.
  • Ability to communicate with executives and their staff.
  • Ability to prioritize and work on multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Ability to train others in the use and support of Omnicom business systems.
  • Understanding of ITIL principles is a plus.
  • Knowledge of Jamf platform is preferred.
  • Knowledge of advertising and media businesses is highly preferred.
  • Relevant certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+, Microsoft, Apple, or Cisco are preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent work experience, is preferred.

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media.

 

The Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) team is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation's technologies and infrastructure, enabling the creation and continued delivery of quality content across all platforms. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people, and places. We are the space in between.

 

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology—not just in Canada, but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force and we are the team making it happen.

 

This is a hybrid role with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines and operational needs.

 

The Opportunity

 

Are you passionate about technology transformation, evolving operating models and shaping new ways of working from concept through to adoption? In this key role, you will serve as a strategic technology transformation adviser to leaders and teams, helping diagnose challenges, define and structure change initiatives, and drive operational implementation and adoption across the organization.

 

Reporting to the Director of the Operational Excellence Office within Technology & Infrastructure (T&I), you will join the team leading the Daily Content initiative in Innovation & Delivery. You will be joining us at a pivotal moment as CBC/Radio-Canada undergoes a major overhaul to modernize its content creation platforms. This transformation goes beyond software and tools — it redefines how production platforms are designed, delivered and used within an organizational model focused on product management, agile at scale, and continuous value creation.

 

In this role, you will combine a strategic consulting mindset with hands-on execution across all stages of the transformation. You will analyze complex issues, challenge established ways of working and provide actionable recommendations while actively driving their implementation by designing and producing the strategies, plans, frameworks, tools and other deliverables needed to execute and adopt the transformation.

 

Key areas of focus include transitioning to a product management model, modernizing collaboration with partners and contributors, and driving user adoption of new production tools. You will help define, structure and roll out the transformation and change management strategies required across all levels of the organization.

 

You will also play a central role in bringing together and aligning diverse teams and stakeholders across CBC/Radio-Canada around a shared vision and common goals. Your ability to grasp and navigate a complex organizational ecosystem, balance operational constraints and competing priorities, and exert influence without direct authority will be essential to align perspectives, build consensus, streamline decision-making and remove roadblocks.

 

Working alongside key stakeholders, you will support the organization in preparing for and implementing changes — including by developing and rolling out effective engagement and communications strategies — and by preparing and supporting end users in tandem with our Learning & Development partners.

 

You will work closely with operational and strategic leaders, as well as with the Daily Content Director, to structure challenges, shape recommendations and guide the evolution of work practices and production tools.

 

As a member of T&I’s Operational Excellence Office, you will help ensure alignment, practical execution and long-term adoption of the transformation by continuously refining our approaches based on results, key insights and frontline needs. Beyond the Daily Content initiative, you will also help build the Office’s methods, practices and capabilities as well as nurture a transformation community of practice across CBC/Radio-Canada to share lessons learned and scale high-impact practices.

 

This position can be based in Toronto or Montreal, with occasional travel required.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Advise leaders and teams on defining and implementing technology transformations, engaging early in the life cycle to analyze needs, diagnose challenges, identify required changes and deliver recommendations aligned with the organization's vision and goals.
  • Guide departments and divisions in evolving their operating models and ways of working, advising on process design, governance, roles and responsibilities, and team collaboration structures.
  • Develop approaches, frameworks and tools to structure and implement transformation — including simple, scalable and reusable interaction models and practical guides — with a focus on change management, Lean, SAFe and Scrum methodologies.
  • Design and execute change management and adoption strategies and plans, incorporating impact assessments, organizational readiness, risk mitigation and stakeholder support.
  • Define and lead engagement, communication and capacity-building strategies — including user training and the preparation of delivery teams and change agents — in partnership with Learning & Development.
  • Proactively identify and resolve risks, resistance and operational roadblocks that could hinder transformation and adoption.
  • Define and track metrics to measure the progress, adoption and effectiveness of new ways of working, using data and insights to continuously refine strategies.
  • Actively participate in key transformation forums and events, including strategic and alignment meetings, sprint reviews, program demos and quarterly planning sessions.

 

What You Bring

  • Undergraduate degree in business administration, technology or a field relevant to organizational transformation (or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience).
  • Seven to 10 years' experience leading large-scale technology transformations, including evolving technology operating models, processes, governance structures, roles and responsibilities, and ways of working within complex, matrixed environments.
  • Proven track record as a strategic transformation adviser, with strong skills in analyzing and diagnosing complex issues, challenging current practices, formulating actionable recommendations and guiding execution.
  • Solid understanding of product management models and agile practices at scale, with hands-on experience applying them to tech transformations. Expertise in SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework), Scrum or other scaled agile frameworks required.
  • Experience with Lean and iterative transformation approaches, alongside the ability to adapt strategies and solutions based on key insights, data and frontline needs.
  • Demonstrated experience in end-to-end change management and adoption, including impact analysis, stakeholder engagement, strategic communications and capability building.
  • Knowledge of media production, broadcasting workflows and related technologies (e.g., audio/video editing, publishing, distribution, graphics generation) a major asset.
  • Proven ability to navigate complex organizational dynamics (including labour relations), manage resistance, resolve conflict and build trust-based relationships with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, paired with sharp business acumen and the ability to synthesize complex challenges into clear, actionable recommendations and solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence, guide and engage leaders and teams without direct authority.
  • Exceptional facilitation and active listening skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, plain language.
  • Bilingualism in English and French (written and spoken) required.

job.description: DISCOVER WHAT’S NEXT. Build Brands. Create Ideas. Make an Impact. Join Connoisseur Media San Francisco | Bay Area The Bay Area is where bold ideas become big things. At Connoisseur Media San Francisco, we bring together the power of local radio, digital marketing, events, and creative storytelling to help businesses connect with audiences, build brands, and grow. We’re looking for an ambitious, curious, relationship-driven Account Executive who sees opportunity everywhere—and knows that great sales begin with great questions, creative thinking, and a genuine understanding of what makes a business successful. If you’re energized by meeting new people, discovering business opportunities, developing smart marketing strategies, and turning ideas into results, this is your opportunity to make your mark in one of the most dynamic markets in the country. MORE THAN RADIO. A WORLD OF POSSIBILITIES. Our Bay Area portfolio connects advertisers with powerful local audiences, trusted brands, and innovative marketing solutions. KOIT — 96.5 The Bay Area’s #1 Adult Contemporary Station with a powerful connection to listeners and the community. KMVQ — 99.7 Now - 1 for ALL THE HITS. KBLX — 102.9 A heritage Bay Area brand playing the best throwbacks and R&B with deep community roots and a loyal audience. KBAY — 98.5 / 92.1 Bay Country - country music, passionate fans, and opportunities for brands to connect authentically. KEZR — MIX 106.5 - The South Bay’s home for today’s best mix and biggest hits. From broadcast campaigns and digital advertising to sponsorships, events, and customized marketing solutions, you’ll have a portfolio of opportunities to turn client challenges into creative, revenue-generating ideas. WHAT YOU’LL DO Be a business builder. Identify, prospect, and develop new relationships with local and regional businesses, advertising agencies, and key decision-makers. Lead with curiosity. Ask insightful questions, uncover client needs, understand business objectives, and develop consultative marketing solutions—not cookie-cutter proposals. Think beyond the traditional. Combine radio, digital, promotions, sponsorships, events, and creative partnerships into integrated campaigns that deliver value for advertisers. Turn ideas into revenue. Prepare compelling presentations, recommend strategic solutions, negotiate opportunities, close business, and grow existing accounts. Own your results. Take initiative, manage your pipeline, maintain consistent sales activity, and achieve or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue goals. Build lasting partnerships. Deliver exceptional service, communicate proactively, and become a trusted marketing resource for your clients. Represent brands that matter. Bring the Connoisseur Media and Connrex Digital story to the marketplace while helping local businesses succeed. WHO YOU ARE You are competitive, resourceful, outgoing, and motivated by the opportunity to make things happen. You enjoy opening doors, building relationships, solving problems, and finding new ways to win. You bring: Strong prospecting, cold-calling, networking, and appointment-setting skills. Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building abilities. A consultative mindset and the confidence to speak with business owners and senior decision-makers. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple clients, priorities, and deadlines. A goal-oriented mindset, resilience, and a desire to continually improve. The ability to turn clients’ needs into compelling marketing ideas and business opportunities. WHAT YOU’LL NEED At least two years of sales experience, preferably in B2B sales, advertising, marketing, media, or a client-facing business development role. A track record of developing business, growing revenue, and working toward measurable sales goals. Comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment where initiative and adaptability matter. A valid driver’s license and a fully insured personal vehicle for business use. Even better if you bring: Experience selling radio, digital advertising, integrated marketing, sponsorships, or events. A strong local network or knowledge of the San Francisco Bay Area business community. Experience creating strategic proposals and delivering engaging client presentations. Familiarity with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace. A bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, communications, or a related field. We value talent, curiosity, drive, and the ability to build meaningful relationships. If you have the right mindset and a passion for helping businesses grow, we want to hear from you. YOUR AMBITION. OUR PLATFORM. BIGGER POSSIBILITIES. At Connoisseur Media, we believe our people are our greatest competitive advantage. We invest in individuals who take ownership of their careers, bring fresh thinking to their work, and want to be part of a team that supports one another and celebrates success. You’ll have the opportunity to work with established local media brands, develop new business relationships, collaborate with creative and digital marketing professionals, and build a career in an industry that continues to evolve. READY TO MAKE YOUR MARK? Bring your ideas. Bring your ambition. Help us shape what’s next for Bay Area businesses and brands. Discover your talent. Build your future. Make an impact with Connoisseur Media San Francisco. The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  
  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  
  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.
  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  
  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  
  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.
  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 
  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be
  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live
  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 
  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 
  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

job.title: Director of Engineering - Dome Productions
job.description:
Req Id: 433339

Dome Productions is North America’s leading production and transmission facilities provider, Dome is unique in its business approach and sets itself apart from others with its integration of primary business units of Mobile Production, Host Broadcaster and Media Services, and Transmission services all under its corporate umbrella. Dome Productions’ resume includes work with major worldwide broadcasters, leagues, production companies, government parties and other content creators, with a major emphasis on sports, eSports, and entertainment. 
     
We provide a supportive and inclusive community where all team members can succeed. And through our commitment to environmental, social and governance initiatives, you will feel good about the greater impact you will have – making every day better for people as they connect, work, learn and play. 
 
Join us. You belong at Dome Productions’

Summary

The Director of Engineering is responsible for the strategic leadership, technical direction, operational performance, and ongoing evolution of Dome Productions' engineering organization. This role oversees the maintenance, readiness, and modernization of Dome's mobile production fleet, technical infrastructure, and engineering resources while ensuring the delivery of reliable, industry-leading broadcast solutions.

As a member of the senior leadership team, the Director of Engineering will establish the long-term technology vision for the organization, lead the transition to next-generation IP, cloud, and hybrid production environments, and develop high-performing engineering teams that support North America's most prestigious live sports and entertainment productions.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Technology Innovation

  • Provide strategic and technical leadership for Dome’s engineering organization, establishing the vision and multi-year roadmap for media platforms, mobiles, studios, software, architecture, and infrastructure.
  • Execute Dome's long-term technology strategy and roadmap, ensuring continued leadership in broadcast and production technologies.
  • Lead the evaluation, adoption, and implementation of emerging technologies, including IP-based workflows, cloud-based production, UHD/4K, HDR, and software-defined infrastructure.
  • Provide expert technical guidance to executive leadership, clients, and industry partners regarding technology trends, opportunities, and risks.
  • Collaborate with leaders across Dome Productions, Bell Media and Rogers Media to understand business priorities and future growth plans, translating them into scalable technology strategies and roadmaps.
  • Establish strategic partnerships with technology vendors, service providers, and industry organizations to support current and future business requirements.
  • Represent Dome Productions within industry associations, technology forums, and key vendor partnerships.

Engineering Operations & Infrastructure Management

  • Provide leadership and oversight for Dome's mobile production fleet, studios, control rooms, and supporting technical infrastructure.
  • Guide the evolution of Dome Productions infrastructure and shape the transition to next-generation architectures across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
  • Ensure all systems meet operational, reliability, performance, and broadcast quality standards.
  • Oversee engineering support for major live productions and serve as the senior escalation point for critical operational issues.
  • Lead large-scale engineering projects, system upgrades, equipment acquisitions, and infrastructure enhancements.
  • Ensure effective asset lifecycle management, maintenance planning, and operational readiness across all technical platforms.

Business Partnership & Financial Accountability

  • Partner with division leaders across Dome Productions, Bell Media, Rogers Media, to align technology investments with business objectives.
  • Develop capital plans, operating budgets, forecasts, and business cases that support strategic priorities.
  • Manage/oversee capital projects ensuring adherence to cost, time and quality deliverables. Oversee purchase, delivery, and installation of new equipment. Ensure the smooth integration, training and communication of new equipment or process.
  • Make sound business decisions that balance operational excellence, financial stewardship, and long-term organizational success.

People Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of engineering leaders, technical specialists, and field engineering personnel responsible for building, maintaining, and continually evolving Dome’s technology ecosystem.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Drive talent acquisition, succession planning, workforce development, performance management, and employee engagement initiatives.
  • Establish training and development programs that advance technical expertise and leadership capabilities across the organization.
  • Promote a safe, inclusive, and high-performing work environment for employees and freelance resources.

Industry Leadership & Client Support

  • Maintain strong relationships with clients, vendors, partners, and industry stakeholders.
  • Update and maintain thorough knowledge of the mobile, studio and distribution business including who’s who, trends, technology, changes, relationships, competitive and client landscapes and changes within the industry
  • Support client-facing discussions involving technical strategy, production solutions, and future business opportunities.
  • Ensure exceptional service delivery and client satisfaction across all engineering-supported productions.

Critical Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in broadcast engineering, media technology, or related technical environments.
  • Minimum 5 years in a senior management or director-level role leading technical teams and complex operations.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing technology strategies, infrastructure roadmaps, and large-scale transformation initiatives.
  • Experience leading high-performing engineering teams within live production, broadcast, media, or technology environments.
  • Strong knowledge of live production and broadcast technologies, including video, audio, routing, replay, intercom, transmission, and contribution systems.
  • Significant experience with SMPTE 2110, IP-based workflows, cloud-based media technologies, and hybrid infrastructure environments.
  • Understanding of modern networking, compute, storage, cybersecurity, and software-defined architectures.
  • Knowledge of broadcast industry standards, including SMPTE, ATSC, UHD/4K, HDR, and related emerging technologies.
  • Experience overseeing complex technology implementations while maintaining highly reliable production operations.
  • Strategic thinker with strong business and financial acumen.
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and build cross-functional partnerships.
  • Exceptional communication and executive presentation skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities in high-pressure environments.
  • Ability to lead through change while maintaining team engagement and operational excellence.
  • Passion for innovation, continuous learning, and delivering exceptional client experiences.
  • Builds trust and credibility across technical, operational, and executive teams.
  • Balances innovation with operational reliability.
  • Develops future-ready engineering capabilities while maintaining exceptional service delivery.
  • Leads confidently in fast-paced, high-stakes live production environments.
  • Creates a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Flexibility to travel domestically and internationally.
  • Degree or diploma in Engineering, Broadcast Technology, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Relevant industry certifications and professional affiliations are considered assets.

 

Adequate knowledge of French is required for positions in Quebec. 

 

Additional Information:

Position Type: Management 
Job Status: Regular - Full Time 
Job Location: Canada : Ontario : Toronto 
Work Arrangement: Full-time in office (meaning that you will be required to perform your work on-site)
Application Deadline: 11/20/2026 

 

For work arrangements that are ‘Hybrid’, successful candidates must be based in Canada and report to a set Dome office for a minimum of 3 days a week.  Recognizing the importance of work-life balance, Dome offers flexibility in work hours based on the business needs.

 

Please apply directly online to be considered for this role.  Applications through email will not be accepted.

 

We know that caring for our team members is at the heart of a healthy, positive and thriving workplace. As part of our team, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive compensation package that includes a competitive salary and a wide range of benefits to support the well-being of you and your family. As soon as you join us, you'll be eligible for medical, dental, vision and mental health benefits that you can tailor to your specific needs. Plus, as a Dome team member, you'll enjoy a 35% discount on our services and access exclusive offers from our partners. 

 

At Dome, we are proud of our focus on fostering an inclusive and accessible workplace where all team members feel valued, respected, supported, and that they belong.

 

Dome is committed to clarity in our hiring process. All roles posted are opportunities we’re actively recruiting for, unless stated otherwise. We also want to make sure that everyone has an equal opportunity to join our team. We encourage individuals who may require accommodations during the hiring process to let us know. For a confidential inquiry, email your recruiter or recruitment@bell.ca to make arrangements. If you have questions or feedback regarding accessibility at Bell, we invite you to complete the Accessibility feedback form or visit our Accessibility page for other ways to contact us.

 

Artificial intelligence may be used to assess parts of your application. Please review our privacy policy (see Phenom for details) to learn more about how we collect, use, and disclose your personal information.

job.description:
Company Overview

Cumulus Media is an audio-first media company delivering premium content to a quarter billion people every month — wherever and whenever they want it.   • Hands-on experience booking campaigns in an enterprise podcast hosting and advertising platform
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, including experience using pivot tables and lookup functions to create clear reports from raw data exports
  • Familiarity with podcast measurement or attribution platforms such as Magellan AI, Podscribe, or Podtrac
  • Strong written communication skills and the confidence to present performance data, insights, and recommendations to senior stakeholders
  • Experience managing outreach or partnerships, including promotional swaps, guest bookings, creator collaborations, or platform relationships

  • Ability to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines, and stakeholder relationships in a fast-paced environment
  • A proactive approach to improving systems, solving operational challenges, and identifying opportunities for audience growth

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Day-to-day experience working with podcast attribution tools such as Magellan AI, Podscribe, or Podtrac

  • Listener fluency across podcast genres such as news, true crime, comedy, and sports

job.title: People Experience Lead
job.description:
Join a team of proud, passionate, and caring people that together share their diverse talents and backgrounds to serve our members and grow the game of golf. Being at the PGA of America means you are supported, respected, and appreciated for your contributions.

The People Experience Lead guides onboarding and early talent programming, including leading the PGA Internship Program, while championing workplace culture through staff events, internal newsletters, and recognition programs. Additionally, the role supports core People Team operations, compliance, confidential record management, and department administrative and financial workflows across the People Function.

RESPONSIBILITIES (Specific areas of responsibility include but are not limited to):


Talent Acquisition, Early Talent Programming, and Onboarding


  • Lead the PGA Internship Program across its full lifecycle, to include recruitment, candidate selection, and housing arrangements. Plan and coordinate the intern schedule of events, including orientation, professional development workshops, and team activities, to create an engaging learning environment. Prepare intern leaders for successful and rewarding experiences. Work closely with partners and leadership to advance inclusion initiatives and connect with diverse talent pools.
  • Lead the onboarding function by creating engaging and contemporary onboarding materials for new talent, creating and executing onboarding schedules for new talent.
  • Support seasonal employee hiring for Championship events, assisting with candidate tracking, pre-employment screenings, and cross functional handoffs to ensure seamless seasonal staff execution and onboarding.
  • Audit company career pages and external job boards to maintain accuracy, producing engaging recruitment media and video content to attract top talent and increase candidate engagement. 

Employee Experience, Culture & Communications


  • Plan and execute employee engagement and workplace culture events at the Home of the PGA of America. Own the operational workflow by establishing clear event timelines, coordinating cross functional team logistics, and guiding internal partners to deliver high quality, memorable staff experiences.
  • Partner with department leadership to launch and manage the company newsletter, establishing editorial standards, coordinating cross-functional content sourcing, and driving internal employee engagement initiatives. 
  • Lead Employee Recognition Programs and assist with Service Award Programs, ensuring timely celebration of staff achievements, career milestones, and ongoing dedication to the organization.
  • Oversee the distribution of all People Team communications using appropriate department branding. Assist with the scheduling of company wide events like speakers, Team Connects, etc.
  • Support Learning and Development curriculum, workshops and related employee training records, i.e., Workday Learning, compliance, etc. Serve as back up in processing Education Assistance Program requests.
  • Maintain ‘The Hub’ ensuring all employee communications and resources are current, compliant, contemporary, and engaging.
  • Order, organize, and maintain an inventory of employee gifts, e.g.new hire, new baby, bereavement, commemorative, and celebratory items.

HR Operations, Compliance & Support

  • Maintain state and federal labor law postings and other pertinent information on company bulletin boards across all office locations.
  • Ensure employee inquiries are answered and/or properly routed in a timely manner.
  • Process invoices and create Purchase Orders in Workday for the Talent and People Experience Team. Provide administrative backup support across the broader People Function.

Employees are expected to contribute to a respectful and inclusive team environment by welcoming and respecting others’ beliefs, backgrounds, identities, abilities, and individuality to help ensure a supportive and engaging experience for Association Members, partners, customers, and guests. No budgetary responsibility.

Working knowledge of Gmail, Google Drive, Google Sheets and Google Docs. job.title: Scenic Stylist
job.description:
Working at QVC Group means joining a live social shopping company with incredible teams, ambitious projects and rewarding careers. QVC Group, Inc. is a Fortune 500 company with six leading retail brands - QVC®, HSN®, Ballard Designs®, Frontgate®, Garnet Hill® and Grandin Road®.

Your Opportunity, Your Team

As a Scenic Stylist, you’ll support QVC and HSN by transforming studio sets into branded, camera-ready environments and styling products for live shows. Your work helps bring each product and brand to life on air.

You’ll interpret scenic design direction, select props and furnishings, and make sure each set is ready for broadcast. You’ll partner with TV Production, Broadcast Operations, and vendors, responding to changing show needs with care and flexibility.

Where You'll Work

  • This role is onsite and will require you to work from our West Chester, PA headquarters daily. Relocation assistance is not available for this role.

What You'll Do

  • Style sets and product displays to support brand direction and present products effectively on live shows.
  • Source and requisition props, furnishings, and other styling elements based on scenic design direction.
  • Transform empty sets into environments suited to each brand and product category.
  • Review set readiness before broadcast and make adjustments to meet on-air needs.
  • Coordinate with production, broadcast operations, and vendors, adapting to last-minute schedule changes.

What You'll Bring

  • At least 2 years of experience in product styling or set styling.
  • Knowledge of styling aesthetics, including design elements, visual merchandising, current style trends, fashion, or floral display.
  • Ability to distinguish colors and textures.

You'll be at the forefront of weather coverage, from daily forecasts to critical severe weather events, using cutting-edge technology to tell the story of our ever-changing skies.

  • Prepare and deliver daily weathercasts utilizing all available weather data and graphics computers.
  • Prepare and deliver urgent weather updates interrupting regular programming as necessary.
  • Prepare and deliver all weathercast materials over a variety of mediums, including, but not limited to: TV, Radio, Internet.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, KNXV
job.description:
We're looking for a storyteller who can do it all — shoot, write, report and most importantly - connect with the community. KNXV, ABC 15 in Phoenix, Arizona, is looking for a talented Multimedia Journalist to join our newsroom. At ABC 15, you'll be more than a journalist — you'll be a one-person powerhouse who brings the stories of the Valley of the Sun to life across television and digital platforms. From breaking news to in-depth community coverage, your work will inform, inspire and make a real difference in the lives of viewers across one of the nation's fastest-growing markets.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Receive assignment or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.
  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interview, observation, and research.
  • Organize material, determine slant or emphasis, and write story according to prescribed editorial style and format standards.
  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.
  • Edit, or assists in editing, videos for all multimedia platforms.
  • Appear on television program when conducting taped interview or narration
  • Give live reports from site of event or mobile broadcast unit.
  • Work cooperatively with photographer assigned to story, if one is assigned.
  • Assist news producer in preparing newscast.
  • Assist online staff in preparing for multi media stories.

 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 3+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Computer literacy required, including newsroom computer systems
  • Videography and non-linear editing experience preferred
  • Knowledge of broadcast quality camera equipment
  • Edit video on Final Cut Pro editing systems, or similar equipment
  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills
  • Proficient at posting content to various websites
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced deadline-driven environment
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Phoenix is one of America's most exciting and sun-soaked cities, offering an extraordinary quality of life for those who call it home. With more than 300 days of sunshine a year, the Valley of the Sun is a playground for outdoor enthusiasts — whether you're hiking the iconic trails of Camelback Mountain and South Mountain Park, kayaking along the Salt River, or exploring the stunning red rocks just a short drive away in Sedona. The sprawling Sonoran Desert landscape is unlike anywhere else on earth, and it's right at your doorstep.

Beyond the outdoors, the downtown arts district offers a vibrant scene that includes the Phoenix Art Museum, one of the largest in the Southwest, as well as the Musical Instrument Museum — a one-of-a-kind destination that draws visitors from around the globe. The local food scene reflects the city's rich cultural diversity, from authentic Sonoran-style Mexican cuisine and acclaimed farm-to-table restaurants to a thriving craft brewery and coffee culture. The city also hosts beloved annual events like the Barrett-Jackson car auction and the Waste Management Phoenix Open, one of the most attended sporting events in the world.

For sports fans, Phoenix is a major-league city all the way, home to the NFL's Cardinals, the NBA's Suns, the WNBA's Mercury, the NHL's Coyotes, and MLB's Diamondbacks. With a booming economy, a young and diverse population, and world-class amenities at every turn, Phoenix isn't just a great place to work — it's a phenomenal place to build a life.

job.title: Multimedia Accountability Reporter, KTNV
job.description:
Scripps-owned KTNV is looking for a Multimedia Accountability Reporter who believes journalism should do more than fill a newscast. You’re a creative, curious storyteller who wants to uncover what’s really happening in Las Vegas, hold the powerful accountable and produce work that can make a difference in people’s lives. You’ll have the freedom to dig deeper, follow compelling leads and find fresh ways to bring important stories to life across broadcast, digital, social and emerging storytelling platforms. Whether you’re analyzing data, working sources, shooting in the field or experimenting with a new way to tell a story, you’ll focus on journalism that connects with audiences wherever they are. If you want to push beyond the traditional reporter playbook and create ambitious, memorable journalism with purpose, this is your opportunity.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Develop original news leads and tips, cultivating sources and identifying accountability stories with meaningful impact for the Las Vegas community.
  • Investigate issues through in-depth reporting, public records, research, data and interviews to uncover facts and provide important context.
  • Analyze databases, statistics and other complex information to identify trends, verify facts and strengthen reporting.
  • Gather and verify information through interviews, observation, research and field reporting while maintaining high journalistic standards.
  • Write and produce compelling, accurate stories for broadcast, digital, social and other multimedia platforms, often on deadline.
  • Shoot video and still photography and edit visual content to create complete, engaging multimedia stories.
  • Deliver polished on-camera reporting, including live reports, taped interviews, narration and breaking-news coverage from the field.
  • Own stories from idea through publication, determining the strongest focus, structure, visuals and storytelling approach for each platform.
  • Collaborate with photographers, producers, digital teams and newsroom colleagues to strengthen coverage and maximize the reach and impact of reporting.
  • Contribute to daily news coverage while balancing enterprise and accountability reporting that may require longer-term research and development.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in journalism, communications or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience, preferred.
  • Generally, 5+ years of journalism or related experience preferred, including experience reporting, writing and producing stories across multiple platforms.
  • Valid driver’s license, good driving record and ability to provide proof of insurance meeting company-required limits are required. This position requires driving as part of the job.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Strong investigative instincts, curiosity and the persistence to keep digging when a story demands more.
  • Advanced critical-thinking and research skills, with the ability to make sense of complicated subjects, statistics and records.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and a strong command of compelling, accurate storytelling.
  • A confident and engaging on-air presence, including the ability to communicate clearly during live and breaking coverage.
  • Multimedia skills and the willingness to report, shoot, write, edit and produce content across platforms.
  • The ability to juggle daily assignments, enterprise reporting and multiple developing stories in a fast-paced newsroom while consistently meeting deadlines.
  • A collaborative mindset and commitment to working effectively with journalists and colleagues throughout the station.
  • Sound editorial judgment and a commitment to accuracy, fairness, verification and accountability journalism.

OUR TEAM:

At KTNV, you’ll join a collaborative newsroom focused on serving the Las Vegas community with journalism that informs, explains and creates impact. Our team brings together journalists with different backgrounds, perspectives, experiences and interests, united by curiosity and a commitment to telling stories that matter. We value colleagues who share ideas, support one another, embrace multiple forms of storytelling and believe great local journalism starts with listening to the community.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Las Vegas is much more than the Strip. It’s a fast-growing, diverse community with an endless supply of meaningful stories, from local government and education to housing, growth, water, public safety and the issues affecting neighborhoods across Southern Nevada. For an accountability reporter, it’s a dynamic market where strong local journalism can make a real difference.

When you’re off the clock, Southern Nevada offers world-class dining, entertainment and professional sports alongside incredible outdoor experiences. Red Rock Canyon, Lake Mead and the surrounding desert and mountains put hiking, climbing, cycling and weekend adventures within easy reach, while Las Vegas provides the energy, culture and experiences of a destination known around the world.

job.title: Senior Manager, Media & Technical Operations
job.description:
Drive Auto is seeking a collaborative, hands-on Senior Manager, Media & Technical Operations to lead the teams responsible for paid-media execution and technical support. This role is ideal for an experienced digital advertising leader who combines deep paid media expertise with strong operational judgment, people leadership, and a commitment to high-quality client delivery.

The Senior Manager will lead the Drive Auto Media and Tech Support Managers, providing direction, coaching, and accountability across both teams. This person will ensure campaigns and technical work are delivered accurately and efficiently; maintain strong support and service standards; and keep the organization prepared for changes across advertising platforms and emerging channels.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and coach the Drive Auto Media and Tech Support teams, fostering a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing culture.
  • Oversee the Drive Auto Media team’s execution of paid campaigns, including campaign builds, optimization practices, quality standards, testing, and performance analysis.
  • Provide subject matter expertise and leadership across Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, and other platforms, including emerging advertising platforms, ensuring teams remain current on meaningful platform changes, new capabilities, and evolving best practices.
  • Evaluate the operational impact of platform updates and new advertising products; determine when the team should test, adopt, document, or train on new capabilities.
  • Oversee the Tech Support team’s work across platform configuration, technical setup, QA, implementations, migrations, troubleshooting, projects, and escalations.
  • Monitor and improve service-level expectations, customer service, workflow consistency, and operational processes across the Tech Support function.
  • Partner closely with the Drive Auto Onboarding, Customer Support, and Account Management teams to deliver media campaigns, issue resolution, and platform deliverables on time and with accuracy.
  • Confidently represent Drive Auto in client-facing conversations, presenting recommendations clearly, making decisive calls when needed, and guiding stakeholders toward the solution that best serves the client and the business.
  • Collaborate with Sales, leadership, and other internal teams to align on operational needs, resolve escalations, and support a strong client experience.
  • Mentor and develop team members through regular feedback, coaching, recognition, and training opportunities.
  • Lead by example through professionalism, adaptability, sound judgment, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

 

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in digital advertising, paid media, automotive marketing, or automotive technology
  • 2+ years of experience leading and developing a team
  • Hands-on experience building and optimizing paid search and paid social campaigns
  • Deep working knowledge of Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager; experience with TikTok and other digital advertising platforms 
  • Experience overseeing campaign execution, optimization, QA, and performance analysis
  • Experience with technical support, platform implementation, configuration, migrations, troubleshooting, ticket workflows, and client escalations
  • Strong understanding of digital advertising platform changes, industry trends, and the ability to translate them into practical guidance for operational teams
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify operational issues and implement effective improvements
  • Demonstrated ability to balance established standards with thoughtful flexibility, using sound judgment to make client and business appropriate decisions
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and leadership skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams and levels of the organization

 

This position will report into the Lafayette, LA office or Hunt Valley, MD office on a hybrid schedule. Drive Auto is a data-driven marketing and technology company helping automotive dealerships reach in-market shoppers and achieve measurable growth. Our collaborative team combines proprietary data, innovative technology, and digital marketing expertise to shape the future of automotive advertising.

News & Entertainment (N&E) Machine Learning The N&E ML team is responsible for building robust data pipelines and advanced machine learning platforms that deliver personalized experiences to users across Disney's News & Entertainment portfolio including ABC News, ABC Entertainment, National Geographic, Marvel, and Disney Studios. Our services leverage machine learning models to enable real-time content personalization and targeted distribution across web, mobile, and connected TV platforms, ensuring that users receive the most relevant and engaging content tailored to their interests. Our mission is to drive seamless, resilient, and low-latency personalized content delivery at scale, while continuously advancing our ML infrastructure and recommendation algorithms across one of the world's most iconic collections of entertainment brands Job Summary: As a Product Software Engineer, you will build the backend services and APIs that deliver ML-driven recommendations to end users across the N&E ML Platform.
