Caching & Performance: Implement caching strategies to reduce latency and infrastructure cost, applying established patterns and tools to keep response times low at scale. Internal Tools: Build internal tools such as admin portals and experimentation dashboards that support the ML team's day-to-day work and decision-making. Database Management: Manage and maintain databases (e.g., DynamoDB) supporting ML systems, ensuring data is stored, indexed, and retrieved efficiently. Cloud Infrastructure: Build and deploy services using AWS (Lambda, ECS, DynamoDB), following established infrastructure patterns to ensure consistency across the platform. On-Call & Reliability: Participate in the on-call rotation for production systems, responding to incidents and helping ensure ML outputs are delivered efficiently and reliably to end users. job.title: Manager, Inventory and Yield
job.description:
The Manager, Inventory and Yield will own the accuracy and consistency of Red Seat Ventures’ inventory source of truth, review and approve deals in Operative AOS, and implement Revenue Operations strategies related to inventory and yield. This role works alongside Sales, Client Service, Ad Ops, Revenue Operations, and other teams to support consistent execution.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Inventory Source of Truth: Own the accuracy and consistency of inventory information across current and future systems. Coordinate updates and resolve discrepancies with the teams that use the data.
  • Deal Review and Approval: Review and approve deals in Operative AOS in accordance with established business rules. Identify and escalate deals that require additional review.
  • Strategy Implementation: Implement Revenue Operations strategies related to inventory, yield, and approved pricing guidance in partnership with Sales, Client Service, Ad Ops, and other teams.
  • Execution Monitoring: Monitor how inventory and yield plans are being carried out; share results, issues, and feedback with Revenue Operations and relevant partners.

QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Ad Operations, deal desk, order management, inventory management, or a related operational role.
  • Strong attention to detail and experience maintaining accurate business data across teams or systems.
  • Ability to review transactions against established guidelines and exercise sound judgment.
  • Strong coordination and communication skills, including the ability to turn direction into consistent execution.
  • Comfort working with data to monitor results and identify discrepancies.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in media, advertising, podcasting, digital audio, video, or streaming.
  • Familiarity with inventory, pricing, yield, ratecards, or deal approval workflows.
  • Experience with Operative AOS, Salesforce, or other CRM and order management systems.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Finance, Business Administration, or a quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.

job.title: Manager, Podcast Marketing
job.description:
Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.

Red Seat Ventures partners with the world’s top creators across multiple genres to grow and monetize their content through advertising, subscriptions, live events, and beyond. We take a multiplatform approach spanning podcasting, video, FAST, and more, backed by our proprietary technology stack, including Supercast for subscriptions and Speakeasy for hosting, distribution, and monetization.

Named after Ted Williams’ longest home run at Fenway Park, Red Seat Ventures was built with a simple mandate: swing for the fences. Today, we are the fastest-growing creator network, backed by Tubi Media Group and Fox Corporation.

  • Understanding of animation-graph techniques and workflows

RESPONSIBILTIES

As a Technical Animator (Rigging) you will be creating rigs for characters and animated objects. You will refine skin-weights, work on cloth simulation, and physical objects. As a rigger, you will improve character setups and game engine workflows to overcome the technical challenges associated with creating animations for our games.

  • Skinning of human character meshes, animated props and interactive objects.
  • Setting up physics for cloth objects, accessories and props.
  • Integrating characters into the game and maintaining rigs for DCC and ingame.
  • Find solutions to animation and rig problems. Keep current with the latest animation technologies and trends.
  • Investigate, diagnose, and resolve animation bugs across tools, pipelines, and in-game setups.
  • Optimize character rigs and animation assets to ensure they meet memory and frame rate performance budgets without compromising visual quality.
  • Sharing knowledge with animators, artists and programmers, and writing technical documents and guidelines.

RÉSUMÉ DU POSTE

En tant qu’animateur technique (Rigging), vous créerez des rigs pour les personnages et les objets animés. Vous peaufinerez les pondérations de skinning, travaillerez sur la simulation de tissus ainsi que sur les objets physiques. En tant que spécialiste du rigging, vous améliorerez les configurations de personnages et les workflows du moteur de jeu afin de relever les défis techniques liés à la création d’animations pour nos jeux.

RESPONSABILITÉS

  • Effectuer le skinning des maillages de personnages humains, des accessoires animés et des objets interactifs.
  • Configurer la physique pour les objets en tissu, les accessoires et les props.
  • Intégrer les personnages dans le jeu et assurer la maintenance des rigs pour les DCC et dans le jeu.
  • Trouver des solutions aux problèmes d’animation et de rig. Se tenir au courant des plus récentes technologies et tendances en matière d’animation.
  • Examiner, diagnostiquer et résoudre les bogues d’animation dans les outils, les pipelines et les configurations en jeu.
  • Optimiser les rigs de personnages et les assets d’animation afin de respecter les budgets de mémoire et de fréquence d’images sans compromettre la qualité visuelle.
  • Partager ses connaissances avec les membres des équipes d’animation, d’art et de programmation, et rédiger de la documentation technique et des lignes directrices.

  • Excellent technical skills like rigging and skinning as well as a good understanding of the principles of animation.
  • Expertise working with Unreal Engine, Motionbuilder and Maya.
  • Experience in the creation of animations tools and the development of workflows and asset pipelines.

  • Expérience dans la création de rigs faciaux.
  • Expérience avec les configurations de personnages modulaires.
  • Bonne compréhension des stratégies d’optimisation des performances pour les jeux vidéo

The Manager, Product role will spearhead the product side of Enterprise Rights Management, including the strategy, roadmap, operating model, and execution of complex technology initiatives. The role combines senior product leadership, technical product management, and direct people management. It will lead and develop Product Managers and related product resources while partnering closely with Engineering, Architecture, Data, Security, Operations, and business stakeholders.

A primary focus will be the successful implementation and evolution of a modern Rights Management System (RMS), supported by integrated data capabilities, workflow automation, and responsible use of AI. The role must be able to translate business and rights-management needs into clear product direction, technically sound solutions, executable roadmaps, and measurable business outcomes.

Responsibilities:

  • Product Strategy and Portfolio Leadership
    • Define and drive the product vision, multi-year roadmap, priorities, and delivery strategy for RMS and the broader Enterprise Rights product portfolio.
    • Translate business objectives, operational pain points, and user needs into product capabilities, investment priorities, and sequenced delivery plans.
    • Provide oversight across multiple concurrent initiatives and workstreams, balancing strategic priorities, delivery dependencies, risks, and available capacity.
    • Establish clear product governance, decision rights, success measures, and communication practices across the portfolio.
    • Partner with senior stakeholders to align product investments with enterprise technology strategy and business outcomes.
  • Technical Product and Solution Leadership
    • Act as the senior product partner to Engineering, Architecture, Data, and platform teams throughout discovery, solution design, implementation, testing, deployment, and adoption.
    • Guide product decisions involving SaaS platforms, enterprise integrations, APIs, data models, workflow orchestration, cloud services, security, and scalability.
    • Ensure business requirements are translated into clear product requirements, capabilities, epics, acceptance criteria, and implementation priorities.
    • Establish and reinforce effective use of Jira and Confluence for backlog management, requirements traceability, product documentation, decision tracking, and cross-functional collaboration.
    • Challenge assumptions, identify technical and process dependencies early, and help teams make informed tradeoffs across scope, value, timing, risk, and maintainability.
    • Provide product leadership for vendor evaluations, implementation partners, and third-party platforms where applicable.
  • RMS Implementation and Transformation
    • Lead the product side of the RMS implementation, including business alignment, capability definition, prioritization, roadmap management, readiness, and adoption.
    • Coordinate product activities across rights, content acquisition, legal, distribution, finance, operations, engineering, data, and other impacted functions.
    • Ensure RMS delivery is connected to the broader Rights ecosystem, including source systems, downstream consumers, reporting, integrations, and the enterprise data layer.
    • Drive transparent reporting of progress, decisions, risks, dependencies, and required leadership actions.
    • Promote sustainable product practices that support implementation delivery as well as long-term platform ownership and continuous improvement.
  • AI, Data, and Intelligent Automation
    • Define and prioritize opportunities to use AI, machine learning, automation, and advanced analytics to improve rights workflows, decision support, data quality, and user experience.
    • Partner with Data, Engineering, Legal, Privacy, Security, and business teams to evaluate AI use cases and move appropriate concepts from discovery into delivery.
    • Ensure AI-enabled product capabilities are grounded in reliable data, clearly defined business value, measurable outcomes, and responsible governance.
    • Champion reusable data and AI capabilities that complement RMS and strengthen the future-state Rights platform.
    • Monitor relevant technology trends and recommend practical opportunities for innovation without losing focus on core delivery commitments.
  • People Leadership and Product Operating Model
    • Directly manage, coach, and develop Product Managers and other product resources, setting clear expectations, priorities, and development goals.
    • Create a consistent product management operating model across discovery, planning, requirements, delivery, stakeholder engagement, and outcome measurement.
    • Lead the product delivery operating model across Agile teams, including roadmap planning, release planning, sprint planning, backlog refinement, prioritization, capacity management, sprint execution, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and continuous improvement, adapting the approach to the needs of each initiative.
    • Assign ownership across initiatives and ensure Product Managers have the context, support, and accountability needed to lead their workstreams.
    • Build a collaborative, high-performing culture focused on customer value, technical credibility, transparency, and execution.
    • Assess team capacity and capability needs and recommend appropriate staffing, role design, and external support when required.
  • Stakeholder, Change, and Executive Communication
    • Serve as a primary product leadership contact for Enterprise Rights and represent the portfolio in cross-functional and leadership forums.
    • Facilitate alignment across business and technology teams, resolve competing priorities, and escalate decisions when necessary.
    • Communicate roadmap status, delivery health, risks, options, and recommendations in a concise and decision-oriented manner.
    • Partner with change-management, training, and operational teams to support adoption and successful transition to new capabilities.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years of progressive experience in product management, business solutions, technology product leadership, or a related discipline.
  • 2+ years of direct people-management experience, including coaching and developing product professionals.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex enterprise product portfolios or large-scale technology transformations from strategy through implementation.
  • Strong technical fluency and experience partnering with Engineering, Architecture, Data, Security, and enterprise platform teams.
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS implementations, systems integration, APIs, data platforms, cloud services, workflow automation, or related technologies.
  • Strong working knowledge of Agile methodologies and product-delivery practices, including roadmap planning, release planning, sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation, prioritization, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and continuous improvement.
  • Hands-on experience using Jira and Confluence to manage product backlogs, document requirements and decisions, track delivery, and maintain clear communication across product, engineering, and business teams.
  • Scrum, Agile, or product management certification, such as Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP), SAFe certification, or an equivalent credential, is preferred.
  • Practical understanding of AI-enabled products, automation, analytics, data governance, and responsible AI considerations.
  • Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, prioritization, problem-solving, and organizational-change skills.
  • Experience in media and entertainment, rights management, licensing, content operations, intellectual property, or a similarly complex domain is strongly preferred.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Can move comfortably between business outcomes, product details, and technical discussions.

Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.

Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.


Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Sitting within the vibrant, agile-focused EMEA HR Operations function, the HR Co-Ordinator, based in Poland, is the first point of contact for HR queries and plays a key role in supporting the efficient delivery of HR services to the business and wider People team. As part of the EMEA HR Operations Team, you will provide administrative and coordination support across the full employee lifecycle to employees predominantly in Poland, as well as Hungary, Czech Republic and Germany, ensuring a smooth and positive employee experience.

 

Working within a busy and fast-paced environment, you will manage day-to-day HR queries through our ticketing system, ensuring requests are handled promptly and within agreed service levels. You will support core HR processes such as onboarding, offboarding, and employee changes, while maintaining accurate employee records and data across HR systems.

 

As part of a team going through an exciting period of change, you will help shape the ongoing improvement of HR processes by spotting opportunities to enhance efficiency and service delivery. This role offers great exposure to a wide range of HR activities and is an excellent opportunity to build a strong foundation in HR operations.

 

What will you do:

  • Be the first point of contact for HR queries from employees and managers across Poland and the wider EMEA region via the AskHR Salesforce ticketing system,
  • Deliver a high-quality employee experience by responding within agreed SLAs and ensure effective queries resolution or, where needed, escalating to the relevant specialist team,
  • Coordinate the triaging and escalation of HR queries across other HR functions, including Payroll, Total Rewards, IT, and HRBP teams, to ensure a seamless and consistent HR service for the business,
  • Manage data change tickets and job requisition requests in line with internal process, partnering with HRBPs, Compensation, Finance, and the HR Data Team to ensure accurate and timely processing,
  • Contribute to accurate HR data through regular reporting, data validation, and system updates, partnering with the HR Data team on regular data audits,
  • Keep HR systems (e.g., employee records, trackers, ticketing tools, local third-party systems) in line with defined processes and SLAs,
  • Support core HR lifecycle processes, including onboarding, offboarding, reference checks, and employment changes, working closely with TA Ops, HR Data, Tech, and Facilities teams,
  • Support leave, absence, and time tracking administration, as well as HR-to-Payroll month-end processing and approvals,
  • Support T1 benefits queries,
  • Bring together face-to-face employee sessions, such as onboarding induction,
  • Take part in scheduled audits and data quality checks to ensure compliance with statutory, data protection, and internal requirements,
  • Help keep the maintenance and communication of HR policies and procedures for Poland and the wider EMEA region in line with changes in local legislation,
  • Keep accurate and up-to-date employee records in line with data protection and company standards,
  • Support to the EMEA HR Operations Manager and wider People team, including maintaining organisational charts, headcount files, and census reports,
  • Bring ideas to process improvements by spotting insights and trends, and getting involved in continuous improvement initiatives across the team.

 

We offer:

  • Employment contract (12 months FTC),
  • Multisport card + private medical care,
  • Complimentary subscriptions to HBO Max, and other Skydance streaming services and digital news products,
  • Access to e-learning and self-development platforms and office library,
  • English language lessons,
  • Active global inclusion and CSR groups,
  • Robust employee engagement opportunities, including access to exclusive screenings and events, speaker series, volunteer activities and more,
  • Well located, modern office with lots of amenities – adjustable desks, electronics toolkit, 3D printer ready for you to use, pool table, console, table tennis, massage chair.

 

We are looking for people who have:

  • Great communication skills – you listen well and can clearly convey information, ideas and instructions to individuals and teams, both verbally and in writing,
  • Proficient in English (spoken and written); proficiency in Polish and/or another EMEA language such as Hungarian, Czech or German is an advantage,
  • At least 1 year of experience working in a similar HR role (e.g. HR administration, HR operations, or HR coordination),
  • Real attention to detail, accuracy and accountability,
  • Customer-service mindset with a focus on delivering a best-in-class and consistent employee experience,
  • Understanding of Polish and wider European employment law and HR operations,
  • Well organised, comfortable juggling multiple priorities and meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment,
  • Experience using case management tools (Service Now, Salesforce), HRIS (Oracle, Success Factors) or equivalent, and Microsoft and Google applications,
  • A knack for spotting potential problems or issues, and taking the right action to resolve or escalate them,
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a team, including building relationships and contributing to a positive team dynamic.

job.description:

ML Platform Lead Engineer, Training & Inference
Organization: Applied Machine Learning Group (AMLG) → ML Platform
Level: Lead / Senior Lead (IC4–IC5)

 

Overview 

We are seeking a Senior Lead / Lead ML Platform Engineer to architect and own the technical direction for our Training and Inference infrastructure. This is a high-leverage role designed for an expert who understands the deep technical stack required to shift ML models from research to global production. You will be responsible for the "engine room" of the AMLG, ensuring that our MLEs can train massive models efficiently and serve them with sub-millisecond reliability. This role requires a unique blend of expertise in distributed systems and hardware acceleration. You will lead the adoption and optimization of AnyScale (Ray) for distributed training and manage a high-performance Kubernetes-based inference environment. You aren't just managing clusters; you are building a seamless, scalable platform that abstracts the complexity of GPUs and distributed compute for the entire organization.

Why This Role Matters

The ML Platform Lead is the force-multiplier for every other ML pod. In this role, you will directly shape:

The Training Foundation: Establishing AnyScale/Ray as the standard for distributed compute, enabling MLEs to train models on petabytes of data without managing infrastructure.
Inference at Scale: Architecting the serving layer that handles billions of requests per day, optimizing for both p99 latency and GPU utilization.
Operational Excellence: Setting the organizational standards for how ML models are deployed, monitored, and scaled across the enterprise.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Roadmap & Strategy: Own the long-term architectural direction for the Training and Inference domains, ensuring the platform scales 10x over a 1–3 year horizon.
Distributed Training Leadership: Lead the implementation and optimization of Ray/AnyScale, providing a unified compute layer for batch processing, model training, and reinforcement learning.
High-Performance Inference: Design and maintain K8s-based inference servers (e.g., Triton, TorchServe, or vLLM) optimized for GPU memory management and high throughput.
Hardware & Cost Optimization: Navigate the trade-offs between different GPU instances (A100s, H100s, T4s), optimizing for cost, availability, and performance.
Cross-Team Standardization: Solve high-leverage problems that affect multiple pods (e.g., Entry, Session, Presentation), establishing reusable patterns for CI/CD, model versioning, and canary deployments.
Reliability Engineering: Define and enforce SLIs/SLOs for the platform, ensuring that infrastructure failures never interrupt the user-facing personalization experience.
Mentorship & Coaching: Act as a technical mentor to senior engineers across the ML Platform and Applied ML pods, raising the bar for system design and operational rigor.

Basic Qualifications

6-8+ years of experience in ML Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, or high-scale Backend Engineering.
Orchestration & Serving: Extensive experience with Kubernetes (K8s) and serving frameworks for large-scale ML models.
Hardware Proficiency: Strong knowledge of GPU architecture, CUDA, and optimizing ML workloads for hardware acceleration.
Leadership (IC4/5): Proven track record of owning the technical direction for a major domain anddriving impact across multiple teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Infra-as-Code (Terraform/Pulumi) and building automated MLOps pipelines.
Distributed Systems Mastery: Deep expertise with Ray (AnyScale) or similar distributed compute frameworks.
Familiarity with ML observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Weights & Biases, or MLFlow).
Experience managing multi-cloud or hybrid-cloud ML environments.
Deep knowledge of Python and C++ for performance-critical systems.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 6–12 months, you will:

Unify the Compute Layer: Successfully transition the majority of AMLG training workloads to a governed AnyScale/Ray environment.
Optimize Inference ROI: Measurably improve GPU utilization and reduce inference costs through better auto-scaling and server optimization.
Establish Durable Standards: Author the "Gold Standard" for ML deployments that is adopted by at least three other pods in the organization.
Reduce Systemic Risk: Implement a self-healing infrastructure layer that significantly reduces manual intervention for cluster-related failures.

job.description:
Press Operator III

Gannett Publishing Services

Wilmington, Delaware

“We have an opening for a highly motivated individual in the Gannett corporation at one of our regional print facilities.”

“It is a fast-paced manufacturing operation which would require basic mechanical and\or manufacturing skill sets” This position is Full Time and will offer $20 per hour based on work-related experience.

The Wilmington GPS group is looking for a full-time Press Operator to assist with daily production on our Goss HO presses. The work includes working with a team to prepare the presses for production, operates the presses or any of their components, cleans the presses and the pressroom, maintains the mechanical readiness of the presses, and other duties as assigned.Every member of the pressroom staff constantly strives to achieve the following goals, and the contribution of every press operator is necessary for success:

·Optimum quality of printed products.

·Observance of all scheduled start and stop times.

·Conservation of material resources, especially newsprint.

·A clean and safe working environment.

This position requires a high school education or equivalent. Three years’ experience in web offset printing is desirable, although production experience of any kind may be helpful.Mechanical ability and familiarity with computers is preferred. Candidates should have the ability to adapt to change, prioritize work, handle multiple tasks, remain flexible and interact with people while demonstrating patience.You must be able to lift/carry up to 100 pounds. Must be able to push/pull up to 2000 pounds. A press operator spends most working hours on his/her feet.In addition to long periods of standing, a press operator is required to climb stairs on the six-level press structure.Operators engaged in press maintenance and some cleaning activities will be required to stoop, kneel, crouch and crawl. They often work in confined areas. Color vision is required.

This position is full-time shift work, which may include scheduled nights, and weekends.

job.title: Senior Systems Engineer
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

NPR is seeking an experienced, technically rigorous Senior IT Systems Engineer to join our IT Systems team. In this role, you will serve as a primary technical lead responsible for the design, deployment, administration, and optimization of NPR’s core virtualized data center infrastructure. The ideal candidate brings deep, hands-on expertise in VMware vSphere, enterprise Storage Area Networks (SAN/NAS), and Cisco Unified Computing System (UCS) environments.

You will play a critical role in ensuring the high availability, scalability, performance, and security of our enterprise systems while partnering across Technology to advance infrastructure modernization and automation initiatives in support of our nationwide public media mission.

Responsibilities

Data Center Architecture & Storage Administration

  1. Architect Virtualized Infrastructure: Design, deploy, and manage core virtualized data center infrastructure, leading enterprise VMware vSphere environments, Cisco UCS compute platforms, and SAN/NAS storage arrays.
  2. Administer Enterprise Compute & Storage: Execute routine server builds, security patch management, virtual machine lifecycle administration, and enterprise storage capacity allocation.
  3. Advance Cloud & Hybrid Integration: Evaluate systems architecture and hybrid-cloud strategy, taking operational ownership of the maintenance and integration of cloud infrastructure (AWS or Azure).

Systems Governance & Disaster Recovery

  1. Govern Disaster Recovery Strategies: Design, maintain, and rigorously test business continuity and disaster recovery strategies, including enterprise backups, data replication, and automated site failovers.
  2. Manage Structured Change Processes: Recommend, test, and implement system enhancements in strict adherence to established organizational change management policies and procedures.
  3. Publish System Documentation & SOPs: Author and maintain comprehensive systems architecture diagrams, standard operating procedures (SOPs), runbooks, and technical documentation for IT colleagues and system stakeholders.

Incident Escalation & Operational Automation

  1. Lead Tier-3 Escalations & Root Cause Analysis: Serve as the senior technical escalation point for enterprise technology teams, isolating root causes and resolving complex production incidents.
  2. Automate Infrastructure Operations: Design and execute automation scripts using modern scripting languages to streamline routine administrative tasks, infrastructure provisioning, and systems health reporting.
  3. Maintain Operational Communications: Provide timely status reporting on system health to engineering leadership, manage incident response on a 24x7 rotation, and articulate outage impact clearly to technical and operational partners.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 5+ years of dedicated experience as a Systems or Infrastructure Engineer supporting, administering, and troubleshooting systems in an enterprise data center environment.
  • Proven, hands-on experience designing and managing complex VMware vSphere environments (clustering, DRS, HA, vMotion).
  • Extensive experience with Cisco UCS Manager, configuring service profiles, templates, and physical hardware deployment.
  • Strong background in configuring and managing enterprise SAN/NAS storage arrays and storage networking protocols.
  • 2+ years of experience planning, designing, and maintaining cloud infrastructure (AWS or Azure).
  • Strong working knowledge of the Microsoft ecosystem, including Windows Server (2016+), Active Directory, Azure AD, Office 365, IIS, SQL, DFS, DHCP, and DNS.
  • Experience creating detailed systems documentation and flow charts.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to successfully handle multiple projects in a high-pressure, collaborative environment.
  • Ability to participate in an on-call rotation and a 2-week onsite rotation every two months (or as required).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Infrastructure Automation & Scripting: Experience utilizing configuration management tools (Ansible, Puppet) and writing automation scripts (PowerShell, Python, or Bash).
  • Identity, Access & Messaging Services: Practical experience managing enterprise SSO/MFA solutions, Exchange Online/Hybrid environments, or Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI).
  • Industry Certifications: Active professional certifications in VMware (VCP), Cisco (CCNA/CCNP Data Center), Microsoft, or AWS/Azure solutions architecture.

Required Skills/Competencies

job.title: Executive Assistant to Chief Product Officer
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

This role ensures that the Chief Product Officer (CPO) can operate at their highest level by keeping their schedules organized, aligned, and free of conflicts. By managing the daily flow of meetings and priorities, the EA helps both leaders stay focused on strategic work and maintain momentum across the organization.


What Motivates You

  • You enjoy creating order, clarity, and structure in fast-moving environments.
  • You excel at anticipating scheduling needs and staying ahead of conflicts.
  • You take pride in supporting senior leaders so they can operate at their best.
  • You’re energized by being a trusted, reliable point of coordination for others.
     

How You’ll Support the Mission

  • Manage highly dynamic calendars for the CPO, ensuring meetings are prioritized and aligned with organizational needs.
  • Coordinate internal and external meetings, resolving conflicts, scheduling holds, and adjusting plans quickly as priorities shift.
  • Monitor upcoming commitments and proactively flag risks, overlaps, or changes that may impact either executive’s day.
  • Ensure executives have the necessary meeting context, agendas, and pre-reads (provided by others).
  • Coordinate meeting logistics, including video links, room reservations, and attendee availability.
  • Serve as a primary contact for scheduling requests and time-sensitive coordination across teams.
  • Book travel arrangements and ensure prober travel documentation.
  • Manage and submit executive’s expenses.
  • Admin support for Product team.
  • Plan and execute culture-building events such as pizza days, snack breaks, cake for birthdays, appreciation weeks, and seasonal team activities.

 

The Skills and Experience You Bring

  • Proven experience supporting senior leaders in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong calendar management skills, with the ability to juggle shifting priorities and anticipate needs.
  • Excellent communication and follow-through, especially when coordinating across teams.
  • High attention to detail, organization, and reliability.
  • Comfort handling sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.
  • Ability to stay calm and solution-oriented when schedules or priorities change rapidly.
     

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting technology, product, or executive leadership teams.
  • Familiarity with Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, and modern productivity tools.
  • Prior experience in a role focused primarily on scheduling or operational coordination.

 

Collaboration makes us stronger. That’s why our offices are designed with open layouts, modern technology, and easy access to transportation. With certain exceptions for newsgathering and business travel, we work on-site five days a week.

job.title: Desktop & A/V Support Engineer
job.description:
About ASCAP

The American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers (ASCAP) is a membership association of more than one million songwriters, composers and music publishers, and represents some of the world’s most talented music creators. Founded and governed by songwriters, composers and publishers, it is the only performing rights organization in the U.S. that operates on a not-for-profit basis. ASCAP licenses a repertory of over 20 million musical works to hundreds of thousands of businesses that use music, including streaming services, cable television, radio and satellite radio and brick and mortar businesses such as retail stores, hotels, clubs, restaurants and bars. ASCAP collects the licensing fees; identifies, matches and processes trillions of performances every year; and returns nearly 90 cents of every dollar back to its members as royalties. The ASCAP blanket license offers an efficient solution for businesses to legally perform ASCAP music while respecting the right of songwriters and composers to be paid fairly. ASCAP puts music creators first, advocating for their rights and the value of music on Capitol Hill, driving innovation that moves the industry forward, building community and providing the resources and support that creators need to succeed in their careers. Learn more and stay in touch at www.ascap.com, on X and Instagram @ASCAP and on Facebook.

# # #


Job overview:

We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented individual with strong Mac devices and Audio Visual skills. This role will be part of our existing team of desktop engineers, primarily focused on Macs and Audio Visual support, with a secondary focus on Windows support.

The Desktop & A/V Support Engineer prioritizes and ensures timely responses and resolutions to requests and incidents for our Mac and conference room users. This role will provide IT support for hardware and business applications while also supporting AV functions such as video conferencing and events with AV components. Additionally, the Desktop & A/V Support Engineer will shift and adjust priorities based on changing business needs in our dynamic environment, while also remaining task-oriented to ensure completion of work from start to finish with appropriate solutions. This role will provide high-touch concierge support for senior ASCAP executives.

The Desktop & A/V Support Engineer within the Global Technology Solutions department is based in our New York office and reports to the Director, Support Services. This position is subject to ASCAP’s in office policy.

Areas of Responsibility & Accountability:

  • Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve complex Mac/PC hardware and software issues with a focus on device security.
  • Support and continually review enterprise Mac/PC client hardware / software standards and strategy.
  • Support client OS, application, mobile, virus, and hardware issues for users.
  • Design, implement, and maintain both Mac desktop group policy using JAMF and PC desktop group policy using BigFix and Intune.
  • Support and troubleshoot conferencing systems including platforms such as Webex, Zoom, Microsoft Teams and Google Meet, as well as hardware room systems.
  • Support the AV production at internal & external events.
  • Work with vendors to design and maintain hardware and software standards.
  • Develop automated workflows and technologies to efficiently manage Mac endpoints.
  • Maintain an inventory database, assign hardware and software assets, and manage warranty and service agreement information.
  • Assist with root cause analysis as it relates to Apple/PC computers and all peripheral devices.
  • Interact with IT and AV vendors, and management, to ensure solutions are being provided for all escalating tickets.
  • Independently resolve complex, break/fix issues in person or via telephone.
  • Be available as needed and provide high-touch technical support to onsite and remote members of ASCAP Senior Management.
  • Write, maintain and implement systems documentation for incident responses and recurring issues.
  • Other projects and duties as assigned.

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in computer science, or a related field preferred.
  • Apple Certified Support Professional (ACSP) and/or Apple Certified IT Professional (ACITP) Certifications preferred.
  • 3+ years of relevant working experience, including troubleshooting, diagnosing, and resolving complex Mac/MS and PC hardware and software issues.
  • Ability to communicate seamlessly and work productively with peers and senior management.
  • Experience with Mac endpoint patching platforms and administration procedures using JAMF.
  • Experience supporting Webex, Zoom, MS Teams, and Google Meet.
  • Experience supporting AV production environments and events.
  • Experience with Microsoft desktop imaging and distribution platforms such as Intune and BigFix.
  • Hands-on desktop support experience in a large enterprise environment preferred.
  • Experience working with anti-virus platforms preferred.
  • In-depth understanding of Mac based hardware, software, and peripherals.
  • Experience with Cisco conferencing hardware including room kits, boards, and peripherals.
  • Shell scripting experience is a plus.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, adjusting set shift hours or days when needed.
  • Ability to travel to other satellite offices when needed.
  • Interest in audio engineering and event production is a plus.
  • This position currently requires the incumbent to be in the office three days per week.

Compensation/Benefits:

Besides providing a unique and dynamic work environment, there are a few other reasons you should consider ASCAP in your career planning. We also offer generous benefit options that are comprehensive and provide the flexibility that most employees want and need. These health care and financial plan options include the following:

  • A choice of either network-only provider medical and dental plans or more flexible medical and dental plans where you can see providers in or out-of-network
  • Vision plan that offers both in and out-of-network provider options
  • 401(k) Plan that offers pre-tax, Roth, and an after-tax employee contribution option, including a company match for pre-tax and Roth contributions

  • Generous time-off policy

job.title: Identity Operations Engineer
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Job Summary:

As a key member of the UMG Operations Center, the Identity Operations Engineer operates and continuously improves UMG’s hybrid identity, access, authentication, privileged-access, and identity-governance services. The role provides specialist operational support across Workday-driven identity lifecycle processes, Saviynt/IGA, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, MFA, PAM, enterprise application integrations, and connected services.


The position will be a team player working to maintain reliable identity integrations and resolve operational issues involving joiners, movers, leavers, contractors, rejoiners, application access, entitlements, authentication, privileged accounts, and non-human identities. The role includes incident, request, change, problem, access-review, audit-evidence, monitoring, and automation activities. The role partners closely with Engineering, Architecture, Cloud, Observability, ITSM, security, regional IT teams, and external providers. Effective communication skills are a must, all while being sensitive to a wide diversity of cultural and technical backgrounds in a global business environment.


Job Functions:

  • Apply least-privilege, segregation-of-duties, secure administration, and identity-governance best practices to protect UMG information resources from unauthorized use, inappropriate access, disclosure, damage, or loss.
  • Troubleshoot and resolves issues related to identities, systems, access, accounts, authentication, authorization, entitlements, and permissions.
  • Investigate and resolve specialist escalations from AD Services and TechOps IAM queues, including application-role access, SecAdmin access, reference-user comparisons, disabled application accounts, access removals, and entitlement issues.
  • Provide ITIL-based operational support across identity services, including incident, request, change, problem, and major-incident participation. Maintain clear ServiceNow assignment, evidence, troubleshooting notes, resolution details, and closure criteria.
  • Operate and troubleshoot identity lifecycle integrations, including joiner, mover, leaver, contractor, rehire/rejoiner, and exception scenarios. Investigate failed provisioning tasks, reconciliation issues, orphaned accounts, and mismatches between authoritative HR data, IGA records, directories, and target applications.
  • Support Workday-driven lifecycle processes and Saviynt/IGA workflows, including access requests, approvals, entitlement ownership, access reviews, remediation, audit evidence, and provisioning/reconciliation failures.
  • Operate and support on-premises and cloud identity services and their configuration, including Active Directory domain services, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Duo, YubiKey/FIDO/PIV authentication, CyberArk/PAM, Saviynt/IGA, Splunk, Active Roles where applicable, PingOne/Aura where applicable, 1Password, HashiCorp Vault, and connected enterprise applications.
  • Troubleshoot Microsoft Entra enterprise applications and federation integrations, including SAML, OIDC/OAuth, claims, redirect URIs, app registrations, group assignments, Conditional Access, Microsoft Graph, certificates, and token/authentication failures.
  • Support privileged and non-human identities, including elevated accounts, service accounts, application accounts, RPA accounts, resource/test accounts, B2B/guest identities, and accounts requiring vault onboarding, password rotation, or ownership validation.
  • Support MFA and authentication operations, including Duo, YubiKey, FIDO/PIV, recovery/reset workflows, OAuth-token issues, and authentication failures across workforce and application services.
  • Complete the key metric reporting and analysis for the Identity Management environment as required.
  • Work to ensure audit tasks related to Identity Management are completed on time, with participation of appropriate parties. Maintain auditable evidence for access approvals, reviews, privileged access, lifecycle actions, exceptions, and remediation.
  • Participate in security incident response teams as needed, including identity compromise, suspicious authentication, privileged-access, credential, and account-containment activities.
  • Utilize industry best practices for appropriate standards, processes, procedures, tools, and documentation.
  • Ensure the maintenance, patching, operating, and monitoring of IAM systems is in place and completed on schedule. Use Splunk and observability service dashboards to identify failures, trends, and emerging operational risk.
  • Maintain accurate ServiceNow CMDB relationships for identity services, configuration items, application integrations, owners, support groups, and dependencies; identify and report stale or incomplete CMDB data.
  • Participate in developing automation to reduce the time spent on routine tasks.
  • This is a shift-based role supporting UMG’s 24/7 follow-the-sun Technical Operations Center. The role participates in scheduled shifts, weekend/public-holiday coverage, on-call rotation, and structured handoffs with regional operations teams

Essential:

  • Solid technical skills in the Identity Management space, including Active Directory and Entra ID.

job.title: Line Producer
job.description:
Our client, a major entertainment company, is actively looking for a Line Producer to join their team in NYC! This is a fully on-site position, so only local applicants will be considered.


*** Please note this is a PART TIME position (expected ~20 hours per week


*** This begins as a 9 month contract, with an opportunity to extend longer


OVERVIEW:

This producer will sit within Project Management as a dedicated resource for the video and motion graphics team, owning alignment between the video team, project managers, internal creative teams, and executive stakeholders, and proactively communicating status, timelines, and progress updates for multiple video and animation projects simultaneously in real time.


The ideal candidate is an experienced producer fluent in the full creative suite, from video production and post through motion graphics and visual effects, who understands how AI is reshaping all of it.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Partner closely with the video team to plan and execute projects from brief through final delivery, ensuring production needs, timelines, and deliverables are clearly defined and aligned with Project Management master schedules.
  • Build and maintain production timelines across multiple concurrent video projects.
  • Communicate status and progress in real time throughout creative development and execution, anticipating production challenges and flagging risks and bottlenecks early to both the video team and Project Management.
  • When creative direction or production needs change, quickly re-adapt schedules and plans and provide the video team and project managers with actionable next steps.
  • Produce written recaps and confirmed direction following every creative review.
  • Coordinate resources, vendors, and freelance talent, including tool access, licenses, and vendor relationships.
  • Manage budgets, track and reconcile project spend.
  • Support production workflows including asset organization and version control, and apply Google's suite and similar tools to production management itself, from scheduling and tracking systems to recaps and status communication.


QUALIFICATIONS

  • Strong project management and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage timelines, deliverables, budgets, resources, and competing priorities across multiple projects.
  • Five+ years of video production experience, ideally including live event, broadcast networks, or entertainment studio/brand marketing.
  • On-set and live event production experience, including rehearsals and show-day operations.
  • Thorough understanding of post-production workflows and tools, including editorial, editing, motion graphics, and visual effects.
  • Familiarity with modern production tools such as Runway, and comfort working in rapidly evolving pipelines.
  • Experience producing and delivering content for LED screen environments, live events, and unique formats, including large scale, ultra wide, and unconventional canvases.
  • Established network of freelance talent and vendors, including editors, motion designers, and production support, and the ability to staff up, supervise, and manage them as projects demand.
  • Highly organized, proactive, and solutions-oriented, with the ability to anticipate issues and keep projects moving in a fast-paced environment.
  • Extensive knowledge of the creative processes from pre-planning, creative development, routing & feedback management, asset sourcing & organization, video and animation specs quality control, and final file delivery.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication.

job.title: Senior Director of Analytics
job.description:
Company And Culture

Complex is the definitive platform for global youth culture and music lifestyle, seamlessly integrating cutting-edge content, commerce and live experiences with unparalleled scale. Through innovative content, Complex tells stories of music, streetwear and style, sports, art and beyond. Its content engages in a dynamic conversation with the audience, reflecting and shaping the zeitgeist of convergence culture. A powerful media juggernaut paired with a curated marketplace, Complex is redefining the way fans interact with their favorite brands and artists and reshaping the future of digital culture and commerce.

Why We're Hiring

Data and analytics are critical to how Complex makes decisions, but this role is about much more than dashboards, reporting, or tracking KPIs. We’re looking for a senior analytics leader who can turn complex, imperfect data into clear business insights and strategic action.

Complex operates across eCommerce, Content, Advertising, and Live Events, creating a uniquely rich—and often complicated—data environment. Understanding how these businesses work individually, and how they intersect, is a core part of the opportunity. The right person will embrace that complexity, quickly identify what matters, and help leadership make better decisions across the organization.

This role requires a strategic thinker who can move fluidly between high-level business questions and detailed analysis. You will partner directly with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to identify opportunities, solve important business problems, and determine where data can have the greatest impact. You will be expected to use AI and emerging analytics tools to accelerate analysis, automate repetitive work, explore new questions, and move from question to insight to action faster.

The goal isn't to build more dashboards. The goal is to help Complex make better decisions and drive better business outcomes.

This role will be on-site 5 days a week at our NYC office or our Los Angeles, CA office.

Thomson Reuters is looking for a Staff Software Engineer / Architect – AI to join our CoCounsel Forward Deployed Engineering team.

This role sits at the intersection of AI engineering, architecture, product development, and customer delivery. You will work directly with customers to understand complex business and technical problems, design the right AI-powered solution, and help build and deploy that solution into production.

The ideal candidate is a highly hands-on AI engineer who can move comfortably between customer discovery, technical architecture, software development, and production delivery. Key Responsibilities

  • Partner directly with customers and internal stakeholders to understand business and technical problems and translate them into scalable AI solutions.

With one million professionals now relying on CoCounsel across 107 countries, the work you do here will matter.


As a Senior Software Engineer – AI, you will work side-by-side with the AI Solutions Architect, Senior Legal AI Engineers, and fellow AI engineers to design, build, and deploy bespoke AI solutions from zero to one for law firms and corporate legal departments. You are a strong, independent engineer who takes solution designs and architectural direction and drives them all the way to production — owning your work end to end, contributing to solution design, and bringing deep AI engineering craft to every engagement.

This is not a back-office engineering role. You will participate in technical discovery with clients, contribute to solution design, develop tailored AI systems, and own the quality of what you ship — ensuring the AI we deploy consistently meets the high trust standards of legal professionals. Your architecture will be reviewed and shaped in partnership with the AI Solutions Architect, giving you a strong technical support structure while you focus on building.


Key Responsibilities


Solution Design & Engineering

  • Design and implement AI-powered solutions tailored to law firm and corporate legal workflows, including contract review, litigation support, discovery automation, and regulatory analysis.
  • Work within architectural frameworks set by the AI Solutions Architect to build scalable, secure, and maintainable AI systems.
  • Architect RAG pipelines, custom AI agents, and multi-component systems that integrate securely into client environments, including document management systems and enterprise platforms.
  • Build and configure multi-step agentic workflows leveraging CoCounsel, Westlaw, and Practical Law capabilities, as well as third-party AI APIs and enterprise integrations.
  • Implement Agent-to-Agent (A2A) workflows and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations to enable interoperability between AI agents and external tools, data sources, and enterprise systems.
  • Design and deploy bespoke automation pipelines and integration scripts tailored to each customer's use case.
  • Implement MLOps and LLMOps practices to support scalable, maintainable deployment of AI solutions in production.

Observability, Quality & Trust

  • Implement monitoring, logging, and tracing solutions to track LLM performance, latency, token usage, and system health in production.
  • Leverage AI evaluation platforms (such as LangSmith, Braintrust, or Weights & Biases) to assess model outputs, track evaluation metrics over time, and surface quality regressions across deployed solutions.
  • Contribute to LLM evaluation efforts — assessing model outputs for accuracy, citation quality, hallucination risk, and fitness for high-stakes legal use — in partnership with the AI Solutions Architect and product team.
  • Develop and maintain evaluation benchmarks, test suites, and red-teaming protocols grounded in real legal workflows, and translate findings into structured input for product and engineering roadmaps.
  • Ensure all solutions comply with ethical AI principles, data protection standards, and enterprise security requirements.

Discovery & Client Engagement

  • Participate in technical discovery on client engagements — contributing to use case scoping, solution design discussions, and early-stage prototyping.
  • Translate complex legal workflows, pain points, and client goals into concrete engineering tasks and implementation plans.
  • Conduct technical demonstrations and early-stage prototyping to support solution design and client confidence.
  • Build trust with legal professionals through fluency in legal terminology, workflows, and the real-world constraints of legal practice.
  • Work directly with legal SMEs to understand their professional reasoning and judgement, and translate that domain knowledge into AI pipeline design, evaluation criteria, and benchmarks.

Technical Contribution & Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with Senior Legal AI Engineers, the AI Solutions Architect, and fellow AI engineers to deliver high-quality solutions across engagements.
  • Contribute to team knowledge-sharing, internal documentation, and reusable solution templates that accelerate delivery across the team.
  • Evaluate and prototype cutting-edge AI techniques, including emerging agentic frameworks, MCP-based tool integrations, and prompt engineering approaches, to improve output quality across diverse legal use cases.
  • Stay current with AI research and the rapidly evolving legal AI landscape, bringing new ideas and approaches into the team.

Required Qualifications


  • 5+ years of software engineering experience with a strong foundation in system design, distributed systems, and clean architecture.
  • At least 2 years of hands-on experience building and deploying AI/ML solutions in production, including LLM-powered applications.
  • Proficiency in orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, PydanticAI, or AutoGen, and solid understanding of RAG architectures and vector databases.
  • Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) workflow patterns for building interoperable, tool-augmented AI systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python (FastAPI or equivalent) and experience building RESTful and async, event-driven architectures.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, CDK, or equivalent).
  • Experience with observability and monitoring stacks (Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, or similar) for production AI systems.
  • Experience with AI evaluation platforms (e.g., LangSmith, Langfuse, Braintrust, Weights & Biases) and the ability to contribute to structured evaluation pipelines for LLM-powered applications.
  • Strong background in secure API development, including authentication and authorization protocols (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT).
  • Strong prompt engineering skills — ability to design, iterate, and optimize LLM prompts for specialized domain tasks.
  • Demonstrated fluency with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot) — this teams operates AI-natively across all engineering workflows, not just client deliverables.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage credibly with both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, including legal professionals.
  • Comfort working independently, navigating ambiguity, and contributing meaningfully in client-facing workshops and discovery sessions.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Fluency in legal terminology and demonstrated experience working directly within or alongside legal teams.
  • Experience in a regulated industry — legal, fintech, or healthcare — and familiarity with associated compliance and data privacy requirements.
  • Experience with legal platforms, document management systems, and legal technology ecosystems.
  • Experience with container orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes).
  • Knowledge of MLOps and LLMOps practices for production AI system lifecycle management.
  • Understanding of the scaling, limitations, and fine-tuning of transformer-based models.
  • Familiarity with emerging AI interoperability standards and protocols, including MCP ecosystem tooling and A2A communication patterns.
  • A portfolio of projects demonstrating in skill building complex, production-grade AI solutions.

What You'll Be Part Of

Over 20,000 law firms and corporate legal departments, and the majority of top US courts and Am Law 100 firms, already trust CoCounsel. CoCounsel functions as an execution layer embedded within professional platforms, combining foundation models, proprietary AI engineering, proprietary content, and domain expertise to complete multi-step workflows end to end. The Forward Deployed Engineering team sits at the sharp end of that trust — closest to clients, closest to the hardest problems, and closest to the future of how legal work gets done.   • Production experience operating a search engine such as Vespa, OpenSearch, or Elasticsearch, including capacity planning and index lifecycle 
  • Operational rigor: SLO definition, observability, on-call leadership, and learning from incidents 
  • Fluency with AI-assisted development tools 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience designing APIs consumed by multiple teams, with versioning, access control, and a strong developer experience 
  • Multi-tenant platform security: identity integration, role-based access control, encryption, and customer-managed keys 
  • Experience operating Kafka or another distributed messaging platform in production 
  • Experience building internal developer platforms where documentation and ease of adoption are treated as product concerns 
  • Tracing and observability for non-deterministic or agentic workflows

In the first 90 days

Customer Success Manager

Você busca desenvolver sua carreira e atuar como Customer Success Manager em uma empresa líder no segmento de Tecnologia? Junte-se a nós!

A Thomson Reuters combina a inteligência, tecnologia e expertise humana para fornecer respostas confiáveis que ajudam os profissionais a tomar decisões confiantes e administrar melhor seus negócios.
Nós os ajudamos a reinventar a maneira como os profissionais trabalham, nossa equipe de especialistas reúne informação, inovação e insight para desvendar situações complexas nos mercados Tributário, Comercio Exterior, Contábil e Jurídico, respaldando nossos clientes na tomada de decisão.

 

Principais Responsabilidades (Key Responsibilities)

  •  Construir relacionamentos de confiança com stakeholders e executivos dos clientes, atuando como conselheiro(a) estratégico(a).
  • Liderar a estratégia de customer success da carteira: planos de sucesso e adoção, realização de valor, mitigação de riscos e preparação para renovação.
  • Conduzir revisões de negócio e executivas (EBRs), com foco em resultados mensuráveis.
  • Monitorar dados de uso e saúde dos clientes para antecipar riscos e oportunidades, liderando planos de ação para contas em risco.
  • Identificar oportunidades de expansão, upsell e cross-sell em parceria com Vendas e Gestão de Contas, e atuar com Produto, Suporte e Serviços Profissionais na defesa das necessidades dos clientes.
  • Manter CRM e sistemas de customer success atualizados e apoiar o time com mentoria e boas práticas.

Qualificações Obrigatórias (Required Qualifications)

  • Inglês avançado (obrigatório).
  • Graduação em Administração, Finanças, Ciências Contábeis, Tecnologia, Direito, Comércio Exterior ou áreas relacionadas.

Senior Product Manager, Data Platform

This is a rare opportunity to own a new market from day one. Noetica is Thomson Reuters’ AI-powered deal intelligence platform with 1.5B+ indexed terms from 3M+ transactions; it gives transactional professionals instant, data-driven benchmarking that doesn’t exist anywhere else in the market. Already trusted by many Am Law 200 firms, Noetica is now expanding beyond legal into Financial Services: a wide-open opportunity for fund managers, credit managers, and corporate treasuries who need deal-term intelligence to assess credit risk and structure transactions.

As a Senior Product Manager expansion, you will own the Noetica product and product strategy to open up this new market at scale. You’ll define what the product needs to be for a new class of customer, build the roadmap to get there, and work closely with engineering, go-to-market, and subject matter experts teams to make it real.

  • Own the market entry. Define and own the product vision and roadmap for Noetica Term Rating, turning signals from fund managers, credit managers, and private equity firms into a focused, deliverable plan.

  • Shape the platform. Drive investment in dedicated Financial Services capabilities, including term analytics, company data integrations, and the distinct data and UX requirements of each Financial Services persona.

job.title: Editorial Data Analyst
job.description:
Join our team at the Guardian and be a part of a diverse and inclusive global organisation that delivers fearless, investigative journalism, and holds power to account. Our team of award-winning journalists, cutting-edge commercial professionals, and industry-leading digital experts are committed to making a difference and represent a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives. We offer a challenging and exciting environment for career development, with a focus on training, growth and fostering an inclusive culture.

 

We are now looking for a Data Analyst to join our Editorial Analytics team. You’ll use data to help understand how our journalism reaches and engages readers, and supports decision making across the newsroom and wider business. 

 

About the role

  • Provide insights on reader engagement and content performance to inform newsroom strategy.
  • Develop an understanding of editorial workflows, audience behaviour and business priorities, and apply this context when interpreting data.
  • Communicate findings clearly, tailoring outputs to different audiences and explaining context and limitations.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering and other teams to support feature development, experimentation and performance analysis.
  • Work responsibly and ethically with data, following privacy and governance standards.

 

About you

  • Experience working with data using SQL (in a professional or academic setting).
  • Understanding of core analytical concepts (e.g. averages, distributions, basic statistical testing).
  • Familiarity with data visualisation tools (e.g. Tableau, Looker).
  • Ability to think logically about problems and break them down into manageable analyses.
  • Comfortable working with stakeholders and building positive working relationships.

We operate in a hybrid environment working 3 days a week from our offices in Kings Cross and 2 days a week remotely. 

We actively encourage applications from groups traditionally underrepresented in the UK media

 

We value and respect all differences (seen and unseen) in all people. We aspire to have inclusive working experiences and an environment that reflects the audience we serve, where our people have equal access to career development opportunities, their voices are heard and can contribute to our future. We actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds. Many of our staff work flexibly and we will consider all requests for flexible working arrangements.

 

How to apply

To apply, please upload your latest CV. You don't need to provide a cover letter. Instead, we have included a question on the application questionnaire relating to editorial analytics that we would like applicants to complete. This question should take about 5 minutes to answer, so please factor in the extra time when applying.

 

We appreciate the time taken to prepare each application we receive. We do not use AI-assisted technology to review applications; every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team. Thank you for bearing with us during the screening process. 

 

The closing date for applications is Wednesday 18th November 2026. 

 

All roles at the Guardian are open for everybody to apply. It is important to us that you feel supported and comfortable throughout your recruitment process, in order to perform your best. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to help your application, this includes providing documents in accessible formats or personalising the process to better support your needs. Please contact Anna Vipers on anna.vipers@guardian.co.uk to discuss further so we can work with you to support you through your application.

 

Benefits at the Guardian

You'll have 30 days of annual leave per year (plus bank holidays) with the option to purchase an additional 5 days. Our pension scheme is generous; if you contribute 5% then we will contribute 8-12% (depending on your age). We believe in giving back, which is why employees are given 2 volunteering days annually and the option of payroll giving. Season ticket loans are also available.

You are entitled to private healthcare, life cover, income protection, and eye tests. You can also opt in to dental insurance.

We have enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental leave policies in place. We also support our employees by offering an IVF, menopause, baby loss, and trans equality policy.

 

Culture and wellbeing

We want everyone to feel like they belong at the Guardian and we champion diversity of thought. Our various employee forums provide a platform to use their voice to foster an inclusive workplace. We became the first major media organisation to achieve B Corp status.

We offer tools to help you prioritise your wellbeing including access to our employee benefits platform which provides tailored support for health and wellbeing. In addition, we also offer free yoga and pilates classes. These run alongside our corporate gym membership and cycle to work scheme.

Our canteen has views overlooking the Regents Canal and caters for breakfast, lunch and dinner.

 

Learning and development

We encourage personal and professional growth. Employees have access to a broad range of tools and solutions, and we are happy to support the pursuit of professional qualifications through vocational courses and apprenticeships.

 

Guardian News and Media is proud to be a London Living wage employer. The minimum salary for any full-time role within the organisation is £30,000 per annum. Salary ranges are dependent on skills and experience.

job.title: Infrastructure Engineer
job.description:
Company Information
For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

Job Summary

The Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for implementing, securing and maintaining AEG's Information Technology (IT) and is responsible for ensuring the secure design of all environments across the AEG global enterprise. The Infrastructure Engineer will work closely with various team members to develop, deploy and implement infrastructure standards across multiple applications, ensuring, best practices, and operational efficiencies. This role work closely with other team members on projects, operational matters, overall service delivery and service transformation.

Essential Functions

  • Work to develop Office 365, VMware and other infrastructure tool configuration across the enterprise.
  • Develop architecture standards, designs and principles.
  • Document infrastructure designs and procedures to ensure compliance standards are met.
  • Write and maintain custom scripts to increase system efficiency and lower the human intervention time on any tasks.
  • Provide 2nd and 3rd level support through root-cause analysis, troubleshooting and collaboration across cross functional teams or vendors.
  • Assist with improving Global Technology customer support by mentoring and cross training others as needed.
  • Support and comply with all Cyber Security, Incident Responses, Compliance and Governance initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS Degree (4-year) Information Technology, Computer Science, or related technical area.
  • 4-6 years IT security solution implementation experience.
  • Experience with the integration of cloud services with on-premise technologies from Microsoft and other SaaS providers.
  • Experience with Infrastructure automation through a working understanding of code and script such as: PowerShell, Python, C#. Experience in Defender for 365 product and features Security.
  • Experience designing and/or implemented security architectures in cloud (Entra/Office 365) environments, and solutioned on-prem architectures and operating models.
  • Experience in Entra IAM solutions. Experience with Office 365 global administration, architecture and development.
  • Experience in writing high standard infrastructure configuration documentation.
  • Solid knowledge of security controls including tenant isolation, encryption at rest, encryption in transit, key management, vulnerability assessments, application firewalls, SIEM, etc.
  • In-depth understanding of security protocols, including but not limited to SSL/TLS, IPSec, SSH, and various encryption standards.
  • Demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, service, and technical challenges and provide solutions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to a non-technical audience.
  • Foundational knowledge of the ITIL framework, and IT Service Management.
  • Understanding of networking and core Internet Protocols such as TCP/IP, DNS, SMTP, HTTP and routing in distributed networks.
  • Strong knowledge on API designs and use to integrate services.
  • Understanding of security and compliance frameworks, standards and implementation in public cloud environments.
  • A thorough understanding of tools, policies and standards related to security systems and experience in executing incident response process and procedures.
  • Knowledge of Defender for Office 365 security tools
  • Project management skills with ability to influence change.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and root-cause analysis capabilities.

Pay Scale: $123,000.00 - $136,000.00

Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings.

AEG reserves the right to change or modify the employee’s job description whether orally or in writing, at any time during the employment relationship.  AEG may require an employee to perform duties outside their normal description.

AEG's policy is to hire the most qualified applicants, and we comply with all applicable federal, state and local employment laws in making hiring and employee decisions.  We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate against applicants or employees on the basis of race, color, marital status, disability, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected status recognized by applicable federal, state or local law.
