Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 500 million tickets sold annually and more than 12,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 40,000 shows and 100+ festivals annually for nearly 4,000 artists in over 40 countries. From our dozens of owned/operated Amphitheaters to our Global Touring team, from Ticketing and Venue Operations to Marketing and Sales... we foster a fun and upbeat work culture with no shortage of opportunities. With perks ranging from free concert tickets to dog-friendly offices, to progressive benefits like student loan reimbursement and adoption/fertility support... it’s no wonder we are certified as a Great Place to Work organization and one of People Magazine’s “50 Companies that Care”. We want everyone to feel like they belong and can thrive in our community, so we strive to help you achieve your career and personal goals. Live music is our passion and where we find our common ground. There has never been a better time to join Live Nation.

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

  • Maintain daily labor/timesheets
  • Conduct semi-annual evaluations of Vinyl Staff.  Propose raise recommendation to Assistant General Manager
  • Hold departmental staff meetings to keep everyone informed of the departments problems/progress
  • Oversee all schedules within Vinyl Rooms

job.title: Vibee - Marketing Manager
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE YOU?

Do you enjoy live events? Do you excel in fast paced, creative environments? Then you’re in luck! We are looking for a highly motivated self-starter who embodies both a passion for music and a love of the live event experience. Is this you? Read on…


WHO ARE WE?

Vibee builds unforgettable destination experiences for fans around the world. Founded by Live Nation, the world’s leading live entertainment company, Vibee provides fans the opportunity to immerse themselves in the best music and entertainment events on land and sea. From curated activations to bespoke festival packages, Vibee creates transformative moments in the most sought after destinations.


THE ROLE

The Marketing Manager at Vibee plays a critical role in driving the promotion of destination experiences, which combine entertainment, travel, and curated experiences into a seamless offering for fans. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of event, travel, and experiential marketing, while being adept in both traditional and digital marketing approaches. This position is note remote and is hybrid in office and on site at various event locations.


RESPONSIBILITIES


Strategic Marketing Development


  • Collaborate on Marketing Strategy: Partner with the Vice President of Marketing, Senior Marketing Manager, and other Vibee team members to define and refine the strategic direction for destination experiences and integration events. Ensure the alignment of marketing campaigns with overarching brand and business objectives.
  • Conceptualize Marketing Plans: Develop comprehensive marketing plans that leverage the full marketing mix, including social media, traditional advertising, influencer collaborations, PR, and digital marketing channels. Ensure these plans resonate with Vibee's target audience and foster deep engagement.
  • Innovative Campaign Ideation: Lead brainstorming sessions to generate creative marketing concepts that highlight the unique aspects of Vibee’s destination experiences, emphasizing exclusive offers like VIP experiences, bespoke packages, and immersive fan moments.

Marketing Execution & Campaign Management


  • Day-to-Day Campaign Management: Oversee the execution of marketing initiatives, ensuring that all campaigns are delivered on time, on brand, and within budget. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration across digital and traditional marketing channels.
  • Content and Social Media Strategy: Manage the content calendar for Vibee’s social media channels in partnership with the Digital Marketing Specialist. Ensure that content is strategically aligned, engaging, and supports both short-term campaigns and long-term brand positioning.
  • Integrated Marketing Efforts: Partner with the Digital Marketing Specialist to create and implement integrated campaigns that go beyond digital, incorporating tactics such as on-ground activations, email marketing, influencer outreach, and partnership marketing.
  • Digital Advertising Liaise with our outside agency on all digital advertising campaigns and manage all steps in the process including asset creation, budget management, and strategic planning.
  • Asset Creation: Initiate all assets needed for marketing campaign cycle.  Work closely with team designer on creative materials and necessary social media and traditional tools.

Budget & Financial Oversight


  • Budget Management: Take ownership of marketing budgets for assigned projects, working closely with the finance and accounts payable teams to ensure proper financial tracking and reporting. Secure necessary approvals for quotes, invoices, and marketing expenses, ensuring transparency and adherence to budget.
  • Financial Reporting: Provide regular updates on budget utilization, campaign ROI, and cost efficiency to the Vice President of Marketing and other key stakeholders.

Collaboration & Team Leadership


  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with the Project Manager and the broader Vibee team to track all marketing deliverables and timelines using internal project management systems. Ensure every aspect of a campaign, from concept to execution, is meticulously managed and delivered.
  • Vendor and Partner Management: Build and maintain relationships with external vendors and marketing partners, ensuring all third-party contributions are aligned with Vibee’s brand vision and quality standards.
  • Team Support and Coordination: Support the marketing team in identifying marketing assets, overseeing the development of tools, and ensuring internal processes are followed. Provide mentorship to junior team members and assist in optimizing team workflow.

Performance Analytics & Optimization


  • KPI Tracking & Reporting: Lead the analysis of key performance indicators (KPIs) for marketing campaigns. Use data to evaluate the success of ongoing initiatives, identify trends, and optimize future campaigns for greater effectiveness and efficiency.
  • Event Performance Evaluation: Analyze the outcomes of destination experiences and integration events, comparing them against established benchmarks. Use insights gained to recommend changes, optimizations, or new opportunities to further enhance fan engagement and event attendance.

Creative & Copy Development


  • Message Consistency: Ensure consistency in all marketing copy, collateral, and communication materials across channels. Oversee the development of messaging that accurately reflects the brand’s voice while catering to the unique needs of each destination experience.
  • Creative Collaboration: Work closely with internal and external creative teams to ensure all marketing materials—from visuals to copy—are innovative, impactful, and in line with Vibee’s brand identity.

Market Research & Trend Monitoring


  • Market Trend Analysis: Stay attuned to emerging trends in both travel and entertainment marketing. Identify new channels, opportunities, and tactics that Vibee can leverage to enhance fan engagement and stay ahead of the competition.
  • Fan Engagement Strategies: Monitor shifts in fan behavior and engagement preferences, continuously refining marketing strategies to align with evolving fan expectations.

Public Relations & Communication


  • Press and Media Collaboration: Coordinate with Vibee’s press and PR teams to craft compelling press releases and execute targeted publicity campaigns. Ensure seamless communication with external media partners to enhance the reach and impact of Vibee’s destination events.
  • Third-Party Campaign Coordination: Act as a liaison between Vibee and external marketing teams, ensuring cohesive and collaborative campaigns that are consistent across all partner channels.

Operational Support & Flexibility


  • Project Management Tools: Utilize and maintain project management tools to ensure clear communication and tracking of marketing tasks. Keep the entire team informed of campaign progress, deadlines, and deliverables.
  • Ad Hoc Duties: Provide support on additional marketing or operational projects as needed, displaying flexibility and willingness to adapt to changing priorities within a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3-5 years of marketing experience and/or live entertainment or hospitality/travel experience preferred
  • Understanding of financial and accounting standards
  • Strong technical skills in Microsoft Excel and Word, as well as Google Sheets and Docs (certification in Excel would be considered an asset)
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills; able to communicate effectively with employees at all levels
  • Strong analytical, financial modeling, and critical thinking skills with a creative approach to problem solving
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and adapt to changes in a rapidly evolving environment
  • Strong ability to manage many projects simultaneously
  • Flexible and reliable team player both with the department and within the organization as a whole
  • Must be an active problem solver, instilled with a sense of urgency for projects large and small

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Must be able to tolerate loud noise levels & busy environments on site at our events
  • May sit for extended periods of time and work in drastic temperature climates onsite at our events
  • Must be willing to work during evening and weekend hours, as required, to meet deadlines
  • Must be willing to travel as required both domestically and abroad, if required
  • Must have a current passport and be able to travel worldwide without restriction

Real Chemistry is looking for a Manager, Paid Search to join our growing Biddable Media team! 

A Manager, Paid Search is responsible for the end-to-end execution, performance, and day-to-day management of paid search campaigns across assigned accounts. This individual translates client objectives into tactical campaign strategies, owns campaign optimization and budget management, identifies opportunities for account growth, and communicates performance insights and recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders. The Manager also coordinates day-to-day projects and begins developing leadership skills by delegating work, overseeing campaign execution, and mentoring junior team members.

What You'll Do 

  • Own the day-to-day execution and performance of paid search campaigns across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and supporting search technologies, from planning and setup through launch, optimization, and reporting.

  • Own campaign pacing, budget management, and ongoing optimization, monitoring real-time performance and making data-driven adjustments to meet client KPIs and improve account performance.

  • Delegate and oversee campaign responsibilities assigned to Associates and Senior Associates, breaking down projects into manageable tasks and ensuring deliverables are accurate and timely. 
  • Mentor and train junior team members on platform execution, campaign processes, and best practices while continuing to develop people leadership capabilities.

job.title: Executive Assistant
job.description:
Opportunity  

Our Brunswick Arts team, known as B’Arts, is an international communications consultancy specialising in championing and protecting the reputations and interests of leading arts, cultural and charitable organisations worldwide. With teams in London, Dubai, Abu Dhabi, New York and Hong Kong, we work alongside some of the most prestigious institutions and exciting initiatives across the global cultural landscape.

We are looking for a highly organised, proactive and adaptable Executive Assistant to join our London team on a 12-month fixed-term contract. This is a pivotal role providing high-level support to two Partners, ensuring the smooth running of their day-to-day activities and anticipating their needs in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

The role is based in our London office Monday to Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on Fridays. The ideal candidate will be a confident self-starter who thrives in a creative and collaborative environment, bringing exceptional organisational skills, sound judgement, discretion and a genuine interest in the arts and cultural sector.

About the Role

As an Executive Assistant at Brunswick Arts, you will:

  • Provide comprehensive diary, inbox, and communications management for two Partners.
  • Organise and maintain Partner inboxes and diaries with a clear, structured system, using colour coordination and folders to ensure efficiency and visibility.
  • Prepare daily briefs and materials, ensuring leaders are fully equipped and informed for client meetings, events, and travel.
  • Draft, prioritise, and triage communications on behalf of senior leaders — from client correspondence to internal notes.
  • Manage complex international travel arrangements, including visas, itineraries, and on-the-ground logistics.
  • Coordinate high-profile client dinners, cultural events, and hospitality with creativity and attention to detail.
  • Oversee financial administration including expenses, billing, and budget tracking.
  • Submit and manage timesheets on behalf of the Partners, ensuring timely and accurate completion each week.
  • Serve as a trusted point of contact for clients and their offices, building relationships with professionalism, warmth, and discretion.
  • Ensure the quality and presentation of client-facing deliverables, from proposals to event materials.
  • Conduct research and compile insights to support client engagements and leadership decision-making.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of systems and workflows across the team.

What We're Looking For

We’re seeking someone who brings:

  • A genuine interest in the arts, culture and charitable sectors, with an enthusiasm for the work of Brunswick Arts (B’Arts) and the organisations and institutions we support across the global cultural landscape.
  • At least 4 years’ experience supporting senior leaders at Partner, Director or C-suite level, ideally within professional services, consultancy or the creative industries.
  • Exceptional organisational skills and sound judgement, with the ability to manage competing priorities, adapt to changing demands and maintain a high level of accuracy and discretion.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a polished, professional and adaptable communication style.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, alongside the confidence and willingness to embrace new digital tools and systems.
  • Strong financial administration skills and meticulous attention to detail, with experience managing expenses, invoicing, timesheets and budget tracking.
  • Proven relationship-building skills, with the confidence to engage effectively and establish trust with senior stakeholders, colleagues and clients.
  • A proactive, solutions-focused approach, with the ability to anticipate challenges, exercise initiative and navigate demanding situations with professionalism and diplomacy.
  • A calm composed and adaptable manner, with the ability to anticipate needs, remain one step ahead and deliver consistently under pressure.
  • A collaborative and team-oriented mindset, with a genuine commitment to contributing to a supportive, inclusive and high-performing assistant team.

Why Join Us

Whether you are joining a client-facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of exceptional employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development

About Brunswick

Brunswick is a global advisory firm. We help companies tackle high-stakes issues, navigate complex stakeholder relationships, and deliver high-impact outcomes. 

Our clients value our ability to anticipate, shape, and respond to the key players and forces in the financial and investment arena, regulatory and geopolitical universe, NGO community, workforce and beyond. They rely on us for deep experience, fresh perspectives and original thinking. So, in Brunswick you will find an exceptional range of experience and talent with a rich mix of backgrounds. From the beginning, we have prioritized attracting, developing, and retaining the best professionals in the industry, united by a culture of inclusivity, excellence, and intellectual curiosity.

Founded in 1987 in London, the firm has organically grown to 27 offices in 18 countries across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia and Australia. We operate as a “one-firm firm” with no individual profit centers.
